source_text: in the beginning god created the heavens and the earth.
target_text: uru-uru tèka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. and the spirit of god was hovering over the surface of the waters.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, aa'i-aa'i dhae mèci mèka. dhu abhu, èi. aa maroga aatu-aatu saguru nare ne. ka roh lamatua lela ètu dedha èi èèna.

source_text: and god said, let there be light, and there was light.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka, hud'i ku dènge saraa. ropa peka nare sèmi ne'e, ka saraa j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
target_text: ropa nèdhi saraa ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. hèia na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga, sèna ka èci-èci ka dènge taa na.

source_text: god called the light day, and the darkness he called night. and there was evening, and there was morning-the first day.
target_text: ka pangare saraa ne ‘mèu', aa maroga na ‘mèda'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èci kèna.

source_text: and god said, let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters. so god made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, na peka, hud'i dènge ku era talele, sèna ka hag'e eele èi. nèti èèna ka, èi re dedha, aa abhu kahèi èi re haha. ropa peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia èi b'agi dènge mi dua.

source_text: god called the expanse sky. and there was evening, and there was morning-the second day.
target_text: ka na pangare èi re dedha na, ‘liru'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka dua kèna.

source_text: and god said, let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear. and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, èi re haha hud'i pakaboko ku mi ca era, sèna ka abhu rai kamango. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka rai mango.

source_text: god called the dry land earth, and the gathering of waters he called seas. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka era rai mango, na pangare na ‘rai-dedha'; aa era èi dhu kaboko èèna, na pangare na ‘dhasi'. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: then god said, let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind. and it was so.
target_text: ka ama lamatua lii hari, peka na, rai hud'i pamamuri ku rupa-rupa ana aaj'u. sèna ka abhu aj'u dhu hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru. sèna ka aj'u-aj'u se, hua-hela madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka ana aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: the earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ètu dedha-rai, ana aaj'u se hua-hela ka madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and there was evening, and there was morning-the third day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka tèlu kèna.

source_text: and god said, let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years. and let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth. and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, aku nèngu na, re bèka dedha, hud'i abhu ku mèdha dhu saraa, ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. hud'i abhu mèdha dhu pasaraa re mèu, aa abhu kahèi dhu pasaraa re mèda. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, j'aj'i tadha, ho sèna ka bisa ige lod'o, hèru, dènge tèu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, mèdha dhu heo aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: god made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. and he made the stars as well.
target_text: ka na tao ka mèdha kapai dua dhu pasaraa rai-haha. dhu kapai risi, pasaraa re mèu; aa dhu ako ana iiki, pasaraa re mèda. aa na tao hua-hètu kahèi.

source_text: god set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
target_text: na tèke mèdha dhu saraa sèra ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka loti mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka mèdha se, pasaraa ka re mèu, aa pasaraa re mèda. dènge j'ara ne'e, na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and there was evening, and there was morning-the fourth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka èpa kèna.

source_text: and god said, let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua padhai lii hari, peka na, hud'i abhu ku ae-ae dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. dènge hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa manu-bhui dhu lela ètu dedha rai-haha ne.

source_text: so god created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every bird of flight after its kind. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka na tao ka i'a aa'i-aa'i dènge badha kapai dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. na paj'aj'i kahèi manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: then god blessed them and said, be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, peka na, i'a se, hud'i laa bèba-kacanga sèna ka papènu èi ètu mia-mia. aa manu-bhui, asa tabha kahèi.

source_text: and there was evening, and there was morning-the fifth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka lèmi kèna.

source_text: and god said, let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds. and it was so. god made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, na, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa badha dhu mamuri ètu rai-dedha. sèmi: badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, èci-èci ka dènge rupa na. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, badha aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: then god said, let us make man in our image, after our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, hua iia, mai ta paj'aj'i dhèu, madhutu rupa èdhi. hud'i laa ra leru dènge ator i'a aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, badha-manu dhu ani, dènge badha leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so god created man in his own image; in the image of god he created him; male and female he created them.
target_text: hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha ne madhutu rupa na. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: god blessed them and said to them, be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bèba-kacanga ku, sèna ka pea papènu rai-haha ne, ho mi ator ne. ja'a hia miu koasa, sèna ka mi ator i'a, manu-bhui, dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: then god said, behold, i have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. they will be yours for food.
target_text: mi nanene paie-iie! ja'a hia miu rupa-rupa nganga'a ètu rai-haha ne'e. sèmi: ana aaj'u dhu dènge hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru.

source_text: and to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth-everything that has the breath of life in it-i have given every green plant for food. and it was so.
target_text: ja'a hia rupa-rupa ana aaj'u kahèi sèna ka j'aj'i nganga'a badha. nganga'a hia badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, nganga'a badha sèra aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god looked upon all that he had made, and indeed, it was very good. and there was evening, and there was morning-the sixth day.
target_text: ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èna kèna.

source_text: thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and by the seventh day god had finished the work he had been doing; so on that day he rested from all his work.
target_text: ropa na sab'a èle, asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu. hèia na ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: then god blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on that day he rested from all the work of creation that he had accomplished.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, na tao lod'o ka pidhu ne, lod'o dhu kapai risi nèti lod'o dhu leo sèra. na tao sèmi èèna, lula na pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a na, ka ètu d'ara lod'o ka pidhu na, na ae.

source_text: this is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the lord god made them.
target_text: d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. lod'o ama lamatua heka paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha èèna,

source_text: now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted; for the lord god had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground. but springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
target_text: dhae abhu mèka ana aaj'u, lula na papuru mèka èj'i. taa èèna, dhoka sèb'u èi di, mai nèti d'ara rai ho pabasa rai re dedha. aa abhu mèka dhèu rai-haha dhu tao oka-tedhe.

source_text: then the lord god formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. hèia na tiu a'ae na asa d'ara sahènga dhèu na, ka na mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and the lord god planted a garden in eden, in the east, where he placed the man he had formed.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua bhoke oka cue ètu rai eden, re bèka dhimu. hèia na hia dhèu ne pea ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: out of the ground the lord god gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. and in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
target_text: ètu d'ara oka èèna, na pamamuri rupa-rupa aj'u dhu be'a, dhu dhèu bisa ra'a. aa na pamamuri kahèi aj'u dua kapua ètu talora aae oka èèna. ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci, na mamuri taa-taa. aa ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci hari, ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: now a river flowed out of eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu loko èci dhu hae nèti d'ara oka èèna. loko èèna, èpa kacanga.

source_text: the name of the first river is pishon; it winds through the whole land of havilah, where there is gold.
target_text: kacanga ka èci na, ngara na pison. nèngu ka dhu hae pale-lème rai hawila dhu abhu hualaa ae-ae.

source_text: and the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, abhu poe-pai, aj'u dhu raa na hèu mèngi, dènge hadhu kale'e.

source_text: the name of the second river is gihon; it winds through the whole land of cush.
target_text: kacanga ka dua, ngara na gihon. kacanga ne, hae pale-lème rai kus.

source_text: the name of the third river is hiddekel; it runs along the east side of assyria. and the fourth river is the euphrates.
target_text: kacanga ka tèlu, ngara na tigris. kacanga ne'e ka, j'aj'i mi too rai asyur re ca bèka dhimu. kacanga ka èpa, ngara na efrat.

source_text: then the lord god took the man and placed him in the garden of eden to cultivate and keep it.
target_text: ka ama lamatua hia dhèu pea ètu d'ara eden, ho na ladhe-leru oka èèna.

source_text: and the lord god commanded him, you may eat freely from every tree of the garden,
target_text: hèia na hia paredha mi dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne, èu bisa mu'a.

source_text: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.
target_text: te ngaa èci dhu èu bisa boe mu'a. nuka hua nèti aj'u dhu ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe. ladhe mu'a, èu madhe dènge.

source_text: the lord god also said, it is not good for the man to be alone. i will make for him a suitable helper.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu haru lii na, aku nèngu na, babe'a na aad'o, ladhe dhèu ne mamuri mesa na. de ja'a neo paj'aj'i hia ne, anga ca dhèu dhu pamèci dènge ne.

source_text: and out of the ground the lord god formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and he brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name. the man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. but for adam no suitable helper was found.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na tao rupa-rupa badha dènge manu-bhui. hèia na pangèd'u si asa dhèu ne, sèna ka na pangare si. ka dhèu ne pangare badha se dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra, èci-èci ka dènge ngara ra. te ngaa dhèu ne abhu mèka anga dhu pamèci dènge nèngu.

source_text: so the lord god caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, he took one of the man's ribs and closed up the area with flesh.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pabhèj'i luu dhèu ne'e. ropa na bhèj'i, ama lamatua nare rui karasa na calaa, ka na pakateme hari nu'a deo na.

source_text: and from the rib that the lord god had taken from the man, he made a woman and brought her to him.
target_text: nèti rui ne, na paj'aj'i bhèni ca dhèu. hèia na pangèd'u bhèni ne mi dhèu èèna.

source_text: and the man said: this is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman, ' for out of man she was taken.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi bhèni ne, ka dhèu na peka, aku nèngu na, waaa! ne'e ne ku! sèmi ne'e ku, heka pamèci dènge ja'a kèna! rui na, sama èci èèna ka dènge rui ja'a. aa isi na, sama kahèi dènge isi ja'a. lula nèngu ne, j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone, nèti èèna ka ja'a pangare ne, ‘dhèu bhèni'.

source_text: for this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, lula dua ra, j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: and the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dua ra dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ra makae boe.

source_text: now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that the lord god had made. and he said to the woman, did god really say, ‘you must not eat from any tree in the garden? '
target_text: nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, mege ka dhu mèu risi kapod'e-kabèli. ca lod'o, mege karèi bhèni na, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? ama lamatua kai miu baku mi'a hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne'e.

source_text: the woman answered the serpent, we may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden, but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, god has said, ‘you must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die. '
target_text: ka bhèni na b'ala, aad'o! ji'i bisa nga'a! dhodhoka aj'u ca kapua ètu talora oka ne, ama lamatua kai, baku nga'a hua na. na peka na, ji'i baku nga'a, aa baku g'ag'e hua èèna kahèi, te aad'o na, ji'i madhe!

source_text: you will not surely die, the serpent told her.
target_text: te ngaa mege na dhaa, aku nèngu na, waa! sèmi boe èèna! miu se madhe boe!

source_text: for god knows that in the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like god, knowing good and evil.
target_text: ama lamatua mema kai tare'a sèmi èèna, lula dhu ne'a le, ladhe mi'e hua aaj'u èèna, miu j'aj'i d'èlu-mèu sèmi nèngu. ho èèna na me'a mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: when the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. she also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.
target_text: aa bhèni ne ladhe na aj'u ne be'a titu kèna, dènge hua na ele boe kee. na ngee, ladhe ja'a ku'a hua aj'u ne'e, ja'a d'èlu-mèu. hèia puu nare ka hua aj'u èèna, ka na'e. na'e nare, nèti hia dhèu èmu na, ka na'a kahèi.

source_text: and the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; so they sewed together fig leaves and made coverings for themselves.
target_text: ra'a rare ka, heka re'a na rèngu dhu pake boe mèdha dhu hutu ua rèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra lui rèu aj'u ho pa'abhe era makae rèngu.

source_text: then the man and his wife heard the voice of the lord god walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of the lord god among the trees of the garden.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, dua ra tadèngi lii core haga ama lamatua ètu d'ara oka èèna. ka dua ra rai lasi lu'u asa ca bèka aj'u, sèna ka lamatua baku nèdhi si.

source_text: but the lord god called out to the man, where are you?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua paroa mi dhèu mone èèna, aku nèngu na, adam! èu ètu mia?

source_text: i heard your voice in the garden, he replied, and i was afraid because i was naked; so i hid myself.
target_text: hèia mone na dhaa, ja'a tadèngi lii lamatua ètu ne'e. te ngaa ja'a makae, lula ja'a pake boe mèdha ètu ua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a rai pahuni iisi.

source_text: who told you that you were naked? asked the lord god. have you eaten from the tree of which i commanded you not to eat?
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, cee ka dhu peka, na èu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake? de tasamia? tatu èu mu'a le hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai na, sina ma?

source_text: and the man answered, the woman whom you gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and i ate it.
target_text: ka na b'ala, peka na, bhèni dhu èu hia ho pa'anga dènge ja'a èèna, ka dhu hia ja'a ku'a!

source_text: then the lord god said to the woman, what is this you have done? the serpent deceived me, she replied, and i ate.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu ad'u madha j'ara èèna? ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te mege ne ka dhu ag'o ja'a! nèti èèna ka, ja'a ku'a.

source_text: so the lord god said to the serpent: because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! on your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua dhoo mege èèna, aku nèngu na, ja'a huku èu, lula tatao èu. nèti badha aa'i-aa'i, dhoka èu di dhu abhu huku sèmi ne'e. mulai nèti deo ne'e toke èu madhe, èu dhoka rod'o dènge kakara, aa mu'a ètu rai di.

source_text: and i will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.
target_text: ja'a tao sèna ka, èu loe boe pamusu dènge bhèni ne. aa ana-èpu miu dua mi sèmi èèna kahèi. ana-èpu èu, èèna na kadhi hui tèdhu dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu nèti ana-èpu bhèni ne, èèna na dhedhe palaho kètu èu.

source_text: to the woman he said: i will sharply increase your pain in childbirth; in pain you will bring forth children. your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni ne, èèna na, ja'a pasusa tabha èu, ropa èu dènge babia; lod'o mora iisi, èu asa tabha j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, d'ara èu d'èi taruu dhèu èmu èu, aa nèngu ka dhu ator èu.

source_text: and to adam he said: because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree of which i commanded you not to eat, cursed is the ground because of you; through toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge mone ne, èu madhutu boe lii paredha ja'a, te ngaa èu nanene dhoka lii dhèu èmu èu di, ka èu mu'a hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai èèna. nèti èèna ka, èu abhu huku kahèi. aa rai lèke huku kahèi. nèti deo ne'e, toke d'ai èu madhe, hud'i èu kabèli rai, heka èu abhu nganga'a kèna. dènge sab'a bia sèmi ne'e ka, èu heka mamuri kèna.

source_text: both thorns and thistles it will yield for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
target_text: masi ka èu sèle rupa-rupa hini èèna ka, te ngaa dhu muri mai dhodhoka dhudhu-sete di.

source_text: by the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground- because out of it were you taken. for dust you are, and to dust you shall return.
target_text: hud'i èu èi kabhèsu haa ku, heka rai hia èu nganga'a kèna. èu hud'i sab'a bia sèmi èèna ku, toke d'ai lod'o èu madhe. èu ne, ja'a paj'aj'i nèti rai. de ladhe èu madhe, èu j'aj'i hari rai.

source_text: and adam named his wife eve, because she would be the mother of all the living.
target_text: èle èèna ka, adam pangare dhèu èmu na ‘hawa' dhu sasoa na ‘dhu mamuri', te nèngu ka j'aj'i ina nèti dhèu dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the lord god made garments of skin for adam and his wife, and he clothed them.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua tao mèdha-papake nèti ka'uri badha, ka papake dua ra.

source_text: then the lord god said, behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. and now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka, limuri ne, dhèu re'a le, mia dhu be'a dènge mia dhu karehe, sèmi èdhi kahèi. de mage dhoka, rèngu ra'a hua aj'u dhu èci hari na, dhu hia mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: therefore the lord god banished him from the garden of eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na babèga eele si nèti d'ara oka eden èèna, ho lasi asa era leo, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge sab'e oka-tedhe. lula dhèu j'aj'i nèti rai, de mamuri kahèi nèti rai.

source_text: so he drove out the man and stationed cherubim on the east side of the garden of eden, along with a whirling sword of flame to guard the way to the tree of life.
target_text: babège nare si, ka lamatua paredha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, dhu dènge èla, ho lasi j'aga oka èèna re ca bèka dhimu. rèngu dènge samala dhu heo ha'a-ha'a, dhu seru la'e-mai. lamatua pua si bèdho eele j'ara la'e sa d'ara, te nèngu d'èi boe dhèu puu rare hua aj'u dhu hia ra mamuri taa-taa èèna.

source_text: and adam had relations with his wife eve, and she conceived and gave birth to cain. with the help of the lord i have brought forth a man, she said.
target_text: hèia adam j'unu dènge dhèu èmu na, hawa. ka bhèni ne dènge babia. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a abhu le ana mone ca dhèu, lula ama lamatua soru nare le ja'a. ka na pangare ana ne, kaen dhu sasoa na ‘abhu'.

source_text: later she gave birth to cain's brother abel. now abel was a keeper of sheep, while cain was a tiller of the soil.
target_text: hèia hawa nara iisi hari ana mone èci. ka na pangare ne habel. dua ra kapai ka, habel j'aj'i dhèu madhenge badha. aa a'a na kaen, sab'a oka-tedhe.

source_text: so in the course of time, cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the lord,
target_text: ca lod'o, kaen nèti isi rai na cahag'e, ka hia lamatua.

source_text: while abel brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock. and the lord looked with favor on abel and his offering,
target_text: habel nèti ana-ana uuru kahib'i-kalèbho na. na roro kahib'i-kalèbho se, ka nèti sisi dhu be'a hia lamatua. d'ara ama lamatua karej'e ropa ladhe nèdhi korban nèti habel ne.

source_text: but he had no regard for cain and his offering. so cain became very angry, and his countenance fell.
target_text: te ngaa na d'èi boe korban unu kaen. hèia kaen nasa bia, ka rèhu na mare boe.

source_text: why are you angry, said the lord to cain, and why has your countenance fallen?
target_text: ka lamatua lii dènge kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! nga tao ka èu nasa sèmi èèna, ka rèhu èu mare boe?

source_text: if you do what is right, will you not be accepted? but if you refuse to do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires you, but you must master it.
target_text: ladhe tatao èu be'a, na ja'a sèmi èu dènge hua iia. de mu pangee uuru ku! ladhe èu tao bhelu, na bhabhelu èèna na'e hari èu, sama sèmi meo neo pacèli maraho. de sèmi èu neo tao bhabhelu, be'a risi core eele ka!

source_text: then cain said to his brother abel, let us go out to the field. and while they were in the field, cain rose up against his brother abel and killed him.
target_text: ca tèka, kaen gale habel, na peka na, mai lati ngad'o oka, we. ropa dua ra d'ai d'ara oka, kaen kalabhe pamadhe ari na.

source_text: and the lord said to cain, where is your brother abel? i do not know! he answered. am i my brother's keeper?
target_text: ka lamatua karèi kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! ari mu ka mia? hèia kaen dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ke'a boe na ètu mia! èu ngee na, ja'a dhèu kèpe haga na, do?

source_text: what have you done? replied the lord. the voice of your brother's blood cries out to me from the ground.
target_text: ka lamatua b'ala, nga tao ka èu bhelu sèmi èèna? baku pangee na, èu pahuni more le raa ari èu ètu d'ara rai, te ja'a dhu kèdhi aa'i-aa'i le!

source_text: now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.
target_text: de lii dhoo lèke le mi dedha èu. lod'o èu pamadhe ari èu, rai sakid'o nare raa na. de limuri ne, rai bisa heka nèti mamuri mi èu.

source_text: when you till the ground, it will no longer yield its produce to you. you will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.
target_text: de ladhe èu sab'a oka-tedhe, rai ne hia heka èu ngaa-ngaa. nèti deo ne'e, èu lu'u sa haa-sa dhimu, sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era paleo-palu'u.

source_text: but cain said to the lord, my punishment is greater than i can bear.
target_text: te ngaa kaen b'ala lamatua, aku nèngu na, haii! ama lamatua, ee! lamatua dhoo ja'a bia titu kèna, de ja'a pasae mèke boe nga.

source_text: behold, this day you have driven me from the face of the earth, and from your face i will be hidden; i will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.
target_text: lula lamatua bège eele ja'a nèti era ne'e, ja'a kaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. ja'a kako lole-laa asa mia-mia. de ladhe paraga dènge dhèu, èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: not so! replied the lord. if anyone slays cain, then cain will be avenged sevenfold. and the lord placed a mark on cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, aad'o sèmi èèna! dhèu cee dhu pamadhe èu, èèna na ja'a huku ne, babia na pidhu hari risi nèti èu. hèia lamatua tao tadha mi kaen, sèna ka dhèu re'a ho baku pamadhe ne.

source_text: so cain went out from the presence of the lord and settled in the land of nod, east of eden.
target_text: hèia kaen tèke eele dènge era èèna. la'e pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, asa era èci, ètu bèka dhimu oka eden. era ne'e, ngara na nod dhu sasoa na, ‘lole-laa'. ka na pea ètu era èèna.

source_text: and cain had relations with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to enoch. then cain built a city and named it after his son enoch.
target_text: hèia kaen leo-èmu, ka dhèu èmu na dènge babia. ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na henok. hèia kaen patitu rae cue, ngara na henok, madhutu ngara ana na.

source_text: now to enoch was born irad, and irad was the father of mehujael, and mehujael was the father of methusael, and methusael was the father of lamech.
target_text: ka henok matana irad. hèia irad matana mehuyael. mehuyael matana metusael. aa ana metusael, lamek.

source_text: and lamech married two women, one named adah and the other zillah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek, dhèu dua. èci ngara na ada, aa ca dhèu hari, ngara na sila.

source_text: adah gave birth to jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock.
target_text: ana ada, ngara na yabal. ana-èpu na, j'aj'i dhèu piara badha. mamuri ra ètu boe ca era, aa ra pea dhoka ètu d'ara paleo di.

source_text: and his brother's name was jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.
target_text: ari yabal, ngara na yubal. ana-èpu yubal, j'aj'i dhèu gai sasadhu, dènge tiu sakino.

source_text: and zillah gave birth to tubal-cain, a forger of every implement of bronze and iron. and the sister of tubal-cain was naamah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek èci hari, sila, nara iisi tubal kaen. ana-èpu na j'aj'i tuka bèsi, ka ra tuku mèdha ae-ae tao nèti bèsi, dènge tabaga. ana hèni tubal kaen, ngara na na'ama.

source_text: then lamech said to his wives: adah and zillah, hear my voice; wives of lamech, listen to my speech. for i have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
target_text: ca tèka, lamek padedha iisi na ètu madha dhèu èmu dua ra, peka na, mi nanene, ee! deo na, ana mone ngèru èci neo game ja'a. te ngaa ja'a dhadhedhe ne, toke madhe.

source_text: if cain is avenged sevenfold, then lamech seventy-sevenfold.
target_text: dhèu dhu pamadhe kaen, abhu huku pidhu hari. te ngaa cee ka dhu neo b'ala ho pamadhe ja'a, abhu huku pidhu nguru pidhu hari.

source_text: and adam again had relations with his wife, and she gave birth to a son and named him seth, saying, god has granted me another seed in place of abel, since cain killed him.
target_text: ka hawa nara iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu. hèia ra pangare ne, set dhu sasoa na, ‘hia', lula aku hawa na, ama lamatua hia ja'a ana ne, sèna ka gati madha habel, dhu kaen pamadhe ne.

source_text: and to seth also a son was born, and he called him enosh. at that time men began to call upon the name of the lord.
target_text: pe d'ai nèbhu ku, set abhu ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na enos. tèu èèna, dhèu mulai manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: this is the book of the generations of adam. in the day that god created man, he made him in his own likeness. male and female he created them, and he blessed them. and in the day they were created, he called them man.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, na tao si sama sèmi rupa nèngu. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. ka na pangare si ‘dhèu rai-haha', aa na hia si berkat. dhèu dhu uru, ngara na adam. ana-èpu adam, nuka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: when adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him seth.
target_text: lod'o adam d'ai ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, dhu rèhu na nare adam. ka pangare na, set.

source_text: and after he had become the father of seth, adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka adam mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèu, hèia na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur adam ceo ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: when seth was 105 years old, he became the father of enosh.
target_text: lod'o set d'ai ca ngasu lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na enos.

source_text: and after he had become the father of enosh, seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka set mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur set ceo ngasu canguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: when enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of kenan.
target_text: lod'o enos mamuri d'ai ceo nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na kenan.

source_text: and after he had become the father of kenan, enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka enos mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu canguru lèmi tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur enos ceo ngasu lèmi tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: when kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of mahalalel.
target_text: lod'o kenan d'ai pidhu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na mahalalel.

source_text: and after he had become the father of mahalalel, kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka kenan mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu èpa nguru tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur kenan ceo ngasu canguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: when mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of jared.
target_text: lod'o mahalalel d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na yared.

source_text: and after he had become the father of jared, mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka mahalalel mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur mahalalel aru ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: when jared was 162 years old, he became the father of enoch.
target_text: lod'o yared d'ai cangasu èna nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na henok.

source_text: and after he had become the father of enoch, jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka yared mamuri d'ai aru ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur yared ceo ngasu èna nguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: when enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of methuselah.
target_text: ropa henok mamuri d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na metusalak.

source_text: and after he had become the father of methuselah, enoch walked with god 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ele èèna, henok mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua d'ai tèlu ngasu tèu. ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so enoch lived a total of 365 years. enoch walked with god, and then he was no more, because god had taken him away.
target_text: na mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. hèia lod'o na d'ai tèlu ngasu èna nguru lèmi tèu, ka na ele, lula ama lamatua paca'e ne sa dedha.

source_text: when methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of lamech.
target_text: lod'o metusalak d'ai cangasu aru nguru pidhu tèu, na matana ana mone èci, ngara na lamek.

source_text: and after he had become the father of lamech, methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: èle èèna ka, metusalak mamuri hari d'ai pidhu ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur metusalak ceo ngasu èna nguru ceo tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: when lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
target_text: lod'o lamek mamuri d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and he named him noah, saying, may this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the lord has cursed.
target_text: lamek pangare ne noh dhu sasoa na ‘pakarej'e d'ara', lula na peka na, ana ne, èèna na pakarej'e d'ara èdhi nèti sasab'a dhu bia, ètu rai dhu ama lamatua dhoo le.

source_text: and after he had become the father of noah, lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka lamek mamuri taruu d'ai lèmi ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, aa na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur lamek pidhu ngasu pidhu nguru pidhu tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: after noah was 500 years old, he became the father of shem, ham, and japheth.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na matana ana mone dhèu tèlu, sem, yafet dènge ham.

source_text: now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu rai-haha, asa bèba-kacanga. ka ra papala-palème rai-haha. dhèu se matana kahèi ana-ana bhèni.

source_text: the sons of god saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives whomever they chose.
target_text: ana-ana mone nèti lamatua ladhe rèdhi ana bhèni nèti dhèu rai-haha se, bhèni iia hua. ka lasi todhe rare ana bhèni mia dhu ra d'èi.

source_text: so the lord said, my spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a roca le dènge tatao dhèu dhu lèke-lèke boe se. roh ja'a dhu pamamuri rèngu sa, d'èi heka hia ra mamuri manèro. hud'i rèngu madhe ku. de èèna na, mamuri rèngu se dhoka d'ai ca ngasu dua nguru tèu di.

source_text: the nephilim were on the earth in those days-and afterward as well-when the sons of god had relations with the daughters of men. and they bore them children who became the mighty men of old, men of renown.
target_text: taa èèna, dènge taa-tebho dhu limuri nèti èèna hari, abhu le dhèu raksasa ètu rai-haha ne. ropa ana mone nèti lamatua leo rare ana bhèni dhèu rai-haha se, ka rara iisi dhèu kapai, nuka: kapala musu, dhèu re'a madhutu lii lolo uru-uru sèra.

source_text: then the lord saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
target_text: taa èèna, lamatua ladhe nèdhi bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha dhu seli-kolane. d'ara rèngu pangee dhoka bhabhelu di.

source_text: and the lord regretted that he had made man on the earth, and he was grieved in his heart.
target_text: ka lamatua manyasa, lula na paj'aj'i le rèngu se ho pea ètu rai-haha ne. tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu papèd'a d'ara lamatua.

source_text: so the lord said, i will blot out man, whom i have created, from the face of the earth-every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air-for i am grieved that i have made them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na peka na, dènge tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, ja'a huku pamadhe dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu paj'aj'i kore si le. manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, ja'a palaho aa'i si kahèi. te ja'a manyasa, nèti ja'a ka paj'aj'i si.

source_text: noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the lord.
target_text: te ngaa noh di dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: this is the account of noah. noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; noah walked with god. and noah had three sons: shem, ham, and japheth.
target_text: lii lolo noh sèmi ne'e ka: ana mone na, dhèu tèlu, nuka sem, yafet dènge ham. noh mamuri dènge mola, koe-kapengo boe. taa èèna, nèngu di dhu mamuri mola. d'ara na dhodhoka ètu ama lamatua.

source_text: now the earth was corrupt in the sight of god, and full of violence. and god looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt; for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo se, ama lamatua ladhe ra bhelu aa'i mèu-mèu. ètu mia-mia èèna ka, j'ara mamuri dhèu se ele iie aa'i. ama lamatua nèdhi dhodhoka bhabhelu di, ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: then god said to noah, the end of all living creatures has come before me, because through them the earth is full of violence. now behold, i will destroy both them and the earth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge noh, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi dhoka bhabhelu dhèu di, dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pama'ète kore le, sèna ka ja'a palaho aa'i rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, noh! èu tao kapa aae cue, dhu tao nèti aj'u adhu. re d'ara roa na, èu bagi mi kama-kama. aa re d'ara dènge li'u kapa, èu lame dènge èi dama.

source_text: and this is how you are to build it: the ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
target_text: mu sab'e kapa na, madhera na ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèlu meter; bhabhèla na dua nguru dua meter; dènge katitu na canguru tèlu meter.

source_text: you are to make a roof for the ark, finish its walls a cubit from the top, place a door in the side of the ark, and build lower, middle, and upper decks.
target_text: èu tao èmu ètu dedha kapa na. te ngaa paconga ca laa ai nèti kadidhi re dedha. èu bagi kapa ne mi tèlu tad'a. aa re karasa na, tao babèdho èci.

source_text: and behold, i will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. everything on the earth will perish.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bèli-camèd'a, ja'a papuru èi aae lala, ho pacène eele rai-haha ne, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: but i will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark-you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. èèna na, èu maso d'ara kapa èèna, mèti dènge dhèu èmu èu, ana-ana èu, dènge dhèu èmu ana-ana èu.

source_text: and you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark-male and female-to keep them alive with you. two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.
target_text: badha aa'i-aa'i ra, èu hag'e more ca pasa-ca pasa, eo mèti asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri dènge èu kahèi. sèmi: badha ani, manu-bhui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: you are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti dènge nganga'a-nganginu, pala miu dènge pala badha sèra hèi.

source_text: so noah did everything precisely as god had commanded him.
target_text: ka noh sab'e madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: then the lord said to noah, go into the ark, you and all your family, because i have found you righteous in this generation.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka dènge noh, ja'a ladhe le palème, te ngaa abhu dhoka èu di dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge bhèni-ana niki èu, lami ka asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: you are to take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate; a pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate; and seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air, male and female, to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.
target_text: mèti dènge badha-badha dhu bisa mi'a, aa bisa hia ja'a kahèi, de mèti pidhu-pidhu pasa asa d'ara kapa. mèti kahèi rupa-rupa manu-bhui pidhu-pidhu pasa. te ngaa badha dhu leo, mèti dhoka ca pasa-ca pasa di. sèna ka badha dènge manu-bhui se, j'aj'i hini, ho baku ma'ète.

source_text: for seven days from now i will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and i will wipe from the face of the earth every living thing i have made.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie, oo! di pidhu lod'o ka, ja'a papuru èj'i aae mai dhu bhoka boe ca lod'o sa, toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. dènge sèmi ne'e, ja'a pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai, dhu ja'a paj'aj'i kore le.

source_text: and noah did all that the lord had commanded him.
target_text: ka noh tao aa'i sèmi lii paredha lamatua.

source_text: now noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came upon the earth.
target_text: lod'o èi aae lala, umur noh èna ngasu tèu.

source_text: and noah and his wife, with his sons and their wives, entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
target_text: noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana niki na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana ra di, lasi asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: the clean and unclean animals, the birds, and everything that crawls along the ground came to noah to enter the ark, two by two, male and female, as god had commanded noah.
target_text: madhutu lii paredha lamatua, ka noh pamaso manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, èci-èci ka dènge pasa na, nèti dhu bisa ra'a, dènge dhu bisa boe ra'a.

source_text: and after seven days the floodwaters came upon the earth.
target_text: ropa èle pidhu lod'o, cag'ag'a laa èi aae lala, ka rai-haha ne, mulai cène.

source_text: in the six hundredth year of noah's life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
target_text: lèke dènge umur noh èna ngasu tèu, risi dua hèru, canguru pidhu lod'o, ka mulai èi aae lala. lod'o èèna, sèmi babèdho liru dhu bhoke eele sa, ka èi na tao sabhori mai. aa èi madha-èi madha ètu rai-haha sabhoka, ka sèmi tao sabhuu sa dedha.

source_text: and the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
target_text: ka èj'i bhori mai loe boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda.

source_text: on that very day noah entered the ark, along with his sons shem, ham, and japheth, and his wife, and the three wives of his sons-
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana mone na dhèu tèlu: sem, yafet dènge ham, dènge dhèu èmu ra, maso lasi asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: they and every kind of wild animal, livestock, crawling creature, bird, and winged creature.
target_text: lasi palere dènge badha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, manu-bhui, dènge badha-badha leo dhu dènge èla sèra.

source_text: they came to noah to enter the ark, two by two of every creature with the breath of life. and they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as god had commanded noah. then the lord shut him in.
target_text: ca pasa-ca pasa nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, lasi asa d'ara kapa palere dènge noh, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ropa aa'i-aa'i ra d'ai d'ara kapa, lamatua bèdho babèdho kapa èèna.

source_text: for forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and the waters rose and lifted the ark high above the earth. so the waters continued to surge and rise greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the waters. finally, the waters completely inundated the earth, so that all the high mountains under all the heavens were covered.
target_text: èj'i aae puru ma'ète boe d'ai èpa nguru lod'o. hèia kapa èèna taleb'o. èi ca'e loe boe toke hutu nare kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae.

source_text: the waters rose and covered the mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
target_text: èi ca'e taruu, ka marèma na seli èpa rèpa risi nèti kolo ledhe sèra.

source_text: and every living thing that moved upon the earth perished-birds, livestock, animals, every creature that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind. of all that was on dry land, everything that had the breath of life in its nostrils died. and every living thing on the face of the earth was destroyed-man and livestock, crawling creatures and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth, and only noah and those with him in the ark remained.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai sèra, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. nuka: dhèu, badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. ate dhoka noh dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa.

source_text: and the waters prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.
target_text: èi na, kura boe toke ca ngasu lèmi nguru lod'o.

source_text: but god remembered noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark. and god sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to subside.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe noh si dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa. hèia na hia ngèlu g'oro, ka èi na kura ka noo-noo.

source_text: the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
target_text: na katange èi madha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa na taha èj'i kahèi.

source_text: the waters receded steadily from the earth, and after 150 days the waters had gone down.
target_text: ka èi kura noo-noo ka. d'ai cangasu lèmi nguru lod'o, èi marèma heka.

source_text: on the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of ararat.
target_text: lèke dènge hèru ka pidhu, risi canguru pidhu lod'o, kapa eta ètu kolo ledhe aae èci, ngara na ararat.

source_text: and the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.
target_text: èi kura taruu toke lod'o ka èci, hèru ka canguru, ka kolo-kolo ledhe cèu noo-noo.

source_text: after forty days noah opened the window he had made in the ark
target_text: risi nèti èpa nguru lod'o, hèia noh bhoke jendela èci.

source_text: and sent out a raven. it kept flying back and forth until the waters had dried up from the earth.
target_text: ka na patalale lakaa ci'u. manu-bhui ne lela la'e-mai, toke èi puru. ka na lèpa heka asa kapa.

source_text: then noah sent out a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground.
target_text: hèia noh patabuli hari, koro j'aha ci'u, sèna ka neo ne'a èi na puru le, do dhae.

source_text: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned to him in the ark, because the waters were still covering the surface of all the earth. so he reached out his hand and brought her back inside the ark.
target_text: te ngaa, lula èi hutu nare dedha-rai era, ka koro ne abhu boe era tèka. ka lèpa hari asa kapa. hèia noh j'ole ai na, kèpe nare, ka na pamaso hari asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: noah waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
target_text: ka noh tatae hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patabuli hari koro j'aha deo na.

source_text: and behold, the dove returned to him in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak. so noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia sa, koro ne lèpa hari la'e asa noh, tutu nèti dènge rèu saitun ca rèu dhu heka tutu nare kèna. nèti èèna ka, noh heka ne'a kèna, èi na dhu puru le tare'a di.

source_text: and noah waited seven more days and sent out the dove again, but this time she did not return to him.
target_text: ka na mate hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patalale hari koro j'aha ca hari ni. te ngaa ca tèka ne, koro ne lèpa heka.

source_text: in noah's six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters had dried up from the earth. so noah removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai èna ngasu ca tèu, lèke lod'o ka èci hèru èci, èi mèti aa'i le. hèia noh bhoke jendela, ka na ladhe palème, nèdhi rai dhu mango le.

source_text: by the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was fully dry.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka dua, lod'o ka dua nguru pidhu, dedha-rai ne dhu mango meto le.

source_text: then god said to noah,
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge noh,

source_text: come out of the ark, you and your wife, along with your sons and their wives.
target_text: noh! aa'i-aa'i mi puru ka nèti dedha kapa èèna.

source_text: bring out all the living creatures that are with you-birds, livestock, and everything that crawls upon the ground-so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.
target_text: papuru aa'i badha-manu sèra! nuka: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. hud'i si, sèna ka ra bèba, papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so noah came out, along with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives. every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird-everything that moves upon the earth-came out of the ark, kind by kind.
target_text: èle èèna ka, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana-ana na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana na sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra puru nèti dedha kapa èèna. badha se, aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua ka madhutu anga ra èci-èci.

source_text: then noah built an altar to the lord. and taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.
target_text: hèia noh pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban hia lamatua. nèti badha-badha dhu bisa ra'a sèra, noh nare ci'u-ci'u, ka na roro, tunu ètu dedha mei deo na, ho j'aj'i mi tadha makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: when the lord smelled the pleasing aroma, he said in his heart, never again will i curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. and never again will i destroy all living creatures as i have done.
target_text: ropa lamatua sangèd'u nare hèu gèmu korban deo na, d'ara na karej'e. ka na ngee na, nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a huku heka rai-haha ne, lula bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu. masi ka rèngu dhoka ngee bhabhelu di, ja'a pa'ele iie heka ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, sèmi dhu ja'a heka tao kore èèna.

source_text: as long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha ne era, hèru dènge tèu, kako madhutu atora. sèmi: hèru sèla dènge hèru puu-g'ètu, hèru pacuhi dènge hèru sagoro, hèru hadhu dènge hèru èj'i lai, mèu dènge mèda.

source_text: and god blessed noah and his sons and said to them, be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pala-bagi berkat mi noh dènge ana-ana na, peka na, miu matana pa'ae-ae, sèna ka papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: the fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. they are delivered into your hand.
target_text: ladhe èèna na, badha hui, manu-bhui dènge i'a aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge miu. miu ka dhu ator si.

source_text: everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as i gave you the green plants, i now give you all things.
target_text: sisi badha aa'i-aa'i, miu bisa mi'a, sèmi dhu mi'a hua-hela, dènge rèu ana aaj'u se. aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a hia miu.

source_text: but you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
target_text: dhoka sisi dhu dènge raa era, miu madha mèu mi'a, lula samanga badha ètu raa na.

source_text: and surely i will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. i will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man: whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in his own image god has made mankind.
target_text: ja'a paj'aj'i dhèu madhutu raropa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, baku pamadhe dhèu. ladhe abhu dhèu, do badha, dhu pamadhe dhèu, na, pamadhe ne kahèi. ne'e, lii paredha nèti ja'a.

source_text: but as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.
target_text: miu se hud'i matana pa'ae-ae ku, sèna ka papènu hari rai-haha ne.

source_text: then god said to noah and his sons with him,
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na,

source_text: behold, i now establish my covenant with you and your descendants after you,
target_text: de ne'e ne, ja'a pajaji dènge miu, toke d'ai lai ana lai èpu.

source_text: and with every living creature that was with you-the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth-every living thing that came out of the ark.
target_text: lii pajaji ne, lèke kahèi mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, dènge manu-bhui. peka ka laa, lèke aa'i-aa'i dhu kalua palere-lere dènge miu nèti dedha kapa.

source_text: and i establish my covenant with you: never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a hia heka èi aae lala, ho pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, aa dènge pa'ele iie rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god said, this is the sign of the covenant i am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come: i have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
target_text: ja'a pasa saroo ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha pasanèd'e lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe dènge miu, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, aa dènge rai-haha ne.

source_text: whenever i form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds, i will remember my covenant between me and you and every living creature of every kind. never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life. and whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, i will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between god and every living creature of every kind that is on the earth. so god said to noah, this is the sign of the covenant that i have established between me and every creature on the earth.
target_text: ladhe abhu ra'i-liru, ho saroo cèu, èèna na pasanèd'e ja'a nèti lii pajaji èèna. na peka na, èi aae pa'ele iie heka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri. dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe, pa'èki tèke le dènge miu, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: the sons of noah who came out of the ark were shem, ham, and japheth. and ham was the father of canaan.
target_text: ana-ana noh dhu puru nèti dedha kapa, sem, yafet dènge ham ham èèna, ama kana'an.

source_text: these three were the sons of noah, and from them the whole earth was populated.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i nèti ana noh dhèu tèlu sèra.

source_text: now noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
target_text: noh èèna, dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. nèngu ka dhu uru j'ara tao oka anggor.

source_text: but when he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and uncovered himself inside his tent.
target_text: ca tèka, na ninu èi anggor, ka na mahu titu kèna. hèia na puru eele mèdha-papake nèti ua na. ka na j'unu lega-loli dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu d'ara paleo na.

source_text: and ham, the father of canaan, saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers outside.
target_text: ropa ham ladhe nèdhi era makae ama na, ka rai li'u la'e, lolo dènge a'a na, sem dènge yafet.

source_text: then shem and japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father's nakedness. their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father's nakedness.
target_text: hèia dua ra rare sig'i-kalolo ca bèla, ka ra bhoke mema ètu kabela-kao ra. ka dua ra kako kabodho lasi asa d'ara paleo ama ra, sèna ka ra pahutu mi ngi'u na. dènge sèmi èèna, rèdhi boe era makae ama ra. èle èèna ka, ra kalua sa li'u.

source_text: when noah awoke from his drunkenness and learned what his youngest son had done to him,
target_text: ropa noh mase'a, na ne'a tatao nèti ana limuri na, ham.

source_text: he said, cursed be canaan! a servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, he! ama kana'an! ja'a dhoo èu! èu ne, èèna na j'aj'i ènu nèti a'a mu si!

source_text: he also declared: blessed be the lord, the god of shem! may canaan be the servant of shem.
target_text: koa-kio lamatua, lula sem! te ngaa kana'an j'aj'i ènu sem.

source_text: may god expand the territory of japheth; may he dwell in the tents of shem, and may canaan be his servant.
target_text: hud'i laa, ama lamatua pataleo rai unu yafet. aa ana-èpu na mamuri mera-milu dènge ana-èpu sem. te ngaa hud'i kana'an j'aj'i ènu yafet.

source_text: after the flood, noah lived 350 years.
target_text: nèti èle èi aae lala, noh mamuri era d'ai tèlu ngasu lèmi nguru tèu.

source_text: so noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
target_text: umur noh d'ai ceo ngasu lèmi nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: this is the account of noah's sons shem, ham, and japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
target_text: èle èi aae, ka ana-ana noh abhu ana-èpu. nuka ana-èpu nèti sem, yafet, dènge ham.

source_text: the sons of japheth: gomer, magog, madai, javan, tubal, meshech, and tiras. the sons of gomer: ashkenaz, riphath, and togarmah. and the sons of javan: elishah, tarshish, the kittites, and the rodanites. from these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
target_text: ana-èpu yafet, nuka: gomer, magog, madai, yawan, tubal, mesek dènge tiras. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra. ana-èpu gomer, ka: askenas, rifat dènge togarma. ana-èpu yawan, ka: elisa, tarsis, dhèu kitim, dènge dhèu dodanim dhu pea ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: the sons of ham: cush, mizraim, put, and canaan.
target_text: ana-èpu ham, ka: kus, misraim, put, dènge kana'an.

source_text: the sons of cush: seba, havilah, sabtah, raamah, and sabteca. and the sons of raamah: sheba and dedan.
target_text: ana-èpu kus, ka: seba, hawila, sabta, raema dènge sabteka. ana-èpu raema, ka: syeba dènge dedan.

source_text: cush was the father of nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
target_text: ana mone kus, ka, nimrod. nèngu ne, kapala musu dhu uru tèka, aa èra.

source_text: he was a mighty hunter before the lord; so it is said, like nimrod, a mighty hunter before the lord.
target_text: a'èra na mai nèti lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha. nèti èèna ka, dhèu biasa peka na, sèna ka èu more dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha, sèmi nimrod, dhu abhu a'èra nèti lamatua.

source_text: his kingdom began in babylon, erech, accad, and calneh, in the land of shinar.
target_text: era na, mulai uru nèti rae babel, erek akad, toke kalne. rae se aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu rai sinear.

source_text: from that land he went forth into assyria, where he built nineveh, rehoboth-ir, calah,
target_text: nèti era sèra, na nare hari asyur. ka na patitu kota niniwe, rehobot-ir, kala,

source_text: and resen, which is between nineveh and the great city of calah.
target_text: dènge resen, ètu talora aae niniwe dènge kala. aa'i-aa'i sèra, kota-kota kapai hua.

source_text: mizraim was the father of the ludites, the anamites, the lehabites, the naphtuhites,
target_text: ana-èpu misraim, ka: dhèu ludim, dhèu ananim, dhèu lehabim, dhèu naftuhim,

source_text: the pathrusites, the casluhites from whom the philistines came, and the caphtorites.
target_text: dhèu patrusim, dhèu kasluhim, dènge dhèu kaftorim. dhèu kasluhim nuka bèi-baki nèti dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and canaan was the father of sidon his firstborn, and of the hittites,
target_text: ana uuru kana'an, nuka, sidon. kana'an j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu het,

source_text: the jebusites, the amorites, the girgashites,
target_text: dhèu yebusi, dhèu amori, dhèu girgasi,

source_text: the hivites, the arkites, the sinites,
target_text: dhèu hiwi, dhèu arki, dhèu sini,

source_text: the arvadites, the zemarites, and the hamathites. later the canaanite clans were scattered,
target_text: dhèu arwadi, dhèu semari, dènge dhèu hamati. ana-èpu kana'an se, pea palème d'ai era dhu kaj'èu,

source_text: and the borders of canaan extended from sidon toward gerar as far as gaza, and then toward sodom, gomorrah, admah, and zeboiim, as far as lasha.
target_text: toke too rai rèngu mulai nèti sidon taruu asa gerar, d'ai gasa. nèti èèna, la'e d'ai sodom, gomora, adma dènge seboim, d'ai kota lasa.

source_text: these are the sons of ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, ana-èpu ham. èci-èci dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: and sons were also born to shem, the older brother of japheth; shem was the forefather of all the sons of eber.
target_text: sem, a'a yafet, nèngu ka j'aj'i bèi-baki dhèu eber.

source_text: the sons of shem: elam, asshur, arphaxad, lud, and aram.
target_text: ana-èpu sem, ka: elam, asyur, arpaksad, lud dènge aram.

source_text: the sons of aram: uz, hul, gether, and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: arphaxad was the father of shelah, and shelah was the father of eber.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: two sons were born to eber: one was named peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named joktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: and joktan was the father of almodad, sheleph, hazarmaveth, jerah,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: hadoram, uzal, diklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: obal, abimael, sheba,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: ophir, havilah, and jobab. all these were sons of joktan.
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: their territory extended from mesha to sephar, in the eastern hill country.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: these are the sons of shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: all these are the clans of noah's sons, according to their generations and nations. from these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech.
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: and as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of shinar and settled there.
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and they said to one another, come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly. so they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of mortar. come, they said, let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: then the lord came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: and the lord said, if they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: come, let us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another's speech.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: so the lord scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: that is why it is called babel, for there the lord confused the language of the whole world, and from that place the lord scattered them over the face of all the earth.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: this is the account of shem. two years after the flood, when shem was 100 years old, he became the father of arphaxad.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: and after he had become the father of arphaxad, shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of shelah.
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: and after he had become the father of shelah, arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of eber.
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: and after he had become the father of eber, shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when eber was 34 years old, he became the father of peleg.
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: and after he had become the father of peleg, eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of reu.
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: and after he had become the father of reu, peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when reu was 32 years old, he became the father of serug.
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: and after he had become the father of serug, reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when serug was 30 years old, he became the father of nahor.
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: and after he had become the father of nahor, serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of terah.
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: and after he had become the father of terah, nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when terah was 70 years old, he became the father of abram, nahor, and haran.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: this is the account of terah. terah became the father of abram, nahor, and haran. and haran became the father of lot.
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: during his father terah's lifetime, haran died in his native land, in ur of the chaldeans.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: and abram and nahor took wives for themselves. abram's wife was named sarai, and nahor's wife was named milcah; she was the daughter of haran, who was the father of both milcah and iscah.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: but sarai was barren; she had no children.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: and terah took his son abram, his grandson lot son of haran, and his daughter-in-law sarai the wife of abram, and they set out from ur of the chaldeans for the land of canaan. but when they arrived in haran, they settled there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: terah lived 205 years, and he died in haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: then the lord said to abram, leave your country, your kindred, and your father's household, and go to the land i will show you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: i will make you into a great nation, and i will bless you; i will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: i will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: so abram departed, as the lord had directed him, and lot went with him. abram was seventy-five years old when he left haran. and abram took his wife sarai, his nephew lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired in haran, and set out for the land of canaan. when they came to the land of canaan,
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the oak of moreh at shechem. and at that time the canaanites were in the land.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: then the lord appeared to abram and said, i will give this land to your offspring. so abram built an altar there to the lord, who had appeared to him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: from there abram moved on to the hill country east of bethel and pitched his tent, with bethel to the west and ai to the east. there he built an altar to the lord, and he called on the name of the lord.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and abram journeyed on toward the negev.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na pidha-pidha era, d'ai rai negeb re ca bèka balèu nèti rai kana'an.

source_text: now there was a famine in the land. so abram went down to egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
target_text: ca tèka, rai kana'an lèke manganga aae. nèti èèna ka, abram si lasi asa bèka balèu, ka ra d'ai rai masir. ka ra manubha taha ètu nèi.

source_text: as he was about to enter egypt, he said to his wife sarai, look, i know that you are a beautiful woman,
target_text: ropa oe d'ai masir, abram peka dènge dhèu èmu na, sarai, aku nèngu na, sarai, èu bhèni iia, nia boe.

source_text: and when the egyptians see you, they will say, ‘this is his wife. ' then they will kill me but will let you live.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu masir rèdhi èu bhèni iia sèmi ne'e, mage dhoka ra pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a dhèu èmu-kamali èu. dènge sèmi èèna, ra parame rare èu.

source_text: please say you are my sister, so that i will be treated well for your sake, and on account of you my life will be spared.
target_text: de be'a risi, èu peka dènge ra, na ja'a ne, ana mone èu. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu pamadhe boe ja'a, aa ra be'a-be'a dènge ja'a, lula èu ne.

source_text: so when abram entered egypt, the egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
target_text: ropa abram si d'ai masir, dhèu ètu èèna, ladhe laa na, sarai ne bhèni iia titu kèna.

source_text: when pharaoh's officials saw sarai, they commended her to him, and she was taken into the palace of pharaoh.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a dhèu aae sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, aa ra koa bhabhèni iia na ètu madha dhèu aae. ka rèti bhèni ne, asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: he treated abram well on her account, and abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae be'a-be'a ka dènge abram, lula sarai. ka na parasee abram mèdha rupa-rupa. nuka badha sèmi: kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia, sapi, keled'ei, dènge onta. na parasee kahèi, ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: the lord, however, afflicted pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of abram's wife sarai.
target_text: lula na nare dhèu èmu dhèu asa d'ara èmu na, nèti èèna ka, lamatua hia huku rupa-rupa mi dhèu aae dènge isi èmu na.

source_text: so pharaoh summoned abram and asked, what have you done to me? why didn't you tell me she was your wife?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae masir paroa abram, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne tao tasamia mi ja'a ne? nga tao ka èu peka boe na, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu?

source_text: why did you say, ‘she is my sister, ' so that i took her as my wife? now then, here is your wife. take her and go!
target_text: te ngaa aku èu na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu! nèti èèna ka, ja'a oe kore ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu ja'a! dhèu èmu èu ka ne'e! more hari ka, aa pakaj'èu ka nèti madha ja'a!

source_text: then pharaoh gave his men orders concerning abram, and they sent him away with his wife and all his possessions.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu sab'a na sèra, babège eele abram, dhèu èmu na, rèti dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua nèti rai èèna.

source_text: so abram went up out of egypt into the negev-he and his wife and all his possessions-and lot was with him.
target_text: ka abram si tèke eele masir, lasi asa rai negeb. la'e dènge dhèu èmu na, aa dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. ana ari na lot madhutu ra kahèi.

source_text: and abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.
target_text: abram èèna, kaja ae titu kèna. badha-manu na, mèdha hualaa dènge mèdha hualaa-pudhi na, ae titu kèna.

source_text: from the negev he journeyed from place to place toward bethel, until he came to the place between bethel and ai where his tent had formerly been pitched,
