target_text: nèti negeb, ra pidha-pidha era, ka d'ai hari talora rae betel dènge rae ai. dhu uru èèna, ra pea rèdhi le ètu era èèna.

source_text: to the site where he had built the altar. and there abram called on the name of the lord.
target_text: aa dhu abram patitu le kahèi mei korban, ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua ètu era èèna.

source_text: now lot, who was traveling with abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
target_text: lot dhu madhutu abram èèna, unu badha-manu dènge dhèu sab'a ae kahèi.

source_text: but the land was unable to support both of them while they stayed together, for they had so many possessions that they were unable to coexist. and there was discord between the herdsmen of abram and the herdsmen of lot. at that time the canaanites and the perizzites were also living in the land.
target_text: te ngaa era èèna taleo boe, ho abram dènge lot aa dènge kakaja ra bisa pea pa'èci. nèti èèna ka, ana madhenge badha abram dènge lot sèra j'aj'i patao-palaha, lula j'u'u ètu era èèna d'ai boe hia badha rèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu feris, dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: so abram said to lot, please let there be no contention between you and me, or between your herdsmen and my herdsmen. after all, we are brothers.
target_text: ka abram peka dènge lot, aku nèngu na, èdhi se, pa'a'ari. mage dhoka èdhi, èci dènge èci be'a boe, lula dhèu sab'a èdhi se patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: is not the whole land before you? now separate yourself from me. if you go to the left, i will go to the right; if you go to the right, i will go to the left.
target_text: de hua iia dua ti pahag'a ka laa. rai ne, taleo. de ladhe èu d'èi rai ca bèka kariu na, ja'a abhu re ca bèka g'ana. te ngaa ladhe èu d'èi re ca bèka g'ana, na ja'a re ca bèka kariu.

source_text: and lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the jordan, all the way to zoar, was well watered like the garden of the lord, like the land of egypt. this was before the lord destroyed sodom and gomorrah.
target_text: hèia lot ladhe palème. ka na ladhe nèdhi rai taleo ètu sebhe loko yarden dhu madha èi ae, toke d'ai rae soar. era ne, rai hèu mèngi sama sèmi oka lamatua, dènge rai masir kahèi. lod'o èèna, lamatua dhae huku mèka kota sodom dènge kota gomora. de rai èèna, be'a era.

source_text: so lot chose the whole plain of the jordan for himself and set out toward the east. and abram and lot parted company.
target_text: hèia lot pili nare era sebhe loko yarden èèna. ka dua ra pahag'e ka. de lot la'e sa ca bèka dhimu.

source_text: abram lived in the land of canaan, but lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward sodom.
target_text: te ngaa abram pea taruu ètu rai kana'an. aa lot la'e pea ètu rae-rae dhu padètu dènge kota sodom ètu sebhe loko yarden.

source_text: but the men of sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against the lord.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu sodom sèra bhelu-katub'a titu kèna. rèngu ro'o boe nanene lamatua.

source_text: after lot had departed, the lord said to abram, now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,
target_text: ropa lot pacèri dènge abram, ka lamatua padhai lii dènge abram, peka na, èu ladhe palème aa'i ku, rai aa'i-aa'i nèti era titu èu èèna. ladhe paie re madha, re kabodho, re ca bèka g'ana, dènge ca bèka kariu mu.

source_text: for all the land that you see, i will give to you and your offspring forever.
target_text: rai aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi sèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu, dènge ana-èpu èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka ra, toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: i will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if one could count the dust of the earth, then your offspring could be counted.
target_text: èèna na ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu èu ae sama sèmi salae dhasi, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: get up and walk around the land, through its length and breadth, for i will give it to you.
target_text: de lamu kako palème madhutu madhera dènge bhabhèla na. te rai se aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a hia mi èu.

source_text: so abram moved his tent and went to live near the oaks of mamre at hebron, where he built an altar to the lord.
target_text: hèia abram si lèpa hari asa era pea ra, dhu dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae ètu mamre, dhu padètu dènge hebron. èle èèna ka, na pudhi hadhu tao mei korban ho na mangaj'i lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: in those days amraphel king of shinar, arioch king of ellasar, chedorlaomer king of elam, and tidal king of goiim
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae èpa dhu pa'èci. rèngu se ka: amrafel, dhèu aae rai sinear. ariok, dhèu aae rai elasar, kedarlaomer, dhèu aae rai elam. dènge tideal, dhèu aae rai goyim.

source_text: went to war against bera king of sodom, birsha king of gomorrah, shinab king of admah, shemeber king of zeboiim, and the king of bela that is, zoar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae leo dhèu lèmi, pa'èci kahèi. nuka: bera, dhèu aae rai sodom. birsa, dhèu aae rai gomora. sinab, dhèu aae rai adema. semeber, dhèu aae rai seboim. dènge bela, dhèu aae rai soar. ka èpa dhèu aae se, lasi pamusu dènge lèmi dhèu aae sèra.

source_text: the latter five came as allies to the valley of siddim that is, the salt sea.
target_text: dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi sèra pakaboko dènge sordad'u ra, ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, dhu limuri ne, ngara na dhasi madhe.

source_text: for twelve years they had been subject to chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i pamusu na, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi se dhu ta'alo mi dhèu aae kedarlaomer, canguru dua tèu kèna. te d'ai tèu ka canguru tèlu, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lab'a ne.

source_text: in the fourteenth year, chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the rephaites in ashteroth-karnaim, the zuzites in ham, the emites in shaveh-kiriathaim,
target_text: ka maso tèu ka canguru èpa, kedarlaomer dènge angalai na dhèu aae dhèu tèlu sera, mai dènge sordad'u ra. hèia ra pamusu ka, ka ra segi pèri-pèri rai. nuka: dhèu refaim ètu rai asterot-karnaim; dhèu susim ètu rai ham; dhèu emim ètu rai sawe-kiryataim,

source_text: and the horites in the area of mount seir, as far as el-paran, which is near the desert.
target_text: dènge dhèu hori dhu ètu ledhe seir, d'ai sebhe mamoo el paran.

source_text: then they turned back to invade en-mishpat that is, kadesh, and they conquered the whole territory of the amalekites, as well as the amorites who lived in hazazon-tamar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa en mispat dhu limuri ne ngara na kades. ka ra segi rai dhèu amalek, dènge dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rae haseson-tamar.

source_text: then the king of sodom, the king of gomorrah, the king of admah, the king of zeboiim, and the king of bela that is, zoar marched out and arrayed themselves for battle in the valley of siddim against chedorlaomer king of elam, tidal king of goiim, amraphel king of shinar, and arioch king of ellasar-four kings against five.
target_text: hèia, lèmi dhèu aae se ator sordad'u ra ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, ka lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae dhèu èpa sèra.

source_text: now the valley of siddim was full of tar pits, and as the kings of sodom and gomorrah fled, some men fell into the pits, but the survivors fled to the hill country.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamoo èèna, dhu abhu mananga èi dama pèri-pèri. ropa ra pamusu, dhèu aae sodom dènge dhèu aae gomora dènge sordad'u ra, rai. ka cahag'e manahu asa d'ara mananga èi dama se. aa cahag'e hari rai asa ledhe lasi.

source_text: the four kings seized all the goods of sodom and gomorrah and all their food, and they went on their way.
target_text: ka èpa dhèu aae dhu segi se, lasi parame rèti mèdha-panyau dènge nganga'a-nginu nèti sodom dènge gomora. èèna ka, ra lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: they also carried off abram's nephew lot and his possessions, since lot was living in sodom.
target_text: te ngaa lot, ana ari abram, dhu pea ètu sodom. ka èpa dhèu aae sèra, ère rèti lot si, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: then an escapee came and reported this to abram the hebrew. now abram was living near the oaks of mamre the amorite, a brother of eshcol and aner, all of whom were bound by treaty to abram.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci rai nèti era èèna. ka la'e lolo dènge abram, dhèu ibrani èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu amori èci, ngara na mamre. aa abram pea dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae unu mamre. a'ari mamre dhèu dua, ngara na eskol dènge aner. rèngu se dhu pa'anga dènge abram.

source_text: and when abram heard that his relative had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men born in his household, and they set out in pursuit as far as dan.
target_text: ropa abram tadèngi na dhèu kèpe rèti le lot, ana ari na, ka abram pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na dhu re'a pamusu. aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu ngasu canguru aru dhèu. ka lasi magèla èpa dhèu aae sèra, asa badae aae lasi d'ai rae dan.

source_text: during the night, abram divided his forces and routed chedorlaomer's army, pursuing them as far as hobah, north of damascus.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abram hag'e dhèu na sèra, mi pèri-pèri kaboko. d'ara mèda èèna kahèi, lasi age si, dènge j'ara pa'oke. ka abram si lasi bate dhèu se d'ai rae hoba, ètu bèka badae kota damsik.

source_text: he retrieved all the goods, as well as his relative lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people.
target_text: hèia abram abhu hari lot, dènge dhèu-dhèu nèngu, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i. na abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo.

source_text: after abram returned from defeating chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of sodom went out to meet him in the valley of shaveh that is, the king's valley.
target_text: ropa abram segi nare dhèu aae èpa sèra, ka na lèpa. hèia dhèu aae sodom mai soru ne ètu d'ara mamoo sawe dhu dhèu biasa peka na, mamoo dhèu aae.

source_text: then melchizedek king of salem brought out bread and wine-since he was priest of god most high -
target_text: tèu èèna, melkisedek, j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. aa nèngu ne j'aj'i kahèi ama agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. na mai soru abram, nèti roti dènge èi hua anggor.

source_text: and he blessed abram and said: blessed be abram by god most high, creator of heaven and earth, and blessed be god most high, who has delivered your enemies into your hand. then abram gave melchizedek a tenth of everything.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho hia berkat mi abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua, dhu dedha risi eele èèna, dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, hia mèngi-nale mi dedha èu. koa-kio ama lamatua dhu hia le èu segi musu. èle èèna ka, abram bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu hari sèra.

source_text: the king of sodom said to abram, give me the people, but take the goods for yourself.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae sodom èèna pahaha iisi na mi abram, peka na, ama. mèdha-panyau dhu èu abhu hari nèti musu ja'a sèra, hud'i laa ama ku abhu aa'i si. te ngaa dhu ja'a manèngi hari, dhoka dhèu-dhèu ja'a sèra.

source_text: but abram replied to the king of sodom, i have raised my hand to the lord god most high, creator of heaven and earth,
target_text: hèia abram b'ala ne, peka na, ja'a subha ètu madha ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha,

source_text: that i will not accept even a thread, or a strap of a sandal, or anything that belongs to you, lest you should say, ‘i have made abram rich. '
target_text: na, ja'a kore boe mèdha-panyau èu, masi ka ciki èèna ka. masi ka loa hèngu ca'èta sa, ja'a kore boe. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èu baku peka na, ‘kakaja abram sèra mai nèti ja'a. '

source_text: i will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me-aner, eshcol, and mamre. they may take their portion.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka mia dhu dhèu ja'a se pake le, sèra èle le, ale ia ka. aa hud'i laa, angalai ja'a dhèu tèlu se: aner, eskol dènge mamre, hag'e rare unu rèngu di.

source_text: after these events, the word of the lord came to abram in a vision: do not be afraid, abram. i am your shield, your very great reward.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, abram! èu baku madha'u. lula ja'a ka dhu j'aj'i mi tami ho bhiri èu nèti musu. aa ja'a hia a'oto mi dedha èu.

source_text: but abram replied, o lord god, what can you give me, since i remain childless, and the heir of my house is eliezer of damascus? abram continued, behold, you have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abram na, masi ka ama lamatua hia ae-ae èèna ka, j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci. lula ja'a ne dènge boe ana matana, ho hia ja'a ana-èpu. de dhu neo unu ae-ae sèmi èèna, tao mi ngaa? neu-neu ka, noto mi ènu ja'a elieser, dhèu damsik èèna. nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: then the word of the lord came to abram, saying, this one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, j'ara na sèmi boe èèna! ana d'èlu èu ku, dhu unu pusaka sèra. ènu èu abhu boe.

source_text: and the lord took him outside and said, now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able. then he told him, so shall your offspring be.
target_text: hèia nèti abram asa li'u, ka na peka, èu ladhe ku asa dedha-liru nèi. ladhe paie ku hua-hètu sèi. bisa iga more, do aad'o? bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu sèi!

source_text: abram believed the lord, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
target_text: ka abram sèmi nare lii padhai lamatua. aa lamatua tadhe ne, dhèu mola, lula abram lèka ne.

source_text: the lord also told him, i am the lord, who brought you out of ur of the chaldeans to give you this land to possess.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua tuhu hari lii na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua. ja'a ka dhu lere kèti èu nèti rae ur, ètu rai dhèu kasdim sèra. aa rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka mu.

source_text: but abram replied, lord god, how can i know that i will possess it?
target_text: te ngaa abram karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, lamatua? dènge j'ara sa mia ka ho ja'a ke'a na, rai ne j'aj'i pusaka ja'a?

source_text: and the lord said to him, bring me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! mai ti tao madha j'ara èci, dhu pa'èki lii padhai lii ja'a deo na. de lamu more sapi rena ci'u, kahib'i rena ci'u, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u. aa'i-aa'i sèra hud'i dhu umur tèlu tèu. aa mèti kahèi koro iia ci'u, dènge koro j'aha ci'u.

source_text: so abram brought all these to him, split each of them down the middle, and laid the halves opposite each other. the birds, however, he did not cut in half.
target_text: ka abram la'e nare badha sèra. hèia na kacèb'e bagi mi dua, sapi, kahib'i, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra. ka na pale sisi se mi rai, dhu èci patangara dènge èci, j'aj'i mi dua b'aris. te ngaa na kacèb'e boe manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and the birds of prey descended on the carcasses, but abram drove them away.
target_text: ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi sèra, mai ho neo ra'a sisi se'e. te ngaa abram bhabhoo eele si.

source_text: as the sun was setting, abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, abram bhèj'i luu. na nii, kuri na maroga mai sarimu nare nèngu, ka na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: then the lord said to abram, know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years. but i will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions. you, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, abram! èèna na èu mamuri toke heka bhoro, aa madhe dènge be'a, ka ra padhane èu dènge be'a. te ngaa ana-èpu èu, èèna na j'aj'i dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai dhèu. ho èèna na, dhèu isi rai sèra, tao si sèmi ènu sa, ka ra ènyi aa paj'èra si, toke èpa ngasu tèu. te, ladhe èèna na, ja'a huku si. ho èèna na, ja'a kèti hari ana-èpu èu nèti era èèna, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae-ae.

source_text: in the fourth generation your descendants will return here, for the iniquity of the amorites is not yet complete.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a ator ho ana-èpu èu dhu ka lèmi kèti hari si asa ne'e mai. limuri ne, dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rai ne'e. dhèu se'e dhèu bhelu, te ngaa dhae bhelu iia mèka. ladhe ana-èpu èu sèra lèpa hari asa era ne'e, ja'a neo pake si ho huku palaho dhèu amori sèra. lula d'ai taa èèna, bhabhelu ra asa hino.

source_text: when the sun had set and darkness had fallen, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda sa, cag'ag'a laa ètu era èèna, abhu èru rai èci dhu sèb'u poka-poka, dènge badhu ai èci dhu heo, kako re sasanga sisi dua baris se.

source_text: on that day the lord made a covenant with abram, saying, to your descendants i have given this land-from the river of egypt to the great river euphrates-
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge abram. na peka na, ja'a jaji mema èu kèna, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u mi ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne, mulai nèti loko masir, d'ai loko efrat,

source_text: the land of the kenites, kenizzites, kadmonites,
target_text: dènge rai dhèu keni, dhèu kenas, dhèu kadmon,

source_text: hittites, perizzites, rephaites,
target_text: dhèu het, dhèu feris, dhèu refaim,

source_text: amorites, canaanites, girgashites, and jebusites.
target_text: dhèu amori, dhèu kana'an, dhèu girgasi, dènge dhèu yebus.

source_text: now abram's wife sarai had borne him no children, but she had an egyptian maidservant named hagar. so sarai said to abram, look now, the lord has prevented me from bearing children. please go to my maidservant; perhaps i can build a family by her. and abram listened to the voice of sarai. so after he had lived in canaan for ten years, his wife sarai took her egyptian maidservant hagar and gave her to abram to be his wife.
target_text: tèu èèna, abram lèpa hari le nèti masir, ka na pea le canguru tèu ètu kana'an. dhèu èmu na sarai abhu mèka kolo. sarai dènge ènu bhèni ca dhèu nèti masir, ngara na hagar. ca lod'o, sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, a'a. lamatua hia boe ja'a ana. de hua iia, lamu j'unu dènge ènu ja'a, hagar, sèna ka na hia ja'a ana. ka abram madhutu lii dhèu èmu na. ka sarai hia hagar j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua abram.

source_text: and he slept with hagar, and she conceived. but when hagar realized that she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
target_text: hèia abram j'unu dènge hagar, ka na dènge babia. ropa hagar ne'a nèngu dènge babia le, ka na padedha iisi na, aa na pahae heka sarai.

source_text: then sarai said to abram, may the wrong done to me be upon you! i delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. may the lord judge between you and me.
target_text: ka sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu hia nèngu mi èu j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua. te ngaa ropa na dènge babia, na pusi pahae heka ja'a! ne'e ne, sala èu! de hud'i laa, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti! heka èu me'a kèna!

source_text: here, said abram, your servant is in your hands. do whatever you want with her. then sarai treated hagar so harshly that she fled from her.
target_text: ka abram dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, wee! èu ne, dhèu èmu uru. aa nèngu, dhèu èmu limuri. de èu ne dhu mèd'u paredha. de èu neo tao ne tasamia, èèna ètu èu na! ka sarai mulai tao sakaa hua dènge hagar, hèia na rai.

source_text: now the angel of the lord found hagar by a spring of water in the desert-the spring along the road to shur.
target_text: na rai d'ai d'ara mamoo. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga ca dhèu, rage ne dètu dènge madha èi, ètu j'ara la'e asa sur.

source_text: hagar, servant of sarai, he said, where have you come from, and where are you going? i am running away from my mistress sarai, she replied.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne hagar, ènu sarai. nga tao ka èu ètu ne'e? èu mai nèti mia, aa lamu mia? hèia hagar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a rai nèti d'ara èmu lamatua ja'a.

source_text: so the angel of the lord told her, return to your mistress and submit to her authority.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pamako ne, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! be'a risi, èu lèpa hari asa adhe-aai sarai, lamatua èu. masi ka na tao èu tasamia èèna ka, sèmi la.

source_text: then the angel added, i will greatly multiply your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count.
target_text: baku madha'u. bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu pa'ae-ae, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: the angel of the lord proceeded: behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. and you shall name him ishmael, for the lord has heard your cry of affliction.
target_text: èu dhu dènge babia. nèbhu heka, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èèna na mu pangare ne ismael dhu sasoa na ‘lamatua tadèngi', lula lamatua tadèngi le lii roma iisi èu.

source_text: he will be a wild donkey of a man, and his hand will be against everyone, and everyone's hand against him; he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.
target_text: ropa ana ne kapai, na mamuri pakaj'èu nèti a'ari na. lula nèngu ne, sama sèmi jara hui dhu d'èi boe nanene lii paredha. sad'i dhèu cee èèna ka, na sisu. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i lab'a ne kahèi.

source_text: so hagar gave this name to the lord who had spoken to her: you are the god who sees me, for she said, here i have seen the one who sees me!
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hagar ngee ka ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le lamatua, dhu ladhe-leru aa madhenge ja'a. hèia na hia ngara mi lamatua, lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ja'a.

source_text: therefore the well was called beer-lahai-roi. it is located between kadesh and bered.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu pangare madha èi na, beer lahai roi, dhu sasoa na madha èi nèti nèngu dhu mamuri, dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. era na, ètu talora aae nèti rae kades dènge rae beret. madha èi ne, abhu era toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and hagar bore abram a son, and abram gave the name ishmael to the son she had borne.
target_text: èle èèna ka, hagar lèpa hari. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. abram pangare ne ismael.

source_text: abram was eighty-six years old when hagar bore ishmael to him.
target_text: lod'o hagar nare iisi ismael, umur abram aru nguru èna tèu kèna.

source_text: when abram was ninety-nine years old, the lord appeared to him and said, i am god almighty. walk before me and be blameless.
target_text: ropa umur abram d'ai ceo nguru ceo tèu, lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne. ka na peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. èu hud'i madhutu taruu dad'èi ja'a, dènge j'ara mamuri èu hud'i mola.

source_text: i will establish my covenant between me and you, and i will multiply you exceedingly.
target_text: ja'a neo pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. aa ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu.

source_text: then abram fell facedown, and god said to him,
target_text: hèia abram patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: as for me, this is my covenant with you: you will be the father of many nations. no longer will you be called abram, but your name will be abraham, for i have made you a father of many nations.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu sèmi ne'e ka: èèna na, èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. nèti èèna ka, èu pake ia ka ngara èu abram dhu sasoa na ‘ama dhu dhèu tadhe', te ngaa abraham dhu sasoa na ‘bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae'.

source_text: i will make you exceedingly fruitful; i will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.
target_text: ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu ae-ae. ja'a paj'aj'i si suku ae-ae. aa ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae nèti rèngu sèra.

source_text: i will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you, to be your god and the god of your descendants after you.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu, aa dènge ana-èpu èu sèra. lii pajaji ne ma'ète boe toke taa-taa, lula ja'a ne'e ka ama lamatua nèti èu dènge ana-èpu mu.

source_text: and to you and your descendants i will give the land where you are residing-all the land of canaan-as an eternal possession; and i will be their god.
target_text: rai kana'an ne aa'i-aa'i, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. ne'e ne, èu dhoka pea manubha di ètu ne'e. te ngaa èèna na, j'aj'i mi unu ana-èpu èu toke taa-taa. aa ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu sèra kahèi.

source_text: god also said to abraham, you must keep my covenant-you and your descendants in the generations after you. this is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: every male among you must be circumcised.
target_text: te ngaa èu dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, hud'i kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji ne, dènge d'ara kateme ku. dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ra, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: you are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between me and you. generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner-even those who are not your offspring. whether they are born in your household or purchased, they must be circumcised. my covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.
target_text: ne'e ne, mone aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna, mulai nèti umur aru lod'o. a'ari èu, dhèu-dhèu sab'a èu, dènge ènu dhu èu hèli more nèti rai leo, aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i suna si. suna na j'aj'i tadha mi ngi'u miu, dhu pa'èki èdhi taa-taa.

source_text: but if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.
target_text: mone mia dhu suna boe, rèngu sèra maso boe ètu d'ara lii pajaji ja'a ne, aa rèngu sèra j'aj'i boe dhèu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: then god said to abraham, as for sarai your wife, do not call her sarai, for her name is to be sarah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu paroa ia ka ngara dhèu èmu mu sarai, te ngaa sara.

source_text: and i will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. i will bless her, and she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will descend from her.
target_text: èèna na ja'a hia mamèngi ae-ae mi sara, sèna ka nara iisi hia èu, ana mone ca dhèu. tare'a! bèli-camèd'a, sara j'aj'i bèi nèti suku ae-ae. aa èèna na, ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae-ae nèti ana-èpu nèngu.

source_text: abraham fell facedown. then he laughed and said to himself, can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? can sarah give birth at the age of ninety?
target_text: hèia abraham patitu kètu urutuu ka pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. te ngaa na mari ètu d'ara. na pangee, na, mone heka bhora dhu cangasu tèu sama sèmi ja'a ne, bisa abhu ana era? aa sara dhu heka gagoo-gagehu ne, dhu ceo nguru tèu kèna, nara iisi hari sa mia?

source_text: and abraham said to god, o that ishmael might live under your blessing!
target_text: ka na peka dènge lamatua, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka laa, ismael ka dhu abhu pusaka ja'a èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: but god replied, your wife sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him isaac. i will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
target_text: te ngaa aku ama lamatua na, aad'o sèmi èèna! bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu mu sara, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. pangare ne isak. lii jaji ja'a ne, lèke mi nèngu dènge ana-èpu na toke mia-mia.

source_text: as for ishmael, i have heard you, and i will surely bless him; i will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. he will become the father of twelve rulers, and i will make him into a great nation.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi le ngaa dhu èu manèngi kahèi, hia ismael. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia berkat mi nèngu kahèi, aa hia ana-èpu na tabha ae. bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu ismael ne, j'aj'i mi canguru dua kapala suku. aa ana-èpu na suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: but i will establish my covenant with isaac, whom sarah will bear to you at this time next year.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, lii pajaji ja'a ne, lèke dhoka mi ana mu isak di. tèu mai ni, hèru sèmi ne'e kahèi, sara nara iisi le.

source_text: when he had finished speaking with abraham, god went up from him.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, ka ama lamatua tèke eele abraham.

source_text: on that very day abraham took his son ishmael and all those born in his household or purchased with his money-every male among the members of abraham's household-and he circumcised them, just as god had told him. so abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised, and his son ishmael was thirteen; abraham and his son ishmael were circumcised on the same day. and all the men of abraham's household-both servants born in his household and those purchased from foreigners-were circumcised with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, abraham tao dènge ka, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ka na suna. na suna ana na, ismael, dènge dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge ne. lod'o èèna, umur abraham ceo nguru ceo tèu le, aa ismael canguru tèlu tèu.

source_text: then the lord appeared to abraham by the oaks of mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.
target_text: ca tèka, abraham pea padètu dènge aj'u aae canau ètu mamre. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu ètu era èèna. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o èèna, sagoro ae titu kèna, ka abraham madhèdi ètu hèb'a paleo na, sèna ka abhu ngèlu g'oro ciki.

source_text: and abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. when he saw them, he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
target_text: ropa abraham boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi dhèu tèlu dhu titu kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna. hèia na rai la'e soru nare si. ropa na d'ai madha si, na patitu kètu urutuu na,

source_text: my lord, said abraham, if i have found favor in your sight, please do not pass your servant by.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama si. mai dhuli ku ho minu èi ciki.

source_text: let a little water be brought, that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree.
target_text: ama si ae ciki mi mamaho ne'e. ho ana-ana iiki rèti èi, sèna ka rasa haga miu.

source_text: and i will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves. this is why you have passed your servant's way. after that, you may continue on your way. yes, they replied, you may do as you have said.
target_text: pe ja'a laku lalau nganga'a-nginu ho ama si mi'a ciki, sèna ka ako kadhii ciki, heka lami taruu kèna. te ja'a karej'e bisa lalau ama si. ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ooo. ji'i dhuli.

source_text: so abraham hurried into the tent and said to sarah, quick! prepare three seahs of fine flour, knead it, and bake some bread.
target_text: hèia abraham pamèri sa d'ara paleo, la'e peka dènge sara, aku nèngu na, mèri! more tarigu dhu be'a risi, ca saku, ho tao roti!

source_text: meanwhile, abraham ran to the herd, selected a tender and choice calf, and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
target_text: ka rai la'e hari asa era sapi na, hèia kèpe ana sapi kabèb'u ci'u. ka na pua dhèu sab'a na sa, pare.

source_text: then abraham brought curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate.
target_text: hèia la'e nare susu, keju dènge sisi dhu heka nasu èèna, nèti hia tamu sèra ra'a. abraham titu taruu ètu mamaho aj'u, ho na lalau si.

source_text: where is your wife sarah? they asked. there, in the tent, he replied.
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, dhèu èmu mu sara, ka mia? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, nuka d'ara paleo èèna.

source_text: then the lord said, i will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife sarah will have a son! now sarah was behind him, listening at the entrance to the tent.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se padhai lii, aku nèngu na, pe d'ai tèu mai nèi, ja'a lèpa hari mai. lod'o èèna, dhèu èmu èu sara nare iisi le ana mone ca dhèu. ropa rèngu padhai lii èèna, sara nanene nèti kabodho babèdho.

source_text: and abraham and sarah were already old and well along in years; sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abraham dènge sara dhu heka bhoro le, ngaa hari sara dhu abhu heka hèru.

source_text: so she laughed to herself, saying, after i am worn out and my master is old, will i now have this pleasure?
target_text: ropa sara tadèngi padhue-padhai rèngu se, ka na mari kèmu. na pangee na, ja'a dhu heka roto-roto sèmi ne'e ne, aa dhèu èmu ja'a dhu roe nia heka. tasamia ji'i bisa tao sèmi ana ngèru dhu leo-èmu hiu, ho abhu ana?

source_text: and the lord asked abraham, why did sarah laugh and say, ‘can i really bear a child when i am old? '
target_text: ka lamatua peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka sara mari? ele boe na ngee na, lii padhai ja'a ne j'aj'i boe, lula nèngu heka le.

source_text: is anything too difficult for the lord? at the appointed time i will return to you-in about a year-and sarah will have a son.
target_text: ja'a ne, lamatua! abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ja'a bisa boe tao. sanèd'e paie. tèu mai, ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, sara dhu nara iisi le, ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: but sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, i did not laugh. no, replied the lord, but you did laugh.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, sara j'aj'i madha'u. ka na pasili, aku nèngu na, ja'a mari boe, nga! te ngaa lamatua b'ala, na, deo na, èu mari, nga.

source_text: when the men got up to leave, they looked out over sodom, and abraham walked along with them to see them off.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu tèlu se pakèd'i neo lasi asa kota sodom. ka abraham lere si d'ai talora j'ara. nèti era èèna, ladhe rèdhi kota sodom.

source_text: and the lord said, shall i hide from abraham what i am about to do?
target_text: ka lamatua ngee ètu d'ara na, hua iia ja'a peka dènge abraham, ja'a neo palaho kota sodom.

source_text: abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, ana-èpu na asa tabha ae, aa suku dhu kapai. aa nèngu ne, èèna na, j'aj'i berkat mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for i have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the lord by doing what is right and just, in order that the lord may bring upon abraham what he has promised.
target_text: ja'a hag'e kore le nèngu, ho na nori ana-èpu na dènge dhèu leo, sèna ka madhutu taruu j'ara lamatua, ho ra mamuri dènge mola. ladhe rèngu mamuri sèmi èèna, ja'a tao aa'i lii dhu ja'a pajaji dènge abraham.

source_text: then the lord said, the outcry against sodom and gomorrah is great. because their sin is so grievous,
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a tadèngi le, lii roma iisi dhèu ae, peka na, dhèu kota sodom dènge gomora bhabhelu ra seli-kolane.

source_text: i will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached me. if not, i will find out.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a puru madha ku mai, sèna ka kèdhi unu ku, ngaa dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, pe ja'a ke'a unu ku.

source_text: and the two men turned away and went toward sodom, but abraham remained standing before the lord.
target_text: ropa lamatua padhai lii era dènge abraham, dhèu dua se lasi taruu sa kota sodom.

source_text: abraham stepped forward and said, will you really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
target_text: hèia abraham la'e padètu dènge lamatua, ka na pamako na, peka na, tasamia? ama neo pamadhe aa'i dhèu-dhèu be'a pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu bhelu, do?

source_text: what if there are fifty righteous ones in the city? will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a ètu d'ara kota èèna, ama pamadhe si hèi? do, ama palaho heka kota sèra, lula rèngu se'e, do?

source_text: far be it from you to do such a thing-to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. far be it from you! will not the judge of all the earth do what is right?
target_text: ama baku tao sèmi èèna! mage dhoka, dhèu be'a sèra madhe hèi, lula ama neo pamadhe dhèu bhelu sèra. ama ka dhu pama'ète lii ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. de ama ku unu mu dhu me'a j'ara èèna adil boe.

source_text: so the lord replied, if i find fifty righteous ones within the city of sodom, on their account i will spare the whole place.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu be'a lèmi nguru dhèu ètu kota sodom, ja'a huku boe kota èèna, lula rèngu.

source_text: then abraham answered, now that i have ventured to speak to the lord-though i am but dust and ashes-
target_text: hèia abraham padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a manèngi abho, lula ja'a neo padhai lii hari ciki. ja'a ne dhoka dhèu goa di, dhu ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five. will you destroy the whole city for the lack of five? he replied, if i find forty-five there, i will not destroy it.
target_text: sèmi d'ai boe dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka èpa nguru lèmi di, tasamia? kura dhoka dhèu lèmi di, na ama neo palaho eele kota èèna, do? ka lamatua b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a abhu dhèu be'a èpa nguru lèmi, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: once again abraham spoke to the lord, suppose forty are found there? he answered, on account of the forty, i will not do it.
target_text: ka abraham pamako hari, na, sèmi abhu dhoka èpa nguru dhèu be'a di, tasamia, ama? ka na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu èpa nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: then abraham said, may the lord not be angry, but let me speak further. suppose thirty are found there? he replied, if i find thirty there, i will not do it.
target_text: abraham pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ama baku nasa. te abhu dhoka tèlu nguru dhèu be'a di, na tasamia? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu tèlu nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and abraham said, now that i have ventured to speak to the lord, suppose twenty are found there? he answered, on account of the twenty, i will not destroy it.
target_text: hèia abraham peka hari, ama mage nasa ladhe ja'a karèi hari ciki. sèmi abhu dhoka dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, na tasamia? ka na dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, sèmi abhu dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, ja'a palaho eele boe kota èèna.

source_text: finally, abraham said, may the lord not be angry, but let me speak once more. suppose ten are found there? and he answered, on account of the ten, i will not destroy it.
target_text: ka abraham katange lii padhai na, aa na karèi, peka na, ama! ja'a padhai lii hari ca tèka, te ngaa baku nasa dènge ja'a. tasamia, ladhe abhu dhoka canguru dhèu di dhu be'a? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu canguru dhèu dhu be'a ètu era èèna, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: when the lord had finished speaking with abraham, he departed, and abraham returned home.
target_text: padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, lamatua la'e dènge ka, aa abraham lèpa kahèi.

source_text: now the two angels arrived at sodom in the evening, and lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. when lot saw them, he got up to meet them, bowed facedown,
target_text: ètu d'ara lamatua dhu padhue-padhai era dènge abraham, ana pajuu na dhèu dua, lasi le asa kota sodom. d'ai nèi, lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka lot dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe kota. ropa nèdhi dhèu dua se, la'e soru nare si. ka na patitu kètu urutuu, aa pacud'u kètu ètu madha ra.

source_text: and said, my lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. then you can rise early and go on your way. no, they answered, we will spend the night in the square.
target_text: ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, mai lati dhuli ku èmu ja'a la. sèna ka ama si rase haga, aa j'unu ètu èmu ja'a. pe bèli mad'ae, heka ama si kako hari kèna. ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, makasi. te ngaa repo ia ka. hud'i laa ji'i j'unu ètu d'ara lapa.

source_text: but lot insisted so strongly that they followed him into his house. he prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
target_text: te ngaa lot pamako si loe boe, ka lasi manubha asa èmu na. ka lot si tunu roti, lalau mei, ka ra'a-rinu pa'èci.

source_text: before they had gone to bed, all the men of the city of sodom, both young and old, surrounded the house.
target_text: dhu dua ra lasi mèka j'unu, cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone sodom aa'i-aa'i, ana mone ngèru toke d'ai mone heka, mai reo rare èmu lot.

source_text: they called out to lot, saying, where are the men who came to you tonight? send them out to us so we can have relations with them!
target_text: dhèu se'e pa'oo-parodha, peka mi lot, aku rèngu na, he, lot! mone dua deo sa, ètu mia? bhabhodho si mai, sèna ka ji'i j'unu dènge ra!

source_text: lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.
target_text: hèia lot li'u la'e, ka na bèdho hari èmu.

source_text: please, my brothers, he pleaded, don't do such a wicked thing!
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! baku miu tao bhelu mi tamu ja'a se.

source_text: look, i have two daughters who have never slept with a man. let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. but do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.
target_text: mi nanene ku ja'a laa! ana bhèni ja'a, dhèu dua. dua ra dhu pa'èci mèka dènge dhèu mone. ja'a hia miu. mere, ho mi tao tasamia èèna ka, sad'i madhutu dad'èi miu. sad'i miu baku tao karehe mi tamu ja'a dhèu dua se. lula madhutu ad'a èdhi, ja'a ka dhu hud'i j'aga si.

source_text: get out of the way! they replied. and they declared, this one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge! now we will treat you worse than them. and they pressed in on lot and moved in to break down the door.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu sodom se pa'oo ma'ète boe, aku rèngu na, èu ne, baku patabha! te èu ne, dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai ji'i ne! de èu dènge boe hak ho kai ji'i. hua iia, èu pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e. te, ladhe lamu boe, ji'i tao èu bia risi nèti dhèu dua se'e! ka ra tule eele lot, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra rai lasi j'èje babèdho èmu.

source_text: but the men inside reached out, pulled lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dua se soro kacui-aai ra, ère pamaso lot, ka ra patèke èmu nèti d'ara.

source_text: and they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door.
target_text: dua ra tao pabèdhu ana madha dhèu sodom aa'i-aa'i ra, ka rèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ra gogo tenge babèdho, te ngaa abhu boe.

source_text: then the two men said to lot, do you have anyone else here-a son-in-law, your sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? get them out of here, because we are about to destroy this place. for the outcry to the lord against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it.
target_text: hèia tamu dhèu dua se, peka dènge lot, aku rèngu na, lamatua ne'a le, bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu sodom se. nèti èèna ka, na paleha ji'i dua mi mai, sèna ka palaho eele kota ne. de èu dhu dènge a'ari leo dhu ètu d'ara kota ne, do aad'o? ladhe dènge ana mone, do ana bhèni, do dhèu èmu ana èu, do, sad'i cee èèna ka, lamu more si, ho rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne lai-lai!

source_text: so lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. get up, he said. get out of this place, for the lord is about to destroy the city! but his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
target_text: hèia lot la'e paraga dènge ana mone dhèu dua, dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni na. ka na peka, dua mi nanene paie! rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne, te lamatua neo palaho eele ne! te ngaa ra pangee na, lot padhai lii paleko di.

source_text: at daybreak the angels hurried lot along, saying, get up! take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae era, ana pajuu lamatua dhèu dua se, pakaseti lot si, ho lasi karohe asa era kaj'èu. ra peka na, lami ka! ère mèti dhèu èmu mu, dènge ana bhèni èu dhèu dua sèra, ho rai ka. tèke eele kota ne'e! mage dhoka miu madhe aa'i palere-lere dènge kota ne.

source_text: but when lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. and they led them safely out of the city, because of the lord's compassion for them.
target_text: te ngaa lot neka-neka era, masi ka lamatua neo hia ne mamuri. nèti èèna ka, tamu dhèu dua se nuni lot, dhèu èmu na, dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua sèra, rèti asa li'u kota.

source_text: as soon as the men had brought them out, one of them said, run for your lives! do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!
target_text: hèia ca dhèu nèti tamu dhèu dua sèra paredha si, peka na, rai palasa, sèna ka abhu sod'a! mage mi kabib'a kabodho! baku ae ètu d'ara mamoo! rai taruu, asa ledhe nèi, sèna ka miu baku madhe!

source_text: but lot replied, no, my lords, please!
target_text: te ngaa lot peka, aku nèngu na, iraa ee! baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. but i cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and i will die.
target_text: mema ama si pamamuri le ji'i se. te ngaa ledhe nèi kaj'èu bia nèti ne'e! mage dhoka ji'i d'ai mèka nèi, j'aj'èra dhu magee nare le ji'i èèna, ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: look, there is a town nearby where i can flee, and it is a small place. please let me flee there-is it not a small place? then my life will be saved.
target_text: ama ladhe ku laa. rae iiki cue dhu kaj'èu boe nèti era ne'e. rae nèi dhu kolongara aad'o. ladhe ama d'èi, ji'i la'a pasoru iisi asa nèi!

source_text: very well, he answered, i will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! lami ka! te èèna na, ja'a palaho boe rae nèi.

source_text: hurry! run there quickly, for i cannot do anything until you reach it. that is why the town was called zoar.
target_text: de rai karohe ka, lami asa nèi! te ja'a tao mèka ngaa-ngaa, ladhe miu d'ai mèka era nèi. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu pangare rae ne soar, dhu sasoa na ‘ana iiki-iiki'.

source_text: and by the time the sun had risen over the land, lot had reached zoar.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea, lot si d'ai soar.

source_text: then the lord rained down sulfur and fire on sodom and gomorrah-from the lord out of the heavens.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, lamatua sadutu ai dènge èi nasu nèti dedha-liru asa sodom dènge gomora.

source_text: thus he destroyed these cities and the entire plain, including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground.
target_text: lamatua pakèpu-ladhu ai kota dènge rae aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara rai èèna, dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu èèna, nuka: dhèu, badha-manu, dènge ana aaj'u.

source_text: but lot's wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
target_text: lod'o rèngu rai, dhèu èmu lot kabib'a kabodho. cag'ag'a laa, na j'aj'i agarii masi.

source_text: early the next morning, abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the lord.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhu mad'ae aae era, abraham la'e asa era dhu med'a na, na pamako lamatua.

source_text: he looked down toward sodom and gomorrah and all the land of the plain, and he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace.
target_text: hèia na ladhe sa haha asa sodom dènge gomora, aa asa d'ara mamoo èèna. na ladhe la'a na, sèb'u poka-poka sèna, dhu ca'e asa dedha-liru. aa ai na'e aa'i le ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so when god destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered abraham, and he brought lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived.
target_text: ama lamatua patalale lot si nèti hahuku èèna, ropa na pakèpu-ladhu ai kota-kota sèra, lula na ngee nèdhi lii pajaji na dènge abraham.

source_text: lot and his two daughters left zoar and settled in the mountains-for he was afraid to stay in zoar-where they lived in a cave.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lot madha'u pea taruu ètu rae soar. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge ana bhèni na dhèu dua sèra, lasi asa ledhe ka ra pea ètu d'ara loe cue.

source_text: one day the older daughter said to the younger, our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana bhèni uru èèna, peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, ètu era ne'e ne, abhu boe dhèu mone ca dhèu sa, dhu bisa leo dènge èdhi se. aa ama èdhi asa heka, de ladhe èèna na, na bisa heka abhu ana.

source_text: come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.
target_text: de be'a risi, ti hia ne ninu mahu, sèna ka èdhi dua ti j'unu dènge ne, ho ti abhu kolo hia ama èdhi.

source_text: so that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
target_text: ka ropa d'ai mèda, dua ra hia ama ra ninu èi anggor toke mahu. hèia ana bhèni uru èèna, la'e j'unu dènge ama na. lula ama na dhu mahu ae, ka ne'a boe nèngu dhu j'unu dènge ana na.

source_text: the next day the older daughter said to the younger, look, i slept with my father last night. let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father's line.
target_text: hèia asa bèli èèna, a'a na peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, mèda deo na, ja'a j'unu le dènge ama èdhi. de mèda ne'e, èu kèna. èdhi hia ne hari ninu mahu, ho lamu j'unu dènge ne. sèna ka èdhi dua ti abhu ana, ho hia ana-èpu mi ama èdhi.

source_text: so again that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda na, dua ra hia hari ama ra ninu mahu. ka ana bhèni limuri ne, la'e ka j'unu dènge ama na. te ngaa, lula ama ra dhu mahu titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ne'a boe ngaa dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ana bhèni na.

source_text: thus both of lot's daughters became pregnant by their father.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, dua ra dènge babia nèti ama d'èlu rèngu.

source_text: the older daughter gave birth to a son and named him moab. he is the father of the moabites of today.
target_text: hèia ana bhèni uru èèna nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na pangare na moab dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti ama'. ana ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu moab.

source_text: the younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him ben-ammi. he is the father of the ammonites of today.
target_text: ka ana bhèni limuri ne, nara iisi ana mone èci kahèi. na pangare na ben ami dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti dhèu ja'a'. ana ne ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu amon.

source_text: now abraham journeyed from there to the region of the negev and settled between kadesh and shur. while he was staying in gerar,
target_text: èle èèna, ka abraham nèti mamre, pidha asa rai negeb, dhu ètu re balèu, ka na pea ètu talora rae kades, dènge rae syur. te ngaa na pea nèbhu boe, ka pidha hari asa rae gerar.

source_text: abraham said of his wife sarah, she is my sister. so abimelech king of gerar had sarah brought to him.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, sara ne, ana hèni ja'a. nèti èèna ka, abimelek dhèu aae gerar, pua dhèu lasi lii d'ai sara. ka nèti ne mai asa d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: one night, however, god came to abimelech in a dream and told him, you are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.
target_text: d'ara ca mèda sa, ama lamatua pad'elo iisi na dènge dhèu aae ètu d'ara nii. na peka, mamadhe èu ne dètu kèna! lula èu more dhèu èmu dhèu.

source_text: now abimelech had not gone near her, so he replied, lord, would you destroy a nation even though it is innocent? didn't abraham tell me, ‘she is my sister'? and she herself said, ‘he is my brother. ' i have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.
target_text: hèia abimelek dhaa, peka na, lamatua! ja'a dhae pa'èci mèka dènge bhèni na. aa ja'a sasala aad'o. abraham unu na ka dhu peka, bhèni na, ana hèni nèngu! aa bhèni na dhaa sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia dhèu lasi lii d'ai ne, dènge d'ara mola. de lamatua baku pad'ui ja'a sasala!

source_text: then god said to abimelech in the dream, yes, i know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so i have kept you from sinning against me. that is why i did not let you touch her.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, tare'a. mema ja'a ke'a d'ara èu mola. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ka dhu taha èu, ho baku pa'èci dènge ne. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èu tao boe sala mi ja'a hèi.

source_text: now return the man's wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live. but if you do not restore her, be aware that you will surely die-you and all who belong to you.
target_text: de èu mèti hari ka bhèni ne, lèpa sa dhèu èmu na. mone na ka dhu nèti lii padhue-padhai ja'a. de lamu manèngi ne, sèna ka na sabaj'a hia èu, ho èu baku madhe. sanèd'e paie! ladhe èu hia boe bhèni na lèpa, èu dènge kabarai èu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: early the next morning abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened, the men were terrified.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu aae pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i, ka na lolo lii nii na. hèia aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u.

source_text: then abimelech called abraham and asked, what have you done to us? how have i sinned against you, that you have brought such tremendous guilt upon me and my kingdom? you have done things to me that should not be done.
target_text: ka dhèu aae paroa abraham. na karèi, aku nèngu na, ja'a tao sala ngaa mi èu, ka èu neo paj'èra ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a? èu ne ele-ho'a ka dènge tao madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: abimelech also asked abraham, what prompted you to do such a thing?
target_text: ngangee èu tasamia ka, mu tao sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: abraham replied, i thought to myself, ‘surely there is no fear of god in this place. they will kill me on account of my wife. '
target_text: ka abraham dhaa, peka na, ama dhèu aae! ja'a pangee na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, kabarai ne dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. de ele boe cahag'e neo pamadhe ja'a, sèna ka parame rare dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father-though not the daughter of my mother-and she became my wife.
target_text: mema ja'a dhu peka tare'a, nèngu ne, ana hèni ja'a. lula ji'i dua mi ca ama, te ngaa ina baka-leo. nèti èèna ka, ji'i dua mi paleo.

source_text: so when god had me journey from my father's house, i said to sarah, ‘this is how you can show your loyalty to me: wherever we go, say of me, he is my brother. '
target_text: ka ropa ama lamatua pua ji'i ho tèke eele era paleo-palu'u ji'i, lod'o èèna ja'a peka dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, aku ja'a na, ‘ladhe èdhi lati asa era leo, ho dhèu karèi èu, dhu èdhi se dhèu èmu-kamali, ladhe èu dhu sue ja'a, na dhaa la, peka na èdhi se, dua ti pa'a'ari. '

source_text: so abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to abraham and restored his wife sarah to him. and abimelech said, look, my land is before you. settle wherever you please. and he said to sarah, see, i am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. it is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pangèd'u hari sara la'e asa abraham. ka na peka dènge sara, èèna na, ja'a hia ana mone mu doi iia ca riho, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha ja'a tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi èu. ho hud'i sène, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a! hèia dhèu aae peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, kabarai ja'a ne, dhu bhoke tèke hia èu. èu neo pea mi era mia èèna ka, ja'a hia èu. ka abimelek hia abraham sapi, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. na hia kahèi ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: then abraham prayed to god, and god healed abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children- for on account of abraham's wife sarah, the lord had completely closed all the wombs in abimelech's household.
target_text: uru èèna, lula abimelek nare dhèu èmu abraham, ka lamatua hutu eele era ana nèti bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu aae èèna. te ngaa ropa abimelek hia sara lèpa hari sa dhèu èmu na, ka abraham sabaj'a ho lamatua bhoke hari era ana nèti bhèni se. ka ra abhu hari ana.

source_text: now the lord attended to sarah as he had said, and the lord did for sarah what he had promised. so sarah conceived and bore a son to abraham in his old age, at the very time god had promised. and abraham gave the name isaac to the son sarah bore to him. when his son isaac was eight days old, abraham circumcised him, as god had commanded him. abraham was a hundred years old when his son isaac was born to him. then sarah said, god has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me. she added, who would have told abraham that sarah would nurse children? yet i have borne him a son in his old age.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua hia sara mèngi-nale madhutu lii pajaji na. lod'o sara dènge babia, abraham dhu heka le. ropa sara nara iisi, umur abraham d'ai cangasu tèu kèna. lod'o sara d'ai hèru, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka abraham pangare ne, isak dhu sasoa na ‘na mari'. sara peka hèi, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua tao ja'a mari, lula ja'a karej'e. dhèu ae ka dhu pangee na, ja'a ètu d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne, abhu heka ana. masi ka dhèu èmu ja'a heka bhoro le, te ja'a bisa kora iisi ana hia ne. èèna na, ladhe dhèu tadèngi j'ara ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mari kahèi dènge ja'a ne. ropa isak d'ai aru lod'o, abraham suna ne, madhutu paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: so the child grew and was weaned, and abraham held a great feast on the day isaac was weaned.
target_text: isak kapai ka noo-noo. ropa oe d'ai lod'o luri susu, abraham tao tatao aae.

source_text: but sarah saw that the son whom hagar the egyptian had borne to abraham was mocking her son, and she said to abraham, expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman's son will never share in the inheritance with my son isaac!
target_text: ca tèke, sara ladhe nèdhi ismael, ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri abraham, padadisi dènge isak. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, sara peka dènge dhèu èmu na, bège eele ènu masir nèi dènge ana na! te, ja'a ko'o boe ana ènu èèna unu pusaka, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka. dhoka ana ja'a isak di, dhu abhu sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: now this matter distressed abraham greatly because it concerned his son ishmael.
target_text: ropa abraham tadèngi lii padhai sara ne, ka d'ara na ako be'a boe, lula ismael ne, ana d'èlu na kahèi.

source_text: but god said to abraham, do not be distressed about the boy and your maidservant. listen to everything that sarah tells you, for through isaac your offspring will be reckoned.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua lii dènge abraham, peka na, abraham! èu baku ngee pa'ae dhèu èmu limuri èu, dènge ana na. madhutu la dad'èi sara ne, lula bèli-camèd'a, èu abhu ana-èpu dhu ja'a moa tèke èèna, nèti isak ne'e ka.

source_text: but i will also make a nation of the slave woman's son, because he is your offspring.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a hia kahèi mèngi-nale mi ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri mu, lula nèngu ne, ana d'èlu èu kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu na j'aj'i suku èci kahèi.

source_text: early in the morning, abraham got up, took bread and a skin of water, put them on hagar's shoulders, and sent her away with the boy. she left and wandered in the wilderness of beersheba.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, abraham tao gee j'ara hia hagar, aa na kadhoe èi d'ara babo'i cue mi kabela-kao na. hèia na patabuli ka bhèni ne dènge ana na ismael, ho lasi. ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo dhu dètu dènge beer-syeba.

source_text: when the water in the skin was gone, she left the boy under one of the bushes.
target_text: ropa èle èi rinu ra, hagar tèke eele ana na ètu d'ara mamaho aj'u iiki ca kapua.

source_text: then she went off and sat down nearby, about a bowshot away, for she said, i cannot bear to watch the boy die! and as she sat nearby, she lifted up her voice and wept.
target_text: ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, d'ara ja'a la'e boe, ladhe ja'a kèdhi mamadhe ana ja'a. ka na madhèdi ako kaj'èu nèti ana na, pe d'ai lèmi nguru meter sa. ka na tangi dènge lii roma iisi.

source_text: then god heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of god called to hagar from heaven, what is wrong, hagar? do not be afraid, for god has heard the voice of the boy where he lies.
target_text: lula ama lamatua dhu tadèngi lii tangi ismael, ka ana pajuu na mai nèti sorga, ka paroa hagar, aku nèngu na, hagar! nga tao ka, èu j'èra ae sèmi ne'e ne? baku madha'u ia ka, te lamatua tadèngi le lii tangi ana èu.

source_text: get up, lift up the boy, and take him by the hand, for i will make him into a great nation.
target_text: de kèd'i lamu more ana nèi. pa'èra d'ara na, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu na, suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: then god opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. so she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
target_text: ka ama lamatua pasaraa musi madha na. cag'ag'a laa nèdhi dènge, èi ca madha ètu era èèna. hèia la'e soli èi asa d'ara babo'i, ka na panginu ana na ismael.

source_text: and god was with the boy, and he grew up and settled in the wilderness and became a great archer. and while he was dwelling in the wilderness of paran, his mother got a wife for him from the land of egypt.
target_text: ka ismael dènge ina na hagar pea dènge ka ètu d'ara mamoo paran. ismael asa na kapai, aa ne'a mèu kataki. ka ina na paleo ne dènge ana bhèni masir ca dhèu. se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ismael.

source_text: at that time abimelech and phicol the commander of his army said to abraham, god is with you in all that you do.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai pangad'o dènge abraham. hèia dhèu aae padhai lii, ka na peka, abraham! ji'i se nge'a ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èu. nèti èèna ka, sad'i èu ad'u ngaa sa èci, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: now, therefore, swear to me here before god that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that i have shown to you.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka èu subha ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, dhu peka na, èu bisa boe kapod'e-kabèli ja'a, dènge ana-èpu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. sèmi dhu ja'a tao le be'a mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao be'a kahèi mi ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a.

source_text: and abraham replied, i swear it.
target_text: ka aku abraham na, ooo! ja'a subha.

source_text: but when abraham complained to abimelech about a well that abimelech's servants had seized,
target_text: te ngaa èle èèna ka, abraham lapor dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu ama dhèu aae parame rare èi ja'a ca madha.

source_text: abimelech replied, i do not know who has done this. you did not tell me, so i have not heard about it until today.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka, waa! ja'a heka tadèngi kèna j'ara ne'e ne. tasamia ka karèi nèti ca hari ni, èu peka boe dènge ja'a? ja'a dhae ke'a mèka, ne'e ne tatao cee ka ne.

source_text: so abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to abimelech, and the two men made a covenant. abraham separated seven ewe lambs from the flock,
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham dènge abimelek pa'èki lii pajaji. ka abraham hia abimelek sapi dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. èle èèna ka, abraham hag'e nare hari kahib'i-kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u.

source_text: and abimelech asked him, why have you set apart these seven ewe lambs?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tao sèmi èèna?

source_text: he replied, you are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that i dug this well.
target_text: ka abraham peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. sèmi la kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u se, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha dhu ama peka le na, ja'a ka dhu kèi èi na.

source_text: so that place was called beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath.
target_text: lula dua ra dhu pa'èki le soo-subha ètu èèna, ka era na ra pangare na beer-syeba dhu sasoa na, ‘madha èi soo-subha'.

source_text: after they had made the covenant at beersheba, abimelech and phicol the commander of his army got up and returned to the land of the philistines.
target_text: ropa pasubha èle, ka dhèu aae dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na lèpa ka, asa era rèngu, rai dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and abraham planted a tamarisk tree in beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the lord, the eternal god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham sèle aj'u tamareska ca kapua ètu beer syeba. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, aj'u ne pasanèd'e abraham, lula ètu era èèna ka, nèngu mangaj'i lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and abraham resided in the land of the philistines for a long time.
target_text: ka abraham pea dènge ka ètu talora dhèu pilistin sèmi dhèu tao mai.

source_text: some time later god tested abraham and said to him, abraham! here i am, he answered.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia lamatua sèku neo ne'a d'ara abraham. neo ne'a abraham madhutu lamatua, do aad'o. ka lamatua paroa ne, aku nèngu na, abraham! hèia na dhaa, peka na, ooo, lamatua.

source_text: take your son, god said, your only son isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of moriah. offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which i will show you.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, mu nanene paie-iie! more ana pasue èu mone mesa na. mèti ne asa rai moria, ho tao ne j'aj'i korban tunu hia ja'a. pe d'ai nèi, ja'a heka paj'uj'u era dhu ètu ledhe èci.

source_text: so abraham got up early the next morning, saddled his donkey, and took along two of his servants and his son isaac. he split the wood for a burnt offering and set out for the place god had designated.
target_text: d'ai bèli mad'ae aae na, abraham sèg'i aj'u sèna ka tao kadhèna. na èki, ka na hue asa dedha keled'ei. ka dua ra dènge isak, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na dhèu dua, pakèd'i asa era dhu lamatua peka dènge ne.

source_text: on the third day abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
target_text: ra kako taruu, ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, abraham nèdhi le era èèna nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: stay here with the donkey, abraham told his servants. the boy and i will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu dua sèra, aku nèngu na, dua mi mate taha mi ne'e dènge keled'ei ne. ja'a dènge ana ja'a la'a asa dedha nèi, ho mangaj'i ama lamatua. ladhe èle na, ji'i lèpa hari mai.

source_text: abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son isaac. he himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together.
target_text: ka abraham nare kadhèna dhu neo tunu korban, ka na tao mi kabela-kao isak. aa nèngu nèd'u tud'i, dènge suu ai. ropa dua ra palere lasi,

source_text: then isaac said to his father abraham, my father! here i am, my son, he replied. the fire and the wood are here, said isaac, but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?
target_text: hèia isak paroa ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, ana? hèia isak karèi, aku nèngu na, èdhi neo lati tunu korban. de ai dènge kadhèna ka se'e le. te ngaa ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èdhi pake j'aj'i korban, ka mia?

source_text: abraham answered, god himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son. and the two walked on together.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abraham na, pe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu hia ana kalèbho, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban. ka dua ra ca'e lasi taruu.

source_text: when they arrived at the place god had designated, abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood. he bound his son isaac and placed him on the altar, atop the wood.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai era dhu lamatua peka èèna, ka abraham pudhi hadhu ho tao mei korban. hèia na paloko kadhèna ètu dedha mei korban ne. ka kèpe ana na isak, èki patarenga ne ètu dedha kadhèna.

source_text: then abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.
target_text: ka nare tud'i, ho neo kèj'i pamadhe ana na.

source_text: just then the angel of the lord called out to him from heaven, abraham, abraham! here i am, he replied.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua lii nèti dedha-liru, peka na, abraham! mata ku! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, lamatua?

source_text: do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him, said the angel, for now i know that you fear god, since you have not withheld your only son from me.
target_text: ka na peka hari, na, baku pamadhe ana èèna! baku tao ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu. ja'a ke'a le, èu ne tare'a-re'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula èu dènge d'ara kateme hia ana èu ca dhèu mesa èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban hia ne.

source_text: then abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns. so he went and took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
target_text: hèia abraham ladhe nèdhi kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u, dhu tadhu na pakai nare dadana aaj'u dhu karoki. ka na la'e kèpe nare, ho tunu j'aj'i mi korban hia ama lamatua, gati ana na.

source_text: and abraham called that place the lord will provide. so to this day it is said, on the mountain of the lord it will be provided.
target_text: ka abraham pangare era èèna, na, ‘lamatua sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu. ' nèti èèna ka, d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu peka na, ètu ledhe lamatua èèna, na sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu.

source_text: and the angel of the lord called to abraham from heaven a second time,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua lii hari nèti dedha-liru, peka na,

source_text: saying, by myself i have sworn, declares the lord, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,
target_text: lamatua unu na, peka, ‘ja'a subha dènge kolongara ja'a mesa ku, sèmi ne'e: èu sadia le hia ja'a ana mu ca dhèu mone mesa na ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: i will surely bless you, and i will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. your descendants will possess the gates of their enemies.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pala-bagi èu dènge ana-èpu èu mèngi-nale ae-ae. èèna na, ra bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu ige rare boe, sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa salae ètu sebhe dhasi. ana-èpu èu sèra, èèna na, segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra.

source_text: and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed my voice.
target_text: nèti ana-èpu èu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale lula èu madhutu le lii paredha ja'a. '

source_text: abraham went back to his servants, and they got up and set out together for beersheba. and abraham settled in beersheba.
target_text: èle hèia, abraham dènge isak, lèpa hari asa era dhu dhèu sab'a na sèra. ka lasi palere asa beer-syeba. d'ai nèi, abraham si pea dènge ka.

source_text: some time later, abraham was told, milcah has also borne sons to your brother nahor:
target_text: ca lod'o, abraham tadèngi na, dhèu èmu ari na nahor, dhu ngara na milka, nara iisi ana na.

source_text: uz the firstborn, his brother buz, kemuel the father of aram,
target_text: ana uru, ngara na us. ari na, bus. èle ka, nara iisi hari kemuel dhu j'aj'i ama aram.

source_text: chesed, hazo, pildash, jidlaph, and bethuel.
target_text: ka na abhu hari kesed, haso, pildas, yidlaf, dènge betuel.

source_text: and bethuel became the father of rebekah. milcah bore these eight sons to abraham's brother nahor.
target_text: betuel èèna, ama nèti ribka.

source_text: moreover, nahor's concubine, whose name was reumah, bore tebah, gaham, tahash, and maacah.
target_text: nahor abhu ana kahèi nèti bhèni piara na, ngara na reuma. ana reuma, nuka: teba, gaham, tahas, dènge maaka.

source_text: now sarah lived to be 127 years old. she died in kiriath-arba that is, hebron in the land of canaan, and abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
target_text: lod'o sara madhe, umur na ca ngasu dua nguru pidhu tèu le. lod'o na madhe èèna, abraham si pea ètu rae kiryat-arba nuka hebron, ètu rai kana'an. ka abraham beke aa tangi dhèu èmu na dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: then abraham got up from beside his dead wife and said to the hittites,
target_text: hèia abraham kèd'i la'e paraga dènge dhèu-dhèu het. ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na,

source_text: i am a foreigner and an outsider among you. give me a burial site among you so that i can bury my dead.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu tao mai ètu talora miu se. ja'a dhu dènge boe rai ca kasib'i sa, sèna ka padhane dhèu èmu ja'a. de ladhe miu sue ja'a, ja'a hèli kore rai miu d'ai ca kasib'i sa, ho tao era padhane ne.

source_text: the hittites replied to abraham,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na,

source_text: listen to us, sir. you are god's chosen one among us. bury your dead in the finest of our tombs. none of us will withhold his tomb for burying your dead.
target_text: sèmi ne'e, ama! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ji'i se tadhe le ama, dhu sama sèmi ca dhèu, dhèu heka dhu ji'i pakab'ua. de sad'i ama d'èi rai mia dhu be'a, dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi ama. ji'i se dhoka ngo'o di; dhèu èci sa dhu magee boe.

source_text: then abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the hittites.
target_text: hèia abraham pacud'u iisi ho hia hormat mi lamatua rai, dhèu het sèra.

source_text: if you are willing for me to bury my dead, he said to them, listen to me, and approach ephron son of zohar on my behalf
target_text: ka na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe miu sèmi lii ja'a na, ja'a manèngi ho peka dènge ana mone sohar, dhu ngara na efron.

source_text: to sell me the cave of machpelah that belongs to him; it is at the end of his field. let him sell it to me in your presence for full price, so that i may have a burial site.
target_text: peka dènge ne, ladhe na d'èi, na pahia dènge ja'a loe na, makpela, dhu ètu karasa oka na. na manèngi ca ngaa èèna ka, ja'a tihe. ja'a neo tihe pama'ète kab'ua na, ètu madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka rai èèna j'aj'i unu ja'a. ja'a neo tao era èèna, j'aj'i mi ro'a dhèu madhe ji'i.

source_text: now ephron was sitting among the sons of heth. so in the presence of all the hittites who had come to the gate of his city, ephron the hittite answered abraham,
target_text: lod'o èèna, efron madhèdi ètu era èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu-dhèu het sèra. ka na tadèngi kahèi lii padhai lii abraham deo na. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na b'ala abraham ètu madha dhèu heka aa'i-aa'i ra ètu sèra, aku nèngu na,

source_text: no, my lord. listen to me. i give you the field, and i give you the cave that is in it. i give it to you in the presence of my people. bury your dead.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna, ama! sèmi ne'e ka laa! oka dènge loe makpela èèna, ja'a hia iia ama. sèna ka mu padhane dhèu èmu èu mi èèna. ja'a pangèd'u rai èèna mi ama, ètu madha dhèu-dhèu ja'a se. sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i sakasii!

source_text: again abraham bowed down before the people of the land
target_text: ka abraham pacud'u kètu hari mi dhèu het se.

source_text: and said to ephron in their presence, if you will please listen to me, i will pay you the price of the field. accept it from me, so that i may bury my dead there.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge efron, aku nèngu na, sèmi èèna oo, be'a kahèi. te ngaa miu nanene lii ja'a, la ma. ja'a neo hèli pama'ète rai na, sèna ka j'aj'i era padhane dhèu-dhèu ja'a.

source_text: ephron answered abraham, listen to me, my lord. the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? bury your dead.
target_text: hèia, aku efron na, rai èèna, kab'ua na, dhoka èpa ngasu doi pudhi di. guna ngaa èdhi dua ti padhue kab'ua rai ciki oo'e èèna, dhu sasoa na aad'o. de lamu ka, ho mèti dhèu madhe na, sèna ka padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: abraham agreed to ephron's terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
target_text: ka abraham d'èi kahèi dènge kab'ua na sange èèna, madhutu sèmi lii efron. hèia ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, na ige nare doi pudhi èpa ngasu, tihe kab'ua rai èèna mi efron.

source_text: so ephron's field at machpelah near mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over to abraham's possession in the presence of all the hittites who had come to the gate of his city. after this, abraham buried his wife sarah in the cave of the field at machpelah near mamre that is, hebron in the land of canaan.
target_text: de dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, abraham abhu dènge rai ne nèti efron, j'aj'i mi unu na. rai na nuka ètu makpela, padètu dènge mamre nuka hebron. na hèli pama'ète rai ne dènge oka na, dènge loe na, aa dènge aj'u aa'i-aa'i ra. dhèu-dhèu heka nèti suku het, aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, rai èèna dènge isi aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i le unu abraham. èle èèna ka, abraham la'e padhane sara ètu d'ara loe èèna, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: so the field and its cave were deeded by the hittites to abraham as a burial site.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhu uru èèna oka dènge loe na unu dhèu het, limuri ne j'aj'i le rai unu abraham. ka na tao j'aj'i mi era udhu rui ra.

source_text: by now abraham was old and well along in years, and the lord had blessed him in every way.
target_text: tèu-tèu mamuri abraham madhera titu kèna. lamatua ladhe-leru ne dènge be'a, aa hia ne mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: so abraham instructed the chief servant of his household, who managed all he owned, place your hand under my thigh, and i will have you swear by the lord, the god of heaven and the god of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the canaanites among whom i am dwelling,
target_text: abraham dhu dènge dhèu èci dhu na lèka ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na. ca lod'o, abraham paroa nare, ka peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mu pasa dhilu èu paie-iie! ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu subha madhe dènge kolongara lamatua. nèngu ka, ama lamatua dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. dhu peka na, èu bisa boe more ana bhèni nèti dhèu kana'an, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a isak.

source_text: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son isaac.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i lamu ku asa rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa a'ari ja'a. ho tenge ètu rèngu sèi, ana bhèni ca dhèu, ho mu paleo dènge ana ja'a ne.

source_text: the servant asked him, what if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? shall i then take your son back to the land from which you came?
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne karèi abraham, aku nèngu na, be'a, ama! te ngaa, sèmi ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, na tasamia? ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i ja'a kèti ana ama ku, ho hia ne leo-èmu ètu nèi, do tasamia?

source_text: abraham replied, make sure that you do not take my son back there.
target_text: hèia, aku abraham na, èu nanene paie! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, mage èu mèti ana ja'a ne, asa nèi kahèi!
