source_text: the lord, the god of heaven, who brought me from my father's house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘to your offspring i will give this land'-he will send his angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.
target_text: mu sanèd'e, te lamatua dhu nèd'u koasa ètu dedha-liru, ka dhu lere ja'a nèti rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa dedha-rai ne'e ne. aa dhu na pa'èki le lii pajaji dènge ja'a, dhu peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne aa'i-aa'i mi ana-èpu èu. ' de èu baku madha'u. sad'i lamu. te èèna na, lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu paraga dènge ana bhèni, dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: and if the woman is unwilling to follow you, then you are released from this oath of mine. only do not take my son back there.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, lii soo-subha ne lèke boe èu. masi ka tasamia na, èu bisa boe mèti ana ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: so the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne, ded'e subha dènge abraham, ka na peka, èèna na, nèngu tao madhutu dad'èi abraham aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: then the servant took ten of his master's camels and departed with all manner of good things from his master in hand. and he set out for nahor's hometown in aram-naharaim.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna pili nare badha onta canguru ngi'u. hèia na hua rupa-rupa mèdha dhu kab'ua asa dedha onta se. hèia la'e ka asa kota nahor, ètu rai mesopotamia.

source_text: as evening approached, he made the camels kneel down near the well outside the town at the time when the women went out to draw water.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka mone ne d'ai kota èèna. hèia na ae kabhèsu dènge onta sèra ètu sebhe kota èèna, dètu dènge madha èi èci. na ae èèna d'ara lod'o nihia le, ropa ana bhèni-ana bhèni kota èèna mai rara èi ètu madha èi èèna.

source_text: o lord, god of my master abraham, he prayed, please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master abraham.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne sabaj'a, peka na, lamatua, èu ka dhu j'aj'i ama lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a, abraham. bhoke j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka kakako ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. pad'elo sasue èu mi lamatua ja'a, aa baku bhèlu lii pajaji ne dènge ja'a. de hia la ja'a paraga dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: here i am, standing beside the spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
target_text: lamatua, ja'a ka titu ètu karasa madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti kota ne, mai rara èi ètu ne'e.

source_text: now may it happen that the girl to whom i say, ‘please let down your jar that i may drink, ' and who responds, ‘drink, and i will water your camels as well'-let her be the one you have appointed for your servant isaac. by this i will know that you have shown kindness to my master.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge ana bhèni èci, peka na, ‘ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu hia ja'a kinu. ' ho ladhe na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama, minu la! aa, pe ja'a hia dènge onta ama, rinu hèi! ' j'ara ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, ana bhèni ne ka dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u, j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu isak! dènge tadha sèmi ne'e, ja'a ke'a na lamatua pad'elo le babe'a mi abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna.

source_text: before the servant had finished praying, rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. she was the daughter of bethuel son of milcah, the wife of abraham's brother nahor. now the girl was very beautiful, a virgin who had not had relations with any man. she went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up again.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a nare mèka, ana bhèni ca dhèu mai. ngara na ribka. nèngu ne, èpu nèti ari abraham, nuka nahor, dènge dhèu èmu na, milka. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ribka ne, bhèni iia nia boe, aa pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge mone. d'ai era èèna, puru asa d'ara èi la'e, ka na isi èru èi na. nèbhu boe, ka ca'e mai sa dedha.

source_text: so the servant ran to meet her and said, please let me have a little water from your jar.
target_text: ropa nare dedha, ka dhèu sab'a abraham èèna, la'e padètu dènge ne. hèia na manèngi, peka na, ana. hia ku ja'a kinu ciki.

source_text: drink, my lord, she replied, and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
target_text: ka na dhaa, minu la, ama! hèia na papuru ka èru èi na, ka na hia dhèu ne ninu.

source_text: after she had given him a drink, she said, i will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.
target_text: ropa ninu èle, ka ana bhèni ne peka na, pe ja'a laku dhui hari èi, sèna ka hia onta ama se, rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw water, until she had drawn water for all his camels.
target_text: ka la'e bhori èi dhu risi, asa d'ara karab'a badha. hèia na ca'e-la'e mai pèri-pèri hari, dhui èi, ho hia onta se rinu toke bècu.

source_text: meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the lord had made his journey a success.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a abraham, titu ka mau-mau, na taru kira ka ana bhèni ne sab'a. ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ele boe nèngu èèna ka ne'e, dhu lamatua paj'uj'u.

source_text: and after the camels had finished drinking, he took out a gold ring weighing a beka, and two gold bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels.
target_text: onta se rinu toke bècu. hèia dhèu ne nare kadheli sahènga, dènge kanau ca pasa. mèdha se dhu tao nèti hualaa. ka na pasa mi sahènga dènge pasaluu mi ai kariu dènge g'ana ana bhèni ne.

source_text: whose daughter are you? he asked. please tell me, is there room in your father's house for us to spend the night?
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ne karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ama mu, ngara na cee? ladhe mo'o, na ja'a manubha taha ètu èmu ama mu.

source_text: she replied, i am the daughter of bethuel, the son that milcah bore to nahor.
target_text: hèia na dhaa, ngara ama ku, na betuel. aa ngara baki ku, nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka.

source_text: then she added, we have plenty of straw and feed, as well as a place for you to spend the night.
target_text: ètu èmu ji'i, era j'unu ae, de d'ai miu j'unu. aa j'u'u ae kahèi, ho hia badha miu se ra'a.

source_text: then the man bowed down and worshiped the lord,
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne pahaha iisi ho mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: saying, blessed be the lord, the god of my master abraham, who has not withheld his kindness and faithfulness from my master. as for me, the lord has led me on the journey to the house of my master's relatives.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, ka ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu kabarai ne'e. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi lamatua ja'a, abraham, aa tao madhutu sama sèmi lii pajaji na dènge ja'a.

source_text: the girl ran and told her mother's household about these things.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana bhèni ne rai la'e asa èmu, na lolo dènge isi èmu na ngaa dhu j'aj'i le èèna.

source_text: now rebekah had a brother named laban, and he rushed out to the man at the spring. as soon as he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister's wrists, and heard rebekah's words, the man said this to me, he went and found the man standing by the camels near the spring.
target_text: ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. ropa laban ladhe nèdhi mèdha hualaa se, aa na tadèngi lii lolo ana hèni na, ka rai asa li'u la'e. la'e soru dhèu sab'a abraham dhu titu era dènge onta ra ètu madha èi.

source_text: come, you who are blessed by the lord, said laban. why are you standing out here? i have prepared the house and a place for the camels.
target_text: hèia laban peka, aku nèngu na, ama! lamatua ka dhu lere miu mai dènge karej'e-karae d'ai ne'e. de baku titu mi li'u ne! mai lati sa èmu ji'i, te ji'i lalau ngare le kama. nganga'a hia badha se, dhu tesa.

source_text: so the man came to the house, and the camels were unloaded. straw and feed were brought to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a abraham ne, madhutu dènge ka laban, lasi èmu betuel. ka laban si papuru mèdha-panyau nèti dedha onta se. èle èèna ka, ra panga'a onta se. rèti èi, hia dhèu sab'a dènge anga na se, ho rase haga.

source_text: then a meal was set before the man, but he said, i will not eat until i have told you what i came to say. so laban said, please speak.
target_text: ropa lalau rare nganga'a-nginu ètu dedha mei, dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ji'i neo nga'a ne, te ngaa ja'a lole uuru ku, mamai ja'a ne. ka laban dhaa, peka na, ama, mu padhai lii ngaa, na peka ka laa.

source_text: i am abraham's servant, he replied.
target_text: hèia dhèu èèna peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu sab'a nèti baki miu abraham.

source_text: the lord has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. he has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
target_text: lamatua hia abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna, mèngi-nale ae titu kèna, ka na kaja-su'i. lamatua pala-bagi ne doi hualaa pudhi dènge hualaa iia; ènu dhèu bhèni dènge dhèu mone, dènge badha-manu ae-ae, sèmi: sapi, onta, keled'ei, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: my master's wife sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.
target_text: lod'o lamatua ja'a se, bhèni-mone d'ai heka ku, ka sara nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu aa'i pusaka ama na.

source_text: my master made me swear an oath and said, ‘you shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the canaanites in whose land i dwell,
target_text: ka abraham pua ja'a subha, peka na, ‘mage èu more ana bhèni kana'an kahèi, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a, isak.

source_text: but you shall go to my father's house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son. '
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i more ana bhèni nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. '

source_text: then i asked my master, ‘what if the woman will not come back with me? '
target_text: hèia ja'a karèi ne, aku ja'a na, ‘tasamia, ladhe ana bhèni ne, no'o boe madhutu ja'a mai sa ne'e? '

source_text: and he told me, ‘the lord, before whom i have walked, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father's house.
target_text: ka na peka, ‘lamatua dhu ja'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na paleha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: and when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath. '
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'ari ja'a se'e ro'o boe ana bhèni na mai asa ne'e, lii subha na lèke boe mi dedha èu ne. '

source_text: so when i came to the spring today, i prayed: o lord, god of my master abraham, if only you would make my journey a success!
target_text: ka deo na, ropa ja'a d'ai madha èi èèna, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara, peka na, ‘lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a abraham. bhoke ku j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka mamai ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. ho sèna ka ja'a abhu ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: here i am, standing beside this spring. now if a maiden comes out to draw water and i say to her, ‘please let me drink a little water from your jar, '
target_text: lamatua, ja'a titu ètu sebhe madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti d'ara kota ne mai rara èi ètu ne'e. de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a peka dènge ana bhèni èci, aku ja'a na, ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu, ho ja'a kinu èi ciki.

source_text: and she replies, ‘drink, and i will draw water for your camels as well, ' may she be the woman the lord has appointed for my master's son.
target_text: ho ladhe na dhaa na, oo. minu! aa èle na, ja'a panginu badha ama se kahèi! ladhe j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii ja'a ne, na èèna ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, ana bhèni ne ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nare hia ana lamatua ja'a. '

source_text: and before i had finished praying in my heart, there was rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. so i said to her, ‘please give me a drink. '
target_text: ja'a dhu dhae èle mèka manèngi-mangaj'i, te ribka dhu nare le era èèna nèti dènge èru èi na. ropa na ca'e mai nèti d'ara èi, ja'a lii dènge ne, aku ja'a na, ‘ana, ee! hia ku ja'a kinu èi ciki. '

source_text: she quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘drink, and i will water your camels as well. ' so i drank, and she also watered the camels.
target_text: ka na papuru dènge ka èru èi na, ka na peka, ‘oo. minu! aa pe ja'a panginu onta ama se kahèi. ' hèia ja'a kinu, aa onta ja'a se oo rinu kahèi.

source_text: then i asked her, ‘whose daughter are you? ' she replied, ‘the daughter of bethuel son of nahor, whom milcah bore to him. ' so i put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.
target_text: ka ja'a karèi ne, ‘ama mu, ngara na cee? ' ka na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama ku, ngara na betuel. aa baki ku, ngara na nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka. ' hèia ja'a papake ne kadheli mi sahènga na, dènge pasaluu kanau hualaa ca pasa mi ai kariu dènge ai g'ana na.

source_text: then i bowed down and worshiped the lord; and i blessed the lord, the god of my master abraham, who led me on the right road to take the granddaughter of my master's brother for his son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a pacud'u kètu ho mangaj'i mi lamatua, ka ja'a peka na, ‘koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu era ne'e ne. aa paraga le kahèi dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak! '

source_text: now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, let me know, so that i may go elsewhere.
target_text: de ne'e ne, ladhe ama si neo pad'elo sasue mi lamatua ja'a abraham, na mi peka pamèu dènge ja'a. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, peka la mola-mola dènge ja'a. ho ja'a ke'a, sèna ka tao hari ngaa.

source_text: laban and bethuel answered, this is from the lord; we have no choice in the matter.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii nare, ka laban dènge betuel dhaa, aku rèngu na, ladhe lamatua dhu ad'u nare le madha j'ara ne, ji'i peka lii ngaa hari.

source_text: rebekah is here before you. take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master's son, just as the lord has decreed.
target_text: ribka ka ne'e ne. more ho mèti, sèna ka na j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana abraham, madhutu sèmi dhu lamatua ator èèna.

source_text: when abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed down to the ground before the lord.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: then he brought out jewels of silver and gold, and articles of clothing, and he gave them to rebekah. he also gave precious gifts to her brother and her mother.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nare mèdha nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi sèra, dènge mèdha-papake dhu saraga, ka na hia mi ribka. aa na hia kahèi mi ana mone na dènge ina na, mèdha-mèdha dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: then he and the men with him ate and drank and spent the night there. when they got up the next morning, he said, send me on my way to my master.
target_text: èle aa'i ka, heka dhèu sab'a ne dènge anga na madhèdi ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra j'unu ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu sab'a ne palangu lii dènge lamatua èmu se, aku nèngu na, hia ka ja'a ho lèpa la asa lamatua ja'a abraham.

source_text: but her brother and mother said, let the girl remain with us ten days or so. after that, she may go.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: but he replied, do not delay me, since the lord has made my journey a success. send me on my way so that i may go to my master.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: so they said, we will call the girl and ask her opinion.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: they called rebekah and asked her, will you go with this man? i will go, she replied.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: so they sent their sister rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and abraham's servant and his men. and they blessed rebekah and said to her, our sister, may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands. may your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: then rebekah and her servant girls got ready, mounted the camels, and followed the man. so the servant took rebekah and left.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: now isaac had just returned from beer-lahai-roi, for he was living in the negev.
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: early in the evening, isaac went out to the field to meditate, and looking up, he saw the camels approaching.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: and when rebekah looked up and saw isaac, she got down from her camel
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.

source_text: and asked the servant, who is that man in the field coming to meet us? it is my master, the servant answered. so she took her veil and covered herself.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: then the servant told isaac all that he had done.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: and isaac brought her into the tent of his mother sarah and took rebekah as his wife. and isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother's death.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: now abraham had taken another wife, named keturah,
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: and she bore him zimran, jokshan, medan, midian, ishbak, and shuah.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: jokshan was the father of sheba and dedan. and the sons of dedan were the asshurites, the letushites, and the leummites.
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: the sons of midian were ephah, epher, hanoch, abida, and eldaah. all these were descendants of keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: abraham left everything he owned to isaac. but while he was still alive, abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son isaac to the land of the east.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: abraham lived a total of 175 years. and at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: his sons isaac and ishmael buried him in the cave of machpelah near mamre, in the field of ephron son of zohar the hittite. this was the field that abraham had bought from the hittites. abraham was buried there with his wife sarah.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: after abraham's death, god blessed his son isaac, who lived near beer-lahai-roi.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: this is the account of abraham's son ishmael, whom hagar the egyptian, sarah's maidservant, bore to abraham.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: these are the names of the sons of ishmael in the order of their birth: nebaioth the firstborn of ishmael, then kedar, adbeel, mibsam, mishma, dumah, massa, hadad, tema, jetur, naphish, and kedemah. these were the sons of ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments-twelve princes of their tribes.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: ishmael lived a total of 137 years. then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: ishmael's descendants settled from havilah to shur, which is near the border of egypt as you go toward asshur. and they lived in hostility toward all their brothers.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: this is the account of abraham's son isaac. abraham became the father of isaac,
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: and isaac was forty years old when he married rebekah, the daughter of bethuel the aramean from paddan-aram and the sister of laban the aramean.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: later, isaac prayed to the lord on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. and the lord heard his prayer, and his wife rebekah conceived.
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: but the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, why is this happening to me? so rebekah went to inquire of the lord,
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: and he declared to her: two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: when her time came to give birth, there were indeed twins in her womb.
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: the first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him esau.
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: after this, his brother came out grasping esau's heel; so he was named jacob. and isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: when the boys grew up, esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: because isaac had a taste for wild game, he loved esau; but rebekah loved jacob.
target_text: isak d'èi na'a sisi badha hui. nèti èèna ka, na sue risi esau. te ngaa ribka sue risi yakob.

source_text: one day, while jacob was cooking some stew, esau came in from the field and was famished.
target_text: ca lod'o, yakob dhu tao bubur kab'ui, aa esau heka lèpa nèti kasiro badha hui kèna. na lèpa dènge manganga, ka roe titu kèna.

source_text: he said to jacob, let me eat some of that red stew, for i am famished. that is why he was also called edom.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ari, ee! hia ku ja'a bubur kab'ui mea ciki ètu d'ara èru èèna, ho ja'a ku'a! te ja'a manganga bia. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare na, edom, dhu sasoa na ‘mea'.

source_text: first sell me your birthright, jacob replied.
target_text: ka, aku yakob na, be'a a'a. te ngaa pasilu ku dènge hak a'a èèna!

source_text: look, said esau, i am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?
target_text: hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, hak a'a ne, ngaa kèna, hud'i nèngu sèna! neo more, na more la. te ja'a manganga bia. sod'e mèti bubur èèna lai-lai mai, te ja'a taha heka.

source_text: swear to me first, jacob said. so esau swore to jacob and sold him the birthright.
target_text: te ngaa, aku yakob hari na, mata ku a'a! èu subha uuru ku, dhu peka na, èu pangèd'u le hak a'a èèna mi ja'a ne. ka esau ded'e subha sèmi dhu yakob peka.

source_text: then jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. thus esau despised his birthright.
target_text: hèia yakob sod'e dènge ka hia ne bubur kab'ui deo na dènge roti. ropa na'a-ninu nare, ka la'e dènge ka. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, esau pusi boe dènge hak a'a na.

source_text: now there was another famine in the land, subsequent to the one that had occurred in abraham's time. and isaac went to abimelech king of the philistines at gerar.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara rai èèna, lèke tèu manganga, èci èèna ka dènge tèu abraham mamuri era. ka isak la'e manèngi abimelek, dhèu aae pilistin, sèna ka na pea ètu gerar.

source_text: the lord appeared to isaac and said, do not go down to egypt. settle in the land where i tell you.
target_text: na tao sèmi èèna, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le iisi na mi nèngu, peka na, mage lamu ka asa masir hèi. pea la mi era dhu èèna na ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu.

source_text: stay in this land as a foreigner, and i will be with you and bless you. for i will give all these lands to you and your offspring, and i will confirm the oath that i swore to your father abraham. i will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and i will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed,
target_text: ladhe èu manubha ètu era èèna, ja'a sama-sama dènge èu, aa pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. èèna na, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru. aa ja'a hia kateme rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a tao madhutu lii pajaji dhu ja'a pa'èki le dènge ama mu abraham.

source_text: because abraham listened to my voice and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi ne'e ne, lula ama mu madhutu dad'èi ja'a, paredha ja'a, dènge atora ja'a.

source_text: so isaac settled in gerar.
target_text: ka isak pea taha ètu gerar.

source_text: but when the men of that place asked about his wife, he said, she is my sister. for he was afraid to say, she is my wife, since he thought to himself, the men of this place will kill me on account of rebekah, because she is so beautiful.
target_text: ribka ne, bhèni iia titu kèna. ka ropa dhèu ètu gerar ladhe rèdhi ne, ra pakarèi. te ngaa isak peka na, ribka ne, ana hèni ja'a. na madha'u, ladhe na peka na dhèu èmu nèngu, dhèu se pamadhe ne, aa ribka parame rare.

source_text: when isaac had been there a long time, abimelech king of the philistines looked down from the window and was surprised to see isaac caressing his wife rebekah.
target_text: isak dhu pea nèbhu le ètu nèi, hèia ca lod'o, dhèu aae nèdhi nèti ro'a jendela na, ladhe laa na isak dènge ribka dhu pa'ango.

source_text: abimelech sent for isaac and said, so she is really your wife! how could you say, ‘she is my sister'? isaac replied, because i thought i might die on account of her.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu lasi paroa isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a dhu ke'a le, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu! te ngaa tasamia ka, èu peka na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu? hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ama! ja'a ne madha'u, ladhe ja'a peka na nèngu ne dhèu èmu ja'a, mage dhoka dhèu pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: what is this you have done to us? asked abimelech. one of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.
target_text: ka dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, sèmi dhèu ètu se'e j'unu dènge dhèu èmu èu, tatu èu pasala ji'i! tasamia ka, èu ad'u j'ara ne'e mi dedha ji'i se?

source_text: so abimelech warned all the people, saying, whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pasanèd'e ana kabarai na, aku nèngu na, miu nanene paie-iie! cee ka dhu bani gagu dhèu ne'e, do dhèu èmu na, èèna na ja'a huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: now isaac sowed seed in the land, and that very year he reaped a hundredfold. and the lord blessed him,
target_text: tèu èèna, isak sèle hini ètu dedha rai dhèu se'e. lod'o d'ai puu-g'ètu, ka na abhu isi rai cangasu hari, lula lamatua hia ne mamèngi.

source_text: and he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.
target_text: lula mèdha-panyau na asa ae, ka na kaja titu kèna.

source_text: he owned so many flocks and herds and servants that the philistines envied him.
target_text: badha-manu na sèmi sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho asa tabha ae. dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pilistin tèka d'ara dènge ne.

source_text: so the philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father's servants had dug in the days of his father abraham.
target_text: uru èèna, abraham, ama isak, dhu kèi èi ae-ae. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si dènge rai.

source_text: then abimelech said to isaac, depart from us, for you are much too powerful for us.
target_text: ka dhèu aae abimelek peka dènge isak, aku nèngu na, isak! be'a risi èu pakèd'i ka nèti kabarai ne'e. lula koasa èu, risi eele le nèti ji'i se.

source_text: so isaac left that place and encamped in the valley of gerar and settled there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak pakèd'i nèti era èèna, ka lasi pea hari ètu d'ara mamoo gerar.

source_text: isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the days of his father abraham, which the philistines had stopped up after abraham died. and he gave these wells the same names his father had given them.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra kèi hari madha èi dhu uru èèna, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si. ka na pangare madha èi se madhutu ngara dhu ama na pangare.

source_text: then isaac's servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water there.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a isak se kèi èi ètu d'ara mamoo gerar, hèi lèke èi madha dhu sabhoka mai.

source_text: but the herdsmen of gerar quarreled with isaac's herdsmen and said, the water is ours! so he named the well esek, because they contended with him.
target_text: lula madha èi ne'e ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenge badha nèti gerar, patao dènge dhèu madhenge badha isak. dhèu se peka na, ne'e ne, madha èi ji'i! nèti èèna ka, isak pangare madha èi na esek, dhu sasoa na ‘patao-palaha'.

source_text: then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it sitnah.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu isak se, kèi hari èi leo ca madha. te ngaa ra patao-palaha hari, lula èi èèna. nèti èèna ka, isak pangare na sitna, dhu sasoa na ‘palab'a'.

source_text: he moved on from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. he named it rehoboth and said, at last the lord has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tèke eele era èèna, la'e kèi hari èi èci. d'ai ne'e ne, ra patao-palaha heka. ka isak pangare madha èi ne rehobot, dhu sasoa na ‘era taleo'. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, lamatua hia le èdhi pea ètu era taleo. ho ètu era ne'e ne, èdhi asa bèba-kacanga.

source_text: from there isaac went up to beersheba,
target_text: ka nèti era ne'e, isak si lasi hari era pea asa beer syeba.

source_text: and that night the lord appeared to him and said, i am the god of your father abraham. do not be afraid, for i am with you. i will bless you and multiply your descendants for the sake of my servant abraham.
target_text: ka mèda na, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti ama mu abraham. de mage mu madha'u, te ja'a ladhe-leru èu. èèna na, ja'a pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale. aa ana-èpu èu asa bèba-kacanga. ja'a ad'u madha j'ara ne'e, lula lii pajaji ja'a dènge ama mu.

source_text: so isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the lord, and he pitched his tent there. his servants also dug a well there.
target_text: hèia isak pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban ètu èèna. ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. hèia, na pea ètu era èèna, ka dhèu sab'a na kèi hari èi.

source_text: later, abimelech came to isaac from gerar, with ahuzzath his adviser and phicol the commander of his army.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek mai nèti gerar. angalai na ahusat, dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai dènge ne, ho paraga dènge isak.

source_text: why have you come to me? isaac asked them. you hated me and sent me away.
target_text: ka isak karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! uru èèna, miu se dhu babège eele ja'a nèti kabarai miu. de ne'e ne, miu se mai tao ngaa hari?

source_text: we can plainly see that the lord has been with you, they replied. we recommend that there should now be an oath between us and you. let us make a covenant with you
target_text: hèia ra peka na, sèmi ne'e. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua dhu j'aga pa'ère èu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pangee, hua iia èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji dhu peka sèmi ne'e: èu j'oka subha, peka na,

source_text: that you will not harm us, just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you, sending you on your way in peace. and now you are blessed by the lord.
target_text: miu se baku tao karehe dènge ji'i, aa ji'i kahèi baku tao karehe dènge miu. mema ji'i se d'ara be'a dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, ca hari ni, miu se lami dènge mera-milu nèti kabarai ji'i ne. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale mi miu.

source_text: so isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tao pesta, ka ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they got up early the next morning and swore an oath to each other. then isaac sent them on their way, and they left him in peace.
target_text: ka asa bèli mad'ae èèna, rèngu j'oka lii soo-subha. hèia isak patalala si lèpa dènge dame.

source_text: on that same day, isaac's servants came and told him about the well they had dug. we have found water! they told him.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu sab'a isak mai peka lula-nèti èi dhu rèngu kèi, na, ama! ji'i rage le èi.

source_text: so he called it shibah, and to this day the name of the city is beersheba.
target_text: hèia isak pangare madha èi ne syeba dhu sasoa na ‘subha'. ka ra pangare kota èèna beer syeba, toke sange ne'e.

source_text: when esau was forty years old, he took as his wives judith daughter of beeri the hittite and basemath daughter of elon the hittite.
target_text: ropa umur esau d'ai èpa nguru tèu, na leo dènge bhèni dhèu dua nèti suku het. bhèni èci, ana nèti beeri, ngara na yudit. èci hari, ana elon, ngara na basmat.

source_text: and they brought grief to isaac and rebekah.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, papèd'a d'ara isak dènge ribka.

source_text: when isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called his older son esau and said to him, my son. here i am, esau replied.
target_text: ropa isak manahu asa d'ara heka, nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa, lula musi madha na ahu le. ka na paroa ana uuru èèna, dhu na sue risi èèna, peka na, esau. mai ku sa ne'e! hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama?

source_text: look, said isaac, i am now old, and i do not know the day of my death.
target_text: ka isak peka hari, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne, ètu d'ara heka le. ke'a boe, pèri lod'o ja'a ne madhe.

source_text: take your weapons-your quiver and bow-and go out into the field to hunt some game for me.
target_text: de more rèka èu, lamu kataki mèti badha hui ci'u hia ja'a.

source_text: then prepare a tasty dish that i love and bring it to me to eat, so that i may bless you before i die.
target_text: mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a, madhutu dad'èi ja'a, ho mèti mai hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia mema èu mèngi-nale. sad'i èu unu le mèngi-nale èèna, ja'a madhe èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: now rebekah was listening to what isaac told his son esau. so when esau went into the field to hunt game and bring it back,
target_text: hèia esau la'e dènge ka, kataki badha hui. te ngaa ribka dhu tadèngi kahèi lii padhai isak deo na.

source_text: rebekah said to her son jacob, behold, i overheard your father saying to your brother esau,
target_text: ka ribka la'e peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, yakob! èu nanene ku! deo na, ja'a tadèngi ama mu pua esau sèmi ne'e:

source_text: ‘bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that i may bless you in the presence of the lord before i die. '
target_text: ‘lamu kataki more ku badha hui ci'u, mai mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale ètu katanga madha lamatua. '

source_text: now, my son, listen to my voice and do exactly as i tell you.
target_text: de mu nanene paie-iie! mu madhutu mola-mola lii paredha ja'a ne.

source_text: go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so that i can make them into a tasty dish for your father-the kind he loves.
target_text: de lamu ka asa era badha èdhi sèi, ho kèpe more kalèbho èni dhu kabèb'u dua ngi'u. roro ho mèti sisi mai asa ja'a. pe ja'a pananasu madhutu dad'èi ama mu.

source_text: then take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies.
target_text: ladhe panasu kore, mèti hia ama mu na'a. ho èle na, na hia èu mèngi-nale, heka na madhe kèna. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, èu ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale èèna. a'a mu abhu boe.

source_text: jacob answered his mother rebekah, look, my brother esau is a hairy man, but i am smooth-skinned.
target_text: te ngaa yakob peka dènge ina na, ina! a'a ku esau, ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge rèu, te ngaa ja'a ne, isi dhu milu aadha-aadha!

source_text: what if my father touches me? then i would be revealed to him as a deceiver, and i would bring upon myself a curse rather than a blessing.
target_text: mage dhoka ama ku g'ag'e isi ja'a, ladhe na ne'a na ja'a dhu leko-monya na. hèia na dhoo ja'a!

source_text: his mother replied, your curse be on me, my son. just obey my voice and go get them for me.
target_text: ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, èu baku cag'ag'a! hud'i laa ina ka dhu ator! ladhe ama mu dhoo èu, pe ina ka pasae! mu mate ia ka, la more ka kahib'i sèra.

source_text: so jacob went and got two goats and brought them to his mother, who made the tasty food his father loved.
target_text: ka yakob la'e nare kahib'i dua ngi'u sèra, hèia na roro, ka nèti hia ina na. hèia ribka pananasu madhutu dad'èi isak.

source_text: and rebekah took the finest clothes in the house that belonged to her older son esau, and she put them on her younger son jacob.
target_text: ka ribka la'e nare mèdha-papake esau dhu be'a, ho na papake mi yakob.

source_text: she also put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
target_text: hèia na pahutu kahèi kacui-aai dènge ladhe goro yakob, pake ka'uri kahib'i deo sa.

source_text: then she handed her son jacob the tasty food and bread she had made.
target_text: ka na pangèd'u yakob nganga'a dhu pananasu nare deo na, dènge roti dhu tunu nare.

source_text: so jacob went to his father and said, my father. here i am! he answered. which one are you, my son?
target_text: hèia yakob ded'e nèti nganga'a se'e, hia ama na na'a. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama. ja'a mai hari le. hèia isak dhaa, peka na, hee! èu ne, cee?

source_text: jacob said to his father, i am esau, your firstborn. i have done as you told me. please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may bless me.
target_text: ka yakob dhaa, peka na, ja'a, esau ana mone uuru ama ku! ja'a sab'e le, madhutu sèmi dhu ama pua deo na. kèd'i, ho mu'a-minu ka. lula ja'a pananasu kore le sisi badha hui dhu ja'a kèti nèti d'ara j'ami. mu'a, ho èle na, ama pala-bagi ja'a mèngi-nale.

source_text: but isaac asked his son, how did you ever find it so quickly, my son? because the lord your god brought it to me, he replied.
target_text: hèia isak peka, aku nèngu na, èu ne, bia tai nga! abhu malai titu kèna, badha hui èèna! hèia yakob dhaa, ja'a abhu le, lula lamatua dhu èu mangaj'i èèna, ka dhu tulu ja'a.

source_text: then isaac said to jacob, please come closer so i can touch you, my son. are you really my son esau, or not?
target_text: ka isak paroa yakob, aku nèngu na, padètu ku asa ne'e mai, sèna ka ja'a g'ag'e sèku èu. èu ne, tare'a ana ja'a esau, do aad'o?

source_text: so jacob came close to his father isaac, who touched him and said, the voice is the voice of jacob, but the hands are the hands of esau.
target_text: hèia yakob la'e padètu-dètu dènge ama na, ka ama na g'ag'e ne. ka isak peka, lii ne, sèmi lii yakob! te ngaa kacui-aai na, kacui-aai esau.

source_text: isaac did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like those of his brother esau; so he blessed him.
target_text: te ngaa isak dhu tadhe iia boe yakob, lula kacui-aai na rèu sèmi esau. ka ropa na neo hia mèngi-nale mi yakob,

source_text: again he asked, are you really my son esau? and he replied, i am.
target_text: na karèi hari era, aku nèngu na, èu ne, tare'a-re'a esau, do? hèia yakob dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a ama. ja'a ne, esau!

source_text: serve me, said isaac, and let me eat some of my son's game, so that i may bless you. jacob brought it to him, and he ate; then he brought him wine, and he drank.
target_text: ka isak peka na, na, j'ole ka sisina mai, sèna ka ja'a ku'a. èle ku, pe ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale. hèia yakob hia sisi dènge èi anggor hia ama na na'a-ninu.

source_text: then his father isaac said to him, please come near and kiss me, my son.
target_text: na'a nare ka, isak lii, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai padètu asa ne'e, ho mu uu ku ja'a laa.

source_text: so he came near and kissed him. when isaac smelled his clothing, he blessed him and said: ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the lord has blessed.
target_text: ka ropa yakob padètu dènge ne, ho uu ne, isak sangèd'u nare hèu mèdha-papake esau. hèia na padhai lii hia mèngi-nale mi yakob, aku nèngu na, hèu ana ja'a tare'a-re'a sèmi hèu j'u'u ètu d'ara pad'a, dhu abhu mamèngi nèti lamatua.

source_text: may god give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth- an abundance of grain and new wine.
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua patiri èi paringi nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka oka-tedhe èu j'aj'i mi rai hèu mèngi. hud'i laa na hia èu are dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, dènge hua anggor dhu pènu ako-pènu èru.

source_text: may peoples serve you and nations bow down to you. may you be the master of your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. may those who curse you be cursed, and those who bless you be blessed.
target_text: suku-suku j'aj'i mi ènu èu, aa dhèu-dhèu leo pahaha iisi mi dedha èu. èu j'aj'i mi lamatua nèti a'ari èu. aa rèngu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha èu. dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu, rèngu abhu dhoo kahèi. aa dhèu cee dhu hia mèngi-nale mi èu, rèngu abhu mèngi-nale kahèi.

source_text: as soon as isaac had finished blessing him and jacob had left his father's presence, his brother esau returned from the hunt.
target_text: ropa isak hia nare mèngi-nale mi yakob, ka heka bhodho li'u la'e tèke eele ama na, cag'ag'a laa esau lèpa nèti kataki badha hui.

source_text: he too made some tasty food, brought it to his father, and said to him, my father, sit up and eat of your son's game, so that you may bless me.
target_text: hèia la'e pananasu, ka sod'e nèti hia ama na. ka na parèi ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, kèd'i mu'a. ja'a lalau kore le sisi badha dhu ja'a kataki kore. mu'a more ku, pe hia ja'a berkat.

source_text: but his father isaac replied, who are you? i am esau, your firstborn son, he answered.
target_text: te ngaa isak malaa, ka na karèi, hee! te èu ne, cee hari ne? hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e, esau! ana uuru ama ku.

source_text: isaac began to tremble violently and said, who was it, then, who hunted the game and brought it to me? before you came in, i ate it all and blessed him-and indeed, he will be blessed!
target_text: ka isak cag'ag'a, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, deo na cee ka dhu hia ja'a sisi, ka ja'a ku'a èèna? ka ja'a hia ne mèngi-nale. aa mèngi-nale èèna, bisa heka ère hari.

source_text: when esau heard his father's words, he let out a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, bless me too, o my father!
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, esau roe ai ca palèpa, ka na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, aku nèngu na, tasamia ne, ama, ee! bagi hia ja'a berkat hèi ma.

source_text: but isaac replied, your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.
target_text: hèia isak peka, ari mu ka monya ja'a, ka parame nare berkat dhu pala èu di.

source_text: so esau declared, is he not rightly named jacob? for he has cheated me twice. he took my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing. then he asked, haven't you saved a blessing for me?
target_text: ka aku esau na, nèngu na leko-monya ja'a dua hari kèna. uru èèna, parame nare hak a'a. ka ne'e ne, parame nare hari berkat dhu madhutu iia-iia na unu ja'a. nèka na, ngara na ‘yakob' te ngaa ele boe ama dhu dènge berkat era, ho hia ja'a. do, aad'o heka? yakob sasoa na ‘kèpe hui tèdhu', te ngaa sasoa dhu leo ‘tuka leko-monya'.

source_text: but isaac answered esau: look, i have made him your master and given him all his relatives as servants; i have sustained him with grain and new wine. what is left that i can do for you, my son?
target_text: hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu ded'e le nèngu, j'aj'i lamatua èu. aa a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra, j'aj'i mi ènu na. ja'a hia na le, unu are pènu soka-pènu karo, dènge hua anggor pènu ako-pènu èru. de ana, ee! mamèngi tasamia hari, dhu ja'a ne pala-bagi mi èu?

source_text: esau said to his father, do you have only one blessing, my father? bless me too, o my father! then esau wept aloud.
target_text: masi ka tadèngi nare le sèmi èèna, te ngaa esau loe boe dènge pamako ama na, peka na, mamèngi na dhodhoka èci di, do? tatu ama dènge hari mamèngi dhu leo hia ja'a. masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ne abhu! ka esau tangi hari dènge d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: his father isaac answered him: behold, your dwelling place shall be away from the richness of the land, away from the dew of heaven above.
target_text: ka isak b'ala ne, peka na, mamuri èu ne, èèna na kaj'èu nèti oka-tedhe dhu hèu mèngi, lula èi paringi patiri boe nèti dedha-liru mai, ho pabasa rai èu.

source_text: you shall live by the sword and serve your brother. but when you rebel, you will tear his yoke from your neck.
target_text: èu ne, mamuri dhoka nèti samala èu di. aa tasa mera mia èèna ka, èu ne j'aj'i ènu ari mu. dhodhoka ladhe bèli-camèd'a, èu bani lab'a ne, èèna na èu heka rai eele nèti d'ara adhe-aai na.

source_text: esau held a grudge against jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. and esau said in his heart, the days of mourning for my father are at hand; then i will kill my brother jacob.
target_text: lula j'ara sèmi ne'e ne ka, esau tèke d'ara dènge ari na yakob, lula parame nare mamèngi na. ka esau pangee na, nèbhu heka, ama ku madhe. de hud'i laa, pe d'ai ku lod'o. ladhe èle beke, ja'a pamadhe ne!

source_text: when the words of her older son esau were relayed to rebekah, she sent for her younger son jacob and told him, look, your brother esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you. so now, my son, obey my voice and flee at once to my brother laban in haran.
target_text: ropa ribka tadèngi esau dhu neo ad'u j'ara karehe, ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, èu nanene ku lii ne! a'a mu neo b'ala d'ara pèd'a na, de na neo pamadhe èu. de be'a risi, èu ne rai lai-lai asa to'o mu laban, ètu kota haran.

source_text: stay with him for a while, until your brother's fury subsides-
target_text: lamu asa nèi, pea ako nèbhu, toke èle nanasa a'a mu.

source_text: until your brother's rage against you wanes and he forgets what you have done to him. then i will send for you and bring you back from there. why should i lose both of you in one day?
target_text: ladhe na bhèlu eele ku tatao èu ne, pe ja'a pua dhèu dhiu paroa èu, sèna ka èu lèpa hari mai. lula ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka ana ja'a dua-dua mi ele parènga d'ara ca lod'o èèna ka.

source_text: then rebekah said to isaac, i am weary of my life because of these hittite women. if jacob takes a hittite wife from among them, what good is my life?
target_text: hèia ribka roma iisi dènge isak, peka na, ja'a ru'a le dènge dhèu èmu esau, dhèu het se! de ladhe yakob todhe nare hari kahèi ana bhèni nèti dhèu het se, hua iia ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: so isaac called for jacob and blessed him. do not take a wife from the canaanite women, he commanded.
target_text: hèia isak paroa nare yakob, ka hia ne mèngi-nale aa holo ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie! èu mage leo ka dènge ana bhèni kana'an hèi.

source_text: go at once to paddan-aram, to the house of your mother's father bethuel, and take a wife from among the daughters of laban, your mother's brother.
target_text: de lamu ka asa padan aram, asa baki mu betuel. lamu madhèdi dènge ana bhèni to'o mu laban ca dhèu.

source_text: may god almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples.
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele na, hia èu mamèngi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu bèba-kacanga, ho nèti rèngu ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae dhu kapai.

source_text: and may he give the blessing of abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land god gave to abraham.
target_text: hud'i laa, lii pajaji ama lamatua dènge abraham èèna, noto mi dedha èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu. sèna ka èu unu rai dhu ama lamatua jaji tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: so isaac sent jacob to paddan-aram, to laban son of bethuel the aramean, the brother of rebekah, who was the mother of jacob and esau.
target_text: padhai lii nare, ka isak hia yakob la'e asa padan aram, asa èmu to'o na laban, dènge baki na betuel.

source_text: now esau learned that isaac had blessed jacob and sent him to paddan-aram to take a wife there, commanding him, do not marry a canaanite woman,
target_text: esau dhu tadèngi le kahèi, dhu peka na isak hia yakob mamèngi, aa kai ne sèna ka baku leo dènge bhèni kana'an. aa na tadèngi hèi, dhu isak hia yakob leo dènge ana bhèni to'o na laban ètu padan aram.

source_text: and that jacob had obeyed his father and mother and gone to paddan-aram.
target_text: ka yakob madhutu lii paredha ina dènge ama na, ka pakèd'i la'e asa padan aram.

source_text: and seeing that his father isaac disapproved of the canaanite women,
target_text: aa esau dhu ne'a le kahèi, ama na d'èi boe dhèu èmu na, bhèni kana'an dua sèra.

source_text: esau went to ishmael and married mahalath, the sister of nebaioth and daughter of abraham's son ishmael, in addition to the wives he already had.
target_text: hèia na la'e asa ama aae na ismael, ka leo hari èmu dènge ana bhèni ismael ca dhèu, ngara na mahalat. mahalat ne, ana mone na ka nebayot.

source_text: meanwhile jacob left beersheba and set out for haran.
target_text: ka yakob tèke eele beer syeba, la'e asa haran.

source_text: on reaching a certain place, he spent the night there because the sun had set. and taking one of the stones from that place, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, yakob d'ai era èci, ka na j'unu ètu era èèna. na neo j'unu, nare hadhu cue, tao lalaka kètu na.

source_text: and jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and god's angels were going up and down the ladder.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, na nii. na ladhe nèdhi langa èci dhu patitu ètu rai, suu na d'ai dedha-liru. ka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ca'e-puru ètu dedha langa èèna.

source_text: and there at the top the lord was standing and saying, i am the lord, the god of your father abraham and the god of isaac. i will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.
target_text: ètu d'ara nii na, yakob ladhe nèdhi lamatua dhu titu ètu karasa nèngu, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne lamatua, ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak. èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south. all the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu ae-ae, sama sèmi ahu rai ne. rèngu se, èèna na, pea palème era-era ètu rai-haha ne. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale.

source_text: look, i am with you, and i will watch over you wherever you go, and i will bring you back to this land. for i will not leave you until i have done what i have promised you.
target_text: mage mu bhèlu! èu ne ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge èu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a lere kèti hari èu mai asa dedha-rai ne'e. ja'a bhera boe èu. aa èèna na, ja'a tao aa'i madhutu sèmi lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu.

source_text: when jacob woke up, he thought, surely the lord is in this place, and i was unaware of it.
target_text: ropa yakob kèd'i nèti bhèj'i, na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, lamatua dhu ètu era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: and he was afraid and said, how awesome is this place! this is none other than the house of god; this is the gate of heaven!
target_text: na madha'u, ka na pangee, na, boo! era ne'e ne pamadha'u ja'a, nga. tatu èmu ama lamatua ètu era ne'e ne! aa era ne'e ne, j'aj'i hèb'a babèdho sorga.

source_text: early the next morning, jacob took the stone that he had placed under his head, and he set it up as a pillar. he poured oil on top of it,
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, yakob kèd'i le èèna. ka nare hadhu dhu na tao lalaka deo na. hèia na patitu j'aj'i mi tadha. ka na bhori èi mènyi asa dedha hadhu èèna, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he called that place bethel, though previously the city had been named luz.
target_text: ka na pangare era ne betel, dhu sasoa na ‘èmu lamatua'. uru èèna, era ne ngara na lus.

source_text: then jacob made a vow, saying, if god will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if he will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob ded'e subha, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama lamatua dhu dènge ja'a, aa j'aga ja'a ètu d'ara kakako ja'a ne, aa panga'e dènge papake ja'a,

source_text: so that i may return safely to my father's house, then the lord will be my god.
target_text: toke ja'a lèpa dènge sod'a, èèna na lamatua j'aj'i mi ama lamatua ja'a.

source_text: and this stone i have set up as a pillar will be god's house, and of all that you give me i will surely give you a tenth.
target_text: hadhu dhu ja'a patitu ne, j'aj'i mi era sogo-tagu mi ama lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi ja'a, ja'a hia na ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: jacob resumed his journey and came to the land of the people of the east.
target_text: hèia yakob kako hari ka asa bèka dhimu.

source_text: he looked and saw a well in the field, and near it lay three flocks of sheep, because the sheep were watered from this well. and a large stone covered the mouth of the well.
target_text: ca lod'o, ladhe nèdhi èi ca madha, dètu dènge rae cue. padètu-dètu dènge madha èi èèna, abhu tèlu kaboko kahib'i-kalèbho, dhu mate rinu èi. te ngaa hadhu aae cue dhu ra pasaguru mi hèb'a èi na.

source_text: when all the flocks had been gathered there, the shepherds would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep. then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
target_text: dhu tema le, ladhe kahib'i tesa aa'i-aa'i ra, ana-ana madhenga kahib'i se, lasi bhoke hadhu na, heka ra dhui kèna, panginu kahib'i si. panginu rare na, ra katange hari hadhu na la'e.

source_text: my brothers, jacob asked the shepherds, where are you from? we are from haran, they answered.
target_text: ka yakob kako la'e asa madha dhèu madhenge kahib'i se, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu mia? hèia ra dhaa, ji'i se, nèti rae haran ne'e.

source_text: do you know laban the grandson of nahor? jacob asked. we know him, they replied.
target_text: ka yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu tadhe to'o ja'a, laban, do? nèngu na, ana nahor. ka ra dhaa, ji'i tadhe ne.

source_text: is he well? jacob inquired. yes, they answered, and here comes his daughter rachel with his sheep.
target_text: hèia yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, na be'a-be'a, sina ma? ka ra peka, oo, na be'a-be'a. ladhe, ana bhèni na ka nèi. ngara na, rahel. nuka eo nèti kahib'i ama na mai sa ne'e, ho hia rinu ètu ne'e. mate ne.

source_text: look, said jacob, it is still broad daylight; it is not yet time to gather the livestock. water the sheep and take them back to pasture.
target_text: hèia yakob peka hari, loo nètu era. de be'a risi, badha mia ètu se'e le, panginu ka si. sèna ka lere mèti hari asa d'ara pad'a, ho ra'a hari j'u'u.

source_text: but they replied, we cannot, until all the flocks have been gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. then we will water the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ra peka, we, j'ara na aad'o sèmi èèna! ji'i mate toke tesa aa'i ku, heka ji'i pakeso hadhu ne, heka panginu badha se kèna.

source_text: while he was still speaking with them, rachel arrived with her father's sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
target_text: yakob padhai lii era, rahel d'ai le era èèna dènge kahib'i ama na. nèngu ka dhu biasa ladhe-leru si.

source_text: as soon as jacob saw rachel, the daughter of his mother's brother laban, with laban's sheep, he went up and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle's sheep.
target_text: ropa yakob nèdhi rahel dènge kahib'i sèra, la'e dènge ka pa'eso eele hadhu dhu saguru hèb'a èi na. ka na panginu badha to'o na sèra.

source_text: then jacob kissed rachel and wept aloud.
target_text: èle ka, la'e uu rahel, dènge tangi.

source_text: he told rachel that he was rebekah's son, a relative of her father, and she ran and told her father.
target_text: ka na lolo dènge rahel, aku nèngu na, ari! ja'a ne, ana nèti ribka, ana hèni ama mu. hèia rahel rai sa èmu la'e, peka dènge ama na.

source_text: when laban heard the news about his sister's son jacob, he ran out to meet him. he embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, where jacob told him all that had happened.
target_text: ropa laban tadèngi lii lolo rahel, dhu peka na yakob ana nèti ana hèni na ribka, ka la'e dènge ka, soru nare yakob. ropa na d'ai, liku nare yakob, ka na uu, hèia gale nèti dènge ka, lasi asa èmu na. ka yakob lolo aa'i-aa'i dènge to'o na.

source_text: then laban declared, you are indeed my own flesh and blood. after jacob had stayed with him a month,
target_text: hèia laban lii, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! èdhi dua ti dhu pa'a'ari. ropa yakob pea dènge rèngu d'ai ca hèru,

source_text: laban said to him, just because you are my relative, should you work for nothing? tell me what your wages should be.
target_text: laban padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yakob! ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka èu sab'a hia ja'a dènge iia-iia d'ara, lula èdhi se dhu pa'a'ari. de èu neo sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra èu ja'a b'ae ca ngaa?

source_text: now laban had two daughters; the older was named leah, and the younger was named rachel.
target_text: laban ne, dhu dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua. dhu uru, ngara na lea. aa ari na, ngara na rahel.

source_text: leah had weak eyes, but rachel was shapely and beautiful.
target_text: lea ne, musi madha na ako ahu. te ngaa rahel, rèhu na bhèni iia, aa ngi'u na saraga bia.

source_text: since jacob loved rachel, he answered, i will serve you seven years for your younger daughter rachel.
target_text: yakob d'èi risi rahel. ka na peka dènge laban, ladhe to'o ku mo'o, ja'a sab'a hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, sad'i to'o ku hia ja'a madhèdi dènge rahel.

source_text: laban replied, better that i give her to you than to another. stay here with me.
target_text: hèia laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! be'a risi, ja'a paleo èu dènge rahel, lula èdhi dua ti dhu a'ari. mage dhoka na madhèdi dènge dhèu leo. de mu pea mi ne'e, sèna ka sab'a hia ja'a.

source_text: so jacob served seven years for rachel, yet it seemed but a few days because of his love for her.
target_text: ka yakob sab'a hia laban pidhu tèu, sèna ka na bisa madhèdi dènge rahel. lula na d'èi madhe-madhe rahel, nèti èèna ka, pidhu tèu èèna, na pangee nuka sèmi pèri-pèri lod'o di.

source_text: finally jacob said to laban, grant me my wife, for my time is complete, and i want to sleep with her.
target_text: ropa risi nèti pidhu tèu, ka na pasanèd'e laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ja'a sab'a le hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, de paleo ka ja'a dènge rahel.

source_text: so laban invited all the men of that place and prepared a feast.
target_text: hèia laban tao tatao, ka na nèru aa'i rae lesa ètu rae èèna.

source_text: but when evening came, laban took his daughter leah and gave her to jacob, and he slept with her. and laban gave his servant girl zilpah to his daughter leah as her maidservant. when morning came, there was leah! what have you done to me? jacob said to laban. wasn't it for rachel that i served you? why have you deceived me? laban replied, it is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older. finish this week's celebration, and we will give you the younger one in return for another seven years of work.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda èèna, laban hia boe rahel, te ngaa na pua lea maso asa d'ara paleo yakob. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne. asa bèli èèna, yakob heka ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu leo dènge lea di. hèia yakob la'e patao dènge laban, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, to'o pasèru ja'a sèmi ne'e? ja'a sab'a sèmi ènu pidhu tèu kateme hia mi èu, sèna ka bisa abhu rahel! nga tao ka to'o pasilu dènge lea? ka laban dhaa, baku nasa ku! madhutu ad'a ji'i ètu rai ne'e, ari bisa boe leo uuru èmu nèti a'a. de be'a risi sèmi ne'e! èu mate hari ku pidhu lod'o, d'ai èle tatao ne, heka èu abhu rahel kèna. sad'i èu sab'a hari hia ja'a pidhu tèu. hèia laban pangèd'u dènge ènu bhèni èci, hia mi lea. ngara na silpa.

source_text: and jacob did just that. he finished the week's celebration, and laban gave him his daughter rachel as his wife.
target_text: lii padhai laban deo na, yakob d'èi kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èle tatao ne pidhu lod'o, ka laban pamadhèdi hari yakob dènge rahel.

source_text: laban also gave his servant girl bilhah to his daughter rachel as her maidservant.
target_text: ka laban hia ènu na dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na bilha, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ènu rahel.

source_text: jacob slept with rachel as well, and indeed, he loved rachel more than leah. so he worked for laban another seven years.
target_text: hèia yakob pa'èci ka dènge rahel. na d'èi risi rahel nèti lea. ka yakob sab'a hari hia to'o na pidhu tèu.

source_text: when the lord saw that leah was unloved, he opened her womb; but rachel was barren.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua ne'a le, yakob sue risi rahel nèti lea. nèti èèna ka, na hia lea nara iisi ana. te ngaa rahel abhu boe ana.

source_text: and leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him reuben, for she said, the lord has seen my affliction. surely my husband will love me now.
target_text: hèia lea dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare ne, ruben dhu sasoa na ‘mèdhi si, abhu ana', lula na peka na, lamatua ladhe nèdhi le sasusa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a tao madha-dhilu mi ja'a.

source_text: again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, because the lord has heard that i am unloved, he has given me this son as well. so she named him simeon.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia, hèia nara iisi hari ana mone èci. na pangare ne, simeon dhu sasoa na, ele boe ‘dhèu tadèngi le', lula na peka na, lamatua dhu ne'a na, dhèu èmu ja'a sue boe ja'a. tu d'ai èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana dhèu èci hari.

source_text: once again leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, now at last my husband will become attached to me, because i have borne him three sons. so he was named levi.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea kad'o hari ana èci, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare na lewi, lula na peka na, dènge ana ne'e ne, èle dènge lii langu ja'a. d'ara dhèu èmu ja'a, pa'èki dènge ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone, dhèu tèlu kèna.

source_text: and once more she conceived and gave birth to a son and said, this time i will praise the lord. so she named him judah. then leah stopped having children.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia ca tèka, hèia nara iisi ana mone èci. na pangare na, yahuda dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘koa-kio', lula na peka na, dènge j'ara ne'e ne, ja'a neo koa-kio lamatua! èle ka, lea dènge heka ana.

source_text: when rachel saw that she was not bearing any children for jacob, she envied her sister. give me children, or i will die! she said to jacob.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu abhu mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, nèngu tèke d'ara dènge a'a na. hèia na peka dènge dhèu èmu na, a'a! hia ku ja'a ana laa, ma. ladhe aad'o, be'a risi ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: jacob became angry with rachel and said, am i in the place of god, who has withheld children from you?
target_text: te ngaa yakob jèke ne, aku nèngu na, èu ngee na, ja'a ne, lamatua, ho bisa hia èu ana! ?

source_text: then she said, here is my maidservant bilhah. sleep with her, that she may bear children for me, so that through her i too can build a family.
target_text: ka rahel b'ala na, sèmi ne'e: hua iia èu more bilha, ènu ja'a na. j'unu dènge ne, sèna ka na matana hia ja'a ana.

source_text: so rachel gave jacob her servant bilhah as a wife, and he slept with her,
target_text: hèia na pangèd'u bilha mi dhèu èmu na. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne.

source_text: and bilhah conceived and bore him a son.
target_text: ka bilha dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: then rachel said, god has vindicated me; he has heard my plea and given me a son. so she named him dan.
target_text: hèia rahel padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua nanene le lii manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu. ama lamatua pama'ète le, lii langu ja'a dènge mola-mola. ka na pangare ana ne, dan dhu sasoa na ‘pama'ète lii'.

source_text: and rachel's servant bilhah conceived again and bore jacob a second son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, bilha dènge hari babia, ka nara iisi ana mone èci.

source_text: then rachel said, in my great struggles, i have wrestled with my sister and won. so she named him naphtali.
target_text: ka rahel peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a limuri ne pa'uji dènge a'a ku, ka ja'a segi. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana na, naftali dhu sasoa na ‘pa'uji', do ‘pa'ère'.

source_text: when leah saw that she had stopped having children, she gave her servant zilpah to jacob as a wife.
target_text: ropa lea ne'a na nèngu ne dènge heka ana, ka na paleo ènu na silpa dènge yakob.

source_text: and leah's servant zilpah bore jacob a son.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: then leah said, how fortunate! so she named him gad.
target_text: hèia lea peka na, kalua ja'a, mèngi le. ka na pangare na, gad dhu sasoa na ‘kalua mèngi'.

source_text: when leah's servant zilpah bore jacob a second son,
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi hari ana mone èci.

source_text: leah said, how happy i am! for the women call me happy. so she named him asher.
target_text: hèia lea padhai lii, peka na, waa! limuri ne, ja'a heka karej'e kèna! mi laladhe ee, te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na ja'a ne oto bia. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, aser dhu sasoa na ‘karej'e'.

source_text: now during the wheat harvest, reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field. when he brought them to his mother, rachel begged leah, please give me some of your son's mandrakes.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge hèru puu-g'ètu are, ruben la'e asa d'ara j'ami. na rage ana aaj'u ca kapua dhu j'aj'i sèmi èi na'i ho hia dhèu bhèni abhu kolo. ka ruben nèti hia ina na lea. ropa rahel nèdhi, ka na peka dènge lea, aku nèngu na, a'a! bagi ku ja'a ciki, èi na'i dhu ruben nèti èèna.

source_text: but leah replied, is it not enough that you have taken away my husband? now you want to take my son's mandrakes as well? very well, said rachel, he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son's mandrakes.
target_text: te ngaa lea b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne seli-kolane! parame more le dhèu èmu ja'a. te ngaa roca mèka na. mu neo hari unu aj'u èi na'i èèna nèti ana ja'a? me'a heka makae d'ara! te ngaa rahel dhaa, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ladhe ja'a abhu èi na'i na, mèda ne'e èu pa'èci dènge yakob. ka lea d'èi kahèi.

source_text: when jacob came in from the field that evening, leah went out to meet him and said, you must come with me, for i have hired you with my son's mandrakes. so he slept with her that night.
target_text: ka pe d'ai loo nihia sa, yakob lèpa nèti d'ara oka. lea la'e soru nare ne, ka na peka, a'a! mèda ne, èu j'unu dènge ja'a! lula ja'a dhu hèli kore le èu, dènge kab'ua èi na'i ana ja'a! ka mèda na, yakob j'unu dènge lea.

source_text: and god listened to leah, and she conceived and bore a fifth son to jacob.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi-mangaj'i lea. nèti èèna ka, na dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka lèmi.

source_text: then leah said, god has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband. so she named him issachar.
target_text: hèia lea pangare ana na, isaskar, dhu sasoa na, ‘b'ae j'aj'èra', lula na peka na, ama lamatua b'ae-baj'a le j'aj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a hia le silpa madhèdi dènge dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: again leah conceived and bore a sixth son to jacob.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea dènge babia hari, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka èna.

source_text: god has given me a good gift, she said. this time my husband will honor me, because i have borne him six sons. and she named him zebulun.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua parasee ja'a mèdha dhu be'a. ka limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a hud'i pakab'ua ku ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone dhèu èna. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, sebulon dhu sasoa na ‘pakab'ua'.

source_text: after that, leah gave birth to a daughter and named her dinah.
target_text: ka lea nara iisi hari, te ngaa ana bhèni, ka na pangare na, dina.

source_text: then god remembered rachel. he listened to her and opened her womb,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu bhèlu boe rahel, ka sèmi lii manèngi-mangaj'i na. nèti èèna ka, na bhoke era ana na.

source_text: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. god has taken away my shame, she said.
target_text: hèia rahel dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, ama lamatua saku eele le d'ara makae ja'a.

source_text: she named him joseph, and said, may the lord add to me another son.
target_text: hèia na pangare ana na yusuf dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘hud'i laa na hia tabha hari', lula aku nèngu na, ja'a manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu hari.

source_text: now after rachel had given birth to joseph, jacob said to laban, send me on my way so i can return to my homeland.
target_text: lod'o rahel nara iisi yusuf, yakob peka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ladhe mo'o, ja'a neo lèpa asa rai ètu-èsu ja'a.

source_text: give me my wives and children for whom i have served you, that i may go on my way. you know how hard i have worked for you.
target_text: ja'a neo laku dènge ana-dhèu èmu ja'a. to'o, èu dhu me'a le, ja'a ne sab'a tèu-tèu nèti mad'ae d'ai loo nihia. de ja'a b'ae pama'ète le rèngu se. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se, j'aj'i le unu ja'a ka teme aae.

source_text: but laban replied, if i have found favor in your eyes, please stay. i have learned by divination that the lord has blessed me because of you.
target_text: hèia, aku to'o na, ana, ee! èu nanene ku lii ja'a laa! madhutu lii malare dhu ja'a abhu, lamatua hia ja'a mamèngi lula èu.

source_text: and he added, name your wages, and i will pay them.
target_text: de èu neo manèngi ca ngaa, peka, sèna ka ja'a b'ae! sad'i èu baku tèke eele ja'a, te ngaa sab'a taruu hia ja'a.

source_text: then jacob answered, you know how i have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care.
target_text: ka yakob peka, to'o! èu mèdhi unu mu le, sasab'a-la'a ja'a. nèti èèna ka, badha-manu to'o se, bèba-kacanga.

source_text: indeed, you had very little before my arrival, but now your wealth has increased many times over. the lord has blessed you wherever i set foot. but now, when may i also provide for my own household?
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhae mai mèka, mèdha-panyau to'o ku ae èèna mèka. te ngaa limuri ne, to'o kaja le. lamatua pala-bagi le to'o ku mamèngi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ka. te d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka ja'a sab'a hia ana-dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: what can i give you? laban asked. you do not need to give me anything, jacob replied. if you do this one thing for me, i will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks.
target_text: hèia laban karèi ne, aku nèngu na, de sèmi èèna na, ja'a b'ae èu tasamia? ka yakob dhaa, peka na, to'o ku, hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa badha-manu to'o ku, ja'a ladhe-leru taruu, sad'i mu tao ku j'ara èci.

source_text: let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb, and every spotted or speckled goat. these will be my wages.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a laku asa badha-manu to'o sèi, ho hag'e si. mia dhu dènge boe katèd'a aa dènge boe karata, sèra sa unu to'o ku taruu. te ngaa mia dhu dènge katèd'a aa dhu karata, hia mi ja'a. dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi, ja'a kora aa'i si. se'e se, hud'i laa j'aj'i mi bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra ja'a.

source_text: so my honesty will testify for me when you come to check on my wages in the future. if i have any goats that are not speckled or spotted, or any lambs that are not dark-colored, they will be considered stolen.
target_text: d'ai lod'o limuri, pe to'o me'a ja'a ne sab'a dènge mola, do aad'o. sad'i lake more, mai ho mu parisa badha-manu ja'a. ladhe mu abhu kahib'i-ka'ia dhu dènge boe katèd'a, aa dhu karata boe, do, kahib'i-kalèbho dhu pudhi, èèna na, dhu me'a le èèna, ja'a mana'u badha-manu to'o.

source_text: agreed, said laban. let it be as you have said.
target_text: ka laban d'èi kahèi, aku nèngu na, oo! j'ara na sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: that very day laban removed all the streaked or spotted male goats and every speckled or spotted female goat-every one that had any white on it-and every dark-colored lamb, and he placed them under the care of his sons.
target_text: te ngaa ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, laban hag'e dènge badha dhu katèd'a, dhu karata, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi. ka na pangèd'u mi ana na si, ho ladhe-leru.

source_text: then he put a three-day journey between himself and jacob, while jacob was shepherding the rest of laban's flocks.
target_text: hèia eo rèti ka badha se asa era èci dhu kaj'èu na tèlu lod'o kako haga nèti era yakob si. ka yakob madhenge ka badha dhu ata se.

source_text: jacob, however, took fresh branches of poplar, almond, and plane trees, and peeled the bark, exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
target_text: èla èèna ka, yakob poro nare dadana aaj'u nèti aj'u tèlu rupa. ka na caci pakarata ka'uri aj'u sèra, tao strep-strep.

source_text: then he set the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of the flocks coming in to drink. so when the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
target_text: hèia aj'u dhu strep-strep se, na tèke asa d'ara karab'a kahib'i. badha se dhu tema le pa'ango aa paleo ètu era èèna.

source_text: they mated in front of the branches. and they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
target_text: de ladhe badha se paleo ètu madha aj'u strep-strep se, ra matana ana dhu rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata.

source_text: jacob set apart the young, but made the rest face the streaked dark-colored sheep in laban's flocks. then he set his own stock apart and did not put them with laban's animals.
target_text: ka ladhe badha laban se neo paleo, yakob patangare si asa kahib'i dhu katèd'a dènge karata sèra. hèia ana dhu ra matana sa rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, badha na asa ae. ka na pacèri eele si nèti badha laban sèra.

source_text: whenever the stronger females of the flock were in heat, jacob would place the branches in the troughs, in full view of the animals, so that they would breed in front of the branches.
target_text: ropa badha dhu èra neo paleo, yakob nare kadhèli aj'u dhu strep-strep sèra, tao mi d'ara karab'a ètu madha si.

source_text: but if the animals were weak, he did not set out the branches. so the weaker animals went to laban and the stronger ones to jacob.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kahib'i dhu roe dènge malaka-god'a neo paleo, yakob soro tèke si. ka badha dhu roe, sèra unu to'o na laban. aa mia dhu èra, sèra unu nèngu.

source_text: thus jacob became exceedingly prosperous. he owned large flocks, maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne, yakob j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. ka kahib'i-ka'ia na, kahib'i-kalèbho na, onta na, keled'ei na, dènge ènu na bhèni-mone, udhu sobhu-sobhu.
