source_text: now jacob heard that laban's sons were saying, jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our father's expense.
target_text: ca tèka, yakob tadèngi lii padhai ana-ana laban se, aku rèngu na, kakaja-sasu'i yakob sèra, lula na kao nare aa'i mèdha-panyau ama èdhi.

source_text: and jacob saw from the countenance of laban that his attitude toward him had changed.
target_text: yakob nèdhi kahèi rèhu to'o laban mare heka, aa be'a heka dènge ne, sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: then the lord said to jacob, go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and i will be with you.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge yakob, d'ai le lod'o, ho èu lèpa asa ina dènge ama mu. ja'a palere-lere dènge èu.

source_text: so jacob sent word and called rachel and leah to the field where his flocks were,
target_text: ka yakob hia dhèu lasi paroa rahel dènge lea, sèna ka mai paraga dènge ne ètu era ani badha, ètu d'ara mamoo.

source_text: and he told them, i can see from your father's countenance that his attitude toward me has changed; but the god of my father has been with me.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, ja'a ladhe-ladhe na, ama miu na rèhu na mare heka dènge ja'a. aa babe'a na mi ja'a, sèmi heka uru èèna. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ama ku sogo-tagu èèna, palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: you know that i have served your father with all my strength.
target_text: miu dua mi se me'a le, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a j'aj'i kuli ètu ama miu!

source_text: and although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, god has not allowed him to harm me.
target_text: te ngaa sèmi èèna, d'ara na la'e kahèi, ka na kapod'e-kabèli taruu ja'a. ka na ub'a rui-j'aj'èra ja'a, canguru hari kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua j'aga pa'èra ja'a.

source_text: if he said, ‘the speckled will be your wages, ' then the whole flock bore speckled offspring. if he said, ‘the streaked will be your wages, ' then the whole flock bore streaked offspring.
target_text: lod'o ama miu peka na, ‘badha dhu rèu ra katèd'a sèra j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ho ladhe lod'o badha se matana, ana dhu katèd'a hua-hua. lod'o leo hari, na peka, ‘badha dhu karata sèra, j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ka badha se matana ana karata aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: thus god has taken away your father's livestock and given them to me.
target_text: ama lamatua ad'u sèmi èèna na, sèna ka nare aa'i badha-manu ama miu èèna, ho hia mi ja'a.

source_text: when the flocks were breeding, i saw in a dream that the streaked, spotted, and speckled males were mating with the females.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa badha se paleo, ja'a kèdhi ètu d'ara nii, dhu peka na, badha mone aa'i-aa'i dhu paleo, abhu dhu katèd'a aa dhu karata hèi.

source_text: in that dream the angel of god said to me, ‘jacob! ' and i replied, ‘here i am. '
target_text: ka ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga paroa ja'a, peka na, ‘yakob! ' hèia ja'a dhaa, ‘tasamia, lamatua? '

source_text: ‘look up, ' he said, ‘and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked, spotted, or speckled; for i have seen all that laban has done to you.
target_text: ka na lii, ‘ladhe ku laa! badha mone dhu paleo sèra, dhodhoka dhu karata dènge katèd'a di. ja'a ka ad'u sèra sa, lula ja'a dhu kèdhi le, ngaa dhu laban tao mi dedha èu.

source_text: i am the god of bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to me. now get up and leave this land at once, and return to your native land. '
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua, dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu betel èèna. ètu era nèi, èu patitu hadhu, ka mu bhori èi mènyi ètu dedha na, ka èu sogo-tagu ja'a. ka èu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ja'a ètu nèi. de kèd'i ka, tèke eele ka rai ne'e ne, lamu ka asa kabarai ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and rachel and leah replied, do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father's house?
target_text: hèia rahel dènge lea b'ala lii na, aku rèngu na, la'a ma! ji'i dènge heka pusaka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama ji'i laban.

source_text: are we not regarded by him as outsiders? not only has he sold us, but he has certainly squandered what was paid for us.
target_text: nèbhu nare sange ne'e, mone heka ne tao ji'i sèmi dhèu leo kara sa. na pahie eele le ji'i se. ka na'e aa'i le kab'ua-kadheli ji'i se.

source_text: surely all the wealth that god has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. so do whatever god has told you.
target_text: de mèdha-panyau dhu ama lamatua nare sèra nèti ama ji'i laban, aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu èdhi dènge ana-ana èdhi se. de ladhe aku lamatua tasa mera mia, te'a dhoka madhutu di!

source_text: then jacob got up and put his children and his wives on camels, and he drove all his livestock before him, along with all the possessions he had acquired in paddan-aram, to go to his father isaac in the land in canaan.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob lalau mèdha-panyau na. hèia na paca'e ana-dhèu èmu na asa dedha onta lasi, aa na eo nèti badha-manu na aa'i-aa'i, dènge mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu ètu padan aram, ho lasi asa rai kana'an.

source_text: now while laban was out shearing his sheep, rachel stole her father's household idols.
target_text: lod'o èèna, laban dhu la'e g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho na. ka rahel mana'u nare patung mèdha sogo-tagu ama na.

source_text: moreover, jacob deceived laban the aramean by not telling him that he was running away.
target_text: aa yakob si lasi palangu boe lii dènge to'o na.

source_text: so he fled with all his possessions, crossed the euphrates, and headed for the hill country of gilead.
target_text: na bau nèti aa'i mèdha-panyau na, ka ra kako pamèri-mèri, lasi re loko efrat, asa ledhe gilead.

source_text: on the third day laban was informed that jacob had fled.
target_text: rarai yakob si èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o ku, heka laban ne'a kèna.

source_text: so he took his relatives with him, pursued jacob for seven days, and overtook him in the hill country of gilead.
target_text: hèia laban oru nare ka dhèu-dhèu na, lasi bate yakob si. d'ai pidhu lod'o ku, heka ra paraga dènge si ètu ledhe gilead.

source_text: but that night god came to laban the aramean in a dream and warned him, be careful not to say anything to jacob, either good or bad.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda èèna, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi laban ètu d'ara nii. na peka na, laban! ladhe èu padhai lii dènge yakob, j'aga paie hèb'a èu na.

source_text: now jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of gilead when laban overtook him, and laban and his relatives camped there as well.
target_text: mèda èèna, yakob si dhu patitu paleo ètu ledhe gilead. aa laban si patitu unu ra kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna kahèi.

source_text: then laban said to jacob, what have you done? you have deceived me and carried off my daughters like captives of war!
target_text: èle ka, laban mai paraga dènge yakob. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu rai mèti ana bhèni ja'a se, dènge boe lii ugu-ge'e sa hèi? mu tao si sèmi dhèu dhu èu segi ètu d'ara papara-pakèj'i.

source_text: why did you run away secretly and deceive me, without even telling me? i would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.
target_text: èu ne ad'a aad'o, palangu boe sa hèi dènge ja'a! ladhe èu peka dènge ja'a be'a-be'a, ele boe ja'a tao sisi-kau, ho ta'a-tinu boko-boko, ho lere miu dènge lii sod'a, heka ji'i patabuli miu kèna.

source_text: but you did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. now you have done a foolish thing.
target_text: sasala èu èci hari ka, èu hia boe ja'a uu ana-èpu ja'a hèi. tatao èu ne goa titu kèna!

source_text: i have power to do you great harm, but last night the god of your father said to me, ‘be careful not to say anything to jacob, either good or bad. '
target_text: carui boe, ladhe ja'a ne neo paj'èra èu! te ngaa malo-malo ka mèda-mèda na, ama lamatua dhu ama mu sogo-tagu èèna, kai ja'a peka na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge èu, ja'a hud'i j'aga paie-iie ku hèb'a ja'a.

source_text: now you have gone off because you long for your father's house. but why have you stolen my gods?
target_text: mema, ja'a dhu ke'a le, èu pakèd'i lula èu dhu neo le lèpa. te ngaa tasamia ka, èu mana'u mèti patung mèdha sogo-tagu ja'a?

source_text: i was afraid, jacob answered, for i thought you would take your daughters from me by force.
target_text: hèia yakob b'ala, aku nèngu na, to'o baku nasa ku dènge ja'a! ja'a pakèd'i mau-mau èèna, lula ja'a mage dhoka mo'o boe ja'a kèti ana-ana se!

source_text: if you find your gods with anyone here, he shall not live! in the presence of our relatives, see for yourself if anything is yours, and take it back. for jacob did not know that rachel had stolen the idols.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhu ne'a nare boe, na dhèu èmu na rahel ka dhu mana'u nèti. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, to'o! mèdha sogo-tagu èèna, mu tenge ne! ladhe mèdhi ètu cee, huku pamadhe ne. parisa aa'i mèu-mèu. ladhe abhu kahèi pusaka to'o dhu leo, more aa'i si. hud'i laa, dhèu se'e se j'aj'i sakasii.

source_text: so laban went into jacob's tent, then leah's tent, and then the tents of the two maidservants, but he found nothing. then he left leah's tent and entered rachel's tent.
target_text: hèia laban la'e parisa ka asa d'ara paleo se èci-èci. na la'e uru asa d'ara paleo yakob. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo lea. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo ènu se dua ra. te ngaa abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. paleo rahel limuri tèka.

source_text: now rachel had taken laban's household idols, put them in the saddlebag of her camel, and was sitting on them. and laban searched everything in the tent but found nothing.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu huni le mèdha sogo-tagu sèra ètu d'ara lalaka onta. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha. d'ai d'ara paleo ne, laban tenge paie-iie, te ngaa na rage boe.

source_text: rachel said to her father, sir, do not be angry that i cannot stand up before you; for i am having my period. so laban searched, but could not find the household idols.
target_text: hèia rahel peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama mage mu nasa kahèi. te ja'a bisa boe titu, lula ja'a abhu hèru. masi ka sèmi èèna, laban tenge taruu, te ngaa abhu boe mèdha sogo-tagu sèra.

source_text: then jacob became incensed and challenged laban. what is my crime? he said. for what sin of mine have you so hotly pursued me?
target_text: ka yakob nasa, hèia na pajèka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne tao bhelu ngaa mi to'o? ka to'o mai bate ja'a, sèmi dhu ja'a ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa!

source_text: you have searched all my goods! have you found anything that belongs to you? put it here before my brothers and yours, that they may judge between the two of us.
target_text: mèdha-panyau ja'a, to'o ceb'e eele si. de mu abhu ngaa? more ka mai tèke mi madha ne, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti tèdhi. aa hud'i laa, dhèu se'e ka dhu pama'ète mèdha èèna unu cee.

source_text: i have been with you for twenty years now. your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have i eaten the rams of your flock.
target_text: dua nguru tèu kèna, ja'a sab'a kuli mi to'o. lod'o ja'a madhenga badha-manu to'o, ci'u sa legu boe. aa ku'a kèdhi boe ci'u sa hèi!

source_text: i did not bring you anything torn by wild beasts; i bore the loss myself. and you demanded payment from me for what was stolen by day or night.
target_text: ladhe badha hui-hahi hui, kadhi pamadhe badha to'o ci'u, ja'a peka boe, te ngaa ja'a gati. aa ladhe dhèu mana'u, to'o pua ja'a gati, masi ka ja'a sala boe.

source_text: as it was, the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
target_text: ladhe re mèu, madha lod'o ai pamango ja'a. aa ladhe mèda, ja'a maringi rig'i-rig'i. ja'a pasaruru boe ciki sa, toke mèu rai, lula madhenge badha-manu to'o.

source_text: thus for twenty years i have served in your household-fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks-and you have changed my wages ten times!
target_text: mema tare'a, dua nguru tèu èèna! ja'a sab'a canguru èpa tèu, sèna ka abhu ana bhèni to'o, dhèu dua se. ka ja'a sab'a hari èna tèu, sèna ka ja'a unu badha-manu se'e. j'aj'i kuli nèbhu nare sange èèna, te ngaa to'o pakura rui-j'aj'èra ja'a d'ai canguru hari.

source_text: if the god of my father, the god of abraham and the fear of isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. but god has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night he rendered judgment.
target_text: malo-malo ka, dènge ama lamatua, dhu baki ku abraham, dènge ama ku isak, dhu sogo-tagu ne. ladhe na leru boe ja'a ne, ele boe to'o hia ja'a lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu pa'abhe boe musi madha na mi j'aj'èra ja'a, aa na tao madha-dhilu mi sasab'a-la'a ja'a aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, mèda deo na, na mai kai to'o, sèna ka baku lii sakaa dènge ja'a.

source_text: but laban answered jacob, these daughters are my daughters, these sons are my sons, and these flocks are my flocks! everything you see is mine! yet what can i do today about these daughters of mine or the children they have borne?
target_text: ropa nanene nare lii padhai yakob, ka laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! bhèni dua se, ana ja'a. ana dhu ra matana se, aa'i-aa'i ra èpu ja'a. badha-manu aa'i-aa'i se, unu ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi ètu se'e se, unu ja'a. te ngaa ja'a neo tao si, tasamia? ja'a bisa boe magee si.

source_text: come now, let us make a covenant, you and i, and let it serve as a witness between you and me.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji. sèna ka lii pajaji èèna ka dhu èki èdhi dua ti.

source_text: so jacob picked out a stone and set it up as a pillar,
target_text: hèia yakob nare ka hadhu aae cue, na patitu ètu èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha.

source_text: and he said to his relatives, gather some stones. so they took stones and made a mound, and there by the mound they ate.
target_text: hèia yakob pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi udhu hadhu. ka ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu era èèna, padètu dènge hadhu sèra.

source_text: laban called it jegar-sahadutha, and jacob called it galeed.
target_text: hèia laban pangare hadhu udhu sèra, yegar sahaduta. te ngaa yakob pangare na, galeed.

source_text: then laban declared, this mound is a witness between you and me this day. therefore the place was called galeed.
target_text: ka laban padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hadhu udhu se, j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ngara na, galeed.

source_text: it was also called mizpah, because laban said, may the lord keep watch between you and me when we are absent from each other.
target_text: laban pangare kahèi era èèna, mispa dhu sasoa na ‘era j'aga dhu dedha', lula na peka na, pe èèna na, lamatua ka dhu j'aga èdhi dua ti, ho masi ka dua ti pakaj'èu, baku kako eele lii pajaji ne.

source_text: if you mistreat my daughters or take other wives, although no one is with us, remember that god is a witness between you and me.
target_text: ladhe èu tao karehe ana ja'a se, do leo-èmu dènge bhèni leo hari, tatu ja'a ke'a boe. te ngaa mu sanèd'e! ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti.

source_text: laban also said to jacob, here is the mound, and here is the pillar i have set up between you and me. this mound is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that i will not go past this mound to harm you, and you will not go past this mound and pillar to harm me.
target_text: èu ladhe ku hadhu dhu patitu ne, dènge hadhu dhu udhu se. sanèd'e, hadhu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi too dènge lane. èu bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi ja'a. aa ja'a kahèi bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi èu.

source_text: may the god of abraham and the god of nahor, the god of their father, judge between us. so jacob swore by the fear of his father isaac.
target_text: dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji ne, dènge kolongara ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èdhi. nuka ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham dènge baki ja'a nahor. nèngu èèna ka, dhu j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti. ropa nanene nare, hèia yakob j'oka soo-subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, dhu ama na isak sogo-tagu.

source_text: then jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain and invited his relatives to eat a meal. and after they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob roro badha, ho j'aj'i mi korban hia mi lamatua ètu ledhe èèna. hèia na paroa dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai ra'a-rinu pa'èci, ka ra beke d'ai lod'o rea.

source_text: jacob also went on his way, and the angels of god met him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si kako taruu. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga sèra mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: when jacob saw them, he said, this is the camp of god. so he named that place mahanaim.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi si, na lii, aku nèngu na, era ne'e ne, sèmi era ae sordad'u lamatua! nèti èèna ka, era èèna na pangare na, mahanaim dhu sasoa na ‘dua era ae iisi'.

source_text: jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother esau in the land of seir, the country of edom.
target_text: ka yakob pua dhèu na pèri-pèri lasi uuru asa rai edom nuka seir, sèna ka lasi peka dènge a'a na esau, ho ne'a mamai na.

source_text: he instructed them, you are to say to my master esau, ‘your servant jacob says: i have been staying with laban and have remained there until now.
target_text: hèia yakob peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lami peka dènge a'a ku esau, sèmi ne'e: ‘lamatua esau! ènu mu yakob, hia ji'i ngèti lii karej'e-karae mi a'a na. peka na, karèi nèti ja'a pakèd'i, toke sange ne'e ne, ja'a pea ètu d'ara èmu to'o laban.

source_text: i have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. i have sent this message to inform my master, so that i may find favor in your sight. '
target_text: limuri ne, ènu lamatua na dènge le unu sapi, keled'ei, rupa-rupa kahib'i, dènge ènu bhèni-mone. ja'a hia uru dhèu se'e dhiu, ho peka dènge a'a ku, mamai ja'a ne. ja'a sanao sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ' èle ka dhèu se lasi.

source_text: when the messengers returned to jacob, they said, we went to your brother esau, and now he is coming to meet you-he and four hundred men with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa hari mai, ra lolo dènge yakob, aku rèngu na, ji'i paraga le dènge a'a mu esau. nuka na mai re limuri nèi, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu dhèu mone, neo mai paraga dènge èu.

source_text: in great fear and distress, jacob divided his people into two camps, as well as the flocks and herds and camels.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, sangasa yakob rèbha-rèbha, aa na madha'u ae. ka na hag'e eele dhèu na dènge badha-manu j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: he thought, if esau comes and attacks one camp, then the other camp can escape.
target_text: na pangee, ladhe esau mai, ho na age kaboko dhu uru, na kaboko dhu limuri bisa rai, tenge sod'a.

source_text: then jacob declared, o god of my father abraham, god of my father isaac, the lord who told me, ‘go back to your country and to your kindred, and i will make you prosper, '
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi-mangaj'i, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! èu j'aj'i lamatua nèti baki ja'a abraham, aa nèti ama ku isak. nanene ku lii manèngi ja'a la! uru èèna, lamatua ka dhu hia ja'a lèpa asa a'ari ja'a, ètu kabarai ne'e. lamatua ka dhu moa tèke, peka na pe lamatua uri pamola j'ara.

source_text: i am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. indeed, with only my staff i came across the jordan, but now i have become two camps.
target_text: ja'a ne madhutu mola-mola na, bisa boe abhu sasue dènge mamako lamatua. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pège loko yarden, ja'a kèti dhoka tatea di. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a lèpa kèti dènge dhèu dua nau, aa dènge badha-manu ae.

source_text: please deliver me from the hand of my brother esau, for i am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.
target_text: ja'a mangingi, mage dhoka a'a ja'a esau, mai pare pamadhe ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamuri mi ja'a, dènge ana-dhèu èmu-kamali aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: but you have said, ‘i will surely make you prosper, and i will make your offspring like the sand of the sea, too numerous to count. '
target_text: lamatua dhu jaji tèke, èèna na pala-bagi mi dedha ja'a mamèngi ae-ae, aa hia ana-èpu ja'a bèba-kacanga, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi, dhu dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: jacob spent the night there, and from what he had brought with him, he selected a gift for his brother esau:
target_text: èle ka, yakob si j'unu ètu era èèna. asa bèli èèna, na hag'e badha pèri-pèri ngi'u ho rèti hia a'a na.

source_text: 200 female goats, 20 male goats, 200 ewes, 20 rams,
target_text: na pili nare kahib'i rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i mone dua nguru ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho mone dua nguru ngi'u,

source_text: 30 milk camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 male donkeys.
target_text: onta rena tèlu nguru ngi'u dènge ana susu, sapi rena èpa nguru ngi'u, canguru ngi'u sapi mone, keled'ei rena dua nguru ngi'u, dènge canguru ngi'u keled'ei mone.

source_text: he entrusted them to his servants in separate herds and told them, go on ahead of me, and keep some distance between the herds.
target_text: ka na hag'e ka badha se, èci-èci ka dènge anga na. hèia na papala ka, èci-èci dènge ana madhenge na. ka na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu kako uuru. pe ja'a dhiu. te ngaa mi palaladha ho kaboko èci pakaj'èu nèti kaboko dhu leo sèra.

source_text: he instructed the one in the lead, when my brother esau meets you and asks, ‘to whom do you belong, where are you going, and whose animals are these before you? '
target_text: ka na peka dènge kaboko dhu uuru tèka, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'a ku esau paraga dènge èu, aa na karèi, peka na, ‘èu lamu mia? èu ne, ènu nèti cee? badha-manu se, unu cee? '

source_text: then you are to say, ‘they belong to your servant jacob. they are a gift, sent to my lord esau. and behold, jacob is behind us. '
target_text: na mi dhaa, peka na, ‘badha-manu se, unu ènu mu, yakob. na pa'adhu hia a'a na, esau. te ngaa nèngu nuka nèti limuri nèi. '

source_text: he also instructed the second, the third, and all those following behind the herds: when you meet esau, you are to say the same thing to him. you are also to say, ‘look, your servant jacob is right behind us. ' for he thought, i will appease esau with the gift that is going before me. after that i can face him, and perhaps he will accept me.
target_text: lii sèmi èèna, na peka kahèi dènge dhèu madhenga badha cahag'e sèra hèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe mi paraga dènge a'a ku esau, mi hia ne badha-manu se. aa mi peka dènge ne, ja'a re limuri. lula madhutu a'abhu yakob, na hia badha se aa'i-aa'i mi esau, èèna na esau sèmi nèngu dènge be'a.

source_text: so jacob's gifts went on before him, while he spent the night in the camp.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na hia uuru rèti badha se. te ngaa mèda èèna, nèngu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: during the night jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the ford of the jabbok.
target_text: mèda na, yakob kèd'i, ka na pua dhèu èmu na dhèu dua, dènge dhèu èmu piara dhèu dua, dènge ana na dhèu canguru èci sèra, lasi uuru pège asa cabèka loko yabok.

source_text: he took them and sent them across the stream, along with all his possessions.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai ca bèka loko, ka na hia aa'i mèdha-panyau na asa nèi.

source_text: so jacob was left all alone, and there a man wrestled with him until daybreak.
target_text: te ngaa yakob pea ka mesa-mesa ètu èèna. hèia dhèu mone èci mai, ka dua ra palèka d'ai oe mèu.

source_text: when the man saw that he could not overpower jacob, he struck the socket of jacob's hip and dislocated it as they wrestled.
target_text: ropa mone ne ne'a na nèngu segi boe yakob, ka na kalabhe mi kolo keja yakob, ka gage na tabod'a eele nèti era na.

source_text: then the man said, let me go, for it is daybreak. but jacob replied, i will not let you go unless you bless me.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii, aku nèngu na, patabuli ja'a, te ciki hari, lod'o rea kèna. te ngaa, aku yakob na, èu hia ja'a mèngi-nale, heka ja'a patabuli èu kèna!

source_text: what is your name? the man asked. jacob, he replied.
target_text: ka mone ne karèi ne, ngara èu ne, cee? na dhaa, peka na, yakob.

source_text: then the man said, your name will no longer be jacob, but israel, because you have struggled with god and with men, and you have prevailed.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii hari, aku nèngu na, èu ngara heka yakob. te ngaa mulai nèti deo ne'e ne, dhèu paroa èu, isra'el, lula èu lab'a le dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, ka èu segi. ngara isra'el sasoa na ‘dhu palèka dènge ama lamatua'.

source_text: and jacob requested, please tell me your name. but he replied, why do you ask my name? then he blessed jacob there.
target_text: ka yakob karèi ne, èu peka ku ngara èu la. te ngaa mone ne peka na, èu neo me'a ngara ja'a, tao ngaa? hèia na hia mèngi-nale mi yakob ètu era èèna.

source_text: so jacob named the place peniel, saying, indeed, i have seen god face to face, and yet my life was spared.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le ama lamatua madha dènge madha, te ngaa ja'a mamuri era. nèti èèna ka, yakob pangare era èèna, peniel, dhu sasoa na, ‘rèhu lamatua'.

source_text: the sun rose above him as he passed by penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.
target_text: ropa yakob tèke eele era èèna, lod'o dhu rea le. te ngaa na kako ged'a, lula gage na tabod'a.

source_text: therefore to this day the israelites do not eat the tendon which is at the socket of the hip, because the socket of jacob's hip was struck near that tendon.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu isra'el ra'a boe sisi isi lasona, lula lamatua kalabhe patabod'a eele gage bèi-baki ra yakob.

source_text: now jacob looked up and saw esau coming toward him with four hundred men. so he divided the children among leah, rachel, and the two maidservants.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, yakob ladhe nèdhi esau, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu sèra, mai asa rèngu. ka na papala ana na mi ina ra èci-èci.

source_text: he put the maidservants and their children in front, leah and her children next, and rachel and joseph at the rear.
target_text: na hia dhèu èmu piara sèra dènge ana ra kako uuru. èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, heka rahel dènge ana na yusuf limuri tèka.

source_text: but jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
target_text: te ngaa yakob kako uuru nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa na padètu dènge a'a na, na patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u d'ai rai pidhu hari.

source_text: esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. and they both wept.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o esau ladhe nèdhi ari na, rai dènge ka, la'e liku nare yakob. dua ra paliku dènge pa'uu. hèia dua ra tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: when esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, who are these with you? jacob answered, these are the children god has graciously given your servant.
target_text: ropa esau nèdhi bhèni dènge ana-ana si, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, se'e se, cee ka se'e? ka yakob peka, rèngu se'e se, dhu ama lamatua pala-bagi hia ja'a, ènu a'a ku ne.

source_text: then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu piara na, dènge ana niki ra lasi pahaha iisi ètu madha esau.

source_text: leah and her children also approached and bowed down, and then joseph and rachel approached and bowed down.
target_text: èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi. dhu lasi limuri, yusuf dènge ina na rahel lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi.

source_text: what do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me? asked esau. to find favor in your sight, my lord, jacob answered.
target_text: èle èèna ka, esau karèi, aku nèngu na, èu pa'adhu badha pèri nau sèi, èu neo tao ngaa? hèia yakob dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ja'a hia mi a'a ku, sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo.

source_text: i already have plenty, my brother, esau replied. keep what belongs to you.
target_text: te ngaa esau peka, ja'a dènge mèdha-panyau ae kahèi. de hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but jacob insisted, no, please! if i have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. for indeed, i have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of god, since you have received me favorably.
target_text: te ngaa yakob b'ala, peka na, baku, a'a. a'a ku hud'i sèmi la mèdha se, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo. te ropa a'a ku b'ui mari, ka ja'a sèmi dhu kèdhi b'ui mari nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: please accept my gift that was brought to you, because god has been gracious to me and i have all i need. so jacob pressed him until he accepted.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, a'a ku sèmi la mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua aad'o se. lula ama lamatua be'a titu kèna dènge ja'a ne. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a unu ngaa-ngaa se aa'i-aa'i. lula yakob pamako taruu, no'o do no'o boe èèna ka, esau sèmi nare kahèi.

source_text: then esau said, let us be on our way, and i will go ahead of you.
target_text: hèia esau peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, miu pa'èra ho lati palere. ja'a lere miu.

source_text: but jacob replied, my lord knows that the children are frail, and i must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. if they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.
target_text: te ngaa aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a! a'a ku ladhe mèdhi unu mu. ana mu se, ana iiki ae era. rèngu se dhae èra èèna mèka. aa badha ae ka dhu heka matana. ladhe ta pakaseti si kako pamèri, ètu d'ara ca lod'o, èèna na madhe aa'i si.

source_text: please let my lord go ahead of his servant. i will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until i come to my lord at seir.
target_text: de be'a risi, a'a ku si kako uuru. pe ji'i kako mau-mau dhiu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a dhiu ngad'o a'a ku ètu seir.

source_text: let me leave some of my people with you, esau said. but jacob replied, why do that? let me find favor in the sight of my lord.
target_text: hèia esau lii hari, na peka, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele dhèu ja'a se cahag'e, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa, aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a, ee! sad'i ja'a ke'a le, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: so that day esau started on his way back to seir,
target_text: tadèngi nare, esau pakèd'i ka, tèke eele si, lèpa asa seir.

source_text: but jacob went on to succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; that is why the place was called succoth.
target_text: te ngaa nèti era èèna, yakob la'e asa sukot. d'ai nèi, na tao èmu dènge oka hia badha aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ra pangare na sukot dhu sasoa na ‘èmu pea taha'.

source_text: after jacob had come from paddan-aram, he arrived safely at the city of shechem in the land of canaan, and he camped just outside the city.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, yakob si kako nèti padan aram, lasi d'ai rae sikem ètu rai kana'an dènge sod'a-mole. hèia ra patitu paleo, sèna ka ra pea padètu dènge rae èèna.

source_text: and the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of hamor, shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of silver.
target_text: rai dhu yakob patitu paleo ne, hèli nare nèti hemor, ana sikem. kab'ua rai ne, ca ngasu doi iia.

source_text: there he set up an altar and called it el-elohe-israel.
target_text: ètu era ne, na pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne'e, el-elohe-isra'el, dhu sasoa na ‘ama lamatua nèti isra'el'.

source_text: now dinah, the daughter leah had borne to jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
target_text: ca lod'o, dina, ana bhèni yakob dènge lea, la'e pangad'o dènge bhèni anga-aangalai na ètu rae èèna.

source_text: when shechem son of hamor the hivite, the prince of the region, saw her, he took her and lay with her by force.
target_text: dhèu aae kabarai ne, ngara na hemor, nèti suku hewi. ngara ana mone na, sikem. ca tèka, sikem ladhe nèdhi dina, ka rai nèti ne, hèia na tao pakarehe ne.

source_text: and his soul was drawn to dinah, the daughter of jacob. he loved the young girl and spoke to her tenderly.
target_text: sikem d'èi madhe-madhe dina ne. ka na solo mako, sèna ka dina no'o dènge ne.

source_text: so shechem told his father hamor, get me this girl as a wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! lamu karèi dina hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhèdi dènge ne.

source_text: jacob heard that shechem had defiled his daughter dinah, but since his sons were with his livestock in the field, he remained silent about it until they returned.
target_text: tatao sikem ne, yakob dhu tadèngi le, te ngaa na mau-mau, aa tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te lod'o èèna, ana mone na sèra, ètu d'ara pad'a madhenge badha rèngu. ka na mate si mai ku.

source_text: meanwhile, shechem's father hamor came to speak with jacob.
target_text: lod'o èèna, hemor, ama sikem, mai padhai lii dènge yakob, ho neo karèi dina hia sikem.

source_text: when jacob's sons heard what had happened, they returned from the field. they were filled with grief and fury, because shechem had committed an outrage in israel by lying with jacob's daughter-a thing that should not be done.
target_text: ètu talora dua ra padhue-padhai era, ana-ana yakob lèpa nèti d'ara pad'a. ropa ra tadèngi sikem dhu tao pakarehe le ana hèni ra, ka d'ara ra pèd'a, ka ra nasa bia. ka ra peka, madha j'ara dhu sèmi ne'e ne, lèke boe ètu isra'el. de ji'i se sèmi boe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: but hamor said to them, my son shechem longs for your daughter. please give her to him as his wife.
target_text: ka hemor pamako yakob, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a sikem d'èi tare'a-re'a ana èu dina. de ja'a manèngi d'ara èu, sèna ka mo'o la, paleo ana bhèni èu dènge ne.

source_text: intermarry with us; give us your daughters, and take our daughters for yourselves.
target_text: ladhe mo'o ana-ana èdhi se paleo iisi-aanga ra. ana-ana mone nèti miu, madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni nèti ji'i. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana-ana mone ji'i madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni miu.

source_text: you may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.
target_text: sèna ka èdhi pea pa'oru pa'èci ètu d'ara rai ne'e. sad'i miu d'èi era mia èèna ka, mi pea la dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. mi d'aga, sèna ka abhu kakaja ètu ne'e.

source_text: then shechem said to dinah's father and brothers, grant me this favor, and i will give you whatever you ask. demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and i will give you whatever you ask. only give me the girl as my wife!
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama dina dènge a'a na sèra, peka na, miu se, sad'i manèngi ngaa, ja'a dhoka madhutu di. masi ka miu manèngi doi pamèu madha, dènge kab'ua pèri-pèri èèna ka, ja'a hia. sad'i mo'o ja'a leo dènge ana hèni miu.

source_text: but because shechem had defiled their sister dinah, jacob's sons answered him and his father hamor deceitfully.
target_text: te ngaa ana-ana yakob se re'a le, sikem dhu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra dina. hèia ra karihu-kahadhu, ka ra bèle, peka mi sikem dènge ama na hemor,

source_text: we cannot do such a thing, they said. to give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
target_text: aku rèngu na, ji'i bisa boe hia ana hèni ji'i leo dènge dhèu dhu suna boe. te èèna na, era makae ji'i èèna!

source_text: we will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us-every one of your males.
target_text: te ngaa j'ara na sèmi ne'e: miu se, hud'i sama ku sèmi ji'i, mone aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki, dhèu kapai, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. we will dwell among you and become one people.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu j'ara ne'e, èdhi heka paleo kèna. aa ji'i pea ètu rai ne'e hèi, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i, aa mo'o boe suna, ji'i ngare hari ana hèni ji'i, ho kèd'i eele rai ne'e.

source_text: their offer seemed good to hamor and his son shechem.
target_text: hèia hemor dènge ana na sikem ro'o kahèi.

source_text: the young man, who was the most respected of all his father's household, did not hesitate to fulfill this request, because he was delighted with jacob's daughter.
target_text: te ngaa sikem no'o heka mate, lula d'ara na d'èi ae dina. dhèu isi rai ètu èèna pakab'ua sikem ne titu kèna.

source_text: so hamor and his son shechem went to the gate of their city and addressed the men of their city:
target_text: ka hemor dènge sikem lasi asa era pama'ète lii, ètu hèb'a tedhe rae èèna, hèia ra padhue lii ne dènge kabarai sèra. ra peka, aku rèngu na,

source_text: these men are at peace with us. let them live and trade in our land; indeed, it is large enough for them. let us take their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhèu isra'el se, d'èi mamuri mera-milu dènge èdhi. de hud'i laa ta pea pa'èci dènge rèngu ètu dedha-rai ne'e. rai ne taleo, de èdhi bisa pea pa'èci aa'i-aa'i ti. èdhi se bisa leo dènge ana bhèni rèngu. aa rèngu bisa madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èdhi kahèi.

source_text: but only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.
target_text: lii manèngi rèngu dhoka èci di, nèti èdhi se. ra manèngi, èdhi mone se aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna ku, madhutu ad'a rèngu.

source_text: will not their livestock, their possessions, and all their animals become ours? only let us consent to them, and they will dwell among us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi se pab'ali le dènge rèngu, èèna na badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau ra j'aj'i unu èdhi. de be'a risi èdhi to'o la madhutu dad'èi ra. mai sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti suna! mo'o, sina ma?

source_text: all the men who went out of the city gate listened to hamor and his son shechem, and every male of the city was circumcised.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra sa, sèmi lii padhai lii hemor dènge ana na sikem. hèia dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ètu rai èèna suna palere-lere.

source_text: three days later, while they were still in pain, two of jacob's sons dinah's brothers simeon and levi took their swords, went into the unsuspecting city, and slaughtered every male.
target_text: d'ara lod'o ka tèlu, ropa rèngu dhu suna se, nu'a ra dhu pèd'a era, ka ana mone dina, simeon dènge lewi, rare samala ra, kako mau-mau, lasi asa d'ara kota. ka dua ra pare pamadhe aa'i-aa'i dhèu mone sèra.

source_text: they killed hamor and his son shechem with their swords, took dinah out of shechem's house, and went away.
target_text: hemor dènge sikem, ra pare pamadhe kahèi. hèia ra rèti dènge ka dina nèti d'ara èmu sikem, lèpa èmu rèngu.

source_text: jacob's other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city, because their sister had been defiled.
target_text: aa ana yakob dhu cahag'e sèra, maso asa d'ara kota èèna, ra parama rèti aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èèna. ra nasa, lula dhèu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra ètu èèna.

source_text: they took their flocks and herds and donkeys, and everything else in the city or in the field.
target_text: ra parama rèti mèdha-panyau dhèu nèti d'ara èmu ra, dènge eo rèti badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara pad'a.

source_text: they carried off all their possessions and women and children, and they plundered everything in their houses.
target_text: rèti aa'i bhèni dènge ana-ana, aa parame rare aa'i mèdha dhu kab'ua nèti kabarai ne.

source_text: then jacob said to simeon and levi, you have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the canaanites and perizzites, the people of this land. we are few in number; if they unite against me and attack me, i and my household will be destroyed.
target_text: ropa yakob ne'a j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, na peka dènge simeon dènge lewi, miu dua mi se, goa ngaa ka ne'e? miu paj'èra ja'a! èèna na, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu peris dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu dedha rai ne'e, tèka d'ara dènge èdhi se. rèngu se, dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa èdhi se, dhèu ciki di. ladhe rèngu se mai age èdhi, na, ra palaho aa'i èdhi.

source_text: but they replied, should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?
target_text: te ngaa ana se dhaa dènge lii nasa, peka na, ama! ama pangee na hud'i laa ji'i soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao ana hèni ji'i ne, bhèni kajeo!

source_text: then god said to jacob, arise, go up to bethel, and settle there. build an altar there to the god who appeared to you when you fled from your brother esau.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua padhai lii dènge yakob, peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu, lod'o èu rai nèti madha a'a mu esau. kèd'i, lamu dènge ka asa betel. ladhe d'ai nèi, mu patitu mei korban hia ja'a. aa pea dènge ka ètu èèna.

source_text: so jacob told his household and all who were with him, get rid of the foreign gods that are among you. purify yourselves and change your garments. then let us arise and go to bethel. i will build an altar there to god, who answered me in my day of distress. he has been with me wherever i have gone.
target_text: ka yakob peka dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i, aku nèngu na, aa'i-aa'i ti lati dènge ka asa betel. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ama lamatua ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu èèna. ja'a neo tao mei korban ètu nèi. de mi core eele mèdha sogo-tagu miu. aa mi pamèu iisi mi, ho mi gati mèdha-papake leo, te èdhi neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: so they gave jacob all their foreign gods and all their earrings, and jacob buried them under the oak near shechem.
target_text: ka ra oru mèdha sogo-tagu, dènge ate-ate ra aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia yakob dhènu mèdha se aa'i-aa'i ra ètu kapua aj'u aae ca kapua dhu padètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: as they set out, a terror from god fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue jacob's sons.
target_text: ropa yakob dènge dhèu na aa'i-aa'i pakèd'i nèti sikem, ama lamatua hia d'ara madha'u mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu padètu dènge rae sikem, ka ra bani boe tao karehe mi yakob si.

source_text: so jacob and everyone with him arrived in luz that is, bethel in the land of canaan.
target_text: ka yakob si d'ai dènge sod'a ètu betel dhu uru èèna, ngara na lus, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: there jacob built an altar, and he called that place el-bethel, because it was there that god had revealed himself to jacob as he fled from his brother.
target_text: ètu ne'e, yakob pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne, el betel, sasoa na ‘betel unu ama lamatua', lula uru èèna ama lamatua pad'elo iisi mi yakob ètu era èèna, lod'o nèngu rai nèti madha a'a na.

source_text: now deborah, rebekah's nurse, died and was buried under the oak below bethel. so jacob named it allon-bachuth.
target_text: padètu dènge rae betel, abhu aj'u aae ca kapua, ngara na alon bakut. sasoa na ‘aj'u tangi dhèu madhe'. pake ngara ne, lod'o debora, ina dhu lalau-lalo'o ribka, madhe, ka padhane ètu karasa aj'u èèna.

source_text: after jacob had returned from paddan-aram, god appeared to him again and blessed him.
target_text: lod'o yakob lèpa nèti padan aram, ama lamatua pad'elo hari iisi na, ka hia na berkat.

source_text: and god said to him, though your name is jacob, you will no longer be called jacob. instead, your name will be israel. so god named him israel.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge ne, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu ngara heka yakob, te ngaa isra'el.

source_text: and god told him, i am god almighty. be fruitful and multiply. a nation-even a company of nations-shall come from you, and kings shall descend from you.
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. de èu matana pa'ae-ae, aa ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, suku-suku mai nèti ana-èpu èu. aa nèti ana-èpu èu sèra, cèu dhèu aae-dhèu aae.

source_text: the land that i gave to abraham and isaac i will give to you, and i will give this land to your descendants after you.
target_text: rai dhu pangèd'u mi baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak, ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: then god went up from the place where he had spoken with him. so jacob set up a pillar in the place where god had spoken with him-a stone marker-and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it with oil.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua peka nare, yakob patitu dènge hadhu ètu era èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha ho na baku bhèlu eele lii lamatua. ka na bhori èi anggor dènge èi mènyi mi dedha hadhu na, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: jacob called the place where god had spoken with him bethel.
target_text: era èèna, na pangare ‘betel'.

source_text: later, they set out from bethel, and while they were still some distance from ephrath, rachel began to give birth, and her labor was difficult.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pakèd'i nèti betel. ropa rèngu kaj'èu èèna mèka nèti rae efrata nuka betlehem èèna, rahel dhu d'ai le lod'o nara iisi na. te ngaa nara iisi carui, hèia na roe titu kèna.

source_text: during her severe labor, the midwife said to her, do not be afraid, for you are having another son.
target_text: ka ropa na pèngu stenga madhe, dhèu ai tadha peka dènge ne, pa'èra d'ara èu, te mora iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu! de baku paroe iisi.

source_text: and with her last breath-for she was dying-she named him ben-oni. but his father called him benjamin.
target_text: lod'o rahel oe ma'ète a'ae, na pangare ana ne, ben-oni, dhu sasoa na ‘ana nèti j'aj'èra ja'a'. ka heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa yakob hia ana ne ngara benyamin, dhu sasoa na ‘ana ai g'ana'.

source_text: so rachel died and was buried on the way to ephrath that is, bethlehem.
target_text: ka ra padhane rahel ètu sebhe j'ara dhu la'e asa efrata, dhu limuri ne, ngara na betlehem.

source_text: jacob set up a pillar on her grave; it marks rachel's tomb to this day.
target_text: hèia yakob pudhi lutu bhatu ètu ro'a dhèu èmu na èèna. d'ai sange ne'e, ro'a rahel ne era.

source_text: israel again set out and pitched his tent beyond the tower of eder.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob pea boe mi ca era sa. ca tèka, na patitu paleo ètu sebhe manara eder.

source_text: while israel was living in that region, reuben went in and slept with his father's concubine bilhah, and israel heard about it. jacob had twelve sons:
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu era èèna, ruben j'unu dènge bilha, dhèu èmu piara ama na. èèna ka, yakob ne'a j'ara ne'e kahèi. ana mone yakob, canguru dua dhèu.

source_text: the sons of leah were reuben the firstborn of jacob, simeon, levi, judah, issachar, and zebulun.
target_text: ana-ana nèti lea, nuka: ruben ana uuru yakob, simeon, lewi, yahuda, isaskar, dènge sebulon.

source_text: the sons of rachel were joseph and benjamin.
target_text: ana-ana rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: the sons of rachel's maidservant bilhah were dan and naphtali.
target_text: ana-ana nèti bilha, ènu rahel: dan dènge naftali.

source_text: and the sons of leah's maidservant zilpah were gad and asher. these are the sons of jacob, who were born to him in paddan-aram.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti silpa, ènu lea, nuka: gad dènge aser. rara iisi ana se ètu padan aram.

source_text: jacob returned to his father isaac at mamre, near kiriath-arba that is, hebron, where abraham and isaac had stayed.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob la'e ngad'o ama na isak asa mamre, dhu dètu dènge kiryat-arba dhu limuri ne, ngara na hebron. uru èèna, baki na abraham pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and isaac lived 180 years. then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. and his sons esau and jacob buried him.
target_text: umur isak d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna. ka ana na esau dènge yakob padhane ne.

source_text: this is the account of esau that is, edom.
target_text: ne'e ne, ana-èpu esau. ngara esau dhu leo, edom.

source_text: esau took his wives from the daughters of canaan: adah daughter of elon the hittite, oholibamah daughter of anah and granddaughter of zibeon the hivite,
target_text: esau leo dènge ana bhèni kana'an dhèu dua. èci dhèu het, ana bhèni nèti elon, ngara na ada. dhèu èmu na èci hari, dhèu hewi, ngara na oholibama. ama na, ngara na anah, aa baki na sibeon.

source_text: and basemath daughter of ishmael and sister of nebaioth.
target_text: esau leo kahèi dènge ana ismael, ngara na basmat. ana mone basmat, ngara na nebayot.

source_text: and adah bore eliphaz to esau, basemath gave birth to reuel,
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu uuru esau, nara iisi elifas. basmat matana rahuel.

source_text: and oholibamah gave birth to jeush, jalam, and korah. these were the sons of esau, who were born to him in the land of canaan.
target_text: aa oholibama matana yeus, yalam dènge kora. ana esau aa'i-aa'i ra sèra rara iisi si ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: later, esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household, along with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the property he had acquired in canaan, and he moved to a land far away from his brother jacob.
target_text: ca tèka, esau pidha asa rai leo cue dhu kaj'èu nèti yakob. la'e nèti aa'i bhèni-ana niki, dhèu-dhèu sab'a, badha-manu, dènge mèdha-panyau na.

source_text: for their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.
target_text: esau pacèri dènge yakob, lula badha-manu ra dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, era pea rèngu katata ètu rai èèna.

source_text: so esau that is, edom settled in the area of mount seir.
target_text: hèia esau nuka edom la'e pea ètu ledhe ètu seir.

source_text: this is the account of esau, the father of the edomites, in the area of mount seir.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu esau dhu ra peka na ‘dhèu edom'. rèngu pea ètu era ledhe seir.

source_text: these are the names of esau's sons: eliphaz son of esau's wife adah, and reuel son of esau's wife basemath. the sons of eliphaz were teman, omar, zepho, gatam, and kenaz. additionally, timna, a concubine of esau's son eliphaz, gave birth to amalek. these are the grandsons of esau's wife adah. these are the sons of reuel: nahath, zerah, shammah, and mizzah. they are the grandsons of esau's wife basemath.
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu esau, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na elifas. elifas ne, ana mone na, dhèu lèmi, nuka: teman, omar, sefo, gatam dènge kenas. dhèu èmu piara elifas, ngara na timna. nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na amalek. dhèu èmu esau, basmat, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehuel. rehuel abhu ana mone dhèu èpa, nuka: nahat, sera, syama, dènge misa.

source_text: these are the sons of esau's wife oholibamah daughter of anah and granddaughter of zibeon whom she bore to esau: jeush, jalam, and korah.
target_text: dhèu èmu esau, oholibama, ana nèti anah, aa èpu nèti sibeon, nara iisi ana mone dhèu tèlu, nuka: yeus, yalam, dènge kora.

source_text: these are the chiefs among the sons of esau. the sons of eliphaz the firstborn of esau: chiefs teman, omar, zepho, kenaz, korah, gatam, and amalek. they are the chiefs of eliphaz in the land of edom, and they are the grandsons of adah.
target_text: ana-èpu esau se pahag'a lème, ka j'aj'i mi suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku ra. ana-ana elifas, dhu ana uuru nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku teman, suku omar, suku sefo, suku kenas, suku kora, suku gatam dènge suku amalek. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana-èpu nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na ada.

source_text: these are the sons of esau's son reuel: chiefs nahath, zerah, shammah, and mizzah. they are the chiefs descended from reuel in the land of edom, and they are the grandsons of esau's wife basemath.
target_text: ana-ana rehuel, dhu ana nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku nahat, suku sera, suku syama, dènge suku misa. aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu esau dènge dhèu èmu na, basmat.

source_text: these are the sons of esau's wife oholibamah: chiefs jeush, jalam, and korah. they are the chiefs descended from esau's wife oholibamah, the daughter of anah.
target_text: ana-ana nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na, oholibama, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku yeus, suku yalam, dènge suku kora.

source_text: all these are the sons of esau that is, edom, and they were their chiefs.
target_text: suku se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti ana-èpu esau.

source_text: these are the sons of seir the horite, who were living in the land: lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer, and dishan. they are the chiefs of the horites, the descendants of seir in the land of edom.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu hori èci, ngara na seir. ana-ana na pahag'a palème rai, ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku na. èle èèna ka, ana-ana na se j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku lotan, suku sobal, suku sibeon, suku anah, suku dison, suku eser, dènge suku disan.

source_text: the sons of lotan were hori and hemam. timna was lotan's sister.
target_text: ana lotan nuka: hori dènge heman. ana hèni lotan, nuka timna.

source_text: these are the sons of shobal: alvan, manahath, ebal, shepho, and onam.
target_text: ana-ana sobal, nuka: alwan, manahat, ebal, sefo, dènge onam.

source_text: these are the sons of zibeon: aiah and anah. this is the anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father zibeon.
target_text: ana-ana nèti sibeon, nuka: aya, dènge anah. anah ne'e ka dhu rage madha èi pana ètu d'ara mamoo, lod'o na madhenga keled'ei ama na.

source_text: these are the children of anah: dishon and oholibamah daughter of anah. these are the sons of dishon: hemdan, eshban, ithran, and cheran.
target_text: ana bhèni nèti anah, nuka oholibama. aa ana mone na, nuka, dison. ana-ana dison, nuka: hemdan, esban, yitran, dènge keran.

source_text: these are the sons of ezer: bilhan, zaavan, and akan.
target_text: ana-ana eser, nuka: bilhan, saawan, dènge akan.

source_text: these are the sons of dishan: uz and aran.
target_text: ana-ana disan, nuka: us, dènge aran.

source_text: these are the chiefs of the horites: chiefs lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer, and dishan. they are the chiefs of the horites, according to their divisions in the land of seir.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku nèti dhèu hori sèra, nuka: lotan, sobal, sibeon, anah, dison, eser, dènge disan. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se pea ètu rai seir.

source_text: these are the kings who reigned in the land of edom before any king reigned over the israelites:
target_text: lod'o dhu kabarai isra'el dènge mèka dhèu aae, te ngaa ètu rai edom dènge le dhèu aae. ngara dhèu aae se, dhutu-dhutu, nuka:

source_text: bela son of beor reigned in edom; the name of his city was dinhabah.
target_text: ra ded'e bela, ana nèti beor, j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu kota dinhaba.

source_text: when bela died, jobab son of zerah from bozrah reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa bela madhe, ra ded'e yobab ho gati ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na sera, nèti rae bosra.

source_text: when jobab died, husham from the land of the temanites reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa yobab madhe, ra ded'e husam ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. husam ne, nèti rai dhèu teman.

source_text: when husham died, hadad son of bedad, who defeated midian in the country of moab, reigned in his place. and the name of his city was avith.
target_text: ropa husam madhe, ra ded'e hadad ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na bedad, nèti rae awit. nèngu ka dhu segi dhèu midian, lod'o ra pamusu ètu moab.

source_text: when hadad died, samlah from masrekah reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa hadad madhe, ra ded'e samla ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. nèngu ne, nèti rae masreka.

source_text: when samlah died, shaul from rehoboth on the euphrates reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa samla madhe, ra ded'e saul ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. saul èèna, nèti rae rehobot, dhu ètu sebhe loko.

source_text: when shaul died, baal-hanan son of achbor reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa saul madhe, ra ded'e baal-hanan ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na akbor.

source_text: when baal-hanan son of achbor died, hadad reigned in his place. his city was named pau, and his wife's name was mehetabel daughter of matred, the daughter of me-zahab.
target_text: ropa baal-hanan madhe, ra ded'e hadar ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. hadar ne, nèti rae pau. aa dhèu èmu na, ngara mehetabel. ama mehetabel, ngara na matret. aa baki na, mesahab.

source_text: these are the names of esau's chiefs, according to their families and regions, by their names: chiefs timna, alvah, jetheth, oholibamah, elah, pinon, kenaz, teman, mibzar, magdiel, and iram. these were the chiefs of edom, according to their settlements in the land they possessed. esau was the father of the edomites.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku dhu j'aj'i nèti ana-èpu esau, nuka: timna, alwa, yetet, oholibama, ela, pinon, kenas, teman, mibsar, magdiel, dènge iram. rèngu se èci-èci pangare rai ra madhutu ngara rèngu unu ra. de aa'i-aa'i se'e, lii lolo nèti ana-èpu esau, dhèu edom èèna.

source_text: now jacob lived in the land where his father had resided, the land of canaan.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lole nèti yakob si. ca tèka ka, yakob la'e pea hari asa rai kana'an. èèna, era pea ama na isak nèti uru ka.

source_text: this is the account of jacob. when joseph was seventeen years old, he was tending the flock with his brothers, the sons of his father's wives bilhah and zilpah, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
target_text: tèu èèna, ana yakob èci, nèti dhèu èmu na rahel, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne'e, ropa umur na d'ai canguru pidhu tèu, nèngu dènge a'a na si, tema le j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho rèngu. a'a na sèra, ana nèti ina leo hari, ngara na bilha dènge silpa. te ngaa yusuf ne'e tuka tenge lii mi dedha a'a na si, ho la'e pana'e ama na.

source_text: now israel loved joseph more than his other sons, because joseph had been born to him in his old age; so he made him a robe of many colors.
target_text: lod'o dhu rara iisi yusuf na, ama na dhu heka le. nèti èèna ka, na sue yusuf ne risi eele nèti ana-ana na leo sèra. ca lod'o ka, yakob j'au kodho madhera èci dhu saraga bia hia yusuf.

source_text: when joseph's brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
target_text: ropa a'a na si ladhe-ladhe la'a na ama na sue risi yusuf, hèia ra mulai tèka d'ara dènge ne, ro'o boe padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: then joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more. he said to them, listen to this dream i had: we were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka yusuf nii. kèd'i nèti bhèj'i ka, na lolo dènge a'a na si lii nii deo na, aku nèngu na, we! mi nanene ku la! ja'a nii, na èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èki are ètu d'ara oka. kabèdhi laa, are dhu ja'a èki titu dhoo-dhoo. te ngaa are miu, oke mere are ja'a deo na, ka pacud'u mi unu ja'a. ra nanene rare sèmi èèna, hèia a'a na se'e tabha nasa hari dènge ne.

source_text: do you intend to reign over us? his brothers asked. will you actually rule us? so they hated him even more because of his dream and his statements.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, we! èu ngee na, èu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai kèna, ho neo paredha ji'i, do? taga na lolo lii nii ne'e, hèia asa ra nasa dènge ne.

source_text: then joseph had another dream and told it to his brothers. look, he said, i had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.
target_text: nèbhu boe, yusuf nii hari ca tèka. na lolo hari dènge a'a na si, aku nèngu na, we! ja'a nii hari, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a kèdhi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu canguru èci. aa'i-aa'i sèra, pahaha iisi mi ja'a.

source_text: he told his father and brothers, but his father rebuked him and said, what is this dream that you have had? will your mother and brothers and i actually come and bow down to the ground before you?
target_text: hèia yusuf lolo hari lii nii deo na dènge ama na, aa dènge a'a na sèra. ka ama na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, lii nii ngaa, kèna! èu ngee na, ja'a dènge ina mu, dènge a'ari èu sèra, mai uu kabaj'èla èu, do? èu nia ae le èèna, nga!

source_text: and his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept in mind what he had said.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, a'a na sèra tèka d'ara bia dènge ne. te ngaa ama na pangee taruu lii nii èèna ètu d'ara na.

source_text: some time later, joseph's brothers had gone to pasture their father's flocks near shechem.
target_text: ca tèka ka, a'a yusuf sèra rèti kahib'i-kalèbho ama na, asa era j'u'u dètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: israel said to him, are not your brothers pasturing the flocks at shechem? get ready; i am sending you to them. i am ready, joseph replied.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ama na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, a'a mu si j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho dètu dènge sikem. de èu pa'èra, ho lamu ladhe ku si la. ka yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku, ama.

source_text: then israel told him, go now and see how your brothers and the flocks are faring, and bring word back to me. so he sent him off from the valley of hebron. and when joseph arrived in shechem,
target_text: hèia ama na peka hari, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ladhe a'a mu si, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho èdhi. ladhe ra samia na, mai peka dènge ja'a. ka yusuf pakèd'i ka nèti d'ara pad'a hebron, la'e taruu d'ai sikem.

source_text: a man found him wandering in the field and asked, what are you looking for?
target_text: d'ai nèi, na tenge a'a na si, palème d'ara pad'a èèna. na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ka dhèu èèna karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu tenge ngaa?

source_text: i am looking for my brothers, joseph replied. can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?
target_text: yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a tenge a'a ja'a. rèngu eo kahib'i-kalèbho dètu ètu era ne'e. de ama, èu paraga dènge si, do aad'o?

source_text: they have moved on from here, the man answered. i heard them say, ‘let us go to dothan. ' so joseph set out after his brothers and found them at dothan.
target_text: hèia, dhèu deo na peka, aku nèngu na, ra aad'o heka ètu ne'e. te ja'a tadèngi, ra peka na lasi padètu dènge rae dotan. hèia yusuf la'e taruu, ka paraga dènge si ètu rae dotan.

source_text: now joseph's brothers saw him in the distance, and before he arrived, they plotted to kill him.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi yusuf nèti kaj'èu, ra padhue rare lii èci neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: here comes that dreamer! they said to one another.
target_text: èci peka dènge èci, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku la! mone eele tuka nii na, nuka mai nèi!

source_text: come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. we can say that a vicious animal has devoured him. then we shall see what becomes of his dreams!
target_text: de mai ho ti pamadhe ne. ho èèna na, ti core eele ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna. ladhe d'ai èmu na, ti peka dènge ama peka na, badha hui ra'e ne. ho èèna na, ti ladhe sèku, lii nii na sèra sa mia!

source_text: when reuben heard this, he tried to rescue joseph from their hands. let us not take his life, he said.
target_text: ropa nanene èèna, hèia a'a na ruben tenge j'ara ho patabuli eele yusuf. hèia na kai ari na si, aku nèngu na, we! èdhi baku pamadhe ne!

source_text: do not shed his blood. throw him into this pit in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him. reuben said this so that he could rescue joseph from their hands and return him to his father.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi kèpe ne, ti tao asa d'ara madha èi madhe nèi. ètu èèna, era dhu dhèu aad'o, de èci sa rèdhi boe ne. sad'i baku pasuti raa na. na peka sèmi èèna, lula na tenge j'ara ho patalale yusuf, ho hia na lèpa hari èmu.

source_text: so when joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe-the robe of many colors he was wearing-
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai madha a'a na si, ra kèpe ne, ka ra rèbhi eele kodho dhu saraga aae ètu ua na.

source_text: and they took him and threw him into the pit. now the pit was empty, with no water in it.
target_text: ka ra nuni pa'oro ne, hèia ra tule ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna.

source_text: and as they sat down to eat a meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of ishmaelites coming from gilead. their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa, lasi ra'a-rinu. ètu talora ra'a-rinu, kabèdhi la ra ladhe rèdhi dhèu canau mai re èèna. dhèu sèra kako rèti dènge badha onta ra, hue dènge mèdha d'aga, sèmi raa aj'u hèu mèngi, bubhu-bubhu dènge èi na'i rupa-rupa. dhèu sèra sa, dhèu ismael, dhu mai nèti rae gilead neo lasi kaj'èu d'ai masir.

source_text: then judah said to his brothers, what profit will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yahuda peka dènge a'ari na sèra, aku nèngu na, ee! be'a risi sèmi ne'e. èdhi baku pamadhe ne. a'oto na ngaa? tasa mera mia èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe pahuni raa na.

source_text: come, let us sell him to the ishmaelites and not lay a hand on him; for he is our brother, our own flesh. and they agreed.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi pahie ne dènge dhèu ismael sèi. èdhi tao ne samia èèna ka oo, nèngu ne'e ari d'èlu èdhi. nèti èèna ka, baku èdhi pamadhe ne! aa'i-aa'i ra d'èi kahèi dènge lii yahuda èèna.

source_text: so when the midianite traders passed by, his brothers pulled joseph out of the pit and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the ishmaelites, who took him to egypt.
target_text: ropa dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai era èèna, hèia a'a yusuf sèra lasi ère rare ne, nèti d'ara madha èi madhe deo na. ka ra pahie ne mi dhèu ismael sèra dènge kab'ua dua nguru bua doi pudhi. ka dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf asa rai masir.

source_text: when reuben returned to the pit and saw that joseph was not there, he tore his clothes,
target_text: lod'o ra pahie yusuf ne, ruben ne'a boe. ropa na la'e patigi sa d'ara madha èi madhe na, capa na kabèdhi, ladhe la'a na yusuf aad'o heka ètu d'ara. nèti èèna ka, na ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, lula d'ara na pèd'a ae titu kèna.

source_text: returned to his brothers, and said, the boy is gone! what am i going to do?
target_text: hèia na la'e sa ari na si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ari èdhi aad'o heka ètu era èèna! ja'a tao samia hari?

source_text: then they took joseph's robe, slaughtered a young goat, and dipped the robe in its blood.
target_text: hèia ra roro kahib'i ci'u, ka rare kodho yusuf dhu saraga aae èèna, cèb'u sa d'ara raa kahib'i deo na.

source_text: they sent the robe of many colors to their father and said, we found this. examine it to see whether it is your son's robe or not.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa ka rèti dènge kodho deo na, pad'elo dènge ama na, ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i pili ngare kodho ne'e. ama ku ladhe sèku la. tao-tao ne'e kodho ari ji'i yusuf.

source_text: his father recognized it and said, it is my son's robe! a vicious animal has devoured him. joseph has surely been torn to pieces!
target_text: ropa nèdhi kodho deo na, yakob tadhe dènge. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ne'e kodho ana ja'a. èle boe badha hui ra'e ana ja'a. ira iiii! ana ja'a madhe le!

source_text: then jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth around his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yakob ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, ka na pake karo, taga nèti d'ara na susa titu kèna. na tangi lii ooi-ooi sène nare lod'o nèbhu aae.

source_text: all his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. no, he said. i will go down to sheol mourning for my son. so his father wept for him.
target_text: ana na, ana mone dènge ana bhèni sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mai padhai lii pakarej'e d'ara ama ra, te ngaa tao rare boe ne. aku nèngu na, aad'o! sasusa ja'a ne bisa d'ai madhe kèti. te ja'a bisa boe bhèlu ana èci ne'e. mema d'ara yakob j'èra taruu, lula na ngee nèdhi ana na yusuf dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: meanwhile, the midianites sold joseph in egypt to potiphar, an officer of pharaoh and captain of the guard.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu yakob ètu d'ara susa era, dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai le masir. d'ai nèi, ka lasi pahie eele yusuf dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa j'aga nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: about that time, judah left his brothers and settled near a man named hirah, an adullamite.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yahuda tèke eele a'ari na, ka la'e pea dènge angalai na èci, ngara na hira, ètu rae adulam.

source_text: there judah saw the daughter of a canaanite man named shua, and he took her as a wife and slept with her.
target_text: ètu èèna, dhèu mone èci, dhèu kana'an, ngara na sua. yahuda d'èi ana bhèni na èci, ka nare j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. dhèu èmu yahuda ne'e nara iisi ana mone pagod'o-pagod'o dhèu pèri-pèri.

source_text: so she conceived and gave birth to a son, and judah named him er.
target_text: ana uuru èèna, ngara na er.

source_text: again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him onan.
target_text: ana ka dua, ngara na onan.

source_text: then she gave birth to another son and named him shelah; it was at chezib that she gave birth to him.
target_text: aa ana ka tèlu, ngara na sela. lod'o ina na nara iisi sela na, yahuda si pidha le asa rae kesib.

source_text: now judah acquired a wife for er, his firstborn, and her name was tamar.
target_text: ropa ana mone uuru, dhu ngara na er èèna kapai, ka ama na la'e tenge dhèu hia ne. ngara ana bhèni na tamar. ka dua ra j'aj'i paleo èmu.

source_text: but er, judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the lord; so the lord put him to death.
target_text: lula er ne, bhelu-katub'a, ka ama lamatua huku pamadhe ne. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge boe kolo.

source_text: then judah said to onan, sleep with your brother's wife. perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.
target_text: hèia yahuda paroe nare ana mone ka dua na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, onan! a'a mu er madhe, dènge boe ana. madhutu ad'a èdhi na, èu hud'i leo hari ku dènge dhèu èmu a'a mu ne. sèna ka èu bisa hia kolo hia a'a mu.

source_text: but onan knew that the offspring would not belong to him; so whenever he would sleep with his brother's wife, he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother.
target_text: mema onan ne'a le ad'a sèmi ne'e. te ngaa na no'o boe hia kolo mi a'a na er. nèti èèna ka, ladhe rèngu j'unu pa'èci, na pasuti eele hua hini nèngu asa li'u, sèna ka tamar baku dènge babia.

source_text: what he did was wicked in the sight of the lord, so he put onan to death as well.
target_text: taga tatao onan sèmi ne'e ka, lamatua nasa bia dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, lamatua huku pamadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: then judah said to his daughter-in-law tamar, live as a widow in your father's house until my son shelah grows up. for he thought, he may die too, like his brothers. so tamar went to live in her father's house.
target_text: ropa yahuda nèdhi ana mone na dua sèra dhu leo dènge tamar madhe sèmi èèna, hèia yahuda madha'u. ka na pangee mage dhoka ana mone ka tèlu èèna, leo hari dènge tamar na madhe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, la'e peka dènge tamar, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa hari asa d'ara adhe-aai ina dènge ama mu. ladhe ana ja'a sela kapai, na èu lèpa hari mai ho leo dènge ne. hèia tamar lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: after a long time judah's wife, the daughter of shua, died. when judah had finished mourning, he and his friend hirah the adullamite went up to his sheepshearers at timnah.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu hèia, dhèu èmu yahuda madhe. na j'èra toke d'ai pa'èle lod'o sasusa na. ka na la'e gale nare angalai na hira, ka lasi asa rae timna. ètu èèna, dhèu rame-rame g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ho pahia.

source_text: when tamar was told, your father-in-law is going up to timnah to shear his sheep,
target_text: dhèu lolo dènge tamar, peka na, to'o mu la'e leru dhèu g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ètu rae timna.

source_text: she removed her widow's garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to enaim, which is on the way to timnah. for she saw that although shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana limuri yahuda, ngara na sela, kapai le. te ngaa tamar ne'a le, na, to'o na no'o boe paleo sela dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, tamar tenge j'ara neo katèju hak nèngu. na bhoke eele mèdha-papake bhèni balu ètu ngi'u na, ka na silu mèdha-papake dhu be'a. na pake salalu pahutu kètu dènge rèhu na. ka la'e madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe sebhe j'ara rae enaim, dhu biasa dhèu kako re èèna lasi rae timna.

source_text: when judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.
target_text: ropa yahuda kako re èèna, na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci madhèdi ètu èèna. na neo laa na dhèu bhèni kajeo, te tamar dhu lalau iisi dènge mèdha-papake saraga, aa pahutu rèhu na kahèi.

source_text: not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her and said, come now, let me sleep with you. what will you give me for sleeping with you? she inquired.
target_text: yahuda ne'a nare boe na dhèu bhèni na, dhèu èmu ana na dhu madhe sèra. hèia na kako la'e padètu dènge bhèni deo na ka, na peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ee! sèmi ja'a dènge èu na, èu manèngi ca ngaa? hèia tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, èèna nèti d'ara d'èi ama.

source_text: i will send you a young goat from my flock, judah answered. but she replied, only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.
target_text: aku yahuda na, sa mia! sèmi ja'a hia èu kahib'i ci'u? hèia tamar dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, bisa ama. sad'i ama hia ku ja'a mèdha èci ho ja'a kèd'u. pe pèri lod'o ho ama pa'adhu kahib'i èèna mai oo, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: what pledge should i give you? he asked. she answered, your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand. so he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him. then tamar got up and departed. and she removed her veil and put on her widow's garments again.
target_text: hèia yahuda karèi hari, aku nèngu na, de ja'a tèka mèdha ngaa mi èu? tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama tèke eele cap, dènge dhari dhu ama inu, dènge tatea dhu ama kèpe èèna hèi. nanene nare ka, yahuda hia mèdha sèra la'e. hèia dua ra lasi bhèj'i ka. èle èèna ka, tamar lèpa la'e èmu. d'ai èmu ka, na bhoke mèdha-papake saraga dènge salalu, ka gati dènge mèdha-papake bhèni balu. nèti èèna ka, tamar dènge babia.

source_text: now when judah sent his friend hirah the adullamite with the young goat to collect the items he had left with the woman, he could not find her.
target_text: nèbhu boe hèia, yahuda manèngi tolong angalai na hira, aku nèngu na, èu mèti kahib'i ne'e hia dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu ètu enaim èèna, ho mèti hari mèdha ja'a dhu ètu nèngu sèra. lod'o hira la'e d'ai nèi, na karèi palème, te ngaa paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna.

source_text: he asked the men of that place, where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at enaim? no shrine prostitute has been here, they answered.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, eee! miu mèdhi dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu biasa madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe èèna, do? na ètu mia, ee? dhèu sèra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ètu ne'e bhèni kajeo aad'o!

source_text: so hirah returned to judah and said, i could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘no shrine prostitute has been here. '
target_text: hèia hira lèpa hari peka dènge yahuda, aku nèngu na, ja'a paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna. ja'a tenge palème, te ngaa dhèu ètu sèra peka aku rèngu na, ètu rae èèna bhèni kajeo aad'o.

source_text: let her keep the items, judah replied. otherwise we will become a laughingstock. after all, i did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.
target_text: yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka la, nèngu abhu mèdha sèra! sad'i dhèu baku pamakae èdhi! ja'a neo b'ae, te ngaa èdhi paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna na.

source_text: about three months later, judah was told, your daughter-in-law tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant. bring her out! judah replied. let her be burned to death!
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu hèru hèia, dhèu lasi lolo dènge yahuda, peka na, dhèu èmu ana èu na tao ngi'u na sèmi dhèu bhèni kajeo. ka na dènge babia le. nanene nare èèna hèia, yahuda nasa bia. hèia na pua dhèu, aku nèngu na, lami nuni pa'oro ne mai, ho labhu asa d'ara ai la'e!

source_text: as she was being brought out, tamar sent a message to her father-in-law: i am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong. and she added, please examine them. whose seal and cord and staff are these?
target_text: ka dhèu lasi ka nuni rèti tamar mai. te ngaa na pad'elo cap dènge tatea èèna. ka na pua dhèu lasi peka dènge to'o na, aku nèngu na, parisa ku mèdha se'e. dhèu dhu unu cap dènge tatea ne'e ka dhu ad'u-ue tatao ne'e, ka ja'a dènge babia ne.

source_text: judah recognized the items and said, she is more righteous than i, since i did not give her to my son shelah. and he did not have relations with her again.
target_text: ropa nèdhi mèdha se'e, yahuda tadhe dènge, na mèdha sèra unu nèngu. hèia na padhai lii dènge ka, aku nèngu na, mema dhèu bhèni ne'e sala boe. ja'a ka dhu sala. madhutu iia na, ja'a ka dhu paleo bhèni ne'e dènge ana ja'a sela. te ngaa ja'a ka ko'o boe. karèi nèti èèna ka, yahuda pa'èci heka dènge tamar.

source_text: when the time came for tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka tamar nara iisi ana dhèu dua.

source_text: and as she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist. this one came out first, she announced.
target_text: lod'o tamar nara iisi na, kabèdhi laa ana èci pacèu uuru kacui-aai èci sa li'u mai. ka dhèu ai tadha dhu panara iisi na nare loa hèngu mea, ka èki mi kanau riti na. bhèni na peka, aku nèngu na, ana uuru ka ne'e.

source_text: but when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, you have broken out first! so he was named perez.
target_text: te ngaa ana èèna ère hari kacui-aai na sa d'ara. hèia, ana èci na kalua uuru hari. nèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, bhèni ai tadha èèna peka, aku nèngu na, waa! èu èra titu kèna! nèti èèna ka, èu paseti ho kalua uuru sa li'u. bhèni na pangare ne, peres, dhu sasoa na, ‘paseti sa li'u'.

source_text: then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named zerah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhu èki dènge loa hèngu mea deo na kalua. ra pangare ne sera sasoa na ‘mea gèu-gèu'.

source_text: meanwhile, joseph had been taken down to egypt, where an egyptian named potiphar, an officer of pharaoh and captain of the guard, bought him from the ishmaelites who had taken him there. and the lord was with joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his egyptian master.
target_text: dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf d'ai masir, hèia ra pahie eele ne dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa sordad'u dhu j'aga ètu dhèu aae masir. yusuf j'aj'i ènu ètu èmu potifar. ètu èèna, lamatua dènge yusuf, ka sasab'a ngaa dhu na tao, nèti babe'a hua-hua.

source_text: when his master saw that the lord was with him and made him prosper in all he did,
target_text: dhèu kapai ne'e ladhe-ladhe na, sasab'a yusuf nèti babe'a hua, ka na ngee ètu d'ara na, lamatua tare'a-re'a dènge yusuf.
