source_text: joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant. potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted him with everything he owned.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, komedhaa ne'e d'èi yusuf, ka na lèka ne. hèia na ded'e ne j'aj'i madho ètu èmu na. aa, na hia ne paredha d'ara èmu nèngu, sèmi èèna kahèi, mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: from the time that he put joseph in charge of his household and all he owned, the lord blessed the egyptian's household on account of him. the lord's blessing was on everything he owned, both in his house and in his field.
target_text: lula yusuf pea ètu èèna, ka lamatua hia mamuri hua iia mi lamatua èmu, dhèu masir èèna. isi èmu na, mèdha-panyau na, oka-tedhe na, aa sasab'a-la'a na, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: so potiphar left all that he owned in joseph's care; he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. now joseph was well-built and handsome,
target_text: lula potifar ladhe-ladhe la'a na yusuf sab'a dènge be'a, ka na pangee heka ngaa-ngaa, dhoka na'a-ninu di. yusuf ne, mone iia.

source_text: and after some time his master's wife cast her eyes upon joseph and said, sleep with me.
target_text: na pea ètu èèna nèbhu mèka. te ngaa dhèu èmu potifar na, d'èi yusuf. ka na mai pamako ne ho dua ra j'unu pa'èci.

source_text: but he refused. look, he said to his master's wife, with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in his house, and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf no'o boe. ka na peka sèmi ne'e ka, baku ina ee! ja'a ne, ènu potifar, dhu na pangèd'u le koasa ho ja'a tao ai-hèb'a mi sasab'a nèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: no one in this house is greater than i am. he has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. so how could i do such a great evil and sin against god?
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu koasa risi nèti ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, na saraka mi kacui-aai ja'a. dhodhoka ina ku di, aad'o. tasamia ka, ja'a bisa tao j'ara karehe ne'e. èèna lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: although potiphar's wife spoke to joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu èmu potifar ne pakaseti taruu bèli-bèli. te ngaa yusuf ne tao boe madha-dhilu dènge ne.

source_text: one day, however, joseph went into the house to attend to his work, and not a single household servant was inside.
target_text: ca tèka, yusuf kako la'e asa d'ara èmu, ho sab'a sasab'a nèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu leo aad'o èci sa ètu èmu.

source_text: she grabbed joseph by his cloak and said, sleep with me! but leaving his cloak in her hand, he escaped and ran outside.
target_text: ka dhèu èmu potifar na raga mai ka, na kèpe kodho yusuf, ka na ère ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, mai! ata dhodhoka èdhi dua ti. de mai ho ti j'unu. te ngaa yusuf d'èi boe. ka na parui, hèia kodho na bhoke eele nèti ua na, ka na rai asa li'u. aa kodho deo na ètu kacui-aai bhèni èèna era.

source_text: when she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu potifar ladhe laa, na, yusuf rai li'u le la'e, aa kodho na tèke eele,

source_text: she called her household servants. look, she said, this hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us. he came to me so he could sleep with me, but i screamed as loud as i could. when he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.
target_text: hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a sèra, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, we! miu mai ladhe ku laa! deo na, ana mone dhèu ibrani na, maso sa d'ara kama ja'a. na neo pamakae ja'a. malo ka ja'a pa'oo, ka na rai, tèke eele kodho na ètu ja'a ne. dhèu èmu ja'a ne, nèti dhèu bhelu asa d'ara èmu, ho hia èdhi ta'e makae!

source_text: so potiphar's wife kept joseph's cloak beside her until his master came home.
target_text: bhèni na kèpe pa'ère kodho èèna, toke d'ai dhèu èmu na lèpa.

source_text: then she told him the same story: the hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me,
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu na nare d'ara èmu, na lolo peka na, a'a! dhèu ibrani dhu mèti mai sa èmu ne'e, deo na maso asa d'ara kama ja'a, neo pakarehe ja'a!

source_text: but when i screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.
target_text: malo ka ja'a pa'oo, paroa ana sab'a se'e. hèia na rai tèke eele kodho na, ka ne'e.

source_text: when his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, this is what your slave did to me, he burned with anger.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu èmu na, potifar nasa bia.

source_text: so joseph's master took him and had him thrown into the prison where the king's prisoners were confined. while joseph was there in the prison,
target_text: hèia na paredha ka dhèu lasi kèpe yusuf. ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho dhèu aae.

source_text: the lord was with him and extended kindness to him, granting him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua bhèlu boe yusuf. nèti èèna ka, lamatua ladhe-leru ne taruu, ka kapala ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, sue yusuf ae titu kèna.

source_text: and the warden put all the prisoners under joseph's care, so that he was responsible for all that was done in the prison.
target_text: na lèka yusuf, ka hia ne j'aj'i madho ho laladhe ana bèdho sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. aa, hia na lalau sasab'a ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the warden did not concern himself with anything under joseph's care, because the lord was with joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.
target_text: lula lèka ne, ka kapala èmu bèdho na, tao heka ai-hèb'a mi ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho èèna. lamatua ladhe-leru taruu yusuf, nèti èèna ka, sasab'a ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho na kako dènge be'a.

source_text: some time later, the king's cupbearer and baker offended their master, the king of egypt. pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker, and imprisoned them in the house of the captain of the guard, the same prison where joseph was confined.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu dua, dhu uru na j'aj'i kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae masir. èci lalau dhua èi dhèu aae. aa èci hari lalau roti dhèu aae. dua ra tao pasala dhèu aae. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aae nasa, ka na pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. dua ra pea ètu era èci dènge yusuf.

source_text: the captain of the guard assigned them to joseph, and he became their personal attendant. after they had been in custody for some time,
target_text: kapala èmu bèdho na, paredha yusuf lalau dhèu dua se'e. ra ètu d'ara bèdho na, ele boe ca tèu do dua tèu le.

source_text: both of these men-the egyptian king's cupbearer and baker, who were being held in the prison-had a dream on the same night, and each dream had its own meaning.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, dua ra nii. ca dhèu ka dènge nii na. aa, lii nii dua sèra, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: when joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were distraught.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yusuf ladhe na dua ra rèhu susa.

source_text: so he asked the officials of pharaoh who were in custody with him in his master's house, why are your faces so downcast today?
target_text: ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka mad'ae ne'e, miu dua mi roe-roe?

source_text: we both had dreams, they replied, but there is no one to interpret them. then joseph said to them, don't interpretations belong to god? tell me your dreams.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mèda deo na, ji'i nii. te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe sasoa na samia! hèia yusuf peka dènge dua ra, aku nèngu na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, èci sa re'a boe sasoa nii, dhodhoka ama lamatua di. de miu lolo ku laa. pe èèna ho ja'a karèi sasoa nèti lamatua.

source_text: so the chief cupbearer told joseph his dream: in my dream there was a vine before me,
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae èèna, lolo uuru peka na, ètu d'ara nii, ja'a ladhe kèdhi aj'u anggor ca kapua.

source_text: and on the vine were three branches. as it budded, its blossoms opened and its clusters ripened into grapes.
target_text: aj'u anggor ne dadana nèngu tèlu di. aj'u na muri mai ka dènge rèu, hela, dènge hua giru-gari dhu madhasa.

source_text: pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and i took the grapes, squeezed them into his cup, and placed the cup in his hand.
target_text: aa ja'a kèd'u galaa dhu dhèu aae biasa pake ninu. ja'a puu hua anggor, ka pacèli èi sa d'ara galaa deo na. hèia kèti asa dhèu aae, hia na ninu.

source_text: joseph replied, this is the interpretation: the three branches are three days.
target_text: tadèngi nare hèia, yusuf peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e ka, ama, ee. sasoa nii na sèmi ne'e ka: dadana tèlu, sasoa na di tèlu lod'o ka.

source_text: within three days pharaoh will lift up your head and restore your position. you will put pharaoh's cup in his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, dhèu aae kalua eele ama nèti d'ara bèdho ne'e. ho na hia hari, ama lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae sèmi uru na.

source_text: but when it goes well for you, please remember me and show me kindness by mentioning me to pharaoh, that he might bring me out of this prison.
target_text: ladhe ama abhu babe'a sèmi èèna, baku bhèlu ja'a, ee? ladhe ama sue ja'a, peka dènge dhèu aae kalua eele ja'a nèti era ne'e.

source_text: for i was kidnapped from the land of the hebrews, and even here i have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: when the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to joseph, i too had a dream: there were three baskets of white bread on my head.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: in the top basket were all sorts of baked goods for pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: joseph replied, this is the interpretation: the three baskets are three days.
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: within three days pharaoh will lift off your head and hang you on a tree. then the birds will eat the flesh of your body.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: on the third day, which was pharaoh's birthday, he held a feast for all his officials, and in their presence he lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: pharaoh restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again placed the cup in pharaoh's hand.
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: but pharaoh hanged the chief baker, just as joseph had described to them in his interpretation.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: the chief cupbearer, however, did not remember joseph; he forgot all about him.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: after two full years had passed, pharaoh had a dream: he was standing beside the nile,
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: when seven cows, sleek and well-fed, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: after them, seven other cows, sickly and thin, came up from the nile and stood beside the well-fed cows on the bank of the river.
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: and the cows that were sickly and thin devoured the seven sleek, well-fed cows. then pharaoh woke up,
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: but he fell back asleep and dreamed a second time: seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, came up on one stalk.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: after them, seven other heads of grain sprouted, thin and scorched by the east wind.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: and the thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven plump, ripe ones. then pharaoh awoke and realized it was a dream.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: in the morning his spirit was troubled, so he summoned all the magicians and wise men of egypt. pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: then the chief cupbearer said to pharaoh, today i recall my failures.
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he put me and the chief baker in the custody of the captain of the guard.
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: one night both the chief baker and i had dreams, and each dream had its own meaning.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: now a young hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. we told him our dreams and he interpreted them for us individually.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: and it happened to us just as he had interpreted: i was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.

source_text: so pharaoh sent for joseph, who was quickly brought out of the dungeon. after he had shaved and changed his clothes, he went in before pharaoh.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: pharaoh said to joseph, i had a dream, and no one can interpret it. but i have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: i myself cannot do it, joseph replied, but god will give pharaoh a sound answer.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: then pharaoh said to joseph: in my dream i was standing on the bank of the nile,
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: when seven cows, well-fed and sleek, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: after them, seven other cows-sickly, ugly, and thin-came up. i have never seen such ugly cows in all the land of egypt!
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: then the thin, ugly cows devoured the seven well-fed cows that were there first.
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: when they had devoured them, however, no one could tell that they had done so; their appearance was as ugly as it had been before. then i awoke.
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: in my dream i also saw seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, growing on a single stalk.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: after them, seven other heads of grain sprouted-withered, thin, and scorched by the east wind.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: and the thin heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones. i told this dream to the magicians, but no one could explain it to me.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: at this, joseph said to pharaoh, the dreams of pharaoh are one and the same. god has revealed to pharaoh what he is about to do.
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: the seven good cows are seven years, and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years. the dreams have the same meaning.
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: moreover, the seven thin, ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind-they are seven years of famine.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: it is just as i said to pharaoh: god has shown pharaoh what he is about to do.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: behold, seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of egypt,
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: but seven years of famine will follow them. then all the abundance in the land of egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will devastate the land. the abundance in the land will not be remembered, since the famine that follows it will be so severe.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: moreover, because the dream was given to pharaoh in two versions, the matter has been decreed by god, and he will carry it out shortly.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: now, therefore, pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of egypt.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: let pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of egypt during the seven years of abundance.
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: under the authority of pharaoh, let them collect all the excess food from these good years, that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities.
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: this food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of egypt. then the country will not perish in the famine.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: this proposal pleased pharaoh and all his officials.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: so pharaoh asked them, can we find anyone like this man, in whom the spirit of god abides?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: then pharaoh said to joseph, since god has made all this known to you, there is no one as discerning and wise as you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: you shall be in charge of my house, and all my people are to obey your commands. only with regard to the throne will i be greater than you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: pharaoh also told joseph, i hereby place you over all the land of egypt. then pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on joseph's finger, clothed him in garments of fine linen, and placed a gold chain around his neck.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: he had joseph ride in his second chariot, with men calling out before him, bow the knee! so he placed him over all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: and pharaoh declared to joseph, i am pharaoh, but without your permission, no one in all the land of egypt shall lift his hand or foot.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: pharaoh gave joseph the name zaphenath-paneah, and he gave him asenath daughter of potiphera, priest of on, to be his wife. and joseph took charge of all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: now joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of pharaoh king of egypt. and joseph left pharaoh's presence and traveled throughout the land of egypt.
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: during the seven years of abundance, the land brought forth bountifully.
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: during those seven years, joseph collected all the excess food in the land of egypt and stored it in the cities. in every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: so joseph stored up grain in such abundance, like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: before the years of famine arrived, two sons were born to joseph by asenath daughter of potiphera, priest of on.
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: joseph named the firstborn manasseh, saying, god has made me forget all my hardship and all my father's household.
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: and the second son he named ephraim, saying, god has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: when the seven years of abundance in the land of egypt came to an end,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: the seven years of famine began, just as joseph had said. and although there was famine in every country, there was food throughout the land of egypt.
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: when extreme hunger came to all the land of egypt and the people cried out to pharaoh for food, he told all the egyptians, go to joseph and do whatever he tells you.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: when the famine had spread over all the land, joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the egyptians; for the famine was severe in the land of egypt.
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: and every nation came to joseph in egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: when jacob learned that there was grain in egypt, he said to his sons, why are you staring at one another?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: look, he added, i have heard that there is grain in egypt. go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: so ten of joseph's brothers went down to buy grain from egypt.
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: but jacob did not send joseph's brother benjamin with his brothers, for he said, i am afraid that harm might befall him.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: so the sons of israel were among those who came to buy grain, since the famine had also spread to the land of canaan.
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: now joseph was the ruler of the land; he was the one who sold grain to all its people. so when his brothers arrived, they bowed down before him with their faces to the ground.
target_text: tèu èèna, yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, yusuf ka dhu pahia. nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.

source_text: and when joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he treated them as strangers and spoke harshly to them. where have you come from? he asked. from the land of canaan, they replied. we are here to buy food. although joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
target_text: ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. te ngaa yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu masir. nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, ee! miu se nèti mia? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i se nèti kana'an. ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.

source_text: joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, you are spies! you have come to see if our land is vulnerable.
target_text: hèia yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, ja'a lèka boe! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. miu mai tenge rahasia rai masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!

source_text: not so, my lord, they replied. your servants have come to buy food.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, aad'o, ama! ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. leo nèti èèna, aad'o.

source_text: we are all sons of one man. your servants are honest men, not spies.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: no, he told them. you have come to see if our land is vulnerable.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf jèka si dènge lii mèdhu hari, peka na, he! omo koso! baku kapod'e-kabèli ja'a. miu se'e tare'a-re'a dhèu bhelu. miu mai tenge rahasia rai ne'e!

source_text: but they answered, your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of canaan. the youngest is now with our father, and one is no more.
target_text: ka ra peka, aad'o ama! ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. ji'i mai nèti rai kana'an. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: then joseph declared, just as i said, you are spies!
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.

source_text: and this is how you will be tested: as surely as pharaoh lives, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
target_text: na! karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. ja'a subha ee! ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!

source_text: send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be confined so that the truth of your words may be tested. if they are untrue, then as surely as pharaoh lives, you are spies!
target_text: de hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

source_text: so joseph imprisoned them for three days,
target_text: ka yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and on the third day he said to them, i fear god. so do this and you will live:
target_text: d'ai lod'o ka tèlu, yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge lamatua. aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi na taruu. sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.

source_text: if you are honest, leave one of your brothers in custody while the rest of you go and take back grain to relieve the hunger of your households.
target_text: ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. j'ara na sèmi ne'e: ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.

source_text: then bring your youngest brother to me so that your words can be verified, that you may not die. and to this they consented.
target_text: d'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: then they said to one another, surely we are being punished because of our brother. we saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen. that is why this distress has come upon us.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, waa! ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and reuben responded, didn't i tell you not to sin against the boy? but you would not listen. now we must account for his blood!
target_text: hèia ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, we! ari-ari ja'a, ee! uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi yusuf èèna.

source_text: they did not realize that joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.
target_text: rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. lod'o yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii ibrani.

source_text: and he turned away from them and wept. when he turned back and spoke to them, he took simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes.
target_text: tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. ka na pua dhèu èki simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: then joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return each man's silver to his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. this order was carried out,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu yusuf paredha.

source_text: and they loaded the grain on their donkeys and departed.
target_text: èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: at the place where they lodged for the night, one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of the sack.
target_text: ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

source_text: my silver has been returned! he said to his brothers. it is here in my sack. their hearts sank, and trembling, they turned to one another and said, what is this that god has done to us?
target_text: capa na cag'ag'a! hèia na paroa a'a na si, peka na, irii! miu mai ladhe ku laa! madhe èdhi kèna. ra tao hari doi ja'a asa d'ara karo ne. ladhe rèdhi èèna ka, ra ele ngangee, aa madha'u bia. ka ra papeka ka, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua tao èdhi samia ka ne?

source_text: when they reached their father jacob in the land of canaan, they described to him all that had happened to them:
target_text: hèia ra kako taruu ka, lasi d'ai kana'an. d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, ngaa dhu rèngu paraga ètu rai masir.

source_text: the man who is lord of the land spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying on the country.
target_text: ra lolo, peka na, ama, ee! ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, bhelu titu kèna. na jèka taruu ji'i. na peka na ji'i la'a j'aj'i mata-mata ho neo pa'ele iie rai masir.

source_text: but we told him, ‘we are honest men, not spies.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa, peka na, ‘aad'o! ji'i se'e padhai lii mola-mola. ji'i mata-mata boe.

source_text: we are twelve brothers, sons of one father. one is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of canaan. '
target_text: ji'i se'e, dhèu be'a-be'a. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi, j'aj'i nèti ca ama, dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa èci madhe le. aa ari dhu limuri èèna, dènge ama ji'i ètu kana'an. '

source_text: then the man who is lord of the land said to us, ‘this is how i will know whether you are honest: leave one brother with me, take food to relieve the hunger of your households, and go.
target_text: na peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo kèdhi, na, miu se'e dhèu be'a, do aad'o! miu èci, pea mi ne'e. aa leo lèpa mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, sèna ka ra baku madhe manganga.

source_text: but bring your youngest brother back to me so i will know that you are not spies but honest men. then i will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land. '
target_text: hud'i miu mèti ku ari miu èèna mai sa ne'e, heka ja'a ke'a kèna, tare'a-re'a miu se'e dhèu be'a, mata-mata boe. èèna na, heka ja'a patabuli dhèu miu dhu ja'a taha ne. aa dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a heka ko'o kèna, miu kako palème dedha rai ne'e. '

source_text: as they began emptying their sacks, there in each man's sack was his bag of silver! and when they and their father saw the bags of silver, they were dismayed.
target_text: lolo èle hèia, heka ra bhoke karo-karo rèngu dhu pènu dènge are sèra. te ngaa ra cag'ag'a ladhe la'a na doi rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu hèb'a karo. rèdhi sèmi èèna, yakob dènge ana-ana na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: their father jacob said to them, you have deprived me of my sons. joseph is gone and simeon is no more. now you want to take benjamin. everything is going against me!
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge si, peka na, miu se, pa'ele le ana-ana ja'a. yusuf aad'o heka. sèmi èèna kahèi, simeon. ne'e miu neo mèti hari benyamin kèna? miu se'e, tare'a-re'a neo paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: then reuben said to his father, you may kill my two sons if i fail to bring him back to you. put him in my care, and i will return him.
target_text: hèia ruben peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! pangèd'u laa benyamin asa ja'a mai. ja'a tago kore. ja'a jaji kèna mi ama ku, èèna ja'a kèti hari na mai. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na ja'a hia ana ja'a, mone dhèu dua sèra ho ama pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: but jacob replied, my son will not go down there with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. if any harm comes to him on your journey, you will bring my gray hair down to sheol in sorrow.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhaa hari, peka na, bisa boe! miu bisa boe mèti benyamin. te a'a na yusuf, madhe le. ne'e, di nèngu ka mesa na. ladhe na abhu calaka ètu j'ara, miu tabha babia mi ja'a, toke madhe kèti.

source_text: now the famine was still severe in the land.
target_text: tèu èèna, ètu rai kana'an asa tabha manganga.

source_text: so when jacob's sons had eaten all the grain they had brought from egypt, their father said to them, go back and buy us a little more food.
target_text: isi èmu yakob ra'a aa'i le nganga'a dhu ca hari na, ana na si lasi hèli ètu masir. ka na padhai lii dènge ana na si, be'a risi lami hari hèli nganga'a asa rai masir.

source_text: but judah replied, the man solemnly warned us, ‘you will not see my face again unless your brother is with you. '
target_text: te ngaa yahuda b'ala, peka na, ama, ca hari na ai g'ana dhèu aae masir dhu pasanèd'e le ji'i, aku nèngu na, ji'i bisa boe pad'elo rèhu mi nèngu, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri, benyamin èèna.

source_text: if you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku hud'i laa hia ji'i ngèti benyamin. heka ji'i bisa la'a hèli nganga'a hia ama ku kèna.

source_text: but if you will not send him, we will not go; for the man told us, ‘you will not see my face again unless your brother is with you. '
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama patabuli boe nèngu, ji'i oo la'a boe kahèi. lula dhèu masir na peka le sèmi èèna.

source_text: why did you bring this trouble upon me? israel asked. why did you tell the man you had another brother?
target_text: hèia yakob jèke si, peka na, nga tao ka miu lolo dènge dhèu èèna, peka na, miu dènge ari èci era? miu tenge j'ara ho paj'èra tabha ja'a!

source_text: they replied, the man questioned us in detail about ourselves and our family: ‘is your father still alive? do you have another brother? ' and we answered him accordingly. how could we possibly know that he would say, ‘bring your brother here'?
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, baku nasa ama, ee! te lula dhèu ne, karèi taruu-taruu neo ne'a a'ari èdhi. na karèi peka na, ‘tasamia? ama mi era, do? miu dènge hari ari dhèu mone dhu leo, do? ' sèmi èèna na, ji'i dhaa tasamia hari? pakaseti ka ji'i dhaa ka laa, dènge mola-mola. te pe, cee ne'a na pua ji'i ngèti hari ari ji'i sa nèi?

source_text: and judah said to his father israel, send the boy with me, and we will go at once, so that we may live and not die-neither we, nor you, nor our children. i will guarantee his safety. you may hold me personally responsible. if i do not bring him back and set him before you, then may i bear the guilt before you all my life.
target_text: ka yahuda padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama hud'i patabuli ku benyamin la'e dènge ji'i. ja'a jaji mema, ladhe j'aj'i ngaa-ngaa mi ngi'u ari ji'i ne'e, ja'a ka dhu gati ne. ladhe ja'a kèti heka nèngu mai asa d'ara kacui-aai ama ku dènge mamuri, hud'i laa sasala na ama ku pasae mi dedha ja'a toke madhe. nèti èèna ka, ama ku hia la, ho ji'i sama-sama la'a dènge ne, te ji'i neo pakèd'i kèna. de karohe mai lati ka, sèna ka cahag'e baku madhe manganga.

source_text: if we had not delayed, we could have come and gone twice by now.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èdhi mate boe panèbhu sèmi ne'e, na, èdhi lati-mai dua hari le.

source_text: then their father israel said to them, if it must be so, then do this: put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man-a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.
target_text: hèia ama ra padhai lii, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, miu nanene! lami mere isi rai èdhi dhu be'a risi, sèmi: dhua nasu oni, bubhu-bubhu, raa aj'u hèu mèngi, èi na'i salap, kanari dènge kab'ui dhu leo sèra. ho sèna ka mèti hia ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna. aa peka dènge ne, ne'e ne tadha mata.

source_text: take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. perhaps it was a mistake.
target_text: aa miu mèti doi risi eele nèti ca hari ni, sèna ka miu bisa hia hari doi kab'ua are uru sèra la'a, dhu miu mèdhi ètu d'ara karo miu sèra. tao-tao dhèu sèra re'a boe, ka tèka sala.

source_text: take your brother as well, and return to the man at once.
target_text: miu mèti ari mu. de èèna na lèpa hari lai-lai!

source_text: may god almighty grant you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother along with benjamin. as for me, if i am bereaved, i am bereaved.
target_text: ja'a sanao-maena, sèna ka, ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi eele èèna, sab'a mi d'ara ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, sèna ka na sue miu. aa na hia hari benyamin dènge simeon lèpa palere dènge miu. te, ladhe ana ja'a se ele, hud'i laa ja'a pasae j'aj'èra ne'e taruu.

source_text: so the men took these gifts, along with double the amount of silver, and benjamin as well. then they hurried down to egypt and stood before joseph.
target_text: hèia lasi pakaboko tadha mata sèra dènge doi, ka lasi asa masir. rèti kahèi dènge benyamin. d'ai nèi ka lasi paraga dènge yusuf.

source_text: when joseph saw benjamin with his brothers, he said to the steward of his house, take these men to my house. slaughter an animal and prepare it, for they shall dine with me at noon.
target_text: ropa yusuf nèdhi benyamin dènge a'a na si, na pua kapala urusan na, aku nèngu na, lere mèti dhèu se'e sa èmu ja'a! ho èèna na, pare sapi ci'u, mi pananasu nganga'a dhu be'a. sèna ka lod'o nètu none, ra'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: the man did as joseph had commanded and took the brothers to joseph's house.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna, tao sama sèmi lii paredha yusuf èèna. na lere nèti dhèu sèra asa èmu yusuf.

source_text: but the brothers were frightened that they had been taken to joseph's house. we have been brought here because of the silver that was returned in our bags the first time, they said. they intend to overpower us and take us as slaves, along with our donkeys.
target_text: ropa ra kako lasi èmu èèna, a'a na sèra madha'u bia. ètu talora j'ara, ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! nga tao ka na pua rèti èdhi sa ne'e? mage dhoka na neo pasusa èdhi. lula doi dhu ra tao hari asa d'ara karo èdhi ca hari na. ra sangaja rèti èdhi sa ne'e, sèna ka ra kèpa èdhi j'aj'i ènu nèngu. ho èèna na, ra parama rara keled'ei èdhi sèra.

source_text: so they approached joseph's steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa ra dètu èmu yusuf na, ra padhai lii dènge kapala urusan èèna, peka na,

source_text: please, sir, they said, we really did come down here the first time to buy food.
target_text: ama! baku nasa dènge ji'i, te ca hari na dhu ji'i mai hèli nganga'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: but when we came to the place we lodged for the night, we opened our sacks and, behold, each of us found his silver in the mouth of his sack! it was the full amount of our silver, and we have brought it back with us. we have brought additional silver with us to buy food. we do not know who put our silver in our sacks.
target_text: ropa ji'i lèpa d'ai talora j'ara, ji'i ae ngara iisi, ho bhèj'i ciki. hèia ji'i bhoke karo ho neo panga'a badha. ladhe la'a na, doi bab'ae ji'i èci-èci ka ètu d'ara karo sèra. ji'i nge'a boe cee ka dhu tao la'a! nèti èèna ka, ji'i ngèti hari doi sèra ka se'e. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama ku baku nasa. aa ji'i ngèti doi ka risi kahèi, neo hèli hari nganga'a.

source_text: it is fine, said the steward. do not be afraid. your god, the god of your father, gave you the treasure that was in your sacks. i received your silver. then he brought simeon out to them.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna dhaa, aku nèngu na, mau-mau, baku madha'u! ele boe lamatua miu èèna ka dhu hia miu berkat ètu d'ara karo sèra. ca hari na, ja'a sèmi le doi miu aa'i-aa'i. miu pakèlu boe! d'ai èmu ka, na patalale simeon pa'èci dènge rèngu.

source_text: and the steward took the men into joseph's house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa d'ara èmu yusuf. hèia kapala urusan èèna hia èi ho ra rase haga ra. aa na ani keled'ei si hèi.

source_text: since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there, they prepared their gift for joseph's arrival at noon.
target_text: ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ladhe èèna na, lod'o nètu miu mi'a dènge ai g'ana dhèu aae. d'ara ra tatae yusuf lèpa, rèngu lalau paie tadha mata ra sèra.

source_text: when joseph came home, they presented him with the gifts they had brought, and they bowed to the ground before him.
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai èmu, aa'i-aa'i ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. ka ra j'ole tadha mata sa hia ne.

source_text: he asked if they were well, and then he asked, how is your elderly father you told me about? is he still alive?
target_text: hèia yusuf karèi si, peka na, tasamia? miu be'a-be'a, do? tasamia dènge ama miu dhu heka èèna? na be'a-be'a, do?

source_text: your servant our father is well, they answered. he is still alive. and they bowed down to honor him.
target_text: ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ènu ama dhu heka na, dhu ama matana ji'i, be'a-be'a. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi hari mi yusuf.

source_text: when joseph looked up and saw his brother benjamin, his own mother's son, he asked, is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about? then he declared, may god be gracious to you, my son.

source_text: then he washed his face and came back out. regaining his composure, he said, serve the meal.
target_text: tangi nare hèia, la'e riu katanga madha na. èle èèna ka, na pa'èra d'ara na, ka la'e hari paraga dènge si. hèia na pua dhèu sab'a sèra lasi lalau nganga'a.

source_text: they separately served joseph, his brothers, and the egyptians. they ate separately because the egyptians would not eat with the hebrews, since that was detestable to them.
target_text: ra lalau nganga'a hia yusuf mei leo. aa a'ari na sèra ra'a mei leo. dhèu sab'a dhèu masir sèra, ra'a ètu mei rèngu mesa ra. lula dhèu masir sèra madenge ladhe madhèdi ra'a pa'èci dènge dhèu ibrani.

source_text: they were seated before joseph in order by age, from the firstborn to the youngest, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.

source_text: when the portions were served to them from joseph's table, benjamin's portion was five times larger than any of the others. so they feasted and drank freely with joseph.
target_text: yusuf pua dhèu sab'a sèra, bagi nganga'a nèti mei nèngu, hia a'ari na sèra. aa'i-aa'i ra abhu nganga'a dhu ae sama. dhoka benyamin di abhu ae risi a'a na si lèmi hari. ka ra'a-rinu d'ai bècu.

source_text: then joseph instructed his steward: fill the men's sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each one's silver in the mouth of his sack.

source_text: put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one's sack, along with the silver for his grain. so the steward did as joseph had instructed.
target_text: aa more moo hualaa pudhi ja'a èèna, ho tao asa d'ara hèb'a karo ari ra dhu limuri èèna. ka na la'e tao madhutu lii paredha yusuf.

source_text: at daybreak, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara cika lii sa, yusuf hia si lèpa. rèti nganga'a dènge keled'ei rèngu.

source_text: they had not gone far from the city when joseph told his steward, pursue the men at once, and when you overtake them, ask, ‘why have you repaid good with evil?
target_text: ra lasi dhae kaj'èu mèka nèti d'ara kota, ka yusuf paredha kapala urusan, peka na, èu karohe lamu magèla si. ladhe paraga dènge si, èu peka sèmi ne'e: ‘nga tao ka miu pake d'ara aapa sèmi èèna mi ai g'ana dhèu aae? miu b'ala babe'a na dènge tatao karehe sèmi ne'e!

source_text: is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination? what you have done is wicked! '
target_text: nga tao ka, miu mana'u mèti moo hualaa pudhi na? miu me'a boe, do? mèdha èèna na, na pake boe ho dhoka ninu di! te ngaa biasa na pake ho ne'a tasamia dènge mamuri dhèu. èèna, mèdha sogo-tagu! tatao miu ne, mema seli-kolane! '

source_text: when the steward overtook them, he relayed these words to them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kapala urusan èèna la'e magèle si toke abhu. ropa na raga si, hèia na peka sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf moa èèna.

source_text: why does my lord say these things? they asked. your servants could not possibly do such a thing.
target_text: ka ra bari ne, aku rèngu na, ama peka ngaa èèna? ji'i subha. ji'i se'e bisa boe tao karehe sèmi èèna!

source_text: we even brought back to you from the land of canaan the silver we found in the mouths of our sacks. why would we steal silver or gold from your master's house?
target_text: ama, èu me'a era, si ma? doi-doi ca hari sa, dhu ètu d'ara karo ji'i sèra, ji'i hia hari le sa ama, to? tasamia ka ji'i bisa mana'u hualaa iia do hualaa pudhi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kapai èèna! bisa boe!

source_text: if any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.
target_text: ama parisa la! ladhe abhu mèdha èèna ètu d'ara karo cee, na huku pamadhe ne! aa hud'i laa, ji'i dhu leo se'e, j'aj'i ènu èu.

source_text: as you say, replied the steward. but only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave, and the rest of you shall be free of blame.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan na dhaa, peka na, aad'o! sèmi ne'e. ladhe abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na dhoka nèngu di j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo lèpa.

source_text: so each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
target_text: ra papuru ka karo sèra. ka ra bhoke dènge.

source_text: the steward searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest-and the cup was found in benjamin's sack.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna parisa karo sèra èci-èci, mulai nèti karo unu a'a na, toke d'ai ari limuri tèka. ka nèdhi moo èèna, ètu d'ara karo benyamin.

source_text: then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, d'ara a'a na sèra j'èra ma'ète mae-mae sène. hèia ra paca'e hari ka karo deo sa asa dedha keled'ei, ka ra lèpa hari asa d'ara kota.

source_text: when judah and his brothers arrived at joseph's house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai èmu yusuf, na ètu èmu era. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na.

source_text: what is this deed you have done? joseph declared. do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth?
target_text: yusuf jèka si, aku nèngu na, he! nga tao ka miu tao ne'e mi ja'a! miu me'a boe, ja'a ne dhèu kapai ètu ne'e. ja'a pake na'i dhu bisa ke'a tatao dhèu, dhu dhèu leo re'a boe!

source_text: what can we say to my lord? judah replied. how can we plead? how can we justify ourselves? god has exposed the iniquity of your servants. we are now my lord's slaves-both we and the one who was found with the cup.
target_text: hèia yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, irii! te ama lamatua pasabhoka kèna sasala èdhi. pe ji'i peka lii mia hari, ama? ji'i sili iisi sa mia hari? ladhe ama neo taha ari ji'i ne'e, na be'a risi, taha ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. more ji'i aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ènu ama ka laa.

source_text: but joseph replied, far be it from me to do this. the man who was found with the cup will be my slave. the rest of you may return to your father in peace.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na nèngu di dhu j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo, lèpa hari dènge mera-milu sa ama miu!

source_text: then judah approached joseph and said, sir, please let your servant speak personally to my lord. do not be angry with your servant, for you are equal to pharaoh himself.
target_text: hèia yahuda la'e padètu asa madha yusuf, ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama wakil! ja'a ke'a koasa ama sama sèmi koasa dhèu aae! uru nèti èèna, ja'a manèngi ama baku nasa dènge ja'a. ja'a neo padhai lii ciki dènge ama.

source_text: my lord asked his servants, ‘do you have a father or a brother? '
target_text: med'a na, ama karèi le ji'i, peka na, ‘ama miu, dènge ari miu dhu èci na, era do? '

source_text: and we answered, ‘we have an elderly father and a younger brother, the child of his old age. the boy's brother is dead. he is the only one of his mother's sons left, and his father loves him. '
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa peka na, ‘ama ji'i heka d'ai seli le. aa ari ji'i dhu limuri èci. lod'o nara iisi ari ji'i ne'e, ama ji'i na heka le. ari ji'i dhu limuri ne'e dènge a'a d'èlu na èci, te ngaa na aad'o heka. ina ra madhe le. ka di nèngu ka mesa na. nèti èèna ka, ama ji'i ne sue ne titu kèna! '

source_text: then you told your servants, ‘bring him down to me so that i can see him for myself. '
target_text: ka ama pua ho ji'i ngèti ari ji'i na mai, sèna ka ama nèdhi ne.

source_text: so we said to my lord, ‘the boy cannot leave his father. if he were to leave, his father would die. '
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa na, ‘ana èèna, bisa boe tèke eele ama na mesa na. ladhe na tèke eele, na ama ji'i na tatu madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: but you said to your servants, ‘unless your younger brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again. '
target_text: hèia ama dhaa na, ‘ladhe miu mèti boe ari miu na, baku mi pad'elo hari rèhu mi sa ne'e. '

source_text: now when we returned to your servant my father, we relayed your words to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ji'i lèpa. d'ai nèi ka, ji'i lolo lii dhu mu moa sèra dènge ama ji'i.

source_text: then our father said, ‘go back and buy us some food. '
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, nganga'a ji'i èla. hèia ama ji'i pua hari ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa masir ne'e.

source_text: but we answered, ‘we cannot go down there unless our younger brother goes with us. so if our younger brother is not with us, we cannot see the man. '
target_text: te ngaa ji'i dhaa na, ‘ama, ee! ji'i la'a heka sa nèi. te ai g'ana dhèu aae na dhu moa le, aku nèngu na, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri na, bisa heka ji'i pad'elo rèhu sa nèi. de ladhe ari ji'i la'e hèi, na heka ji'i la'a kèna. '

source_text: and your servant my father said to us, ‘you know that my wife bore me two sons.
target_text: ama ji'i peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘miu me'a kahèi, si ma? dhèu èmu ja'a rahel èèna, ana na dhoka dua di.

source_text: when one of them was gone, i said: surely he has been torn to pieces. and i have not seen him since.
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to sheol in sorrow. '
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: so if the boy is not with us when i return to your servant, and if my father, whose life is wrapped up in the boy's life, sees that the boy is not with us, he will die. then your servants will have brought the gray hair of your servant our father down to sheol in sorrow.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: indeed, your servant guaranteed the boy's safety to my father, saying, ‘if i do not return him to you, i will bear the guilt before you, my father, all my life. '
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: now please let your servant stay here as my lord's slave in place of the boy. let him return with his brothers.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for how can i go back to my father without the boy? i could not bear to see the misery that would overwhelm him.
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: then joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, send everyone away from me! so none of them were with joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: but he wept so loudly that the egyptians heard him, and pharaoh's household soon heard of it.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: joseph said to his brothers, i am joseph! is my father still alive? but they were unable to answer him, because they were terrified in his presence.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: then joseph said to his brothers, please come near me. and they did so. i am joseph, your brother, he said, the one you sold into egypt!
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: and now, do not be distressed or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place, because it was to save lives that god sent me before you.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for the famine has covered the land these two years, and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting.
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: god sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: therefore it was not you who sent me here, but god, who has made me a father to pharaoh-lord of all his household and ruler over all the land of egypt.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: now return quickly to my father and tell him, ‘this is what your son joseph says: god has made me lord of all egypt. come down to me without delay.
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: you shall settle in the land of goshen and be near me-you and your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and there i will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution. '
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: behold! you and my brother benjamin can see that i, joseph, am the one speaking with you.
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: tell my father about all my splendor in egypt and everything you have seen. and bring my father down here quickly.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: then joseph threw his arms around his brother benjamin and wept, and benjamin wept as they embraced.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. and afterward his brothers talked with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: when the news reached pharaoh's house that joseph's brothers had come, pharaoh and his servants were pleased.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: pharaoh said to joseph, tell your brothers, ‘do as follows: load your animals and return to the land of canaan.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: then bring your father and your families and return to me. i will give you the best of the land of egypt, and you shall eat from the fat of the land. '
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: you are also directed to tell them: ‘take wagons from the land of egypt for your young children and your wives, and bring your father and come back.
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: but pay no regard to your belongings, for the best of all the land of egypt is yours. '
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: so the sons of israel did as they were told. joseph gave them wagons as pharaoh had instructed, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: he gave new garments to each of them, but to benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and he sent to his father the following: ten donkeys loaded with the best of egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions for his father's journey.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: then joseph sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving, he said to them, do not quarrel on the way!
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: so the brothers went up out of egypt and came to their father jacob in the land of canaan.
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: joseph is still alive, they said, and he is ruler over all the land of egypt! but jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.

source_text: i will go down with you to egypt, and i will surely bring you back. and joseph's own hands will close your eyes.

source_text: then jacob departed from beersheba, and the sons of israel took their father jacob in the wagons pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.

source_text: joseph said to his brothers and to his father's household, i will go up and inform pharaoh: ‘my brothers and my father's household from the land of canaan have come to me.

source_text: the men are shepherds; they raise livestock, and they have brought their flocks and herds and all that they own. '

source_text: so joseph went and told pharaoh: my father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all they own, have come from the land of canaan and are now in goshen. and he chose five of his brothers and presented them before pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: what is your occupation? pharaoh asked joseph's brothers. your servants are shepherds, they replied, both we and our fathers.
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: then they said to pharaoh, we have come to live in the land for a time, because there is no pasture for the flocks of your servants, since the famine in the land of canaan has been severe. so now, please allow your servants to settle in the land of goshen.

source_text: pharaoh said to joseph, now that your father and brothers have come to you,
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: the land of egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. they may dwell in the land of goshen. and if you know of any talented men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: then jacob blessed pharaoh and departed from his presence.

source_text: why should we perish before your eyes-we and our land as well? purchase us and our land in exchange for food. then we, along with our land, will be slaves to pharaoh. give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate.

source_text: however, he did not acquire the priests' portion of the land, for it had been given to them by pharaoh. they ate the rations that pharaoh supplied; so they did not sell their land.

source_text: then joseph said to the people, now that i have acquired you and your land for pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.

source_text: at harvest time, you are to give a fifth of it to pharaoh, and four-fifths will be yours as seed for the field and food for yourselves and your households and children.

source_text: you have saved our lives, they said. we have found favor in our lord's eyes, and we will be pharaoh's servants.

source_text: so joseph established a law that a fifth of the produce belongs to pharaoh, and it is in effect in the land of egypt to this day. only the priests' land does not belong to pharaoh.

source_text: now the israelites settled in the land of egypt, in the region of goshen. they acquired property there and became fruitful and increased greatly in number.

source_text: and jacob lived in the land of egypt seventeen years, and the length of his life was 147 years.

source_text: when the time drew near for israel to die, he called his son joseph and said to him, if i have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness. do not bury me in egypt,

source_text: but when i lie down with my fathers, carry me out of egypt and bury me with them. joseph answered, i will do as you have requested.

source_text: swear to me, jacob said. so joseph swore to him, and israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: some time later joseph was told, your father is ill. so he set out with his two sons, manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: when jacob was told, your son joseph has come to you, israel rallied his strength and sat up in bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: jacob said to joseph, god almighty appeared to me at luz in the land of canaan, and there he blessed me
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and told me, ‘behold, i will make you fruitful and multiply you; i will make you a multitude of peoples, and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession. '
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now your two sons born to you in egypt before i came to you here shall be reckoned as mine; ephraim and manasseh shall be mine, just as reuben and simeon are mine.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: any children born to you after them shall be yours, and they shall be called by the names of their brothers in the territory they inherit.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: now as for me, when i was returning from paddan, to my sorrow rachel died along the way in the land of canaan, some distance from ephrath. so i buried her there beside the road to ephrath that is, bethlehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: when israel saw the sons of joseph, he asked, who are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: joseph said to his father, they are the sons god has given me in this place. so jacob said, please bring them to me, that i may bless them.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: now israel's eyesight was poor because of old age; he could hardly see. joseph brought his sons to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: i never expected to see your face again, israel said to joseph, but now god has let me see your children as well.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: then joseph removed his sons from his father's knees and bowed facedown.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: and joseph took both of them-with ephraim in his right hand toward israel's left hand, and manasseh in his left hand toward israel's right hand-and brought them close to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: but israel stretched out his right hand and put it on the head of ephraim, the younger; and crossing his hands, he put his left on manasseh's head, although manasseh was the firstborn.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: then he blessed joseph and said: may the god before whom my fathers abraham and isaac walked, the god who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the angel who has redeemed me from all harm- may he bless these boys. and may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers abraham and isaac, and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: when joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on ephraim's head, he was displeased and took his father's hand to move it from ephraim's head to manasseh's.
