target_text: ka na pamako, peka na, ama, ee! ana bhèni ja'a, heka canguru dua tèu, pèd'a oe madhe. mai lati ku asa èmu ja'a, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ne nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: so jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around him.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, madhutu yairus asa èmu na. te ngaa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, dhèu ae titu kèna, ka ra seti ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: and a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
target_text: ètu talora dhèu ae sèra, abhu dhèu bhèni èci dhu pèd'a dhèu bhèni. papèd'a ne loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna.

source_text: she had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. instead, her condition had only grown worse.
target_text: mèdha-panyau dènge doi-dhari dhèu bhèni ne'e, èle aa'i mèu-mèu ho b'ae dote. te ngaa papèd'a na èle boe, asa na hoe.

source_text: when the woman heard about jesus, she came up through the crowd behind him and touched his cloak. for she kept saying, if only i touch his garments, i will be healed. immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: at once jesus was aware that power had gone out from him. turning to the crowd, he asked, who touched my garments?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: his disciples answered, you can see the crowd pressing in on you, and yet you ask, ‘who touched me? '
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: but he kept looking around to see who had done this.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before him trembling in fear, and she told him the whole truth.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: daughter, said jesus, your faith has healed you. go in peace and be free of your affliction.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: while he was still speaking, messengers from the house of jairus arrived and said, your daughter is dead; why bother the teacher anymore?
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but jesus overheard their conversation and said to jairus, do not be afraid; just believe.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and he did not allow anyone to accompany him except peter, james, and john the brother of james.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: when they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: he went inside and asked, why all this commotion and weeping? the child is not dead, but asleep.
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: and they laughed at him. after he had put them all outside, he took the child's father and mother and his own companions, and went in to see the child.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: taking her by the hand, jesus said, talitha koum! which means, little girl, i say to you, get up!
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. she was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded. then jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and he told them to give her something to eat.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: jesus went on from there and came to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: when the sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were astonished. where did this man get these ideas? they asked. what is this wisdom he has been given? and how can he perform such miracles?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: isn't this the carpenter, the son of mary and the brother of james, joses, judas, and simon? aren't his sisters here with us as well? and they took offense at him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: then jesus said to them, only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: so he could not perform any miracles there, except to lay his hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: and he was amazed at their unbelief. and he went around from village to village, teaching the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: then jesus called the twelve to him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: he instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey-no bread, no bag, no money in their belts- and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: and he told them, when you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: if anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: so they set out and preached that the people should repent.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: they also drove out many demons and healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: now king herod heard about this, for jesus' name had become well known, and people were saying, john the baptist has risen from the dead! that is why miraculous powers are at work in him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: others were saying, he is elijah, and still others, he is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: but when herod heard this, he said, john, whom i beheaded, has risen from the dead!
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: for herod himself had ordered that john be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother philip's wife herodias, whom herod had married. for john had been telling herod, it is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife!
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: so herodias held a grudge against john and wanted to kill him. but she had been unable,
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: because herod feared john and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. when he heard john's words, he was greatly perplexed; yet he listened to him gladly.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: on herod's birthday, her opportunity arose. herod held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of galilee.
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: when the daughter of herodias came and danced, she pleased herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, ask me for whatever you wish, and i will give it to you.
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: and he swore to her, whatever you ask of me, i will give you, up to half my kingdom!
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: then she went out and asked her mother, what should i request? and her mother answered, the head of john the baptist.
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: at once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: i want you to give me the head of john the baptist on a platter immediately.
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: the king was consumed with sorrow, but because of his oaths and his guests, he did not want to refuse her.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: so without delay, the king commanded that john's head be brought in. he sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: the man brought john's head on a platter and presented it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: when john's disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: meanwhile, the apostles gathered around jesus and brought him news of all they had done and taught.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: and he said to them, come with me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while. for many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: so they went away in a boat by themselves to a solitary place.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: but many people saw them leaving and recognized them. they ran together on foot from all the towns and arrived before them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: when jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. and he began to teach them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: by now the hour was already late. so the disciples came to jesus and said, this is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but jesus told them, you give them something to eat. they asked him, should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: go and see how many loaves you have, he told them. and after checking, they said, five-and two fish.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: then jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: so they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, jesus spoke a blessing and broke the loaves. then he gave them to his disciples to set before the people. and he divided the two fish among them all.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: they all ate and were satisfied,
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: immediately jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: after bidding them farewell, he went up on the mountain to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: when evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and jesus was alone on land. he could see that the disciples were straining to row, because the wind was against them. about the fourth watch of the night, jesus went out to them, walking on the sea. he intended to pass by them, but when they saw him walking on the sea, they cried out, thinking he was a ghost- for they all saw him and were terrified. but jesus spoke up at once: take courage! it is i. do not be afraid.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. and the disciples were utterly astounded,
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they had not understood about the loaves, but their hearts had been hardened.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: when they had crossed over, they landed at gennesaret and moored the boat.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: as soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized jesus
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was. and wherever he went-villages and towns and countrysides-they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him just to let them touch the fringe of his cloak. and all who touched him were healed.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: then the pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from jerusalem gathered around jesus,
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and they saw some of his disciples eating with hands that were defiled-that is, unwashed. now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the pharisees and all the jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially. and on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. and there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining. so the pharisees and scribes questioned jesus: why do your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? instead, they eat with defiled hands.
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: jesus answered them, isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘these people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. they worship me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: you have disregarded the commandment of god to keep the tradition of men. he went on to say, you neatly set aside the command of god to maintain your own tradition.
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moses said, ‘honor your father and your mother' and ‘anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death. '
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘whatever you would have received from me is corban' that is, a gift devoted to god, he is no longer permitted to do anything for his father or mother.
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: thus you nullify the word of god by the tradition you have handed down. and you do so in many such matters.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: once again jesus called the crowd to him and said, all of you, listen to me and understand:
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: after jesus had left the crowd and gone into the house, his disciples inquired about the parable.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: are you still so dull? he asked. do you not understand? nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him, because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated. thus all foods are clean.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: he continued: what comes out of a man, that is what defiles him.
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: jesus left that place and went to the region of tyre. not wanting anyone to know he was there, he entered a house, but was unable to escape their notice.
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about jesus, and she came and fell at his feet. now she was a greek woman of syrophoenician origin, and she kept asking jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: first let the children have their fill, he said. for it is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to the dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: yes, lord, she replied, even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: then jesus told her, because of this answer, you may go. the demon has left your daughter.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: and she went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: then jesus left the region of tyre and went through sidon to the sea of galilee and into the region of the decapolis.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: some people brought to him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged jesus to place his hand on him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: immediately the boy's father cried out, i do believe; help my unbelief!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mone èèna dhaa dènge oe tangi, aku nèngu na, ama, mema ja'a parcaya, te ngaa pa'èra hari ku lalèka ja'a ne'e!

source_text: when jesus saw that a crowd had come running, he rebuked the unclean spirit. you deaf and mute spirit, he said, i command you to come out and never enter him again.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ae mai lingu, ka na paredha nidhu èèna, aku nèngu na, heh! nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu ka nèti ana ne'e! sèna ka na bisa tadèngi aa na padhai lii kahèi. èu baku maso ia ka asa d'ara ana ne'e!

source_text: after shrieking and convulsing him violently, the spirit came out. the boy became like a corpse, so that many said, he is dead.
target_text: ropa nidhu tadèngi lii yesus, hèia na pakèce. ka na hake ana ne mi rai, ka na rèbha-rèbha sène, heka nidhu kalua nèti d'ara ana èèna kèna. ana èèna kalau heka, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le. ka dhèu ètu sèra sa peka, aku rèngu na, waa! ana ne madhe le!

source_text: but jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana ne, ka na pakèd'i ne. hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: after jesus had gone into the house, his disciples asked him privately, why couldn't we drive it out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, tèke eele era èèna, lasi dhuli èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, rèngu mesa ra, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège eele nidhu èèna?

source_text: jesus answered, this kind cannot come out, except by prayer.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! nidhu sèra mema bhelu. de ladhe miu manèngi boe a'èra nèti lamatua, na, miu bisa boe babège eele nidhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: going on from there, they passed through galilee. but jesus did not want anyone to know,
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna, lasi taruu asa propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna,

source_text: because he was teaching his disciples. he told them, the son of man will be delivered into the hands of men. they will kill him, and after three days he will rise.
target_text: lula na neo aj'a ana madhutu na di. ka na lole dènge si, nèbhu heka dhèu pahie eele ja'a dènge dhèu leo. hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask him about it.
target_text: yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra malaa. rèngu bani heka karèi sasoa lii padhai lii nèngu.

source_text: then they came to capernaum. while jesus was in the house, he asked them, what were you discussing on the way?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi d'ai kapernaum. ropa ra maso asa d'ara èmu èci, yesus karèi si, peka na, deo na miu pasisu ngaa ètu talora j'ara?

source_text: but they were silent, for on the way they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.
target_text: èci sa bani boe dhaa, lula ètu talora j'ara deo na, rèngu ako pasala d'ara, nèti ra pasisu, cee ka dhu kapai risi ètu talora rèngu.

source_text: sitting down, jesus called the twelve and said, if anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.
target_text: hèia yesus madhèdi, ka na holo si, peka na, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri nèngu hud'i sama sèmi dhèu haha dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu.

source_text: then he had a little child stand among them. taking the child in his arms, he said to them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus sa'u nare ana iiki èci, ka la'e asa talora rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes not only me, but the one who sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi ana iiki ne, èèna sama sèmi nèngu lalau-lalo'o ja'a kahèi. aa nèngu lalau-lalo'o ama ku kahèi, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: john said to him, teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus dhu ngara na yohanis, peka na, ama! ca tèka ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu pake kolongara ama ku, ho na babège eele nidhu. te ngaa ji'i kai ne, lula nèngu dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: do not stop him, jesus replied. for no one who performs a miracle in my name can turn around and speak evil of me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, baku mi kai ne! te dhèu dhu pake kolongara ja'a, ho na tao tadha malaa, nèngu pa'ele iie boe kolongara ja'a.

source_text: for whoever is not against us is for us.
target_text: ladhe nèngu palab'a boe dènge èdhi, nèngu na dhèu èdhi.

source_text: indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of christ, truly i tell you, he will never lose his reward.
target_text: de mi sanèd'e paie! ladhe abhu dhèu ne'a, na, miu madhutu kristus, ka na soru-bara miu, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe rui-j'aj'èra nèngu. masi ka dhèu dhu hia miu èi iia ca galaa èèna ka, ama lamatua bhèlu boe tatao nèngu èèna.

source_text: but if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge ra, peka na, mage-mage, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki èci kako sala j'ara, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a! be'a risi hia dhèu èèna, rare hadhu aae cue, ho èki mi ladha goro ne, ho pacène ne asa talora dhasi.

source_text: if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. it is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake kacui-aai èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge kacui-aai kateme.

source_text: if your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. it is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake haga èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge haga cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge haga kateme.

source_text: and if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. it is better for you to enter the kingdom of god with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge musi madha kateme.

source_text: where ‘their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched. '
target_text: ‘naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na, madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna. '

source_text: for everyone will be salted with fire.
target_text: a'aj'a ja'a ne, mema bia. de ladhe cee dhu madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu, sèmi dhèu dhu neo paga sisi hud'i masi uuru ku, sèna ka sisi paga èèna taha nèbhu.

source_text: salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.
target_text: masi mema be'a. èdhi pake ho pasèro nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, guna na ngaa? dhoka bhori eele di. miu hud'i j'aj'i sèmi masi kahèi, sèna ka mamuri pasue dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i. de mi pasisu ia ka, peka na, cee ka dhu kapai, aa cee ka dhu ana iiki.

source_text: then jesus left that place and went into the region of judea, beyond the jordan. again the crowds came to him and he taught them, as was his custom.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa propensi yudea dènge era-era ètu cabèka dhimu loko yarden. ètu mia-mia, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus. hèia na aj'a si, sèmi biasa.

source_text: some pharisees came to test him. is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife? they inquired.
target_text: dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai neo pamanahu ne. ra karèi ne sèmi ne'e ka, madhutu a'abhu agama èdhi, ladhe mone dhu dènge le d'ara èmu, bisa pa'ia hari, do aad'o?

source_text: what did moses command you? he replied.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu sanèd'e, do? atora dhèu èmu-kamali dhu musa hia èdhi uru èèna, tasamia?

source_text: they answered, moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, nanori musa peka, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i dhèu mone tao uru ku sasuri pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu na.

source_text: but jesus told them, moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, peka na, nanene, ee! musa suri sèmi èèna, lula miu kètu hadhu.

source_text: however, from the beginning of creation, ‘god made them male and female. '
target_text: baku bhèlu lii lolo dhu uru tèka, lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha! dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, mone dènge bhèni.

source_text: ‘for this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone tèke eele ina-ama na, ho mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and the two will become one flesh. ' so they are no longer two, but one flesh.
target_text: sèna ka dua ra j'aj'i mi èci. '

source_text: therefore what god has joined together, let man not separate.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pa'èci le rèngu dua ra, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri eele si!

source_text: when they were back inside the house, the disciples asked jesus about this matter.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi mesa ra asa d'ara èmu cue. ètu èèna, rèngu karèi ne lii aj'a deo sa.

source_text: so he told them, whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu mone cee dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu bhèni leo, nèngu bersina.

source_text: and if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.
target_text: èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu bhèni. ladhe nèngu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na leo hari dènge mone leo, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: now people were bringing the little children to jesus for him to place his hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu rèti ana-ana rèngu asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus sabaj'a hia si, ho hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu sèra.

source_text: but when jesus saw this, he was indignant and told them, let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them! for the kingdom of god belongs to such as these.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na nasa dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. baku magee si. te dhèu sèmi sèra ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: truly i tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of god like a little child will never enter it.
target_text: miu sanèd'e paie! dhèu cee dhu neo mai asa katanga-madha lamatua, d'ara na kateme hud'i d'èi paraga dènge ne, èci èèna ka ana iiki dhu d'ara d'èi paraga dènge ina-ama ra. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them, and blessed them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus liku nare ana iiki se, ka na tao kacui-aai na mi dedha kètu ana iiki se èci-èci, ho na hia si lii mamèngi.

source_text: as jesus started on his way, a man ran up and knelt before him. good teacher, he asked, what must i do to inherit eternal life?
target_text: ropa yesus si neo pakèd'i, dhèu kaja èci rai mai neo paraga dènge ne. hèia na pacud'u ètu madha yesus, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a neo karèi ciki. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne maso sorga ho mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: why do you call me good? jesus replied. no one is good except god alone.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ne ‘hua iia'? dhèu rai-haha ne èci sa dhu hua iia boe. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu hua iia.

source_text: you know the commandments: ‘do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother. '
target_text: èu me'a le, lii paredha ama lamatua sèra nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: ‘baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli; baku monya ho parame more mèdha-panyau dhèu; aa pakab'ua ina-ama èu. '

source_text: teacher, he replied, all these i have kept from my youth.
target_text: dhèu èèna dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama mese! nèti ana ngèru ka mai, ja'a madhutu le lii paredha sèra aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, there is one thing you lack: go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. then come, follow me.
target_text: yesus rasa kasia dènge dhèu ne'e, hèia na peka, tare'a! te ngaa j'ara èci era. lèpa ka asa èmu èu, lamu pahia aa'i su'i-kakaja èu. kab'ua na lamu pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa. èle èèna, heka mai kèna, ho madhutu ja'a. pe bèli-camèd'a lamatua pala-bagi hia èu hari kakaja-sasu'i dhu leo ètu sorga.

source_text: but the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
target_text: ropa dhèu ne tadèngi nare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, d'ara na laho mae-mae. la'e ka èmu dènge d'ara dhu pèd'a bia, lula nèngu dhèu kaja tare'a.

source_text: then jesus looked around and said to his disciples, how hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of god!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe la'e-mai, aa peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi nanene! dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga!

source_text: and the disciples were amazed at his words. but jesus said to them again, children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of god!
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, ana madhutu na bingu. ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, mi nanene paie! mema carui ladhe dhèu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. baku ngee èèna mud'a!

source_text: it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhèu kaja maso sorga ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, sama carui dènge badha onta ci'u dhu kapai maso asa oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: they were even more astonished and said to one another, who then can be saved?
target_text: lii padhai lii yesus ne asa pamalaa dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i si. ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus looked at them and said, with man this is impossible, but not with god. for all things are possible with god.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe si èci-èci, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, madhutu dhèu rai-haha, na, carui. te ngaa baku bhèlu, madhutu ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: peter began to say to him, look, we have left everything and followed you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus padhai lii, peka na, ama, ji'i tèke eele le ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i unu ji'i, ho madhutu èu. de ji'i abhu bab'ala na ngaa?

source_text: truly i tell you, jesus replied, no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for my sake and for the gospel will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age-houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions-and in the age to come, eternal life.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, aa tèke eele ina-ama na, a'ari na, ana-èpu na, oka-tedhe na, sasab'a-la'a na, dènge isi èmu aa'i-aa'i, ho la'e peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu mia-mia, lèpa loo limuri, nèngu abhu hari ngaa-ngaa sèra, d'ai cangasu hari. aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tèke eele sèra, èèna na nèngu abhu risi hari. aa nèngu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi, lula madhutu ja'a. te ngaa ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua. bab'ala nèngu, sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu padedha iisi, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli. te ngaa dhèu dhu ngee, na, nèngu dhèu haha di, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu kapai.

source_text: as they were going up the road to jerusalem, jesus was walking ahead of them. the disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. again jesus took the twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to him:
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa kota yerusalem. yesus kako uuru. ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge dhèu leo dhu kako pa'èci madhutu ne re limuri. rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai dhu yesus peka dènge rèngu uru èèna, peka na, dhèu neo pamadhe ne ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bingu dènge madha'u. hèia yesus paroa nare ana madhutu na sèra mesa ra, ho na peka hari dènge rèngu dhèu neo tao ngaa mi dedha nèngu ètu yerusalem.

source_text: look, we are going up to jerusalem, and the son of man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. they will condemn him to death and will deliver him over to the gentiles,
target_text: yesus peka dènge si, mi nanene! èdhi neo lati asa yerusalem. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ètu nèi, dhèu neo pahie eele ja'a asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra uku-ked'i pamadhe ja'a. ra tule eele ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: who will mock him and spit on him and flog him and kill him. and after three days he will rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a. ra paru'e ilu mi ja'a. aa ra dhedhe pamae iisi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra pamadhe ja'a kèna. mema ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa d'ai camèda, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: then james and john, the sons of zebedee, came to jesus and declared, teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we ask.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana sabadeus, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, mai asa yesus. ka ra manèngi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i neo padhai lii dènge ama ciki.

source_text: what do you want me to do for you? he inquired.
target_text: ka yesus karèi si, miu neo ngaa?

source_text: they answered, grant that one of us may sit at your right hand and the other at your left in your glory.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ama mèd'u paredha, ji'i manèngi ama pamadhèdi ji'i dua mi, èci re sebhe g'ana, èci hari re kariu, sèna ka ji'i paredha hèi.

source_text: you do not know what you are asking, jesus replied. can you drink the cup i will drink, or be baptized with the baptism i will undergo?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu dua mi se me'a boe lii manèngi miu èèna. èèna na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae. de tasamia? miu ngee, na, miu se bisa pasae j'aj'èra dènge ja'a toke madhe, do?

source_text: we can, the brothers answered. you will drink the cup that i drink, jesus said, and you will be baptized with the baptism that i undergo.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i bisa, ama! ka yesus b'ala, peka na, mema, èèna na, miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a.

source_text: but to sit at my right or left is not mine to grant. these seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.
target_text: te ngaa cee dhu madhèdi re sebhe g'ana, do sebhe kariu ja'a, èèna hak ja'a aad'o. te dhu hak ka ama lamatua dhu pama'ète mema le, na, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: when the ten heard about this, they became indignant with james and john.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra tadèngi lii manèngi yakobis dènge yohanis sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa bia.

source_text: so jesus called them together and said, you know that those regarded as rulers of the gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa aa'i-aa'i si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, sina ma? dhèu-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha j'eli ana kabarai sèna ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto. dhèu kapai kabarai dhu tadhe boe lamatua hia paredha risi eele, ka ana kabarai bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: but it shall not be this way among you. instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
target_text: te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna! nèti talora miu, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku ana pua-paleha ho lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
target_text: cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i tao ngi'u na sama sèmi ènu.

source_text: for even the son of man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a mai hia boe dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te ngaa ja'a mai ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu ae, dènge hia mamuri ja'a ho sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: next, they came to jericho. and as jesus and his disciples were leaving jericho with a large crowd, a blind beggar named bartimaeus, the son of timaeus, was sitting beside the road.
target_text: yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dènge dhèu ae titu kèna kako lasi kota jeriko. ropa rèngu neo kako taruu, dhèu bèdhu èci madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara, na kanata ai ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu kako re èèna. ngara na bartimeos, ana nèti timeos.

source_text: when he heard that it was jesus of nazareth, he began to cry out, jesus, son of david, have mercy on me!
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu dhu kako mai sèra, yesus nèti rae nasaret na kahèi, ka na rodhe, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! ji'i mate èu nèbhu ae le! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: many people admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, son of david, have mercy on me!
target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: jesus stopped and said, call him. so they called the blind man. take courage! they said. get up! he is calling for you.
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: throwing off his cloak, bartimaeus jumped up and came to jesus.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: what do you want me to do for you? jesus asked. rabboni, said the blind man, let me see again.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: go, said jesus, your faith has healed you. and immediately he received his sight and followed jesus along the road.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: as they approached jerusalem and came to bethphage and bethany at the mount of olives, jesus sent out two of his disciples
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: and said to them, go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. untie it and bring it here.
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: if anyone asks, ‘why are you doing this? ' tell him, ‘the lord needs it and will return it shortly. '
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: so they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. they untied it,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: and some who were standing there asked, why are you untying the colt?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: the disciples answered as jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: then they led the colt to jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and he sat on it.
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: the ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: hosanna! blessed is he who comes in the name of the lord!
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: blessed is the coming kingdom of our father david! hosanna in the highest!
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: then jesus entered jerusalem and went into the temple courts. he looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to bethany with the twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: the next day, when they had left bethany, jesus was hungry.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to see if there was any fruit on it. but when he reached it, he found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: then he said to the tree, may no one ever eat of your fruit again. and his disciples heard this statement.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: when they arrived in jerusalem, jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. he overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and he would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: then jesus began to teach them, and he declared, is it not written: ‘my house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations'? but you have made it ‘a den of robbers. '
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: when the chief priests and scribes heard this, they looked for a way to kill him. for they were afraid of him, because the whole crowd was astonished at his teaching.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: and when evening came, jesus and his disciples went out of the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: as they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots. peter remembered it and said, look, rabbi! the fig tree you cursed has withered.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: have faith in god, jesus said to them.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: truly i tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘be lifted up and thrown into the sea, ' and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: therefore i tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: and when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: after their return to jerusalem, jesus was walking in the temple courts, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders came up to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: by what authority are you doing these things? they asked. and who gave you the authority to do them?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: i will ask you one question, jesus replied, and if you answer me, i will tell you by what authority i am doing these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: john's baptism-was it from heaven or from men? answer me!
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: they deliberated among themselves what they should answer: if we say, ‘from heaven, ' he will ask, ‘why then did you not believe him? '
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but if we say, ‘from men'. they were afraid of the people, for they all held that john truly was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: so they answered, we do not know. and jesus replied, neither will i tell you by what authority i am doing these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: then jesus began to speak to them in parables: a man planted a vineyard. he put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: at harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: but they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: he sent still another, and this one they killed. he sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘they will respect my son, ' he said.
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but the tenants said to one another, ‘this is the heir. come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours. '
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: so they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: what then will the owner of the vineyard do? he will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: have you never read this scripture: ‘the stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: this is from the lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: at this, the leaders sought to arrest jesus, for they knew that he had spoken this parable against them. but fearing the crowd, they left him and went away.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: later, they sent some of the pharisees and herodians to catch jesus in his words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: teacher, they said, we know that you are honest and seek favor from no one. indeed, you are impartial and teach the way of god in accordance with the truth. is it lawful to pay taxes to caesar or not? should we pay them or not?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, why are you testing me? bring me a denarius to inspect.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: so they brought it, and he asked them, whose image is this? and whose inscription? caesar's, they answered.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: then jesus told them, give to caesar what is caesar's, and to god what is god's. and they marveled at him.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: then the sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to jesus and questioned him:
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: teacher, moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother's widow and raise up offspring for him.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: now there were seven brothers. the first one married and died, leaving no children.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. and the third did likewise.
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: in this way, none of the seven left any children. and last of all, the woman died.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? for all seven were married to her.
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: jesus said to them, aren't you mistaken, because you do not know the scriptures or the power of god?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: when the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the book of moses, how god told him, ‘i am the god of abraham, the god of isaac, and the god of jacob'?
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he is not the god of the dead, but of the living. you are badly mistaken!
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. noticing how well jesus had answered them, he asked him, which commandment is the most important of all?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: jesus replied, this is the most important: ‘hear o israel, the lord our god, the lord is one.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: love the lord your god with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength. '
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: the second is this: ‘love your neighbor as yourself. ' no other commandment is greater than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: right, teacher, the scribe replied. you have stated correctly that god is one and there is no other but him,
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and to love him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, which is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.
target_text: èdhi hud'i sue risi ne, toke d'ara d'èi ho pa'èci dènge ne, tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi sama sèmi èdhi sue ngi'u èdhi unu ti. lamatua d'èi risi eele tatao sèmi èèna, nèti èdhi madhutu dhodhoka atora agama di. tatao sèmi èèna be'a risi, nèti èdhi tèti badha ho lati tunu hia lamatua, do tèti mèdha leo hia ne.

source_text: when jesus saw that the man had answered wisely, he said, you are not far from the kingdom of god. and no one dared to question him any further.
target_text: ropa yesus nanene nare dhèu ne dhaa sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, mese agama ne ne'a dènge be'a le. hèia yesus peka na, èu oe j'aj'i unu ama lamatua kèna. èle èèna ka, dhèu leo sèra bani heka pakarèi dènge yesus, lula dhèu èci sa segi boe ne.

source_text: while jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, how can the scribes say that the christ is the son of david?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a dhèu ae sèra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi si, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, tasamia? mese agama sèra aj'a, peka na, kristus èèna dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. madhutu ngangee rèngu, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud. te ngaa a'aj'a sèmi èèna d'ai lèke mèu mèka.

source_text: speaking by the holy spirit, david himself declared: ‘the lord said to my lord, sit at my right hand until i put your enemies under your feet. '
target_text: lula, nèti uru ka mai, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake daud ho suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua peka le mi lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi mi era dhu hua iia, re bab'oa g'ana ja'a. pe èèna na ja'a tao musu èu pahaha iisi, toke ra bisa boe ded'e kètu mi èu. '

source_text: david himself calls him ‘lord. ' so how can he be david's son? and the large crowd listened to him with delight.
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud paroa kristus èèna, peka na, ‘lamatua' na. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu sèra peka, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna d'ai mèka. lula nèngu èèna j'aj'i lamatua nèti daud kahèi. ropa yesus peka nare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra d'èi titu kèna nanene ne.

source_text: in his teaching jesus also said, watch out for the scribes. they like to walk around in long robes, to receive greetings in the marketplaces,
target_text: ka yesus peka hari si, miu hud'i pajiko paie ku mese agama. rèngu d'èi pasia pake kodho madhera d'ai rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, sèna ka dhèu dhu rèdhi rèngu sèra, koa si, peka na, ‘ladhe ku laa! dhèu sèra, dhèu kapai! '

source_text: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
target_text: ladhe sèmi rèngu maso asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, do lasi ra'a-sisi, ra tenge era madhèdi dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: they defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. these men will receive greater condemnation.
target_text: de hua iia mi pajiko paie! rèngu kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu bhèni balu sèra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra sèra dènge j'ara titu ho sabaj'a pamadhera aae, sèna ka dhèu peka na, rèngu se dhèu mola. te ngaa limuri mai, na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi asa rèngu.

source_text: as jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, he watched the crowd putting money into it. and many rich people put in large amounts.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e madhèdi patangara dènge boaraka derma ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. na ladhe dhèu mai pamaso doi kolete asa d'ara boaraka èèna. ka na ladhe dhèu kaja sèra parèu doi ae.

source_text: then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
target_text: te ngaa abhu bhèni balu èci dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa mai manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na pamaso dua doi asa d'ara boaraka èèna. dua doi dhu na pamaso èèna, kab'ua ciki ood'e di.

source_text: jesus called his disciples to him and said, truly i tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus gape ana madhutu na, ka na peka, mi ladhe ku bhèni balu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa nèi. na pamaso dhoka dua doi di, te ngaa nèngu hia risi eele nèti dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: for they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.
