target_text: dhèu leo sèra hia kolete nèti doi sisa rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi nèngu asa lamatua.

source_text: as jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, hèia ana madhutu na èci paj'uj'u asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na peka, ama! ladhe ku èmu ne'e! ra tao rare, saraga bia. ra pagod'o rare hadhu sèra, mera titu kèna!

source_text: do you see all these great buildings? jesus replied. not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, èmu ne mema saraga titu kèna! te nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eele ne. ka hadhu-hadhu sèra, èci sa pamadhèdi heka ètu dedha èci.

source_text: while jesus was sitting on the mount of olives opposite the temple, peter, james, john, and andrew asked him privately,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa ledhe saitun, ka na madhèdi ètu era dhu patangara dènge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia petrus, yakobis, yohanis dènge anderias mai padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: tell us, when will these things happen? and what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?
target_text: ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama! lole hari ku, lii dhu ama ku peka dènge ji'i deo na. lod'o mia sèra sa j'aj'i? aa tadha-tadha na, samia?

source_text: jesus began by telling them, see to it that no one deceives you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu pajiko paie-iie, sèna ka baku lèke tipu.

source_text: many will come in my name, claiming, ‘i am he, ' and will deceive many.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, ho ra peka na, ‘ja'a ne kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ' aa ra leko-monya dhèu ae.

source_text: when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. these things must happen, but the end is still to come.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi dhèu pamusu, do tadèngi lii lolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i dènge pakasiro ètu mia-mia, miu baku madha'u kahèi. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku. te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. there will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. these are the beginning of birth pains.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku mai pamusu dènge suku leo, rai èci mai pamusu dènge rai leo. ètu mia-mia, j'aj'i rai opo dènge kabake-manganga. sèra sa j'aj'i tadha sama sèmi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: so be on your guard. you will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. on my account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
target_text: de hua iia, na, miu mage-mage! te èèna na dhèu mai kèpa miu, ho ra nuni asa dhèu paredha agama dhu pama'ète lii agama. aa ra game miu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ho èèna na rèti miu asa madha dhèu dhu dènge koasa, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa be'a kahèi, ne'e ne miu abhu tebho ho peka kolongara ja'a mi rèngu.

source_text: and the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
target_text: te dhèu unu ama lamatua hud'i lasi uuru ku lole lii lolo be'a ja'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, heka lod'o èle rai-haha ne d'ai kèna.

source_text: but when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the holy spirit.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe ra èki rèti miu asa era pama'ète lii langu, miu baku madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a neo padhai lii ngaa? do, ja'a neo dhaa ngaa? ' ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, miu padhai lii madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka dènge miu.

source_text: brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ana dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ama d'èlu na tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ina-ama dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ana d'èlu rèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe si.

source_text: you will be hated by everyone because of my name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
target_text: de èèna na, dhèu d'èi boe miu, taga miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa dhèu cee dhu bisa taha toke d'ai èle lod'o èèna, tatu ama lamatua hia mamuri mi nèngu.

source_text: so when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be let the reader understand, then let those who are in judea flee to the mountains.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, èèna na, abhu dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. ho na mai maso ka titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu bisa boe ètu era èèna, ho na pahera era èèna. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu mèdhi le sèmi èèna, na, mi pajiko paie-iie! cee dhu baca lii ne'e, pajiko paie kahèi! èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, dètu ae le. ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, na, dhèu-dhèu ètu propensi yudea lega-rai asa kolo ledhe lasi.

source_text: let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
target_text: rèngu hud'i rai pamèri-mèri, sèna ka baku abhu j'aj'èra. ladhe dhèu mai le asa li'u, lèpa ia ka rare mèdha asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: and let no one in the field return for his cloak.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu ètu d'ara oka, baku lèpa èmu rare mèdha-papake.

source_text: how miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
target_text: dhu j'èra risi, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, dènge ina dhu pasusu ana rara iisi hiu, lula rèngu rai rare boe.

source_text: pray that this will not occur in the winter.
target_text: de hua iia risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra baku lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: for those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of god's creation until now, and never to be seen again.
target_text: te j'aj'èra lod'o èèna, bia titu kèna! mulai nèti ama lamatua tao rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu bia sèmi èèna. j'aj'èra bia sèmi èèna, lod'o limuri, j'aj'i heka hari.

source_text: if the lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. but for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has cut them short.
target_text: ladhe ama lamatua pab'ab'e boe lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mamuri. te ngaa, taga ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, ka na pab'ab'e lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: at that time if anyone says to you, ‘look, here is the christ! ' or ‘there he is! ' do not believe it.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai na, miu tadèngi dhèu mai peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ladhe ku! kristus ètu ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo hari peka, aku rèngu na, ‘aad'o! kristus ètu nèi! ' miu baku nanene kahèi!

source_text: for false christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu mai ho tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa cahag'e hari peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na ra tao tadha malaa ae-ae dènge koasa nidhu, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. rèngu patangi-tenge j'ara sèna ka dhèu unu ama lamatua lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: so be on your guard; i have told you everything in advance.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie-iie! mema lod'o j'aj'èra bia èèna d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e uuru miu!

source_text: but in those days, after that tribulation: ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka hari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe èle lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, na, ‘madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga, aa hèru heo heka.

source_text: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken. '
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu bèbha nèti dedha-liru mai, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru j'aj'i kaco-balo. '

source_text: at that time they will see the son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
target_text: èle èèna, heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èèna na ja'a mai dènge ra'i-liru nèti dedha. hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi a'èra dènge dadedha ja'a.

source_text: and he will send out the angels to gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
target_text: ka ja'a paredha ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ho puru lasi oru-kaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a hag'e kore nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne; nèti suu haa d'ai suu dhimu, nèti suu badae toke d'ai suu balèu.

source_text: now learn this lesson from the fig tree: as soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, ja'a kore upama nèti ana aaj'u. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, èèna tadha hèru hadhu dètu le!

source_text: so also, when you see these things happening, know that he is near, right at the door.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra j'aj'i, sama sèmi lii peka ja'a deo na, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, mamai ja'a dètu ae le.

source_text: truly i tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri se, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o dhu pènu dènge j'aj'èra na d'ai le.

source_text: heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a ele boe, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: no one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the son, but only the father.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii, peka na, dhèu èci sa re'a boe lod'o do jam dhu ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga sèra re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku, ke'a boe kahèi. dhoka ama ku mesa na di, dhu ne'a.

source_text: be on your guard and stay alert! for you do not know when the appointed time will come.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi hud'i pajiko paie, lula miu me'a boe lod'o d'ai na.

source_text: it is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a laku tèke eele miu kèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a mai hari. sama sèmi dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele èmu nèngu, ho la'e asa rai kaj'èu. na pua ana-ana nèngu j'aga paie èmu. aa na bagi hia si sasab'a. ka na paredha ana madhenga èmu, sèna ka na j'aga paie, toke d'ai nèngu lèpa hari.

source_text: therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return-whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga mèda-mèu kahèi, lula miu me'a boe lod'o mia ja'a mai hari, sama sèmi ana madhenga èmu ne'a boe lod'o lamatua èmu na lèpa. lèpa lod'o nihia, talora mèda, oe mèu, lod'o rea, do lod'o nètu; miu me'a boe jam èèna.

source_text: otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
target_text: mage dhoka na mai sahèka, te abhu miu dhu bhèj'i luu era.

source_text: and what i say to you, i say to everyone: keep watch!
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: now the passover and the feast of unleavened bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest jesus and kill him. but not during the feast, they said, or there may be a riot among the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara neo kèpe yesus dènge mau-mau. te rèngu neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara padhue èèna, ra peka na, taha ku! baku parai kèpe ne, lula lod'o kalela dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao dènge èdhi. rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dii dua lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, dhu biasa ra peka na, ‘paska' dènge ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. kalela se pasanèd'e rèngu lod'o bèi-baki ra kalua nèti rai masir.

source_text: while jesus was in bethany reclining at the table in the home of simon the leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. she broke open the jar and poured it on jesus' head.
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu pèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. hèia lod'o kalela dhae d'ai mèka, na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra lasi ra'a-rinu ètu èmu simon. ètu talora ra'a-rinu era, dhèu bhèni èci mai paraga yesus. nèd'u dènge boto èci dhu ra tao nèti hadhu. isi boto ne, èi hèu mèngi asli dhu kab'ua titu kèna, dhu ra tao nèti amo aaj'u hèu mèngi. hèia bhèni ne pamae hèb'a boto èèna, ka na pasuti èi hèu mèngi mi kètu yesus, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: why this waste of perfume?
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu leo dhu ra'a-rinu pa'èci kahèi. ropa dhèu se rèdhi dhèu bhèni ne tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa. ka ra padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ngaa ka unu bhèni nèi? na bhori eele èi hèu mèngi kab'ua aae èèna!

source_text: it could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor. and they scolded her.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie èi hèu mèngi èèna, ho la'e papala doi ae sèra, mi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. te kab'ua èi hèu mèngi ne, èci èèna ka dènge gaji tuka d'ara ca tèu. hèia ra jèke bhèni ne.

source_text: but jesus said, leave her alone; why are you bothering her? she has done a beautiful deed to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e lula nèngu pasuti le ngi'u ja'a dènge èi hèu mèngi ne'e!

source_text: the poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. but you will not always have me.
target_text: dhèu kasia sèra, bèli-bèli ètu talora miu. de lod'o mia èèna ka dhu miu lake mere, na, miu bisa soru-bara si. te ngaa nèbhu heka, ja'a pa'èci heka dènge miu.

source_text: she has done what she could to anoint my body in advance of my burial.
target_text: mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka ètu rai-haha ne. dènge tatao bhèni ne, nèngu lalau ngi'u ja'a, sama sèmi nèngu pahèu mèngi mema ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane.

source_text: and truly i tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.
target_text: miu patadhe, ee! èèna na, ladhe dhèu lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua ètu mia-mia, na, ra palolo kahèi tatao be'a bhèni ne'e. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e nèngu.

source_text: then judas iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests to betray jesus to them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abhu ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru dua sèra, ngara na yudas iskariot. nèngu kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra ho neo pahie yesus mi rèngu. ropa na paraga dènge rèngu, ka na peka naneo na.

source_text: they were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. so judas began to look for an opportunity to betray jesus.
target_text: lod'o kètu agama sèra tadèngi naneo yudas, ka ra karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra jaji, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, tatu ji'i b'ae. hèia yudas kalua, ka na mulai tenge j'ara ho pahie yesus.

source_text: on the first day of the feast of unleavened bread, when the passover lamb was to be sacrificed, jesus' disciples asked him, where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the passover?
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o partama nèti lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi. de d'ara lod'o èèna, rèngu tema tunu roti dhu dènge boe ragi, aa roro kahib'i-kalèbho kahèi. hèia ana madhutu yesus sèra mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! doe ne'e ne, lod'o kalela paska èdhi kèna. de ama neo ji'i lalau era kalela paska ètu mia?

source_text: so he sent two of his disciples and told them, go into the city, and a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. follow him,
target_text: hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua, aku nèngu na, miu lami uuru ku asa d'ara kota. ètu nèi, miu paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, dhu pasae èi d'ara g'ala iiki cue. lami madhutu ne nèti limuri.

source_text: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘the teacher asks: where is my guest room, where i may eat the passover with my disciples? '
target_text: ladhe na maso asa èmu mia èèna ka, na, miu madhutu ne asa d'ara. hèia miu peka mi lamatua èmu èèna, sèmi ne'e, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi kama èci, ho na neo tao kalela paska dènge ana madhutu nèngu. '

source_text: and he will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. make preparations for us there.
target_text: pe dhèu èèna paj'uj'u kama aae èci ètu èmu dedha na, dhu na sadia nare le. de miu dua mi dhoka lami lalau nganga'a di.

source_text: so the disciples left and went into the city, where they found everything as jesus had described. and they prepared the passover.
target_text: hèia dua ra lasi ka asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, rèngu rèdhi tare'a, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yesus moa deo na. ka ra sadia aa'i-aa'i, ho yesus si ra'a kalela paska ètu era èèna. èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi paroa yesus si.

source_text: when evening came, jesus arrived with the twelve.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu dhèu canguru dua sèra d'ai era èèna.

source_text: and while they were reclining and eating, jesus said, truly i tell you, one of you who is eating with me will betray me.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi ra'a sama-sama. ètu talora ra'a era, yesus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu nanene ku! èèna na dhèu èci nèti miu se pahie eele ja'a mi dhèu leo.

source_text: they began to be grieved and to ask him one after another, surely not i?
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, ana madhutu yesus sèra cag'ag'a dènge manyasa. ka rèngu èci-èci mulai karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka èèna, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: he answered, it is one of the twelve-the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahia ja'a.

source_text: the son of man will go just as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom he is betrayed! it would be better for him if he had not been born.
target_text: mi sanèd'e! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke le, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa kasia, dhèu dhu neo pahia ja'a èèna, bèli-camèd'a nèngu dui nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: while they were eating, jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, take it; this is my body.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora ra'a era, yesus nare roti cue, hèia na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na sèra. ka na peka na, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a kèna. mere ho mi'a.

source_text: then he took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na nare galaa dhu isi dènge èi hua anggor. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua kahèi. ka na j'ole galaa èèna asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rinu.

source_text: he said to them, this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
target_text: hèia na peka, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna, dhu suti sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. raa ne, j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa le èèna, limuri ne j'aj'i le tare'a. mere ho minu ka!

source_text: truly i tell you, i will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when i drink it anew in the kingdom of god.
target_text: mi sanèd'e paie! nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. toke d'ai ja'a dènge ama ku ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the mount of olives.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, lasi dènge asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: then jesus said to them, you will all fall away, for it is written: ‘i will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered. '
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako rèngu èèna, yesus padhai lii, peka na, d'ara mèda ne'e ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. sama sèmi dhu ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala asa haa, asa dhimu. '

source_text: but after i have risen, i will go ahead of you into galilee.
target_text: èèna na ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, ja'a laku uru nèti miu asa propensi galilea!

source_text: peter declared, even if all fall away, i never will.
target_text: ka petrus b'ala, peka na, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: truly i tell you, jesus replied, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, petrus! mu patadhe! mèda ne'e kahèi, manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te ngaa èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: but peter kept insisting, even if i have to die with you, i will never deny you. and all the others said the same thing.
target_text: ka petrus pajèka dènge ne, peka na, aad'o sèmi èèna, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe dènge ama kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pasili boe ama, aa rai eele boe! angalai petrus sèra lii èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: then they came to a place called gethsemane, and jesus told his disciples, sit here while i pray.
target_text: hèia yesus si lasi d'ai d'ara oka cue ètu ledhe saitun, ngara na ‘getsemani'. d'ai èèna, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, miu madhèdi mate ja'a mi ne'e. ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: he took with him peter, james, and john, and began to be deeply troubled and distressed.
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, dènge yohanis lasi dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, na rasa d'ara nèngu ma'ète laho mae-mae.

source_text: then he said to them, my soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. stay here and keep watch.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a pèd'a titu kèna! ja'a rasa sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi mate mi ne'e.

source_text: going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from him. abba, father, he said, all things are possible for you. take this cup from me. yet not what i will, but what you will.
target_text: hèia la'e ako kaj'èu ciki nèti era èèna, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu rai, ka na sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ladhe sèmi ama d'èi, na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e d'ai madhe. ja'a ke'a le, ètu madha ama, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ama bisa boe tao. de ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne'e nèti kabela-kao ja'a. masi ka sèmi èèna, baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a; te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: then jesus returned and found them sleeping. simon, are you asleep? he asked. were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
target_text: èle èèna ka, na lèpa asa ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, te ngaa ra bhèj'i luu. hèia na parèi si, ka na padhai lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus! èu bhèj'i, do? ja'a nèbhu boe ètu nèi, te ngaa miu bisa boe beke mate ja'a ciki sa!

source_text: watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. for the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
target_text: kèd'i ho pamako musi madha èu. kèd'i ka, ho beke dènge ja'a! d'ara miu neo tao be'a kahèi, te ngaa ngi'u miu roe. de be'a risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe miu lèke dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: again he went away and prayed, saying the same thing.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i ca tèka hari. nèngu manèngi hari mi ama lamatua, aku nèngu na, ama! ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: and again jesus returned and found them sleeping-for their eyes were heavy. and they did not know what to answer him.
target_text: ka na lèpa hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu bhèj'i hari le, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna. hèia na parèi hari si, te ngaa rèngu re'a boe dhaa sèmi ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: when jesus returned the third time, he said, are you still sleeping and resting? that is enough! the hour has come. look, the son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele si, ka la'e manèngi-mangaj'i d'ai tèlu hari kèna. èle èèna ka, na lèpa la'e parèi ana madhutu na sèra. na peka, miu bhèj'i taruu era? sange èèna ka laa! kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, nuka mai dènge angalai nèngu sèra. rèngu mai kèpe ja'a, ho saraka mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a si.

source_text: rise, let us go. see, my betrayer is approaching!
target_text: kèd'i ka! pamako musi madha miu, ho ladhe ku asa nèi! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a ne, nuka mai nèi. mai ho lati paraga dènge si!

source_text: while jesus was still speaking, judas, one of the twelve, arrived, accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia yudas d'ai madha yesus dènge dhèu ae titu kèna. rèngu mai rèti dènge hela dènge cèki, ho kèpe yesus. dhèu se tao sèmi èèna, lula ra madhutu lii paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: the one i kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away securely.
target_text: yudas hia mema tadha mi dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe d'ai nèi, ja'a uu cee, na, nèngu kèna. de mi kèpe ne.

source_text: going directly to jesus, he said, rabbi! and kissed him.
target_text: ropa yudas si d'ai era èèna, na la'e asa madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama mese! hèia na liku nare yesus, ka na uu ne.

source_text: then the men seized jesus and arrested him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae sèra ara asa madha yesus, ka ra kèpe ne.

source_text: and one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus asked the crowd, have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest me as you would an outlaw?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae dhu mai kèpe nèngu sèra, aku nèngu na, tasamia? miu ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? ka miu mai kèpe ja'a mèti hela dènge cèki?

source_text: every day i was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. but this has happened that the scriptures would be fulfilled.
target_text: bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu èci sa kèpe boe ja'a. mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: then everyone deserted him and fled.
target_text: ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele yesus mesa na ètu èèna.

source_text: one young man who had been following jesus was wearing a linen cloth around his body. they caught hold of him, but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu ana mone ngèru èci kahèi dhu madhutu yesus re limuri. ana ne pahutu isi na dènge sig'i ca bèla. dhèu sèra neo kèpe ne kahèi, ka na rai tèke eele sig'i na ètu kacui-aai dhèu sèra, lula na madha'u. hèia na rai dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ua na.

source_text: they led jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and scribes assembled.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra rèti yesus asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. ètu èèna, dhèu kapai sèra pakaboko le. rèngu sèra, nuka: kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. and he sat with the officers and warmed himself by the fire.
target_text: ropa ra kèpe rèti yesus, petrus madhutu mau-mau nèti limuri. hèia na maso kahèi d'ai madha èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, ka na madhèdi manyiru ai sama-sama dènge dhèu j'aga ètu sèra.

source_text: now the chief priests and the whole sanhedrin were seeking testimony against jesus to put him to death, but they did not find any.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra padhue dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi j'ue lii langu agama. ra patangi-tenge bukti ho pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa rèngu abhu boe bukti èci sa.

source_text: for many bore false witness against jesus, but their testimony was inconsistent.
target_text: ka ra paroa dhèu ae asa madha ho j'aj'i sakasii, sèna ka neo pabèbhe yesus. te ngaa lii sakasii rèngu sèra, èci dènge èci pamèci boe.

source_text: then some men stood up and testified falsely against him:
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu sakasii leo dhu kèd'i titu, ka ra pakapod'e lii, peka na,

source_text: we heard him say, ‘i will destroy this man-made temple, and in three days i will build another that is made without hands. '
target_text: ji'i tadèngi dhèu ne'e peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu dhèu rai-haha tao dènge kacui-aai ra. te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o ka, ja'a patitu kore hari le èmu èèna, dènge boe pake kacui-aai dhèu. '

source_text: but even their testimony was inconsistent.
target_text: te ngaa lii lolo rèngu sèra èci dènge èci baka-leo hua.

source_text: so the high priest stood up before them and questioned jesus, have you no answer? what are these men testifying against you?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna, kèd'i titu ètu talora dhèu ae dhu madhèdi ètu sèra. ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae mai le galaa èu. nga tao ka èu mau-mau, mo'o boe dhaa lii galaa sèra?

source_text: but jesus remained silent and made no reply. again the high priest questioned him, are you the christ, the son of the blessed one?
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, lii boe ca hèb'a sa. èle èèna ka, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne, karèi hari ne ca tèka, èu peka ku laa! tare'a-re'a èu ne kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa nèti uuru èèna, do?

source_text: i am, said jesus, and you will see the son of man sitting at the right hand of power and coming with the clouds of heaven.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèngu èèna ka, ja'a ne! bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, madhèdi re bab'oa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. koasa nèngu kapai risi eele! ladhe èèna na, ja'a dènge nèngu, ngèd'u paredha sama-sama. èle èèna na, ja'a puru mai nèti sorga dènge ra'i-liru.

source_text: at this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, why do we need any more witnesses?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii padhai yesus, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne nasa titu kèna, hèia na ciu pamae kodho madhera ètu ua na. ka na pajèka peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu heka sakasii!

source_text: you have heard the blasphemy. what is your verdict? and they all condemned him as deserving of death.
target_text: miu tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, si? nèngu unu na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna! nèngu padedha iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. lii ne'e ne, lii dhu pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua, dhèu èèna hud'i lèke huku madhe ku! de mi pama'ète tasamia? hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i pama'ète, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a sala! de nèngu ne hud'i lèke huku pamadhe!

source_text: then some of them began to spit on him. they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said to him, prophesy! and the officers received him with slaps in his face.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu kèd'i lasi sabhuu ilu mi rèhu yesus. ra hutu musi madha na, ka ra game ne. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu j'aj'i dhèu mèti lii padhai ama lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu? èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu dhu madhenge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho mai pakako rèti yesus. ropa ra kako, ra tèb'e pa'oke ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: while peter was in the courtyard below, one of the servant girls of the high priest came down and saw him warming himself there. she looked at peter and said, you also were with jesus the nazarene.
target_text: mèda èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu èèna. hèia ènu dhèu bhèni èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, mai ka nèdhi petrus madhèdi manyiru ai. na ladhe kaloo ka rèhu petrus, ka karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na èu sama-sama dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but he denied it. i do not know or even understand what you are talking about, he said. then he went out to the gateway, and the rooster crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu èèna. hèia petrus kalua, ka la'e titu ètu hèb'a tedhe. kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo.

source_text: there the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby, this man is one of them.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni èèna ladhe nèdhi hari petrus. ka na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne ca dhèu nèti rèngu kahèi!

source_text: but he denied it again. after a little while, those standing nearby said once more to peter, surely you are one of them, for you too are a galilean.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, ka na peka, tao-tao èu huj'u! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e! nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci ètu èèna kahèi, peka hari mi petrus, aku nèngu na, èu ne baku pasili, peka na, èu dènge boe dhèu se'e se! we! miu se aa'i-aa'i mi, dhèu galilea, si?

source_text: but he began to curse and swear, i do not know this man of whom you speak!
target_text: ka petrus pab'ala hari, aku nèngu na, ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: and immediately the rooster crowed a second time. then peter remembered the word that jesus had spoken to him: before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times. and he broke down and wept.
target_text: petrus dhu padhai lii nare mèka, kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo ka dua hari kèna. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii dhu yesus peka dènge nèngu, ladhe manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari peka na èu tadhe boe ja'a! ropa ngee nèdhi, hèia petrus tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole sanhedrin devised a plan. they bound jesus, led him away, and handed him over to pilate.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu-dhèu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi sèra pare'a lii ho pamadhe yesus. ka ra èki rèti ne, lasi asa madha gubernur pilatus.

source_text: so pilate questioned him, are you the king of the jews? you have said so, jesus replied.
target_text: ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, tasamia? èu ne tare'a dhèu aae yahudi, do? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, tare'a. ama gubernur peka lèke kèna.

source_text: and the chief priests began to accuse him of many things.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e tao sala ae titu kèna! hèia ra lolo ka sasala na èci-èci.

source_text: then pilate questioned him again, have you no answer? look how many charges they are bringing against you!
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari yesus, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai dhèu se'e, do? dhèu se'e, pasala le èu ae-ae. èu b'ala ku laa!

source_text: but to pilate's amazement, jesus made no further reply.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa, ka gubernur malaa.

source_text: now it was pilate's custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, dhèu ae sèra paj'uj'u ana bèdho èci, ho gubernur patalale ne.

source_text: and a man named barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana bèdho èci, ngara na barabas. uru èèna, ra kèpe ne, taga na palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: so the crowd went up and began asking pilate to keep his custom.
target_text: lula lod'o tatao paska èèna oe dètu le, dhèu ae lasi manèngi gubernur pilatus, ka ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, ama gubernur! lod'o tatao paska dètu le! lod'o sèmi ne'e, ama gubernur patabuli ku ana bèdho èci, sama sèmi tèu-tèu uru sèra.

source_text: do you want me to release to you the king of the jews? pilate asked.
target_text: hèia gubernur b'ala lii rèngu, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a patabuli cee? tasamia, ladhe ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do? miu mo'o, do aad'o?

source_text: for he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed jesus over.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, lula nèngu ne'a le, kètu agama yahudi ka rèti yesus mai asa nèngu, taga ra kacèki dènge yesus.

source_text: but the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release barabbas to them instead.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi se dadugu dhèu ae sèra, ho manèngi gubernur, peka na, ji'i ngo'o boe nèngu! ji'i d'èi dhoka patabuli barabas di!

source_text: so pilate asked them again, what then do you want me to do with the one you call the king of the jews?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, ladhe sèmi èèna, yesus, dhu ra pangare na ‘dhèu aae yahudi' èèna, ja'a tao ne, tasamia?

source_text: and they shouted back, crucify him!
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: why? asked pilate. what evil has he done? but they shouted all the louder, crucify him!
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasala na ngaa? ja'a parisa kore le. te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu nèngu tao! te ngaa dhèu se asa ka hino pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and wishing to satisfy the crowd, pilate released barabbas to them. but he had jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
target_text: lula gubernur neo pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae sèra, ka na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi rèngu. ka na paredha dhèu j'aga sèra lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare ne, hèia sordad'u sèra rèti ka yesus lasi neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then the soldiers led jesus away into the palace that is, the praetorium and called the whole company together.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère rèti yesus asa era dhu taleo èci ètu madha èmu gubernur. ka ra paroa anga sordad'u dhu leo sèra ca batalion, ho pakaboko.

source_text: they dressed him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and set it on his head.
target_text: ra papake yesus kodho madhera aae èci, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa, sama sèmi mèdha-papake dhèu aae-dhèu aae. ka rare loro aj'u dhu padhudhu, ho ènyu solo. hèia ra ènyi solo padhudhu èèna mi kètu yesus. ka ra tao ne, sèmi dhèu aae dhu ded'e hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae.

source_text: and they began to salute him: hail, king of the jews!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sangaja pakab'ua yesus. ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama dhèu aae yahudi dhu hua iia!

source_text: they kept striking his head with a staff and spitting on him. and they knelt down and bowed before him.
target_text: aa ra sangaja pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua yesus. ka ra sabhuu ilu pèri-pèri hari mi rèhu yesus. sèmi èèna kahèi, ra d'eu kètu yesus dènge gui pahari-pahari.

source_text: after they had mocked him, they removed the purple robe and put his own clothes back on him. then they led him out to crucify him.
target_text: ropa ra tao rare sèmi èèna, ka ra bhoke eele kodho madhera nèti ua na. ka ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. èle ka, rèti yesus asa li'u yerusalem, ho neo paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha d'ai madhe.

source_text: now simon of cyrene, the father of alexander and rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of jesus.
target_text: ropa rèngu kalua nèti yerusalem, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci. ngara na simon, ama nèti aleksander dènge rufus. ropa na neo maso asa yerusalem, sordad'u sèra pakaseti ne pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus.

source_text: they brought jesus to a place called golgotha, which means the place of the skull.
target_text: ère rèti yesus asa era èci, ngara na golgota. sasoa na, ‘era rui kètu'.

source_text: there they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra neo hia yesus ninu èi hua anggor manyilu dhu pab'ali dènge èi na'i, sèna ka na taha rarii nèti nu'a-nu'a ètu ngi'u na sèra. te ngaa yesus no'o boe ninu.

source_text: and they crucified him. they also divided his garments by casting lots to decide what each of them would take. it was the third hour when they crucified him.
target_text: hèia ra paku kacui-aai dènge haga yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. paku rare ka, ra patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ele boe d'ara hake ceo mad'ae sa. èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake yesus.

source_text: and the charge inscribed against him read: the king of the jews.
target_text: ka ra suri ètu papa èci dhu ra paku re dedha kètu yesus, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae yahudi rèngu pake alasan èèna ka, ho huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: along with jesus, they crucified two robbers, one on his right and one on his left.
target_text: ètu èèna, ra paku parapo dhèu dua kahèi pa'èci dènge yesus. èci re cabèka g'ana, aa èci hari re cabèka kariu yesus.

source_text: and those who passed by heaped abuse on him, shaking their heads and saying, aha! you who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days,
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re èèna, ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu ra paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ka ra pakareko kètu, aa ra padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, heh! èu ne peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho d'ara tèlu lod'o, èu pakèd'i hari, si?

source_text: come down from the cross and save yourself!
target_text: èu puru sèku nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ho patabuli ngi'u èu! ladhe sèmi èèna, heka ji'i parcaya, na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: in the same way, the chief priests and scribes mocked him among themselves, saying, he saved others, but he cannot save himself!
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, kètu agama yahudi sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne, patabuli le dhèu leo nèti rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, te ngaa nèngu bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu unu na nèti j'aj'èra ne'e.

source_text: let the christ, the king of israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe! and even those who were crucified with him berated him.
target_text: nèngu peka unu na, nèngu ne ‘kristus', dhu uru èèna ama lamatua moa tèke le. dhèu leo peka na, nèngu ne dhèu aae isra'el. ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, hud'i laa na puru nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, sèna ka ji'i ngèdhi ne. heka ji'i parcaya ne kèna. dhèu dua dhu ra paku sama-sama dènge yesus sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus kahèi.

source_text: from the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
target_text: d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, era èèna maroga, toke d'ai hake tèlu loo nihia.

source_text: at the ninth hour, jesus cried out in a loud voice, eloi, eloi, lema sabachthani? which means, my god, my god, why have you forsaken me?
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu nihia, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, peka na, eloi! eloi! lema sabaktani? dhu sasoa, peka na, lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka, ama ku tèke eele ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: when some of those standing nearby heard this, they said, behold, he is calling elijah.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu ètu èèna, tadèngi lii pa'oo yesus. ka ra peka, miu nanene ku laa! te na paroa elia, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru èèna.

source_text: and someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. he put it on a reed and held it up for jesus to drink, saying, leave him alone. let us see if elijah comes to take him down.
target_text: ka dhèu èci rai la'e nare ula dhasi, ka na cèb'u asa d'ara èi hua anggor manyilu. hèia nare ula èèna, èki ètu suu tatea èci, ka na soro asa panyoro yesus ho na camuci. dhèu èèna peka, èdhi tatae sèku. cee ne'a, tao-tao elia mai, ho papuru ne nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: but jesus let out a loud cry and breathed his last.
target_text: hèia yesus pa'oo hari ca tèka, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae, ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci. ropa yesus ma'ète a'ae, bèla ne mae cèri bagi mi dua, nèti dedha toke d'ai haha.

source_text: when the centurion standing there in front of jesus saw how he had breathed his last, he said, truly this man was the son of god!
target_text: ètu golgota abhu komedhaa sordad'u j'aga dhu titu dètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi mamadhe yesus, na cag'ag'a. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! mema tare'a! dhèu ne'e ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and there were also women watching from a distance. among them were mary magdalene, mary the mother of james the younger and of joses, and salome. these women had followed jesus and ministered to him while he was in galilee, and there were many other women who had come up to jerusalem with him.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu lasi asa era èèna kahèi. ra titu nèti kaj'èu, ladhe rèdhi mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. rèngu se ka dhu uru èèna lalau-lalo'o yesus ètu galilea. rèngu sèra, nuka: salome, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yoses, dènge dhèu bhèni leo hari dhu mai asa yerusalem, sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: now it was already evening. since it was preparation day that is, the day before the sabbath, joseph of arimathea, a prominent council member who himself was waiting for the kingdom of god, boldly went to pilate to ask for the body of jesus.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu èci tenge j'ara ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu èèna, ngara na yusuf, nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne'e kahèi, ca dhèu dhu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi. nèngu dhèu d'ara be'a kahèi. aa nèngu mate nèbhu le paredha ama lamatua mai. lod'o yesus madhe èèna, lèke hari jumat. bèli na, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, yusuf neo papuru eele ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara lod'o hari jumat èèna. ka na pabani iisi na, la'e paraga dènge gubernur pilatus, manèngi ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: pilate was surprised to hear that jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii manèngi yusuf ne, na malaa. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, eea! nga tao ka, dhèu ne madhe malai sa mia ne! ja'a ngee, na, dhae madhe mèka! hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa komedhaa, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, sa mia? yesus madhe le, do dhae?

source_text: when pilate had confirmed it with the centurion, he granted the body to joseph.
target_text: komedhaa èèna b'ala, peka na, tare'a, ama! na madhe le karèi deo na. ropa gubernur tadèngi nare lii dhaa èèna, hèia na hia yusuf la'e nare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: so joseph bought a linen cloth, took down the body of jesus, wrapped it in the cloth, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
target_text: hèia yusuf la'e hèli bèla madhera dhu kab'ua èci, ka na la'e asa golgota. d'ai nèi, ka na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. na pahutu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla hiu. tèu èèna, ra heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu d'ara hadhu aae. hèia ra nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus asa d'ara ro'a èèna. ka ra loli rare hadhu kabela dhu kapai èci, ho ra bèdho paie hèb'a ro'a èèna. èle èèna ka, yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: mary magdalene and mary the mother of joseph saw where his body was placed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari, ina yoses, madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. dua ra rèdhi era dhu ra padhane yesus, ka ra patadhe paie era èèna.

source_text: when the sabbath was over, mary magdalene, mary the mother of james, and salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of jesus.
target_text: bèli èèna, lèke hari sabtu, nuka lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. ropa lod'o cèna la'e, maria nèti rae magdala, maria dhu leo hari ina yakobis, dènge salome, lasi hèli èi hèu mèngi, sèna ka bèli rèngu bisa lasi pasuti mi ngi'u aae yesus madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
target_text: ropa hari migu mad'ae aae èèna, tèlu ra lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: they were asking one another, who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb? but when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, tèlu ra padhue, aku rèngu na, waa! d'ai nèi, na, cee ka dhu bisa loli eele hadhu aae èèna nèti hèb'a ro'a? èdhi tèlu ti bisa boe, lula hadhu èèna kapai bia! te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai ro'a èèna, rèdhi hadhu èèna dhu hari eele le nèti hèb'a ro'a.

source_text: when they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
target_text: hèia bhèni se maso asa d'ara. rèngu cag'ag'a titu kèna, lula ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, rèdhi ana mone ngèru èci madhèdi ètu sebhe g'ana rèngu, dhu pake mèdha pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: but he said to them, do not be alarmed. you are looking for jesus the nazarene, who was crucified. he has risen! he is not here! see the place where they put him.
target_text: hèia mone ngèru èèna, peka dènge rèngu, baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a, na, miu mai tenge yesus dhèu nasaret, dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na aad'o heka ètu ne'e, lula na mamuri hari le! mai ho ladhe unu mi, te ngi'u yesus aad'o heka ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na.

source_text: but go, tell his disciples and peter, ‘he is going ahead of you into galilee. there you will see him, just as he told you. '
target_text: de lami ka lai-lai, ho lole dènge petrus si, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le! na la'e uuru le asa galilea. èèna na rèngu paraga dènge yesus ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna na peka mema le dènge rèngu. de lami ka!

source_text: so the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. and in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.
target_text: ropa bhèni se rèdhi heka ngi'u yesus ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na, rèngu cag'ag'a. ka rai asa li'u lasi. hèia rèngu lèpa dènge ka, ra peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa ètu j'ara, lula rèngu madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: early on the first day of the week, after jesus had risen, he appeared first to mary magdalene, from whom he had driven out seven demons.
target_text: hari migu mad'ae aae era, yesus pad'elo uuru ngi'u na mi maria nèti magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus babège eele nidhu pidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: she went and told those who had been with him, who were mourning and weeping.
target_text: ropa na nèdhi nare yesus, hèia la'e dènge ka, peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu uru èèna madhutu yesus. dhèu sèra pakaboko taruu ètu era èci. rèngu ètu d'ara susa era, taga ra ngee mamadhe yesus.

source_text: and when they heard that jesus was alive and she had seen him, they did not believe it.
target_text: ka maria peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu susa era? susa ia ka, te yesus mamuri hari le! deo na, ja'a heka paraga dènge ne kèna! te ngaa rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, èu ne, monya! ji'i lèka boe.

source_text: after this, jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae èci. ropa d'ai talora j'ara, yesus pad'elo ngi'u dènge si. te ngaa nèngu ub'a le. nèbhu boe, heka ra tadhe ne.

source_text: and they went back and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them either.
target_text: hèia dua ra lèpa hari, lasi peka dènge angalai ra sèra, aku rèngu na, wee! miu nanene ku laa! lai-lai deo na, ji'i paraga le dènge yesus ètu j'ara! te ngaa angalai ra aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, eeh! miu baku monya sèmi èèna!

source_text: later, as they were eating, jesus appeared to the eleven and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paraga dènge ana madhutu na sèra, dhèu canguru èci, ropa ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu. ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, wee! miu kètu hadhu pa'ae sa mia ne! dhèu peka le dènge miu, rèngu rèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha rèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya boe! aku miu na, dhèu sèra monya! de ne'e ne, ja'a unu ku mai. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa ja'a mamuri hari le! de mèdhi le, sina ma!

source_text: and he said to them, go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
target_text: de lami ka asa mia-mia palème rai-haha ne. peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lii lolo be'a ja'a ne.

source_text: whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu parcaya ja'a aa abhu sarani, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri sèna ka na bisa pea taruu dènge ne ètu sorga. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na nèngu abhu huku nèti lamatua, ka lamatua core eele ne asa li'u la'e, ho na pea taruu ètu nèi.

source_text: and these signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
target_text: aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a sèra, rèngu tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra re'a, peka na, koasa ra mema mai nèti ama lamatua! conto sèmi, èèna na rèngu bisa babège eele nidhu pake kolongara ja'a. ladhe èèna na, ama lamatua hia si padhai lii pake lii leo dhu rèngu mesa ra dhane rare boe.

source_text: they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.
target_text: ladhe rèngu kèpe mege dhu dènge raco, do, rinu lèke raco, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ladhe ra tao kacui-aai asa dhèu pèd'a, dhèu èèna èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu na.

source_text: after the lord jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of god.
target_text: ropa padhai lii èle dènge ana madhutu na sèra, hèia ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa sorga. ètu nèi, nèngu j'aj'i ai g'ana ama na, ka rèd'u paredha sama-sama.

source_text: and they went out and preached everywhere, and the lord worked through them, confirming his word by the signs that accompanied it.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ana madhutu na sèra madhutu paredha na. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia, ho lole mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lii lolo be'a yesus. hèia ama lamatua hia si koasa ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu yesus peka le dènge rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae parcaya yesus, taga rèngu re'a le lii lolo be'a èèna, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us, just as they were handed down to us by the initial eyewitnesses and servants of the word. therefore, having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent theophilus,
target_text: ama teofilus dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lii maho'o nèti ja'a. dhèu ae dhu suri sèku le lii lolo nèti mamuri dènge sasab'a-la'a yesus dhu j'aj'i ètu talora aae ji'i. rèngu suri lii lolo sèra pake lii lolo dhu parai reo nèti ji'i asa ji'i karèi nèti uru ka, dhu ji'i nge'a nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu dètu dènge lamatua yesus, aa nèti dhèu leo dhu ladhe rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. lii lolo se'e, lèke mola-mola dènge mamoa ama lamatua karèi nèti uru kèna. de ja'a parisa kore le toke lutu dènge be'a, j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mulai nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. hèia ja'a pama'ète ho sèna ka suri si paie-iie ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. dènge j'ara ne, ama bisa me'a mèu ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.
target_text: aa ama bisa parcaya ngaa dhu dhèu lole sèra, lii dhu monya boe. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i tare'a!

source_text: in the time of herod king of judea there was a priest named zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of abijah, and whose wife elizabeth was a daughter of aaron.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i lii lolo ne sèmi ne'e: lod'o dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi yudea, abhu ca dhèu, dhu ngara na sakaria. nèngu ne, ca dhèu ama agama yahudi. aa nèngu kahèi, ca dhèu nèti kaboko ama agama abia. dhèu èmu sakaria, ngara na elisabet, ca dhèu ana-èpu nèti ama agama kahèi. te elisabet ne, ana-èpu nèti harun, a'a musa.

source_text: both of them were righteous in the sight of god, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the lord.
target_text: dua ra mamuri mola madhutu paredha dènge atora aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua. aa dhèu pakab'ua si kahèi.

source_text: but they had no children, because elizabeth was barren, and they were both well along in years.
target_text: dua ra dhu heka le, te ngaa dhu abhu boe kolo, te era ana nèti elisabet dhu bèdho mèno.

source_text: one day while zechariah's division was on duty and he was serving as priest before god,
target_text: ca tèka, sakaria dènge dhèu d'ara kaboko abia lèke lod'o rèngu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the temple of the lord and burn incense.
target_text: madhutu atora ama agama, hud'i ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu maso asa kama mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, dhèu ne hud'i pasèbu ai pake aj'u hèu mèngi ètu madha ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, sakaria lèke lot.

source_text: and at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.
target_text: hèia la'e dènge ka asa d'ara. nèngu dhu talora pasèbu ai ètu d'ara kama èèna, dhèu ae-ae dhu sabaj'a ètu madha èmu.

source_text: just then an angel of the lord appeared to zechariah, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga titu re bèka g'ana era tunu aj'u hèu mèngi ne.

source_text: when zechariah saw him, he was startled and gripped with fear.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, sakaria madha'u titu kèna, ka ne'a heka tao sèmi ngaa.

source_text: but the angel said to him, do not be afraid, zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. your wife elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name john.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, sakaria! baku madha'u! te ama lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu. de bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu èu nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yohanis.

source_text: he will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
target_text: èèna na dhèu ae karej'e kahèi sama-sama dènge miu, lula miu abhu ana. bèli-camèd'a, ana ne pakarej'e d'ara èu.

source_text: for he will be great in the sight of the lord. he shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the holy spirit even from his mother's womb.
target_text: koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, bera-bera dènge ne, karèi nèti ina na kad'o nèngu era. nèngu ne hud'i luri ninu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. ropa na kapai, ama lamatua pake ne j'aj'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara.

source_text: many of the sons of israel he will turn back to the lord their god.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a èèna pamako nare dhèu isra'el ae-ae, ho ra lèpa hari asa ama lamatua rèngu.

source_text: and he will go on before the lord in the spirit and power of elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous-to make ready a people prepared for the lord.
target_text: tatao dènge koasa na nuka sèmi elia, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua karèi uru. nèngu ne mai uuru nèti lamatua èdhi. nèngu ne bisa kabèli d'ara ina-ama, ho sue hari ana-ana ra. aa dhèu dhu rai nèti madha lamatua, na ad'u si ho ra lèpa hari madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti sèmi èèna, nèngu tao dhèu sèna ka sadia d'ara ra sèmi mamai lamatua.

source_text: how can i be sure of this? zechariah asked the angel. i am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.
target_text: te ngaa sakaria karèi ana pajuu ne, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, sina ma? ! ja'a dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne! tasamia ja'a bisa ke'a, na, j'ara se bisa j'aj'i?

source_text: i am gabriel, replied the angel. i stand in the presence of god, and i have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne gabriel, dhèu pajuu ama lamatua. nèngu ka paleha ja'a mai, sèna ka peka dènge èu lii lolo dhu be'a ne.

source_text: and now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.
target_text: te ngaa èu mo'o boe lèka lii padhai ja'a ne. de tadha dhu èu manèngi, sèmi ne'e! he'o èu èèna na sakaa, ho èu bisa heka padhai lii, nèti deo ne'e ne, toke miu abhu ana. pe èu mèdhi unu mu. te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: meanwhile, the people were waiting for zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu li'u sèra, bingu titu kèna, lula sakaria tao bhodho boe.

source_text: when he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. he kept making signs to them but remained speechless.
target_text: ropa na kalua mai, nèngu bisa heka padhai lii. ka na hia tadha re kacui-aai na, heka dhèu se'e re'a, na, lamatua hia tanila ropa nèngu ètu d'ara kama mola-mèci èèna.

source_text: and when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.
target_text: ropa èle sasab'a ra, hèia sakaria lèpa asa èmu na.

source_text: after these days, his wife elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. she declared, the lord has done this for me. in these days he has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka elisabet dènge babia. ka na pea dhoka ètu d'ara èmu toke lèmi hèru. na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio lamatua! lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. ladhe ja'a ne dènge ka kolo, dhèu pamakae heka ja'a.

source_text: in the sixth month, god sent the angel gabriel to a town in galilee called nazareth,
target_text: ropa elisabet dènge babia d'ai èna hèru, hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, la'e asa rae cue ètu propensi galilea, ngara na nasaret. ngara ana pajuu ne, gabriel.

source_text: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named joseph, who was of the house of david. and the virgin's name was mary.
target_text: ètu nasaret, abhu ana bhèni ngèru ca dhèu, ngara na maria. nèngu ne dhèu dhu lii d'ai le, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. gabriel la'e paraga dènge maria.

source_text: the angel appeared to her and said, greetings, you who are highly favored! the lord is with you.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi na mi ana bhèni ne, hèia na lii, peka na, salama, maria, ee! ama lamatua dhu hag'e nare le èu, ho neo ad'u j'ara hua iia èci hia èu. aa nèngu bera-bera dènge èu kahèi.

source_text: mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka maria bingu, lula ne'a boe sasoa nèti lii padhai ana pajuu ne.

source_text: so the angel told her, do not be afraid, mary, for you have found favor with god.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, maria! baku madha'u. te ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu.

source_text: behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name jesus.
target_text: nèbhu heka, èu dènge babia, ho èèna na, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus.

source_text: he will be great and will be called the son of the most high. the lord god will give him the throne of his father david,
target_text: nèngu ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai. èèna na lamatua pangare ne, ‘nèngu ne, ana d'èlu ja'a. ' nuka, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. pe ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka nèd'u paredha, nuka sèmi baki na, dhèu aae daud.

source_text: and he will reign over the house of jacob forever. his kingdom will never end!
target_text: nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha taa-taa mi dhèu isra'el. te paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: how can this be, mary asked the angel, since i am a virgin?
target_text: te ngaa maria karèi gabriel, peka na, ja'a ne j'unu kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone èci sa! tasa mera mia ka ja'a dènge babia?

source_text: the angel replied, the holy spirit will come upon you, and the power of the most high will overshadow you. so the holy one to be born will be called the son of god.
target_text: hèia gabriel dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai asa èu. aa koasa nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, èèna na mai sarimu nare èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana dhu bèli-camèd'a èu more iisi èèna, tare'a-re'a mola-mèci, lula nèngu èèna, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: look, even elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
target_text: baku malaa! te a'ari èu ca dhèu, ngara na elisabet, dènge le babia kahèi. dhèu peka na, nèngu èèna bisa heka nara iisi, lula nèngu dhu heka le. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu dènge babia èna hèru kèna.

source_text: for no word from god will ever fail.
target_text: te bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i!

source_text: i am the lord's servant, mary answered. may it happen to me according to your word. then the angel left her.
target_text: ka maria dhaa, peka na, be'a. ja'a ne ènu ama lamatua. hud'i laa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii èu èèna ka. ja'a ke'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga ne lèpa, tèke eele maria.

source_text: in those days mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of judah, where she entered the home of zechariah and greeted elizabeth.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia maria pakèd'i nèti nasaret, la'e lai-lai asa rae sakaria, ètu ledhe-ledhe propensi yudea. d'ai nèi, la'e dènge ka asa d'ara èmu sakaria. ka na hia lii maho'o mi elisabet.

source_text: when elizabeth heard mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and elizabeth was filled with the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa elisabet tadèngi lii maho'o nèti maria, hèia ana ètu d'ara kabake elisabet pasèja. aa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, maso sa elisabet.

source_text: in a loud voice she exclaimed, blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
target_text: ka elisabet pa'oo, peka na, maria! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, risi nèti dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne! èèna na dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oke padedha-dedha kahèi ana dhu èu kad'o èèna.

source_text: and why am i so honored, that the mother of my lord should come to me?
target_text: ra pakab'ua ja'a kahèi, lula ina nèti lamatua ja'a mai pangad'o dènge ja'a.

source_text: for as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
target_text: ropa èu mèti lii maho'o mi dedha ja'a, cag'ag'a laa ana dhu ja'a kad'o ne pasèja ètu d'ara kabake ja'a, lula karae.

source_text: blessed is she who has believed that the lord's word to her will be fulfilled.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èu, lula èu ne parcaya, peka na, nèngu tao madhutu lii dhu na moa tèke.

source_text: then mary said: my soul magnifies the lord,
target_text: maria bhoka hèb'a, peka na, nèti d'ara iiki ja'a, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha lamatua!

source_text: and my spirit rejoices in god my savior!
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ama lamatua hia ja'a mamuri!

source_text: for he has looked with favor on the humble state of his servant. from now on all generations will call me blessed.
target_text: nèngu ne tao le madha-dhilu mi ja'a, nuka ana pua-paleha na dhu dènge boe kab'ua ne. karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ngee na, ja'a ne, bhèni dhu kalua mèngi titu kèna,

source_text: for the mighty one has done great things for me. holy is his name.
target_text: lula lamatua tao j'ara malaa mi dedha ja'a. nèngu ne, dhu koasa dedha risi aa dhu mola-mèci risi.

source_text: his mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.
target_text: ama lamatua loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakab'ua aa dhu pahaha iisi ra mi nèngu, nèti lai ana-lai èpu.

source_text: he has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
target_text: na pake koasa na, sèna ka tao pakaco dhèu-dhèu dhu padedha iisi sèra.

source_text: he has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
target_text: na pamanahu dhèu aae-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u koasa, lula ra padedha iisi. te ngaa na j'oka padedha-dedha dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: he has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.
target_text: na panga'a dhèu dhu manganga toke bècu, te ngaa na babège-lalèta dhèu-dhèu kaja ho lasi dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: he has helped his servant israel, remembering to be merciful,
target_text: na soru-bara dhèu isra'el na, dènge loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi rèngu.

source_text: as he promised to our fathers, to abraham and his descendants forever.
target_text: uru èèna, na pa'èki tèke le lii pajaji dènge bèi-baki èdhi, nuka baki abraham dènge ana-èpu na aa'i-aa'i ra. d'ai sange ne'e, lii pajaji èèna pa'èki mèno.

source_text: mary stayed with elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.
target_text: hèia maria pea dènge elisabet toke tèlu hèru, heka lèpa asa èmu na ètu nasaret.

source_text: when the time came for elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
target_text: ropa d'ai hèru, ka elisabet nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: her neighbors and relatives heard that the lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
target_text: lii ne'e, ra palolo d'ai a'ari na dènge rae lesa, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na, ka na hia elisabet ana mone ca dhèu. hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: on the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father zechariah.
target_text: lod'o ana ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne, madhutu atora dhèu yahudi. ra neo pangare ana ne, sakaria, madhutu ngara ama na.

source_text: but his mother replied, no! he shall be called john.
target_text: te ngaa ina na b'ala ra, aku nèngu na, aad'o sèmi èèna! ngara na hud'i yohanis ku!

source_text: they said to her, there is no one among your relatives who bears this name.
target_text: te ngaa ra b'ala ne, nga tao ka pili ngara yohanis? nèti a'ari miu, ca dhèu sa dhu ngara dhae, sèmi mèka èèna!

source_text: so they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.
target_text: ka ra senen ho karèi sakaria, sèna ka neo pangare ana ne ngara na ngaa.

source_text: zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, his name is john. and they were all amazed.
target_text: hèia sakaria senen ho manèngi lei. ra hia ne lei, ka na suri peka na, ngara na yohanis! ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa titu kèna.

source_text: immediately zechariah's mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, he'o na dhu sakaa mèno èèna, mako dènge ka. ka na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: all their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of judea were talking about these events.
target_text: hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pea padètu ètu sèra sa, madha'u dènge malaa. ka lii ne'e mulai ra palolo nèti hèb'a sa hèb'a, toke dhèu-dhèu ètu ledhe-ledhe ètu propensi yudea re'a aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, what then will this child become? for the lord's hand was with him.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, ra pangee, peka na, tatu koasa nèti lamatua bera-bera dènge ana ne. bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na kapai mai, na j'aj'i dhèu sèmi mia, oo?

source_text: then his father zechariah was filled with the holy spirit and prophesied:
target_text: èle ka, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa sakaria. ka na padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: blessed be the lord, the god of israel, because he has visited and redeemed his people.
target_text: koa-kio ama lamatua dhèu isra'el! te na mai le ho sui nare dhèu unu na, sèna ka rèngu baku j'aj'i sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: he has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant david,
target_text: lamatua ded'e le ca dhèu dhu koasa na kapai titu kèna, ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèngu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: as he spoke through his holy prophets, those of ages past,
target_text: lamatua moa mema, karèi nèti uru ka, re dhèu dhu maj'èni rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
target_text: limuri ne na neo patabuli èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, aa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara pèd'a dènge èdhi.

source_text: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember his holy covenant, the oath he swore to our father abraham, to grant us
target_text: na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi bèi-baki èdhi, lula na sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji na mi rèngu, dhu na pa'èki dènge baki abraham.

source_text: deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve him without fear,
target_text: na patabuli le èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, sèna ka ta pahaha iisi mi nèngu, dhu dènge heka d'ara madha'u.

source_text: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our lives.
target_text: na patalale le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri mola-mèci dènge be'a taa-taa, ètu katanga madha na.

source_text: and you, child, will be called a prophet of the most high; for you will go on before the lord to prepare the way for him,
target_text: yohanis, ee! èu ne, ana ja'a. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadhe èu, na, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu dedha risi aa'i. èèna na, lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu, sèna ka ra pakabhèle kacui-aai ra ho soru mamai lamatua.

source_text: to give to his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lamu paj'uj'u j'ara hia mi dhèu unu lamatua, sèna ka re'a, na, ama lamatua hia mamuri mi rèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu saku eele sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: because of the tender mercy of our god, by which the dawn will visit us from on high, to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.
target_text: lula d'ara lamatua taleo aa rasa kasia mi dedha èdhi, nèti èèna ka, na hia èdhi taa-tebho dhu hiu, nuka sèmi lod'o hiu nèti saraa dhu hiu. èdhi dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa èdhi dhu pea dènge d'ara madha'u ètu sanabhu mamadhe, lula pabe'a mèka dènge lamatua, bèli-camèd'a abhu saraa ho lere èdhi asa j'ara dhu nèti mera-milu.

source_text: and the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to israel.
target_text: ka yohanis asa kapai noo-noo. aa roh lamatua pa'èra ne. na kapai mai, hèia la'e pea ka ètu d'ara mamoo, toke d'ai lod'o na pakako sasab'a mi dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: now in those days a decree went out from caesar augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire. this was the first census to take place while quirinius was governor of syria.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara kirenius j'aj'i gubernur ètu siria, dhèu aae kapai agustus, hia paredha, dhu peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu paredha roma, hud'i lèpa asa rae èta-èsu ra ho madhutu sensus! èèna heka hiu-lai kèna, dhèu paredha roma ige ana kabarai na.

source_text: and everyone went to his own town to register.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i lèpa asa rai èta-èsu ra, sèna ka madhutu sensus.

source_text: so joseph also went up from nazareth in galilee to judea, to the city of david called bethlehem, since he was from the house and line of david. he went there to register with mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf pea ètu rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea. nèngu dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni ca dhèu, ngara na maria, dhu dènge le babia. yusuf ne, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ka nèngu hud'i lèpa ku asa kota daud, nuka betlehem ètu propensi yudea, sèna ka madhutu sensus. nèti èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa kota betlehem.

source_text: while they were there, the time came for her child to be born.
target_text: ropa dua ra ètu nèi, maria d'ai lod'o nara iisi.

source_text: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. she wrapped him in swaddling cloths and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, dua ra abhu boe kama ètu d'ara losmen. nèti èèna ka, dua ra maso lasi asa d'ara oka badha. hèia maria nara iisi ana uuru, mone ca dhèu. ka pasig'i ne dènge kaha'i bèla, aa paj'unu ètu d'ara karab'a, era badha ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.
target_text: mèda èèna, abhu ana madhenga badha dhèu pèri-pèri dhu beke madhenge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a ètu li'u kota.

source_text: just then an angel of the lord stood before them, and the glory of the lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. hèia saraa lamatua rai-reo nare rèngu, ka ra madha'u bia.

source_text: but the angel said to them, do not be afraid! for behold, i bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne peka, baku madha'u! nanene pabe'a-be'a! te ja'a ne mai ho peka lii lolo be'a èci hia miu. cee dhu tadèngi lii ne'e, tatu rèngu karej'e.

source_text: today in the city of david a savior has been born to you. he is christ the lord!
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne, sèmi ne'e ka: deo ne'e, ca dhèu ina nara iisi le kristus ètu betlehem, nuka kota dhèu aae daud. kristus ne'e ka dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka. lamatua hia na mai, sèna ka na patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèngu ne'e, èèna na dhèu paroa na, ‘lamatua'!

source_text: and this will be a sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.
target_text: pe miu tadhe ne sèmi ne'e ka: miu paraga dènge ana rara iisi hiu ca dhèu dhu pahutu dènge sig'i. ra paj'unu ne ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising god and saying:
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, hèia cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae mai nèti sorga. ka ra pa'èci dènge ne. hèia ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge lii sod'a, peka na,

source_text: glory to god in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom his favor rests!
target_text: ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua! nèngu dhu nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi. ama lamatua neo hia dame dènge mera-milu mi dhèu rai-haha, dhu pakarej'e d'ara na!
