source_text: you also must be ready, because the son of man will come at an hour you do not expect.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema dhari, te ca dhèu sa dhu re'a boe pèri lod'o dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna mai hari.

source_text: lord, said peter, are you addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?
target_text: hèia petrus karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! lii pakasame ama deo na, lèke dhoka mi ji'i do, lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i?

source_text: and the lord answered, who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time? blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns. truly i tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, lii pakasame deo na lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sèmi kapala urusan dhu satia. nèngu d'èlu-mèu uri j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi lamatua na. te èèna na, lamatua na ded'e ne, sèna ka papala nganga'a hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra. ladhe nèngu maj'èni sab'e madhutu sasab'a na sèmi èèna, masi ka lamatua na mai sange mera mia èèna ka, te ngaa nèngu ne dhu loe boe tao j'ara dhu lèke. hèia na oto, lula lamatua na ded'e ne ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘my master will be a long time in coming, ' and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
target_text: te ngaa carui bagi kapala urusan dhu pangee, na, ‘ele boe nèbhu ku, heka lamatua ne lèpa kèna. ' hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, mone dènge bhèni. ka na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge kea rae-rae toke mahu.

source_text: the master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka kapala urusan ne ne'a nare boe, cag'ag'a laa, lamatua na lèpa. ka lamatua na kalabhe ne, hèia babège eele ne, sèna ka sèmi nare pala na ètu li'u, palere-lere dènge dhèu dhu satia boe, tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua ra.

source_text: that servant who knows his master's will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
target_text: te dhèu sab'a dhu re'a dad'èi lamatua ra, te ngaa pa'èra boe tao madhutu, do, d'èi boe sab'e madhutu, bèli-camèd'a ra dui rare hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: but the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. from everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu sab'e sale, lula re'a boe dad'èi lamatua ra, rèngu abhu boe hahuku dhu bia. te dhèu dhu abhu ae, ra manèngi ae nèti nèngu kahèi. dhèu dhu abhu sasab'a kapai, dhadhaa na kapai kahèi.

source_text: i have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how i wish it were already kindled!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a ne ho cèri eele dhèu ja'a nèti dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai, ho tunu eele maruru. dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe ai ne mulai heo ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but i have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed i am until it is accomplished!
target_text: te ngaa uru nèti èèna, ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra dhu bia. ja'a bèli-camèd'a j'èra ae, toke d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: do you think that i have come to bring peace to the earth? no, i tell you, but division.
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a mai kèti dame ètu rai-haha, do? aad'o! ja'a mai sèna ka tao dhèu rai-haha ne patao-palaha dènge mae-manyèla, lula lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: from now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu pa'a'ari mae-manyèla. ètu d'ara èmu cue, dhèu tèlu lab'a dhèu dua, dua lab'a tèlu.

source_text: they will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.
target_text: ama lab'a ana, ana lab'a ama. ina lab'a ana; ana lab'a ina. teto lab'a ana mantu; ana mantu lab'a teto na.

source_text: then jesus said to the crowds, as soon as you see a cloud rising in the west, you say, ‘a shower is coming, ' and that is what happens.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ra'i-liru mèdhi aae cèu nèti haa, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha èj'i oe mai kèna. ' mema lèke sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when the south wind blows, you say, ‘it will be hot, ' and it is.
target_text: ladhe ngèlu balèu mai, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha lod'o pana titu kèna. ' mema tare'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: you hypocrites! you know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. why don't you know how to interpret the present time?
target_text: weeh! miu dhèu leko-monya dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna me'a peka mia lod'o èj'i, aa mia lod'o pana aae. te ngaa tasamia ka mo'o boe me'a dènge dad'èi lamatua ètu taa limuri ne?

source_text: and why don't you judge for yourselves what is right? make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu tao lii langu, nga tao ka miu bisa boe pama'ète unu mi, mia dhu lèke! be'a risi uri uuru ku dame! mage dhoka miu d'ai katanga madha hakim, ho na pama'ète, na, miu maso asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: i tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.
target_text: te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu bisa boe kalua, ladhe miu b'ae mere mèka dedha dhu hakim pama'ète nare èèna.

source_text: at that time some of those present told jesus about the galileans whose blood pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge yesus, na, gubernur pilatus pamadhe le dhèu yahudi pèri-pèri nèti galilea, lod'o dhu mai asa yerusalem, rèti korban asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: to this he replied, do you think that these galileans were worse sinners than all the other galileans, because they suffered this fate?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus karèi si, madhutu miu, na, tasamia? dhèu dhu ra pamadhe sèra, sasala ra kapai risi nèti dhèu galilea dhu leo aa'i-aa'i ra, do? nèti èèna ka, ra huku pamadhe si, do?

source_text: no, i tell you. but unless you repent, you too will all perish.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, lod'o limuri miu laho nuka sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of siloam collapsed on them: do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in jerusalem?
target_text: aa tasa mera mia hari dènge canguru aru dhèu dhu madhe ca hari ni, ropa ètu siloam manara guri, hèia kabhie nare si, èèna? sasala si ae risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: no, i tell you. but unless you repent, you too will all perish.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola, miu èèna na laho sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: then jesus told this parable: a man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. he went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.
target_text: hèia yesus peka lii pakasame èci, na, abhu ca dhèu dhu dènge ana aaj'u ètu d'ara oka na. bèli-bèli, na la'e patigi, teko-teko ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ana aaj'u ne dhae hua mèka.

source_text: so he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘look, for the past three years i have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven't found any. therefore cut it down! why should it use up the soil? '
target_text: ka na pua dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, aku nèngu na, ‘tèlu tèu kèna, ja'a laku-mai ho ladhe ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. de patue eele ne, te nèngu ne dhoka na'e era di. '

source_text: ‘sir, ' the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until i dig around it and fertilize it.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ama baku pasori ku. hud'i nèbhu hari ku ciki laa d'ai ca tèu sa. pe ja'a kakèi rai reo kapua na, sèna ka tao pupuk, ho na sega.

source_text: if it bears fruit next year, fine. but if not, you can cut it down. '
target_text: ladhe d'ai tèu mai nèi, aj'u ne hua, na be'a. ladhe aad'o, la'a sina ma, patue eele ka laa. '

source_text: one sabbath jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi, yesus la'e aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. she was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu bhèni ca dhèu dhu kabodho kapo'o canguru aru tèu kèna, lula nidhu tao ne. bhèni ne bisa boe pamola kabodho na.

source_text: when jesus saw her, he called her over and said, woman, you are set free from your disability.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi, hèia na paroa ne, aku nèngu na, ina! lamatua patalale le j'aj'èra nèti èu.

source_text: then he placed his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify god.
target_text: ka yesus tao ai mi bhèni ne. kaca'a laa, kabodho bhèni ne mola dènge kahèi. hèia bhèni ne manèngi makasi, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: but the synagogue leader was indignant that jesus had healed on the sabbath. there are six days for work, he told the crowd. so come and be healed on those days and not on the sabbath.
target_text: te ngaa kapala èmu sabaj'a ne nasa, lula yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. ka na peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ca migu, dhèu sab'a èna lod'o. de be'a risi dhèu pèd'a mai lèke dènge lod'o-lod'o sab'a sèra, sèna ka tenge dhèu puri-pa'èle si. baku mai lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a!

source_text: you hypocrites! the lord replied. does not each of you on the sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, heeh! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, miu sab'a kahèi, si? te miu lami patabuli sapi dènge keled'ei miu, sèna ka hia ra'a-rinu, si?

source_text: then should not this daughter of abraham, whom satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the sabbath day?
target_text: bhèni ne, ana-èpu abraham sama sèmi èdhi. dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra ne canguru aru tèu kèna. ladhe ja'a patabuli ne nèti nidhu, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, na èèna sala, do?

source_text: when jesus said this, all his adversaries were humiliated. and the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things he was doing.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka musu yesus sèra makae. te ngaa dhèu ae dhu leo sèra karej'e, lula sasab'a na sèra be'a titu kèna.

source_text: then jesus asked, what is the kingdom of god like? to what can i compare it?
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pasoro dhèu-dhèu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. it grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna rèngu ciki di, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu sèmi aj'u dhu lamusi na ana iiki-iiki. dhèu sèle ne ètu d'ara oka. ka muri mai, hèia j'aj'i ana aaj'u dhu kapai aae. èèna ka manu-bhui mai tao rèd'a ètu dadana na sèra.

source_text: again he asked, to what can i compare the kingdom of god?
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a pasoro dhèu unu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.
target_text: nèngu ne nuka sèmi ragi dhu dhèu bhèni nare, ho na pab'ali dènge tarigu dua saku, sèna ka tao roti pa'ae. lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e èèna, pab'ali dènge tarigu ae-ae, hèia ca'e aa'i. dhèu unu lamatua pangaru ra asa tabha kapai sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: then jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way toward jerusalem.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai kako lasi asa kota yerusalem. rèngu kako, lasi dhuli kota-kota dènge rae-rae, ho na aj'a dhèu.

source_text: lord, someone asked him, will only a few people be saved? jesus answered,
target_text: d'ai era èci, ka ca dhèu karèi ne, ama mese! ele boe dhèu ciki di, dhu abhu sod'a, do?

source_text: make every effort to enter through the narrow door. for many, i tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hèb'a maso asa sorga èèna, kob'o. de tenge j'ara paie-iie, sèna ka miu bisa maso re èèna. te abhu dhèu ae dhu sèku neo maso, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: after the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘lord, open the door for us. ' but he will reply, ‘i do not know where you are from. '
target_text: ladhe lamatua èmu patèke le babèdho, èèna na miu titu ètu li'u, ho kad'eu babèdho, dènge pa'oo manèngi, peka na, ‘ama! bhoke ku laa! ' te ngaa na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘miu sèra, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu! '

source_text: then you will say, ‘we ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets. '
target_text: hèia miu peka hari, na, ‘nga tao ka ama tadhe boe ji'i? ji'i se ka dhu tema madhèdi nga'a-nginu dènge ama. aa ama kahèi dhu tema aj'a-nori ji'i ètu j'ara oka-hoo ji'i. '

source_text: and he will answer, ‘i tell you, i do not know where you are from. depart from me, all you evildoers. '
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘deo na ja'a dhu peka le, na, ja'a tadhe boe miu! miu se, dhèu dhu tema ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. de pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! '

source_text: there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see abraham, isaac, jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of god, but you yourselves are thrown out.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, miu tangi roma iisi dènge kadhi ngutu lii kico-kico. te miu ladhe mèdhi baki abraham, isak dènge yakob, dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, madhèdi le ètu sorga. te ngaa miu lèke babège asa li'u.

source_text: people will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of god.
target_text: pe dhèu mai nèti suu-suu rai-haha ne, nèti dhimu, nèti haa; nèti badae, nèti balèu, ho aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi pa'èci, ra'a-rinu rame-rame ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua.

source_text: and indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a j'ara ne'e: ladhe d'ai ka lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, pangee, na, nèngu ana iiki d'ai seli, aa te ngaa nèngu kab'ua titu kèna. aa abhu dhu uru èèna peka, na, nèngu dhèu kapai, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu dhoka ana iiki di.

source_text: at that very hour, some pharisees came to jesus and told him, leave this place and get away, because herod wants to kill you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, na, hua iia ama mese pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e, te dhèu aae herodes neo pamadhe ama.

source_text: but jesus replied, go tell that fox, ‘look, i will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day i will reach my goal. ' nevertheless, i must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of jerusalem.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, herodes ne, cakaraa badha dhu d'èlu-mèu kapod'e-kabèli. lami peka dènge nèngu, na, ja'a bata eele nidhu dènge pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra, deo ne'e ne dènge bèli. camèd'a ku, sasab'a ja'a ne heka èle kèna. masi ka tasa mera mia èèna ka, nèti kakako ja'a asa yerusalem ne, ja'a neo sab'a hari ku ciki. te dhèu yerusalem sèra, dhu d'èi pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: o jerusalem, jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often i have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
target_text: waa, dhèu kabarai yerusalem, ee! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra dhu mai pad'elo j'ara hia miu. pèri-pèri hari le, ja'a neo kaboko miu ho bhiri mi nèti bhelu-katub'a, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu sarimu nare ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu mo'o boe.

source_text: look, your house is left to you desolate. and i tell you that you will not see me again until you say, ‘blessed is he who comes in the name of the lord. '
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua pusi-pahae heka èmu manèngi-mangaj'i miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu j'aj'i èmu pa'ela. èèna na, miu mèdhi heka ja'a, toke miu dhaa, na, ‘ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu mai nèti kolongara ama lamatua, lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia na mai! '

source_text: one sabbath, jesus went to eat in the home of a leading pharisee, and those in attendance were watching him closely.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ca dhèu ama nèti partei agama parisi nèru yesus ho ra'a-sisi ètu èmu na. ropa yesus madhèdi na'a, abhu dhèu dhu ma'u, neo rèdhi ne tao ngaa lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: right there before him was a man with dropsy.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a boho madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: so jesus asked the experts in the law and the pharisees, is it lawful to heal on the sabbath or not?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora yahudi dènge dhèu parisi dhu madhèdi ra'a ètu sèra kahèi, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora nèti baki musa, bisa pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, do aad'o?

source_text: but they remained silent. then jesus took hold of the man, healed him, and sent him on his way.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci sa bhoka boe hèb'a. hèia yesus gai dhèu pèd'a ne, ka na èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ka yesus pua dhèu ne, sèna ka lèpa ka.

source_text: and he asked them, which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the sabbath day will not immediately pull him out?
target_text: èle ka yesus karèi hari si, peka na, ladhe ana èci manahu asa d'ara èi lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu lami ère eele ana ne'e, do aad'o? ladhe sapi manahu asa d'ara èi la'e, miu soro tèke, do, lami kaso ne asa li'u? tatu miu kaso ne asa li'u. de èèna, sasoa na, miu sab'a le, sina ma?

source_text: and they were unable to answer these questions.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus ne, èci sa bisa boe dhaa.

source_text: when jesus noticed how the guests chose the places of honor, he told them a parable:
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus taru kira mi dhèu mai ra'a-sisi ètu d'ara èmu ne. dhèu ae ka dhu d'èi era re madha, ho lasi madhèdi. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, yesus peka,

source_text: when you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe dhèu nèru miu asa pesta kab'i, mage lami madhèdi ka asa era dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. mage dhoka lamatua pesta ne nèru tamu dhu kapai risi.

source_text: then the host who invited both of you will come and tell you, ‘give this man your seat. ' and in humiliation, you will have to take the last place.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, lamatua pesta mai gai èu, peka na, ‘mage mu nasa kahèi, ama! ama pidha sa kabodho, ee. te ja'a tèke kadera ne hia dhèu kapai nèi. ' hèia èu kèd'i dènge makae, tèke eele kadera ne, ka lamu madhèdi asa kabodho.

source_text: but when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘friend, move up to a better place. ' then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.
target_text: de ladhe èu abhu nèru, lamu madhèdi ètu kadera re kabodho tèka. ropa lamatua pesta ladhe nèdhi èu, na mai peka, ‘ama! mai madhèdi asa madha ne. ' dènge j'ara ne, miu abhu pakab'ua ètu madha tamu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, èèna na lamatua pahaha si. te ngaa dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu haha, èèna na lamatua ded'e padedha si.

source_text: then jesus said to the man who had invited him, when you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, lod'o leo, ladhe ama neo tao tatao, mage nèru dhoka a'ari ama dènge dhèu kaja sèra mesa ra! te tatu rèngu bisa nèru hari ama.

source_text: but when you host a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama tao tatao, nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bèdhu sèra.

source_text: and you will be blessed. since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.
target_text: tatu rèngu b'ala rare boe ama. te ngaa ladhe ama nèru si, ama lamatua ka dhu b'ala ama. ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe le, na bhèlu boe babe'a ama.

source_text: when one of those reclining with him heard this, he said to jesus, blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of god.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ca mei dènge yesus, padhai lii, peka na, dhu karej'e risi ka, rèngu dhu madhutu ra'a pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua!

source_text: but jesus replied, a certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a lolo sèmi ne'e: abhu ca dhèu dhu tao tatao kapai. hèia na nèru dhèu ae titu kèna.

source_text: when it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘come, for everything is now ready. '
target_text: ropa d'ai tadha dhèu ra'a-rinu, ka na pua ènu na, la'e paroa dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, peka na, ‘mai lati ka, te neo mulai pesta kèna. '

source_text: but one after another they all began to make excuses. the first one said, ‘i have bought a field, and i need to go see it. please excuse me. '
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e padhai lii rupa-rupa, sèna ka lasi boe asa d'ara pesta. ca dhèu peka sèmi ne'e, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore oka cue, de neo laku ladhe sèku. de mage nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe. '

source_text: another said, ‘i have bought five yoke of oxen, and i am going to try them out. please excuse me. '
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore sapi maroo rai lèmi pasa. de ja'a neo laku cob'a si. baku nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe! '

source_text: still another said, ‘i have married a wife, so i cannot come. '
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka kab'i kèna, de bisa boe dhiu. '

source_text: the servant returned and reported all this to his master. then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame. '
target_text: ka ènu ne, lèpa peka dènge lamatua na. ropa tadèngi nare, ka nasa titu kèna. hèia na paredha ènu na, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, èu lamu lai-lai! lamu asa j'ara-j'ara, dènge asa sasanga j'ara ètu kota ne'e, sèna ka nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu kasia, dhu haga roe cabèka, dhu bèdhu, dènge dhèu-dhèu karuku sèra. '

source_text: ‘sir, ' the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room. '
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, la'e dènge ka nèru dhèu-dhèu sèra. ka na lèpa hari, hèia na peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! dhèu se, ka se'e le. te ngaa era madhèdi ae era. '

source_text: so the master told his servant, ‘go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
target_text: hèia lamatua na peka, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, lamu hari asa rae-rae ètu li'u kota, toke d'ai d'ara oka sèi. lamu pamako sad'i cee èèna ka, mèti si mai ho ra madhèdi papènu d'ara pesta ne.

source_text: for i tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet. '
target_text: nanene, ee! dhèu dhu pahae boe dènge lii nèru ja'a ne, rèngu se re'a boe babe'a tatao ne ciki sa hèi! '

source_text: large crowds were now traveling with jesus, and he turned and said to them,
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa yerusalem. dhèu ae madhutu ne. hèia na kabib'a ladhe sa rèngu, ka na peka, na,

source_text: if anyone comes to me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters-yes, even his own life-he cannot be my disciple.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra; risi nèti ina-ama na, risi nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, risi nèti ana niki na, risi nèti a'ari na, aa risi-risi hari nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and whoever does not carry his cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.
target_text: te dhèu dhu d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu pasae j'aj'èra na taruu.

source_text: which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
target_text: de ladhe neo madhutu ja'a, ngee pabe'a-be'a ku. nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao èmu dhu dènge tad'a-tad'a. nèngu hud'i ige uuru ku, ogo d'ai lutu sela. mage dhoka doi d'ai boe.

source_text: otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
target_text: ladhe ige boe paie-iie, ele boe d'ai fanderen di, doi dhu aad'o heka le. ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu mari madhe aa pamakae ne hèi,

source_text: saying, ‘this man could not finish what he started to build. '
target_text: peka na, ‘miu ladhe ku dhèu ne'e laa! heka na sab'e fanderen kèna, te ngaa doi na saku aa'i le! '

source_text: or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
target_text: conto dhu leo, nuka sèmi dhèu lasi pamusu. dhèu aae dhu neo la'e pamusu hud'i madhèdi ku, sèna ka pare'a uuru ku dènge angalai na. ladhe sordad'u rèngu dhoka canguru riho dhèu di, bisa segi musu dua nguru riho dhèu, do aad'o?

source_text: and if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
target_text: ladhe ige rare, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe segi, be'a risi lod'o musu dhu kaj'èu era, ra pua dhèu lasi peka sèna ka uri padame.

source_text: in the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be my disciple.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. nèngu hud'i kali bagi ku la'e-mai, dhu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èra le tèke eele aa'i ngaa-ngaa, do aad'o? te ladhe aad'o, na, dhèu ne'e nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned? it is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. he who has ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: yesus tuhu lii padhai pake lii pakasame dhu leo hari, na, masi ne, be'a. èdhi pake ne ho pabe'a nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe na sèro heka, j'aj'i ngaa hari? bisa heka pake ne, ho pabe'a nganga'a. neo tao mi pupuk, bisa boe kahèi. dhodhoka core eele iia d'ara di. dhèu cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, nanene paie-iie!

source_text: now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu roro bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe mai ae-ae asa yesus, sèna ka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa dhèu yahudi peka, na, rèngu sèra dhèu karehe.

source_text: so the pharisees and scribes began to grumble: this man welcomes sinners and eats with them.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu parisi dènge mese agama yahudi sèra ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, huuh! dhèu ne pa'angalai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu laku boe se. ngaa hari na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge si!

source_text: then jesus told them this parable:
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus lolo dènge ra lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: what man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu unu kahib'i-kalèbho cangasu ngi'u. ka ci'u ele. na tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele dhu ceo nguru ceo se ètu era dhu be'a, aa la'e tenge dhu ele deo na, toke rage ne.

source_text: and when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari kahib'i-kalèbho ne, ka na pasae nèti, dènge karej'e-karae.

source_text: comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘rejoice with me, for i have found my lost sheep! '
target_text: d'ai èmu, ka na paroa angalai na aa'i-aa'i, hèia na peka dènge si, ‘mai, sèna ka karej'e dènge ja'a! te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu ele èèna, kèdhi hari le. '

source_text: in the same way, i tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
target_text: ètu sorga, sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ca dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia ele-ho'a, ka na lèpa hari asa lamatua, ana kabarai sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae. rèngu karej'e risi lula ca dhèu dhu lèpa hari asa lamatua, nèti ceo nguru ceo dhèu dhu mamuri mola, dhu sala boe j'ara.

source_text: or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
target_text: ka yesus lolo hari lii pakasame dhu leo èci, peka na, abhu ca dhèu ina, dhu doi iia na canguru bua. ne'a na, dhu ele ca doi. ka na tao tasamia? tatu la'e suru labhu ho d'elo palème era, aa saku èmu ne d'ai ro'a kakilu, sèna ka tenge doi cue dhu ele ne.

source_text: and when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘rejoice with me, for i have found my lost coin. '
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari doi ne, na paroa dènge dhèu dhu ètu baboa èmu na sèra, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘miu mai, ho karej'e sama-sama dènge ja'a. te doi ja'a cue dhu ele deo na, kèdhi hari le! '

source_text: in the same way, i tell you, there is joy in the presence of god's angels over one sinner who repents.
target_text: ètu sorga sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu tao sala, ka na ele-ho'a, ho lèpa hari asa ama lamatua, tatu ana pajuu ètu sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae.

source_text: then jesus said, there was a man who had two sons.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na dènge lii pakasame kahèi, peka na, ama ca dhèu dènge ana mone na dhèu dua.

source_text: the younger son said to him, ‘father, give me my share of the estate. ' so he divided his property between them.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana limuri peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! hia ka pala ja'a nèti pusaka sèra, deo ne'e ne kahèi! ' hèia ama na bagi hia dua ra pusaka na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge pala ra.

source_text: after a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka ana limuri ne pahie unu na. hèia na lalau mèdha na, ka la'e asa rae kaj'èu. ètu era nèi, ana limuri ne pasaku aa'i-aa'i doi-dhari na, ho pakarej'e iisi.

source_text: after he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
target_text: ropa doi na èle aa'i mèu-mèu, rai ne dhu lèke manganga bia, ka mamuri ana ne j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: so he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
target_text: ka la'e tenge sasab'a. hèia ca dhèu nèti kabarai èèna hia na panga'a hahi.

source_text: he longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
target_text: lula ana ne manganga d'ai seli, ka neo na'a nganga'a hahi se. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hia ne na'a.

source_text: finally he came to his senses and said, ‘how many of my father's hired servants have plenty of food? but here i am, starving to death!
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, ka na pangee la'e-mai, aku nèngu na, ‘anga ee! ja'a ètu ne'e, oe madhe manganga kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ama ku, dhèu sab'a ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: i will get up and go back to my father and say to him, father, i have sinned against heaven and against you.
target_text: de be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku, ho peka dènge ne, ama! ja'a tao le sala dhu kapai titu kèna, mi lamatua dènge ama.

source_text: i am no longer worthy to be called your son. make me like one of your hired servants. '
target_text: ja'a nia boe j'aj'i ana ama ku. hud'i laa ama sèmi more ja'a ne j'aj'i mi kuli ètu d'ara èmu ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: so he got up and went to his father. but while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. he ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
target_text: ropa pangee nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa la'e asa èmu ama na. nèti kaj'èu era, ama na ladhe nèdhi le nèngu, ka ama na rasa kasia. ka na puru nèti èmu, rai la'e soru nare ana dhu lèpa hari ne. hèia na liku nare, ka uu ne.

source_text: the son declared, ‘father, i have sinned against heaven and against you. i am no longer worthy to be called your son. '
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana ne peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ne tao le sala dhu kapai mi dedha lamatua dènge ama ku. ja'a nia heka j'aj'i hari ana ama. '

source_text: but the father said to his servants, ‘quick! bring the best robe and put it on him. put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
target_text: te ngaa ama na paredha dènge ka dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, peka na, ‘karohe! lami mere kodho madhera dhu be'a risi, ho papake ne. mere kadheli, ho pasaluu mi kacui-aai na. aa papake salapa mi haga na.

source_text: bring the fattened calf and kill it. let us feast and celebrate.
target_text: lami ère mere sapi kab'oi èèna ho pare, te èdhi neo ta'a-tinu rame-rame.

source_text: for this son of mine was dead and is alive again! he was lost and is found! ' so they began to celebrate.
target_text: lula ana ja'a ne, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa ja'a abhu hari ne. ' na padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, ka mulai ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana uuru dhu aad'o ètu èmu, te na sab'a ètu d'ara oka. ropa na lèpa, nèti kaj'èu era, na tadèngi le dhèu karihu musiik dènge roge-ledho.

source_text: so he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
target_text: ka na paroa nare dhèu sab'a ca dhèu, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ee! tao rarame ngaa ètu ne'e?

source_text: ‘your brother has returned, ' he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound. '
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ari mu lèpa hari le. de ama mu pua pare sapi, sèna ka tao pesta kapai, te ana na lèpa hari dènge sod'a. '

source_text: the older son became angry and refused to go in. so his father came out and pleaded with him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia ana uuru ne pasaree. na no'o boe maso asa d'ara èmu. ka ama na la'e rarange ne.

source_text: but he answered his father, ‘look, all these years i have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. yet you never gave me even a young goat so i could celebrate with my friends.
target_text: te ngaa na ka'ugu, peka na, ‘ama! pangee ku laa! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae, nuka sèmi kuli sa, hia mi ama. ja'a ne ke'a boe sisu dad'èi ama. masi ka sèmi èèna, abhu mèka ama hia ana kahib'i ci'u, sèna ka ja'a pakarej'e dènge mone aanga-angalai ja'a.

source_text: but when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him! '
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana ama dhu bhera-lelu doi-dhari ama, ho la'e karihu dènge bhèni karehe, lèpa hari mai, ka ama pare sapi kab'oi na, tao pesta aae hia ne. '

source_text: ‘son, you are always with me, ' the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
target_text: te ngaa ama na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ana pasue, ee! nanene paie-iie. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, èu ne bera-bera dènge ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ja'a, sèra sa unu èu kahèi.

source_text: but it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found. '
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i karej'e dènge karae ku, lula ari mu ca dhèu ne. uru èèna, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa limuri ne mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa abhu hari. '

source_text: jesus also said to his disciples, there was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
target_text: ka yesus hia lii upama èci mi ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu dhu ded'e dhèu sab'a na èci j'aj'i kapala urusan. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, na tadèngi dhèu palolo, peka na, kapala urusan ne mulai kapod'e-kabèli ka parugi nèngu.

source_text: so he called him in to ask, ‘what is this i hear about you? turn in an account of your management, for you cannot be manager any longer. '
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne paroa kapala urusan na, ka peka dènge ne, ‘èu ne, tasamia? ja'a tadèngi, na, èu kapod'e mèdha-panyau ja'a. de lamu suri ku ngaa dhu èu ad'u-ue ètu d'ara sasab'a èu, ho ja'a parisa ku. ladhe parisa kore, ja'a kalua eele èu. '

source_text: the manager said to himself, ‘what shall i do, now that my master is taking away my position? i am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, hèia kapala urusan ne mulai pajiko, na, ‘ja'a ne j'èra kèna! ja'a neo sab'a ngaa hari? pare rai, ja'a èra boe. j'aj'i dhèu hèb'a mènyi, ja'a makae.

source_text: i know what i will do, so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes. '
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a heka ètu ne'e, ja'a hud'i tenge j'ara ku, sèna ka dhèu leo bisa hari sèmi rare ja'a ho sab'a. '

source_text: and he called in each one of his master's debtors. ‘how much do you owe my master? ' he asked the first.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na paroa nare aa'i dhèu dhu pakèlu lamatua na. na karèi dhèu uru, aku nèngu na, ‘ee! kèlu èu ca ngaa ètu lamatua ja'a? '

source_text: ‘a hundred measures of olive oil, ' he answered. ‘take your bill, ' said the manager. ‘sit down quickly, and write fifty. '
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ja'a dhu pakèlu èi lèngi saitun èpa riho liter. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘tare'a. sasuri pakèlu èu ka ne'e. ciu eele ka, madhèdi ho suri gati sasuri kèlu dhu hiu, peka na, kèlu èu dua riho liter di. '

source_text: then he asked another, ‘and how much do you owe? ' ‘a hundred measures of wheat, ' he replied. ‘take your bill and write eighty, ' he told him.
target_text: ka karèi dhèu pakèlu ka dua, peka na, ‘aa èu hari, kèlu ca ngaa? ' ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, ‘ja'a pakèlu are, cariho karo. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘ciu eele sasuri dhui èèna, ho suri dhu hiu hari, peka na, kèlu èu, aru ngasu karo di. '

source_text: the master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. for the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
target_text: na tao sèmi ne'e ka, toke lamatua na ne'a tatao nèngu. te ngaa lamatua ne hud'i mangaku, na, dhèu kapala urusan dhu bhelu ne mema mèu kapod'e-kabèli. de ja'a lolo lii upama ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ladhe pasoro dènge dhèu parcaya, dhèu dhu parcaya boe d'èlu-mèu risi tenge j'ara ho pa'oto ngi'u ra ètu talora aae kabarai limuri ne.

source_text: i tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal dwellings.
target_text: miu ngee sèku. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne karihu kaj'alu re mèdha-panyau ra, te ngaa be'a risi miu pake mèdha-panyau miu sèra, ho soru-bara dhèu. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu abhu angalai ae. masi ka mèdha se èle, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a lamatua tao tèke era hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mola ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na mola kahèi ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mèu kapod'e ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na kapod'e kahèi ètu j'ara dhu kapai.

source_text: so if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
target_text: ladhe dhèu parcaya heka miu, ho uri mèdha-panyau ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki ètu rai-haha ne, tasamia ka lamatua parcaya miu ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai?

source_text: and if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
target_text: ladhe miu bisa boe uri mèdha-panyau dhèu leo, na, dhèu cee ka dhu bani ho hia miu mèdha-panyau ra?

source_text: no servant can serve two masters. either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. you cannot serve both god and money.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èci bisa boe nanene dua lamatua. te aad'o na, nèngu d'èi boe èci, aa sue èci. nèngu d'ara kateme dènge ca dhèu, te ngaa pusi boe dènge èci. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. te dhèu bisa boe sue ama lamatua palere dènge sue doi-dhari.

source_text: the pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all of this and were scoffing at jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri dhu nanene lii padhai yesus deo na. ka ra sasei ne, lula rèngu se dhèu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: so he said to them, you are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but god knows your hearts. for what is prized among men is detestable before god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge si, masi ka miu pamèu iisi ètu madha dhèu, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a d'ara bhelu miu. abhu j'ara ae dhu dhèu rai-haha ded'e padedha-dedha, te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, j'ara sèra karehe, aa dhu madenge dènge rèngu.

source_text: the law and the prophets were proclaimed until john. since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of god is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
target_text: toke mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi muri madhutu atora nèti baki musa aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia. dhèu ae dhu tenge le j'ara, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: but it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the law.
target_text: masi ka dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa atora nèti ama lamatua ciki sa, ele boe. ca katèd'a sa ele boe hèi!

source_text: anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu na, aa na madhèdi hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu bersina. aa dhèu dhu leo dènge bhèni dhu pa'ia-pa'ela, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.
target_text: ka yesus lole tabha hari, peka na, abhu dhèu kaja ca dhèu. nèngu d'èi pake mèdha-papake dhu be'a-be'a, tao nèti bèla alus. mèu-mèda na'a-ninu nganga'a dhu be'a hua, aa karae taruu.

source_text: and a beggar named lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores
target_text: ètu kota ne'e, abhu kahèi ca dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ngara na, lasarus. ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge kamèu. bèli-bèli angalai na rèti pamadhèdi ne ètu hèb'a tedhe dhèu kaja èèna.

source_text: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man's table. even the dogs came and licked his sores.
target_text: na sanao teko-teko abhu kaha'i nganga'a nèti dhèu kaja ne, sèna ka bisa na'a, te ngaa na abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka busa di mai, ho j'ore nana kamèu na.

source_text: one day the beggar died and was carried by the angels to abraham's side. and the rich man also died and was buried.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, lasarus madhe. hèia ana pajuu ama lamatua mai nèti sorga, ka rèti lasi pamadhèdi ne ètu baboa abraham. aa nèbhu boe ka, dhèu kaja ne madhe kahèi, ka dhèu ded'e lasi padhane.

source_text: in hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw abraham from afar, with lazarus by his side.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne maso boe sorga. nèngu maso asa d'ara naraka, sama-sama dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhe le. ètu era nèi, dhèu kaja ne abhu j'aj'èra taa-taa. ca tèka na boti kètu, ka ladhe nèdhi lasarus madhèdi ètu baboa baki abraham.

source_text: so he cried out, ‘father abraham, have mercy on me and send lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. for i am in agony in this fire. '
target_text: hèia na pa'oo, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! sue ku ja'a laa! pua ku lasarus cèb'u kolo ai na asa d'ara èi, sèna ka mai pabasa ku kolo he'o ja'a ne. te ja'a j'èra titu kèna ètu d'ara ai naraka ne! '

source_text: but abraham answered, ‘child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, while lazarus received bad things. but now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ana, ee! sanèd'e ku! uru èèna lod'o èu mamuri era ètu rai-haha nèi, èu abhu le aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. te ngaa lasarus ne, unu dhodhoka sasusa di. ka limuri ne, lamatua pakarej'e ne ètu ne'e, te ngaa èu pasae more j'aj'èra.

source_text: and besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that even those who wish cannot cross from here to you, nor can anyone cross from there to us. '
target_text: risi-risi hari, ètu talora aae èu dènge ji'i, lamatua tao tèke loe aae èci dhu taleo dènge marèma. de dhèu nèti ne'e bisa boe dhiu asa era èèna, aa dhèu nèti èèna bisa boe pège sa ne'e mai. '

source_text: ‘then i beg you, father, ' he said, ‘send lazarus to my father's house,
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, baki abraham pua lasarus la'e asa èmu ama ku.

source_text: for i have five brothers. let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment. '
target_text: te ja'a ne dènge ari dhèu mone, dhèu lèmi era. sèna ka lasarus la'e pasanèd'e si, ho ra lèpa ka asa lamatua. masi ka lod'o d'ai ra madhe, rèngu maso ia ka asa era j'aj'èra ne. '

source_text: but abraham replied, ‘they have moses and the prophets; let your brothers listen to them. '
target_text: te ngaa abraham b'ala ne, ‘ama lamatua hia le rèngu sasuri nèti baki musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na. ari mu si, bisa baca pahari-pahari ho re'a dad'èi lamatua. '

source_text: ‘no, father abraham, ' he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent. '
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne pasisu, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! èèna dhae d'ai mèka. rèngu sèi pahae boe lii holo-nori ama lamatua! hud'i abhu ku ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu madhe la'e asa rèngu, heka rèngu ele-ho'a, aa neo nanene kèna. '

source_text: then abraham said to him, ‘if they do not listen to moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead. '
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ladhe rèngu sèi ro'o boe nanene lii holo-nori nèti musa dènge nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, na, masi ka dhèu madhe bhodho nèti d'ara ro'a ra, ho padhai lii dènge rèngu èèna ka, rèngu ro'o boe nanene. '

source_text: jesus said to his disciples, it is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
target_text: yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ae ka dhèu manahu asa d'ara sasala, lula tatao dhèu leo. te ngaa dhèu dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala èèna, pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: it would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, toke ana iiki parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne bia. dhu samaa risi, ladhe èki ladha goro dhèu ne'e dènge hadhu aae cue, ho parèu eele asa d'ara dhasi ètu talora lèu.

source_text: watch yourselves. if your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
target_text: de j'aga ngi'u pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu baku pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala! te ngaa ladhe a'ari mu tao sala, pasanèd'e ne. ladhe na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai manèngi abho, na pabhèlu eele sasala na.

source_text: even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘i repent, ' you must forgive him.
target_text: ladhe a'ari èu tao sala pidhu hari d'ara ca lod'o, ka na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai pidhu hari ho manèngi abho, èu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na pidhu hari kahèi.

source_text: the apostles said to the lord, increase our faith!
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu se mai asa yesus, ka ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! parcaya ji'i se èra boe. de ama pa'èra ku parcaya ji'i.

source_text: and the lord answered, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘be uprooted and planted in the sea, ' and it will obey you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe miu parcaya koasa nèti ama lamatua, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, te ngaa miu bisa paredha aj'u aae ne, ‘tahoi eele, ho pidha asa d'ara dhasi! ' ka aj'u ne madhutu lii paredha miu.

source_text: which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘come at once and sit down to eat'?
target_text: èle ka yesus lii, aku nèngu na, tare conto èci. nuka sèmi ènu dhu pare rai ètu d'ara oka, do, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. sab'a nare, ka lèpa sa èmu. tatu lamatua na peka boe dènge ne, ‘mai ho dua ti ta'a sama-sama! '

source_text: instead, won't he tell him, ‘prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while i eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink'?
target_text: aad'o, sina ma? dhu lèke ka, lamatua paredha ne, peka na, ‘lamu lalau mei hia ja'a. ku'a-kinu kore ku, pe èu mu'a-minu ètu kabodho nèi! '

source_text: does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
target_text: ladhe ènu ne lalau nare madhutu dad'èi lamatua na, miu ngee, na, lamatua ne manèngi makasi mi ènu ne, do? aad'o!

source_text: so you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘we are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty. '
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi. ladhe sab'a mere aa'i dhu lamatua paredha le, miu peka na, ‘ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri. ji'i dhoka pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i di. '

source_text: while jesus was on his way to jerusalem, he was passing between samaria and galilee.
target_text: lod'o yesus si lasi asa yerusalem, rèngu d'ai too propensi galilea dènge propensi samaria.

source_text: as he entered one of the villages, he was met by ten lepers. they stood at a distance
target_text: ropa rèngu neo maso asa d'ara rae cue ètu èèna, dhèu canguru dhu pèd'a kusta mai, neo paraga dènge yesus. rèngu se titu nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: and raised their voices, shouting, jesus, master, have mercy on us!
target_text: ka ra pa'oo palere-lere, peka na, yesus! mone kapai, ee! sue ku ji'i laa!

source_text: when jesus saw them, he said, go, show yourselves to the priests. and as they were on their way, they were cleansed.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii pa'oo ra, ka na ladhe si, hèia na pua, aku nèngu na, lami pad'elo uuru ku isi miu asa ama agama, sèna ka ra parisa papèd'a kusta miu sèra, èle le, do dhae! ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka lasi dènge. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa, rèngu dhu èle le nèti kusta.

source_text: when one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising god in a loud voice.
target_text: rèngu lasi taruu dènge karej'e-karae. te ngaa abhu ca dhèu di, dhu lèpa hari mai asa yesus. na pa'oo, peka na, koa-kio lamatua! te ja'a èle le nèti papèd'a!

source_text: he fell facedown at jesus' feet in thanksgiving to him-and he was a samaritan.
target_text: hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho manèngi makasi ae-ae mi yesus. te'a boe, te nèngu ne dhèu yahudi boe. nèngu ne ca dhèu samaria dhu loe boe tao lii langu dènge dhèu yahudi.

source_text: were not all ten cleansed? jesus asked. where then are the other nine?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu sèra dhu madhutu dènge ne, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? deo na ja'a pa'èle dhèu canguru si? dhu ceo, mia lasi?

source_text: was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to god?
target_text: tasamia ka dhoka dhèu leo kara ne'e di, dhu lèpa mai ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, dènge koa-kio kolongara na?

source_text: then jesus said to him, rise and go; your faith has made you well!
target_text: hèia na peka mi dhèu ne, na, èu èle le, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. de kèd'i, lèpa ka dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: when asked by the pharisees when the kingdom of god would come, jesus replied, the kingdom of god will not come with observable signs. nor will people say, ‘look, here it is, ' or ‘there it is. ' for you see, the kingdom of god is in your midst.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! peka ku dènge ji'i, lod'o mia ama lamatua neo pakako paredha na? ka yesus dhaa, sèmi ne'e. mage mi pangee, na, lamatua pakako paredha na dènge rupa-rupa tadha ètu rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. dhèu abhu boe tadha dhu peka na, ‘ladhe ku asa ne'e mai! te ama lamatua pakako paredha na ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘na pakako paredha na ètu nèi! ' aad'o! te na pakako paredha na ètu talora aae miu, ètu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: then he said to the disciples, the time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the son of man, but you will not see it.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, nèbhu boe, na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, pa'èci heka dènge miu. d'ai ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, miu d'èi titu kèna neo mèdhi mamai hari ja'a. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o mamai ja'a.

source_text: people will tell you, ‘look, there he is! ' or ‘look, here he is! ' do not go out or chase after them.
target_text: ladhe èèna na dhèu mai peka, na, ‘kristus ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘kristus ètu nèi! ' na, miu baku bhute ho patangi-tenge, te lii padhai rèngu sèra, kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: for just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the son of man in his day.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi bela dhu heo kacèb'a ètu dedha-liru nèti suu asa suu.

source_text: but first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu hud'i abhu uuru ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. ka dhèu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ro'o boe nanene, aa neo tule eele ne.

source_text: just as it was in the days of noah, so also will it be in the days of the son of man:
target_text: te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na neo mai hari, dhèu mamuri karehe sama biasa, èci èèna ka dènge lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: people were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day noah entered the ark. then the flood came and destroyed them all.
target_text: taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, tao pesta kab'i toke lod'o noh maso asa d'ara kapa na. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe nanene kahèi. kaca'a laa, èi aae lala, ka pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: it was the same in the days of lot: people were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o lot mamuri era, dhèu mamuri karehe titu kèna. taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, bad'aga, sab'a oka-tedhe, patitu èmu, aa mamuri karehe sèmi biasa.

source_text: but on the day lot left sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
target_text: te ngaa ro'o boe nanene kahèi. hèia mad'ae aae era, ropa lot rai eele nèti kota sodom, cag'ag'a laa, èj'i ai dènge èi nasu bhori mai nèti dedha-liru, aa labhu pakèpu rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: it will be just like that on the day the son of man is revealed.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e ku! mage dhoka bèli-camèd'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, dhèu mamuri dhoka sèmi biasa di. te ngaa kaca'a laa, na cèu mai.

source_text: on that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu madha èmu, maso ia ka asa d'ara ho lalau mèdha. dhèu dhu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka asa èmu ho rare mèdha ra.

source_text: remember lot's wife!
target_text: sanèd'e ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu lot. na madhe, lula nèngu ngee mèdha-panyau ètu èmu na.

source_text: whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe madhutu ja'a lula sue ngi'u na, èèna na mamuri na ele iia d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a toke soro mamuri na, lula sue ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu sod'a-mole, aa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: i tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other left.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, ladhe dhèu dua j'unu ètu era èci, kabèdhi laa lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, èèna na lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: where, lord? they asked. jesus answered, wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu tadèngi rare, hèia ra karèi yesus, ama mese! sèra sa bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i ètu mia? ka yesus core lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ladhe miu mèdhi ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na, miu me'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, dhu peka na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna. dènge sasoa dhu pahuni, peka na, ladhe yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, sad'i dhèu re'a baca tadha sèra.

source_text: then jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
target_text: ca tèka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, pake lii pakasame ho rèngu loe boe manèngi-mangaj'i, aa baku ma'ète sanao-maena. rèngu hud'i parcaya taa-taa lamatua.

source_text: in a certain town there was a judge who neither feared god nor respected men.
target_text: lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: ètu d'ara kota cue, abhu ca dhèu ama pama'ète lii langu, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. na pahae boe ca dhèu sa hèi.

source_text: and there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘give me justice against my adversary. '
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu kahèi bhèni balu èci, dhu loe boe mai sa dhèu pama'ète lii ne, ho manèngi, peka na, ‘ama hakim! j'ue ku lii langu ja'a dènge mola! '

source_text: for a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘though i neither fear god nor respect men,
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna, dhèu pama'ète lii ne pusi boe dènge bhèni balu ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka, na roca nanene ne. hèia na madhèdi pangee ka, ‘mema ja'a ne pusi boe dènge ama lamatua, risi-risi dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: yet because this widow keeps pestering me, i will give her justice. then she will stop wearing me out with her perpetual requests. '
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne pakabo'o kètu ja'a. de be'a risi ja'a pama'ète lii na dènge mola. te ladhe ja'a panena, na mai taruu paj'èra ja'a. '

source_text: and the lord said, listen to the words of the unjust judge.
target_text: de miu pangee ku lii padhai dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bhelu ne.

source_text: will not god bring about justice for his elect who cry out to him day and night? will he continue to defer their help?
target_text: ladhe nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu pama'ète lii ne tao ai-hèb'a mi bhèni balu ne, tatu ama lamatua kahèi neo tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu unu na dhu sabaj'a mèu-mèda mi nèngu ho manèngi sasue na. te ngaa lamatua mate heka panèbhu.

source_text: i tell you, he will promptly carry out justice on their behalf. nevertheless, when the son of man comes, will he find faith on earth?
target_text: te nèngu uri lii langu rèngu dènge boe pamata. de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne mai hari, ja'a bisa paraga dènge dhèu parcaya ètu rai-haha ne era, do aad'o?

source_text: to some who trusted in their own righteousness and viewed others with contempt, he also told this parable:
target_text: ka yesus lolo tabha hari pake lii pakasame lula-nèti dhèu dhu pangee na ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu, aa dhu d'èi pahaha dhèu leo. na peka na,

source_text: two men went up to the temple to pray. one was a pharisee and the other a tax collector.
target_text: abhu ama dhèu dua dhu lasi sabaj'a asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, aa èci hari dhèu roro bea. dhèu yahudi peka na dhèu parisi sèra, dhèu dhu mola. te ngaa ra pangee, na, dhèu roro bea, dhèu karehe.

source_text: the pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘god, i thank you that i am not like the other men-swindlers, evildoers, adulterers-or even like this tax collector.
target_text: d'ai èmu sabaj'a dhèu parisi ne titu mesa-mesa na, ka na manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ‘makasi lamatua, te ja'a ne dhèu be'a. ja'a ne bhelu boe nuka sèmi dhèu leo sèra. ja'a mana'u boe. ja'a manga'a boe. ja'a dhèu dhu bersina boe. makasi lamatua, te ja'a ne bhelu boe nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea ne.

source_text: i fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that i acquire. '
target_text: ja'a ne maj'èni puasa ca migu dua hari. aa ja'a d'èi hia ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a abhu. ' dhèu parisi ne, sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but the tax collector stood at a distance, unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven. instead, he beat his breast and said, ‘god, have mercy on me, a sinner! '
target_text: te ngaa dhèu roro bea ne titu pakaj'èu ètu kabodho nèi. na bani boe boti kètu ho ladhe sa dedha. nèngu dhoka pacud'u di, dhu dènge d'ara ma'ète mae-mae. na sabaj'a, peka na, ‘ama lamatua! sue ku ja'a, dhèu dhu pènu dènge sasala-sasigo ne! abho eele ku sasala ja'a! '

source_text: i tell you, this man, rather than the pharisee, went home justified. for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.
target_text: lod'o dhèu dua se lèpa lasi asa èmu ra, cee ka dhu pabe'a dènge ama lamatua? dhèu parisi dhu pamone, do dhèu roro bea ne? tatu na sèmi dènge be'a, dhèu roro bea dhu pahaha iisi ne. te ngaa na pusi boe dènge dhèu parisi ne. te ama lamatua pahaha dhèu dhu pamone-pabhèni, te ngaa na padedha dhèu dhu re'a pahaha iisi.

source_text: now people were even bringing their babies to jesus for him to place his hands on them. and when the disciples saw this, they rebuked those who brought them.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu sa'u rèti ana ra dhu rara iisi hiu asa yesus, sèna ka na tao ai na mi ana iiki se, aa padhai lii hia si mamèngi. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu se'e.

source_text: but jesus called the children to him and said, let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them! for the kingdom of god belongs to such as these. truly i tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of god like a little child will never enter it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus soru mamai ra dènge be'a. hèia na kai ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. miu baku bhabhae si. sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, nèngu hud'i sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu sanao-maena dhoka mi ina-ama na.

source_text: then a certain ruler asked him, good teacher, what must i do to inherit eternal life?
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu kapai yahudi èci, mai karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a ne hud'i tao ku tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, ja'a maso sorga, aa mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: why do you call me good? jesus replied. no one is good except god alone.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, tasamia ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ‘dhu hua iia'? dhodhoka èci di dhu hua iia, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: you know the commandments: ‘do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother. '
target_text: èu me'a le atora ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: baku j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe èu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii dhu leko-monya; aa pakab'ua ina dènge ama mu.

source_text: all these i have kept from my youth, he said.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, tare'a, ama! ja'a dhu madhutu le atora sèra, karèi nèti ja'a ana iiki era.

source_text: on hearing this, jesus told him, you still lack one thing: sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. then come, follow me.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus peka, na, be'a! te ngaa èu kura ca madha j'ara era. nuka, lamu ho pahie mèdha-panyau èu aa'i-aa'i. kab'ua ra, lamu pabagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa sèra. èle na, èu lèpa hari mai sèna ka madhutu ja'a. te èèna na, ama lamatua b'ala hari mèdha-panyau èu ètu sorga.

source_text: but when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu ne d'ara na susa, te nèngu kaja d'ai seli.

source_text: seeing the man's sadness, jesus said, how hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of god!
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ne lèpa dènge d'ara na laho mae-mae, hèia na padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja mema carui titu kèna maso sorga.

source_text: indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of god.
target_text: èdhi pasèku ku dènge j'ara leo. mema bisa boe badha unta dhu kapai bisa maso asa d'ara oka na re ro'a j'aj'au. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu dhu maena dhoka mèdha-panyau na, te ngaa maena boe lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe maso sorga.

source_text: those who heard this asked, who then can be saved?
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi sèra, karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ladhe dhèu kaja carui maso sorga, dhèu sèmi mia ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri taa-taa?

source_text: but jesus said, what is impossible with man is possible with god.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, mi dhèu rai-haha, j'ara ae-ae mema carui. te ngaa bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: look, said peter, we have left all we had to follow you.
target_text: hèia petrus tuhu lii, peka na, ama! ji'i tèke eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ji'i, ka mai madhutu ama. bèli-camèd'a ji'i abhu ngaa?

source_text: truly i tell you, jesus replied, no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of god
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, petrus! nanene paie-iie. dhèu dhu tèke eele èmu na, dhèu èmu-kamali na, a'ari na, ina-ama na, do ana-ana na, lula nèngu pakako sasab'a ama lamatua,

source_text: will fail to receive many times more in this age-and in the age to come, eternal life.
target_text: tatu na abhu hari ae risi ètu rai-haha ne. aa ladhe èle rai-haha ne, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: then jesus took the twelve aside and said to them, look, we are going up to jerusalem, and everything the prophets have written about the son of man will be fulfilled.
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, ho lasi padhue-padhai mesa ra. hèia yesus peka dènge ra, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, èdhi kako ne, lati asa kota yerusalem. d'ai nèi, j'ara aa'i-aa'i nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra dhu suri tèke le, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, pe j'aj'i nuka sèmi dhu ra suri.

source_text: he will be delivered over to the gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
target_text: èèna na, ra soro ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. aa ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a, pahahe ja'a rupa-rupa, paru'e ilu ra mi ja'a,

source_text: they will flog him and kill him, and on the third day he will rise again.
target_text: ra hake kalabhe ja'a. èle èèna ka, ra pamadhe ja'a. te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but the disciples did not understand any of these things. the meaning was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend what he was saying.
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na bingu, lula rèngu dhane rare mèka sasoa nèti lii padhai yesus.

source_text: as jesus drew near to jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
target_text: lod'o yesus si oe maso kota jeriko, abhu dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu dhu madhèdi kanata ai ètu sebhe j'ara.

source_text: when he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu ae kako re èèna, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, ngaa ne?

source_text: jesus of nazareth is passing by, they told him.
target_text: ka dhèu peka dènge ne, na, yesus nèti nasaret dhu kako re ne'e.

source_text: so he called out, jesus, son of david, have mercy on me!
target_text: hèia dhèu bèdhu ne rodhe pamèdhu-mèdhu, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu dhèu aae daud, ee! sue ku ja'a!

source_text: those who led the way admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, son of david, have mercy on me!
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu kako uuru nèti yesus kai ne, sèna ka na mau-mau. te ngaa asa na hino dènge lii rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to him. when he had been brought near, jesus asked him,
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi, ka na titu. hèia na pua dhèu lasi pakako rèti dhèu bèdhu ne. d'ai madha na, ka yesus karèi ne,

source_text: what do you want me to do for you? lord, he said, let me see again.
target_text: èu neo ja'a tao ngaa hia èu? ka na dhaa, ama! ja'a manèngi sèna ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: receive your sight! jesus replied. your faith has healed you.
target_text: yesus b'ala ne, peka na, be'a. lula èu lèka na ja'a bisa pa'èle èu, de èu bisa mèdhi dènge kèna.

source_text: immediately he received his sight and followed jesus, glorifying god. and all the people who saw this gave praise to god.
target_text: kaca'a laa, musi madha dhèu ne be'a dènge ka. ka la'e madhutu yesus dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ladhe rèdhi ne, koa-kio kolongara lamatua kahèi.

source_text: then jesus entered jericho and was passing through.
target_text: ka yesus si maso re kota jeriko, ho neo lasi taruu.

source_text: and there was a man named zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu ca dhèu kapala roro bea dhu roro doi hia dhèu paredha roma. ngara na sakeos, aa nèngu ne dhèu kaja.

source_text: he was trying to see who jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi yesus kako re èèna, ka nèngu neo nèdhi. te ngaa bisa boe nèdhi dènge be'a, lula katitu na bab'a d'ai seli, aa dhèu ae dhu kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: so he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see him, since jesus was about to pass that way.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na rai uru, ka na ca'e asa kolo aj'u ca kapua ètu sebhe j'ara, dhu yesus neo re èèna.

source_text: when jesus came to that place, he looked up and said, zacchaeus, hurry down, for i must stay at your house today.
target_text: ropa d'ai kapua aj'u ne, yesus ladhe asa dedha. hèia na paroa, peka na, sakeos! puru ka! karohe, te deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a neo manubha ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: so zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed him joyfully.
target_text: ka sakeos malaa. hèia na puru pamèri-pamèri, la'e dènge yesus asa èmu na. d'ara na karej'e-karae.

source_text: and all who saw this began to grumble, saying, he has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu ka'ugu, peka na, hmm! sakeos ne, dhèu karehe! nga tao ka yesus manubha ètu d'ara èmu na? ! dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le!

source_text: but zacchaeus stood up and said to the lord, look, lord, half of my possessions i give to the poor, and if i have cheated anyone, i will repay it fourfold.
target_text: d'ai d'ara èmu, sakeos titu ètu madha yesus, ka lii, peka na, ama mese! nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a bagi mèdha-panyau ja'a mi dua, capala hia mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ladhe ja'a roro bea parisi, ja'a b'ae hari mi rèngu èpa kali lipat.

source_text: jesus said to him, today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of abraham.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, be'a. deo ne'e kahèi, ama lamatua pala-bagi sod'a-mole mi èu dènge isi èmu èu aa'i-aa'i, lula èu parcaya lamatua kahèi, nuka sèmi baki abraham.

source_text: for the son of man came to seek and to save the lost.
target_text: te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ètu rai-haha ne. mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka tenge dhèu dhu sero nèti j'ara lamatua, ho hia si sod'a-mole.

source_text: while the people were listening to this, jesus proceeded to tell them a parable, because he was near jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of god would appear imminently.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nanene lii padhai yesus. rèngu oe dètu dènge kota yerusalem. rèngu pangee, na, yesus neo pakako paredha ama lamatua ètu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu aae. hèia yesus lolo dènge si lii pakasame èci.

source_text: so he said, a man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.
target_text: na peka na, abhu dhèu kapai èci. neo la'e asa rai kaj'èu, ho dhèu ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu nèi. ladhe èle, nèngu neo lèpa hari mai ho j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu d'ara kabarai na.

source_text: beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘conduct business with this until i return, ' he said.
target_text: lod'o nèngu pa'èra neo pakèd'i, paroa nare dhèu sab'a na canguru dhèu, ka na bagi hia si ca dhèu, juru cue. na paredha si, peka na, ‘miu pake doi se j'aj'i mi poko. te lod'o d'ai ja'a lèpa, miu hud'i peka ku leto na ca ngaa. ' èle èèna ka, na pakèd'i.

source_text: but his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘we do not want this man to rule over us. '
target_text: te ngaa kabarai na d'èi boe ne. ka ra hia dhèu lasi peka, na, ‘ji'i ngo'o boe dhèu ne paredha ji'i. '

source_text: when he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ra ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia na lèpa hari ka. d'ai èmu na, ka na paroa dhèu sab'a na, dhèu canguru sèra, ka karèi si, peka na, ‘miu se leto ca ngaa nèti juru dhu ja'a hia miu sèra? '

source_text: the first servant came forward and said, ‘master, your mina has produced ten more minas. '
target_text: dhèu sab'a dhu uru, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a leto juru canguru bua nèti poko dhu ja'a abhu! '

source_text: his master replied, ‘well done, good servant! because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities. '
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge ne, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu maj'èni. lula ja'a bisa lèka èu nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki, nèti èèna ka karèi nèti deo ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha canguru kota. '

source_text: the second servant came and said, ‘master, your mina has made five minas. '
target_text: èle ka dhèu sab'a ka dua, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a abhu leto juru lèmi bua nèti poko dhu ja'a sèmi. '

source_text: and to this one he said, ‘you shall have authority over five cities. '
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka, na, ‘be'a! ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha lèmi kota. '

source_text: then another servant came and said, ‘master, here is your mina, which i have laid away in a piece of cloth.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu nèti hari juru na. ka na peka, ‘doi ama ka ne'e! ja'a rapi ka pahuni ne, mage ele.

source_text: for i was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. you withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow. '
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, lula madha'u. ja'a ke'a ama, dhèu nasa. te ama d'èi more ngaa dhu unu boe ama, aa d'èi puu hua dhu ama sèle boe! '

source_text: his master replied, ‘you wicked servant, i will judge you by your own words. so you knew that i am a harsh man, withdrawing what i did not deposit and reaping what i did not sow?
target_text: ropa dhèu aae tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka na jèke ne, ‘èu ne, dhèu goa d'ara! lii padhai èu ne pabia ngi'u èu mesa mu. èu me'a, na, ja'a dhèu nasa, ho kore ngaa dhu unu boe ja'a, aa puu ngaa dhu ja'a sèle boe.

source_text: why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return i could have collected it with interest? '
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka lamu boe tèke ne asa bank? ho sèna ka lod'o ja'a lèpa, ja'a bisa abhu leto. masi ka ciki di. '

source_text: then he told those standing by, ‘take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas. '
target_text: hèia dhèu aae ne pua dhèu leo ètu sèra, peka na, ‘mere doi nèngu ne, sèna ka hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto canguru deo na. '

source_text: ‘master, ' they said, ‘he already has ten! '
target_text: te ngaa ra pasisu, peka na, ‘ama! dhèu ne abhu ae le. nga tao ka neo more nèti dhèu dhu unu ciki, ho patabha sa nèngu hari? '

source_text: he replied, ‘i tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aae b'ala, peka na, ‘pangee paie-iie ku! ladhe dhèu dhu mèu uri ngaa dhu dhèu hia ne, èèna na nèngu abhu tabha hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, èèna na rare aa'i ngaa dhu na unu.

source_text: and these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me. '
target_text: de lami kèpe mere musu ja'a, dhu ro'o boe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae. mèti si mai sa ne'e, sèna ka pamadhe si ètu madha ja'a. lami ka! '

source_text: after jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa yesus lolo èle, hèia lasi taruu ka asa yerusalem. yesus dhu kako uru.

source_text: as he approached bethphage and bethany at the mount of olives, he sent out two of his disciples,
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge dua rae, nuka betfage dènge betania, dhu ètu karasa ledhe saitun, ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uru.

source_text: saying, go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. untie it and bring it here.
target_text: na pua si peka na, miu dua mi lami asa rae dhu ètu madha nèi. pe miu mèdhi keled'ei ngèru ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu èèna. keled'ei ne, dhèu manya'e rèdhi mèka. mi lècu dhari na, pakako mèti mai.

source_text: so those who were sent went out and found it just as jesus had told them.
target_text: dua ra lasi ka, hèia ra rage keled'ei ngèru nuka sèmi dhu yesus peka.

source_text: as they were untying the colt, its owners asked, why are you untying the colt?
target_text: ropa ra lècu dhari keled'ei ne, ka lamatua badha ne karèi si, na, nga tao ka miu patabuli badha ne?

source_text: the lord needs it, they answered.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne.

source_text: then they led the colt to jesus, threw their cloaks over it, and put jesus on it.
