source_text: as he rode along, the people spread their cloaks on the road.

source_text: and as he approached the descent from the mount of olives, the whole multitude of disciples began to praise god joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:
target_text: ropa na puru nèti ledhe saitun, ka dhèu se dènge ana-ana madhutu na, mulai pa'oo koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula rèngu rèdhi le tadha-tadha koasa.

source_text: blessed is the king who comes in the name of the lord! peace in heaven and glory in the highest!
target_text: ra pa'oo peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua pua mai! ama lamatua hia ne berkat! dhèu rai-haha limuri ne, bisa padame le dènge lamatua ètu sorga. koa-kio kolongara lamatua dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi.

source_text: but some of the pharisees in the crowd said to him, teacher, rebuke your disciples!
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu parisi ètu talora aae dhèu ae sèra. ka ra peka dènge yesus, ama mese! kai ku dhèu se, ho baku ra pakii-pakèce sèmi ne'e, te seli-kolane!

source_text: i tell you, he answered, if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ladhe dhèu se'e kutu hèb'a ra, èèna na, hadhu se ka dhu koa-kio kolongara lamatua!

source_text: as jesus approached jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu yerusalem, yesus ladhe nèdhi kota ne, hèia na tangi,

source_text: and said, if only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! but now it is hidden from your eyes.
target_text: peka na, ira ii! dhèu yerusalem, ee! dad'èi ja'a deo ne'e, miu abhu dame dhu ja'a kèti mai. te ngaa lula miu pahae boe lamatua, ka miu unu heka. dame ne pakaj'èu le nèti miu.

source_text: for the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a musu miu mai udhu padedha rai palème li'u tedhe miu ne, hèia ra maso sa d'ara, musu dènge miu.

source_text: they will level you to the ground-you and the children within your walls. they will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from god.

source_text: he declared to them, it is written: ‘my house will be a house of prayer. ' but you have made it ‘a den of robbers. '

source_text: jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing him.

source_text: yet they could not find a way to do so, because all the people hung on his words.
target_text: te ngaa ra abhu boe j'ara, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi titu kèna, nanene lii padhai yesus.

source_text: one day as jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the gospel, the chief priests and scribes, together with the elders, came up to him.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na aj'a-nori lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu èèna. hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai karèi ne.

source_text: tell us, they said, by what authority are you doing these things, and who gave you this authority?

source_text: i will also ask you a question, jesus replied. tell me:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, ja'a neo karèi miu ca madha j'ara kahèi, heka ja'a dhaa lii karèi miu kèna.

source_text: john's baptism-was it from heaven, or from men?
target_text: sèmi ne'e: miu se tadhe yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, do? cee ka dhu hia ne koasa ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: they deliberated among themselves and said, if we say, ‘from heaven, ' he will ask, ‘why did you not believe him? '
target_text: hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, ira ee! èdhi sèmi tare le pala ti ngaa. ladhe èdhi peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka pua', èèna na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu lèka boe yohanis? '

source_text: but if we say, ‘from men, ' all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that john was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka pua', na dhèu ae sèra pèci pamadhe èdhi. te dhèu sèra parcaya, na, yohanis ne dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: so they answered that they did not know where it was from.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe.

source_text: and jesus replied, neither will i tell you by what authority i am doing these things.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ra, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: then he proceeded to tell the people this parable: a man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenants, and went away for a long time.
target_text: hèia yesus lolo dènge dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, peka na, abhu dhèu èci dhu sèle anggor ètu d'ara oka na. na hia dhèu seb'a oka anggor ne, sèna ka rèngu pabagi isi rai nèti oka-tedhe ne. ka na pidha la'e pea panèbhu asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: at harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. but the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
target_text: d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, hèia lamatua oka anggor ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu, la'e nare pala nèngu. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se, game ana paleha ne, ka ra hia ne lèpa dènge ai hua.

source_text: so he sent another servant, but they beat him and treated him shamefully, sending him away empty-handed.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu hari. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka se game, ka ra pamakae ne. hèia ra babège ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua hari ana paleha na ka tèlu, te ngaa ra game ne, toke diu raa, ka ra core ne asa li'u oka.

source_text: ‘what shall i do? ' asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘i will send my beloved son. perhaps they will respect him. '
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne pangee ka, ‘ja'a tao hari ku tasamia? be'a risi ja'a pua ana pasue ja'a ka la'e. ele boe ra pakab'ua ne, de ra sèmi ne dènge be'a. ' de na pua ana d'èlu na la'e.

source_text: but when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘this is the heir. let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours. '
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se ladhe rèdhi ne, hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, ‘mi ladhe ku laa! te lamatua oka ne hia ana d'èlu na nuka mai nèi. nèngu ne ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu pusaka ama na aa'i-aa'i ra. de ta pamadhe ne! sèna ka èdhi ka dhu unu oka anggor ne. '

source_text: so they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. what then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
target_text: ropa ana ne d'ai, hèia dhèu se nuni pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u oka, ka ra pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu pangee, na, lamatua oka ne tao dhèu sab'a oka sèra tasamia?

source_text: he will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others. and when the people heard this, they said, may such a thing never happen!
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tatu na mai pamadhe aa'i si, ka na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne. ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu peka na, ladhe bisa, na, ji'i baku abhu huku nèti ama lamatua sèmi èèna!

source_text: but jesus looked directly at them and said, then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘the stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone'?
target_text: hèia yesus laladhe patae si, ka na karèi, ladhe huku boe si sèmi èèna, nga tao ka dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua suri, na: ‘hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le era padhèdi agarii talora? '

source_text: everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.
target_text: dhèu dhu kadhunu lèke hadhu ne, nèngu tatu laho teb'o-teb'o, lula abhu huku. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu cee, nèngu laho kao-kao, lula lèke huku.

source_text: when the scribes and chief priests realized that jesus had spoken this parable against them, they sought to arrest him that very hour. but they were afraid of the people.
target_text: ropa mese agama dènge kètu agama yahudi se tadèngi lii lolo ne, rèngu re'a, na, yesus padhai lii padhèto dènge rèngu pake lii pakasame. rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor deo sa. de ra nasa titu kèna. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhu d'èi nanene lii aj'a yesus. ka lasi tèke eele ne.

source_text: so they watched him closely and sent spies who pretended to be sincere. they were hoping to catch him in his words in order to hand him over to the rule and authority of the governor.
target_text: èle ka, musu-musu yesus ma'u ne. rèngu tenge dhèu j'aj'i mata-mata dhu bisa tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu mola, sèna ka ra kèpe ne. rèngu sanao sèna ka yesus padhai lii dhu palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, ho èèna na lasi peka dènge gubernur, sèna ka ra pua dhèu lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: teacher, they inquired, we know that you speak and teach correctly. you show no partiality, but teach the way of god in accordance with the truth.
target_text: ka ra pua mata-mata, sèna ka pakarèi dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. ama me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa hag'e boe dhèu. ama aj'a-nori dhèu madhutu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dènge mola.

source_text: is it lawful for us to pay taxes to caesar or not?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ca j'ara: madhutu atora agama èdhi dhèu yahudi, hud'i ji'i b'ae ku doi bea mi dhèu aae kapai paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but jesus saw through their duplicity and said to them,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee kaj'alu rèngu ho neo pamanahu ne. ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na,

source_text: show me a denarius. whose image and inscription are on it? caesar's, they answered.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue. hèia ra pad'elo dènge ne doi èci. ka yesus karèi si, ne'e ne, rupa cee ka ne? aa ngara cee, ne? ra dhaa, peka na, èèna, dhèu aae kapai, keser.

source_text: so jesus told them, give to caesar what is caesar's, and to god what is god's.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, hia asa dhèu paredha, ngaa dhu unu rèngu. aa hia mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: and they were unable to trap him in his words before the people; and amazed at his answer, they fell silent.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu se malaa, lula rèngu bisa boe sii pamanahu rare ne ètu madha dhèu ae. ka hèb'a ra kutu mèno.

source_text: then some of the sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to question him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama saduki mai ho neo kèpe yesus. dhèu saduki aj'a, na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka ètu lod'o èle rai-haha ne. rèngu mai pakarèi dènge yesus, na,

source_text: teacher, they said, moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother's widow and raise up offspring for him.
target_text: ama mese! atora musa dhu suri tèke hia èdhi, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone madhe, aa dhu dènge mèka kolo, na, ari nèti dhèu madhe ne madhèdi nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo hia a'a dhu madhe ne.

source_text: now there were seven brothers. the first one married a wife, but died childless.
target_text: mema uru èèna baki musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. dhu uru leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe ana.

source_text: then the second
target_text: hèia ari na todhe nare hari bhèni balu ne. nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dhu dènge mèka kolo kahèi.

source_text: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ana ka tèlu. na leo dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. toke ari ra limuri tèka, madhe kahèi dènge boe kolo.

source_text: and last of all, the woman died.
target_text: hèia bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: so then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? for all seven were married to her.
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: bhèni ne leo nèdhi le dènge ana mone dhèu pidhu sèra. ladhe d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: jesus answered, the sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, dhèu dhodhoka paleo èmu ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: but those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage. in fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. and since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of god.
target_text: te ngaa ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. aa ètu era nèi, dhèu madhe heka. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te, lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, na hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na.

source_text: even moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. for he calls the lord ‘the god of abraham, the god of isaac, and the god of jacob. '
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri baki musa, dhu lole aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. ètu èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti baki èu dhu uru-uru sèra. nuka baki abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu se mangaj'i taa-taa mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. '

source_text: he is not the god of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive.
target_text: masi ka baki mu se madhe karèi jahi ali. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, nèngu j'aj'i mi lamatua rèngu era, de èdhi te'a le, na, rèngu se mamuri era. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua; dhèu madhe, aad'o si!

source_text: some of the scribes answered, teacher, you have spoken well!
target_text: tadèngi yesus dhaa sèmi èèna, ka mese agama padhai lii, peka na, lii dhaa ama mese èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: and they did not dare to question him any further.
target_text: nèti lod'o èèna, abhu heka ca dhèu sa dhu bani karèi yesus, lula abhu boe j'ara dhu bisa pamanahu rare ne.

source_text: then jesus declared, how can it be said that the christ is the son of david?
target_text: yesus aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi dhèu sèra, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? mese agama sèra, aj'a peka na, kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. madhutu a'aj'a rèngu, nèngu ne dhodhoka ana-èpu dhèu aae daud di. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for david himself says in the book of psalms: ‘the lord said to my lord, sit at my right hand
target_text: lula uru èèna, dhèu aae daud mesa na dhu suri le, ètu d'ara lii sod'a koa-kio, na, ‘ama lamatua peka le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai madhèdi mi era dhu kab'ua ètu babo g'ana ja'a ne.

source_text: until i make your enemies a footstool for your feet. '
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: thus david calls him ‘lord. ' so how can he be david's son?
target_text: de nèti sasuri ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. sasoa na, ladhe dhèu peka na kristus ne dhoka ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka! lula nèngu ne j'aj'i lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: in the hearing of all the people, jesus said to his disciples,
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i taru kira mi lii padhai yesus, hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: beware of the scribes. they like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge mese agama sèra. te rèngu d'èi kako pake kodho robho rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘rèngu se dhèu kapai! ' rèngu d'èi tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ètu d'ara pesta, aa ètu era-era dhèu ae pakaboko.

source_text: they defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. these men will receive greater condemnation.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e, lula rèngu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra dènge titu ho sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu. rèngu d'èi dhèu koa ra, peka na, rèngu dhèu mola. te ngaa lamatua ne'a sasala ra, de èèna na nèngu huku si bia risi.

source_text: then jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,
target_text: lod'o yesus aj'a ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ladhe nèdhi dhèu kaja mai pamaso doi asa d'ara boaraka derma.

source_text: and he saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi kahèi bhèni balu ca dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa mai madhutu sabaj'a. na pamaso kahèi doi dua sen asa d'ara boaraka ne. doi na se'e, kab'ua ciki oo'e di.

source_text: truly i tell you, he said, this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, nanene pabe'a-be'a! bhèni balu ne, dhoka pamaso doi dua sen di, te ngaa na hia risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.
target_text: dhèu leo se pamaso doi kolete nèti doi karisi rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi na tao mi doi kolete. masi ka nèti doi ne'e, nèngu ako taha mamuri.

source_text: as some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, jesus said,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus dhu koa-kad'iri èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama! ladhe ku laa, èmu ne be'a titu kèna! ra pake hadhu cetak dhu kapai hua, ka ra paca'e mera titu kèna. aa dhèu hia kahèi mèdha ra dhu kab'ua, sèna ka pasaraga èmu lamatua ne! te ngaa yesus b'ala, na,

source_text: as for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.
target_text: èmu ne mema saraga. te ngaa nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eela hadhu se, toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: teacher, they asked, when will these things happen? and what will be the sign that they are about to take place?
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yesus se karèi, peka na, ama mese! ngaa dhu ama peka-padhai deo na, j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? ladhe lod'o na dètu le, tadha-tadha na sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: jesus answered, see to it that you are not deceived. for many will come in my name, claiming, ‘i am he, ' and, ‘the time is near. ' do not follow them.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu j'aga paie-iie, ho baku lèke tipu. te èèna na rupa-rupa dhèu mai tèb'a kakara ra, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus. ' abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ‘lod'o a'èle rai-haha dètu kèna! ' te ngaa baku mi parcaya kahèi!

source_text: when you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. these things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.
target_text: ladhe miu tadèngi ka dhèu palolo, peka na: dhèu patao-palaha, dènge papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, baku mi cag'ag'a. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uru ku. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: then he told them, nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a suku èci pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci papara-pakèj'i dènge negara leo.

source_text: there will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
target_text: èèna na, j'aj'i rai opo dhu kapai aae. ètu mia-mia, manganga-mad'èu dhu seli eele, aa èi papèd'a pad'ai cèu palème era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha dhu pamadha'u dhèu, aa tadha-tadha dhu kapai aae ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: but before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. on account of my name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.
target_text: j'ara se'e se j'aj'i aa'i mèka, te ngaa èèna na dhèu mai kèpe rare miu, aa paj'èra miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a. hèia ra soro miu asa dhèu dhu uri lii langu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa ra taha miu ètu d'ara bèdho. ra rèti miu asa madha dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu paredha leo. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: this will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o ne'e, sèna ka peka dènge rèngu lii lolo be'a ja'a.

source_text: so make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
target_text: de mage pangee tasamia miu siri iisi.

source_text: for i will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ja'a hia miu lii-lii dhu pamèci dènge lii dhaa. dènge sèmi èèna, musu miu sèra, re'a heka peka-padhai sèmi ngaa hari.

source_text: you will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death. and you will be hated by everyone because of my name.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a. abhu nèti a'ari miu unu mi, sèmi ina-ama, a'ari, kera ba'i, rae lesa dènge mone anga-aangalai. èèna na nèti rèngu se'e ka, tenge j'ara ho pahie eele miu, toke ra pamadhe miu cahag'e.

source_text: yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madha'u, te lamatua bhèlu boe miu. rèu kètu miu ca loa sa kabhui eele boe, ladhe dènge boe dad'èi na.

source_text: by your patient endurance you will gain your souls.
target_text: ladhe miu taha mere taruu, tatu ama lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia miu.

source_text: but when you see jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ka sordad'u mai pamusu reo rare yerusalem, miu me'a le, na, d'ai lod'o ele iie yerusalem kèna.

source_text: then let those who are in judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.
target_text: ropa ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea rai dènge ka asa ledhe-ledhe. dhèu ètu d'ara kota kèd'i kahèi, sèna ka rai. aa dhèu ètu rae, mai ia ka asa d'ara kota.

source_text: for these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
target_text: te lamatua hia lod'o-lod'o sasusa sèra, ho huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene nèngu. se'e se lèke nuka sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: how miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! for there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu j'èra risi, nuka, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu dènge ana susu. lod'o èèna, abhu susa palème rai-haha, aa dhèu yahudi j'èra bia, lula ama lamatua nasa dènge rèngu sèra.

source_text: they will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. and jerusalem will be trodden down by the gentiles, until the times of the gentiles are fulfilled.
target_text: èèna na musu mai pamadhe si cahag'e, aa taha cahag'e ho j'aj'i ènu ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, mai j'aj'èli pakaj'alu kota yerusalem, aa koasa rare kabarai na, toke èle lod'o ra.

source_text: there will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
target_text: èle ka yesus lole mamai hari na, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari, abhu tadha ètu madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua hètu-hua hètu. ètu rai-haha ne abhu tadha kahèi, sèmi uli sea, dhasi ko'a dhu loe boe, aa naha aae lalulu mai. se'e se tao dhèu rai-haha ne, madha'u dènge ele ngangee, toke re'a heka tao ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
target_text: koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru loe boe karèbha. ropa ladhe rèdhi aa'i-aa'i, hèia ra madha'u titu kèna, lula rai-haha ne oe ele iie kèna!

source_text: at that time they will see the son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
target_text: èle ku heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a kèna, ‘dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne puru mai ètu d'ara ra'i-liru'. ja'a mai dènge koasa, aa dènge dadedha dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: when these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.
target_text: ladhe mulai j'aj'i ka tadha sèra, na, miu boti ka kètu miu, te lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua hia mamuri mi miu.

source_text: then jesus told them a parable: look at the fig tree and all the trees.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lolo pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu taru kira pabe'a-be'a ku mi aj'u sèra.

source_text: when they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka hèru rèu ra karara, èèna tadha na hèru hadhu dètu le.

source_text: so also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of god is near.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge lod'o-lod'o sasusa. ladhe cèu, èèna tadha na paredha ama lamatua dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: truly i tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a cahag'e dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se mai le.

source_text: heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a taha taa-taa.

source_text: but watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life-and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mi j'aga-j'aga, te cag'ag'a laa ja'a mai hari sahèka! mage dhoka miu taru kira heka, hèia miu mamuri dènge minu mahu, aa bhute dhoka tenge mamuri karej'e di. mage dhoka miu me'a boe tadha ne, lula miu bhute dènge j'ara dhu leo.

source_text: for it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pahuni iisi ra nèti madha ja'a.

source_text: so keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the son of man.
target_text: de miu hud'i mate tatae ku. baku ma'ète manèngi-mangaj'i, sèna ka miu bisa taha ètu talora aae sasusa sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ropa ja'a lèpa hari mai, miu makae boe titu ètu madha dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: every day jesus taught at the temple, but every evening he went out to spend the night on the mount of olives.
target_text: bèli-bèli, ladhe re mèu, yesus la'e aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ladhe re mèda, kalua nèti yerusalem ho la'e bhèj'i asa rae ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: and early in the morning all the people would come to hear him at the temple.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu ae-ae dhu mai le pakaboko ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho nanene lii aj'a-nori na.

source_text: now the feast of unleavened bread, called the passover, was approaching,
target_text: lod'o èèna, oe d'ai lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, nuka pesta roti dhu dènge boe ragi. ètu d'ara lod'o hua iia se, ra roro kahib'i-kalèbho tao kalela paska kahèi. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka pasanèd'e uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki rèngu kalua nèti masir.

source_text: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put jesus to death; for they feared the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus. te ngaa ra mage dhèu ae sèra maruru, lula dhèu se d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: then satan entered judas iscariot, who was one of the twelve.
target_text: nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus, dhèu canguru dua sèra, èci ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o kètu agama yahudi sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus, dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas iskariot.

source_text: and judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray jesus to them.
target_text: hèia la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi se dènge kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. la'e neo pane'a dènge ra, sèna ka pahie yesus dènge rèngu.

source_text: they were delighted and agreed to give him money.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yudas, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna. ra pamoa, peka na, la'a, ma! ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae.

source_text: judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.
target_text: ka yudas d'èi, hèia na mulai tenge lod'o dhu lake nare, sèna ka dhèu ae baku re'a nèngu pahie eele yesus.

source_text: then came the day of unleavened bread on which the passover lamb was to be sacrificed.
target_text: hèia d'ai ka lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, dhu rèngu biasa roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao kalela paska.

source_text: jesus sent peter and john, saying, go and prepare for us to eat the passover.
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus dènge yohanis, aku nèngu na, dua mi lami uuru, sèna ka sadia tèke nganga'a kalela paska ho ta'a sama-sama.

source_text: where do you want us to prepare it? they asked.
target_text: ka dua ra karèi, ama! ji'i la'a sadia nganga'a asa mia?

source_text: he answered, when you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. follow him to the house he enters,
target_text: hèia na b'ala, ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem, pe miu paraga dènge dhèu mone ca dhèu dhu pasae g'ala èi cue. madhutu ne toke d'ai èmu na.

source_text: and say to the owner of that house, ‘the teacher asks: where is the guest room, where i may eat the passover with my disciples? '
target_text: peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi ca kama, ho neo pake tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. abhu, do? '

source_text: and he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. make preparations there.
target_text: èèna na lamatua èmu ne pad'elo dènge miu kama èci dhu taleo ètu èmu dedha. nèngu lalau pamèci nare aa'i le kama èèna. ate dhoka miu dua mi lami sadia nganga'a ètu èèna.

source_text: so they went and found it just as jesus had told them. and they prepared the passover.
target_text: ka dua ra lasi. hèia ra paraga ka nuka sèmi ngaa dhu yesus peka le. ka dua ra sadia nganga'a-nganginu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: when the hour had come, jesus reclined at the table with his apostles.
target_text: ropa lalau rare aa'i, yesus si mai. yesus madhèdi ètu mei, aa ana-ana pajuu-paleha na madhèdi kahèi ra'a pesta.

source_text: and he said to them, i have eagerly desired to eat this passover with you before my suffering.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, ja'a d'èi titu kèna madhèdi ku'a kalela paska dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, uru nèti ja'a abhu j'aj'èra.

source_text: for i tell you that i will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of god.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a. te èle ne'e ne, ja'a madhèdi heka ku'a kalela paska dènge miu. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ku, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka ku'a hari kèna.

source_text: after taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, take this and divide it among yourselves.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare galaa cue dhu isi èi anggor. ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, èle ka na soro galaa ne asa rèngu. hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi mere galaa ne, ho èci-èci minu.

source_text: for i tell you that i will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of god comes.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! karèi nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ka, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and he took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, this is my body, given for you; do this in remembrance of me.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare roti cue, ka manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na soro sa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u aae ja'a dhu ja'a hia sa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. lod'o-lod'o dhu miu mi'e ne, pasanèd'e taruu miu, lula tatao ja'a.

source_text: in the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, this cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, ka na ded'e nare galaa dhu isi èi anggor. hèia na lii, peka na, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a ka ne, dhu bhori mai sèna ka hia sod'a-mole mi miu. nèti raa ne'e ka, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhu hiu dènge miu.

source_text: look! the hand of my betrayer is with mine on the table.
target_text: mage pamud'e, te abhu dhèu dhu madhèdi sama-sama dènge èdhi ètu mei ne, èèna na, nèngu pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: indeed, the son of man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays him.
target_text: mema ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahie eele ja'a, sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a, nèngu pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne, ana-ana pajuu-paleha se pakarèi, peka na, cee ka dhu ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhelu ne mi dedha na?

source_text: a dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them would be considered the greatest.
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus se pasisu, peka na, nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, cee ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: so jesus declared, the kings of the gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai si, peka na, ètu rai-rai dhu kabarai ra tadhe boe lamatua, dhèu aae ra hia paredha dhu bia risi mi kabarai rèngu. te ngaa rèngu neo sèna ka kabarai paroa rèngu, peka na, ‘ama dhu taru kira kabarai'.

source_text: but you shall not be like them. instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madhutu j'ara sèra. cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri na hud'i tare'a-re'a sama sèmi dhèu haha ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. dhu neo j'aj'i kètu, hud'i ladhe-leru ku sama sèmi ana pua-paleha.

source_text: for who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? is it not the one who reclines? but i am among you as one who serves.
target_text: miu pangee sèku, dhèu kapai sèra nuka mia? dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei, do, dhu lalau mei? tatu dhèu dhu madhèdi ne, dhèu kapai, si? te ngaa ja'a ne, tao boe ngi'u sèmi sèra. ja'a mai lalau-lalo'o miu.

source_text: you are the ones who have stood by me in my trials.
target_text: miu se'e ka dhu bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and i bestow on you a kingdom, just as my father has bestowed one on me,
target_text: ama ku ded'e le ja'a, sèna ka kèd'u paredha ètu era paredha na. ka limuri ne, ja'a ded'e miu kahèi,

source_text: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of israel.
target_text: ho miu bèli-camèd'a madhèdi mi'a dènge ja'a ca mei ètu sorga. ja'a hia koasa kahèi, sèna ka miu paredha canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: simon, simon, satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus. dhèu aae nidhu neo hia miu pacèri nèti ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu tatai ho hag'e eele èto nèti laludhu.

source_text: but i have prayed for you, simon, that your faith will not fail. and when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, petrus, ho èu lèka ja'a taruu. ladhe èu lèpa hari mai asa ja'a, na, èu hud'i pa'èra ku d'ara a'ari èu, nuka dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: lord, said peter, i am ready to go with you even to prison and to death.
target_text: hèia petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe tèke eele ama. te ja'a pa'èra maso bui sama-sama dènge ama. masi ka ja'a madhe palere-lere dènge ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: but jesus replied, i tell you, peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka na, petrus! nanene paie. mèda ne'e kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, èu pasili le tèlu hari, na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: then jesus asked them, when i sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything? nothing, they answered.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ca hari na, ja'a pua miu lami lole lii lolo be'a ja'a asa mia-mia, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho baku mèti doi, tas, dènge salapa. lod'o èèna, miu kura ngaa? ka aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ca hari na, ji'i kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa!

source_text: now, however, he told them, the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
target_text: hèia yesus peka tabha hari, na, te ngaa limuri ne, leo. ladhe miu dènge doi, na todhe mèti. ladhe dènge tas, na mèti kahèi. ladhe dènge boe samala, pahia kodho miu, sèna ka hèli.

source_text: for i tell you that this scripture must be fulfilled in me: ‘and he was numbered with the transgressors. ' for what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi pangee na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu. hèia nèbhu heka, rèngu mai kèpe ja'a. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhu baki yesaya suri tèke le: ‘ra tao ne sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a! '

source_text: so they said, look, lord, here are two swords. that is enough, he answered.
target_text: ka ra peka na, ama! ji'i ngèti hela dua. hèia yesus peka, d'ai le. ale ia ka sèra!

source_text: jesus went out as usual to the mount of olives, and the disciples followed him.
target_text: ra'a rare paska, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa ledhe saitun, sèmi biasa.

source_text: when he came to the place, he told them, pray that you will not enter into temptation.
target_text: d'ai nèi, yesus peka dènge si, miu hud'i sabaj'a ku, ho baku lèke dadugu-rariu.

source_text: and he withdrew about a stone's throw beyond them, where he knelt down and prayed,
target_text: hèia na tèke eele si, la'e kaj'èu boe. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho sabaj'a, peka na,

source_text: father, if you are willing, take this cup from me. yet not my will, but yours be done.
target_text: ama! ladhe ama d'èi na, pakaj'èu ku j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa mage madhutu dad'èi ja'a; hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then an angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ama lamatua èci mai nèti sorga pa'èra d'ara na.

source_text: and in his anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
target_text: lula d'ara na j'èra titu kèna, toke èi kabhèsu na suti sèmi raa sa.

source_text: when jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, na kèd'i la'e paraga dènge ana madhutu na. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i, lula ngi'u roe aa d'ara susa.

source_text: why are you sleeping? he asked. get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ra, tasamia ka miu se bhèj'i? be'a risi miu sabaj'a, ho ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: while he was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called judas, one of the twelve. he approached jesus to kiss him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu na, mai dènge dhèu ae-ae. na mai padètu-dètu dènge yesus, neo kèpe ho uu ne.

source_text: but jesus asked him, judas, are you betraying the son of man with a kiss?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, yudas! èu neo pahie eele dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a dènge a'uu, do?

source_text: those around jesus saw what was about to happen and said, lord, should we strike with our swords?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu leo sèra re'a tatao bhelu nèti yudas ne, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ji'i lab'a si, do? te ji'i dhu ngèti hela.

source_text: and one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se, bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: but jesus answered, no more of this! and he touched the man's ear and healed him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa si, peka na, sange èèna ka! baku lab'a si. hèia na g'ag'e dhilu dhèu ne, ka pa'èle.

source_text: then jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for him, have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe yesus, nuka: kètu agama yahudi sèra, dhèu heka d'ara rae, kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dènge dhèu leo hari kahèi. yesus karèi si, tasamia? miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, ka mai kèpe ja'a mèti samala dènge aj'u cèki, do?

source_text: every day i was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. but this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mai kèpe ja'a. de hud'i laa! ne'e d'ai lod'o miu. ne'e ne mai nèti koasa dhèu aae nidhu!

source_text: then they seized jesus, led him away, and took him into the house of the high priest. and peter followed at a distance.
target_text: hèia ra kèpe rare lamatua yesus, ka nuni rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. petrus kako mau-mau re kabodho.

source_text: when those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, peter sat down among them.
target_text: ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao ai raci. hèia petrus la'e manyiru ai kahèi.

source_text: a servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. this man also was with him, she said.
target_text: ka bhèni sab'a ca dhèu ladhe nèdhi petrus dhu manyiru ai. na ladhe patae rèhu petrus, ka peka dènge dhèu leo ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu ne'e ne dhu madhutu yesus kahèi!

source_text: but peter denied it. woman, i do not know him, he said.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne. èu me'a ngaa?

source_text: a short time later, someone else saw him and said, you also are one of them. but peter said, man, i am not.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ca dhèu ladhe sa petrus, èle ka na lii, aku nèngu na, tare'a. èu ne, mema ca dhèu nèti dhèu yesus sèra, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! èu peka leli na!

source_text: about an hour later, another man insisted, certainly this man was with him, for he too is a galilean.
target_text: pe d'ai ca jam sa, ca dhèu leo hari, peka na, ja'a ke'a dhèu ne'e ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus. te nèngu ne, dhèu galilea kahèi.

source_text: man, i do not know what you are talking about, peter replied. while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu monya èèna! ropa petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna, kaca'a laa manu kokotoo.

source_text: and the lord turned and looked at peter. then peter remembered the word that the lord had spoken to him: before the rooster crows today, you will deny me three times.
target_text: hèia yesus kabib'a sa nèngu. ka petrus sanèd'e lii yesus deo na, dhu peka na, mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari kèna.

source_text: and he went outside and wept bitterly.
target_text: ngee nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia petrus kalua nèti madha èmu ne, dènge tangi dhu d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: the men who were holding jesus began to mock him and beat him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu j'aga yesus, padhai lii pahaha ne, dènge game pa'oke ne.

source_text: they blindfolded him and kept demanding, prophesy! who hit you?
target_text: ra pahutu rèhu na pake bèla, ka ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, wee! ladhe èu ne dhèu mèti lii padhai lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: and they said many other blasphemous things against him.
target_text: èle ka, ra padhèd'a aape ne.

source_text: at daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. they led jesus into their sanhedrin and said,
target_text: mad'ae aae era, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, pakaboko le uri lii langu yesus. ka ra pua dhèu lasi nuni rèti yesus asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: if you are the christ, tell us. jesus answered, if i tell you, you will not believe.
target_text: ropa yesus maso, ka ra karèi ne, èu peka ku laa! èu ne, tare'a kristus, do? hèia na b'ala, peka na, masi ka ja'a dhaa na tare'a, miu se lèka boe.

source_text: and if i ask you a question, you will not answer.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a bari miu ca madha j'ara, tatu miu dhaa boe.

source_text: but from now on the son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of god.
target_text: nèbhu heka ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai èèna, ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ho èèna na, ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana na, sèna ka paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: so they all asked, are you then the son of god? he replied, you say that i am.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka aa'i-aa'i ra karèi, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ngee, na, èu ne ana ama lamatua, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a, sèmi dhu miu peka na.

source_text: why do we need any more testimony? they declared. we have heard it for ourselves from his own lips.
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu uri lii langu se, aa'i-aa'i peka, na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadèngi le, si? na ded'e iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne lii pahahe kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe dhèu tao iisi ra nuka sèmi lamatua, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku. de tasamia? èdhi parluu heka sakasii. huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: then the whole council rose and led jesus away to pilate.
target_text: masi ka dhèu uri lii langu agama yahudi sèra pama'ète rare le sèna ka huku pamadhe yesus, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe hak ho huku pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, lere rèti yesus asa madha gubernur nèti paredha roma, dhu ètu èèna nuka pilatus. rèngu d'èi ladhe gubernur ka dhu huku ne.

source_text: and they began to accuse him, saying, we found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to caesar, and proclaiming himself to be christ, a king.
target_text: de ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ra lole sasala yesus èci-èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tuka lab'a paredha roma. na aj'a peka na, dhèu baku b'ae bea sa dhèu paredha. na ded'e iisi na, peka na, nèngu ne, kristus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: so pilate asked him, are you the king of the jews? you have said so, jesus replied.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka gubernur karèi ne, peka na, tare'a, do? èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a. sèmi lii padhai ama.

source_text: then pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, i find no basis for a charge against this man.
target_text: parisa èle ka, gubernur ladhe sa kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu ae sèra. ka na lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a abhu boe sasala dhèu ne ciki sa hèi.

source_text: but they kept insisting, he stirs up the people all over judea with his teaching. he began in galilee and has come all the way here.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se pakadhii taruu, aku rèngu na, aad'o, ama gubernur. dhèu ne la'e aj'a sa mia-mia, ho kakèj'i kabarai, sèna ka palab'a dènge dhèu paredha. na tao maruru mulai nèti propensi galilea toke d'ai kota yerusalem ne'e.

source_text: when pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a galilean.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu ne dhèu galilea, do? ka dhèu se dhaa, tare'a. nèngu nèti galilea.

source_text: and learning that jesus was under herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to herod, who himself was in jerusalem at that time.
target_text: ropa ne'a nare sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur pua lere rèti yesus asa dhèu aae herodes, dhu paredha propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, nèngu ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: when herod saw jesus, he was greatly pleased. he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard about him and was hoping to see him perform a miracle.
target_text: herodes ne, dhu tadèngi ae le, dhèu palolo tatao yesus, aa nèbhu le neo paraga dènge ne kahèi. nèngu dhu sanao-maena bisa nèdhi dènge madha na tadha malaa èci-dua sa nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, lod'o lere rèti yesus asa nèngu, d'ara na karej'e.

source_text: herod questioned jesus at great length, but he gave no answer.
target_text: hèia na karèi yesus rupa-rupa j'ara, te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa.

source_text: meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing him.
target_text: ropa herodes padhai lii era dènge yesus, te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra galaa hari yesus dènge rupa-rupa sasala.

source_text: and even herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. dressing him in a fine robe, they sent him back to pilate.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae herodes dènge sordad'u na padhai lii pahahe ne. ka ra papake yesus kodho saraga dhu madhera robho d'ai rai èci, sèmi dhèu aae tema pake, hèia ra padhai lii pahahe ne taruu. ka rèti hari ne la'e asa gubernur pilatus.

source_text: that day herod and pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies.
target_text: uru nèti èèna, gubernur dènge dhèu aae herodes dhu pamusu. te ngaa nèti lod'o èèna, dua ra pa'angalai.

source_text: then pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus paroa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, sama-sama dènge dhèu ae sèra, mai pakaboko ho nanene lii pama'ète.

source_text: and said to them, you brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. i have examined him here in your presence and found him not guilty of your charges against him.
target_text: aku nèngu na, miu mèti le yesus asa ja'a, aa mi galaa ne, peka na, nèngu d'èi kakèj'i kabarai ho lab'a paredha roma. ja'a parisa le toke lutu ètu madha miu, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: neither has herod, for he sent him back to us. as you can see, he has done nothing deserving of death.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes parisa le kahèi. te ngaa na abhu boe sasala ngaa-ngaa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na hia hari ne mai sa ja'a. dhèu ne dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. de ja'a bisa boe huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: therefore i will punish him and release him.
target_text: ja'a neo pama'ète sèmi ne'e: ja'a pua kalabhe ne pake gui, èle na ja'a patabuli eele ne.

source_text: but they all cried out in unison: away with this man! release barabbas to us!
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, bisa boe! pamadhe ne! patabuli barabas. ra pa'oo-parodha sèmi èèna, lula tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, gubernur patabuli ca dhèu nèti d'ara bèdho madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.
target_text: barabas ne maso bèdho, lula na kakèj'i dhèu lab'a paredha roma ètu kota yerusalem, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: wanting to release jesus, pilate addressed them again,
target_text: te ngaa gubernur neo patabuli yesus. ka na karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, tasamia ladhe ja'a patabuli yesus?

source_text: but they kept shouting, crucify him! crucify him!
target_text: te ngaa asa ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, aad'o! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: a third time he said to them, what evil has this man done? i have found in him no offense worthy of death. so after i punish him, i will release him.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur ngee na j'ara ne lèke boe, ka na karèi d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, nga tao ka ja'a madhutu miu ho paku pamadhe ne? bhabhelu na ngaa? ja'a parisa le nèngu ne, te ngaa abhu boe j'ara èci sa kahèi, ho huku pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo dhoka kalabhe ne, èle ku, heka patabuli ne.

source_text: but they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for jesus to be crucified. and their clamor prevailed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha hari pamèdhu-mèdhu, sèna ka laka-seti ne ho paku pamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia gubernur taha nare heka,

source_text: so pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
target_text: ka na pama'ète madhutu dad'èi dhèu sèra.

source_text: as they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and handed jesus over to their will.
target_text: hèia na patabuli barabas, ca dhèu dhu d'èi palab'a, dènge pamadhe dhèu. te ngaa na soro yesus la'e asa adhe-aai dhèu se'e, sèna ka ra tao ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: as the soldiers led him away, they seized simon of cyrene on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him to carry behind jesus.
target_text: èle ka, sordad'u roma sèra nuni rèti yesus asa li'u kota yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara, ra paraga dènge dhèu èci nèti kota kirene, dhu ngara na simon, dhu neo maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem. ka ra laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha ne gati yesus. ka na kako re limuri madhutu yesus.

source_text: a great number of people followed him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai laladhe yesus. abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu pasuti èi madha, lula d'ara pèd'a ropa rèdhi ne.

source_text: but jesus turned to them and said, daughters of jerusalem, do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe bhèni se tangi, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ina-ina nèti yerusalem. baku tangi ja'a ne. tangi hiu ngi'u miu mesa mi, dènge ana niki miu.

source_text: look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed! '
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, sasusa dhu kapai risi mai, hèia dhèu peka na, ‘bhèni dhu kalua hua iia, nuka, bhèni dhu rara iisi rèdhi boe, aa dhu pasusu rèdhi boe ana. '

source_text: at that time ‘they will say to the mountains, fall on us! and to the hills, cover us! '
target_text: lod'o sasusa aae na mai, dhèu j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi, peka na, ‘be'a risi, ledhe guri mai ho kabhie ka ji'i! ' aa ra peka kahèi, ‘dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne, be'a risi kabhuku dhènu eele ka ji'i. '

source_text: for if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?
target_text: ladhe dhèu bisa paj'èra dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala, tasamia hari mi dhèu bhelu?

source_text: two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with jesus.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se rèti yesus, ra nuni rèti kahèi dhèu bhelu dhèu dua, ho huku pamadhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: when they came to the place called the skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals, one on his right and the other on his left.
target_text: rèngu d'ai era èci, dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu. ' hèia ra paku yesus dènge dhèu bhelu dhèu dua se, mi aj'u palolo-palèbha ra èci-èci. ka ra sèle patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèra. ra hia dhèu bhelu èci ètu karasa g'ana yesus, aa èci hari ètu karasa kariu na.

source_text: then jesus said, father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing. and they divided up his garments by casting lots.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus sabaj'a peka na, ama! bhèlu eele sasala dhèu se, te rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue. èle ka sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka neo re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: the people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at him, saying, he saved others; let him save himself if he is the christ of god, the chosen one.
target_text: dhèu ae mai laladhe ètu era èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu kapai yahudi sèra, peka pa-aape yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu dhu patabuli nare le dhèu leo nèti mamadhe-mamopo, te ngaa bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu mesa na. ladhe nèngu ne, tare'a-re'a kristus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, hud'i laa na puru unu na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne.

source_text: the soldiers also mocked him and came up to offer him sour wine.
target_text: sordad'u se padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi. ra hia ne ninu èi anggor manyilu,

source_text: if you are the king of the jews, they said, save yourself!
target_text: aa ra parodha pahaha ne, peka na, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a dhèu aae yahudi, na, patabuli eele ka ngi'u mu nèti mamadhe!

source_text: above him was posted an inscription: this is the king of the jews.
target_text: ra suri ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi. ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, ra huku ne lula j'ara ne'e ka.

source_text: one of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on him. are you not the christ? he said. save yourself and us!
target_text: ca dhèu bhelu dhu paku ètu karasa yesus padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu ne tare'a kristus, do? ladhe tare'a, na, patabuli eele ka èdhi!

source_text: but the other one rebuked him, saying, do you not even fear god, since you are under the same judgment?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhelu èci hari kai ne, aku nèngu na, weh! èu ne me'a boe madha'u dènge ama lamatua, hèi? te èu ne abhu huku madhe èci èèna ka dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: we are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. but this man has done nothing wrong.
target_text: èdhi dua ti pasae tare huku madhe ne, lèke dènge tatao èdhi. te ngaa dhèu ne, tao boe sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: then he said, jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom!
target_text: ka dhèu ne, peka hari, aku nèngu na, yesus! ladhe ama maso ka asa era paredha ama, na baku bhèlu ja'a.

source_text: and jesus said to him, truly i tell you, today you will be with me in paradise.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge èu kèna, na, lod'o deo ne'e kahèi, èu lamu asa sorga palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: it was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour. the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhu lod'o nètu le. te ngaa madha lod'o saraa boe, aa maroga kiu-kiu abhe nare era èèna, toke d'ai hake tèlu lod'o nihia. ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla bhèla aae èci dhu ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, bèla ne mae bagi mi dua.

source_text: then jesus called out in a loud voice, father, into your hands i commit my spirit. and when he had said this, he breathed his last.
target_text: ètu era dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu' èèna, yesus pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a pangèd'u samanga ja'a mi d'ara adhe-aai ama. ropa padhai lii èle, hèia yesus ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: when the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to god, saying, surely this was a righteous man.
target_text: abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma titu ètu era èèna, dhu padètu dènge aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi yesus madhe, ka na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a re'a dhèu d'ara mola!

source_text: and when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra rèdhi mamadhe yesus, ra manyasa, dènge d'ara ra roe bhilu, ka ra lèpa dènge d'ara susa.

source_text: but all those who knew jesus, including the women who had followed him from galilee, stood at a distance watching these things.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu yesus titu ètu kaj'èu, rèdhi na madhe. ina-ina dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea toke yerusalem, ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: now there was a council member named joseph, a good and righteous man, who had not consented to their decision or action. he was from the judean town of arimathea, and was waiting for the kingdom of god.
target_text: ropa yesus madhe, dhèu èci tenge j'ara, sèna ka papuru ngi'u aae na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu ne, ngara na yusuf nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne, dhèu d'ara mola, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. yusuf ne dhu tatae ama lamatua pad'elo, na, nèngu nèd'u paredha na. yusuf kahèi ca dhèu nèti dhèu dhu uri lii langu agama yahudi. te ngaa nèngu d'èi boe dènge lii pama'ète huku madhe mi yesus.

source_text: he went to pilate to ask for the body of jesus.
target_text: lula na neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi sèna ka nèngu uri ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.
target_text: ka pilatus d'èi, hèia yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus. èle ka na pahutu ngi'u aae dènge bèla alus. ka ded'e rèti asa d'ara ro'a hadhu èci, dhu heka pae rare kèna. ètu ro'a ne, padhane rèdhi mèka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: it was preparation day, and the sabbath was beginning.
target_text: mamadhe yesus lèke dènge hari jumat. lod'o yusuf si padhane rare ne, lod'o nihia le. ladhe lod'o cèna, d'ai lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: the women who had come with jesus from galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how his body was placed.
target_text: ina-ina dhu mai palere dènge yesus nèti galilea, lasi madhutu yusuf nèti limuri, sèna ka neo re'a era padhane yesus ètu ro'a mia.

source_text: then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes. and they rested on the sabbath, according to the commandment.
target_text: ropa rèdhi era ne, ka ina se lèpa lasi sadia bunga dènge èi hèu mèngi. d'ai lod'o cèna, rèngu ae nèti sasab'a ra, madhutu atora lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. rèngu mate èle ku lod'o sabaj'a, heka neo lasi tao bunga mi ngi'u aae yesus kèna.

source_text: on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
target_text: lod'o hari migu oe mèu sa, ina se rèti bunga dènge èi hèu mèngi, ho lasi ro'a yesus.

source_text: they found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai nèi, ladhe rèdhi hadhu aae dhu yusuf pake katange ro'a yesus, dhu bhaloli le sa karasa na.

source_text: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the lord jesus.
target_text: hèia lasi dènge ka asa d'ara, te ngaa abhu boe ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: while they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
target_text: ka rèngu ele ngangee. cag'ag'a laa dhèu dua dhu pake mèdha kale'e, mai titu ka ètu sebhe rèngu.

source_text: as the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, why do you look for the living among the dead?
target_text: ina se madha'u bia, ka ra pacud'u d'ai rai. ka dhèu se karèi si, peka na, nga tao ka miu mai tenge dhèu mamuri ètu era dhèu madhe?

source_text: he is not here; he has risen! remember how he told you while he was still in galilee:
target_text: yesus aad'o heka ètu era ne'e! te na mamuri hari le. ele boe miu bhèlu eele le, ngaa dhu peka nare, lod'o na ètu galilea era, sina ma?

source_text: ‘the son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again. '

source_text: then they remembered his words.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, heka rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai yesus uru èèna.

source_text: and when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the eleven and to all the others.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa dènge ka, lasi peka dènge ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci sèra, dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu ne.

source_text: but their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana madhutu sèra tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na ina se monya.

source_text: peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. and after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
target_text: hèia petrus kèd'i dènge ka, rai la'e asa ro'a. d'ai nèi, na patigi sa d'ara ro'a, te ngaa nèdhi dhoka bèla hutu di. hèia na lèpa, ka na pangee, sa mia ka ne?

source_text: that same day two of them were going to a village called emmaus, about seven miles from jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, ana madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae cue, ngara na emaus. kaj'èu na pe d'ai canguru ca kilo nèti kota yerusalem.

source_text: they were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

source_text: and as they talked and deliberated, jesus himself came up and walked along with them.

source_text: but their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

source_text: he asked them, what are you discussing so intently as you walk along? they stood still, with sadness on their faces.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu dua mi se, padhue-padhai ngaa? ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka ra titu. rèhu ra sèmi dhèu susa titu kèna.

source_text: one of them, named cleopas, asked him, are you the only visitor to jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?
target_text: ka dhu ngara na kleopas, karèi ne, ama ne sèmi dhèu hiu sa, dhu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lai-lai ne j'aj'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: what things? he asked. the events involving jesus of nazareth, they answered. this man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before god and all the people.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, tasamia? ka ra b'ala, peka na, yesus nèti nasaret èèna! nèngu na tare'a dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa lamatua pangèd'u na koasa, ka na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa. nèngu d'èlu-mèu kahèi aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e dènge ne. aa lamatua karej'e dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: our chief priests and rulers delivered him up to the sentence of death, and they crucified him.
target_text: te ngaa te'a boe, na, kètu agama èdhi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, kèpe rare ne. ka ra hia ne asa gubernur sèna ka huku pamadhe ne. de ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha toke madhe.

source_text: but we were hoping he was the one who would redeem israel. and besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i sanao nèngu ne'e ka kristus, dhu mai patabuli dhèu-dhèu èdhi nèti paredha roma, dhu paj'èra èdhi. te ngaa ètu d'ara hari jumat lai-lai ne, ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: furthermore, some of our women astounded us. they were at the tomb early this morning,
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i asa ele ngangee. te deo na, ina-ina ji'i mai peka, na, mad'ae aae era rèngu lasi asa ro'a.

source_text: but they did not find his body. they came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that jesus was alive.
target_text: te ngaa ra palolo, peka na, ngi'u aae yesus ele le. hèia ladhe rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka dènge rèngu, na, yesus mamuri hari le!

source_text: then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. but him they did not see.
target_text: ropa tadèngi ngare, hèia angalai ji'i dhèu pèri-pèri, rai lasi asa ro'a. ka rèdhi sèmi dhu ina-ina sa peka. rèngu rèdhi boe ngi'u aae yesus hèi.

source_text: then jesus said to them, o foolish ones, how slow are your hearts to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
target_text: ropa lolo rare, yesus lii dènge si, peka na, gagoa miu se! nga tao ka miu mo'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra peka tèke!

source_text: was it not necessary for the christ to suffer these things and then to enter his glory?
target_text: te rèngu suri le, na, kristus ne hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, heka na abhu pakab'ua dènge dadedha kèna.

source_text: and beginning with moses and all the prophets, he explained to them what was written in all the scriptures about himself.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a si, aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri tèke lula-nèti kristus ne. karèi nèti sasuri baki musa toke dhèu rèti lii padhai dhu leo sèra.

source_text: as they approached the village where they were headed, he seemed to be going farther.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe d'ai emaus, ka yesus pasabhe eele neo kako taruu.

source_text: but they pleaded with him, stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over. so he went in to stay with them.
target_text: te ngaa ra manèngi, peka na, ama! j'unu taha ku dènge ji'i mèda ne'e, te lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka yesus maso palere-lere dènge rèngu asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: while he was reclining at the table with them, he took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them.
target_text: ropa rèngu madhèdi neo ra'a, hèia yesus nare roti ca balok. ka na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia na pamae roti ne. ropa na j'ole roti ne sa rèngu dua ra,

source_text: then their eyes were opened and they recognized jesus-and he disappeared from their sight.
target_text: heka ra tadhe, na, nèngu ne yesus. te ngaa kabèdhi laa, na ele nèti madha rèngu dua ra!

source_text: they asked each other, were not our hearts burning within us as he spoke with us on the road and opened the scriptures to us?
target_text: hèia dua ra padhue, peka na, waa! deo na ropa na peka paled'a lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, d'ara èdhi taleo moro-moro sange rai-haha.

source_text: and they got up that very hour and returned to jerusalem. there they found the eleven and those with them, gathered together
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dua ra kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa asa yerusalem. lasi paraga dènge canguru ca dhèu ana madhutu yesus sèra, dènge dhèu leo dhu pakaboko ètu era èèna.

source_text: and saying, the lord has indeed risen and has appeared to simon!
target_text: hèia ana madhutu se peka dènge rèngu dua ra, na, mema tare'a! lamatua yesus mamuri hari le! deo na pad'elo iisi na dènge petrus.

source_text: then the two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized jesus in the breaking of the bread.
target_text: èle ka dhèu dua se lole aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i ètu j'ara, toke rèngu dua ra tadhe yesus ropa na pamae roti.

source_text: while they were describing these events, jesus himself stood among them and said, peace be with you.
target_text: lod'o rèngu palolo era, kaca'a laa, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu. na hia maho'o mi rèngu, peka na, saloom!

source_text: but they were startled and frightened, thinking they had seen a spirit.
target_text: ka ra cag'ag'a aa madha'u, lula ra ngee na nidhu.

source_text: why are you troubled, jesus asked, and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u? miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le, do?

source_text: look at my hands and my feet. it is i myself. touch me and see-for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see i have.
target_text: miu ladhe sèku ai dènge haga ja'a ne. ja'a ka ne'e ne. j'ole ai miu ho g'ag'e unu mi! sèna ka mi lèka, na, ja'a ka ne'e ne, nidhu boe. te nidhu dènge boe ngi'u, te ngaa miu mèdhi ngi'u ja'a ne, si? !

source_text: and when he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii era, na pad'elo dènge si era nu'a dhu ètu adhe-aai dènge haga na.

source_text: while they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, he asked them, do you have anything here to eat?
target_text: rèngu karej'e titu kèna, lula yesus mamuri hari le. dhoka ra bingu, te re'a boe tasamia ka bisa j'aj'i sèmi èèna. hèia yesus karèi si, miu mi'a ngaa?

source_text: so they gave him a piece of broiled fish,
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne i'a paga ca kadhèli.

source_text: and he took it and ate it in front of them.
target_text: yesus sèmi nare i'a ne, hèia na'e dènge ka ètu madha rèngu.

source_text: jesus said to them, these are the words i spoke to you while i was still with you: everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the law of moses, the prophets, and the psalms.
target_text: èle ka, na lii dènge rèngu, peka na, tasamia? miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a uru èèna dhu bera-bera dènge miu? ja'a peka dènge miu ca hari ni, hud'i j'aj'i ku aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra suri tèke lula-nèti ja'a ne. nuka nèti baki musa, aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo sèra, aa nèti sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio.

source_text: then he opened their minds to understand the scriptures.
target_text: èle ka, na bhoke paled'a, sèna ka re'a mèu sasoa nèti isi sasuri lamatua.

source_text: and he told them, this is what is written: the christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
target_text: na peka tabha hari, na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua se dhu suri le, na, kristus dhu lamatua hia mai èèna, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa ladhe d'ai camèd'a, na mamuri hari. te dhu suri aa'i le j'ara se'e!

source_text: and in his name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in jerusalem.
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, ja'a hia miu koasa, ho lami mèti lii lolo be'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i, mulai nèti yerusalem ne. peka dènge rèngu, na, dhèu dhu mangaku sasala ra, aa lèpa hari asa lamatua, pe lamatua saku pamèu sasala ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: you are witnesses of these things.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sakasii, sèna ka miu lolo, peka na, ja'a dui j'aj'èra, ka madhe, hèia mamuri hari.

source_text: and behold, i am sending the promise of my father upon you. but remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia roh dhu mola-mèci, dhu ama ku pajaji nare le. te ngaa miu hud'i tatae ku nèngu ètu kota yerusalem ne, toke abhu koasa nèti sorga.

source_text: praising god continually in the temple.

source_text: in the beginning was the word, and the word was with god, and the word was god.

source_text: he was with god in the beginning.
target_text: lod'o liru dènge rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, dhèu ne'e abhu mema le sama-sama dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: through him all things were made, and without him nothing was made that has been made.

source_text: in him was life, and that life was the light of men.

source_text: the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

source_text: there came a man who was sent from god. his name was john.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo èci, ngara na yohanis. ama lamatua pua-paleha ne kahèi,

target_text: sèna ka j'aj'i sakasii ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti saraa ne. ho sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lamatua, lula lii padhai yohanis ne.

source_text: he himself was not the light, but he came to testify about the light.
target_text: yohanis ne, bukan saraa èèna. te ngaa lamatua pua ne ho la'e peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti saraa ne.

source_text: the true light who gives light to every man was coming into the world.

source_text: he was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.

source_text: he came to his own, and his own did not receive him.
