target_text: hèia dhèu se'e sèmi rare kahèi lii padhai lii petrus si. ka hag'e rare dhèu pidhu, nuka: dhèu èci, ngara na stefanus. nèngu ne parcaya tare'a-re'a lamatua yesus, dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake nèngu. aa angalai nèngu na, nuka: pelipus, prokorus, nikanor, timon, permenas, dènge nikolas, nèti kota antiokia. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na maso agama yahudi.

source_text: they presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
target_text: hèia lere rèti dhèu pidhu dhu ra pili rare sèra, asa madha dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua. ka ra bane ai dènge manèngi-mangaj'i hia si, ho ded'e si j'aj'i dhèu ladhe-leru bhèni balu ana-lalu, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra abhu pala dhu pamera.

source_text: so the word of god continued to spread. the number of disciples in jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
target_text: èèna ka, dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, asa tabha ae ètu kota yerusalem. aa ama agama yahudi sèra, ae kahèi dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus.

source_text: now stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hia berkat ae mi stefanus. na hia stefanus koasa kahèi, ho na tao tadha-tadha malaa dènge j'ara-j'ara kapai, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi unu ra.

source_text: but resistance arose from what was called the synagogue of the freedmen, including cyrenians, alexandrians, and men from the provinces of cilicia and asia. they began to argue with stephen,
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu mai nèti rai-rai kaj'èu, nuka: kota kirene, kota aleksandria, propensi kilikia, dènge propensi asia. uru èèna, rèngu j'aj'i ènu dhèu leo, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka lamatua rèngu patabuli si. èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e pakaboko ètu yerusalem. rèngu tema le lasi asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhu ra patitu unu ra. èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, ra pangare ne, ‘j'aj'i heka ènu'. ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii stefanus, dhèu se d'èi boe, ka ra pab'ala dènge ne.

source_text: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the spirit by whom he spoke.
target_text: stefanus ne, dhèu d'èlu-mèu, lula nèngu padhai lii pake koasa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e segi boe nèngu.

source_text: then they prompted some men to say, we heard stephen speak words of blasphemy against moses and against god.
target_text: ka ra tenge j'ara aapa mi dedha stefanus. ra lasi b'ae dhèu ho j'aj'i sakasii leko-monya, peka na, ji'i tadèngi, na, dhèu ne'e padhai lii pahaha musa dènge ama lamatua!

source_text: so they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted stephen. they seized him and brought him before the sanhedrin,
target_text: rèngu dadugu dhèu, toke d'ai dhèu heka ad'a yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tadèngi kahèi. ka ra nasa. nèti èèna ka, lasi kèpe rare stefanus, hèia ra nuni ne asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: where they presented false witnesses who said, this man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
target_text: sakasii leko-monya rèngu sèra, ue lii langu ho pamanahu stefanus, peka na, dhèu ne loe boe padhai lii pakarehe èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. aa na peka pa'ele iie lii paredha ama lamatua, dhu musa papuru mi èdhi.

source_text: for we have heard him say that jesus of nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that moses handed down to us.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi kahèi, na peka, na, yesus, dhèu nasaret, neo sag'e eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne. aa nèngu ne neo pa'ele iie atora ad'a dhu baki musa tao tèka hia èdhi.

source_text: all who were sitting in the sanhedrin looked intently at stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era pama'ète lii langu agama èèna ladhe kaloo stefanus, lula rèhu na sama sèmi rèhu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: then the high priest asked stephen, are these charges true?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi karèi stefanus, peka na, dhèu se'e galaa èu ne, lèke do aad'o?

source_text: and stephen declared: brothers and fathers, listen to me! the god of glory appeared to our father abraham while he was still in mesopotamia, before he lived in haran, and told him, ‘leave your country and your kindred and go to the land i will show you. '
target_text: ka stefanus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama-ama, aa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu nanene ku ja'a. uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi abraham dhae tèke eele mèka rai èta-èsu na. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu kapai risi pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu. lamatua hia ne paredha, peka na, ‘pakèd'i nèti rai èta-èsu èu; tèke eele a'ari èu. lamu ka asa era èci, dhu bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu! ' hèia na pakèd'i ka nèti rai èta-èsu na, ètu rai mesopotamia, la'e asa kota haran.

source_text: so abraham left the land of the chaldeans and settled in haran. after his father died, god brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.
target_text: hèia na tèke eele rai dhèu kasdim, ka la'e pea ètu kota haran. ropa ama d'èlu na madhe, ka ama lamatua lere ne asa rai ne'e ne, dhu ama-ama a'ari pea toke d'ai sange ne'e ne.

source_text: he gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. but god promised to give possession of the land to abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hag'e boe rai ca kasib'i sa hia ne ho j'aj'i rai pusaka na. te ngaa ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, nèngu hia rai ne'e, j'aj'i rai pusaka ana-èpu na. te ngaa lod'o èèna, abraham dènge mèka ana.

source_text: god told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, ‘bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu èu lasi pea ètu rai dhèu. ho dhèu rai èèna ènyi si, aa tao rèngu j'aj'i ènu, dènge paj'èra si toke d'ai èpa ngasu tèu.

source_text: ‘but i will punish the nation that enslaves them, ' god said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship me in this place. '
target_text: ho ladhe èle èpa ngasu tèu èèna, ja'a huku dhèu kabarai dhu tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ènu sèra. hèia ana-èpu èu tèke eele rai èèna, ho rèngu mai asa era ne'e ne, sèna ka ra manèngi makasi mi ja'a. '

source_text: then god gave abraham the covenant of circumcision, and abraham became the father of isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. and isaac became the father of jacob, and jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na hia tadha lii moa ne dènge j'ara suna ana mone, j'aj'i tadha dhu sasoa na, abraham j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, ropa ana na, isak, d'ai umur aru lod'o, hèia na suna ne. aa isak suna ana na, yakob kahèi. aa yakob suna ana-ana mone na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, ladhe umur rèngu d'ai aru lod'o. rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, bèi-baki èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: because the patriarchs were jealous of joseph, they sold him as a slave into egypt. but god was with him
target_text: ca tèka, bèi-baki èdhi sèra d'ara pèd'a dènge ari ra yusuf, ka ra pahie eele ne ka j'aj'i ènu ètu rai masir nèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ne.

source_text: and rescued him from all his troubles. he granted joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of pharaoh king of egypt, who appointed him ruler over egypt and all his household.
target_text: nèti èèna ka lamatua patabuli eele ne nèti j'aj'èra nèngu. ama lamatua hia ne d'èlu-mèu, ka ne'a j'ara ae-ae, ka dhèu aae masir sue ne. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ne j'aj'i gubernur ètu rai masir. aa na nèd'u koasa kahèi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: then famine and great suffering swept across egypt and canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
target_text: hèia tèu manganga lèke rai masir dènge rai kana'an. tèu-tèu manganga mad'èu èèna, bia titu kèna. nèti èèna ka dhèu ètu mia-mia j'èra d'ai seli. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèi-baki èdhi abhu heka nganga'a.

source_text: when jacob heard that there was grain in egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
target_text: te ngaa baki yakob tadèngi lii, na, ètu rai masir abhu nganga'a. ka na pua ana-ana na sèra, nuka bèi-baki èdhi, ho lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rai masir.

source_text: on their second visit, joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to pharaoh.
target_text: hèli rare, hèia ra lèpa. ropa oe èle nganga'a sèra, ka ama ra pua hari lasi hèli nganga'a ètu masir. lod'o èèna ka, heka yusuf bhoke d'ara, peka na, nèngu ne ari d'èlu rèngu. ka na patadha a'ari na sèra dènge dhèu aae masir.

source_text: then joseph sent for his father jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf manèngi ama na dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i lasi pea asa rai masir. rèngu dhu lasi asa nèi, aa'i-aa'i ra pidhu nguru lèmi dhèu.

source_text: so jacob went down to egypt, where he and our fathers died.
target_text: de baki yakob pidha asa nèi, toke d'ai bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe ètu masir.

source_text: their bones were carried back to shechem and placed in the tomb that abraham had bought from the sons of hamor at shechem for a price he paid in silver.
target_text: ka nèbhu aae ku, heka rèti rui bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèpa hari asa rae sikem ètu rai kana'an. ka ra tèke rui sèra ètu era dhu uru èèna baki abraham hèli nare nèti ana-èpu hemor.

source_text: as the time drew near for god to fulfill his promise to abraham, our people in egypt increased greatly in number.
target_text: stefanus tuhu hari lii, peka na, se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, èèna na limuri hari nèngu neo hia rai pusaka mi baki abraham ètu era èèna. ropa oe d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua moa èèna, èdhi dhèu yahudi tabha ae titu kèna ètu rai masir nèi.

source_text: then another king, who knew nothing of joseph, arose over egypt.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae hiu èci paredha ètu nèi. te ngaa nèngu tadhe boe yusuf.

source_text: he exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.
target_text: dhèu aae ne'e ènyi ruri dhèu èdhi sèra. aa na bhelu titu kèna dènge bèi-baki èdhi. na laka-seti rèngu ho core eele ana rèngu dhu rara iisi hiu, sèna ka madhe.

source_text: at that time moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of god. for three months he was nurtured in his father's house.
target_text: lod'o èèna, d'ai lod'o ina musa nara iisi ne. musa kabèb'u titu kèna! ina dènge ama na madhutu boe lii paredha dhèu aae. ra piara pahuni ne, toke d'ai tèlu hèru.

source_text: when he was set outside, pharaoh's daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
target_text: ropa rèngu bisa heka pahuni ne ètu d'ara èmu, ka ra panangi eele ne. te ngaa ana bhèni dhèu aae masir rage nare ne, ka sa'u nèti asa èmu, ka na ladhe-leru ne sèmi ana d'èlu nèngu.

source_text: so moses was educated in all the wisdom of the egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu rai masir aj'a aa'i ne dènge mamèu ra, toke d'ai na j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu. nèngu ne d'èlu-mèu ètu d'ara lii padhai, aa ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a.

source_text: when moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of israel.
target_text: ropa musa d'ai umur èpa nguru tèu, hèia na neo patadha dènge dhèu isra'el nèngu sèra.

source_text: and when he saw one of them being mistreated, moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the egyptian who was oppressing him.
target_text: ropa na la'e, ka na nèdhi dhèu masir èci dhu game dhèu isra'el ca dhèu. ka na sarii dhèu isra'el èèna, aa na hake pamadhe dhèu masir èèna.

source_text: he assumed his brothers would understand that god was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
target_text: te musa ngee, na, dhèu nèngu sèra re'a le, na, ama lamatua pua ne ho patabuli rèngu nèti j'aj'èra ra. te ngaa rèngu re'a mèka.

source_text: the next day he came upon two israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘men, you are brothers. why are you mistreating each other? '
target_text: bèli èèna, musa la'e hari ladhe dhèu isra'el na sèra. ka na rage dhèu dua pagama. aa na neo padame dhèu dua se, peka na, ‘weh! miu dua mi se, pa'a'ari. nga tao ka miu dua mi patao? '

source_text: but the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed moses aside and said, ‘who made you ruler and judge over us?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu game angalai na, dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i! aa cee ka dhu paj'uj'u èu, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu j'ue lii langu ji'i?

source_text: do you want to kill me as you killed the egyptian yesterday? '
target_text: èu ngee, na, èu bisa pamadhe hari ja'a, sama sèmi èu pamadhe dhèu masir med'a na? '

source_text: at this remark, moses fled to the land of midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.
target_text: ropa musa tadèngi nare lii ne'e, hèia na rai eele nèti rai masir, la'e pea ètu rai dhèu median. na leo-èmu ètu èèna, ka ra abhu ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: after forty years had passed, an angel appeared to moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near mount sinai.
target_text: d'ai èpa nguru tèu, hèia musa la'e asa d'ara mamoo èci, padètu dènge ledhe èci, ngara na ledhe sinai. ètu èèna, ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka pad'elo iisi na nèti d'ara ai dhu heo ètu ana aaj'u iiki ca kapua. ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, te ngaa kèpu boe.

source_text: when moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. as he approached to look more closely, the voice of the lord came to him:
target_text: ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musa loo-loo sène. ka na la'e padètu ho neo ne'a, ngaa ka ne. kabèdhi laa, na tadèngi ama lamatua padhai lii nèti d'ara ai, peka na,

source_text: ‘i am the god of your fathers, the god of abraham, isaac, and jacob. ' moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
target_text: ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu! lamatua nèti baki abraham, baki isak, dènge baki yakob. ' tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka na madha'u toke d'ai isi karèbha. aa na bani heka doa kètu ho ladhe ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e èèna.

source_text: then the lord said to him, ‘take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘we, musa! era dhu èu titu ne, era luri. bhoke eele salapa èu!

source_text: i have indeed seen the oppression of my people in egypt. i have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. now come, i will send you back to egypt. '
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a bhèlu eele le dhèu isra'el unu ja'a ètu masir sèi. aad'o! ja'a sanèd'e si era. ja'a ke'a j'aj'èra rèngu. ja'a tadèngi le lii roma iisi rèngu manèngi sasue. de ja'a neo puru ho patabuli eele si. mai ku asa ne'e! ja'a neo pua èu lèpa hari asa masir nèi. '

source_text: this moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘who made you ruler and judge? ' is the one whom god sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ka lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi nèti d'ara ai èèna, na paredha musa ho lèpa hari asa masir. lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu ho patabuli eele dhèu isra'el nèti d'ara j'aj'èra rèngu. musa ne ka dhu uru èèna dhèu karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i? ' te ngaa ne'e ne, lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne!

source_text: he led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of egypt, at the red sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, musa lèpa hari asa rai masir. ètu nèi, na tao tadha-tadha malaa ae. ka na kalua eele dhèu isra'el nèti masir. nèti si kako re dhasi mea, ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo d'ai èpa nguru tèu.

source_text: this is the same moses who told the israelites, ‘god will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. '
target_text: ka musa peka dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘èèna na lamatua ded'e dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho na paj'aj'i ne dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, sama sèmi na ded'e nare ja'a. '

source_text: he was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on mount sinai, and with our fathers. and he received living words to pass on to us.
target_text: musa pa'èci dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra ètu d'ara mamoo. nèngu èèna ka dhu j'aj'i kalete mi bèi-baki èdhi dènge ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. te ana pajuu èèna ka dhu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua asa musa. sèra sa ka dhu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii holo-nori sèra ka dhu lamatua papuru ètu ledhe sinai.

source_text: but our fathers refused to obey him. instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to egypt.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi sèra ro'o boe nanene musa. aa ra tule eele ne, ho ra neo lèpa hari asa rai masir.

source_text: they said to aaron, ‘make us gods who will go before us! as for this moses who led us out of the land of egypt, we do not know what has happened to him. '
target_text: ka ra lasi rarange harun, aku rèngu na, ‘ari mu musa ka dhu pakalua eele èdhi nèti rai masir. te ngaa èdhi te'a heka nèngu ètu ro'a mia. de ji'i manèngi èu tao mèdha sogo-tagu èci hia èdhi, sèna ka mèdha sogo-tagu èèna lere èdhi. '

source_text: at that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.
target_text: ka ra tao ka mèdha sogo-tagu èci, rupa sèmi ana sapi ci'u. èle èèna ka, ra para badha hia mèdha sogo-tagu èèna. ka ra ra'a-sisi rame-rame, lula rèngu karej'e nèti mèdha sogo-tagu dhu rèngu tao unu ra.

source_text: but god turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, o house of israel?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua soro kabodho hia si. ka ra mulai sogo-tagu ka mèdha dedha-liru, sèmi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu. te ngaa lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna. èèna na lèke sèmi lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘weh! miu dhèu isra'el sèra! d'ara èpa nguru tèu, miu kako palème d'ara mamoo. aa miu para badha sèra, neo sogo-tagu mi ja'a, do, neo sogo-tagu mi cee?

source_text: you have taken along the tabernacle of molech and the star of your god rephan, the idols you made to worship. therefore i will send you into exile beyond babylon. '
target_text: miu koa-kio boe ja'a! bèli-bèli miu sogo-tagu dhoka mèdha sogo-tagu miu sèra di. miu maso-kalua taruu d'ara èmu mèdha sogo-tagu nidhu, ngara na molok. miu biasa sogo-tagu nidhu hua-hètu èci kahèi, ngara na refan. de miu d'èi dhoka sogo-tagu mèdha pa'ue-ai miu. nèti èèna ka, limuri mai ja'a bhabhoo miu lami asa cabèka babel nèi. '

source_text: our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony with them in the wilderness. it was constructed exactly as god had directed moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
target_text: stefanus padhai lii taruu, peka na, ama lamatua paj'uj'u rupa nèti era manèngi-mangaj'i èci mi musa. hèia musa si patitu paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èci, dhu tao nèti ka'uri badha dènge bèla, sama sèmi rupa dhu lamatua pad'elo le. ka dhèu isra'el sèra mai sabaj'a mi ama lamatua ètu era èèna. ho ladhe rèngu pidha nèti ca'era asa era leo lasi, na, ra sag'e eele paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, aa ra èki nèu ne, aa ra jèru rèti asa era hiu. ètu era hiu, ra patitu hari paleo èèna.

source_text: and our fathers who received it brought it in with joshua when they dispossessed the nations god drove out before them. it remained until the time of david,
target_text: limuri mai, lod'o yosua si pamusu dènge dhèu rai leo ètu rai kana'an, ama lamatua babège eele si. ka na pabagi rai kana'an èèna hia bèi-baki èdhi. lod'o rèngu parame rare rai èèna, rèngu rèti paleo manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua asa era èèna. paleo èèna titu taruu ètu èèna, toke d'ai lod'o dhèu aae daud nèd'u paredha.

source_text: who found favor in the sight of god and asked to provide a dwelling place for the god of jacob.
target_text: dhèu aae daud manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi baki yakob si. ka daud pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, hèia lamatua hia nèngu berkat. ka na manèngi ho lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu sèna ka patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu hiu.

source_text: but it was solomon who built the house for him.
target_text: te ngaa ana nèti daud, ngara na soleman ka dhu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua èèna.

source_text: however, the most high does not dwell in houses made by human hands. as the prophet says:
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua pea boe ètu d'ara èmu dhu dhèu rai-haha tao, lula uru èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci suri tèke le, peka na,

source_text: ‘heaven is my throne and the earth is my footstool. what kind of house will you build for me, says the lord, or where will my place of repose be?
target_text: ‘dedha-liru èèna, kadera era ja'a madhèdi paredha. aa rai-haha èèna, era hue haga ja'a. de tasamia ka miu bisa tao èmu èci dhu be'a hia ja'a pea ètu d'ara? bisa boe!

source_text: has not my hand made all these things? '
target_text: lula dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu paj'aj'i! '

source_text: you stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! you always resist the holy spirit, just as your fathers did.
target_text: hèia stefanus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, miu dhèu kètu hadhu! miu se, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu nanene boe nèngu. miu dhèu dhu palab'a dènge ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki miu dhu soro kabodho asa ne! ka limuri ne, miu neo hari palab'a dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, do?

source_text: which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? they even killed those who foretold the coming of the righteous one. and now you are his betrayers and murderers-
target_text: bèi-baki miu sèra ka dhu paj'èra taruu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. miu peka ku! dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua mia ka dhu rèngu paj'èra boe? aad'o, sina ma! uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema, aku rèngu na, limuri mai ama lamatua pua dhèu nèngu dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa bèi-baki miu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. ka miu tenge j'ara kahèi ho hia dhèu leo pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci nèti lamatua.

source_text: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.
target_text: aa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga sèra dhu rèti mai atora ad'a dhu lamatua neo hia mi èdhi, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe.

source_text: on hearing this, the members of the sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu pama'ète lii langu sèra nanene rare lii padhai lii stefanus, ka re'a mema, na, nèngu pasala si. ka ra kadhi ngutu aa tèka d'ara.

source_text: but stephen, full of the holy spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of god and jesus standing at the right hand of god.
target_text: te ngaa roh mola-mèci lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara stefanus. na doa kètu ka ladhe asa dedha-liru. ètu nèi, na ladhe nèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, dènge nèdhi kahèi lamatua yesus titu ètu sebhe g'ana na ètu era dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: look, he said, i see heaven open and the son of man standing at the right hand of god.
target_text: hèia stefanus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e ku, ama aa'i-aa'i. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoke eele, aa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a titu ètu era hua iia, re sebhe g'ana ama lamatua.

source_text: at this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu pama'ète lii langu sèra hutu ro'a dhilu ra. ka ra jèke ne, sèna ka kai stefanus baku bhoke hèb'a. ka ra mangamok neo game ne.

source_text: they dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named saul.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra nuni-pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u kota. d'ai nèi, ka sakasii sèra bhoke eele kodho li'u ra, ho ra hia mi ana mone ngèru èci nèd'u. ngara na saulus, dhu j'aj'i dhèu dadugu-rariu dhèu. èle èèna ka, ra tabhie stefanus dènge hadhu.

source_text: while they were stoning him, stephen appealed, lord jesus, receive my spirit.
target_text: ropa ra tabhie, hèia stefanus pa'oo, peka na, lamatua yesus! lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. sèmi more ku samanga ja'a!

source_text: falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, lord, do not hold this sin against them. and when he had said this, he fell asleep.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na bèbhe-lèpe urutuu, ka na pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ama! baku hia si d'ui sasala ne'e! hèia na ma'ète a'ae dènge ka.

source_text: and saul was there, giving approval to stephen's death. on that day a great persecution broke out against the church in jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout judea and samaria.
target_text: aa saulus ètu èèna kahèi, ka nèngu d'èi ra pamadhe stefanus kahèi.

source_text: god-fearing men buried stephen and mourned deeply over him.
target_text: lod'o stefanus madhe, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara d'èi dènge lamatua. lasi rare ngi'u aae stefanus ho ra padhane. ka ra tangi ne. nèti lod'o èèna, ka dhèu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu kota yerusalem, toke d'ai rèngu j'èra bia. èle èèna ka, rèngu rai pahag'a lasi asa propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria. rèngu aa'i-aa'i rai, te ngaa tèke eele dhoka dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus di ètu yerusalem.

source_text: but saul began to destroy the church. going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.
target_text: te ngaa saulus tenge j'ara taruu ho pa'èle dhèu unu yesus sèra. na tenge si ètu mia-mia. na maso-kalua èmu dhèu ho na tenge si. sad'i abhu dhèu mone, do dhèu bhèni, na kèpe si, ho na cèlu si asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
target_text: masi ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus sèra ho ra rai asa haa asa dhimu, te ngaa rèngu loe boe peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia.

source_text: philip went down to a city in samaria and proclaimed the christ to them.
target_text: conto sèmi, ca tèka, pelipus la'e asa d'ara kota èci ètu propensi samaria, ho peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, na, yesus, nuka kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: the crowds gave their undivided attention to philip's message and to the signs they saw him perform.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra pakaboko ho nanene paie ngaa dhu pelipus peka-padhai.

source_text: with loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.
target_text: conto sèmi, ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao. nidhu sèra rai eele dhèu se'e dènge pakii-pakèce. dhèu karuku dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: so there was great joy in that city.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara kota èèna karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: prior to that time, a man named simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of samaria. he claimed to be someone great,
target_text: ètu kota èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu pake na'i, ngara na simon. nèbhu le na pake na'i ètu talora dhèu samaria sèra. ka na padedha iisi na, peka na, ja'a dhèu èra!

source_text: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, this man is the divine power called the great power. they paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.
target_text: ka nèti kota èèna, ana iiki do dhèu kapai, dhèu mone do bhèni, palolo dhoka dhèu ne'e di, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e ele-madha, nga! ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao ne, mai nèti koasa ama lamatua! lula nèngu pake na'i, nèti uru ka mai dhèu ae lèka ne.

source_text: but when they believed philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of god and the name of jesus christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, rèngu nanene pelipus aj'a rèngu j'ara paredha ama lamatua. aa na peka j'ara ho rèngu rèti kolongara yesus, sèna ka rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. ropa ra tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae parcaya, ka j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ra abhu sarani.

source_text: even simon himself believed and was baptized. he followed philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.
target_text: te ngaa simon parcaya kahèi, ka manèngi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra sarani ne. hèia na madhutu pelipus asa mia-mia. ropa nèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu pelipus tao, hèia na pangètu kètu na, peka na, ira ii! sèmi ne'e ne, risi eele!

source_text: when the apostles in jerusalem heard that samaria had received the word of god, they sent peter and john to them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dhu ètu yerusalem sèra, tadèngi, na, dhèu ae parcaya le lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu propensi samaria. ka ra manèngi petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa nèi.

source_text: on their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the holy spirit. for the holy spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the lord jesus. then peter and john laid their hands on them, and they received the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai nèi, rèngu heka re'a kèna, dhèu ètu nèi abhu mèka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. rèngu dhoka abhu sarani pake kolongara yesus di. hèia petrus dènge yohanis bane ai mi dhèu sèra, ka ra manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka dhèu samaria sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi. ka dhèu se'e abhu dènge roh kahèi.

source_text: when simon saw that the spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon ladhe nèdhi rèngu dua ra bane ai mi dhèu se'e, ka dhèu sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua. hèia na j'ole doi asa petrus dènge yohanis, dènge lii manèngi, peka na,

source_text: give me this power as well, he said, so that everyone on whom i lay my hands may receive the holy spirit.
target_text: ama-ama! miu hia ku ja'a koasa èèna. sèna ka ladhe ja'a bane ai mi dhèu, na, ra abhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi.

source_text: but peter replied, may your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of god with money!
target_text: te ngaa petrus jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhoo èu dènge doi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa hèli koasa roh mola-mèci dènge doi dhari, do? aad'o! dhèu bisa boe hèli roh lamatua!

source_text: you have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before god.
target_text: èu dènge boe hak mi roh lamatua, lula d'ara èu mola boe. èu dhoka tenge-tenge j'ara di.

source_text: repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the lord. perhaps he will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
target_text: èu hud'i ae eele ku nèti sasala-sasigo èu sèra. hua iia èu sabaj'a ho teko-teko lamatua saku eele ngangee aapa èu.

source_text: for i see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, d'ara èu aapa, aa j'ara karehe ae dhu èki èu!

source_text: then simon answered, pray to the lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.
target_text: ka simon manèngi dua si, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe sèmi èèna, miu dua mi sabaj'a ku hia ja'a, sèna ka lii dhoo dhu miu peka èèna, baku lèke ja'a.

source_text: and after peter and john had testified and spoken the word of the lord, they returned to jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the samaritan villages.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia petrus dènge yohanis lole aa'i lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, aa ra lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu d'ara kota èèna. hèia rèngu lèpa hari asa yerusalem. ra kako re rae-rae ètu propensi samaria, ho lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus mi dhèu ètu rae sèra.

source_text: now an angel of the lord said to philip, get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from jerusalem to gaza.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga pua pelipus, peka na, lamu ku madhutu j'ara asa balèu. madhutu j'ara dhui, dhu nèti kota yerusalem la'e asa rai gasa.

source_text: so he started out, and on his way he met an ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of candace, queen of the ethiopians. he had gone to jerusalem to worship, and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading isaiah the prophet.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii paredha èèna, ka na pakèd'i dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kako ètu j'ara èèna, ladhe nèdhi dhèu èci. dhèu èèna, pegawi kapai nèti rai etiopia. nèngu ne ka dhu ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau dhèu aae bhèni, ngara na kandake. pegawi èèna heka sabaj'a nare ètu yerusalem, ka na lèpa èmu ca'e kareta. ropa pelipus nèdhi ne, nèngu madhèdi baca ètu dedha kareta. na baca sasuri dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya.

source_text: the spirit said to philip, go over to that chariot and stay by it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh lamatua pua pelipus la'e padètu asa kareta èèna, sèna ka na paraga dènge dhèu èèna.

source_text: so philip ran up and heard the man reading isaiah the prophet. do you understand what you are reading? philip asked.
target_text: ropa na dètu, ka na tadèngi, na, dhèu èèna baca sasuri yesaya. ka pelipus karèi ne, peka na, ama! ama ku me'a, do aad'o, ngaa dhu ama baca èèna?

source_text: how can i, he said, unless someone guides me? and he invited philip to come up and sit with him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ja'a ke'a boe. hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka-padhai dènge ja'a, heka ja'a ke'a kèna. ca'e mai ho madhèdi dènge ja'a.

source_text: the eunuch was reading this passage of scripture: he was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.
target_text: sasuri dhu na baca èèna, sèmi ne'e ka, ra nuni rèti ne, sama sèmi nuni kahib'i-kalèbho, ho neo roro ne. nèngu j'aj'i sama sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dhèu g'ute rèu ne, te ngaa nèngu mau-mau sène, na kabee boe. hèb'a na kutu mèno, aa na kalua boe lii ca lamusi sa.

source_text: in his humiliation he was deprived of justice. who can recount his descendants? for his life was removed from the earth.
target_text: ka ra lalangu ne, ra j'ue lii langu na lèke boe. lod'o èèna, ra pamadhe ne, masi ka nèngu dènge boe sasala-sasigo. de èdhi peka ngaa hari lula-nèti ana-èpu na?

source_text: tell me, said the eunuch, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?
target_text: ropa na baca nare, hèia na karèi pelipus, peka na, tasamia, ee? sasuri yesaya ne, lèke mi nèngu, do, lèke mi dhèu leo?

source_text: then philip began with this very scripture and told him the good news about jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus aj'a ne lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na lolo nèti lii sasuri yesaya, ho pad'elo j'ara madhutu yesus.

source_text: as they traveled along the road and came to some water, the eunuch said, look, here is water! what is there to prevent me from being baptized?
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu d'ara kakako era, rèngu rage loko èci dènge èi. ka dhèu èèna peka dènge pelipus, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ku èi ka nèi. ladhe èu ngee, na, cadhui boe, mai puru lati, ho èu sarani ku ja'a.

source_text: and he gave orders to stop the chariot. then both philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and philip baptized him.
target_text: hèia pegawi èèna, paredha ho patitu kareta. ka dua ra puru asa d'ara èi èèna, ka pelipus sarani ne.

source_text: when they came up out of the water, the spirit of the lord carried philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but went on his way rejoicing.
target_text: ropa ra kalua mai nèti d'ara èi, kabèdhi laa roh lamatua ded'e nèti pelipus asa era leo. ka dhèu èèna nèdhi heka pelipus. hèia pegawi kapai èèna lèpa dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: but philip appeared at azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to caesarea.
target_text: ka pelipus cèu ètu rae èci, ngara na asotus. nèti rae èèna, ka na la'e padhue-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na dhuli rae-rae ètu rai èèna, toke d'ai kota kaisarea.

source_text: meanwhile, saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the lord. he approached the high priest
target_text: lod'o èèna, saulus paj'èra taruu dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus. na tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe si. nèti èèna ka, la'e asa kètu kapai risi agama yahudi,

source_text: and requested letters to the synagogues in damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the way, he could bring them as prisoners to jerusalem.
target_text: ka manèngi pèri-pèri sasuri koasa, ho nèti la'e asa ama-ama èmu manèngi-mangaj'i agama yahudi ètu kota damsik nèi. na manèngi, ladhe nèngu rage dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus ètu nèi, bhèni-mone, nèngu kèpe ho èki si, sèna ka ère nèti hari si asa yerusalem.

source_text: as saul drew near to damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare sasuri koasa sèra, ka nèngu dènge angalai na lasi asa kota damsik. ropa oe dètu dènge kota èèna, cag'ag'a laa, saraa puru nèti dedha-liru sarimu nare saulus.

source_text: he fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, saul, saul, why do you persecute me?
target_text: ka na bèbhe rai la'e. hèia na tadèngi lii èci padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, saulus! saulus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: who are you, lord? saul asked. i am jesus, whom you are persecuting, he replied.
target_text: hèia saulus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhu padhai lii ne, cee ka èu? lii èèna, peka hari, ja'a ne, yesus, dhu èu paj'èra aae ne.

source_text: now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.
target_text: kèd'i, ho lamu asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, pe ja'a peka dènge èu, ngaa dhu èu hud'i tao.

source_text: the men traveling with saul stood there speechless. they heard the voice but did not see anyone.
target_text: aa angalai nèngu sèra tadèngi kahèi lii èèna, te ngaa rèdhi boe cee-cee. dhèu se'e malaa, ka re'a heka padhai lii ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. so they led him by the hand into damascus.
target_text: hèia saulus kèd'i titu. ka na neo bhoke musi madha na, te ngaa nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ka ra sarad'e rèti ne asa d'ara kota damsik.

source_text: for three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, na bisa boe nèdhi ngaa-ngaa. aa na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: in damascus there was a disciple named ananias. the lord spoke to him in a vision, ananias! here i am, lord, he answered.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota èèna, abhu dhèu unu lamatua yesus èci, ngara na ananias. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne, sama sèmi tanila sa. na paroa, peka na, ananias! hèia ananias dhaa, peka na, oo, lamatua!

source_text: get up! the lord told him. go to the house of judas on straight street and ask for a man from tarsus named saul, for he is praying.
target_text: lamatua peka, na, nanene ku! èu lamu tenge ku dhèu unu ja'a èci. kako lamu asa j'ara èci, dhu ngara na j'ara mola. lamu asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. ètu èèna, karèi rèngu dhèu èci nèti kota tarsus, ngara na saulus. dhèu èèna sabaj'a era.

source_text: in a vision he has seen a man named ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.
target_text: ja'a hia ne tanila kahèi, na, èèna na dhèu mone èci neo mai paraga dènge ne, nuka èu, ananias. de lamu ho bane ai èu mi nèngu, sèna ka na bisa nèdhi hari.

source_text: but ananias answered, lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to your saints in jerusalem.
target_text: te ngaa ananias b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, lamatua! ji'i tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti dhèu èèna. nèngu èèna ka dhu paj'èra dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bani heka bhodho baboro!

source_text: and now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name.
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i tadèngi hari, peka na, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ne koasa ho mai kèpa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus.

source_text: go! said the lord. this man is my chosen instrument to carry my name before the gentiles and their kings, and before the people of israel.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua padhai lii hari dènge ananias, peka na, masi ka sèmi èèna, èu hud'i lamu ku! te ja'a hag'e kore nèngu le, ho na bhoke j'ara, sèna ka na lole lii lolo be'a ja'a hia dhèu kabarai leo sèra, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu isra'el kahèi.

source_text: i will show him how much he must suffer for my name.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a pad'elo dènge ne, sèna ka nèngu ne'a mema j'aj'èra tasa mera mia ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèngu pasae, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: so ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on saul. brother saul, he said, the lord jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the holy spirit.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii padhai lii lamatua, hèia ananias la'e ka maso asa èmu èèna. ka na bane ai na mi saulus, peka na, angalai saulus! lamatua yesus dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu talora j'ara lod'o èu mai asa ne'e, nèngu èèna ka dhu pua ja'a mai paraga dènge èu ètu ne'e. na pua ja'a kahèi ho sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha èu, sèna ka èu bisa mèdhi hari. aa na d'èi ho èu sèmi more roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: at that instant, something like scales fell from saul's eyes, and his sight was restored. he got up and was baptized,
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, saulus rasa ngaa èci bèbhe eele nèti musi madha nèngu, sèmi nai i'a. hèia na ladhe nèdhi hari. ka na kèd'i, aa ra sarani dènge ne.

source_text: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. and he spent several days with the disciples in damascus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na na'a-ninu. ka na abhu hari a'èra. ka saulus pea hari dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri lod'o ètu kota damsik.

source_text: saul promptly began to proclaim jesus in the synagogues, declaring, he is the son of god.
target_text: aa la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! mema yesus tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua.

source_text: all who heard him were astounded and asked, isn't this the man who wreaked havoc in jerusalem on those who call on this name? and hasn't he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa dènge bingu, ropa ra tadèngi saulus padhai lii sèmi èèna. hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu yesus ètu yerusalem, sina ma? aa mamai ne, sèna ka na kèpe dhèu se'e ho nèti asa kètu agama yahudi sèra! na, tasamia ka ne?

source_text: but saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the jews living in damascus by proving that jesus is the christ.
target_text: te ngaa saulus padhai lii taruu, aku nèngu na, yesus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru, ho pua na mai. saulus padhai lii dènge d'èlu-mèu aa d'ara adhu, toke dhèu yahudi sèra segi boe nèngu. nèti èèna ka, a'èra saulus asa tabha kapai.

source_text: after many days had passed, the jews conspired to kill him,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu yahudi sèra sanunu ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but saul learned of their plot. day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.
target_text: te ngaa saulus ae nare ngangee aapa rèngu èèna, dhu peka na, ra mate ne mèu-mèda ètu hèb'a-hèb'a tebho kota, ho ra neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: one night, however, his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.
target_text: ka ca tèka hari, d'ara mèda, angalai saulus pèri-pèri dhèu mai rare ne, ka ra papuru ne ètu d'ara kadhari cue, re karasa li'u tebho kota. dènge j'ara èèna ka, nèngu rai nèti kota damsik.

source_text: when saul arrived in jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
target_text: èle èèna ka, saulus la'e asa yerusalem. d'ai nèi, ka na neo pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu sèra madha'u dènge nèngu, lula ra pangee, na, nèngu dhoka sangaja di, j'aj'i dhèu parcaya dhu madhutu lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, nèngu kabèli hari ho neo kèpe rèngu.

source_text: then barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how saul had seen the lord, who spoke to him on the road to damascus, and how saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of jesus.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci, ngara na barnabas, nèngu ka dhu nèti saulus ho patadhe mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua ètu èèna. na lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi dedha saulus ètu talora j'ara. na peka, na, saulus paraga le dènge lamatua yesus kahèi. aa yesus padhai lii dènge nèngu kahèi. na lolo kahèi babani saulus padhai lii j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu damsik sèra.

source_text: so saul stayed with them, moving about freely in jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the lord.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare barnabas peka sèmi èèna, heka ra sèmi rare saulus kèna. ka ra pea pa'èci ètu kota yerusalem. saulus bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus kahèi, sad'i dènge dhèu cee èèna ka. nèngu madha'u boe.

source_text: he talked and debated with the grecian jews, but they tried to kill him.
target_text: na pakarèi dènge pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu padhai lii yunani. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii padhai lii nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra tenge j'ara neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: when the brothers learned of this, they took him down to caesarea and sent him off to tarsus.
target_text: ropa dhèu unu lamatua yesus re'a ngangee karehe dhèu sèra, hèia lasi rare saulus rèti asa kota kaisarea. d'ai nèi, ka ra pua ne lèpa asa kota na, tarsus.

source_text: then the church throughout judea, galilee, and samaria experienced a time of peace. it grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the lord and the encouragement of the holy spirit.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu propensi yudea, propensi galilea, dènge propensi samaria, mamuri dènge mera-milu. rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: as peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in lydda.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o sèra, petrus biasa kako palème asa mia-mia, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu unu lamatua sèra. ca lod'o ka na la'e ngad'o rèngu ètu rae lida.

source_text: there he found a man named aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
target_text: ètu nèi, na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ngara na eneas. dhèu ne, karuku aru tèu kèna, ka na kèd'i nare heka nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: aeneas, peter said to him, jesus christ heals you! get up and put away your mat. immediately aeneas got up,
target_text: hèia petrus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, eneas! limuri ne, lamatua yesus kristus pa'èle èu. de kèd'i ka! lalau paie era j'unu èu! nanene nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and all who lived in lydda and sharon saw him and turned to the lord.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi eneas èle le, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rae lida dènge rae saron parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: in joppa there was a disciple named tabitha which is translated as dorcas, who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na tabita, pea dètu dènge nebhe dhasi ètu kota yope. madhutu lii yunani ra paroa bhèni ne, ngara na dorkas. sasoa na ‘rusa'. bhèni ne parcaya lamatua yesus. tatao bhèni ne be'a mi dedha dhèu leo, aa na tema laladhe dhèu j'èra.

source_text: at that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.
target_text: lod'o èèna, tabita ne pèd'a aae, ka madhe. ka dhèu padiu ne èi. èle èèna ka, ra papake ne mèdha-papake, ka ra paj'unu ne ètu kama dedha.

source_text: since lydda was near joppa, the disciples heard that peter was there and sent two men to urge him, come to us without delay.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu se tadèngi, na, petrus ètu rae lida, dhu kaj'èu nèti kota yope, sèmi kako haga na ele boe ca'èta lod'o sa. ka ra pua dhèu dua lasi paroa petrus, peka na, ama! ji'i manèngi ama mai ku lai-lai asa kota yope.

source_text: so peter got up and went with them. on his arrival, they took him to the upper room. all the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that dorcas had made while she was still with them.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka petrus kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu rèngu. d'ai nèi, ka na maso taruu asa d'ara kama tabita. ètu d'ara kama na, pènu le dènge bhèni balu dhu mai tangi. bhèni balu sèra pad'elo mi petrus kodho dènge mèdha-papake leo, dhu dorkas j'au hia rèngu, lod'o na mamuri era.

source_text: then peter sent them all out of the room. he knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, tabitha, get up! she opened her eyes, and seeing peter, she sat up.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si kalua nèti kama. ka na patitu urutuu ho na manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia na ladhe asa dhèu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii, peka na, tabita! kèd'i ka! cag'ag'a laa, tabita bhoke musi madha na. ropa ladhe nèdhi petrus, ka na kèd'i madhèdi.

source_text: peter took her by the hand and helped her up. then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe kacui-aai na, ho hia ne titu. ka petrus paroa bhèni balu sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu leo ètu èèna, ho na hia bhèni dhu mamuri hari ne asa rèngu.

source_text: this became known all over joppa, and many people believed in the lord.
target_text: ka lii lole ne, dhèu lolo palème d'ara kota yope, toke d'ai dhèu ae parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: and peter stayed for several days in joppa with a tanner named simon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus pea pèri-pèri lod'o ètu èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. dhèu ne'e, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: at caesarea there was a man named cornelius, a centurion in what was called the italian regiment.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma dhèu èci, ngara na kornelis. nèngu ne, komedhaa nèti sordad'u cangasu dhèu. rèngu mai nèti kaj'èu, nèti rai italia, ka ra pea ètu kota kaisarea.

source_text: he and all his household were devout and god-fearing. he gave generously to the people and prayed to god regularly.
target_text: nèngu dènge isi èmu na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ae ka dhèu roma leo sèmi boe èèna. nèngu biasa soru-bara dhèu j'èra, aa na maj'èni sabaj'a mi ama lamatua.

source_text: one day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of god who came to him and said, cornelius!
target_text: ca lod'o hari, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, na abhu tanila. na ladhe nèdhi iia-iia ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka na paroa ne, peka na, kornelis!

source_text: cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, what is it, lord? the angel answered, your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before god.
target_text: ropa kornelis ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga, ka na madha'u titu kèna. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama? ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, na, lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu leo. ka na sanèd'e èu.

source_text: now send men to joppa to call for a man named simon who is called peter.
target_text: de pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa rèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: he is staying with simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.
target_text: dhèu èèna manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, unu simon, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: when the angel who spoke to him had gone, cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu nèti sorga ne tèke eele kornelis, ka na paroa ana sab'a na dhèu dua, dènge sordad'u èci dhu d'èi padètu dènge lamatua kahèi.

source_text: he explained what had happened and sent them to joppa.
target_text: kornelis lolo aa'i ngaa dhu nèngu nèdhi èèna, ka na pua si lasi asa kota yope.

source_text: the next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, peter went up on the roof to pray.
target_text: ka asa bèli èèna, pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, dhèu paleha nèti kornelis sèra oe d'ai le yope. lod'o èèna, petrus ca'e la'e neo manèngi-mangaj'i asa kalaga dedha èmu simon.

source_text: he became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
target_text: ropa na manèngi-mangaj'i, na rasa manganga. na mate dhèu lalau nganga'a-nginu. ropa nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i era, na abhu tanila kahèi.

source_text: he saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
target_text: na nèdhi sèmi liru bhoka. ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla puru mai, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na.

source_text: it contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.
target_text: ètu d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, nèngu ladhe nèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi.

source_text: then a voice said to him: get up, peter, kill and eat!
target_text: hèia na tadèngi lii èci pua ne, petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a!

source_text: no, lord! peter answered. i have never eaten anything impure or unclean.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! ji'i dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: the voice spoke to him a second time: do not call anything impure that god has made clean.
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka kaj'alu!

source_text: this happened three times, and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven.
target_text: hahèla-koi èèna cèu tèlu hari, èle èèna ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: while peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by cornelius found simon's house and approached the gate.
target_text: hèia petrus pajiko la'e-mai sasoa tanila deo na. kabèdhi laa, ana paleha kornelis sèra d'ai madha èmu simon. ra titu ètu hèb'a èmu.

source_text: they called out to ask if simon called peter was staying there.
target_text: ka ra lii, peka na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci dhu manubha ètu èmu ne'e. ngara na, simon petrus. ele boe ama tadhe, do?

source_text: as peter continued to reflect on the vision, the spirit said to him, behold, three men are looking for you.
target_text: ropa petrus pajiko sasoa tanila na era. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ne, petrus. dhèu mate èu ka haha si.

source_text: so get up! go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because i have sent them.
target_text: de puru ho lamu ka dènge si. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. masi ka ad'a yahudi aj'a, na, dhèu yahudi hud'i madenge dènge dhèu leo, te ngaa èu baku madenge dènge rèngu, lula ja'a ka dhu pua rèngu mai rare èu.

source_text: so peter went down to the men and said, here am i, the one you are looking for. why have you come?
target_text: ka petrus puru la'e paraga dènge dhèu sèra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka dhu miu tenge. de miu parluu ngaa?

source_text: cornelius the centurion has sent us, they said. he is a righteous and god-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole jewish nation. a holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, komedhaa sordad'u roma èci pua ji'i mai asa ne'e. nèngu èèna, komedhaa nèti cangasu sordad'u. dhèu ne d'ara mola, aa na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. dhèu yahudi ae dhu re'a le babe'a dhèu ne'e. med'a na, heka ana pajuu ama lamatua puru mai nèti sorga, ho pua lamatua ji'i manèngi èu lamu asa èmu na, ho na neo nanene unu na nèti èu.

source_text: so peter invited them in as his guests. and the next day he got ready and went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from joppa.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia petrus manèngi rèngu ho j'unu taha mèda ne ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, ra pakèd'i, lasi palere. dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri nèti yope lasi kahèi.

source_text: the following day he arrived in caesarea, where cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
target_text: mèda èèna rèngu j'unu ètu j'ara. bèli èèna, heka rèngu d'ai kota kaisarea kèna. ropa rèngu d'ai, kornelis mate mema rèngu. na pakaboko nare le a'ari na dènge mone-aanga angalai na ètu èmu nèngu.

source_text: as peter was about to enter, cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai hèb'a èmu, kornelis mai soru ne, ka madhèdi patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga petrus, ho na pahaha iisi.

source_text: but peter helped him up. stand up, he said, i am only a man myself.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pakèd'i ne, peka na, ama! baku sèmi èèna! baku pahaha iisi mi ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èu kahèi.

source_text: as peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, kornelis kèd'i titu dènge. ka dua ra padhai lii, kako lasi asa d'ara èmu. d'ai d'ara èmu, petrus nèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko mate nèngu.

source_text: he said to them, you know how unlawful it is for a jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. but god has shown me that i should not call any man impure or unclean.
target_text: na ladhe palème dhèu sèra, ka na padhai lii, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i mi! miu me'a mema ad'a ji'i dhèu yahudi. madhutu ad'a ji'i, na, ji'i bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu leo. ngaa hari, maso asa d'ara èmu ra. te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le dènge ja'a, ladhe mèdha ngaa dhu nèngu peka na mèu, ja'a baku peka na mèdha èèna kaj'alu. de limuri ne, ja'a madenge heka dènge dhèu leo. ja'a hud'i tao dhèu leo sama sèmi a'ari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: so when i was invited, i came without objection. i ask, then, why have you sent for me?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o miu lami paroa, ka ja'a mai dènge. ja'a pamata heka, lula lamatua peka nare le dènge ja'a sèmi èèna. miu peka ku laa. miu parluu ngaa nèti ja'a?

source_text: cornelius answered: four days ago i was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour. suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
target_text: hèia kornelis lole aa'i mèu-mèu, aku nèngu na, èpa lod'o dhu la'e èèna, ropa lod'o nihia, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu èmu ja'a. cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone èci titu ètu madha ja'a. mèdha-papake na heo loa-loa.

source_text: and said, ‘cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before god.
target_text: ka na paroa ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘kornelis! lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: therefore send to joppa for simon, who is called peter. he is a guest in the home of simon the tanner, by the sea. '
target_text: de lod'o ne'e, pua dhèu lasi rare dhèu èci asa kota yope. ngara na, simon petrus. nèngu manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, ètu èmu tuka pamèu ka'uri badha. ngara na, simon kahèi. '

source_text: so i sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. now then, we are all here in the presence of god to listen to everything the lord has instructed you to tell us.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua dhèu dhiu rare ama. ji'i manèngi makasi ae, lula ama mai dènge, ropa tadèngi lii paroa ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pakaboko ètu ne'e, ho neo nanene ngaa dhu ama lamatua pua ama peka dènge ji'i!

source_text: then peter began to speak: i now truly understand that god does not show favoritism,
target_text: hèia petrus padhai lii, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, na, ètu madha ama lamatua, dhèu rai-haha sama èci èèna ka. lamatua ladhe boe rèhu, mia ka dhèu yahudi, aa mia ka dhèu leo.

source_text: but welcomes those from every nation who fear him and do what is right.
target_text: dhèu mia dhu d'ara mola, dhu maj'èni manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, aa madhutu dad'èi nèngu, rèngu sèra pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: he has sent this message to the people of israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through jesus christ, who is lord of all.
target_text: de miu me'a, ngaa dhu lamatua peka le dènge ji'i dhèu isra'el, peka na, nèngu pua le kristus, nuka yesus. ka yesus madhe ho padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua. aa nèngu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: you yourselves know what has happened throughout judea, beginning in galilee with the baptism that john proclaimed:
target_text: miu tadèngi kahèi, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le ètu palème propensi yudea. lii lole èèna mulai nèti yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, aj'a dhèu ho ra ele-ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo rèngu. aa rèngu hud'i abhu sarani kahèi, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, rèngu pabe'a le dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: how god anointed jesus of nazareth with the holy spirit and with power, and how jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because god was with him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua hia roh na dhu mola-mèci mi yesus, dhèu nasaret. lamatua hia koasa na mi yesus kahèi. ka yesus maso-kalua rae-rae, tao j'ara be'a mi dhèu-dhèu. aa na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra si. na tao sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua sama-sama dènge ne taruu.

source_text: we are witnesses of all that he did, both in the land of the jews and in jerusalem. and although they put him to death by hanging him on a tree,
target_text: te ji'i se'e ka dhu ladhe ngèdhi unu mi, ngaa dhu na sab'a ètu kota yerusalem, aa palème kabarai yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: god raised him up on the third day and caused him to be seen-
target_text: nèngu madhe tare'a, te ngaa asa camèd'a, ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ka na pad'elo iisi na, ho dhèu rèdhi, sèna ka ra re'a nèngu mamuri hari tare'a-re'a le.

source_text: not by all the people, but by the witnesses god had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae cahag'e dhu rèdhi boe ne, dhoka ji'i di. lod'o nèngu mamuri hari le, ji'i biasa nga'a-nginu dènge ne. ama lamatua paj'uj'u ji'i ho la'a lole palème lii lolo be'a yesus mi dhèu ae ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and he commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one appointed by god to judge the living and the dead.
target_text: aa lamatua ka dhu pua ji'i la'a lole peka pasaraa mi dhèu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu na paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai, nuka yesus. aa lamatua ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu j'ue lii langu, ho pama'ète, na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua, aa cee aad'o. yesus èèna ka dhu j'ue lii dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era.

source_text: all the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra lole le yesus, peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare si, aa saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu kahèi.

source_text: while peter was still speaking these words, the holy spirit fell upon all who heard his message.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii nare mèka, cag'ag'a laa, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa d'ara dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra dhu nanene lii padhai lii na.

source_text: all the circumcised believers who had accompanied peter were astounded that the gift of the holy spirit had been poured out even on the gentiles.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu yahudi angalai petrus dhu mai palere dènge ne nèti kota yope asa èmu kornelis ètu kota kaisarea. ropa rèngu rèdhi dhèu ae sèra abhu roh ama lamatua, ka ra malaa, lula rèngu heka re'a kèna, na, lamatua hia roh na mi dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: for they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting god. then peter said,
target_text: rèngu tadèngi dhèu ètu d'ara èmu kornelis sèra padhai lii, pake lii dhu baka-leo. aa ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. hèia petrus padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? they have received the holy spirit just as we have!
target_text: miu mèdhi unu mi! dhèu se'e se, sèmi rare le roh lamatua èci èèna ka dènge èdhi kahèi. de mai ka, sèna ka èdhi sarani si. dhèu èci sa dhu bisa heka taha rèngu.

source_text: so he ordered that they be baptized in the name of jesus christ. then they asked him to stay for a few days.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si ho sarani kornelis dènge dhèu ètu sèra sa, ho ra j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra manèngi petrus pea dènge rèngu pèri-pèri lod'o hari. èle èèna ka, heka ra hia ne lèpa asa yerusalem.

source_text: the apostles and brothers throughout judea soon heard that the gentiles also had received the word of god.
target_text: petrus dhae lèpa mèka, te ngaa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dènge dhèu parcaya yesus dhu leo sèra, dhu pea ètu yerusalem, tadèngi rare le, peka na, dhèu yahudi boe sèmi rare le lii lole be'a lamatua.

source_text: so when peter went up to jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai kota yerusalem, dhèu nèti partei yahudi dhu parcaya yesus mai pasala ne,

source_text: and said, you visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.
target_text: peka na, weh! èu tao samia kèna? èu me'a ad'a-tatao èdhi, do aad'o? èu ne bani titu kèna, maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu leo! aa èu mu'a-minu dènge rèngu kahèi! baku tao sèmi èèna, te rèngu madhutu mèka ad'a suna èdhi! èdhi bisa boe pa'èci dènge rèngu sèra!

source_text: but peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:
target_text: hèia petrus lole aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le, peka na,

source_text: i was in the city of joppa praying, and in a trance i saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
target_text: lod'o ja'a ètu kota yope, ja'a laku sabaj'a, ka ja'a abhu tanila. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoka, ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na, puru mai asa ja'a.

source_text: i looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
target_text: ropa ja'a patigi asa d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, ja'a kèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi. badha se'e se, dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi luri.

source_text: then i heard a voice saying to me, ‘get up, peter, kill and eat. '
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci pua, peka na, ‘petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a! '

source_text: ‘no, lord, ' i said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth. '
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, ‘bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra! '

source_text: but the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘do not call anything impure that god has made clean. '
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka na kaj'alu! '

source_text: this happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi hahèla-koi èèna cèu padhutu tèlu hari, ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: just then three men sent to me from caesarea stopped at the house where i was staying.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu tèlu d'ai èmu dhu ja'a pea. rèngu nèti kaisarea mai tenge ja'a.

source_text: the spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. these six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man's home.
target_text: hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘puru ho lamu ka dènge dhèu sèra. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. èu baku madenge dènge rèngu. ' ka a'ari èdhi dhèu èna palere dènge ja'a kahèi asa kaisarea. ètu èèna, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi maso asa d'ara èmu komedhaa sordad'u roma.

source_text: he told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘send to joppa for simon who is called peter.
target_text: na lolo, peka na, pèri-pèri lod'o dhu la'e èèna, nèngu nèdhi ana pajuu lamatua puru nèti sorga, titu ètu d'ara èmu na. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa mèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: he will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved. '
target_text: sèna ka dhèu èèna ka dhu pad'elo mi dedha èu dènge isi èmu èu aa'i-aa'i ra, j'ara lamatua dhu hia miu mamuri, dènge saku eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. '

source_text: as i began to speak, the holy spirit fell upon them, just as he had fallen upon us at the beginning.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pad'elo j'ara mamuri lamatua mi dedha rèngu. ka rèngu abhu dènge ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, sama sèmi èdhi abhu ca hari na.

source_text: then i remembered the word of the lord, as he used to say, ‘john baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the holy spirit. '
target_text: ropa ja'a kèdhi rèngu abhu roh lamatua kahèi, ka ja'a sanèd'e lii padhai lii lamatua yesus uru èèna, dhu peka na, ‘yohanis sarani dhèu pake dhoka èi di, te ngaa ladhe miu mate hari pèri-pèri lod'o, èèna na lamatua neo tao dhu kapai risi eele hia miu. nuka, na hia miu roh na dhu mola-mèci. '

source_text: so if god gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the lord jesus christ, who was i to hinder the work of god?
target_text: te lamatua unu na ka dhu hia roh na mi dedha dhèu leo sèra, sama sèmi na pala-bagi mi èdhi se. de madhutu dad'èi miu, ja'a hud'i palab'a dènge ama lamatua, do tasamia? de ja'a peka ngaa hari?

source_text: when they heard this, their objections were put to rest, and they glorified god, saying, so then, god has granted even the gentiles repentance unto life.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, petrus siri iisi na sèmi èèna, ka rèngu pasala heka ne. hèia ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! nia kahèi, nga! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia dhèu leo ho ra tèke eele j'ara mamuri rèngu dhu sala, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. sèna ka rèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with stephen traveled as far as phoenicia, cyprus, and antioch, speaking the message only to jews.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ra pamadhe rare stefanus, ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e rai paj'ala asa mia-mia. cahag'e rai asa propensi finisia. cahag'e rai asa pulu siprus, aa cahag'e hari rai d'ai kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. dhèu dhu rai sèra, lole taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia. te ngaa ra lole dhoka dènge dhèu yahudi rèngu sèra. ra lole boe dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: but some of them, men from cyprus and cyrene, went to antioch and began speaking to the greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the lord jesus.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu mai nèti pulu siprus dènge kota kirene. rèngu cahag'e rai taruu lasi asa kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. rèngu se'e ka dhu lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus hia dhèu yahudi boe ètu era èèna.

source_text: the hand of the lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the lord.
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae titu kèna parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: when news of this reached the ears of the church in jerusalem, they sent barnabas to antioch. when he arrived and saw the grace of god, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the lord with all their hearts. barnabas was a good man, full of the holy spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the lord.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu yerusalem tadèngi, na, dhèu leo ètu kota antiokia parcaya yesus kahèi. ka ra pua barnabas la'e ladhe si ètu nèi. barnabas ne, dhèu d'ara be'a, aa parcaya tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. aa roh lamatua dènge nèngu kahèi. ropa nèngu d'ai nèi, na nèdhi tare'a ama lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo sèra. ka d'ara nèngu karej'e. ka na pa'èra d'ara rèngu, sèna ka rèngu madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri lamatua dènge tare'a-re'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu lamatua ètu èèna asa tabha ae.

source_text: then barnabas went to tarsus to look for saul,
target_text: èle èèna ka, barnabas la'e tenge saulus asa kota tarsus.

source_text: and when he found him, he brought him back to antioch. so for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. the disciples were first called christians at antioch.
target_text: lod'o paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako saulus ho lasi pea ètu antiokia. ka dua ra pea ètu nèi ca tèu, pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu dua ra aj'a-nori j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu ae. ètu kota antiokia ne'e ka, dhèu mulai pangare dhèu parcaya lamatua yesus, ‘dhèu kristen'.

source_text: in those days some prophets came down from jerusalem to antioch.
target_text: lod'o rèngu dua ra pea ètu antiokia era, pèri-pèri dhèu mai nèti yerusalem. ama lamatua tema le pake dhèu se'e ho rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: one of them named agabus stood up and predicted through the spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. this happened under claudius.
target_text: nèti rèngu se, dhèu èci, ngara na agabus. roh lamatua peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu lod'o manganga-mad'èu lèke palème toke d'ai suu-suu rai-haha. hèia la'e peka hari dènge dhèu-dhèu. lii dhu na padhai na, mema j'aj'i tare'a, lod'o dhèu aae kapai risi ètu roma, ngara na klaudius, nèd'u paredha. ra paroa dhèu aae kapai risi ne, keser.

source_text: so the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in judea.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii agabus ne, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu antiokia sèra, rare lii èci ho pa'oru doi, sèna ka ra hia mi a'ari dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, dhu abhu j'aj'èra ètu propensi yudea. èci-èci hia madhutu a'abhu ra.

source_text: this they did, sending their gifts to the elders with barnabas and saul.
target_text: ropa ra pa'oru rare, ka ra pua barnabas dènge saulus rèti doi sèra asa dhèu j'èra sèi.

source_text: about that time, king herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae herodes mulai paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus cahag'e.

source_text: he had james, the brother of john, put to death with the sword.
target_text: nèngu paredha dhèu lasi pare pamadhe yakobis pake samala. yakobis ne, a'a yohanis.

source_text: and seeing that this pleased the jews, herod proceeded to seize peter during the feast of unleavened bread.
target_text: ropa herodes ne'a, na, d'ara dhèu kapai yahudi sèra karej'e nèti mamadhe yakobis, ka asa na hino. lèke lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi dhu ra pangare na, pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi, ka na pua dhèu lasi kèpe petrus.

source_text: he arrested him and put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. herod intended to bring him out to the people after the passover.
target_text: kèpe rare ne, ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. ka ra pua sordad'u èpa kaboko ho j'aga petrus pagati-gati mèu-mèda. ca kaboko sordad'u èèna, dhèu èpa. ladhe èle lod'o hua iia, heka herodes neo pama'ète lii petrus ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: so peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to god for him.
target_text: lod'o ra pamaso petrus asa d'ara bèdho, dhèu unu lamatua yesus sèra sabaj'a ma'ète boe manèngi ho lamatua ladhe-leru petrus.

source_text: on the night before herod was to bring him to trial, peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.
target_text: bèli èèna, herodes neo pama'ète lii langu petrus ètu madha dhèu ae. te ngaa mèda èèna, ra èki petrus pake rate dua ètu d'ara èmu bèdho. na j'unu ètu talora sordad'u dhèu dua. aa sordad'u leo sèra j'aga ètu hèb'a babèdho.

source_text: suddenly an angel of the lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. he tapped peter on the side and woke him up, saying, get up quickly. and the chains fell off his wrists.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, mai titu ètu èèna. ka d'ara kama na saraa bia. hèia ana pajuu èèna parèi petrus, peka na, petrus! kèd'i mèri! kaca'a laa, rate bèsi sèra bhoke eele unu na nèti kacui-aai petrus.

source_text: get dressed and put on your sandals, said the angel. peter did so, and the angel told him, wrap your cloak around you and follow me.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pua ne, peka na, pake kodho dènge salapa èu! pake nare, ka ana pajuu èèna peka hari, aku nèngu na, pake kodho li'u èu, ho mai madhutu ja'a!

source_text: so peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. he thought he was only seeing a vision.
target_text: hèia petrus madhutu ana pajuu ne lasi asa li'u. petrus ngee, na, nèngu nii di. te ngaa mema j'aj'i tare'a.

source_text: they passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself. when they had gone outside and walked the length of one block, the angel suddenly left him.
target_text: ropa rèngu seli eele era j'aga partama dènge ka dua, hèia rèngu d'ai hèb'a babèdho bèsi. babèdho èèna bhoke unu na, ka dua ra kalua madhutu ka j'ara asa d'ara kota. cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua ne ele, ka tèke eele petrus mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: then peter came to himself and said, now i know for sure that the lord has sent his angel and rescued me from herod's grasp and from everything the jewish people were anticipating.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ne ele, hèia petrus heka mase'a kèna. ka na ngee, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! ja'a heka ke'a kèna. lamatua pua ana pajuu na mai, ho patalale eele ja'a nèti kacui-aai herodes. lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka kahadhu karehe dhèu yahudi sèra, lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: and when he had realized this, he went to the house of mary the mother of john, also called mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus la'e asa èmu maria. maria ne, ina yohanis. ngara leo yohanis ne, markus. ètu èmu èèna, dhèu ae pakaboko ho sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ladhe-leru petrus ètu d'ara lii langu èèna.

source_text: he knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named rhoda came to answer it.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai madha hèb'a oka èmu èèna, ka na paroa dènge d'eu hèb'a oka. ka ana bhèni sab'a èci, ngara na rode, neo ne'a dhèu cee ka dhu mai.

source_text: when she recognized peter's voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, peter is standing at the gate!
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii petrus, na tadhe dènge. na karej'e bia. ka rai asa d'ara èmu la'e, peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene ku! petrus nuka li'u! te ngaa lula nèngu bingu, ka na bhèlu eele bhoke hèb'a oka hia petrus.

source_text: you are out of your mind, they told her. but when she kept insisting it was so, they said, it must be his angel.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae sèra dhaa, peka na, aad'o, sina ma! baku paleko! te ngaa bhèni ne peka hari, aku nèngu na, tare'a! èèna lii petrus! nuka li'u nèi. ka dhèu se'e lèka boe, aku rèngu na, ele boe, dhèu nèi ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, dhu mai madhenge petrus.

source_text: but peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
target_text: rèngu patule-pajuku taruu, te ngaa petrus loe boe paroa, toke lasi bhoke hèb'a oka hia ne. ropa ra bhoke rare, ka rèngu malaa, lula petrus tare'a-re'a di.
