target_text: baku malaa dènge naneo lamatua dhu paj'uj'u j'ara, ho èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge nèngu. dhu lèke, ladhe èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, te ngaa lula boe nèti èdhi tao madhutu atora na. te atora na dhu suri le sèmi èèna, aa dhèu rèti lii padhai na uru-uru sèra, peka sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na.

source_text: and this righteousness from god comes through faith in jesus christ to all who believe. there is no distinction,
target_text: ama lamatua peka, na, èdhi dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne, ropa èdhi parcaya yesus kristus. nèngu dhu hag'e boe rèhu dhèu, te na tao sèmi èèna mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of god,
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao sala. nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho neo pabe'a ngi'u rèngu dènge ama lamatua, bisa boe pamèci dènge dadedha lamatua.

source_text: and are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in christ jesus.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pama'ète, peka na, èdhi dènge heka sasala. na sèmi nare èdhi, lula yesus kristus sui nare le èdhi nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: god presented him as the atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, in order to demonstrate his righteousness, because in his forbearance he had passed over the sins committed beforehand. he did this to demonstrate his righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and to justify the one who has faith in jesus.
target_text: ama lamatua paj'uj'u le yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i korban papo makae ho saku eele sasala-sigo èdhi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i parcaya ne, na, nèngu ka dhu tago nare hahuku èdhi. ka na pasuti raa na, aa madhe gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ama lamatua peka na, ngaa dhu na pama'ète ne, lèke tare'a. uru èèna, d'ara lamatua taleo titu kèna, hèia na pama'ète ho pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo dhu dhèu ad'u-ue le. te ngaa ladhe na huku boe dhèu dhu tao sala, nèngu adil boe. de na bhoke j'ara, sèna ka yesus kristus dui nare hahuku nèti dhèu sala. limuri ne, lamatua pad'elo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, peka na, nèngu tao dhu be'a taruu. ka dhèu sala aa'i-aa'i ra dhu parcaya yesus, na cap si dhèu mola.

source_text: where, then, is boasting? it is excluded. on what principle? on that of works? no, but on that of faith.
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu pangee, na, miu bisa padhai lii lela dedha, lula ama lamatua sèmi nare miu, do? bisa boe! miu neo pad'elo atora èci dhu tao pabe'a miu dènge lamatua, do? miu pangee, na, lamatua sèmi nare miu lula miu tao dhu be'a, do? bisa boe! èdhi te'a dhoka paj'uj'u mi atora dhu peka na, ama lamatua sèmi nare èdhi, lula èdhi parcaya yesus. nèngu na, kèna!

source_text: for we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, nèti ra parcaya yesus, nèti boe rèngu tao madhutu atora di.

source_text: is god the god of jews only? is he not the god of gentiles too? yes, of gentiles too,
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua sèmi nare dhoka dhèu yahudi di, do nèngu sèmi nare dhèu leo kahèi? lèke! na sèmi nare aa'i!

source_text: since there is only one god, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
target_text: te ama lamatua ne, dhoka èci di. aa dhoka j'ara èci di, dhu na sèmi nare sèna ka èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne bisa pabe'a dènge ne. nuka èdhi hud'i parcaya kristus. j'ara ne pala mi dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? certainly not! instead, we uphold the law.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, èèna na tao atora na j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa, do? aad'o! dhu lèke ka, parcaya èdhi èèna ka dhu tao pamèci atora na.

source_text: what then shall we say that abraham, our forefather, has discovered?
target_text: èdhi tare conto nèti abraham, baki ji'i dhèu yahudi. èdhi bisa te'a ngaa nèti nèngu lula-nèti dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula parcaya kristus?

source_text: if abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before god.
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a sèmi ne'e: ladhe abraham bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula na tao j'ara be'a, nèngu kahèi abhu hak ho koa iisi ètu madha dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu bisa boe bhoka hèb'a.

source_text: for what does the scripture say? abraham believed god, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, peka na, lula abraham parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka, lamatua peka na, abraham ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: now the wages of the worker are not credited as a gift, but as an obligation.
target_text: dhèu sab'a, tatu abhu gaji. èèna na doi iia d'ara boe, te ngaa doi dhu lamatua na b'ae ne gati rui-j'aj'èra. te sèra sa hak nèti dhèu sab'a.

source_text: however, to the one who does not work, but believes in him who justifies the wicked, his faith is credited as righteousness.
target_text: lamatua ka dhu unu hak, ho peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya yesus kristus bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne, masi ka uru èèna, dhèu ne tao sala aa pahae boe lamatua. abhu boe j'ara èci sa, dhu dhèu bisa ad'u-ue, ho pabe'a ngi'u nèngu dènge lamatua. te dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku yesus kristus, heka lamatua peka na, nèngu dhèu d'ara mola, aa lamatua sèmi nare ne.

source_text: and david speaks likewise of the blessedness of the man to whom god credits righteousness apart from works:
target_text: dhèu aae daud peka kahèi, na, d'ara dhèu karèj'e-karae, ropa ama lamatua peka na, dhèu se dhu d'ara mola, masi ka rèngu tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te daud suri, na,

source_text: blessed are they whose lawless acts are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
target_text: masi ka dhèu se sisu atora lamatua, te ngaa na saku eele sasala-sasigo si. nèti èèna ka, rèngu oto titu kèna! dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala si.

source_text: blessed is the man whose sin the lord will never count against him.
target_text: te ladhe lamatua pa'iga heka sasala dhèu, na, dhèu sèra oto tare'a!

source_text: is this blessing only on the circumcised, or also on the uncircumcised? we have been saying that abraham's faith was credited to him as righteousness.
target_text: de ele boe miu pangee, na, dhodhoka dhèu yahudi dhu suna di, dhu bisa oto, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, si? aa dhèu suku leo dhu suna boe, bisa boe, si? aad'o! ngangee sèmi sèra sala! nèti èèna ka, ji'i dhu peka mema-mema le, lula abraham parcaya lamatua, ka lamatua cap ne, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: in what context was it credited? was it after his circumcision, or before? it was not after, but before.
target_text: lod'o mia lamatua cap abraham sèmi èèna? lod'o dhu na suna le, do dhae? dhu mola-mola, nuka lèke lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: and he received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. so then, he is the father of all who believe but are not circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.
target_text: tare'a! lod'o abraham suna mèka, ama lamatua cap nare le nèngu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge lamatua. nèbhu ku, heka na suna kèna, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu lèka lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna ka, abraham j'aj'i dhèu oti j'ara hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua. te lamatua sèmi nare dhèu dhu parcaya, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, masi ka ra suna, do aad'o.

source_text: and he is also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised, but who also walk in the footsteps of the faith that our father abraham had before he was circumcised.
target_text: abraham bhoke j'ara kahèi hia èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu suna le. lula boe nèti èdhi suna, te ngaa lula èdhi parcaya kristus sama sèmi abraham parcaya lamatua lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: for the promise to abraham and his offspring that he would be heir of the world was not given through the law, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pa'èki pajaji dènge abraham, dènge ana-èpu na, peka na, nèbhu-nèbhu rai-haha kateme j'aj'i mi pusaka rèngu. lamatua pajaji sèmi èèna, lula abraham parcaya ne, aa lamatua cap ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. te ngaa lamatua pajaji boe sèmi èèna, ladhe dhoka abraham tao madhutu atora lamatua.

source_text: for if those who live by the law are heirs, faith is useless and the promise is worthless,
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dhoka atora lamatua di, bisa sèmi rare pusaka dhu lamatua moa, sasoa na, parcaya mi lamatua parcuma di. aa lii pajaji lamatua èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: because the law brings wrath. and where there is no law, there is no transgression.
target_text: ètu era mia abhu atora lamatua, ètu èèna kahèi dhèu sisu atora èèna. aa ladhe dhèu sisu atora lamatua, na, lamatua nasa, hèia na huku si. aa ladhe atora lamatua aad'o, tatu dhèu sisu boe.

source_text: therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may rest on grace and may be guaranteed to all abraham's offspring-not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of abraham. he is the father of us all.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i parcaya ku lamatua. èèna ka dhu risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i. te lamatua d'èi pad'elo dènge mola-mola d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. aa ladhe èdhi lèka ne, sama sèmi abraham, tatu èdhi abhu ngaa dhu na moa, masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tao madhutu atora na, do aad'o. de èdhi aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, sama sèmi ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: as it is written: i have made you a father of many nations. he is our father in the presence of god, in whom he believed, the god who gives life to the dead and calls into being what does not yet exist.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ad'u-ue sèna ka èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. abraham parcaya ama lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ka ama lamatua tao paj'aj'i lii moa na. nèngu kahèi dhu pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka ngaa-ngaa dhu aad'o, j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: against all hope, abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as he had been told, so shall your offspring be.
target_text: masi ka abraham dènge mèka ana, te ngaa na lèka ama lamatua, aa tatae lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na. nèti parcaya èèna ka, lamatua tao ne j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, na, ana-èpu ae-ae bèli-camèd'a mai nèti èu.

source_text: without weakening in his faith, he acknowledged the decrepitness of his body since he was about a hundred years old and the lifelessness of sarah's womb.
target_text: abraham lèka èra lamatua, masi ka ne'a nèngu dhu heka bhora le, umur dhu cangasu tèu kèna. era ana nèti sara dhu bèdho mèno le, aa na heka d'ai seli le.

source_text: yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of god, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to god,
target_text: te ngaa lalèka abraham kura boe, ho pangee na, lamatua bisa boe tao madhutu lii padadha na. parcaya na asa tabha èra mi lamatua, aa na ded'e padedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: being fully persuaded that god was able to do what he had promised.
target_text: abraham lèka tare'a-re'a, ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha le, nèngu bisa tao.

source_text: this is why it was credited to him as righteousness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua cap abraham, peka na, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: now the words it was credited to him were written not only for abraham,
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka na, lamatua ige boe sèmi èèna hia abraham mesa na,

source_text: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited-for us who believe in him who raised jesus our lord from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa mi èdhi kahèi! te ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, na cap èdhi kahèi dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: he was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.
target_text: yesus madhe, lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala-sasigo. hèia na mamuri hari, ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with god through our lord jesus christ,
target_text: de, lula èdhi parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na cap èdhi dhèu d'ara mola. hèia d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mola-mèci hia lamatua, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai, bhoke j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. and we rejoice in the hope of the glory of god.
target_text: kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula èdhi parcaya le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i èra. aa d'ara èdhi karae kahèi, lula te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi, sèna ka te'a mèu dadedha na.

source_text: not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
target_text: masi ka èdhi abhu rupa-rupa sasusa, te ngaa d'ara èdhi karej'e-karae taruu. te èdhi te'a, na, j'èra uuru ku heka bisa taha dènge èra risi hari.

source_text: perseverance, character; and character, hope.
target_text: ladhe èdhi èra ka ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èèna ka dhu tao èdhi manahu boe, aa mamuri èdhi pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna, èèna ka dhu pa'èra parcaya èdhi, peka na, pe lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: and hope does not disappoint us, because god has poured out his love into our hearts through the holy spirit, whom he has given us.
target_text: ladhe lalèka èdhi asa èra sèmi èèna, èdhi makae boe. te lamatua dhu bagi le hia èdhi, roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka èdhi te'a mèu, na, nèngu dhu sue èdhi titu kèna.

source_text: for at just the right time, while we were still powerless, christ died for the ungodly.
target_text: nèngu pad'elo sasue na sèmi ne'e ka: ropa èdhi mampu boe pabe'a dènge lamatua, te'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pua kristus madhe pala èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu mamuri pusi-pahae boe lamatua. lamatua pili lod'o dhu lèke sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
target_text: pangee paie-iie ku! te cadhui ku abhu dhèu dhu sadia madhe hia angalai na dhu d'ara mola. ele boe abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu sadia madhe, ho soru dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: but god proves his love for us in this: while we were still sinners, christ died for us.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le sasue na ae-ae mi dedha èdhi. lula, lod'o èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara sasala era, kristus madhe le gati èdhi.

source_text: therefore, since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through him!
target_text: ama lamatua cap èdhi, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne, lula kristus pasuti raa na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. aa te ngaa, ladhe dhèu ue sasala, lamatua nasa. te ngaa nèti mamadhe kristus, èdhi dhu tao sala abhu heka huku.

source_text: for if, when we were enemies of god, we were reconciled to him through the death of his son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi pamusu dènge lamatua. te ngaa ana ama lamatua mesa na madhe, ho cuhi d'ara lamatua, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame dènge lamatua. de limuri ne, èdhi pamusu heka, te ngaa pabe'a hari le. risi-risi hari, kristus dhu mamuri hari le, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, na hia èdhi mamuri, sèna ka èdhi baku lèke hahuku.

source_text: not only that, but we also rejoice in god through our lord jesus christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di! d'ara èdhi bisa karae, peka na, lamatua ne, dedha risi eele! lula èdhi pa'èki dènge ne. èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, madhe le pala èdhi, sèna ka èdhi padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
target_text: de karèi nèti uuru èèna ka, adam ka dhu tao uru sasala-sasigo. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia boe ne mamuri taruu. hèia karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne madhutu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu. aa, lula rèngu tao sala sama sèmi adam, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku nuka sèmi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: for sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, lod'o ama lamatua papuru mèka atora na, dhèu tao le sasala dhu pale-lème le rai-haha ne. te ngaa, lula dènge mèka atora, ka abhu boe dhu ige sasala-sasigo dhèu sèra.

source_text: nevertheless, death reigned from adam until moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that adam transgressed. he is a pattern of the one to come.
target_text: mulai nèti adam toke d'ai musa sèmi rare atora lamatua èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tatu madhe. masi ka rèngu sisu boe paredha lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi adam, te ngaa ra tao rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi adam. ladhe èdhi pasoro adam dènge lamatua yesus, abhu dhu sama, aa abhu dhu sama boe. te adam èci èèna ka dènge rupa dhu paj'uj'u asa raropa yesus, dhu bèli-camèd'a èèna cèu mai.

source_text: but the gift is not like the trespass. for if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did god's grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, jesus christ, abound to the many!
target_text: te ngaa sasala adam, sama boe dènge babe'a dhu yesus hia èdhi. te dhèu èci, nuka adam, sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus, tao rupa-rupa babe'a hia mi èdhi, aa pamata boe dhèu b'ala babe'a na. nèti tatao ca dhèu ne'e ka, pad'ai mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, te ama lamatua d'èi tao be'a hia èdhi.

source_text: again, the gift is not like the result of the one man's sin: the judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
target_text: dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sama boe dènge sasala dhu adam tao èèna. ropa adam tao sasala, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu, peka na èu sala. de èu hud'i abhu huku! te ngaa masi ka dhèu ue sasala ae titu kèna, ama lamatua, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era, aa pama'ète, na, èu sala boe. de èu bebas le, aa mu abhu heka huku. mai, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ja'a!

source_text: for if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive an abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, jesus christ!
target_text: de ca dhèu nuka adam dhu tao sala, aa sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus dhu tao be'a. lula tatao na dhu be'a èèna ka, èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi mèdha èci dhu na hia iia d'ara mi èdhi. na neo hia èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi èdhi j'aj'i angalai dhèu aae.

source_text: so then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
target_text: de nèti ca dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, na bhoke j'ara ho ama lamatua babège eele dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti madha na. aa nèti ca dhèu leo hari dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke, na bhoke j'ara ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, sèna ka mamuri mola dènge ne.

source_text: for just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: adam ne, ca dhèu dhu d'èi boe nanene lamatua, ka sisu paredha lamatua. aa dhèu ae kahèi madhutu tao sasala, sama sèmi adam. aa yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu nanene lamatua, ka tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua.

source_text: the law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,
target_text: ama lamatua papuru atora na re musa, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu, mia dhu sala. te ngaa ètu mia-mia sasala dhèu asa tabha ae. ètu èèna kahèi, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae risi hari.

source_text: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through jesus christ our lord.
target_text: uru èèna, bhabhelu ètu d'ara dhèu abhu koasa dhu uri rèngu, toke ra tao sasala dhu nèti mamadhe. te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara be'a dhu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus tao èèna, ama lamatua pake ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. aa j'ara be'a ne dènge koasa sèna ka ator èdhi kahèi, hèia èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa mamuri mola taruu dènge ne.

source_text: what then shall we say? shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?
target_text: de èdhi peka ngaa hari? ele boe miu pangee, na, ama lamatua pabhèlu eele le sasala èdhi, lula d'ara hua iia na. nèti èèna ka, hud'i laa èdhi tino tao sala, sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na risi hari mi èdhi.

source_text: certainly not! how can we who died to sin live in it any longer?
target_text: aad'o sèmi èèna! lèke boe ladhe èdhi tao sala taruu. te èdhi dhu pama'ète tare le, peka na, èdhi tèke eele aa'i le sasala-sasigo èdhi. lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge bhabhelu-katub'a, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi dhu madhe le! te dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao sala, si? ladhe èdhi madhe le, tasamia hari èdhi bisa mamuri ad'u-ue sasala? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: or aren't you aware that all of us who were baptized into christ jesus were baptized into his death?
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, na, ropa sarani èdhi, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, èdhi tèke eele le mamuri dhui, ho abhu mamuri hiu, nuka dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: we were therefore buried with him through baptism into death, in order that, just as christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the father, we too may walk in newness of life.
target_text: lod'o kristus madhe, ra padhane ne. aa lod'o ra sarani èdhi, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe kahèi, tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia ra padhane èdhi. de ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari kristus nèti mamadhe na. ama lamatua d'èi ladhe èdhi sèmi tare koasa na kahèi, ho mamuri hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu hiu.

source_text: for if we have been united with him like this in his death, we will certainly also be united with him in his resurrection.
target_text: te èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe palere dènge yesus. de èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge ne, tatu bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri hari nèti mamadhe, sama sèmi nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: we know that our old self was crucified with him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa sasala. te ngaa mamuri èdhi dhu dhui èèna, madhe le, èci èèna ka dènge paku pamadhe èdhi ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge kristus. limuri ne, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dènge heka koasa ho uri èdhi. limuri ne, èdhi aad'o heka ètu d'ara a'èki sèna ka tao hari sasala. te èdhi sèmi heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho pili neo tao ngaa.

source_text: for anyone who has died has been freed from sin.
target_text: ladhe dhèu dhu madhe le, nèngu bebas le, si? abhu heka ngaa èci sa laka-seti ne, ho ad'u-ue hari sasala.

source_text: now if we died with christ, we believe that we will also live with him.
target_text: de, lula èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge kristus, na, èdhi parcaya, peka na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taruu dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: for we know that since christ was raised from the dead, he cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over him.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, lula yesus kristus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, de nèngu bisa heka madhe hari. te abhu boe èci sa dhu dènge koasa ho pamadhe hari ne.

source_text: the death he died, he died to sin once for all; but the life he lives, he lives to god.
target_text: na madhe ca tèka èèna ka, ho segi koasa nèti sasala. te ngaa limuri ne na mamuri ho pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: so you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to god in christ jesus.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku iisi sèmi èèna. nuka sèmi miu dhu madhe le, nèti èèna ka sasala dènge heka koasa mi dedha miu. de limuri ne, miu hud'i mamuri ku ho pakab'ua ama lamatua, lula miu dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.
target_text: bhabhelu ètu d'ara èu dhu dènge koasa. baku soro tèke bhabhelu èèna ator èu, ka èu dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae sèna ka èu tao bhabhelu-katub'a. te èèna na ngi'u aae èu madhe.

source_text: do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to god as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to him as instruments of righteousness.
target_text: aa baku soro isi èu sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke boe, te èèna sala kahèi. te ngaa pangèd'u mamuri èu mi ama lamatua di, sèna ka nèngu ka dhu uri mamuri èu. sama sèmi èu dhu madhe le, ka mamuri hari. de pake la mamuri èu kateme aa'i, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.
target_text: baku soro tèke sèna ka sasala ator miu, sama sèmi sasala ka dhu j'aj'i lamatua miu. de limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri madhutu ia ka atora musa, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te miu dhu mamuri mola le, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. de limuri ne d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu uri mamuri miu.

source_text: what then? shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? certainly not!
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu ngee, na, èdhi madhutu ia ka atora musa, ho pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. de hud'i laa èdhi tao sala taruu di. te lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era mi èdhi! miu pangee sèmi èèna ka, si? ja'a pasanèd'e, èèna na sale!

source_text: do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?
target_text: ja'a kore upama nèti ènu dènge lamatua na. ladhe miu soro ngi'u mi ho sab'a hia dhèu èci, na, miu hud'i nanene, aa sab'a madhutu dad'èi na. te nèngu èèna kètu miu, aa miu j'aj'i ènu na. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu bisa pili neo madhutu mia. te miu bisa pili, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala, hèia miu j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala ne. te ngaa ladhe miu pili sèmi èèna, miu tao iisi mi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. do, miu bisa pili tao dhu lèke, dènge j'aj'i ènu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua mi. ladhe pili sèmi èèna, miu bisa pabe'a dènge ne!

source_text: but thanks be to god that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.
target_text: uru èèna, miu soro tèke sèna ka sasala uri miu, te ngaa limuri ne miu nanene d'ara iiki miu, sèna ka tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu sarani aj'a-nori miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
target_text: te lamatua dhu patalale le miu nèti koasa sasala, toke sasala sèra uri heka miu. de limuri ne, j'ara dhu lèke ka dhu uri miu.

source_text: i am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
target_text: ja'a peka ne'e, pake conto dhu j'aj'i bèli-bèli, nèti lamatua dènge ènu, sèna ka miu me'a malai ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai. uru èèna, miu hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu sèna ka tao sala, dhu pakaj'alu miu madhutu atora musa. te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu dhu me'a dhoka tao dhu be'a di, dhu hia miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: for when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa miu dhoka nanene aa tao madhutu dad'èi sasala, miu mo'o boe nanene aa tao dhu lèke.

source_text: what fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? the outcome of those things is death.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu abhu ngaa dhu be'a nèti tatao miu sèra? aad'o, sina ma? aa te ngaa, ngaa dhu miu abhu sèra tao miu mi'e makae di. lula miu tao sala sèmi èèna, ka dhu miu abhu, nuka lamatua soro kabodho mi miu.

source_text: but now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to god, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ama lamatua patalale eele le miu nèti lamatua uru èèna, de miu parluu ia ka tao sasala. de ne'e ne miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu sab'a nèti ama lamatua. lèpa lod'o limuri, pe miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia ne, aa abhu mamuri mola-mèci dhu d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for the wages of sin is death, but the gift of god is eternal life in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: te ropa èdhi tao sasala, lamatua tule eele èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna ka dhu èdhi abhu. èdhi madhe kèna! te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara èci hia èdhi. te na neo hia iia èdhi mamuri mola dhu ma'ète boe. èdhi abhu mamuri èèna, ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: do you not know, brothers for i am speaking to those who know the law, that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a mèu atora huku sèra. sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri era, atora huku dènge hak ho ator miu. te ngaa ladhe miu madhe le, atora huku dènge heka hak mi miu.

source_text: for instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. but if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
target_text: ja'a kore pakasame nèti atora dhèu èmu-kamali. ladhe dhèu bhèni èci leo le èmu dènge mone èci, na, madhutu atora huku, dua ra j'aj'i dhèu èmu-kamali toke madhe. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mone madhe uuru, bhèni balu ne pa'èki heka dènge atora deo na. nèngu bisa hari leo-èmu.

source_text: so then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress, even if she marries another man.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe bhèni ne leo hari èmu lod'o dhèu èmu na mamuri era, nèngu bersina. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe le, atora nèti laleo èmu lèke heka nèngu. bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu kalora iisi. de ladhe na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu leo, madhutu atora, nèngu bersina boe.

source_text: therefore, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of christ, that you might belong to another, to him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to god.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu dhèu parcaya! sèmi ne'e: kristus madhe le. èèna nuka sèmi miu madhutu madhe dènge ne kahèi, hèia tèke eele mamuri miu dhu dhui. ka atora huku lèke heka mi miu. limuri ne atora huku lèke heka miu, te ngaa mamuri miu pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. èèna cakaraa dènge bhèni balu dhu leo hari èmu. ngaa-ngaa tao boe. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu miu ad'u-ue sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.
target_text: te uru èèna, èdhi tao dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae èdhi di. lula èdhi te'a atora, èèna ka dhu hia èdhi sisu atora sèra, ho tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de sasala èdhi sèra ka dhu tao ama lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi.

source_text: but now, having died to what bound us, we have been released from the law, so that we serve in the new way of the spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku atora. te ngaa limuri ne, atora ne lèke heka èdhi, dhu tèke eele le mamuri dhu dhui. madhutu dad'èi j'ara dhui, na, atora musa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci èèna, dhu èki tèke èdhi. te ngaa madhutu dad'èi j'ara hiu, na, èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora èèna. te roh lamatua ka dhu uri èdhi! nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi sab'a dhoka hia lamatua.

source_text: what then shall we say? is the law sin? certainly not! indeed, i would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. for i would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, do not covet.
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? neo peka, na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa ne, sala! aad'o! te ladhe ja'a ke'a mèu boe atora ne, tatu ja'a bisa boe ke'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu d'ara ja'a. nuka sèmi, abhu atora dhu peka na, mage d'ara neo mere mèdha-panyau dhèu. te ngaa dènge j'ara tasamia ka, ja'a bisa ke'a, na, d'ara neo sèmi èèna, sala, ladhe ke'a boe atora èèna? bisa boe!

source_text: but sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. for apart from the law, sin is dead.
target_text: te ngaa lula abhu atora dhu peka sèmi èèna, èèna nuka sèmi j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo kore rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau dhèu. ladhe dènge boe atora dhu kai, sasala na abhu boe koasa ho ator dhèu.

source_text: once i was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and i died.
target_text: ètu mamuri ja'a uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèu mèka dad'èi nèti atora lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka ke'a kèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mulai mase'a, na, ja'a sisu le atora sèra ka ad'u-ue sasala. de hua nèti sasala èèna ka, ja'a hud'i madhe ku.

source_text: so i discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.
target_text: hèia d'ara ja'a roe bhilu, te ke'a na, ja'a mesa ku bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua, ladhe tao madhutu dhoka atora na. de pantas ladhe ja'a abhu nanasa nèti lamatua, nuka huku madhe èèna, lula ja'a sisu le atora na. aa te ngaa lamatua hia atora ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri dhu lèke. te ngaa bagi ja'a, atora ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ja'a, ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a.

source_text: for sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through the commandment put me to death.
target_text: atora ne mema pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu mola. te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu sub'u ètu d'ara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tipu hari ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, ho pangee na, ja'a bisa pabe'a ja'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ja'a tao madhutu atora na. hèia èèna nuka sèmi atora mesa èèna ka dhu tao toke lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a.

source_text: so then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
target_text: de ladhe deo na dhèu peka na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa èèna, sala, na, ja'a dhaa na, aad'o! atora lamatua ne, mola-mèci! aa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara atora ne mola-mèci, lèke, aa be'a kahèi.

source_text: did that which is good, then, become death to me? certainly not! but in order that sin might be exposed as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, atora ne ka dhu tao lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a, do? aad'o! te masi ka ja'a ke'a atora sèra, te ngaa ja'a nanene taruu bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a tao sala. de nèti sasala ja'a èèna ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a. atora ne mema be'a, te èèna ka dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu tao èdhi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. de ropa lamatua pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, atora èèna ka dhu peka paled'a, na, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi èèna, be'a boe.

source_text: we know that the law is spiritual; but i am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, atora dhu lamatua pangèd'u re musa, puru mai nèti roh lamatua. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di, dhu dènge d'ara dhu èra boe. hèia ja'a nanene j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, toke ja'a manahu asa d'ara sasala. èèna nuka sèmi sasala dhu j'aj'i lamatua ja'a, aa ja'a j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala.

source_text: i do not understand what i do. for what i want to do, i do not do. but what i hate, i do.
target_text: pamalaa ja'a. ja'a ke'a boe ngaa ka dhu ja'a tao. te ja'a tao boe madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a neo tao. te ngaa ja'a tao madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a d'èi boe tao.

source_text: and if i do what i do not want to do, i admit that the law is good.
target_text: ladhe ja'a tao ngaa dhu ja'a neo boe tao, ja'a mangaku, na, atora lamatua ne lèke.

source_text: in that case, it is no longer i who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
target_text: de ja'a boe ka dhu uri ngi'u ja'a. te bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ka dhu uli ja'a!

source_text: i know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for i have the desire to do what is good, but i cannot carry it out.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le, na, abhu boe j'ara dhu be'a muri ètu d'ara ja'a. te ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha dhu d'ara karehe. d'èi do d'èi boe, ja'a bisa boe pakaseti iisi sèna ka tao dhu lèke. ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe!

source_text: for i do not do the good i want to do. instead, i keep on doing the evil i do not want to do.
target_text: te ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe tao. aa ko'o boe tao dhu bhelu, te ngaa cèku tao!

source_text: and if i do what i do not want, it is no longer i who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ad'u-ue ngaa dhu ko'o boe tao, èèna mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa lula sasala dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: so this is the principle i have discovered: when i want to do good, evil is right there with me.
target_text: ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tate'a èci, sèmi ne'e ka: masi ka ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu palab'a ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for in my inner being i delight in god's law.
target_text: aa te ngaa madhutu iia-iia ètu d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, ladhe ja'a pangee atora lamatua.

source_text: but i see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.
target_text: te ngaa nuka sèmi abhu koasa ètu d'ara ja'a dhu pa'ele iie ja'a. te ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe. èèna nuka sèmi koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a dhu kèpe nare ja'a, ho laka-seti madhutu ne.

source_text: what a wretched man i am! who will rescue me from this body of death?
target_text: ira ii, kasian, ee! ja'a ne dhèu j'èra! dhèu cee ka dhu bisa patabuli ja'a nèti koasa bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ne, dhu tao lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a?

source_text: thanks be to god, through jesus christ our lord! so then, with my mind i serve the law of god, but with my flesh i serve the law of sin.
target_text: te ngaa malo-malo ka! ama lamatua unu na ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele ja'a! ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua, lula kètu èdhi yesus kristus bisa hia mamuri mi ja'a! de ladhe ja'a mamuri maena dhoka mi ngi'u ja'a di, na, ja'a j'èra. masi ka ja'a neo tao madhutu atora lamatua, te ngaa abhu koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, dadugu ja'a, sèna ka tao taruu dhoka bhabhelu-katub'a di.

source_text: therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in christ jesus.
target_text: de ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus!

source_text: for in christ jesus the law of the spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.
target_text: te abhu dua lii tate'a dhu lèke: ka èci peka na, ladhe èdhi pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, roh lamatua hia koasa mi èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola. ka dua peka na, abhu bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dhu kakèj'i èdhi ho tao sala. aa ladhe èdhi tao sala, ama lamatua mad'enge dènge èdhi. aa ladhe èdhi abhu roh lamatua, na patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: for what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, god did by sending his own son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. he thus condemned sin in the flesh,
target_text: masi ka èdhi tao madhutu atora musa, èèna bisa boe patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, lula èdhi se dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di dhu tao bhabhelu katub'a taruu. te ngaa lamatua ka dhu bhoke j'ara. te nèngu pua ana mone mesa na mai, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha biasa, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi. masi ka èdhi dhèu rai-haha biasa tao rupa-rupa sasala, te ngaa yesus mesa-mesa na dhu tao nèdhi boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. ngaa hari, nèngu j'aj'i korban, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu.

source_text: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua hia kristus mai, sèna ka na madhe, ho hud'i laa èdhi bisa tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke, madhutu atora lamatua. ka limuri ne, èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu mola madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, aa tao heka madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ti.

source_text: those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the spirit set their minds on the things of the spirit.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ra, tao sèmi èèna lula ra pangee dhoka j'ara bhabhelu di. te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, rèngu dhoka pangee j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara roh lamatua di.

source_text: the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the spirit is life and peace,
target_text: dhèu dhu soro tèke bhabhelu ator ngangee na, sama sèmi dhèu dhu nanene boe roh lamatua, nuka sèmi d'ara nèngu aad'o heka dènge lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu soro tèke roh lamatua ator ngangee na, mamuri na mola, aa d'ara na mera-milu.

source_text: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to god: it does not submit to god's law, nor can it do so.
target_text: dad'èi èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne, palab'a bia dènge dad'èi lamatua. hèia èdhi to'o boe pahaha iisi ho nanene lamatua, lula èdhi mesa ti bisa boe.

source_text: those controlled by the flesh cannot please god.
target_text: te dhèu dhu soro tèke dad'èi ra ator rèngu, d'èi do d'èi boe, èèna bisa boe pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: you, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the spirit, if the spirit of god lives in you. and if anyone does not have the spirit of christ, he does not belong to christ.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, dhèu dhu mamuri bhelu heka, madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi. te ladhe abhu roh lamatua dhu mamuri ètu d'ara miu, miu tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara nèngu. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu roh kristus pea boe ètu d'ara na, nèngu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: but if christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
target_text: ngi'u aae miu bèli-camèd'a madhe, lula sasala dhu miu tao uru sèra. te ngaa, lula limuri ne kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, roh miu mamuri taruu, lula ama lamatua cap le miu dhèu d'ara mola, hèia miu pabe'a hari le dènge ne.

source_text: and if the spirit of him who raised jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised christ jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his spirit, who lives in you.
target_text: te ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. de masi ka èdhi madhe, te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi, pe nèngu pamamuri hari èdhi kahèi. sasoa na, na pamamuri èdhi sama sèmi na pamamuri hari kristus.

source_text: therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! èdhi dhu dènge kèlu-g'ètu. mage nèti kèlu-g'ètu ne, ho mamuri èdhi madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa èdhi hud'i mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri madhutu dhoka bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi di, tatu lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi, aa èdhi pasae tare huku madhe! te ngaa ladhe èdhi soro tèke roh lamatua palaho koasa sasala ètu d'ara èdhi, èèna na èdhi heka bisa mamuri dhu mola kèna.

source_text: for all who are led by the spirit of god are sons of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu nanene roh lamatua, sèna ka na ator si, na, dhèu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: for you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, abba! father!
target_text: ladhe èdhi soro tèke roh lamatua ator èdhi, na tao boe èdhi sèmi ènu dhu mamuri dhoka dènge d'ara madha'u di. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa, lula èdhi sèmi tare le roh lamatua ho uri èdhi, èdhi te'a le, na, èdhi j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, nèngu d'èi tadèngi, ladhe èdhi paroa ne, ama pasue!

source_text: the spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are god's children.
target_text: d'ara èdhi unu ti ka dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua. aa roh lamatua kahèi peka sèmi èèna.

source_text: and if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of god and co-heirs with christ-if indeed we suffer with him, so that we may also be glorified with him.
target_text: ladhe èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua, èèna sasoa na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi sèmi tare pusaka na, lula nèngu j'aj'i ama èdhi. aa ladhe ama hia pusaka mi ana na kristus, èdhi kahèi sèmi palere-lere dènge ne. te ngaa abhu ca j'ara era: èdhi hud'i abhu ku j'aj'èra, sama sèmi kristus kahèi dhu abhu le j'aj'èra, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e èdhi padedha-dedha, nuka sèmi nèngu ded'e padedha-dedha le kristus.

source_text: i consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
target_text: te ngaa madhutu a'abhu ja'a, j'aj'èra dhu èdhi pasae ne'e ne, kab'ua na aad'o, ladhe pasoro dènge dadedha dhu lamatua neo pad'elo mi èdhi.

source_text: the creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of god.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dhu mate tatae neo rèdhi na pad'elo ana-ana na sèra, nuka cee! te na neo pad'elo dènge ra, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: for the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the one who subjected it, in hope
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, aa dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa ra madhutu boe, lula boe dad'èi rèngu, te ngaa nèti dad'èi lamatua, te na huku si sèna ka pa'ele iie si. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu era maena era.

source_text: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of god.
target_text: te limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i sèra ele iie, aa abhu boe j'ara kalua. te ngaa èèna na, lamatua neo patabuli si, sèna ka ra ele iie heka, te ngaa rèngu bisa j'aj'i kapai titu kèna madhutu dad'èi na. lamatua kahèi neo ded'e padedha-dedha ana-ana na, ho patabuli rèngu nèti dhu ele iie sèra.

source_text: we know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
target_text: te èdhi te'a le, na, abhu j'aj'èra ae ètu rai-haha ne. karèi nèti uru ka d'ai doe ne'e, aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i sèra, taraa pèd'a, dhu ra tatae ho lamatua tao aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i hiu. èèna nuka sèmi bhèni dhu taraa kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
target_text: mesa boe rai-haha di dhu tatae, te ngaa èdhi kahèi mate sèmi èèna. masi ka lamatua hia uru le roh na mi èdhi, èdhi taraa d'ara pèd'a kahèi. te èdhi dhu tatae mate ama lamatua ded'e nare èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana dhu mola, dènge patabuli ngi'u èdhi aa'i-aa'i nèti dhu ele iie.

source_text: for in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. who hopes for what he can already see?
target_text: lod'o lamatua hia èdhi mamuri, na peka kahèi, bèli-camèd'a na tao sèmi ngaa. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi dhu tatae era lula dhae j'aj'i mèka. ladhe èdhi tèdhi ka j'ara èci dhu j'aj'i le, èdhi pamata heka neo tèdhi j'ara èèna. te dhèu parluu heka mate, sèna ka rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i le, sina ma?

source_text: but if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhu tatae ho neo tèdhi ca j'ara dhu dhae j'aj'i mèka, èdhi pa'èra d'ara taruu.

source_text: in the same way, the spirit helps us in our weakness. for we do not know how we ought to pray, but the spirit himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o èdhi mate tae-tae èèna, roh lamatua ka dhu soru-bara èdhi, lula èdhi se dhu roe-bhilu, aa te'a boe sabaj'a dhu lèke. te ngaa roh lamatua unu na ka dhu sabaj'a gati èdhi, masi ka te'a dhoka taraa di, aa te'a boe sabaj'a peka lii ngaa.

source_text: and he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the spirit, because the spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of god.
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu, dhu èdhi neo peka nèti d'ara èdhi. nèngu ne'a ngangee roh na kahèi. nèti èèna ka, nèngu ne'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu roh na neo peka ho soru-bara èdhi. te ngangee roh lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ngangee ama lamatua mesa na. aa roh na dhu sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, manèngi sèna ka lamatua soru-bara dhèu parcaya sèra. te roh ne sabaj'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and we know that god works all things together for the good of those who love him, who are called according to his purpose.
target_text: de limuri ne èdhi te'a le sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua tao aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a hia dhèu dhu sue nèngu. te karèi nèti uru ka, lamatua dhu ator nare le j'ara tasamia dhu na neo tao hia mi rèngu. aa na paroa le rèngu, peka na, mai ka! mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a!

source_text: for those god foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his son, so that he would be the firstborn among many brothers.
target_text: lula uru-uru sèra, na tadhe le rèngu aa hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i ca ropa dènge ana na, nuka kristus. te kristus ka dhu ana uuru, aa dhu leo sèra j'aj'i mi ari na.

source_text: and those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.
target_text: dhèu dhu lamatua tadhe karèi nèti uru sèra, na paroa nare le, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. aa rèngu kahèi, dhu uru èèna dhèu sala, na tao si j'aj'i dhèu mola, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ne. aa na ded'e si padedha-dedha.

source_text: what then shall we say in response to these things? if god is for us, who can be against us?
target_text: de èdhi peka ngaa hari nèti j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra? ama lamatua dhu bhiri nare èdhi. aa ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu cee dhu bisa lab'a hari èdhi? abhu boe, sina ma?

source_text: he who did not spare his own son but gave him up for us all, how will he not also, along with him, freely give us all things?
target_text: ama lamatua taha boe ana na. te ngaa soro ana na ho madhe j'aj'i korban, sèna ka soru-bara èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. lula ama lamatua taha boe ana na, èdhi bisa te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a na hia iia èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. lèke, si?

source_text: who will bring any charge against god's elect? it is god who justifies.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, abhu dhèu dhu bisa pèci sasala asa dhèu dhu lamatua hag'e nare sèra? te ngaa aad'o, si? te lamatua mesa na ka dhu cap èdhi j'aj'i dhèu mola dhu dènge heka sasala, ho èdhi pabe'a hari dènge ne.

source_text: who is there to condemn us? for christ jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of god-and he is interceding for us.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, abhu dhèu era dhu peka na, hud'i lamatua huku ku dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra. te ngaa bisa boe! te yesus kristus dhu madhe le. risi-risi hari, lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari ne nèti mamadhe na. hèia lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka pamadhèdi ne ètu era dhu kab'ua risi re baboa g'ana na. aa ètu èèna, nèngu loe boe sabaj'a hia èdhi.

source_text: who shall separate us from the love of christ? shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, abhu dhèu do, j'ara dhu leo, dhu bisa tao kristus sue heka èdhi, do? bisa boe! masi ka èdhi paraga dènge lii langu do, sasusa do, manganga-mad'èu do, unu boe mèdha-papake do, mamadhe-mamopo do, dhèu neo pamadhe do, te ngaa kristus sue èdhi taruu. abhu boe èci sa dhu bisa pacèri èdhi nèti sasue kristus.

source_text: as it is written: for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri tèke, peka na, dhèu loe boe tenge j'ara neo pamadhe èdhi, lula èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. rèngu tao èdhi, nuka sèmi kalèbho dhu ra neo roro.

source_text: no, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
target_text: de masi ka èdhi paraga dènge sasusa sèmi ngaa èèna ka, te ngaa èdhi segi le, lula kristus sue èdhi titu kèna!

source_text: for i am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
target_text: ja'a ke'a mèu le, na, abhu boe j'ara èci sa dhu bisa hag'e eele sasue lamatua nèti dedha èdhi. masi ka èdhi mamuri do, èdhi madhe do, abhu ana pajuu nèti sorga do, dhu rèd'u paredha do, abhu koasa do, lii langu dhu j'aj'i limuri do, dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a do,

source_text: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of god that is in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: koasa ètu dedha-liru do, koasa ètu rai-haha do, mèdha leo dhu lamatua tao nare le - abhu boe èci sa dhu bisa pacèri èdhi nèti ama lamatua, dhu kai ne, sèna ka sue ia ka èdhi! lula èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai.

source_text: i speak the truth in christ; i am not lying, as confirmed by my conscience in the holy spirit.
target_text: èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus, padhai lii dhu lèke. de ja'a monya boe miu. d'ara iiki ja'a kahèi, peka na, roh lamatua dhu ator d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart. for i could wish that i myself were cursed and cut off from christ for the sake of my brothers, my own flesh and blood,
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi ne'e ka: d'ara ja'a susa. ja'a rasa bia, lula ja'a ngee kèdhi dhèu-dhèu ja'a mesa ku. te ja'a neo sèna ka dhèu ja'a, dhèu yahudi sèra, pa'èki dènge kristus kahèi, te ngaa ae dhu parcaya boe nèngu. ladhe sèmi ja'a dhu bisa bhoke j'ara hia rèngu, ja'a sadia manèngi ho lamatua huku ja'a, sèna ka gati si. aa ja'a sadia manèngi kahèi, sèna ka lamatua hag'e eele ja'a nèti kristus, ho rèngu bisa pa'èki dènge ne.

source_text: the people of israel. theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
target_text: aa te ngaa, rèngu se dhèu isra'el, nuka bangsa èci dhu kalua hua iia titu kèna. lamatua dhu ded'e le rèngu se, j'aj'i ana-ana na karèi nèti katanga rai ka. na pad'elo dadedha na mi rèngu. na pa'èki dènge ra rupa-rupa lii pajaji. na pangèd'u si atora na. rèngu ka dhu re'a mèu pahaha iisi mi lamatua, aa sab'a hia ne. lamatua dhu pamoa le, neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi rèngu.

source_text: theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of christ, who is god over all, forever worthy of praise! amen.
target_text: dhèu yahudi j'aj'aj'i ra nèti bèi-baki ji'i, nuka: abraham, isak dènge yakob dhèu rare ngara ‘isra'el' nèti yakob. aa kristus, dhu lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru-uru ka ho pua mai èèna, j'aj'aj'i na nèti bèi-baki ji'i dhèu yahudi kahèi. kristus ne'e ka, ama lamatua kahèi dhu nèd'u paredha mi aa'i-aa'i se. de lèke, ladhe dhèu ded'e koa-kio hia ne toke d'ai mia-mia. lèke tare'a!

source_text: it is not as though god's word has failed. for not all who are descended from israel are israel.
target_text: masi ka abhu dhèu isra'el ae ka dhu sèmi mèka kristus, te ngaa dhèu bisa boe peka, na, lii pajaji lamatua èèna j'aj'i boe. baku ngee, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i nèti bèi-baki isra'el sèra, j'aj'i bangsa isra'el dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: nor because they are abraham's descendants are they all his children. on the contrary, through isaac your offspring will be reckoned.
target_text: nuka sèmi, dhèu ae-ae j'aj'aj'i ra nèti bèi-baki ji'i, abraham. te ngaa rèngu aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i boe ana-èpu d'èlu abraham dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare. te lamatua dhu peka le dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, ana-èpu èu dhu ja'a tadhe, dhoka rèngu dhu j'aj'i nèti ana mu isak di.

source_text: so it is not the children of the flesh who are god's children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring.
target_text: sasoa na, karèi nèti uru d'ai sange ne'e, ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i boe nèti baki ji'i abraham, dhu j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua. dhodhoka ana-èpu dhu j'aj'i nèti lii pajaji lamatua dènge abraham di, dhu lamatua tadhe. rèngu ka di dhu j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua dhu lèke.

source_text: for this is what the promise stated: at the appointed time i will return, and sarah will have a son.
target_text: te lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge abraham, peka na, pe d'ai tèu mai nèi, ja'a lèpa hari mai. lod'o èèna dhèu èmu èu sara nara iisi le ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: not only that, but rebecca's children were conceived by one man, our father isaac.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di. te isak dènge dhèu èmu na ribka, nara iisi ana kajari dua.

source_text: yet before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad, in order that god's plan of election might stand, not by works but by him who calls, she was told, the older will serve the younger.
target_text: lod'o ribka nara iisi mèka ana na si, rèngu se dhae tao mèka j'ara dhu mola, do dhu bhelu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua peka uuru le dènge ribka lula-nèti ana kajari dhu kalua uuru, peka na, bèli-camèd'a a'a ne sab'a hia ari na. lamatua peka sèmi èèna ho pad'elo, na, ladhe nèngu hag'e nare le dhèu èci, nèngu dhu ne'a le, neo pake dhèu ne sèna ka tao tasa mera mia. hèia lamatua pili ari na, j'aj'i dhèu unu na. lamatua parluu heka pamata, ho laladhe ari ne neo tao ngaa, lula lamatua dhu ne'a mema le.

source_text: so it is written: jacob i loved, but esau i hated.
target_text: te lamatua dhu peka le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, aku nèngu na, ja'a pili kore le yakob, te ngaa ja'a tule eele esau.

source_text: what then shall we say? is god unjust? certainly not!
target_text: de èdhi peka tasamia? ele boe cahag'e peka na, lamatua pama'ète lii langu, bia cabèka, do? bisa boe!

source_text: for he says to moses: i will have mercy on whom i have mercy, and i will have compassion on whom i have compassion.
target_text: te uru èèna, ama lamatua dhu peka le dènge musa, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu paraga dènge sasusa, ja'a ka dhu pili neo pad'elo rasa kasia mi cee, aa ja'a ka dhu pili neo bhoke d'ara ja'a mi dhèu dhu ja'a paj'uj'u unu ku.

source_text: so then, it does not depend on man's desire or effort, but on god's mercy.
target_text: de dhèu ne'e rasa boe d'ara taleo lamatua, lula dad'èi nèngu unu na, do, lula tatao unu na. te ngaa lula lamatua mesa na ka dhu neo pad'elo d'ara taleo na mi dhèu ne'e.

source_text: for the scripture says to pharaoh: i raised you up for this very purpose, that i might display my power in you, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, lamatua padhai lii dènge dhèu aae masir, peka na, ja'a ded'e kore èu j'aj'i dhèu aae, lula ja'a neo pake èu ho pad'elo koasa ja'a mi dhèu ae-ae. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne, bisa koa-kio kolongara ja'a.

source_text: therefore god has mercy on whom he wants to have mercy, and he hardens whom he wants to harden.
target_text: de ladhe lamatua neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu èci, na, nèngu tao. aa ladhe na neo tao d'ara ca dhèu adhu sèmi hadhu, na, nèngu tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: one of you will say to me, then why does god still find fault? for who can resist his will?
target_text: ladhe sèmi abhu dhèu dhu sisu ja'a, peka na, kèri sèmi èèna, ladhe lamatua neo ad'u j'ara èci, cee ka dhu bisa lab'a ne? aad'o, sina ma? de nga tao ka nèngu neo pèci sasala mi dedha èdhi? èèna adil boe!

source_text: but who are you, o man, to talk back to god? shall what is formed say to him who formed it, why did you make me like this?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pangee sèmi èèna, ja'a dhaa sèmi ne'e ka: èu pangee na, èu ne cee? ! èu neo padhai lii lab'a lamatua, do? baku sèmi èèna! te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, abhu dhu suri, peka na, ladhe dhèu tao mèdha èci, abhu ètu mia mèdha ne karèi hari dhèu dhu tao ne peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao ja'a sèmi ne'e! ? '

source_text: does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
target_text: nuka sèmi dhèu tao èru rai. nèti rai mea ca kahore, nèngu dènge hak tao g'ala dhu kale'e cue, sèna ka dhèu koa ne. dhèu ne dènge hak kahèi, pake rai mea ca kahore ne tao era kaboko maruru èci, madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: what if god, intending to show his wrath and make his power known, bore with great patience the vessels of his wrath, prepared for destruction?
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. nèngu dènge hak ho tao madhutu dad'èi na. nèngu neo pad'elo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, nèngu nasa, aa tule eele bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao. nèngu neo ho dhèu re'a kahèi, na, nèngu unu koasa ae-ae. sèna ka dhèu bisa re'a, nèngu taha d'ara dènge dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a. te ngaa mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a, dhoka mate lod'o di, ho ra ele iie aa'i.

source_text: what if he did this to make the riches of his glory known to the vessels of his mercy, whom he prepared in advance for glory-
target_text: lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara ne, ho paj'uj'u mi dhèu ae, na, nèngu neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu cahag'e. rèngu se'e ka dhu na hag'e nare mema le, sèna ka ded'e si padedha-dedha. aa na neo sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, nèngu mesa na ka dhu dedha risi aa'i.

source_text: including us, whom he has called not only from the jews, but also from the gentiles?
target_text: te èdhi se dhu na pili nare le, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. èdhi se, cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e hari nèti dhèu leo rai kara.

source_text: as he says in hosea: i will call them ‘my people' who are not my people, and i will call her ‘my beloved' who is not my beloved,
target_text: uru èèna, lamatua pake dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na hosea, ho suri dhèu leo rai kara sèra, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, unu boe ja'a, te ngaa ja'a neo paroa kore si, na, ‘miu se, dhèu ja'a. ' aa abhu suku dhu uru èèna, ja'a sue boe, te ngaa ja'a neo paroa kore si, na, ‘miu se, suku dhu ja'a sue. '

source_text: and, it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘you are not my people, ' they will be called ‘sons of the living god. '
target_text: hosea suri kahèi, na, ètu èèna, ètu era dhu lamatua peka dènge si, na, ‘miu se, j'aj'i boe dhèu ja'a! ' pe lamatua dhu mamuri èèna, neo peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ‘limuri ne, miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ja'a! ' na peka sèmi èèna, lula na kasia mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra.

source_text: isaiah cries out concerning israel: though the number of the israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
target_text: dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci hari, nuka yesaya, peka nèdhi le lula-nèti suku isra'el, na, masi ka dhèu isra'el ca nau-ca nadha, nuka sèmi salae dhasi, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua patabuli rèngu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra, dhoka dhèu ciki di.

source_text: for the lord will carry out his sentence on the earth thoroughly and decisively.
target_text: te èèna d'ai lod'o na, ho ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sama sèmi dhu na peka mema le. te ngaa na pamata heka, te na pamèci nare lai-lai!

source_text: it is just as isaiah foretold: unless the lord of hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like sodom, we would have resembled gomorrah.
target_text: lod'o uru èèna, yesaya peka le lula-nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi oto, lula ama lamatua dhu koasa risi aa'i èèna, soro tèke sèna ka ana-èpu èdhi cahag'e abhu sod'a. te ladhe aad'o sèmi èèna, na, èdhi se aad'o heka le, nuka sèmi dhèu kota sodom dènge kota gomora sèra.

source_text: what then will we say? that the gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? èdhi neo peka, na, dhèu dhu yahudi boe sèra mai nèti mia-mia. uru èèna rèngu tenge boe j'ara ho pabe'a rèngu dènge lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, ra pabe'a le dènge ne, lula parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: but israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu isra'el sèra, neo ae le tenge j'ara sèna ka tao madhutu atora musa, ho pabe'a rèngu dènge lamatua, te ngaa j'aj'i boe.

source_text: why not? because their pursuit was not by faith, but as if it were by works. they stumbled over the stumbling stone, as it is written: see, i lay in zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame.
target_text: nga tao ka rèngu bisa boe pabe'a dènge lamatua? lula rèngu dhodhoka neo tao madhutu atora di, sèna ka na sèmi nare si nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara mola, te ngaa rèngu parcaya boe yesus kristus. hèia rèngu oe sèmi kadhunu sa, lèke hadhu kadhunu cue. ne'e ne ka naneo nèti sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu peka na, ladhe ku sa ne'e! te ja'a pamadhèdi le ca dhèu ètu ledhe sion, nuka kota yerusalem. dhèu ne nuka sèmi hadhu cue, dhu dhèu kadhunu lèke ne. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya ne, nèngu parluu boe makae. hadhu ne, nuka yesus. te ngaa dhèu isra'el tule eele ne. èèna na sama sèmi rèngu kadhunu, ka bèbha lula hadhu deo na.

source_text: brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to god for the israelites is for their salvation.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo dhèu isra'el abhu ngaa? ja'a sabaj'a ho hud'i laa lamatua patalale rèngu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka karej'e kèna!

source_text: for i testify about them that they are zealous for god, but not on the basis of knowledge.
target_text: ja'a bisa peka j'ara-j'ara nèti tatao dhèu se'e: rèngu se maj'èni neo madhutu ama lamatua. masi ka ra maj'èni sèmi èèna, te ngaa re'a mèu boe j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: because they were ignorant of god's righteousness and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to god's righteousness.
target_text: lula rèngu re'a boe j'ara mamuri dhu mola, dhu bisa pabe'a dhèu dènge lamatua, nèti èèna ka dhèu se bhoke j'ara unu ra, ho neo sèku pabe'a dènge lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: for christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhutu dhoka atora di, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare si, na, èèna d'ai mèka. nèti èèna ka, kristus pamèci nare aa'i mèu-mèu le, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua. ka limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for concerning the righteousness that is by the law, moses writes: the man who does these things will live by them.
target_text: uru èèna, musa pad'elo le j'ara ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, sèna ka dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ra tao madhutu aa'i mèu-mèu atora lamatua. nèngu suri, peka na, dhèu cee dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ne, bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu mamuri mola.

source_text: but the righteousness that is by faith says: do not say in your heart, ‘who will ascend into heaven? ' that is, to bring christ down
target_text: te ngaa sasuri mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo j'ara leo, peka na, dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua sad'i rèngu parcaya yesus kristus. dhu suri tèke, na, mage karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu bisa ca'e asa sorga? ' èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu neo ca'e la'e peka dènge kristus, na, èdhi dhèu rai-haha d'èi ladhe nèngu puru mai sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: or, ‘who will descend into the abyss? ' that is, to bring christ up from the dead.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, peka na, mage karèi, na ‘cee ka dhu neo puru la'e asa d'ara naraka, ètu era dhèu madhe sèra? ' èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu puru la'e ho paca'e kristus nèti era mamadhe na, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: but what does it say? the word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:
target_text: baku sèmi èèna! te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, na, lii moa nèti lamatua ètu katanga madha èu! te lii moa èèna abhu le ètu hèb'a dènge d'ara èu. lii moa ne dhu èdhi peka-padhai dènge dhèu, peka na, ladhe èu neo abhu mamuri, na, hud'i parcaya ku kristus!

source_text: that if you confess with your mouth, jesus is lord, and believe in your heart that god raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
target_text: ladhe èu mangaku dènge hèb'a mu, peka na, kristus èèna, kètu ja'a, aa parcaya ètu d'ara èu, na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari le yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na, ka ama lamatua patabuli èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èu.

source_text: for with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved.
target_text: te ladhe èu parcaya kristus dènge d'ara kateme, ama lamatua cap èu, peka na, èu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. aa ladhe èu mangaku dènge hèb'a mu, peka na, yesus j'aj'i kètu èu, ama lamatua patabuli èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èu kahèi.

source_text: it is just as the scripture says: anyone who believes in him will never be put to shame.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, cee dhu parcaya ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a, na'e boe makae, lula lamatua neo tao j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu, ngaa dhu na peka nare le.

source_text: for there is no difference between jew and greek: the same lord is lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on him,
target_text: dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, èci èèna ka. beda boe. abhu dhoka kètu èci di, aa nèngu ka kètu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi bara nèti nèngu.

source_text: for, everyone who calls on the name of the lord will be saved.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi lamatua soru-bara si, pe nèngu patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: how then can they call on the one in whom they have not believed? and how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? and how can they hear without someone to preach?
target_text: te ngaa tasamia dhèu bisa manèngi bara nèti ca dhèu, ladhe rèngu dhae parcaya mèka ne? aa tasamia rèngu bisa parcaya ne, ladhe rèngu dhae tadèngi mèka j'ara mamuri dhèu ne? tasamia rèngu bisa tadèngi lula-nèti nèngu ne, ladhe abhu boe dhèu dhu lole dènge ra?

source_text: and how can they preach unless they are sent? as it is written: how beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!
target_text: aa tasamia rèngu bisa lole dènge dhèu, ladhe abhu boe dhu pua-paleha si? ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe dhèu rèti mai lii lolo be'a, mamai dhèu se'e se be'a titu kèna!

source_text: but not all of them welcomed the good news. for isaiah says, lord, who has believed our message?
target_text: te ngaa miu kahèi me'a, na, abhu dhèu isra'el cahag'e ro'o boe nanene lii lolo be'a lamatua. te yesaya, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri peka na, lamatua! dhèu se'e ro'o boe lèka lii moa dhu rèngu tadèngi le nèti ji'i!

source_text: consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of christ.
target_text: de ladhe neo parcaya ama lamatua, na, hud'i nanene uuru ku lii holo-nori na. aa neo me'a lii moa na, hud'i tadèngi uuru ku lula-nèti kristus.

source_text: but i ask, did they not hear? indeed they did: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.
target_text: ja'a karèi sèku, sèmi ne'e: ele boe miu pangee, na, dhèu isra'el sèra tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula-nèti kristus, do? tatu ra tadèngi le! nuka sèmi dhèu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu palolo lula-nèti lamatua ne pale-palème le rai-haha; lii rèngu d'ai aa'i le palème rai-haha toke d'ai suu-suu rai.

source_text: i ask instead, did israel not understand? first, moses says: i will make you jealous by those who are not a nation; i will make you angry by a nation without understanding.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi hari ca j'ara, dhèu isra'el sèra dhane rare mèka j'ara ama lamatua, do? musa ka, dhèu uru j'ara dhu suri peka na, lamatua peka mi dhèu isra'el sèmi ne'e: ja'a neo tao j'ara èci hia dhèu nèti suku leo sèra. j'ara ne tao miu tèka d'ara. aa ja'a neo tao j'ara èci, hia dhèu dhu mi pangee na kahadhu ènyu. j'ara ne tao miu kadhi ngutu.

source_text: and isaiah boldly says: i was found by those who did not seek me; i revealed myself to those who did not ask for me.
target_text: limuri hari, yesaya suri dhu paled'a risi lula-nèti dhèu yahudi boe, dhu peka na, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge boe ja'a, te ngaa rèngu paraga le dènge ja'a. abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna manèngi boe ho rèdhi ja'a, te ngaa ja'a pad'elo iisi le mi rèngu.

source_text: but as for israel he says: all day long i have held out my hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.
target_text: te ngaa, lula-nèti dhèu isra'el sèra, lamatua peka le sèmi ne'e: mèda-mèu, ai ja'a dhu pakabhèle tèke, sèna ka tatae mamai dhèu isra'el asa ja'a. te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a, aa ra d'èi palab'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: i ask then, did god reject his people? certainly not! i am an israelite myself, a descendant of abraham, from the tribe of benjamin.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ele boe miu pangee, na, lula dhèu isra'el ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na tule eele le si. sèmi èèna ka, do? aad'o! te j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti rèngu kahèi! ja'a ne, nèti suku benyamin. ama benyamin, nuka yakob. baki na, isak, ama isak, ka abraham, dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: god did not reject his people, whom he foreknew. do you not know what the scripture says about elijah, how he appealed to god against israel:
target_text: ama lamatua tule eele nèdhi boe dhèu unu na sèra. rèngu se'e ka dhu na tadhe karèi nèti uru-uru ka. miu sanèd'e era, ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti elia, si? elia ka'uu-kamuki mi lamatua lula-nèti dhèu isra'el sèra, hèia na manèngi, sèna ka lamatua huku si,

source_text: lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars. i am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well?
target_text: peka na, ama! dhèu se pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai, dhu ama pua mai. ra pa'ele iie le mei korban kahèi, ètu era dhu dhèu tema pahaha iisi mi ama. nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ate dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku di dhu mamuri. te ngaa rèngu tenge j'ara, ho neo pamadhe ja'a kahèi!

source_text: and what was the divine reply to him? i have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to baal.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa, peka na: lii èu èèna, sala! te dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ja'a, abhu pidhu riho dhèu era. rèngu se taha dènge èra, aa sogo-tagu boe ba'al!

source_text: in the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace. and if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works. otherwise, grace would no longer be grace.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi limuri ne. te dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i boe dhu soro kabodho mi ama lamatua. abhu ciki nèti ji'i era dhu lamatua pili nare, sèna ka hia mamuri, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i, lula boe nèti tatao ji'i dhu be'a! te ladhe nèngu hud'i pili nare ku ji'i lula tatao ji'i dhu be'a, sasoa na, nèngu bisa boe pama'ète sèna ka neo pad'elo, do pad'elo boe, d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i. ladhe sèmi èèna, peka iia ka, na, ‘nèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na'.

source_text: what then? what israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. the others were hardened,
target_text: de lala'e na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi rèngu, sèna ka rèngu bisa pabe'a kahèi dènge lamatua. te ngaa abhu boe, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu, dènge ro'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa cahag'e nèti dhèu se abhu. dhèu se'e ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si.

source_text: as it is written: god gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see, and ears that could not hear, to this very day.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri lula-nèti dhèu kètu hadhu sèra, peka na, lamatua hia si, musi madha dhu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi, ro'a dhilu dhu bisa boe tadèngi, aa kahadhu dhu bisa boe pangee. de rèngu re'a mèu iia boe, toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and david says: may their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution to them.
target_text: dhèu aae daud suri le kahèi lula-nèti dhèu yahudi se, ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, hud'i laa ho ra tao pesta ètu mei unu ra. te tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i sasii ho sii hari rèngu, ka ra ngee na aa'i-aa'i se be'a le. aa nèti mèdha-panyau unu ra, ka dhu pasaleku rèngu.

source_text: may their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
target_text: hud'i laa sèna ka musi madha ra maroga, ho rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa! hud'i laa rèngu dui bia taruu, sèna ka kabodho ra asa kabhuku!

source_text: i ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? certainly not! however, because of their trespass, salvation has come to the gentiles to make israel jealous.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: nga tao ka dhèu yahudi sèra kadhunu? ra bèbha le, do? aad'o! te ngaa, lula rèngu ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus, ne'e ne ka dhu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka ra bisa abhu mamuri, lula lamatua patabuli si nèti sasala ra. nèti tatao lamatua sèmi èèna, nèngu neo ho dhèu yahudi sèra tèka d'ara, hèia ra lèpa hari ho madhutu ne.

source_text: but if their trespass means riches for the world, and their failure means riches for the gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!
target_text: de dhu mola na kèna, peka na, dhèu yahudi se sisu ngaa dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo nèti palème rai-haha ne bisa rasa kakee-mamènyi d'ara hua iia lamatua. de dhèu yahudi rugi kapai. te ngaa èèna tao dhèu yahudi boe sèra oto titu kèna. de nèbhu-nèbhu, ladhe dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi hari!

source_text: i am speaking to you gentiles. inasmuch as i am the apostle to the gentiles, i magnify my ministry
target_text: ja'a neo peka j'ara èci dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, sèmi ne'e: lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka, laku peka-padhai dènge miu, lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, sèna ka pakako sasab'a dhu be'a aae ne.

source_text: in the hope that i may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a pakako sasab'a ne dènge be'a, ja'a sanao sèna ka dhèu yahudi unu ku tèka d'ara. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ja'a bisa bara rèngu cahag'e sèna ka abhu mamuri.

source_text: for if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
