target_text: ropa lamatua tule eele dhèu unu na, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu j'ara ho maso j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa èle èèna, ladhe sèmi rèngu padame hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi. te èèna sama sèmi rèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe ra!

source_text: if the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao roti. ladhe nare tarigu ciki saraka mi lamatua, èèna na roti se j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua. aa ladhe dhèu hia amo aj'u èci, ho j'aj'i bua sulung mi lamatua, èèna na aj'u ca kapua ne j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
target_text: ja'a neo pakasame dhèu yahudi dènge aj'u saitun ca kapua dhu ra piara ètu d'ara oka. ama lamatua dhu tutu eele le dadana cahag'e nèti aj'u ne. te ngaa miu dhu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi saitun j'ami. hèia, nèti dadana miu cahag'e, lamatua pare nare ka la'e patapa mi aj'u dhu ètu d'ara oka deo na. dènge j'ara ne, dadana nèti aj'u dhu ètu li'u oka, sakid'o nare mamuri nèti aj'u ètu d'ara oka deo na. ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhu yahudi boe, dhu sèmi mere d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, dhu na neo hia mi dhèu unu na, dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: do not boast over those branches. if you do, remember this: you do not support the root, but the root supports you.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! de mage mi padedha iisi, ho pangee na, miu dhu nèti li'u, be'a risi nèti dadana dhu lamatua tutu eele sèra! ladhe èu neo padedha iisi, mage èu bhèlu, te, èu ne dhoka ca dadana di! èu boe ka dhu pa'èra kapua aj'u ne. te amo ka dhu pa'èra aj'u ne!

source_text: you will say then, branches were broken off so that i could be grafted in.
target_text: ele boe èu neo peka, na, lamatua pare eele dadana èci nèti aj'u dhu muri ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka na pakaj'èpe ja'a mi era deo na, ho gati dadana deo na.

source_text: that is correct: they were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. do not be arrogant, but be afraid.
target_text: mema lèke. te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, lamatua tutu eele dadana sèra, lula rèngu parcaya boe ne. aa èu gati si, lula èu parcaya nèngu. de baku padedha iisi! be'a risi loe aa baku lela dedha!

source_text: for if god did not spare the natural branches, he will certainly not spare you either.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi sèra nuka sèmi dadana dhu muri mema, dhu cèu uru tèka. te ngaa lamatua tèke eele boe si toke panèbhu ètu èèna. de ladhe èu parcaya boe taruu mi lamatua, mage èu maena ho na soro tèke èu taruu ètu èèna!

source_text: take notice, therefore, of the kindness and severity of god: severity to those who fell, but kindness to you, if you continue in his kindness. otherwise you also will be cut off.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee pabe'a-be'a ku. ama lamatua mema d'ara hua iia. te ngaa ne'a hia huku dhu bia kahèi. pe nèngu huku dhèu dhu manahu le, dhu pabe'a heka dènge ne. te ngaa mi miu dhèu yahudi boe, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, sad'i miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne, aa miu sèmi mere babe'a na. te ngaa ladhe miu sèmi mere boe j'ara sèmi èèna, lamatua pare eele kahèi miu nèti aj'u na.

source_text: and if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for god is able to graft them in again.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu yahudi sèra. ladhe ra ele-ho'a ka, ho mulai parcaya kristus, pe lamatua tape hari rèngu mi aj'u uru èèna. te nèngu dènge koasa ho bisa tao j'ara sèmi èèna!

source_text: for if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
target_text: te miu dhu dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dadana nèti aj'u saitun hui, dhu muri tab'a ètu li'u oka. te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare miu, ka pakaj'èpe laa mi aj'u saitun dhu hua iia, dhu na sèle ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka hud'i laa aj'u hui èèna leko-leo, aa aj'u ètu d'ara oka leko-leo. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe, bisa j'aj'i sèmi sèra, ngaa hari dhèu yahudi. rèngu bisa risi eele hari, ladhe lamatua pakaj'èpe hari si mi laa aj'u rèngu unu ra.

source_text: i do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited: a hardening in part has come to israel, until the full number of the gentiles has come in.
target_text: a'ari ètu roma! miu hud'i me'a ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi rahasia. te ladhe miu me'a, miu mage pakapai iisi, dhu peka na, miu d'èlu-mèu risi. te j'ara na sèmi ne'e: limuri ne d'ara dhèu yahudi, adhu sèmi hadhu, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus. te ngaa rèngu bisa boe sèmi èèna taruu. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pili nare si, parcaya le kristus, bèli-camèd'a dhèu yahudi sèra parcaya ne kahèi.

source_text: and so all israel will be saved, as it is written: the deliverer will come from zion; he will remove godlessness from jacob.
target_text: de ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, pe lamatua patalale dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu patabuli èdhi nèti mamadhe-mamopo. nèngu mai nèti ledhe sion, nuka kota yerusalem. èèna na, nèngu ka dhu tao ho ana-èpu yakob ele-ho'a. te rèngu mamuri pusi-pahae boe ja'a, aa ra soro kabodho mi j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: and this is my covenant with them when i take away their sins.
target_text: ja'a neo saku eele sasala-sasigo ra. te ja'a pa'èki le lii padhadha dènge rèngu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo be'a lamatua, ra tao iisi ra nuka sèmi musu dhu palab'a dènge ne. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, rèngu hia j'ara mi miu dhu yahudi boe! masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua sue si era, lula na sue bèi-baki ra, aa na hag'e nare si j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: for god's gifts and his call are irrevocable.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua hia le mèdha èci, na nare heka. aa ladhe na paroa nare le dhèu, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! mai asa d'ara ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a! na babège eele heka si.

source_text: just as you who formerly disobeyed god have now received mercy through their disobedience,
target_text: uru èèna, miu dhèu yahudi boe, mo'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere rasa kasia nèti lamatua, lula dhèu yahudi ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: so they too have now disobeyed, in order that they too may now receive mercy through the mercy shown to you.
target_text: de rèngu se'e ka dhu limuri ne ro'o boe tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi miu era. aa bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dedha rèngu kahèi.

source_text: for god has consigned everyone to disobedience so that he may have mercy on everyone.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi dedha dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu yahudi boe. te aa'i-aa'i ra tao boe madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi rèngu ètu d'ara babèdho, aa re'a boe j'ara kalua. lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: o, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of god! how unsearchable are his judgments, and untraceable his ways!
target_text: ama lamatua d'èlu-mèu titu kèna! aa na pake mamèu na, sèna ka tao j'ara hua iia. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu tadhe mèu ne. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua pama'ète lii langu. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a mèu, nga tao ka lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara èci.

source_text: who has known the mind of the lord? or who has been his counselor?
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu ngangee ama èdhi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa holo ne.

source_text: who has first given to god, that god should repay him?
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa hia iia lamatua mèdha èci. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa laka-seti lamatua sèna ka na b'ala hari!

source_text: for from him and through him and to him are all things. to him be the glory forever! amen.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i kapua ra nèti ama lamatua! aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula nèngu ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao, èdhi sab'a hia ne. èdhi koa-kio ne, taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia! lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: therefore i urge you, brothers, on account of god's mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to god, which is your spiritual service of worship.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka saraka mamuri miu kateme mi lamatua, sama sèmi korban dhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. pa'èra ngi'u miu ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa mamuri mola, te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu pad'elo sasue miu aa pakab'ua ne. mema lèke, ladhe miu pahaha iisi mi nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of god.
target_text: baku soro tèke ho dhèu rai-haha ne pua miu tao sèmi ne'e, do sèmi èèna, do mamuri sèmi ngaa sa, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. baku sad'i madhutu iia d'ara di, j'ara ngangee ra, j'ara mamuri ra, do ad'a tatao ra. te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, ladhe miu soro tèke lamatua ub'a ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu, sèna ka miu laladhe aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu j'ara hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa me'a dad'èi lamatua mi dedha miu. te dad'èi lamatua èèna, be'a, pamèci, dènge pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: for by the grace given me i say to every one of you: do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith god has given you.
target_text: lula lamatua pajuu le ja'a, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e ka: lee ngi'u miu dènge j'ara dhu lèke! baku padedha ngi'u risi nèti dhu lèke. baku pake j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. dhèu èci-èci hud'i tenge j'ara ho ne'a mèu a'èra dènge karunya dhu lamatua hia le mi nèngu, lula na parcaya kristus.

source_text: just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
target_text: tare pakasame dènge ngi'u dhèu. ètu ngi'u ne, abhu bagian-bagian, dhu dènge sasab'a-la'a baka-leo.

source_text: so in christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. èdhi se dhèu ae-ae, te ngaa pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. aa dhèu èci-èci ka dènge sasab'a-la'a na, nuka sèmi bagian nèti ngi'u ne. èci parluu èci. tare conto nèti kacui-aai dhu poro pama'ète nèti ngi'u ne, gaguna na aad'o heka, si?

source_text: we have different gifts according to the grace given us. if one's gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: lamatua pangèd'u èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti koasa, sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a-la'a na, lula na d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nuka sèmi, ladhe lamatua hia èu koasa sèna ka èu peka lii moa na, èu hud'i peka aa'i lii moa deo na. te ngaa baku peka risi nèti lii moa èèna.

source_text: if it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;
target_text: ladhe lamatua hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, èu hud'i lalau-lalo'o pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti nèngu, na, èu hud'i aj'a-nori ku pake koasa deo na.

source_text: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.
target_text: ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu, èu hud'i pa'èra si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na hia èu koasa ho soru-bara dhèu leo dènge mèdha-panyau dhu èu unu, hia la mèdha-panyau sèra mi dhèu sèna ka èu soru-bara si. ladhe na hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a lamatua dènge be'a, na, èu hud'i maj'èni ho pimpin si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu rasa kasia ho soru-bara dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, èu hud'i bara si dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: love must be sincere. detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
target_text: ladhe miu pad'elo sasue mi dhèu, na, tao dènge d'ara mola; baku peka leo tao leo. core eele bhelu-katub'a, aa kèpe pa'èra-èra j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: be devoted to one another in brotherly love. outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
target_text: miu dhèu sarani hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci. pa'èra iisi ho pad'elo pakab'ua miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the lord.
target_text: ladhe miu sab'a, sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, baku dènge paloa-pad'ui. hud'i laa sèna ka d'ara miu karae, lod'o miu ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a. aa miu hud'i sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
target_text: d'ara miu hud'i karej'e mèda-mèu, te miu me'a le, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo tao tasamia hia miu. pa'èra d'ara ladhe abhu sasusa. baku roca sabaj'a mèda-mèu.

source_text: share with the saints who are in need. practice hospitality.
target_text: pake mèdha-panyau miu, ho bara dhèu sarani dhu parluu miu bara si. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai nèti rae leo, hia ra'a-rinu, aa sèmi mere si sèna ka manubha ètu d'ara èmu mi. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo le sasue miu mi dedha rèngu.

source_text: bless those who persecute you. bless and do not curse.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu tino paj'èra miu, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale. tare'a! baku dhoo si!

source_text: rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'ara karej'e, na, karej'e sama-sama dènge ra. aa ladhe abhu dhu tangi roma iisi, lula d'ara pèd'a, na, tangi sama-sama dènge ra.

source_text: live in harmony with one another. do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. do not be conceited.
target_text: mamuri pasue dènge d'ara èci. baku padedha iisi. be'a risi miu pa'angalai dènge dhèu haha. baku padedha iisi ho pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu me'a.

source_text: do not repay anyone evil for evil. carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao bhelu mi dedha èu, na, èu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu kahèi. te ngaa èu hud'i tenge j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa sèmi rare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: if it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
target_text: ladhe bisa, na, tenge j'ara ho mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for god's wrath. for it is written: vengeance is mine; i will repay, says the lord.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ladhe dhèu tao sala mi miu, na, baku b'ala ne. soro tèke, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu ator. te lamatua nasa ladhe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sama sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho b'ala sasala dhèu. te ja'a ka dhu huku bhabhelu dhèu.

source_text: on the contrary, if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. for in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.
target_text: dhu be'a risi ka, tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe musu èu manganga, na, hia ne na'a. ladhe musu èu koko-kamango, na, hia ne ninu. te ladhe tao ka sèmi èèna, nèngu makae unu na, aa na pakab'ua hari èu.

source_text: do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
target_text: baku soro tèke bhabhelu ator èu. be'a risi ladhe j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a ka dhu uli èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èu bisa segi madha j'ara dhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from god. the authorities that exist have been appointed by god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i nanene ku atora nèti dhèu paredha. te rèngu dènge hak aa koasa ho paredha dhèu. te ngaa koasa èèna, mai nèti ama lamatua. lula lamatua ka dhu ded'e si, nèti èèna ka rèngu abhu koasa ho rèd'u paredha.

source_text: consequently, whoever resists authority is opposing what god has set in place, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu lab'a dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, èci èèna ka rèngu lab'a dhu lamatua ded'e nare le. ladhe ra ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu huku nèti lamatua.

source_text: for rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu lèke, baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te ngaa ladhe miu ad'u j'ara bhelu, be'a risi miu madha'u dènge ra! de j'aga ngi'u ho tao dhu lèke, sèna ka miu baku madha'u dènge ra. aa ladhe miu tao ka j'ara sèmi èèna, pe ra koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: for he is god's servant for your good. but if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. he is god's servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
target_text: te dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu sèra ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si, ho ladhe-leru miu. te ngaa ladhe miu loe boe nèti tao sala, be'a risi miu madha'u! te rèngu dènge hak dhu iia d'ara boe ho huku miu. rèngu, nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha lamatua, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. te lamatua sèmi nare boe bhabhelu dhu dhèu tao; na nasa dènge ra.

source_text: therefore it is necessary to submit to authority, not only to avoid punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i nanene ku, mi dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te miu dhu me'a mèu le, èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola. aa miu me'a kahèi, na, lamatua nasa, ladhe èdhi tao boe dhu lèke.

source_text: this is also why you pay taxes. for the authorities are god's servants, who devote themselves to their work.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu hud'i b'ae bea dhu madhutu atora, lula dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha sèra, pakako sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
target_text: de miu hud'i b'ae aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke madhutu atora. b'ae hia dhèu roro bea sèra, bea aa'i-aa'i dhu miu hud'i b'ae ku. pakab'ua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mema nia sèmi lii pakab'ua. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a taruu, ded'e padedha kolongara si, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
target_text: b'ae pama'ète kèlu èu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka baku mamuri ètu d'ara kèlu-g'ètu. te èdhi pakèlu dhoka ètu ca madha j'ara di, nuka pasue. ladhe miu sue dhèu, miu tao le madhutu atora-atora nèti lamatua.

source_text: the commandments do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not covet, and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: love your neighbor as yourself.
target_text: te atora sèra peka na, baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali mu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku d'èi leli neo unu mèdha-panyau dhèu, aa dhu leo hari. ladhe neo madhutu aa'i atora se'e, hud'i tao madhutu ku atora èci ne'e, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu.

source_text: love does no wrong to its neighbor. therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu leo, èdhi tao boe bhelu mi nèngu, si? de ladhe èdhi loe boe pad'elo sasue èdhi, èdhi bisa tao madhutu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: and do this, understanding the occasion. the hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
target_text: ama lamatua neo patabuli èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha. aa limuri ne, lod'o sèna ka dhèu abhu mamuri nèti lamatua dètu ae le, ladhe èdhi pasoro dènge lod'o dhu èdhi heka parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i mamuri pasue, lula èdhi te'a le madha j'ara ne'e. nuka sèmi uru èèna, èdhi dhu bhèj'i era. te ngaa limuri ne d'ai le lod'o na, ho èdhi kèd'i ka nèti bhabhèj'i èdhi!

source_text: the night is nearly over; the day has drawn near. so let us lay aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
target_text: nèbhu boe, te mèda oe èle kèna, aa lod'o rea kèna. de be'a risi èdhi ae eele ka nèti bhabhelu-katub'a èdhi. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhabhelu, te rèngu pangee, na, abhu boe dhu ladhe rèdhi tatao rèngu sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i j'aj'i ku sama sèmi sordad'u dhu bori mema mèdha-papake pamusu, ho pa'èra ngi'u sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.
target_text: èdhi hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi, na, èdhi dhu tao j'ara be'a. be'a boe ladhe èdhi mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara tao pesta, dènge tinu mahu di. be'a boe ladhe èdhi tao j'ara makae. be'a boe ladhe bau lii langu g'ana-kariu. aa be'a boe ladhe èdhi tèka d'ara, lula èdhi d'èi boe dhèu risi èdhi.

source_text: instead, clothe yourselves with the lord jesus christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi ka, miu ub'a d'ara miu, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai. aa ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue j'ara dhu lèke boe, na, taha d'ara mu! mage soro tèke ho madhutu dad'èi mu dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on his opinions.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa parcaya na èra mèka, aa j'ara ae ka dhu ne'a mèka. pakabhèle ai èu ho sèmi more ne dènge d'ara kateme. baku sisu ngaa dhu na peka-padhai. hud'i laa nèngu pa'angalai dènge miu.

source_text: for one person has faith to eat all things, while another, who is weak, eats only vegetables.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu pangee na, dhèu sarani bisa ra'a ngaa sa, nuka sèmi sisi, do ngaa èèna ka. te ngaa abhu dhèu sarani leo, dhu parcaya ra èra mèka, dhu ra'a dhoka sayur di. te ra luri sisi.

source_text: the one who eats everything must not belittle the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for god has accepted him.
target_text: te ngaa nanene, ee! dhèu sarani dhu bisa ra'a ngaa èèna ka, baku pahahe dhèu dhu neo boe ra'a sisi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sarani dhu neo boe ra'a sisi, baku peka dènge dhèu dhu bisa ra'a sisi, na, weh! mu'a sisi, sala! lula ama lamatua sèmi nare le dua ra ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na!

source_text: who are you to judge someone else's servant? to his own master he stands or falls. and he will stand, for the lord is able to make him stand.
target_text: ladhe èu me'a dhoka karitik a'ari mu dhèu parcaya sèra, te èu ngee na, èu ne cee? èu dènge hak ngaa, ho pèci sasala mi dhèu leo? dhèu ne ènu èu boe, si! aa èu ne, lamatua boe nèngu, si. te dhodhoka lamatua nèngu di dhu unu hak, sèna ka peka paled'a, tatao na èèna lèke, do sala. te ngaa baku bhèlu, bèli-camèd'a lamatua na sèmi nare dhèu ne'e dènge be'a, lula lamatua na bisa pa'èra ne, sèna ka na bisa titu èra.

source_text: one person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pama'ète rare, peka na, lod'o èci be'a risi nèti lod'o leo. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu peka na, lod'o aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, lod'o èci sa risi boe nèti lod'o leo. dhèu èci-èci ka pama'ète unu na j'ara ne'e.

source_text: he who observes a special day does so to the lord; he who eats does so to the lord, for he gives thanks to god; and he who abstains does so to the lord and gives thanks to god.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pangee, na, abhu lod'o dhu be'a risi nèti lod'o leo, nèngu tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhèu dhu na'a sisi dènge nganga'a dhu leo, bisa na'a ho pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu na'a boe sisi. nèngu neo pakab'ua kahèi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèngu manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for none of us lives to himself alone, and none of us dies to himself alone.
target_text: lod'o èdhi mamuri, èdhi mamuri boe dhoka hia ngi'u èdhi mesa ti. aa ladhe èdhi madhe, madhe boe dhoka pala ngi'u mesa ti.

source_text: if we live, we live to the lord, and if we die, we die to the lord. so whether we live or die, we belong to the lord.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri era, èdhi pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi madhe, èdhi pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de masi ka èdhi mamuri, do madhe, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na era.

source_text: for this reason christ died and returned to life, that he might be the lord of both the dead and the living.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus madhe, hèia mamuri hari. na tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa j'aj'i kètu bagi mi dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era kahèi.

source_text: why, then, do you judge your brother? or why do you belittle your brother? for we will all stand before god's judgment seat.
target_text: de, nga tao ka èu ded'e iisi mu, tao sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu, ho karitik leli lii padhai a'ari mu dhèu sarani? nga tao ka èu pahahe ne? te bèli-camèd'a èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti hud'i lati asa madha ama lamatua, ho na parisa mamuri èdhi èci-èci.

source_text: it is written: as surely as i live, says the lord, every knee will bow before me; every tongue will confess to god.
target_text: abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ama èdhi mesa na dhu peka, na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pe patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ja'a, dènge pakab'ua ja'a. bèli-camèd'a, nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu èci-èci, ra mangaku, na, ja'a j'aj'i kètu rèngu, lula ja'a ne, ama lamatua. '

source_text: so then, each of us will give an account of himself to god.
target_text: de èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, bèli-camèd'a hud'i dhaa ètu madha lamatua, ho peka na, èdhi tao tasamia, aa nga tao ka èdhi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: therefore let us stop judging one another. instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother's way.
target_text: uru èèna, miu ètu roma pèci sasala taruu mi a'ari miu dhèu sarani sèra. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! be'a risi èdhi pama'ète sèmi ne'e: èdhi baku tao sèna ka a'ari èdhi kadhunu. èdhi baku tenge j'ara ho sii pamanahu si, sèna ka ra tao sasala.

source_text: i am convinced and fully persuaded in the lord jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. but if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ja'a ke'a mèu, sèmi ne'e: abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu bisa pakaj'alu dhèu, toke na bisa boe sabaj'a mi lamatua. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu èci dhu pangee, na, mèdha èci tao ne kaj'alu, toke nèngu ngee na, bisa heka dènge hak sèna ka sabaj'a, na, hud'i laa mèdha ne j'aj'i mèdha luri hia nèngu.

source_text: if your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. do not by your eating destroy your brother, for whom christ died.
target_text: conto sèmi èu mu'a sisi, aa papèd'a d'ara a'ari mu, na, èu pad'elo boe sasue èu mi nèngu, si? ladhe sèmi èèna, baku mu'a! baku pa'ele iie a'ari mu, lula èu neo mu'a nganga'a èci! te kristus madhe pala mi dhèu ne'e kahèi.

source_text: do not allow what you consider good, then, to be spoken of as evil.
target_text: be'a boe ladhe èu ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu a'abhu èu, be'a, te ngaa dhèu leo padhai kakoli kolongara èu, lula ra pangee na, tatao èu deo na, karehe.

source_text: for the kingdom of god is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the holy spirit.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! te ama lamatua ka, dhèu aae èdhi. te ngaa èdhi j'aj'i boe dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, lula èdhi ta'a-tinu madhutu dhoka atora di. aad'o! ladhe èdhi neo j'aj'i dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, èdhi hud'i tao dhu lèke, d'ara mola-mèci, mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, aa d'ara dhu karej'e-karae. aa'i-aa'i se bisa j'aj'i, ladhe èdhi pa'èki taruu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for whoever serves christ in this way is pleasing to god and approved by men.
target_text: dhèu dhu lalau-lalo'o hia kristus sèmi èèna, pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. aa dhèu leo lee kahèi mamuri dhèu ne'e, hèia padedha kolongara dhèu ne'e, peka na, nèngu ne, be'a!

source_text: so then, let us pursue what leads to peace and to mutual edification.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i pa'èra ètu d'ara mamuri padame, aa maj'èni pa'èra èci dènge èci.

source_text: do not destroy the work of god for the sake of food. all food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to let his eating be a stumbling block.
target_text: baku pa'ele iie sasab'a lamatua ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo, lula dhoka nèti j'ara ta'a-tinu di. lamatua dhu peka le, èdhi bisa ta'a ngaa èèna ka, te aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa ladhe èu patao-palaha dènge a'ari mu lula j'ara nganga'a-nganginu di, èu sala le. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: it is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything to cause your brother to stumble.
target_text: hua iia taha iisi mu. mu'a ia ka sisi, do minu ia ka èi anggor, do baku mu'a-minu ngaa dhu leo, dhu tao a'ari mu kadhunu.

source_text: keep your belief about such matters between yourself and god. blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe èu more lii èci dènge lamatua, hèia èu pama'ète, na, èu neo parcaya ne lula-nèti nganga'a-nganginu, na, èu oto aa dènge heka lii langu. pangee ia ka ngaa-ngaa dhu peka na, èu tao sala, do aad'o. te èu dhu pama'ète more le sèmi èèna.

source_text: but the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe d'ara èu kajari, ka mu'a mèdha èci dhu èu ngee na pakaj'alu èu, lamatua pasala èu, lula èu madhutu boe ngaa dhu èu parcaya lod'o dhu èu mu'a. te ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue ngaa sa èci, te ngaa èu parcaya, peka na, èèna lèke boe ètu madha lamatua, na, èèna èu sala le.

source_text: we who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
target_text: èdhi dhu parcaya èra, hud'i dènge d'ara maho'o ho bara dhèu dhu parcaya èra mèka, sèna ka rèngu taha ètu d'ara sasusa. be'a boe, ladhe èdhi dhoka pakarej'e ngi'u èdhi mesa ti.

source_text: each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a hud'i sèmi ne'e ku: èdhi èci-èci ka tenge j'ara, sèna ka tao dhu be'a hia a'ari èdhi dhèu sarani, ho parcaya ra asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa karej'e dènge èdhi.

source_text: for even christ did not please himself, but as it is written: the insults of those who insult you have fallen on me.
target_text: te yesus kristus mesa na, pakako boe sasab'a na ho pakarej'e d'ara nèngu unu na, te ngaa na neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua kahèi. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua lula-nèti ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dedha yesus, dhu peka na, lii pa-aape rèngu hia mi èu, noto mi dedha ja'a kahèi.

source_text: for everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the scriptures, we might have hope.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna dhèu suri ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, sèna ka nori èdhi. nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka asa pa'èra èdhi, taha pa'èra-èra, aa lii holo-nori na pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, èdhi bisa taha ètu d'ara tatae neo tèdhi lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: now may the god who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in christ jesus,
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia dhèu a'èra, sèna ka ra bisa taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi lamatua pad'elo j'ara, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci madhutu dad'èi yesus kristus.

source_text: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the god and father of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: te ladhe miu mamuri d'ara èci, miu bisa sama-sama koa-kio ama lamatua. nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: accept one another, then, just as christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to god.
target_text: de miu isi-aanga mi hud'i sèmi mere èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sèmi nare le miu. te ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, pe dhèu ae j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: for i tell you that christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of god's truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka hia dhèu yahudi re'a mèu, peka na, ama lamatua padhai lii lèke mola-mola. aa kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha kahèi, ho pamèci aa'i mèu ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha neo tao, hia mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: so that the gentiles may glorify god for his mercy. as it is written: therefore i will praise you among the gentiles; i will sing hymns to your name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu re'a, na, nèngu dhu rasa kasia mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. sèra nuka sèmi dhu daud suri uru èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, mi suku dhu leo sèra. ja'a neo sod'a lii koa-kio kolongara èu ètu katanga madha udhu rasa dhu leo sèra.

source_text: again, it says: rejoice, o gentiles, with his people.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, na, we! miu dhèu leo rai kara dhu nèti rai leo. tao d'ara miu karej'e kea rae-rae, palere-lere dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and again: praise the lord, all you gentiles, and extol him, all you peoples.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, daud suri, peka na, miu dhu nèti suku leo sèra. lami peka palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti dadedha lamatua, sèna ka rèngu koa-kio kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: and once more, isaiah says: the root of jesse will appear, one who will arise to rule over the gentiles; in him the gentiles will put their hope.
target_text: ètu era leo hari, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, yesaya suri, peka na, nèti dhèu aae daud, ana isai, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai ana-èpu na ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha mi suku leo sèra. rèngu dhu re'a le, naneo mamai nèngu èèna. hèia rèngu mate tatae ne, te rèngu re'a mèu, na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: now may the god of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the holy spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi sanao-maena. ladhe miu parcaya ne, nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara miu aa pamau d'ara miu. hud'i laa sèna ka koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, tao miu asa me'a mèu lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao.

source_text: i myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, brimming with knowledge, and able to instruct one another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, d'ara miu pènu dènge madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu be'a, j'ara ae-ae dhu miu me'a mèu le, aa me'a holo èci dènge èci.

source_text: however, i have written you a bold reminder on some points, because of the grace god has given me
target_text: ja'a suri paled'a-led'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ho pasanèd'e miu catèka hari nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara. ja'a suri sèmi ne'e, lula lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a,

source_text: to be a minister of christ jesus to the gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of god, so that the gentiles might become an offering acceptable to god, sanctified by the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèngu asa dhèu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a pakako sasab'a ja'a èèna, nuka sèmi ama agama èci dhu neo pa'èra dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i mi persembahan èci dhu pamaho'o d'ara lamatua. te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu tao si j'aj'i mola-mèci, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare si.

source_text: therefore i exult in christ jesus in my service to god.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa boti kètu ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: i will not presume to speak of anything except what christ has accomplished through me in leading the gentiles to obedience by word and deed,
target_text: ja'a bani boe padhai lii j'ara leo. ja'a dhoka lole tatao dhu kristus ad'u-ue, aa dènge j'ara sèmi ngaa na pake ja'a. limuri ne, abhu dhèu yahudi boe dhu madhutu kristus, lula lamatua pake ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara pake lii padhai dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the spirit of god. so from jerusalem all the way around to illyricum, i have fully proclaimed the gospel of christ.
target_text: kristus pangèd'u le mi ja'a koasa nèti roh lamatua, sèna ka bisa tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na pangèd'u koasa èèna mi ja'a, sèna ka neo pad'elo, peka na, kristus ne cee. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a peka-padhai le aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti lii lolo be'a kristus dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a lole nèti kota yerusalem, pale-lème toke d'ai rai ilirikum dètu dènge italia.

source_text: in this way i have aspired to preach the gospel where christ was not known, so that i would not be building on someone else's foundation.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a dhu pangee, na, ja'a d'èi titu kèna lole lula-nèti kristus mi dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lii lolo be'a na! te ja'a d'èi boe aj'a-nori ètu era dhu dhèu leo aj'a le.

source_text: rather, as it is written: those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, suku dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ne. dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa, rèngu sèra ka dhu pe re'a mèu lula nèngu.

source_text: that is why i have often been hindered from coming to you.
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a ae sèmi èèna, ka lake kore mèka dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu.

source_text: but now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions, and since i have longed for many years to visit you,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, sasab'a ja'a ètu ne'e èla aa'i le. aa ja'a nelu nèbhu ae le pèri-pèri tèu kèna, dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: i hope to see you on my way to spain. and after i have enjoyed your company for a while, you can equip me for my journey.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a laku asa spanyol, ja'a neo dhuli miu. aa ladhe ja'a dhuli taha ètu era miu, miu bisa ogo ja'a kahèi laku asa spanyol.

source_text: now, however, i am on my way to jerusalem to serve the saints there.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo laku uru asa yerusalem, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: for macedonia and achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in jerusalem.
target_text: te a'ari èdhi ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya, hia le doi kolete, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa dhu parcaya lamatua ètu yerusalem.

source_text: they were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. for if the gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
target_text: rèngu neo tao sèmi ne'e, lula ra pangee, na, rèngu oe sèmi pakèlu sa, mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem. te dhèu-dhèu nèti suku leo ètu mia-mia, rèngu abhu le j'ara hua iia kahèi dhu uru èèna roh lamatua hia le mi dhèu yahudi sèra. de lèke mola-mola ladhe dhèu sarani dhu dhèu yahudi boe, pake mèdha-panyau ra ho soru-bara a'ari ra dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: so after i have completed this service and have safely delivered this bounty to them, i will set off to spain by way of you.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pabagi kore ka doi se'e mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem, ja'a neo dhuli pangad'o dènge miu, ropa laku asa spanyol.

source_text: i know that when i come to you, i will come in the fullness of the blessing of christ.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu, kèti dènge mèngi-nale ae-ae nèti kristus.

source_text: now i urge you, brothers, by our lord jesus christ and by the love of the spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to god for me.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lula yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, aa lula roh lamatua ka tao miu pasue èci dènge èci, nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi ho miu sabaj'a patare'a-re'a, sèna ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: pray that i may be delivered from the unbelievers in judea, and that my service in jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,
target_text: manèngi sèna ka lamatua bhiri-sarobho ja'a ètu propensi yudea, ho dhèu dhu ro'o boe parcaya lamatua baku tao bhelu mi dedha ja'a. aa manèngi ho ladhe ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani ètu yerusalem, rèngu sèmi rare ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: so that by god's will i may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed.
target_text: èle èèna, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, ja'a bisa dhiu asa miu dènge d'ara karej'e, lula ja'a neo ae kore ciki dènge miu.

source_text: the god of peace be with all of you. amen.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu. te nèngu ka dhu bisa tao ho dhèu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. lèke tare'a!

source_text: i commend to you our sister phoebe, a servant of the church in cenchrea.
target_text: dènge sasuri ne'e, ja'a neo patadha miu dènge ana hèni èdhi febe, aa manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne. nèngu ka dhu ra ded'e ho ladhe-leru juma'at ètu kota kengkrea.

source_text: welcome her in the lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her with anything she may need from you. for she has been a great help to many people, including me.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a. tao dhu pantas mi nèngu, nuka sèmi hia dhèu sarani sèra, lula nèngu ne pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ladhe na parluu ngaa, soru-bara ne. te nèngu biasa soru-bara le ja'a dènge dhèu ae-ae, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: greet prisca and aquila, my fellow workers in christ jesus,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, priskila dènge dhèu èmu na, akila. ji'i ka dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ae-ae nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: who have risked their lives for me. not only i but all the churches of the gentiles are grateful to them.
target_text: dua ra oe madhe sad'i neo pamamuri ja'a. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di dhu manèngi makasi mi dua ra. te dhèu yahudi boe dhu j'aj'i le dhèu sarani, nèti juma'at aa'i-aa'i buli mia-mia, manèngi makasi kahèi, lula tatao ra dhu be'a.

source_text: greet also the church that meets at their house. greet my beloved epenetus, who was the first convert to christ in the province of asia.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara èmu priskila dènge akila. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi angalai ja'a, epenetus. nèngu ka, dhèu uru tèka parcaya kristus ètu propensi asia.

source_text: greet mary, who has worked very hard for you.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, maria. nèngu dhu sab'a ne'a boe j'èra ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: greet andronicus and junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. they are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in christ before i was.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi andronikus dènge ana hèni èdhi, yunia. dua ra dhèu yahudi, sama sèmi ja'a kahèi. dua ra parcaya uuru kristus nèti ja'a. uru èèna, rèngu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho. dua ra j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, aa dhèu ae tadhe si.

source_text: greet ampliatus, my beloved in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ampliatus. ja'a sue ne, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: greet urbanus, our fellow worker in christ, and my beloved stachys.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi urbanus. nèngu kahèi pakako sasab'a kristus sama-sama dènge èdhi. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi stakis, dhu ja'a sue.

source_text: greet apelles, who is approved in christ. greet those who belong to the household of aristobulus.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi apeles. masi ka nèngu lèke dadugu-rariu, te ngaa na segi ka nare li'u, lula lèka èra kristus. hia lii maho'o mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i nèti aristobulus.

source_text: greet herodion, my fellow countryman. greet those from the household of narcissus who are in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi a'a herodion. nèngu dhèu yahudi kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi isi èmu narkisus dhu parcaya kristus.

source_text: greet tryphena and tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the lord. greet my beloved persis, who has worked very hard in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi ana hèni èdhi, trifena dènge trifosa. rèngu pakako kahèi sasab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. hia lii maho'o mi angalai ja'a, ana hèni èdhi, persis. te nèngu kahèi sab'a bia hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: greet rufus, chosen in the lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi rufus. kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu hag'e nare ne. hia lii maho'o mi ina na kahèi. te nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ina d'èlu ja'a.

source_text: greet asyncritus, phlegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas, and the brothers with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi asinkritus, flegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas dènge a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet philologus and julia, nereus and his sister, and olympas and all the saints with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi filologus, ana hèni èdhi, yulia, olimpas, nereus dènge ana hèni na, dènge dhèu-dhèu sarani aa'i dhu sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet one another with a holy kiss. all the churches of christ send you greetings.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, mi pa'uu èci dènge èci, dhu pantas mi dhèu parcaya. juma'at kristus aa'i-aa'i ètu se'e, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi.

source_text: now i urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. turn away from them.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mage-mage! j'aga paie-iie, te abhu dhèu dhu tao miu mae-manyèla, aa dhu neo sii pabèbhe miu. ngaa dhu rèngu peka dènge miu sèra, palab'a dènge ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a-nori le miu. de baku pa'angalai dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for such people are not serving our lord christ, but their own appetites. by smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
target_text: dhèu sèra sab'a boe hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rèngu sèra dhoka sab'a ho pa'oto ngi'u rèngu unu ra. dhèu sèra dhoka hèb'a mènyi mi dhèu dhu dhae re'a mèka mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe. rèngu hèb'a mènyi ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu.

source_text: everyone has heard about your obedience, so i rejoice over you. but i want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le, na, miu loe boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna lula miu. dad'èi ja'a ka, ladhe miu d'èlu-mèu ètu j'ara-j'ara be'a, aa baku pakihu kee dènge j'ara-j'ara karehe.

source_text: the god of peace will soon crush satan under your feet. the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu bisa hia èdhi mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ka dhu èèna na palaho koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, aa pad'elo, peka na, miu ka dhu segi. se'e se nèbhu heka j'aj'i. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do lucius, jason, and sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
target_text: ari èdhi, timotius, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ja'a, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi. lukius, yason, dènge sosipater, hia lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a.

source_text: i, tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the lord.
target_text: ja'a ne, tertius, ka dhu suri sasuri ne'e madhutu ngaa dhu paulus pua ja'a suri. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, te ja'a ne dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings. erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother quartus.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, manubha ètu èmu gayus. dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i tema pakaboko ètu èmu na ho manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi. erastus, dhu j'aj'i bendahara kota, dènge a'ari èdhi kuartus, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: now to him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of jesus christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu unu koasa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i èra. lii lolo be'a na peka sèmi èèna ka, aa ja'a aj'a-nori dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi, ropa ja'a peka dènge rèngu lula-nèti yesus kristus. lamatua ka dhu bhoke paled'a hia mi èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus, dhu uru-uru sèra dhèu dhae re'a mèka, lula dhu pahuni era.

source_text: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal god, in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith -
target_text: te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, limuri ne mèu aadha-aadha le. ama lamatua dhu madhe nèdhi boe, nèngu ka ator sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, re'a mèu madha j'ara dhu pahuni uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu sèra bisa parcaya ne, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: to the only wise god be glory forever through jesus christ! amen.
target_text: dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na di, ama lamatua. dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na, dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara. ja'a d'èi j'oka padedha-dedha ne, lula tatao yesus kristus! lèke tare'a! sasuri ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka, saloom, paulus

source_text: paul, called to be an apostle of christ jesus by the will of god, and our brother sosthenes,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua hag'e nare le ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. sostenes hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: to the church of god in corinth, to those sanctified in christ jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our lord jesus christ, their lord and ours:
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu dhèu parcaya ama lamatua ètu kota korintus. na hag'e nare le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci nèngu, lula miu parcaya le yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema le karèi nèti uru ka ho na mai. ama lamatua tao miu mola-mèci kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. te rèngu manèngi le sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus soru-bara si. nèngu ne j'aj'i kètu mi dedha èdhi aa rèngu kahèi.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i always thank my god for you because of the grace he has given you in christ jesus.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a ngee kèdhi miu, ja'a padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, makasi ae-ae lula parcaya dhèu korintus sèra! te lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu, lula miu lèka taruu yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua na mai.

source_text: for in him you have been enriched in every way, in all speech and all knowledge,
target_text: hèia na hia miu a'èra, ka miu bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a aa'i-aa'i, lula miu pa'èki dènge ne. èèna ka dhu tao d'ara miu kaja-su'i dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka miu me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia risi, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri nèngu. miu me'a kahèi j'ara mia dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu lole mi dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: because our testimony about christ was confirmed in you.
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i ne'e ka dhu padelo, na, j'ara-j'ara dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu lula-nèti kristus èèna, dhu amo le ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu me'a tare'a-re'a, na, j'ara sèra lèke.

source_text: therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: de miu abhu le j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia dhèu unu na. kura boe ciki sa. hèia miu tatae lod'o dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua bhoke ho pad'elo kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: kristus èèna ka dhu neo pa'èra miu sèna ka miu taha taruu, toke na mai hari asa rai-haha ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu manahu boe, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala mi dedha miu.

source_text: god, who has called you into fellowship with his son jesus christ our lord, is faithful.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ama lamatua, lula ngaa dhu nèngu peka, èèna ka dhu j'aj'i. tatu nèngu neo tao j'ara se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa tadhe ana na, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus èèna.

source_text: i appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our lord jesus christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ètu d'ara aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a padhai lii pake kolongara kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de ja'a manèngi tare'a-re'a, sèna ka miu loe ka nèti padhèto ètu d'ara lii padhai. te ngaa miu hud'i tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci, aa baku mae-manyèla. miu hud'i pake ngangee madhera, ho me'a, na, miu neo d'ai too-lane dhu èci èèna ka di.

source_text: my brothers, some from chloe's household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.
target_text: te abhu dhèu nèti isi èmu ana hèni èdhi kloe dhu mai peka dènge ja'a, na, ètu talora miu abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: what i mean is this: individuals among you are saying, i follow paul, i follow apollos, i follow cephas, or i follow christ.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a re paulus! aa cahag'e peka na, ja'a re apolos! aa abhu kahèi dhu paka'uu, na, ja'a re petrus! aa dhu leo hari peka na, ja'a ne, nanene dhoka kristus di!

source_text: is christ divided? was paul crucified for you? were you baptized into the name of paul?
target_text: miu pangee tasamia, ee? dhèu unu kristus bisa boe mae-manyèla. do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ka dhu madhe pala miu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? aad'o! do, lod'o ra sarani miu, rèngu pake ngara ja'a, ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, do? bisa boe, si?

source_text: i thank god that i did not baptize any of you except crispus and gaius,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, te lod'o ja'a ètu èèna dènge miu, ja'a sarani boe dhèu ae. dhu ja'a sarani ètu nèi dhoka krispus dènge gayus di.

source_text: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa peka na, ra sarani ja'a pake ngara paulus, ka ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu paulus.

source_text: yes, i also baptized the household of stephanas; beyond that i do not remember if i baptized anyone else.
target_text: ee, ja'a heka sanèd'e kèna. ja'a sarani isi èmu stefanus cahag'e kahèi. te ngaa ja'a sanèd'e heka, abhu dhèu era dhu ja'a sarani, do aad'o.

source_text: for christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with words of wisdom, lest the cross of christ be emptied of its power.
target_text: te kristus pua boe ja'a ho laku sarani dhèu. kapua sasab'a ja'a, nuka peka-padhai dènge j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a lole mi dhèu, nèngu d'èi boe ja'a peka mamèu ja'a, do, pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii sèmi èèna, èèna pakura koasa nèti lii lolo mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: for the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of god.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi peka-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, goa titu kèna. te ngaa dhèu sèmi sèra, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. aa te ngaa, bagi mi èdhi, mamadhe kristus ne, sèna ka pad'elo koasa lamatua ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: for it is written: i will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent i will frustrate.
target_text: j'ara ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na, ama lamatua peka na, ‘madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu re'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pa'ele iie aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua. rupa-rupa mamèu rèngu, bèli-camèd'a ja'a core eele aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu guna boe. '

source_text: where is the wise man? where is the scribe? where is the philosopher of this age? has not god made foolish the wisdom of the world?
target_text: uru èèna, mema lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, tasamia hari? dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra, sèmi ngaa sa? mese agama sèra, j'aj'i sèmi ngaa? aa tuka tao lii langu sèra, tasa mera mia? miu nanene sèku! lamatua tao si nuka sèmi dhèu goa! nèngu bete eele aa'i le mamèu dhu amo ètu d'ara kahadhu dhèu rai-haha ne, aa tao mamèu sèra nuka sèmi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for since in the wisdom of god the world through its wisdom did not know him, god was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe. jews demand signs and greeks search for wisdom,
target_text: mamèu ama lamatua lènge aa'i mèu-mèu. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa j'ara ngangee rèngu mesa ra d'ai mèka ho ra tadhe hua iia ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua pake le mamèu na ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu rai-haha. te uru èèna, lamatua pangee, peka na, masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a sèra goa, te ngaa tasamia èèna ka, hud'i ja'a pua ku dhèu lasi lole dènge ra j'ara dhu lèke nèti ja'a. te lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na ho lasi lole dènge dhèu. na pama'ète nare le neo pake lii moa èèna, sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya ne. nèngu pake j'ara ne, ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, j'ara ama lamatua ne, goa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pusi-pahae boe dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te dhèu yahudi neo manèngi dhoka tadha-tadha malaa di, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. aa dhèu yunani neo nanene dhoka j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu maso asa d'ara kahadhu ra, madhutu ngangee rèngu mesa ra.

source_text: but we preach christ crucified, a stumbling block to jews and foolishness to gentiles,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa èdhi dhu j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua lati peka dènge dhèu, na, lamatua pua le kristus, nuka dhèu dhu nèngu pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, mai asa rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ropa dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo ne'e, rèngu sisu, te madhutu a'abhu ra, dhèu dhu lamatua neo pua mai èèna, bisa boe madhe sèmi èèna. ropa dhèu yunani tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na, lii lolo dhèu goa!

source_text: but to those who are called, both jews and greeks, christ the power of god and the wisdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. rèngu sèra cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, mamadhe kristus dhu pad'elo le mi rèngu, na, koasa ama lamatua dènge boe too-lane, aa mamèu na risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: for the foolishness of god is wiser than man's wisdom, and the weakness of god is stronger than man's strength.
target_text: masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, j'ara lamatua ne unu dhèu goa, te ngaa nèngu mèu risi eele rèngu. aa masi ka ra pangee, na, lamatua dènge boe koasa, te ngaa koasa na dedha risi eele nèti rèngu.

source_text: brothers, consider the time of your calling: not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were powerful; not many were of noble birth.
target_text: a'ari pasue! sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu lii padhai ja'a ne, sanèd'e mamuri miu, lod'o lamatua hag'e nare miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha, ètu talora aae miu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu d'èlu-mèu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu dènge pangaru kapai, aa abhu boe dhèu ae dhu a'ari ra dhu dènge kolongara kapai.

source_text: but god chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; god chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, na, tabhènga ana liku, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu. aa na hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu dhèu rai-haha, dhèu dhu dènge boe koasa, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dènge koasa.

source_text: he chose the lowly and despised things of the world, and the things that are not, to nullify the things that are,
target_text: hèia na hag'e nare dhèu haha dhu dènge boe kolongara, aa dhu biasa dhèu pahaha si. te lamatua neo pake si, sèna ka dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu kapai, j'aj'i sèmi dhèu dènge boe pangaru ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so that no one may boast in his presence.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa tèb'a kakara ètu madha ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu dhèu kapai.

source_text: it is because of him that you are in christ jesus, who has become for us wisdom from god: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu bhoke pataleo j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. lamatua ka pake yesus j'aj'i dhèu dhu pala-bagi mamèu na mi dedha èdhi. yesus èèna ka dhu oti j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua. yesus èèna ka dhu tao èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola dènge mèci. aa nèngu ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: therefore, as it is written: let him who boasts boast in the lord.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, cee ka dhu d'èi pakapai kolongara dhèu, be'a risi pakapai kolongara lamatua èdhi. baku pakapai iisi!

source_text: when i came to you, brothers, i did not come with eloquence or wisdom as i proclaimed to you the testimony about god.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a dhiu asa miu, ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna dhèu rai-haha ne re'a mèka. te ngaa ja'a kèti boe lii sèra ho padedha iisi. aa ja'a padhai boe pake lii dhu carui, sèna ka pad'elo mamèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: for i resolved to know nothing while i was with you except jesus christ and him crucified.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a pad'elo dhoka ca j'ara di, nuka yesus kristus. nèngu ne, dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. te ngaa ropa yesus mai, dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhoka j'ara ne'e di, dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: i came to you in weakness and fear, and with much trembling.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a rasa mamèu ja'a d'ai boe, aa ja'a madha'u ka isi karèbha.

source_text: my message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the spirit's power,
target_text: j'ara lii padhai ja'a, aa ngaa dhu ja'a lole, mud'a di. te ja'a ko'o boe pake lii dhu karisi sèna ka pamako miu. aad'o! te ngaa ropa ja'a peka-padhai, na, lii padhai ja'a j'aj'i led'a, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu ator ja'a, aa koasa na sab'a ètu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: so that your faith would not rest on men's wisdom, but on god's power.
target_text: te ja'a pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe miu parcaya ama lamatua, lula miu nanene lii padhai dhèu d'èlu-mèu di. dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu parcaya lamatua, lula na pad'elo koasa na mi dedha miu.

source_text: among the mature, however, we speak a message of wisdom-but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe ji'i padhai lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya èra le, ji'i aj'a rèngu pake lii padhai dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu. te ngaa dhu re'a mèu èèna, madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, do, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu paredha sèra aj'a limuri ne. te sèra sa, bèli-camèd'a ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: no, we speak of the mysterious and hidden wisdom of god, which he destined for our glory before time began.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i aj'a dhoka j'ara mamèu dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. lula uru-uru sèra, lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, lamatua pahuni j'ara sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu pama'ète le, sèna ka neo bhoke patalele lii pahuni èèna hia èdhi, ho èdhi kahèi abhu pala ètu d'ara kolongara na dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: none of the rulers of this age understood it. for if they had, they would not have crucified the lord of glory.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu paredha limuri ne, re'a mèu iia boe mamèu lamatua. te ladhe re'a tare'a, tatu ra paku pamadhe boe kètu èdhi dhu dedha risi èèna, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: rather, as it is written: no eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what god has prepared for those who love him.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri lula-nèti rahasia lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke, peka na, abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae rèdhi mèka dènge musi madha ra, aa abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae tadèngi rèdhi mèka dènge ro'a dhilu ra, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ngee rèdhi boe. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na lamatua sadia tèke le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: but god has revealed it to us by the spirit. the spirit searches all things, even the deep things of god.
target_text: uru èèna, mema dhèu re'a boe j'ara sèra, te ngaa limuri ne ama lamatua pake roh na ho bhoke paled'a hia èdhi. roh lamatua èèna ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. te nèngu parisa toke lutu d'ara iiki lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for who among men knows the thoughts of man except his own spirit within him? so too, no one knows the thoughts of god except the spirit of god.
target_text: èdhi èci-èci ka dènge roh ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhèu rai-haha, èci-èci ka dènge ngangee aa tatao na. aa abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu ne'a mèu d'ara iiki èdhi, dhoka roh èdhi unu ti dhu ne'a. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a d'ara iiki lamatua. dhoka roh nèngu mesa na ka dhu ne'a mèu.

source_text: we have not received the spirit of the world, but the spirit who is from god, that we may understand what god has freely given us.
target_text: èdhi dhu sèmi tare le roh lamatua, ka nèngu ka dhu ator èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. lula roh lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi tadhe aa'i j'ara dhu be'a, dhu nèngu tao le hia èdhi.

source_text: and this is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom, but in words taught by the spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.
target_text: j'ara sèra ka dhu èdhi tema padhue-padhai. te ji'i lole j'ara-j'ara dhu roh lamatua aj'a-nori ji'i. ka ji'i se aj'a boe pake lii dhu nèti mamèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori pake lii dhu mai nèti roh lamatua mi dhèu dhu tadhe nèngu.

source_text: the natural man does not accept the things that come from the spirit of god. for they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe roh lamatua, ropa na nanene lii padhai ji'i, nèngu d'èi boe sèmi. lula nèngu ngee, na, ngaa kèna? maso boe d'ara kahadhu! aa te ngaa, masi ka tasamia èèna ka, dhèu ne bisa boe ne'a j'ara sèra, te nèngu dhu mamuri pa'èki boe dènge roh lamatua.

source_text: the spiritual man judges all things, but he himself is not subject to anyone's judgment.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, heka re'a j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. te ngaa dhèu leo pajiko rare boe ngangee dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for who has known the mind of the lord, so as to instruct him? but we have the mind of christ.
target_text: bisa tasamia? te abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na: cee ka dhu bisa re'a ngangee ama lamatua? do, cee ka dhu bisa ator lamatua, ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii holo-nori dhèu èèna? abhu boe ca dhèu sa! madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi te'a j'ara se'e, lula kristus ka dhu soru-bara sèna ka èdhi bisa pangee madhutu ngangee nèngu.

source_text: brothers, i could not address you as spiritual, but as worldly-as infants in christ.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ja'a ètu èèna era, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dhae pa'èki èra mèka dènge roh lamatua. lula miu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu dhoo-dhoo di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha dhu leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe padhai lii dènge miu, nuka sèmi padhai lii dènge dhèu ee'a, te miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa.

source_text: i gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for solid food. in fact, you are still not ready,
target_text: ja'a hud'i aj'a miu j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe, lula miu bisa mèka sèmi mere j'ara dhu carui, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu bisa mèka ra'a sisi. miu hud'i kadhii ku, sama sèmi dhèu ee'a dhu tema ra'a sisi. te ngaa limuri ne, miu nuka sèmi ana rara iisi hiu era, dhu me'a dhoka minu susu di.

source_text: for you are still worldly. for since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? are you not walking in the way of man?
target_text: lula ngangee miu cakaraa dhèu dhu neo dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu risi nèti miu, miu tèka d'ara aa patao-palaha leli! nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka na, miu me'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi miu dhoo-dhoo. de sèmi èèna na, miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for when one of you says, i follow paul, and another, i follow apollos, are you not mere men?
target_text: lula miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a ne, re paulus! aa cahag'e dhu peka na, ja'a ne, re apolos! lod'o-lod'o miu padhai lii sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo, na, miu èci èèna ka dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: what then is apollos? and what is paul? they are servants through whom you believed, as the lord has assigned to each his role.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, apolos èèna, cee? aa ja'a, paulus ne, cee? te ji'i dua mi se, dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i dhoka pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus. apolos pakako sasab'a madhutu paredha kètu èdhi. aa ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: i planted the seed and apollos watered it, but god made it grow.
target_text: ja'a ka dhu uru tèka lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu sèle hini. hèia apolos mai aj'a-nori miu. èèna nuka sèmi nèngu ka dhu bui-tatee hini dhu ja'a sèle kore sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao hini sèra muri j'aj'i kapai aae.

source_text: so neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only god, who makes things grow.
target_text: de dhèu dhu sèle hini sèra dènge boe kab'ua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu bui. dhodhoka èci di dhu dènge kab'ua, nuka ama lamatua. lula nèngu ka tao hini sèra muri, ka sub'u dènge sega.

source_text: he who plants and he who waters are one in purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèle, aa dhèu dhu bui-tatee, sab'a sama-sama, te sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakako sasab'a lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na b'ae rui-j'aj'èra ra.

source_text: for we are god's fellow workers; you are god's field, god's building.
target_text: te ji'i sama-sama dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. aa miu nuka sèmi oka lamatua, dhu nèngu neo uri. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu ama lamatua patitu.

source_text: by the grace god has given me, i laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. but each one must be careful how he builds.
target_text: de lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèti èèna ka ja'a sama sèmi dholu. ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a ho ke'a mèu j'ara-j'ara nèti kapua, sèna ka ja'a tao era padhèdi dhu èra ètu d'ara mamuri miu. hèia dhèu leo aj'a-nori miu kahèi, ho rèngu patitu mi era padhèdi dhu ja'a tao kore èèna. te ngaa tuka èci-èci hud'i sab'a ku dènge d'ara kateme, ho rèngu patitu èmu dhu èra.

source_text: for no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is jesus christ.
target_text: era padhèdi dhu èra èèna, abhu le. nuka yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo bisa boe tao era padhèdi leo ètu d'ara miu, te lamatua dhu tao tèke le era padhèdi dhu lèke.

source_text: if anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
target_text: tatu abhu dhèu dhu neo patitu kahèi ètu era padhèdi èèna pake rupa-rupa nèu. abhu dhu neo pake nèu dhu kab'ua, sèmi hualaa, doi pudhi do hadhu kale'e. abhu dhu pake nèu biasa, nuka sèmi aj'u, j'u'u do rèu hidhu.

source_text: his workmanship will be evident, because the day will bring it to light. it will be revealed with fire, and the fire will prove the quality of each man's work.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a tuka èci-èci ka bisa te'a, aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a sasab'a rèngu èèna, be'a do aad'o. te lod'o èle rai-haha, lamatua neo sèku ne, sama sèmi na pake ai ho pad'elo, na, sasab'a dhèu sèra, bisa taha do aad'o.

source_text: if what he has built survives, he will receive a reward.
target_text: ladhe uji nare sasab'a nèti ca dhèu pake ai, aa nèu dhu na pake bisa taha, bèli-camèd'a lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra na ètu sorga.

source_text: if it is burned up, he will suffer loss. he himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe uji nare sasab'a dhèu pake ai, aa ai na'e aa'i nèu dhu nèngu pake patitu ètu era padhèdi èèna, na, lamatua hia boe dhèu ne ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa tuka ne abhu mamuri era, masi ka sèmi dhèu dhu rai kalua nèti d'ara èmu ai na'e.

source_text: do you not know that you yourselves are god's temple, and that god's spirit dwells in you?
target_text: miu hud'i me'a ku, dhu peka na, miu sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a lamatua, aa roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara.

source_text: if anyone destroys god's temple, god will destroy him; for god's temple is holy, and you are that temple.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie èmu sabaj'a lamatua, nuka era pea na, na mage-mage! bèli-camèd'a lamatua pa'ele iie ne kahèi! te èmu sabaj'a lamatua èèna mola-mèci. de miu hud'i mola-mèci ku kahèi.

source_text: let no one deceive himself. if any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
target_text: miu baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi! ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu aa ne'a aa'i madhutu mamèu dhèu ètu rai-haha lod'o limuri ne, èèna peka na, nèngu ne'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa. ladhe èu mase'a le, peka na, èu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa, heka èu mulai me'a kèna.

source_text: for the wisdom of this world is foolishness in god's sight. as it is written: he catches the wise in their craftiness.
target_text: ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ama lamatua peka na, goa. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke, peka na: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa èèna na lamatua pake hari ngangee na dhu karehe sèra, j'aj'i mi sasii, ho sii pa'ele iie hari nèngu!

source_text: and again, the lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.
target_text: ètu era leo dhu suri kahèi, peka na, lamatua èdhi dhu ne'a le ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra pangee, aa dhèu dhu hud'i re'a ku neo tao ne tasa mere mia, nèngu dhu ne'a nare le, na, rèngu dhoka ngee iia d'ara di.

source_text: therefore, stop boasting in men. all things are yours, whether paul or apollos or cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future. all of them belong to you,
target_text: de miu baku padedha dhèu èci sa, dhu peka na, nèngu èèna lènge aa'i dhèu. te lamatua ka dhu ded'e dhèu, ho ator miu. aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu miu. de dhèu dhu ator miu sèra, sama sèmi: ja'a, apolos, dènge petrus, ji'i se j'aj'i unu miu. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne unu miu kahèi, masi ka miu mamuri do miu madhe, masi ka deo ne'e do lod'o dhu mai, aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu miu kateme aae.

source_text: and you belong to christ, and christ belongs to god.
target_text: aa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. aa kristus unu ama lamatua!

source_text: so then, men ought to regard us as servants of christ and stewards of the mysteries of god.
target_text: de miu baku koa-kad'iri ji'i, te ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha kristus di. aa ama lamatua lèka ji'i, sèna ka j'aga paie-iie j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke.

source_text: now it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhenga mèdha-panyau lamatua na, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: i care very little, however, if i am judged by you or by any human court. in fact, i do not even judge myself.
target_text: tasamia dènge ja'a? ja'a sab'e madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, do aad'o? ja'a ko'o boe ke'a, miu nile ja'a tasa mera mia. aa ja'a pusi-pahae boe kahèi dhèu leo nile ja'a sèmi ngaa sa. ja'a ke'a boe nile ngi'u ja'a unu ku kahèi.

source_text: my conscience is clear, but that does not vindicate me. it is the lord who judges me.
target_text: te masi ka d'ara iiki ja'a peka na, ja'a be'a le, tatu boe sasoa na, ja'a be'a. dhu mèci ka, lamatua ka dhu nile ja'a tasa mera mia.

source_text: therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the lord comes. he will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men's hearts. at that time each will receive his praise from god.
target_text: de miu baku tao ngi'u sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu ho nile dhèu leo sèra. mate mamai hari lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu. nèngu ka pasabhoka aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao pahuni ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu neo bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu ngee ètu d'ara ra. hèia ama lamatua neo peka aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu tao le.

source_text: brothers, i have applied these things to myself and apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us not to go beyond what is written. then you will not take pride in one man over another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a dènge apolos, nuka sèmi ja'a j'aj'i mi conto ho miu bisa aj'a nèti ji'i, nuka: tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua. baku tao dhu leo. ladhe miu madhutu ka j'ara se'e, miu baku bia re èci sa, aa padedha iisi lula madhutu ca dhèu, aa pahahe dhèu leo.

source_text: for who makes you so superior? what do you have that you did not receive? and if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, miu risi nèti dhèu leo, do? baku! te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu unu, miu abhu nèti ama lamatua. de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu nged'e ej'a ai, nuka sèmi miu ad'u-ue unu mi?

source_text: already you have all you want. already you have become rich. without us, you have become kings. how i wish you really were kings, so that we might be kings with you!
