target_text: nuka sèmi aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu, miu abhu le. nuka sèmi miu kaja le! miu tao ngi'u mi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu kapai sama sèmi dhèu aae sa, aa ji'i soru-bara boe ciki sa. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua ka dhu hia aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu. te ngaa ladhe miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu aae, ele boe ji'i ngèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge miu, si?

source_text: for it seems to me that god has displayed us apostles at the end of the procession, like prisoners appointed for death. we have become a spectacle to the whole world, to angels as well as to men.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha ji'i, ho la'a asa mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka lole dènge dhèu j'ara-j'ara kristus. te ngaa ca tèka-ca tèka sa ja'a pangee, na, lamatua pua ji'i titu re limuri tèka, sama sèmi ana bèdho dhu tatae abhu huku madhe. hèia na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga mai laladhe ji'i.

source_text: we are fools for christ, but you are wise in christ. we are weak, but you are strong. you are honored, but we are dishonored.
target_text: miu kapai titu kèna, nga! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, miu d'èlu-mèu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus. te ngaa rèngu pangee, na, ji'i goa titu kèna, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. ele boe rèngu ngee, na, miu èra risi, aa ji'i se roe aala-aala. ele boe ra ded'e miu padedha-dedha, te ngaa ro'o boe pusi-pahae ji'i ciki sa hèi. seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: to this very hour we are hungry and thirsty, we are poorly clothed, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.
target_text: toke d'ai deo ne'e, ji'i manganga dènge koko-kamango. mèdha-papake ji'i kaha'i-kaheru. dhèu loe boe game ji'i. ji'i nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era pea.

source_text: we work hard with our own hands. when we are vilified, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
target_text: ji'i sab'a dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi toke d'ai èi kabhèsu hae. ladhe dhèu padhai-kakoli ji'i, ji'i dhoka b'ala, peka na, ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia miu. ladhe dhèu paj'èra ji'i, na, ji'i b'ala boe, dhoka mau-mau di.

source_text: when we are slandered, we answer gently. up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i, ji'i dhoka dhaa dènge rèhu mare di. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ji'i se nuka sèmi kaj'alu do mamumu dhu core eele.

source_text: i am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you as my beloved children.
target_text: ja'a suri j'ara se'e, neo boe pamakae miu. te ngaa ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, lula ja'a sue miu nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a sa. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho lèpa asa j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: even if you have ten thousand guardians in christ, you do not have many fathers; for in christ jesus i became your father through the gospel.
target_text: masi ka dhèu riho-riho dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara hia miu lula-nèti kristus, te ngaa dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu j'aj'i ama miu. te ja'a ka dhèu uru j'ara dhu peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu parcaya ne. ja'a tao j'ara èèna, lula ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne.

source_text: therefore i urge you to imitate me.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka miu madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a ne.

source_text: that is why i have sent you timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the lord. he will remind you of my way of life in christ jesus, which is exactly what i teach everywhere in every church.
target_text: nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu soru-bara miu. ja'a sue ne, sama sèmi ana matana ja'a. ja'a lèka ne, te nèngu kahèi mamuri pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. èèna na nèngu soru-bara miu ho pasanèd'e miu nèti mamuri ja'a. j'ara mamuri ja'a sèmi èèna, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. èèna ka dhu ja'a aj'a-nori dènge dhèu sarani dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: some of you have become arrogant, as if i were not coming to you.
target_text: abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ja'a lake kore boe dhiu dènge miu. nèti èèna ka rèngu nged'e titu kèna.

source_text: but i will come to you shortly, if the lord is willing, and then i will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying, but what power they have.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua èdhi d'èi, nèbhu boe ja'a d'ai kota korintus. ho èèna na ja'a ke'a mèu, na, dhèu sèra padhai lii padedha iisi, do, rèngu tare'a dènge koasa!

source_text: for the kingdom of god is not a matter of talk but of power.
target_text: te ama lamatua èèna dhèu aae dhu unu koasa. ka dhèu nèngu hèb'a mènyi boe, ho pa'èra dhèu ètu d'ara lalèka ra, te ngaa rèngu pake koasa dhu lèke.

source_text: which do you prefer? shall i come to you with a rod, or in love and with a gentle spirit?
target_text: de dad'èi miu tasamia? ladhe ja'a dhiu, na, ja'a tao lii sakaa aa huku miu? do, ja'a dhiu pad'elo sasue dènge d'ara be'a?

source_text: it is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: a man has his father's wife.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, ca dhèu nèti juma'at miu dhu ad'u j'ara karehe dènge dhèu bhèni. ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue ne bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula nèngu j'unu pa'èci dènge ina bhala na!

source_text: and you are proud! shouldn't you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this?
target_text: te ngaa miu pamone-pabhèni, sèmi juma'at miu mola-mèci le! te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, miu hud'i makae ku, aa d'ara pèd'a. dhèu sèmi èèna, babège eele ne pakaj'èu!

source_text: although i am absent from you in body, i am present with you in spirit, and i have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if i were present.
target_text: masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu èci dènge èci, te ngaa d'ara ja'a dhoka ètu miu di. de ja'a pama'ète kore le lii langu dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae èèna, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu ètu èèna le.

source_text: when you are assembled in the name of our lord jesus and i am with you in spirit, along with the power of the lord jesus,
target_text: ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète sèmi èèna, lula yesus j'aj'i kètu èdhi, aa ja'a dhèu pajuu-paleha na. de miu hud'i madhèdi pa'èci ku ho pama'ète lii langu èèna pake kolongara kètu èdhi. aa d'ara ja'a sama-sama dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: hand this man over to satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the day of the lord.
target_text: hèia miu hud'i saraka dhèu ne asa dhèu aae nidhu, sèna ka nèbhu-nèbhu na core eele j'ara bhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara na. sèna ka ladhe kètu èdhi mai hari, na, nèngu patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na.

source_text: your boasting is not good. do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough?
target_text: be'a boe ladhe miu nged'e! baku bhèlu, na, èdhi pakihu bibit roti ciki di ho bisa pakapai adonan aa'i-aa'i. bibit roti, nuka sèmi bhabhelu dhèu. de ladhe soro tèke dhèu ad'u-ue bhabhelu ètu talora aae miu, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani leo sèra madhutu tao bhelu kahèi!

source_text: get rid of the old leaven, that you may be a new unleavened batch, as you really are. for christ, our passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
target_text: babège eele dhèu bhelu èèna nèti juma'at miu, sèmi uru èèna dhèu yahudi sèra core eele ragi aa'i-aa'i nèti èmu rèngu sèra ho neo ra'a kalela paska. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa j'aj'i hari nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara na abhu heka bhelu-katub'a. miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sèmi èèna. uru èèna, dhèu roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao badha korban kalela paska. d'ai limuri ku, rèngu pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i korban dhu pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: therefore let us keep the feast, not with the old bread, leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu yahudi ra'a gee-j'ara nèti roti dhu pake boe ragi ètu d'ara lod'o kalela paska. limuri ne, èdhi nuka sèmi roti dhu pake boe ragi èèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i j'aga paie mamuri èdhi sèna ka baku tao ia ka j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, aa baku papèd'a d'ara dhèu leo. èdhi hud'i padhai lii dhu lèke taruu. hèia ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri èdhi, ra peka na, tatao èdhi madhutu d'ara mola.

source_text: i wrote you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a suri kèdhi le sasuri dhu peka na, baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: i was not including the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. in that case you would have to leave this world.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a ne peka boe, na, miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, do dhèu manga'a, do dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu mana'u rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, do dènge dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu. te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i tao iisi mi pakaj'èu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but now i am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler. with such a man do not even eat.
target_text: te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne nuka: miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu sarani, aa te ngaa nèngu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, do dhu manga'a, do dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, do dhu pahahe kolongara dhèu, do dhu mahu, do dhu kapod'e mèdha-panyau dhèu. èdhi baku pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. aa loe eele ka madhèdi mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: what business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? are you not to judge those inside?
target_text: miu dènge hak ho lee mamuri dhèu sarani. te ngaa ja'a dènge boe hak, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua.

source_text: god will judge those outside. expel the wicked man from among you.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka bèli-camèd'a pama'ète hia dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne. de miu baku bhèlu, ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa loe boe tao bhabhelu, na, babège eele ne!

source_text: if any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu sarani pagalaa dènge a'ari na dhèu sarani, nga tao ka lami asa pengadilan ètu madha hakim dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua? tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna? be'a risi lami asa madha dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu uri lii langu miu!

source_text: do you not know that the saints will judge the world? and if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu dhae me'a mèka, peka na, dhèu-dhèu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a rèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. de tasamia ka miu mesa mi bisa boe uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki?

source_text: do you not know that we will judge angels? how much more the things of this life!
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, ladhe bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu uri lii langu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. de tatu hud'i miu ku dhu uri lii langu dhu bèli-bèli j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: so if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?
target_text: risi-risi hari, ladhe miu dhèu parcaya pagalaa lula-nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, nga tao ka miu pake dhèu pama'ète lii dhu dhèu-dhèu sarani pakab'ua boe si?

source_text: i say this to your shame. is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?
target_text: de ja'a neo peka ca j'ara dhu pamakae miu. sèmi ngaa? nuka sèmi ètu talora aae miu abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu d'èlu-mèu uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, sèmi lii langu dhu cèu nèti a'ari èdhi.

source_text: instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!
target_text: te ngaa nèti talora miu abhu dhèu parcaya dhu ère nèti a'ari na dhèu parcaya asa madha dhèu pama'ète lii langu! aa te ngaa dhèu pama'ète lii langu ne dhu parcaya boe lamatua!

source_text: the very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already. why not rather be wronged? why not rather be cheated?
target_text: lèke boe, sina ma? miu dhu segi boe le èèna, ladhe miu èci dènge èci lami pagalaa asa era pama'ète lii langu. be'a risi, a'ari èu èèna soro tèke ne, ladhe na tao sala mi dedha èu. aa ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya mana'u nare mèdha-panyau èu, be'a risi hud'i laa nare!

source_text: instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, even against your own brothers!
target_text: te ngaa miu dhèu parcaya èci tao sala mi a'ari miu. aa èci mana'u èci. aa te ngaa miu sama-sama dhèu parcaya!

source_text: do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of god? do not be deceived: neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi me'a boe j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i! te dhèu dhu ro'o boe tao dhu lèke, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. mage soro tèke dhèu tipu miu, sèna ka miu ad'u-ue sasala! dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhu bersina, mone dhèu dua dhu pa'èci nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali,

source_text: nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhèu mana'u, dhèu manga'a, dhèu rinu mahu, dhu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu, dhu pakapod'e ho rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi se'e se, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua!

source_text: and that is what some of you were. but you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified, in the name of the lord jesus christ and by the spirit of our god.
target_text: mema, uru èèna miu cahag'e sèmi èèna kahèi! te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia pamèu miu. aa nèngu bhoke le j'ara kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne. na tao j'ara se'e, lula miu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa lula miu pa'èki dènge roh lamatua kahèi.

source_text: everything is permissible for me, but not everything is beneficial. everything is permissible for me, but i will not be mastered by anything.
target_text: ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a neo tao sèra, tatu boe be'a hia ja'a. de masi ka ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe j'ara dhu karehe koasa nare ja'a.

source_text: food for the stomach and the stomach for food, but god will destroy them both. the body is not intended for sexual immorality, but for the lord, and the lord for the body.
target_text: conto sèmi, dhèu peka na, nganga'a parluu kabake, aa kabake parluu nganga'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua palaho aa'i dua-dua ra. conto dhu leo hari, èdhi bisa boe soro ngi'u èdhi sèna ka bisa tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali èdhi boe. èdhi unu ngi'u ne, sèna ka sab'a hia lamatua èdhi. aa lamatua èdhi ladhe-leru ngi'u èdhi.

source_text: by his power god raised the lord from the dead, and he will raise us also.
target_text: ropa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus madhe, ama lamatua ka pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe èdhi madhe, nèngu dènge koasa kahèi ho pamamuri hari èdhi.

source_text: do you not know that your bodies are members of christ? shall i then take the members of christ and unite them with a prostitute? never!
target_text: ngi'u miu j'aj'i mi unu kristus, nuka sèmi miu bagian nèti ngi'u kristus. tatu j'ara ne, miu me'a le! de ladhe ja'a pake bagian nèti ngi'u kristus, ho laku pa'èci dènge ngi'u nèti bhèni kajeo, na tasamia? baku sèmi èèna! te èèna na lèke boe!

source_text: or don't you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? for it is said, the two will become one flesh.
target_text: tatu miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao j'ara makae ho j'unu pa'èci dènge bhèni kajeo, na, dua-dua pakihu kee j'aj'i mi èci. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, rèngu dua ra pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but he who unites himself with the lord is one with him in spirit.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i le èci dènge nèngu, sama sèmi dua ra dhu pa'èki ètu d'ara roh èci.

source_text: flee from sexual immorality. every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
target_text: ladhe èu abhu tebho tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu èu boe, na, rai pakaj'èu! dhèu ad'u-ue sasala rupa-rupa dhu pa'ele iie rèngu unu ra, aa pa'ele iie dhèu leo kahèi. te dhèu dhu karihu kaj'alu pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: do you not know that your body is a temple of the holy spirit who is in you, whom you have received from god? you are not your own;
target_text: ngi'u èu èèna, nuka sèmi èmu sabaj'a roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. roh nèngu èèna ka, dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, te ama lamatua mesa na ka hia roh na mi dedha miu. nèti èèna ka, miu dènge boe hak ciki sa hèi, ho j'aj'i lamatua dhu ator ngi'u miu unu mi. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu mamuri sèmi pame'a boe sa dènge j'ara se'e?

source_text: you were bought at a price. therefore glorify god with your body.
target_text: kristus sui nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. de miu hud'i mamuri ku dènge pakab'ua ngi'u miu unu mi, ho pad'elo, na, miu pakab'ua ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now for the matters you wrote about: it is good to abstain from sexual relations.
target_text: ja'a neo suri j'ara-j'ara dhu miu pakarèi ètu d'ara sasuri miu èèna, dhu peka na, tasamia? dhu be'a ka, dhèu mone baku leo-èmu, do?

source_text: but because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
target_text: sèmi ne'e: lula abhu lod'o taleo ae, dhu dhèu bisa manahu asa d'ara tatao dhu sala ètu d'ara pa'èci mone dènge bhèni, nèti èèna ka be'a risi dhèu mone èci hud'i dènge ku dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu bhèni hud'i pa'èci ku dènge dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na.

source_text: the husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu. aa dhèu bhèni dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu.

source_text: the wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband. likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.
target_text: te bhèni dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na sèna ka j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na. aa mone dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na ho j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na.

source_text: do not deprive each other, except by mutual consent and for a time, so you may devote yourselves to prayer. then come together again, so that satan will not tempt you through your lack of self-control.
target_text: de miu baku patula-pajuku, lula dua-dua mi dhu dènge hak hua! te ngaa ladhe miu neo sabaj'a di, ho mo'o boe ngee j'ara dhu leo-leo, na, j'unu pa'èci boe d'ara ciki oo'e èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i dua mi mere lii èci ku. aa ladhe sabaj'a mere, na, be'a risi pakaboko hari dènge ka. te ladhe aad'o, na, bisa j'aj'i be'a boe! te dhèu aae nidhu bisa dadugu-rariu dhèu dhu taha rare boe d'ara.

source_text: i say this as a concession, not as a command.
target_text: j'ara ne mai nèti a'abhu ja'a di, nèti boe atora lamatua.

source_text: i wish that all men were as i am. but each man has his own gift from god; one has this gift, another has that.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, be'a risi dhèu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu dènge boe dhèu èmu. te ngaa ama lamatua hia dhèu karunya pamèci dènge nèngu. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hia si leo-èmu, aa abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si leo boe èmu.

source_text: now to the unmarried and widows i say this: it is good for them to remain unmarried, as i am.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni dhu leo mèka èmu, aa dènge bhèni balu, na, be'a risi miu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a ne.

source_text: but if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe taha mere boe, hua iia leo èmu ka. dhu hua iia risi ladhe dhèu leo-èmu, te aad'o na, dad'èi d'ara na pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: to the married i give this command not i, but the lord: a wife must not separate from her husband.
target_text: ne'e ne mai boe nèti ngangee ja'a mesa ku. te ja'a neo peka ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha le mi dhèu dhu leo le èmu, na, bhèni bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. and a husband must not divorce his wife.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèke eele dhèu èmu na, be'a risi leo ia ka èmu. hua iia nèngu la'e padame dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. sèmi èèna kahèi mone, bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: to the rest i say this i, not the lord: if a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
target_text: ne'e ne madhutu ngangee ja'a, mai boe nèti lamatua èdhi. aa mi dhèu leo, ja'a neo padhai lii sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu mone dhèu sarani dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe dhèu èmu na neo mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: and if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe mone ne d'èi era sèna ka dua ra mamuri pa'èci taruu.

source_text: for the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband. otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
target_text: te mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa mola-mèci, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge bhèni dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. aa bhèni dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. te ladhe aad'o, na, ana-ana rèngu bisa boe mola-mèci. te ngaa dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: but if the unbeliever leaves, let him go. the believing brother or sister is not bound in such cases. god has called you to live in peace.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu bhèni do dhèu mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, dhu la'e tèke eele dhèu èmu-kamali na dhu parcaya, na hud'i nèngu sène. ka dhèu èmu dhu parcaya, pa'èki heka dènge ne. te ama lamatua paroa miu sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
target_text: dhèu bhèni dhu parcaya, dhu leo le èmu aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu mone dhu parcaya dhu leo le èmu sèra! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. miu me'a iia mèka.

source_text: regardless, each one should lead the life that the lord has assigned to him and to which god has called him. this is what i prescribe in all the churches.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa mamuri dhèu èci-èci tasa mera mia lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri taruu sèmi èèna. baku ub'a hari, te ama lamatua dhu ator nare le sèmi èèna. ja'a aj'a-nori atora ne ètu juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: was a man already circumcised when he was called? he should not become uncircumcised. was a man still uncircumcised when called? he should not be circumcised.
target_text: conto, ladhe miu suna le sèna ka pad'elo, na, miu dhèu yahudi, hèia lod'o limuri miu tadèngi ama lamatua paroa nare miu, na, baku pasili, peka na, miu suna le. aa dhèu dhu dhae suna mèka ropa tadèngi ama lamatua paroa si, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, na, suna ia ka. lula rèngu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. keeping god's commandments is what counts.
target_text: ladhe dhu suna le, èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. aa suna mèka èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. dhu dènge kab'ua ka, nuka èdhi madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: each one should remain in the situation he was in when he was called.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lamatua pua boe miu suna, do baku suna. de hud'i ka laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka.

source_text: were you a slave when you were called? do not let it concern you-but if you can gain your freedom, take the opportunity.
target_text: ja'a hia hari conto èci. ladhe èu j'aj'i ènu lod'o ama lamatua paroa èu, na, hud'i laa sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa ladhe sèmi èu dhu ènu boe, na, hud'i laa! ladhe bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu bebas, ngaa-ngaa tao boe kahèi.

source_text: for he who was a slave when he was called by the lord is the lord's freedman. conversely, he who was a free man when he was called is christ's slave.
target_text: te ropa lamatua paroa ca dhèu ènu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ènu ne j'aj'i le sèmi ca dhèu dhu bebas, dhu sab'a hia lamatua na ètu sorga. aa lod'o ama lamatua paroa ca dhèu bebas j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhèu ne j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus.

source_text: you were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.
target_text: kristus tihe pama'ète nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna! de miu baku j'aj'i ènu hia dhèu leo.

source_text: brothers, each one should remain in the situation he was in when god called him.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri miu tasamia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka. hud'i laa sèmi èèna ka, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: now about virgins, i have no command from the lord, but i give a judgment as one who by the lord's mercy is trustworthy.
target_text: miu karèi ja'a lula-nèti dhèu kalora iisi dhu j'unu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa. ama lamatua peka boe ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a nèti j'ara èèna. te ngaa miu bisa sèmi ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai, lula ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia mi ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: because of the present crisis, i think it is good for a man to remain as he is.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi abhu j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. de mamuri dhèu tasa mera mia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: are you committed to a wife? do not seek to be released. are you free of commitment? do not look for a wife.
target_text: ladhe èu pa'èki dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, baku ia eele ne. ladhe èu dhu pa'èki heka dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, tenge ia ka bhèni leo, sèna ka leo ia ka èmu.

source_text: but if you do marry, you have not sinned. and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. but those who marry will face troubles in this life, and i want to spare you this.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èu leo hari èmu, na, èu sala boe ngaa-ngaa. aa ladhe bhèni dhu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone leo-èmu, nèngu ad'u-ue boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa sanèd'e, dhèu dhu paleo èmu, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa ètu rai-haha ne. dad'èi ja'a sèna ka miu baku susa sèmi èèna.

source_text: what i am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. from now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! madhutu ngangee ja'a, nuka: lod'o oe èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le. de mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu, mage ladhe dhoka dhèu èmu nèngu di, te ngaa laladhe kahèi asa lamatua.

source_text: those who weep, as if they did not; those who are joyful, as if they were not; those who make a purchase, as if they had nothing;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhu tangi, be'a risi pa'èra d'ara ho baku tangi, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu karej'e-karae, be'a risi baku karej'e seli, te ngaa laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu hèli ngaa-ngaa, be'a risi tao mamuri na nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua.

source_text: and those who use the things of this world, as if not dependent on them. for this world in its present form is passing away.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pake mèdha-panyau nèti rai-haha ne, be'a risi tao ngi'u na, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri na dhu maena boe mi mèdha-panyau rai-haha ne, sèna ka na laladhe dhoka asa ama lamatua di. lula j'ara mamuri rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele.

source_text: i want you to be free from concern. the unmarried man is concerned about the work of the lord, how he can please the lord.
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu baku pangee ae-ae. te dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lod'o nèngu ae ho na tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. sèna ka nèngu bisa tenge j'ara ho sab'a pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: but the married man is concerned about the affairs of this world, how he can please his wife, and his interests are divided. the unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. but the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu leo le èmu, hud'i taru kira dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèngu kahèi hud'i taru kira ku mi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu hud'i tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi. j'ara se'e se ka tao ngangee na j'aj'i mi kajari. sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge heka dhèu èmu, aa bhèni kalora iisi. rèngu taru kira dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka bisa mamuri mola-mèci ètu d'ara dènge ngi'u aae. te ngaa bhèni dhu leo le èmu, d'ara na kajari. nèngu taru kira ka mi dad'èi lamatua, te ngaa na tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi.

source_text: i am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the lord.
target_text: ja'a lole j'ara se'e, sèna ka nèti babe'a hia miu. ja'a ko'o boe ho miu lèke sasii. dad'èi ja'a ka, miu tao dhu lèke, aa tangare asa dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: however, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mone dhu lii d'ai le bhèni dhu d'ai umur paleo èmu, na, hud'i laa ra paleo, ladhe mone ne d'èi heka pamata. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu tao boe j'ara sala. te ladhe ra mate panèbhu, mage dhoka mone èèna taha nare boe d'ara, hèia nèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint, with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin, he will do well.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mone ne bisa taha nare d'ara, nèngu baku laka-seti ho kab'i lai-lai. te ne'a ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. masi ka nare nèbhu, dènge boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so then, he who marries the virgin does well, but he who does not marry her does even better.
target_text: de dhèu mone dhu leo dènge bhèni na, èèna be'a. aa dhu leo boe èmu èèna, be'a risi hari.

source_text: a wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. but if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu leo le èmu, pa'èki toke madhe dènge dhèu èmu na. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe, nèngu bisa leo hari dènge dhèu mone leo, sad'i mone ne dhèu dhu parcaya kristus kahèi.

source_text: in my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. and i think that i too have the spirit of god.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, be'a risi bhèni balu ne, leo ia ka èmu. ja'a pangee, na, lii holo ne cèu nèti roh lamatua dhu ètu d'ara ja'a kahèi.

source_text: now about food sacrificed to idols: we know that we all have knowledge. knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
target_text: ja'a neo lole lula-nèti sisi dhu dhèu pake sogo-tagu nidhu. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu te'a ae le j'ara se'e. dhu j'aj'i mi lii langu, ka ladhe dhèu ne'a ae, na, nèngu bisa nged'e, te na pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu risi nèti dhèu leo sèra. de be'a risi, èdhi mamuri dènge pasue di. te j'ara pasue ne'e ka tao dhèu aa'i-aa'i asa tabha èra ètu d'ara parcaya ra.

source_text: the one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ne'a mèu, èèna peka na, mamèu nèngu dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: but the one who loves god is known by god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sue ama lamatua, tatu lamatua tadhe ne. ne'e ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: so about eating food sacrificed to idols: we know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no god but one.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu na'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu le mi nidhu, èdhi aa'i-aa'i te'a, na, nèngu dhoka pahaha iisi mi mèdha sogo-tagu ètu rai-haha di, te ngaa pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu lèke. te èdhi te'a, na, abhu dhoka ama lamatua èci di dhu lèke aa, mèdha sogo-tagu aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu, dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth as there are many so-called gods and lords,
target_text: abhu mèdha ae-ae ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu peka, na, ‘lamatua rèngu' do aad'o na, ‘kètu rèngu'.

source_text: yet for us there is but one god, the father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. and there is but one lord, jesus christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
target_text: te ngaa bagi èdhi, ama lamatua dhoka èci di. nèngu èèna, ama èdhi. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti nèngu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao hia mi nèngu. aa kètu èdhi dhoka èci di, nuka yesus kristus. ama lamatua pake yesus, lod'o na paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. aa èdhi mamuri, lula yesus ka dhu hia èdhi.

source_text: but not everyone has this knowledge. some people are still so accustomed to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. and since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara se'e. rèngu loe boe pangee mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, hèia ngangee rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ngangee rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, ropa ra'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, rèngu pangee, na, nganga'a ne j'aj'i le korban ho pake sogo-tagu nidhu! ladhe ja'a ku'a mèdha ne'e, na, ja'a pa'èki era dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu! de ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee rèngu, toke rèngu bisa heka unu ngangee madhera, lula d'ara rèngu èra boe.

source_text: but food does not bring us closer to god: we are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.
target_text: nga tao ka sèmi èèna? nganga'a bisa boe nèti èdhi asa madha ama lamatua, si? ladhe ta'a boe, èdhi asa boe bhelu, sina ma? aa ladhe ta'a, tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu be'a, si?

source_text: be careful, however, that your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak.
target_text: te ngaa mage-mage! masi ka èu dènge hak sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èci, tatu boe j'ara ne nèti babe'a hia èu. ladhe sèmi abhu a'ari ca dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu tao j'ara èèna, hèia na manahu, na, èèna be'a boe!

source_text: for if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol's temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
target_text: èu dhu me'a le, j'ara ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. te ngaa ladhe a'ari dhèu parcaya dhu d'ara na èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu mu'a ètu d'ara èmu sogo-tagu, na pangee sèmi ngaa? tatu na pangee, na, ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a sogo-tagu èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, masi ka nganga'a èèna ra pae'a le nidhu.

source_text: so this weak brother, for whom christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
target_text: èu me'a le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu asa paroe d'ara dhèu dhu èra mèka. aa te ngaa dhèu èèna, a'ari èu dhèu parcaya. kristus madhe hia nèngu kahèi!

source_text: by sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against christ.
target_text: hua iia pangee sèmi ne'e: ladhe a'ari èu dhu d'ara èra mèka ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu ngangee rèngu sala lula tatao èu, na, èu tao le sasala hia rèngu. aa èu tao sasala mi kristus kahèi.

source_text: therefore, if what i eat causes my brother to stumble, i will never eat meat again, so that i will not cause him to stumble.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a dhu tao a'ari ja'a dhèu parcaya manahu asa d'ara sasala, be'a risi ja'a baku ku'a sisi sèmi sèra, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. te ja'a ko'o boe rèngu manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: am i not free? am i not an apostle? have i not seen jesus our lord? are you yourselves not my workmanship in the lord?
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge boe hak ho suri sèmi ne'e hia miu. te ama lamatua pua ja'a laku lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a dhu kèdhi le kètu èdhi, yesus èèna. ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne. hèia miu aa'i-aa'i parcaya nèngu kahèi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ne.

source_text: even if i am not an apostle to others, surely i am to you. for you are the seal of my apostleship in the lord.
target_text: masi ka dhèu leo ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, te ngaa tatu miu me'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a dhiu peka-padhai lii moa na asa miu. ladhe miu neo me'a mèu, na, lee mamuri miu di. te miu dhu pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus!

source_text: this is my defense to those who scrutinize me:
target_text: ja'a neo dhaa mi dhèu dhu pèci sasala mi dedha ja'a, sèmi ne'e:

source_text: have we no right to food and to drink?
target_text: miu ngee, na, ja'a dènge barnabas dènge boe hak ho abhu nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu dhu ji'i aj'a-nori si, do?

source_text: have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the lord's brothers and cephas?
target_text: miu pangee, na, ji'i dènge boe hak ho leo dènge dhèu bhèni kristen, dhu la'a sama-sama pakako sasab'a lamatua ètu era leo, do? madhutu iia-iia na, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra, rèti kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. ari lamatua yesus sèra tao sèmi èèna. petrus mesa na sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: or are barnabas and i the only apostles who must work for a living?
target_text: do, miu ngee na, dhoka ja'a dènge barnabas di dhu hud'i sab'a tenge doi-dhari, sèna ka bisa mamuri ho aj'a-nori dhèu?

source_text: who serves as a soldier at his own expense? who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? who tends a flock and does not drink of its milk?
target_text: ngangee miu sèmi èèna, mai nèti mia? ladhe sèku sordad'u sèra. rèngu pusi boe hèli nganga'a-nganginu dènge mèdha-papake. ladhe sèku dhèu sab'a ètu oka anggor. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kai, peka na, èu baku mu'a hua anggor sèra! aa ladhe sèku dhèu madhenga badha. dhèu ne dènge hak ho nare susu nèti kahib'i-kalèbho dhu nèngu j'aga.

source_text: do i say this from a human perspective? doesn't the law say the same thing?
target_text: ja'a padhai lii ne madhutu boe ngangee ja'a dhèu rai-haha ne. te atora sèra nèti ama lamatua dhu peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for it is written in the law of moses: do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain. is it about oxen that god is concerned?
target_text: ètu atora musa, dhu suri peka na, ropa sapi j'èli are ho hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, baku kape hèb'a na, sèna ka bisa na'a. miu pangee, na, lamatua soro tèke sèna ka dhoka sapi di dhu bisa na'a, do?

source_text: isn't he actually speaking on our behalf? indeed, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest. if we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?
target_text: aad'o! lamatua peka na, nèngu taru kira èdhi kahèi. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu dhu kabèli rai, aa dhèu dhu hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, ropa ra sab'a, rèngu re'a kahèi, èèna na abhu pala ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, be'a risi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhèu kristen sèra, bisa abhu pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra ra. te lod'o ji'i aj'a-nori miu j'ara-j'ara nèti roh lamatua èèna, ji'i nuka sèmi ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe dhu sèle hini. de lod'o ji'i aj'a ngare, ladhe ji'i abhu nganga'a-nganginu do ngaa hari nèti miu, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te j'ara na sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: if others have this right to your support, shouldn't we have it all the more? but we did not exercise this right. instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of christ.
target_text: dhèu leo dhu aj'a-nori miu, dènge hak sèna ka abhu dhua-èi dènge mèdha-panyau nèti miu, si? aa ji'i tasamia? ji'i dènge hak risi eele nèti rèngu! te ngaa miu me'a le. ji'i se pake ngèdhi boe hak ho laka-seti miu. ji'i pa'èra ètu rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka baku magee miu. te, dènge j'ara ne'e, miu d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu.

source_text: do you not know that those who work in the temple eat of its food, and those who serve at the altar partake of its offerings?
target_text: pangee ku laa! ama-ama agama dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, mamuri nèti persembahan dhu dhèu rèti. aa dhèu dhu sab'a ètu mei korban, ra'a sisi nèti badha dhu dhèu rèti.

source_text: in the same way, the lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua dhu moa, na, dhèu dhu sasab'a ra peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus, rèngu bisa mamuri nèti rui-j'aj'èra nèti sasab'a-la'a ra. dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: but i have not used any of these rights. and i am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. indeed, i would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.
target_text: masi ka ja'a dènge hak ho mamuri sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a d'èi boe tao sèmi èèna. ja'a suri boe sasuri ne sèna ka miu hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pakako sasab'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. de hua iia risi ja'a madhe, ladhe dhèu pangee, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu.

source_text: yet when i preach the gospel, i have no reason to boast, because i am obligated to preach. woe to me if i do not preach the gospel!
target_text: masi ka ja'a lole taruu dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a lamatua, te ngaa èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci, dhu ja'a bisa padedha iisi. ja'a hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti lamatua, te lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a sèmi èèna. ladhe ja'a sab'a boe madhutu sasab'a ja'a, na dui kore j'aj'èra! te tatu pasae kore hahuku.

source_text: if my preaching is voluntary, i have a reward. but if it is not voluntary, i am still entrusted with a responsibility.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne lula madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, na, ngaa dhu ja'a abhu sèra, nuka sèmi gaji dhu dhèu sab'a sèra abhu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne, lula lamatua pua ja'a, èèna leo. te lamatua lèka ja'a ho j'aga mèdha-panyau na dhu kab'ua.

source_text: what then is my reward? that in preaching the gospel i may offer it free of charge, and so not use up my rights in preaching it.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, upa ja'a ngaa? ja'a parluu boe gaji. ja'a padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa. ne'e ka dhu tao ja'a karae, nuka sèmi ja'a abhu le upa. de masi ka ja'a unu rupa-rupa hak, nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu sasab'a ra padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a èèna, te ngaa ja'a pake aa'i boe hak sèra.

source_text: though i am free of obligation to anyone, i make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu bebas dhu sab'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a. dhèu dènge boe hak ho pua ja'a tao ne'e, do, tao èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a tao ngi'u nuka sèmi ènu, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i abhu hak ho paleha ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a bisa soru-bara dhèu ae, sèna ka ra madhutu ama lamatua taruu.

source_text: to the jews i became like a jew, to win the jews. to those under the law i became like one under the law though i myself am not under the law, to win those under the law.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pa'èci dènge dhèu yahudi, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu yahudi, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu yahudi ho ra tadhe lamatua. ladhe ja'a pa'èci ka dènge dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra atora lamatua, ja'a tao madhutu atora lamatua, ho ja'a bisa soru-bara si, sèna ka ra tadhe mèu lamatua, masi ka ja'a ke'a, na, tao madhutu atora èèna, bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua.

source_text: to those without the law i became like one without the law though i am not outside the law of god but am under the law of christ, to win those without the law.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pakaboko dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe atora lamatua, ja'a j'aj'i sèmi rèngu ho lere kèti si asa lamatua. ja'a patabuli boe atora lamatua dhu na hia mai re musa, te ngaa ja'a mamuri pake atora kristus

source_text: to the weak i became weak, to win the weak. i have become all things to all people so that by all possible means i might save some.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe kahèi, ho ja'a bisa pamako si sèna ka mai asa ama lamatua. dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a tao iisi sèmi rèngu, sèna ka, ladhe bisa, kèti cahag'e asa madha lamatua.

source_text: i do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that i may share in its blessings.
target_text: ja'a tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa lèka lii lolo be'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa abhu pala dhu be'a nèti madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, dhu lamatua hia èdhi.

source_text: do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? run in such a way as to take the prize.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dènge pa'uji rai. dhèu ae-ae madhutu pa'uji rai, te ngaa dhu abhu juara dhoka dhèu èci di. de miu èci-èci mi hud'i rai pa'èra-èra ku ho j'aj'i juara hia lamatua.

source_text: everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. they do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu pa'uji, hud'i madhutu ku paredha nèti dhèu dhu aj'a rèngu, si? dhèu se sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula neo abhu solo juara dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie. te ngaa èdhi sab'a sèna ka abhu upa dhu taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: therefore i do not run aimlessly; i do not fight like i am beating the air.
target_text: de ja'a rai leli boe. te ngaa ja'a tenge j'ara ho rai pa'èra-èra toke d'ai lane. ladhe pasoro ja'a sèmi dhèu tuka paj'ubhu, na, ja'a j'ubhu leli boe, te ngaa hud'i j'ubhu palèke ku.

source_text: no, i discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after i have preached to others, i myself will not be disqualified.
target_text: ja'a pa'èra d'ara, aa aj'a ngi'u sèna ka bisa taha taruu. te be'a boe ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ama lamatua, aa te ngaa ja'a mesa ku sisu atora, hèia lamatua kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara pa'uji rai èèna.

source_text: i do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage miu bhèlu eele lii lolo dhu uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki èdhi ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe. ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ra'i-liru dhu kako uuru nèti rèngu. aa ama lamatua hag'e eele èi dhasi, hèia ra kako d'ai cabèka dhasi dènge sod'a.

source_text: they were all baptized into moses in the cloud and in the sea.
target_text: dhasi dènge ra'i-liru se, nuka sèmi lii pakasame sa. te bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèka musa nuka sèmi ama ho lere si, ka ra madhutu ra'i-liru, aa maso asa d'ara dhasi palere-lere dènge ne. èèna sama sèmi èdhi dhu parcaya kristus hèia abhu sarani, dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa ti nanene ne.

source_text: they all ate the same spiritual food
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi aa'i-aa'i ra, ra'a nganga'a dhu roh lamatua sadia tèke hia ra.

source_text: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was christ.
target_text: aa rinu nèti èi dhu roh lamatua sadia hia ra kahèi. èi dhu rinu èèna kalua nèti hadhu aae dhu roh lamatua paj'uj'u tèke. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia èèna ka, hadhu èèna dhu ètu èèna le. madhutu iia-iia na, hadhu èèna, nuka kristus.

source_text: nevertheless, god was not pleased with most of them, for they were struck down in the wilderness.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge tatao dhèu ae sèra. ka ropa ra kako palème era mamoo dhu taleo èèna, dhèu ae madhe. ka ra padhane si palème era.

source_text: these things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi baku d'èi tao j'ara bhelu sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: do not be idolaters, as some of them were. as it is written: the people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.
target_text: baku pae'a nidhu sèmi rèngu cahag'e. ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu isra'el madhèdi ra'a-rinu pesta ètu madha patung sapi iiki ci'u. ka ra sogo-tagu ne.

source_text: we should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
target_text: èdhi baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èdhi. te uru-uru sèra, rèngu tao j'ara makae sèmi sèra ka, hèia dua nguru tèlu riho dhèu madhe ètu d'ara ca lod'o doko èèna ka.

source_text: we should not test christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
target_text: èdhi baku ad'u-ue bhabhelu rupa-rupa, ho neo te'a, kristus huku èdhi, do aad'o. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e neo sèku ama lamatua sèmi èèna ka, ka na hia mege ae-ae dhu dènge raco sèna ka kadhi pamadhe si.

source_text: and do not complain, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.
target_text: èdhi baku ka'uu-kamuki kahèi. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e re'a dhoka ka'uu-kamuki di, ka ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na èci nèti sorga mai pamadhe si.

source_text: now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.
target_text: j'ara ne lèke mi dhèu isra'el, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha hia mi èdhi. ra suri se'e se, ho èdhi bisa te'a, sèna ka baku tao madhutu sasala rèngu. te lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: so the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! limuri ne èu ngee, na, èu èra le. te ngaa baku pamud'e, sèna ka baku manahu.

source_text: no temptation has seized you except what is common to man. and god is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. but when you are tempted, he will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ngee mèdhi neo tao bhabhelu, te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu leo dhu paraga rèdhi le kahèi, dadugu-rariu sèmi sèra. te ngaa èu bisa parcaya ama lamatua, sèna ka na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu peka. te lamatua soro tèke boe èu ho abhu dadugu-rariu risi nèti a'èra èu. ropa èu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, nèngu pad'elo j'ara kalua hia èu. nèngu neo pa'èra èu, ho baku manahu.

source_text: therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe dhèu neo laka-seti miu sèna ka sogo-tagu nidhu, na, pakeso nèti era èèna! baku pamata!

source_text: i speak to reasonable people; judge for yourselves what i say.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a ngee madhera. hud'i laa miu mesa mi dadoo unu mi, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka-padhai èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of christ? and is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of christ?
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe èdhi pakaboko sèna ka ta'a-tinu ètu mei ama lamatua, hèia tare galaa ho manèngi makasi mi lamatua, ka tinu nèti galaa èèna, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. ropa na pasuti raa na ka na madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhutu madhe kahèi. ladhe èdhi pamae roti èèna, hèia ta'e, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ropa kristus madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi kahèi madhe sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ta'e nèti roti cue. de aa'i-aa'i dhu rare pala nèti roti cue ne, nuka sèmi èdhi dhu pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci, masi ka èdhi dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: consider the people of israel: are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
target_text: pangee sèku dhèu isra'el uru sèra. ropa rèngu roro badha ètu dedha mei korban sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, ama agama dhu roro ne ka dhu bisa na'e sisi èèna. sasoa na, rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, aa pa'èki kahèi dènge dhèu dhu rèti badha ho j'aj'i mi korban.

source_text: am i suggesting, then, that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything? no, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to god. and i do not want you to be participants with demons.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tasamia? lod'o dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua neo hia mèdha-panyau rèngu j'aj'i mi mèdha sogo-tagu ra, èèna dènge boe kab'ua, do? te mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, dhoka patung dhu madhe di! aad'o! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhèu roro badha ho j'aj'i badha sogo-tagu, rèngu sogo-tagu nidhu bhelu. te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi ama lamatua dhu lèke. de ja'a ko'o boe ho miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèmi sèra.

source_text: you cannot drink the cup of the lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the lord and the table of demons too.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki dènge lamatua, ka minu nèti galaa ètu mei lamatua, na, miu bisa boe pa'èci dènge nidhu bhelu sèra, aa baku minu nèti galaa dhu ra pake pae'a nidhu. te ladhe miu minu sèmi èèna, sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu bisa boe mi'a ètu mei nidhu. goa, ee! te sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèra!

source_text: are we trying to provoke the lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu sèmi ngaa? neo papèd'a d'ara lamatua èdhi, do? èèna bahaya! ele boe miu ngee, na, miu èra risi lamatua, do?

source_text: everything is permissible, but not everything is beneficial. everything is permissible, but not everything is edifying.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a neo tao ngaa èèna ka, bisa. te èèna hak ja'a. tare'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra nèti babe'a hia èu. aa tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, bisa soru-bara èu ho pa'èra d'ara mu.

source_text: no one should seek his own good, but the good of others.
target_text: baku tenge dhoka leto pala ngi'u èu di. be'a risi tenge oto hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe hèli sisi ètu d'ara pasa, na, mu'a laa. baku pakarèi ia ka, peka na, sisi pae'a nidhu, do? do pangee, na, ja'a bisa ku'a sisi ne, do aad'o?

source_text: for, the earth is the lord's, and the fullness thereof.
target_text: lula ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, rai-haha dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i, unu lamatua èdhi.

source_text: if an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus nèru miu, peka na, mai lati ta'a asa èmu ja'a! ladhe miu lami, na, mi'a ngaa dhu na hia miu. baku pakarèi ia ka, na, ja'a bisa ku'a nganga'a ne'e, do aad'o?

source_text: but if someone tells you, this food was offered to idols, then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience-
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu mai paka'uu, peka na, baku mu'a ne'e ne, te sisi ne sisi sogo-tagu nidhu, be'a risi èu baku mu'a. èu hud'i taru kira ku mi dhèu dhu mai peka lii deo na, ho baku pabia ne.

source_text: the other one's conscience, i mean, not your own. for why should my freedom be determined by someone else's conscience?
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, pangee paie-iie, madhutu ngangee dhèu deo na, bisa ku'e do aad'o. baku ngee dhoka dhu be'a madhutu ngangee èu mesa mu. aa te ngaa, ja'a bisa tao madhutu d'èi d'ara ja'a. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe nèngu ad'u-ue ca madha j'ara, nga tao ka ja'a bebas boe sa hèi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a, lula be'a boe bagi mi dhèu leo?

source_text: if i partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am i denounced because of that for which i give thanks?
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia ja'a ku'a, na, nga tao ka dhèu padhai pamanahu ja'a?

source_text: so whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of god.
target_text: de miu neo mi'a do, minu do, tao ngaa èèna ka, na, tao aa'i-aa'i sèna ka pakapai kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: do not become a stumbling block, whether to jews or greeks or the church of god-
target_text: baku pasusa dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, do dhèu unu lamatua dhu parcaya sèra.

source_text: as i also try to please everyone in all i do. for i am not seeking my own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved.
target_text: tao nuka sèmi ja'a tao. te ja'a neo cob'a pakarej'e si ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a mesa boe tao dhu be'a hia ja'a di, te ngaa neo tao dhu be'a bagi rèngu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka rèngu abhu sod'a kahèi.

source_text: you are to imitate me, just as i imitate christ.
target_text: miu ladhe mi ja'a, aa tao madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a. te ja'a ladhe mi kristus, aa tao madhutu tatao nèngu.

source_text: now i commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as i passed them on to you.
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu, lula tasamia èèna ka miu sanèd'e taruu ja'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu, miu tao madhutu era. be'a titu kèna!

source_text: but i want you to understand that the head of every man is christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of christ is god.
target_text: te ngaa ca j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu nuka: baku bhèlu j'aj'aj'i miu nèti mia. dhèu mone dhu parcaya sèra, kèni na nèti kristus, dhu j'aj'i kètu ra. dhèu bhèni j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone. aa kristus mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
target_text: dhèu mone baku pahutu kètu na lod'o nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i, do, ropa na peka-padhai lii moa lamatua. te èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae kristus, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi.

source_text: and every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni hud'i pahutu kètu na lod'o sabaj'a, do ropa nèngu lole lii moa lamatua. te ladhe aad'o na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae dhèu èmu na, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi. aa nèngu pamakae ngi'u nèngu unu na, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu lusu pakahoni kètu na.

source_text: if a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. and if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhu d'èi boe pahutu kètu na, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha nèngu pakab'ua dhèu èmu na, be'a risi nèngu g'ute pabab'a rèu kètu na. te ngaa ladhe nèngu rasa kètu na kahoni pamakae nèngu, hua iia nèngu pahutu kètu na.

source_text: a man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of god; but the woman is the glory of man.
target_text: ngee sèku sèmi ne'e: dhèu mone parluu boe hutu kètu na, te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu mone madhutu raropa na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. aa dhèu bhèni kahèi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha dhèu mone.

source_text: for man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
target_text: te lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, na tao boe dhèu mone nèti dhèu bhèni. te ngaa paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone.

source_text: neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
target_text: aa lamatua tao boe dhèu mone hia mi dhèu bhèni. te ngaa na pangèd'u dhèu bhèni mi dhèu mone.

source_text: for this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
target_text: de hua iia risi dhèu bhèni pahutu kètu ho dhèu re'a, na, nèngu pake hak na ho sabaj'a aa lole lii moa lamatua, madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ana pajuu nèti sorga re'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: in the lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, bhèni dènge mone bisa boe èci-èci ka tao unu na.

source_text: for just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. but everything comes from god.
target_text: ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru ku dhèu mone. hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone. te ngaa èle èèna ka, dhèu bhèni ka dhu nara iisi dhèu mone. aa ama lamatua ka dhu tao aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i.

source_text: judge for yourselves: is it proper for a woman to pray to god with her head uncovered?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe dhèu bhèni pahutu boe kètu ho sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, be'a, do aad'o?

source_text: doesn't nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
target_text: madhutu ad'a miu ètu kota korintus, ladhe dhèu mone rèu kètu madhera, èèna pamakae nèngu, do?

source_text: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? for long hair is given to her as a covering.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni dhu rèu kètu na madhera, be'a titu kèna, si? lamatua hia ne rèu kètu madhera ho pa'abhe kab'a kètu na. èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: if anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu loe boe pakarèi nèti j'ara ne'e, sanèd'e, te nèti ji'i dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at, aa nèti juma'at-juma'at, ne'e ne dhu tema le j'aj'i ètu talora èdhi.

source_text: in the following instructions i have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo padhai lii ca j'ara. te ngaa lii ne koa-kad'iri boe miu. te ropa miu pakaboko, miu tao boe j'ara dhu lèke, te ngaa miu asa tao maruru.

source_text: first of all, i hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part i believe it.
target_text: partama, dhu ja'a tadèngi, na, lod'o miu pakaboko tao kasasi, miu dhu mae-manyèla. nèti lii dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tatu abhu cahag'e dhu lèke tare'a.

source_text: and indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
target_text: mema, lula mamae-manyèla miu èèna ka, bisa te'a cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lamatua èdhi, aa mia dhu nanene boe.

source_text: now then, when you come together, it is not the lord's supper you eat.
target_text: te lod'o miu dhèu sarani pakaboko ho mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku mi lamatua yesus. èèna ka dhu lèke. te ngaa miu tao boe sèmi èèna.

source_text: for as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. while one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
target_text: tadha na, nuka ropa miu madhèdi mi'a, abhu dhu mate boe dhèu leo, abhu dhu ra'a dènge gagoo, aa abhu leo dhu rinu mahu. toke abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu abhu boe pala, ka ra manganga.

source_text: don't you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? or do you despise the church of god and humiliate those who have nothing? what can i say to you? shall i praise you for this? no, i will not!
target_text: tasamia ka ne! ? miu dènge boe èmu ho mi'a-minu, do? do, miu neo pa'ele iie kolongara juma'at lamatua? do, miu neo pamakae dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra? miu neo ja'a padhai lii tasamia hari? neo sèna ka ja'a koa-kad'iri miu ètu d'ara tatao miu ne, do? baku maena!

source_text: for i received from the lord what i also passed on to you: the lord jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took bread,
target_text: lamatua yesus ka dhu peka unu na dènge ja'a j'ara ne, de ja'a peka hari dènge miu. peka na, ropa dhèu pa'èra neo pamadhe ne, mèda èèna nèngu nare roti cue.

source_text: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, this is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.
target_text: hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi'a roti ne, te ne'e ne ngi'u ja'a, dhu mae hia miu. de miu hud'i mi'a roti ne, sèna ka sanèd'e ja'a.

source_text: in the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, this cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of me.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge galaa dhu isi èi anggor, aku nèngu na, èi anggor ne, sasoa na, ama lamatua neo pa'èki lii padhadha hiu dènge miu. ka ja'a hud'i pasuti raa ja'a toke madhe, heka lii padhadha èèna j'aj'i. lod'o-lod'o miu minu èi anggor sèmi ne'e, miu hud'i ngee mèdhi ku mamadhe ja'a.

source_text: for as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the lord's death until he comes.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o miu tao j'ara sèmi ne'e, ho mi'a roti dènge minu nèti galaa sèmi ne'e, toke kristus lèpa hari mai, èèna nuka sèmi miu palolo hari mamadhe na.

source_text: therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the lord.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o dhèu ra'a roti dènge rinu nèti galaa èèna, sèna ka sanèd'e kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'ara na mola boe dènge dhèu leo, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne. lula, èèna ngi'u dènge raa nèti lamatua yesus. de ladhe d'ara dhu mola mèka, na, nèngu nia boe na'a dènge ninu, lula j'ara èèna pahahe lamatua yesus.

source_text: each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
target_text: be'a risi ca dhèu-dhèu ka parisa uuru ku d'ara na. ladhe d'ara na dhu mola le, heka bisa na'a roti aa ninu èi anggor kèna.

source_text: for anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhu ra'a dènge rinu dhu d'ara ra koe-kapengo. te ra pangee, na, mamadhe yesus èèna, dènge boe kab'ua. ngi'u yesus dènge boe sasoa bagi mi ja'a. dhèu sèmi se'e se, bèli-camèd'a dui rare pala ra, lula hahuku dhu sadia tèke le.

source_text: that is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ètu talora aae miu sèra, abhu dhu èra boe, abhu dhu lèke papèd'a-tarègu, aa abhu dhu madhe le.

source_text: now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parisa paie-iie d'ara èdhi, èdhi abhu boe huku sèmi sèra.

source_text: but when we are judged by the lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi huku èdhi, na tao sèmi èèna sèna ka aj'a-nori èdhi ho èdhi madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te nèngu d'èi boe ladhe èdhi lèke huku sama sèmi dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko ho mi'a-minu ètu mei lamatua, èci hud'i mate ku èci.

source_text: if anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. and when i come, i will give instructions about the remaining matters.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu taha boe manganga, be'a risi mi'a uuru ku ètu èmu, sèna ka ropa miu pakaboko pa'èci, baku abhu dhu lèke huku. j'ara leo dhu miu karèi sèra, pe ja'a dhiu ku, heka ator si kèna.

source_text: now about spiritual gifts, brothers, i do not want you to be uninformed.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe miu me'a mèu nèti koasa dènge karunya dhu roh lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi pake.

source_text: you know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
target_text: miu dhu me'a, na, lod'o miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu lamatua, miu sogo-tagu mèdha dhu lii aad'o sèra. miu madhutu rèngu iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: therefore i inform you that no one who is speaking by the spirit of god says, jesus be cursed, and no one can say, jesus is lord, except by the holy spirit.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu me'a, na, tatu boe abhu dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, dhoo-saseo yesus èèna! aa tatu dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka na, yesus èèna, lamatua ja'a!

source_text: there are different gifts, but the same spirit.
target_text: roh lamatua hia mi dhèu èci-èci ka dènge karunya na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge sasab'a-la'a ra. te ngaa karunya sèra mai nèti roh èci di.

source_text: there are different ministries, but the same lord.
target_text: dhèu abhu karunya rupa-rupa ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu nanene dhoka lamatua èci di.

source_text: there are different ways of working, but the same god works all things in all people.
target_text: dhèu unu rupa-rupa sasab'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a lamatua, èèna j'aj'i lula ama lamatua di dhu soru-bara rèngu ho ra pakako sasab'a-la'a sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: now to each one the manifestation of the spirit is given for the common good.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo roh na mi mamuri dhèu dènge j'ara dhu baka-leo hua, te ngaa dad'èi na sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra sama-sama abhu babe'a.

source_text: to one there is given through the spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same spirit,
target_text: lamatua pangèd'u koasa roh na mi dhèu unu na. ka cahag'e abhu koasa, sèna ka ngangee madhera ho nori dhu lèke. cahag'e abhu koasa ho peka paled'a ngaa dhu rèngu re'a dènge be'a.

source_text: to another faith by the same spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one spirit,
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka parcaya pa'èra mi ama lamatua, lula rèngu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge roh na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. cahag'e hari lole lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na. cahag'e abhu koasa sèna ka re'a, roh mia ka mai nèti ama lamatua, aa mia ka dhu aad'o. cahag'e hari, abhu koasa ho bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. aa cahag'e hari, bisa peka sasoa nèti lii sèra.

source_text: all these are the work of one and the same spirit, who apportions them to each one as he determines.
target_text: te ngaa dhodhoka roh èci di dhu bisa tao rèngu, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a ra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pangèd'u mi dhèu èci-èci, ka rèngu bisa sab'a madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua èèna.

source_text: the body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. and although its parts are many, they all form one body. so it is with christ.
target_text: ja'a neo pasoro karunya sèra dènge ngi'u dhèu. ngi'u èci, te ngaa bagian na ae-ae. te ngaa bagian se, pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci di. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu unu kristus sèra.

source_text: for in one spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether jews or greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one spirit to drink.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'èki dènge roh èci di. nèti èèna ka, lod'o èdhi abhu sarani, èdhi nuka sèmi ca suku. masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do dhèu bebas, ama lamatua pala hia èdhi roh èci di. èèna nuka sèmi tinu èi dhu hia mamuri nèti madha èi èci di.

source_text: for the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
target_text: tare'a, ngi'u ne nèti boe ca bagian di. te na j'aj'i nèti bagian ae-ae.

source_text: if the foot should say, because i am not a hand, i do not belong to the body, that would not make it any less a part of the body.
target_text: ladhe sèmi haga èu, peka na, ja'a ne, kacui-aai boe. de ja'a j'aj'i boe bagian nèti ngi'u èu. masi ka nèngu peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i bagian nèti ngi'u èu era. tare'a, si?

source_text: and if the ear should say, because i am not an eye, i do not belong to the body, that would not make it any less a part of the body.
target_text: aa ladhe dhilu èu peka na, ja'a ne, musi madha boe. de ja'a ne j'aj'i boe bagian nèti ngi'u èu. masi ka na peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu bagian nèti ngi'u èu kahèi.

source_text: if the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? if the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
target_text: pangee sèku! ladhe ngi'u èu dhoka musi madha di, tasamia èu bisa tadèngi? aa ladhe ngi'u èu dhoka rèu dhilu di, tasamia ho èu bisa sangèd'u?

source_text: but in fact, god has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to his design.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, ama lamatua tao èdhi j'aj'i mi èci sama sèmi ngi'u èci, ka nèngu ator bagian se madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: if they were all one part, where would the body be?
target_text: ladhe ngi'u ne dhoka ca bagian di, ngara na ‘ngi'u' boe, sina ma?

source_text: as it is, there are many parts, but one body.
target_text: te dhu lèke ka, ngi'u èdhi ne, dènge bagian ae-ae. se'e ka tao ne j'aj'i ngi'u kateme aae.

source_text: the eye cannot say to the hand, i do not need you. nor can the head say to the feet, i do not need you.
target_text: musi madha bisa boe pahahe kacui-aai, dhu peka na, ja'a parluu boe èu! aa kètu bisa boe peka dènge haga na, ja'a dale boe èu!

source_text: on the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
target_text: dhu lèke mola-mola ka, nuka, abhu bagian nèti ngi'u dhu roe, aa dhu dènge kab'ua ae boe, te ngaa èdhi parluu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. and our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
target_text: abhu bagian dhu èdhi pangee, na, rèngu se gaguna ra ae boe, te ngaa èdhi haduli si paie-iie. aa abhu bagian dhu èdhi makae pacèu, ka pahutu pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. but god has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
target_text: te ngaa bagian dhu pamakae boe èdhi, èdhi tao boe si ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua oru nare bagian aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. ka nèngu ator sèna ka bagian dhu èdhi pangee, na, dhu dènge boe kab'ua, èdhi ladhe-leru si be'a-be'a,

source_text: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
target_text: te lamatua d'èi boe ngi'u èdhi pahag'a. dad'èi na sèna ka bagian se èci soru-bara èci.

source_text: if one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
target_text: te ladhe bagian èci paraga dènge susa, na, aa'i-aa'i ra susa kahèi. aa ladhe ra pakab'ua èci, na, aa'i-aa'i karej'e kahèi.

source_text: now you are the body of christ, and each of you is a member of it.
target_text: èci èèna ka dènge miu. te miu sama sèmi ngi'u kristus dhu kateme. dhèu parcaya èci-èci nuka sèmi ca bagian nèti ngi'u kristus.

source_text: and in the church god has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.
target_text: te ètu talora miu dhèu parcaya, ama lamatua hia koasa sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a, nuka: partama, lamatua pua-paleha dhèu cahag'e ho lasi lole lii moa na. ka dua, na pake dhèu cahag'e, j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai nèngu. ka tèlu, na hia dhèu cahag'e d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti nèngu. aa na hia koasa mi dhèu cahag'e, sèna ka bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa ho pad'elo dadedha na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. cahag'e hari abhu karunya ho soru-bara dhèu. cahag'e hari abhu karunya sèna ka uri dhèu ho sab'a sama-sama dènge be'a. aa lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu cahag'e hari, ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii.

source_text: are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? do all work miracles?
target_text: de ngangee miu tasamia? ama lamatua pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i ho lasi peka-padhai lii moa na, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori, do? aad'o. na hia koasa mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa, do? aad'o.

source_text: do all have gifts of healing? do all speak in tongues? do all interpret?
target_text: na hia koasa mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèna ka puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho bisa bhoke paled'a sasoa nèti lii se'e, do? aad'o.

source_text: but eagerly desire the greater gifts. and now i will show you the most excellent way.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema-mema ho sèmi mere aa pake karunya dènge be'a dhu hia gaguna mi dhèu ae. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a neo pad'elo j'ara dhu hua iia risi hia miu.

source_text: if i speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, i am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a bisa padhai lii pake lii aa'i-aa'i, nèti dhèu rai-haha do, lii nèti ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, te ngaa dènge boe sasue ciki sa ètu d'ara ja'a, kolo-karisi na ngaa? lii padhai ja'a sèra mola mèu lao, sama sèmi babha dhu lii cère-cère, do nuka sèmi dere dhu lii dhèru-dhèru di.

source_text: if i have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if i have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, i am nothing.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a dènge karunya ho lole peka lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na, aa dhu ke'a aa'i rahasia, dènge ke'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu se re'a, aa ladhe lalèka ja'a èra mi lamatua toke ja'a bisa pahari eele ledhe nèti era na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, na, gaguna na ngaa? rui-j'aj'èra ja'a guna boe mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: if i give all i possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, i gain nothing.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pahie eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ja'a, ho sèna ka kab'ua ra panga'a dhèu unu aad'o, do, soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban, te ngaa ladhe ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, gaguna na ngaa? ja'a dènge boe j'ara dhu tao ja'a nged'e. te sèra sa parcuma! guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: love is patient, love is kind. it does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
target_text: te sasue èèna, d'ara taleo. sasue èèna, lii mako. sasue èèna, d'ara kura boe. sasue èèna, padedha boe iisi. sasue èèna, pamone-pabhèni boe.

source_text: it is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
target_text: sasue èèna, lii sakaa boe. sasue èèna, neo boe pasegi ngi'u unu na. sasue èèna, nasa malai boe. sasue èèna, tèka boe d'ara.

source_text: love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.
target_text: sasue èèna, karej'e dènge ngaa dhu lèke, aa d'èi boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: it bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
target_text: sasue èèna, taha taruu ètu d'ara madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i. sasue èèna, parcaya taruu. sasue èèna, sanao-maena taruu. sasue èèna, ma'ète boe.

source_text: love never fails. but where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.
target_text: sasue dènge boe too-lane. te, ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka le, nèbhu-nèbhu parluu heka. aa dhu dhèu padhai pake lii rupa-rupa, bèli-camèd'a parluu heka kahèi. aa ladhe ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra re'a, nèbhu-nèbhu guna heka kahèi.

source_text: for we know in part and we prophesy in part,
