target_text: limuri ne dhu te'a dhoka ciki oo'e di. aa ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu tèti lii padhai lamatua, èdhi peka dhoka j'ara dhu dhae tesa mèka.

source_text: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, aa'i-aa'i sèra tesa dhe'i-dhe'i. lod'o èèna j'ara-j'ara dhu tesa mèka, guna heka mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: when i was a child, i talked like a child, i thought like a child, i reasoned like a child. when i became a man, i set aside childish ways.
target_text: conto sèmi: lod'o ja'a ana iiki era, ja'a padhai lii sama sèmi ana iiki. ngangee ja'a sama sèmi mia dhu ana iiki pangee. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a dhèu ee'a le. nèti èèna ka, tatao ja'a sèmi heka ana iiki.

source_text: now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. now i know in part; then i shall know fully, even as i am fully known.
target_text: conto leo: limuri ne, èdhi tèdhi rango-rango era, dhae mèu iia mèka, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe asa d'ara tèru dhu ahu. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu pe aa'i-aa'i se mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe padètu iiki-iiki ètu madha èdhi. ne'e ne, ja'a ke'a dhoka ciki di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu bisa ke'a aa'i, nuka sèmi ama lamatua ladhe madhore d'ai adhe-usu ja'a.

source_text: and now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
target_text: de limuri ne, abhu tèlu j'ara dhu èdhi hud'i tao, dhu taha taruu. nuka: èdhi hud'i parcaya taruu lamatua; èdhi sanao-maena taruu, na, pe lamatua ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i be'a; aa èdhi hud'i pasue taruu. nèti tèlu j'ara se, dhu dedha risi ka, sasue. lula sasue ka dhu hua risi nèti aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka pasue ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. te abhu heka j'ara leo dhu dedha risi. aa tenge j'ara kahèi, sèna ka roh lamatua hia miu koasa dènge karunya, ho bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. aa dhu be'a, nuka, ladhe miu abhu karunya sèna ka lole lii moa lamatua.

source_text: for he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to god. indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the spirit.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu abhu karunya ho padhai lii pake lii leo, roh lamatua hia ne koasa sèna ka peka paled'a j'ara dhu mèu iia mèka. te ngaa nèngu padhai lii boe dènge dhèu leo, te padhai lii dhoka dènge lamatua di. dhèu dhu pa'èci dènge ne ètu sèra, abhu boe èci sa dhu re'a lii padhai nèngu.

source_text: but he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu abhu karunya ho lole lii moa lamatua, na, nèngu peka lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra. nèngu pa'èra ku parcaya dhèu mi lamatua, pa'èra d'ara dhèu, aa pakarej'e d'ara dhèu susa.

source_text: the one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
target_text: dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, nèngu pa'èra dhoka ngi'u nèngu mesa na di. te ngaa dhèu dhu padhue-padhai lii moa lamatua èèna, nèngu pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko dènge ne, sèna ka juma'at kateme asa tabha èra.

source_text: i wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but i would rather have you prophesy. he who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. te ngaa ja'a d'èi risi, ladhe miu bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te dhèu dhu peka lii moa lamatua èèna, guna risi nèti dhèu dhu dhoka padhai pake lii leo di. ladhe padhai pake lii leo, èèna be'a, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu bisa peka paled'a sasoa na. dènge sèmi èèna, lii moa sèra bisa asa pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu juma'at, sèna ka re'a mèu.

source_text: now, brothers, if i come to you speaking in tongues, how will i benefit you, unless i bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pangee sèku j'ara ne. ladhe sèmi ja'a dhiu ngad'o miu ho padhai pake lii dhu miu me'a boe sasoa na, miu abhu oto na ngaa? aad'o, si? te ngaa ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge miu, be'a risi ja'a peka dènge miu dad'èi lamatua. be'a risi ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka. be'a risi ja'a aj'a-nori miu ho me'a mèu risi hari j'ara sèra. be'a risi ja'a pasanèd'e miu lii holo-nori lamatua. be'a risi aj'a-nori miu. dènge j'ara sèmi sèra, heka miu abhu oto kèna, si?

source_text: even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge alat musiik. se'e se mèdha madhe, te ngaa lii ra rupa-rupa. pake sakino do, sasadhu do, gitar do, ladhe pangèci boe lii na, tatu dhèu re'a boe lii sod'a sèmi ngaa, si?

source_text: again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
target_text: ladhe lii tèbhe mèu iia boe, na, tasa mera mia sordad'u bisa re'a, na, rèngu hud'i tao ngaa mi musu ra? bisa boe, si?

source_text: so it is with you. unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? you will just be speaking into the air.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ladhe miu padhai lii, pake lii dhu dhèu bisa boe re'a mèu, èèna nuka sèmi miu padhai lii dènge lai ngèlu. parcuma, te dhèu bisa boe dhane rare lii padhai èu!

source_text: assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne abhu lii ae titu kèna. lii se, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: if, then, i do not know the meaning of someone's language, i am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a ke'a boe lii dhèu leo, bagi ja'a lii ne dènge boe kab'ua. ja'a ke'a boe lii rèngu, aa rèngu re'a boe lii ja'a kahèi. ji'i baga taa, aa j'aj'i sèmi dhèu leo rai kara sa.

source_text: it is the same with you. since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu neo abhu karunya dènge koasa nèti lamatua. èèna be'a. te ngaa be'a risi ladhe miu tenge j'ara ho abhu koasa dènge karunya dhu miu bisa pake sèna ka pa'èra dhèu parcaya sèra!

source_text: therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
target_text: de dhèu dhu padhai pake lii leo, be'a risi nèngu sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia ne karunya kahèi, ho peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna.

source_text: for if i pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii leo, ja'a sabaj'a pake d'ara ja'a, te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a padhai lii èèna.

source_text: what then shall i do? i will pray with my spirit, but i will also pray with my mind. i will sing with my spirit, but i will also sing with my mind.
target_text: de babe'a na, ja'a tao tasamia? ja'a pake dua-dua, te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake d'ara ja'a, aa ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii dhu ke'a mèu kahèi. ja'a neo sod'a pake lii sod'a koa-kio mi lamatua nèti d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a bisa sod'a kahèi, pake lii dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say amen to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
target_text: te ladhe èu pake lii leo ho koa-kio ama lamatua nèti d'ara èu, te ngaa abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu re'a boe lii deo na, tasamia nèngu bisa d'ara èci dènge èu? lod'o èu manèngi makasi mi lamatua pake lii leo, tasamia dhèu èèna bisa nare lii èci dènge èu, ka na peka na, lèke kèna! bisa boe, si? te nèngu ne'a boe lii padhai èu deo na.

source_text: you may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
target_text: èu bisa manèngi makasi sèmi èèna kahèi mi lamatua. te ngaa èèna pa'èra boe d'ara dhèu leo.

source_text: i thank god that i speak in tongues more than all of you.
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, te ngaa ja'a padhai lii pake lii leo risi nèti miu. aa ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula nèngu hia ja'a bisa padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: but in the church, i would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, na, be'a risi ja'a padhai lii dhoka lèmi hèb'a dhu bab'a te ngaa re'a mèu, sèna ka aj'a-nori si. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii pamadhera-dhera pake lii leo, dènge pake lii riho-riho hèb'a dhu re'a boe, na, gaguna na aad'o.

source_text: brothers, stop thinking like children. in regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu neo me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara, na, miu hud'i pangee nuka sèmi dhèu ee'a. mage pangee sèmi ana iiki! te ngaa re j'ara bhelu-katub'a, miu hud'i nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe tao bhabhelu, lula d'ara ra dhu mèu aadha-aadha.

source_text: it is written in the law: by strange tongues and foreign lips i will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to me, says the lord.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua èdhi peka, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo pake dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo sèra, ho padhai lii dènge dhèu isra'el. masi ka ja'a peka tasamia èèna ka, te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a. '

source_text: tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu dhu parcaya mèka lamatua, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. j'ara ne'e soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa ladhe dhèu lole lii moa lamatua, na, ne'e ne ka soru-bara rèngu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus.

source_text: so if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pakaboko, ka miu padhai lii pake lii baka-leo, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a boe j'ara se'e, maso dhiu asa talora aae miu, dhèu se ngee sèmi ngaa sa? tatu ra peka na, dhèu ètu se'e se, huj'u aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: but if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
target_text: aa ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i dhu padhue-padhai ho peka paled'a lii moa lamatua, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a mèu mèka j'ara-j'ara se, maso dhiu asa talora miu. tatu dhèu ne, neo nanene lii padhai miu. de, ngaa dhu miu peka-padhai sèra, pad'elo sasala na, toke neo parisa mamuri na d'ai lutu.

source_text: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. so he will fall facedown and worship god, proclaiming, god is truly among you!
target_text: ka bhabhelu dhu nèngu pahuni ètu d'ara na, èèna na bhoka patalele, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ètu talora aae miu di!

source_text: what then shall we say, brothers? when you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. all of these must be done to build up the church.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko, èci-èci ka dènge karunya na. abhu dhu sod'a koa-kio ama lamatua. abhu dhu aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti lamatua. abhu dhu peka paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni era. abhu dhu padhai pake lii leo. aa abhu dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo sèra. j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, rèngu hud'i tao ku ho pa'èra parcaya dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: if anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'èi padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna be'a. sad'i dua do tèlu dhèu di, baku pa'ae-ae. dhèu èci padhai lii uuru, èle ku heka dhèu leo kèna. aa hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka sasoa na.

source_text: but if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and god.
target_text: ladhe sèmi abhu boe dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna, na, baku padhai lii pake lii leo ètu katanga madha dhèu ae-ae. hud'i laa rèngu padhai lii ètu d'ara ra. rèngu bisa padhai lii dènge lamatua sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, dua do tèlu dhèu di dhu padhai lii, lole lii moa lamatua. dhèu leo hud'i dadoo ku lii padhai nèti dhèu dhu padhai sèra.

source_text: and if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua bhoke ca j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka mi ca dhèu dhu madhèdi nanene ètu èèna, na, nèngu hud'i peka paled'a lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu èèna. aa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha, hud'i ae eele nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka hia dhèu dhu heka tadèngi lii moa lamatua, ho na padhai lii.

source_text: for you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te ngaa ladhe padhai lii, na, èci uru, ladhe èle heka dhèu leo kèna. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa nanene, bisa re'a j'ara, aa bisa pa'èra d'ara ra.

source_text: the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu lole lii moa lamatua, hud'i ne'a ator ngi'u na. ka èci pamata dènge èci, aa dhèu leo taha uru.

source_text: for god is not a god of disorder, but of peace-as in all the churches of the saints.
target_text: te abhu boe maruru ètu ama lamatua, te ngaa mera dènge milu di. ètu mia-mia, ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, hud'i sèmi ne'e ku:

source_text: women are to be silent in the churches. they are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
target_text: dhèu bhèni madhèdi mau-mau, bisa boe padhai lii pa'ae. rèngu hud'i nanene kètu juma'at sèra. te atora ama lamatua peka sèmi èèna kahèi, si?

source_text: if they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu neo karèi j'ara èci, pe d'ai èmu ku heka karèi dhèu èmu na kèna. te ladhe bhèni maruru ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, sèra sa pamakae iisi ra!

source_text: did the word of god originate with you? or are you the only ones it has reached?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? te lii holo-nori ama lamatua mai boe nèti miu. aa lii holo-nori na hia boe miu mesa mi ètu kota korintus di! de pangee paie ku!

source_text: if anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what i am writing you is the lord's command.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu bisa lole lii moa lamatua, do pangee na, nèngu abhu koasa nèti roh lamatua, na, nèngu ne'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a suri hia miu sèra, atora dhu ja'a tao boe, te ngaa paredha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: but if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare j'ara se, na, miu baku sèmi mere dhèu ne.

source_text: so, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! tenge j'ara sèna ka miu abhu koasa ho bisa peka paled'a lii moa lamatua. aa mage kai dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku padhai pake lii leo.

source_text: but everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
target_text: de ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pakako aa'i-aa'i madhutu mola-mola. tao uuru ku èci, heka dhu leo kèna. pakako aa'i-aa'i dènge be'a, madhutu madha j'ara na. baku dènge maruru.

source_text: now, brothers, i want to remind you of the gospel i preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo sèna ka miu sanèd'e lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu uru èèna ja'a peka-padhai le dènge miu. miu sèmi mere, hèia tao taruu madhutu lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: by this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word i preached to you. otherwise, you have believed in vain.
target_text: te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri, sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra. te ngaa ladhe miu parcaya taruu boe ama lamatua, na, parcaya miu èèna ele iie d'ara.

source_text: for what i received i passed on to you as of first importance: that christ died for our sins according to the scriptures,
target_text: ja'a aj'a le miu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele, dhu uru èèna dhèu aj'a-nori ja'a. nuka: kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, madhe le sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the scriptures,
target_text: ra padhane ne. ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, lamatua pamamuri hari ne, lèke mola-mola sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua.

source_text: and that he appeared to cephas and then to the twelve.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kristus pad'elo iisi na mi petrus. nèngu pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra kahèi.

source_text: after that, he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
target_text: aa ca tèka, na pad'elo iisi na mi lèmi ngasu risi dhèu parcaya. dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ladhe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha rèngu. nèti rèngu se, ae dhu mamuri era, aa ciki di dhu madhe le.

source_text: then he appeared to james, then to all the apostles.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi mi yakobis. hèia nèngu pad'elo iisi kahèi, mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and last of all he appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
target_text: ja'a dhèu limuri tèka dhu ladhe kèdhi ne. te ja'a ne nuka sèmi ana dhu rara iisi limuri tèka.

source_text: for i am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because i persecuted the church of god.
target_text: dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra kapai risi nèti ja'a ne. madhutu mola-mola, na, ja'a nia boe j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te uru èèna, ja'a ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but by the grace of god i am what i am, and his grace to me was not in vain. no, i worked harder than all of them-yet not i, but the grace of god that was with me.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. hèia na tao ja'a j'aj'i sèmi ne'e ne. ropa nèngu tao j'ara be'a hia ja'a, na core eele boe lod'o iia d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ne'e ne ja'a sab'a bia risi nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra! ja'a mesa ku boe dhu sab'a, te ngaa d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu sab'a ètu mamuri ja'a.

source_text: whether, then, it was i or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a, do, dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo dhu aj'a-nori èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te a'aj'a ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi èèna dhoka ca j'ara di. ji'i peka-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i parcaya lii lolo be'a dhu sama èèna.

source_text: but if it is preached that christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
target_text: ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. de, nga tao ka miu cahag'e peka na, dhèu madhe sèra, mamuri hari boe? ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: if there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even christ has been raised.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, kristus mamuri hari boe kahèi!

source_text: and if christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
target_text: aa ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge dhèu, gaguna aad'o. aa lalèka miu mi kristus, parcuma kahèi!

source_text: in that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about god. for we have testified about god that he raised christ from the dead, but he did not raise him if in fact the dead are not raised. for if the dead are not raised, then not even christ has been raised.
target_text: aa ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, ji'i j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli mi ama lamatua. te ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kristus! mema tare'a dhu ji'i lole sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ladhe sèmi dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari boe kristus kahèi.

source_text: and if christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, lalèka miu mi ama lamatua parcuma! aa miu pasae taruu sasala-sasigo miu!

source_text: then those also who have fallen asleep in christ have perished.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu madhe le, ladhe kristus kèd'i boe nèti mamadhe na, rèngu madhe pacèri nèti ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: if our hope in christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
target_text: kristus j'aj'i era sarai èdhi, lula te'a, na, nèngu neo tao j'ara hua iia hia èdhi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi sanao-maena ho nèngu neo tao sèmi èèna dhoka ètu rai-haha di, na parcuma! aa èdhi j'aj'i dhèu kasia risi eele nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: but christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
target_text: aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, si? te dhu lèke mola-mola ka: kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri le nèti mamadhe na! aa mesa boe nèngu di, te èèna na dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari kahèi. kristus ne, nuka sèmi hua uru dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari madhutu nèngu.

source_text: for since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
target_text: uru-uru èèna, dhoka dhèu èci di, nuka adam dhu sisu paredha ama lamatua. de hahuku na, nuka mamadhe. hahuku ne noto mi èdhi dhèu rai-haha kahèi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu hari, nuka kristus, dhu mamuri madhutu paredha ama lamatua. de, lula babe'a nèngu ka dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari!

source_text: for as in adam all die, so in christ all will be made alive.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sisu paredha lamatua, lèke huku madhe sama sèmi adam kahèi. te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge kristus, èèna na ama lamatua pamamuri hari si.

source_text: but each in his own turn: christ the firstfruits; then at his coming, those who belong to him.
target_text: te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. kristus dhèu partama dhu mamuri hari, nuka sèmi hua uru deo na. aa pe na lèpa hari mai asa rai-haha ne, dhèu unu na sèra heka mamuri hari kèna.

source_text: then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to god the father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
target_text: èle ku, heka rai-haha ne èle kèna. lod'o èèna, kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu pa'ele iie koasa aa'i-aa'i, paredha aa'i-aa'i, aa mamèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pamusu dènge lamatua. nèngu j'aj'i kahèi dhèu aae dhu pangèd'u hari hak paredha na mi ama na, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: for he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
target_text: te ama lamatua hud'i nèd'u paredha taruu, toke na segi aa'i dhu lab'a kristus, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: the last enemy to be destroyed is death.
target_text: abhu ca j'ara dhu pamusu dènge èdhi era, nuka mamadhe. te ngaa d'ai limuri, ka lamatua segi kahèi koasa mamadhe. de lèpa lod'o limuri, dhèu madhe heka.

source_text: for god has put everything under his feet. now when it says that everything has been put under him, this clearly does not include the one who put everything under him.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lamatua tao dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna. de dhu suri, peka na, dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu nèngu, de lèke, ladhe peka na, ama lamatua pahaha boe iisi mi dhèu unu nèngu èèna. lula ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu mi ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and when all things have been subjected to him, then the son himself will be made subject to him who put all things under him, so that god may be all in all.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a ladhe aa'i-aa'i nanene tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èèna na ana ne pangèd'u aa'i-aa'i hari mi ama na, dhu ded'e ne j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra. èle èèna, ama lamatua paredha taruu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? if the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu neo sarani ho gati dhèu dhu madhe le dhu dhae sarani mèka. te ngaa ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, nga tao ka rèngu neo sarani hia dhèu madhe?

source_text: and why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
target_text: aa nga tao ka ji'i oe madhe pahari-pahari ètu d'ara sasab'a ji'i, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe?

source_text: i face death every day, brothers, as surely as i boast about you in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: te bèli-bèli ja'a oe madhe! te ngaa a'ari pasue! ja'a subha, te ja'a pangee, na, ngaa-ngaa tao boe ladhe ja'a madhe. te ja'a bisa boti kètu, lula miu pa'èki taruu dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua le mai.

source_text: if i fought wild beasts in ephesus for human motives, what did i gain? if the dead are not raised, let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, ja'a patao-palaha dènge dhèu sèra nuka sèmi badha hui dhu bhelu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a dhoka patao-palaha, ho bisa segi mesa ku, aa hia boe lamatua, èèna parcuma. guna boe ngaa-ngaa! te ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, hua iia èdhi madhutu dhu dhèu peka, na, mai èdhi pesta rame-rame, aa ta'a-tinu be'a-be'a, te bèli èdhi madhe kèna!

source_text: do not be deceived: bad company corrupts good character.
target_text: miu baku lèke tipu, ho pangee sèmi èèna! te abhu dhu peka na, ladhe èu pa'èci dènge dhèu bhelu, èèna pakaj'èu èu nèti mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of god. i say this to your shame.
target_text: ad'u-ue ia ka bhabhelu-katub'a! rèno ka! ator ngi'u mu! tao dhu lèke di! dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i me'a ku makae, te ètu talora aae miu, abhu era dhèu dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: but someone will ask, how are the dead raised? with what kind of body will they come?
target_text: abhu dhu pakarèi, na, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, j'ara na tasamia? aa ngi'u aae j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: you fool! what you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
target_text: goa, ee! te ladhe sèle hini, hini ne hud'i roe ètu d'ara rai uuru ku, heka na bisa muri kèna.

source_text: and what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
target_text: aa hini dhu èdhi sèle, rupa na leko-leo nèti dhu muri, èli, heka cèu rèu kèna. te nèngu èèna hini dhu mango-meto, nuka sèmi gandum, do are, do hini dhu leo.

source_text: but god gives it a body as he has designed, and to each kind of seed he gives its own body.
target_text: èci-èci ka madhutu raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula nèngu ka dhu ator raropa nèti ana aaj'u sèra.

source_text: not all flesh is the same: men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.
target_text: badha dènge dhèu rai-haha sèmi èèna kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia ngi'u dhèu rai-haha madhutu raropa dhèu rai-haha. ngi'u badha èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra. manu-bhui dènge raropa ra. i'a dènge raropa ra. dhu leo sèra dènge raropa ra.

source_text: there are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
target_text: abhu mèdha ètu dedha-liru, aa abhu ètu rai-haha. ètu dedha-liru dènge kolo-karisi na. te ngaa kolo-karisi ne, leko-leo nèti dhu ètu rai-haha. dhu ètu rai-haha abhu kolo-karisi kahèi. te ngaa kolo-karisi se, leko-leo nèti dhu abhu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: the sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru kolo-karisi madha lod'o leko-leo; kolo-karisi hèru leko-leo; aa kolo-karisi hua-hètu leko-leo kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge kolo-karisi ra. de aa'i-aa'i ra dènge kolo-karisi, si?

source_text: so will it be with the resurrection of the dead: what is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, èèna nuka sèmi hini deo na. te ladhe padhane ka dhèu madhe, ngi'u aae na ele iie, si? te ngaa ladhe mamuri hari, ngi'u na sèmi heka uru èèna. te ladhe mamuri hari, bisa heka madhe.

source_text: it is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
target_text: ropa èdhi padhane dhèu madhe, èdhi mad'enge ngi'u aae ne. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èèna mamuri hari, na saraga titu kèna! te nèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci! dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao ngaa-ngaa lod'o dhèu padhane ne. te ngaa ropa na mamuri hari, nèngu èra titu kèna!

source_text: it is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. if there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mamuri era, ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, si? te ngaa ropa na madhe, ho mamuri hari, na, roh lamatua hia ne mamuri dhu lèke. ka dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna.

source_text: so it is written: the first man adam became a living being; the last adam a life-giving spirit.
target_text: dhèu rai-haha dhu uru-uru j'ara, dhu sama sèmi èdhi, nuka adam. madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, nèngu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu mamuri, dhu ne'a ngee dènge rasa. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha dhu raropa na sama sèmi adam, dhu dedha risi eele, nuka kristus. roh na ka dhu bisa hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: the spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, ka bisa madhe. te ngaa dhu mamuri hari, nuka dhèu dhu abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti roh lamatua.

source_text: the first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara ètu rai-haha ne, dhu tao nèti ahu rai. te ngaa raropa ka dua, nuka kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: as was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
target_text: èdhi dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne ca ropa dènge dhèu partama dhu lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, ca ropa dènge kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
target_text: èdhi dhèu limuri ne, ca ropa dènge adam dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, gati dènge raropa hiu, sama sèmi kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: now i declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of god, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, sèmi ne'e: èdhi dhu ca ropa dènge dhèu partama, ngi'u èdhi j'aj'i nèti sisi dènge raa. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa boe abhu pusaka ho j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. bisa boe! te raropa dhèu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ngi'u ra ele iie, ka bisa boe sèmi rare ngaa dhu taha nare nèbhu.

source_text: listen, i tell you a mystery: we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed-
target_text: de nanene paie-iie! te ja'a neo bhoke paled'a rahasia èci. èèna na abhu dhèu parcaya cahag'e dhu madhe boe. te ngaa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èèna na gati raropa hiu.

source_text: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. for the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
target_text: ropa lii tiu tèbhe limuri tèka, aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i dènge sahèka. malai risi nèti ate musi madha. te ropa tèbhe limuri tèka lii, cag'ag'a laa dhèu madhe mamuri hari. aa ladhe ra mamuri hari, dhèu se madhe heka, aa ele iie heka. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu raropa hiu.

source_text: for the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality. when the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: death has been swallowed up in victory.
target_text: te ngi'u aae èdhi dhu bisa ele iie ne'e ne, j'aj'i ngi'u hiu dhu ele iie heka! aa èdhi dhu bisa madhe ne'e ne, neo ub'a j'aj'i raropa hiu dhu madhe heka! èèna madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua palaho eele le koasa mamadhe, aa segi le mamadhe! nèti èèna ka èdhi madhe heka.

source_text: where, o death, is your victory? where, o death, is your sting?
target_text: he, mamadhe! koasa èu ètu mia? he, mamadhe! dhudhu èu ètu mia?

source_text: the sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
target_text: nga tao ka mamadhe nèti rasa pèd'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha? lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala. tasamia ka sasala sèra dènge koasa? lula atora ama lamatua peka na, sasala èdhi, nuka sisu paredha na!

source_text: but thanks be to god, who gives us the victory through our lord jesus christ!
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i leko-leo le! de èdhi hud'i manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua. te nèngu ka tao èdhi bisa segi bhabhelu-katub'a lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. mema tare'a, te kristus ka dhu segi aa'i!

source_text: therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. always excel in the work of the lord, because you know that your labor in the lord is not in vain.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra d'ara! baku roe! sasab'a miu hia mi ama lamatua hud'i asa be'a, aa asa ae. te miu me'a le, na, sab'a bia hia lamatua èdhi èèna, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as i directed the churches of galatia:
target_text: ne'e ne, ja'a suri hia miu lula-nèti doi dhu miu pakaboko hia dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. ja'a peka le dènge dhèu parcaya ètu propensi galati, j'ara tasamia rèngu hud'i pakaboko doi èèna. miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: on the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when i come no collections will be needed.
target_text: ladhe hari migu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i pa'oru doi ciki nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu. baku mate ja'a dhiu ku, heka miu parai-oru kèna.

source_text: then, on my arrival, i will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to jerusalem.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a dhiu, miu paj'uj'u dhèu dhu miu lèka, sèna ka rèti doi soru-bara sèra asa dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. pe ja'a suri sasuri ho patadha rèngu dènge kètu juma'at ètu nèi.

source_text: and if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
target_text: aa ladhe miu ngee, na, be'a ladhe ja'a madhutu hèi, na, ji'i la'a palere.

source_text: after i go through macedonia, however, i will come to you; for i will be going through macedonia.
target_text: ladhe ja'a kako palème le propensi makedonia, ja'a heka dhiu asa miu kèna. de mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a hud'i laku uuru ku asa makedonia.

source_text: perhaps i will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever i go.
target_text: èle èèna, pe ja'a dhiu pea taha dènge miu ako panèbhu ciki; ele boe d'ai èle hèru pacuhi. hèia miu bisa lere ja'a asa era leo hari.

source_text: for i do not want to see you now only in passing; i hope to spend some time with you, if the lord permits.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, ja'a dhiu ne ca lod'o boe di. te ja'a neo pea dènge miu ako panèbhu, ladhe lamatua d'èi.

source_text: but i will stay in ephesus until pentecost,
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo pea era ètu kota epesus ne, toke lod'o babe'a pantekosta, nuka lèmi nguru lod'o èle kalela paska.

source_text: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
target_text: lula ètu ne'e ja'a abhu lod'o taleo ae, ho sab'a taruu, masi ka abhu dhèu ae dhu lab'a sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: if timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the lord, just as i am.
target_text: ladhe timotius j'aj'i dhiu paraga dènge miu, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, sèna ka baku na ngee rupa-rupa. te nèngu ne dhèu sab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sama sèmi ja'a ne kahèi.

source_text: no one, then, should treat him with contempt. send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for i am expecting him along with the brothers.
target_text: mage soro tèke dhèu laladhe ne dènge hui madha di. soru-bara ne toke na lèpa asa ja'a dènge be'a. te ja'a dènge a'ari dhu leo se, dhu mate tatae ne.

source_text: now about our brother apollos: i strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. he was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
target_text: ca j'ara era dhu miu hud'i me'a ku. ja'a dhu pamako le angalai èdhi apolos, ho na dhiu pangad'o dènge a'ari dhu leo. te ngaa no'o mèka dhiu. de mi mate, pe na abhu lod'o taleo, heka na dhiu kèna.

source_text: be on the alert. stand firm in the faith. be men of courage. be strong.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga ngi'u miu paie-iie! miu hud'i pa'èra-èra ho parcaya taruu ama lamatua! mage madha'u! pa'èra iisi!

source_text: do everything in love.
target_text: sad'i miu sab'a ngaa èèna ka, pad'elo la sasue.

source_text: you know that stephanas and his household were the first converts in achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. now i urge you, brothers,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu me'a, na, stefanus dènge isi èmu na ka dhèu partama dhu parcaya kristus ètu propensi akaya nèi. rèngu sab'a re'a boe j'èra, sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu parcaya ètu nèi. de ja'a manèngi ho

source_text: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
target_text: miu nanene dhèu sèmi sèra. nuka rèngu dhu sab'a bia ho sama-sama lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: i am glad that stephanas, fortunatus, and achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
target_text: d'ara ja'a neo dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu. d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, lula mamai stefanus, fortunatus dènge akaikus asa ne'e. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa gati miu.

source_text: for they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.
target_text: tèlu ra pa'èra d'ara ja'a, sama sèmi ra pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi. miu hud'i pakab'ua dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: the churches in the province of asia send you greetings. aquila and prisca greet you warmly in the lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
target_text: juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi asia hia miu lii maho'o. akila dènge dhèu èmu na, priskila, aa dhèu leo dhu tema pakaboko ètu èmu ra, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhu pa'èki kahèi dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: all the brothers here send you greetings. greet one another with a holy kiss.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi. ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci, pake uu dhu nia hia dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: this greeting is in my own hand-paul.
target_text: mi laladhe! te ja'a, paulus, suri dènge kacui-aai unu ku: saloom!

source_text: if anyone does not love the lord, let him be under a curse. come, o lord!
target_text: dhèu cee dhu sue boe kètu èdhi, pe ama lamatua huku ne. ja'a d'èi tabea dhèu madhutu lii aram èdhi dhèu yahudi, dhu peka, marana ta! dhu sasoa na, lamatua! mai ka!

source_text: the grace of the lord jesus be with you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: my love be with all of you in christ jesus. amen.
target_text: ja'a sue miu aa'i-aa'i mi, lula èdhi pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. sasuri ja'a sèmi ne'e ka. saloom! nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of christ jesus by the will of god, and timothy our brother, to the church of god in corinth, together with all the saints throughout achaia:
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a sèna ka laku lole lula-nèti yesus kristus dènge dhèu asa mia-mia. yesus kristus èèna, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. ari èdhi timotius ètu ne'e kahèi. na hia lii maho'o. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne'e mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu biasa pakaboko ètu kota korintus dènge propensi akaya.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, nuka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra dènge miu, sèna ka miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ, the father of compassion and the god of all comfort,
target_text: dad'èi ji'i ka ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rasa kasia aa'i-aa'i kapua nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi.

source_text: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from god.
target_text: nèngu ka pamaho'o d'ara èdhi ladhe èdhi ètu d'ara sasusa. nèti èèna ka, èdhi kahèi bisa pamaho'o dhèu leo dhu paraga dènge sasusa. te èdhi bisa pa'èra d'ara rèngu, sama sèmi lamatua pa'èra le d'ara èdhi.

source_text: for just as the sufferings of christ overflow to us, so also through christ our comfort overflows.
target_text: kristus abhu le susa ae-ae hia èdhi. de, lula kristus rasa le susa sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama na pa'èra d'ara èdhi taruu, ladhe èdhi paraga dènge susa.

source_text: if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
target_text: ladhe ji'i ètu ne'e abhu susa, ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara ji'i. aa ladhe ji'i paraga dènge j'aj'èra, hèia taha dènge d'ara taleo, na, miu hud'i me'a kahèi, lamatua pake j'ara sèmi ne'e sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, ho patalale miu nèti koasa bhabhelu-katub'a. te ladhe miu abhu sasusa sama sèmi ji'i, lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka miu bisa taha mere dènge d'ara taleo kahèi.

source_text: and our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a mèu, na, miu bisa taha mere dènge èra. te ji'i nge'a, na, ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi ji'i, lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, aa nèngu pa'èra d'ara ji'i kahèi.

source_text: we do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of asia. we were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ji'i sèna ka miu me'a mèu sasusa dhu ji'i abhu ètu propensi asia. ji'i rasa bia, risi nèti dhu ji'i bisa pasae, toke ji'i oe ele ngangee, lula ji'i pangee, na, ji'i madhe kèna.

source_text: indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in god, who raises the dead.
target_text: ji'i rasa bia, nuka sèmi dhèu èci ropa tadèngi hakim pama'ète hahuku pamadhe ne. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, sèna ka ji'i parcaya ama lamatua, aa baku parcaya ngi'u ji'i unu mi. te lamatua èèna ka dhu unu koasa ho pamamuri hari dhèu madhe.

source_text: he has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us. in him we have placed our hope that he will yet again deliver us,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pakaj'èu le ji'i nèti bhabhelu, lod'o ji'i oe madhe. bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pakaj'èu ji'i nèti bhabhelu-katub'a kahèi. aa ji'i ma'ète boe sanao, sèna ka na pakaj'èu taruu ji'i nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: as you help us by your prayers. then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.
target_text: ladhe miu loe boe sabaj'a hia ji'i, èèna ka soru-bara ji'i kahèi, te ama lamatua neo tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae hia mi ji'i. nèngu tao j'ara èèna, lula dhèu ae dhu sabaj'a hia ji'i. hèia lod'o dhèu ae sanèd'e ji'i, rèngu manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and this is our boast: our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from god-not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of god.
target_text: ji'i bisa koa-kad'iri iisi ji'i, lula ji'i nge'a ètu d'ara iiki ji'i, ngaa dhu ji'i ad'u-ue ètu rai-haha ne, madhutu dad'èi lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ji'i. ji'i rai boe nèti sasab'a-la'a ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi ji'i sab'a dènge d'ara mola. ji'i pakako sasab'a ji'i, pake boe mamèu dhu mai nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa mamèu dhu kapua na nèti ama lamatua. te lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa asa tabha èra ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a lod'o ji'i bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: for we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. and i hope that you will understand us completely,
target_text: ja'a suri hia miu dhodhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu miu bisa baca aa bisa me'a mèu. limuri ne miu me'a le naneo ja'a cahag'e. te ngaa ja'a sanao, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a miu bisa me'a mèu risi hari.

source_text: as you have already understood us in part, so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our lord jesus.
target_text: ne'e ne, miu me'a ciki era lula-nèti ji'i se. te ngaa èèna na, lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mai hari ka, ja'a ke'a, na, miu me'a j'ara ae-ae. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa koa-kad'iri ji'i, sama sèmi ji'i koa-kad'iri miu kahèi.

source_text: confident of this, i planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, nèti èèna ka ca hari na, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho dhiu ngad'o hari miu, sèna ka miu bisa abhu mèngi-nale dua hari.

source_text: i wanted to visit you on my way to macedonia, and to return to you from macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to judea.
target_text: de uru èèna ja'a dhu pangee, ladhe j'aj'i laku asa propensi makedonia, na, ja'a bisa dhuli ngad'o miu. ho ladhe ja'a lèpa nèti makedonia, ja'a bisa dhuli hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa soru-bara ja'a, ho bisa laku taruu asa propensi yudea.

source_text: when i planned this, did i do it carelessly? or do i make my plans by human standards, so as to say yes, yes when i really mean no, no?
target_text: te ngaa tasamia? lod'o-lod'o ja'a peka, neo dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, ele boe mi pangee, na, ja'a uri kore mèka, si? do, miu pangee, na, ja'a dhodhoka pama'ète madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a di, sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, si? do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ne dhèu dhu peka leo, tao leo, ho d'èi, peka na, oo. aa te ngaa ja'a ngee ètu d'ara ja'a, na, aad'o! ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: but as surely as god is faithful, our message to you is not yes and no.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya ama lamatua, lula nèngu peka ca j'ara, tatu na tao madhutu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i sama sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ji'i dhaa, peka na, oo, na ji'i pangee boe, na, aad'o.

source_text: for the son of god, jesus christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and silvanus and timothy, was not yes and no, but in him it has always been yes.
target_text: ja'a, silas dènge timotius dhu aj'a le miu lula-nèti yesus kristus, ana ama lamatua. nèngu dhu kapod'e-kabèli boe, peka na, oo, te ngaa a'abhu na, aad'o. nèngu ne ub'a boe, te ladhe na peka na, oo, a'abhu na tare'a-re'a, oo.

source_text: for all the promises of god are yes in christ. and so through him, our amen is spoken to the glory of god.
target_text: madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke, èèna na na paj'aj'i si. nèti èèna ka, ladhe yesus pamoa ca j'ara, peka na, oo, èdhi bisa dhaa, na, tare'a! lèke sèmi èèna! lula ji'i nge'a le ngaa dhu yesus neo tao. ji'i peka j'ara ne, sèna ka pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: now it is god who establishes both us and you in christ. he anointed us,
target_text: lamatua ne'e ka dhu hag'e nare miu dènge ji'i. nèngu ka dhu ded'e nare èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. nèngu kahèi dhu tao èdhi taha taruu.

source_text: placed his seal on us, and put his spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu hia roh na, ho uri èdhi, aa pad'elo hia èdhi ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu èci dhu tao tadha mi mèdha èci, sèna ka peka na, mèdha èèna unu nèngu.

source_text: i call god as my witness that it was in order to spare you that i did not return to corinth.
target_text: ja'a manèngi, sèna ka lamatua mesa na j'aj'i sakasii mi lii padhai ja'a ne. te lamatua ne'a d'ara ja'a. nèngu ne'a, nga tao ka ja'a lake kore mèka dhiu asa korintus. ja'a ko'o boe pamakae miu, nèti èèna ka ja'a dhae dhiu mèka.

source_text: not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
target_text: ji'i ngo'o boe pakapai ngi'u j'aj'i dhèu kapai, ho laka-seti miu, peka na, miu hud'i parcaya mi cee. te ngaa ji'i sab'a sama-sama dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu bisa karej'e-karae. te miu bisa taha pa'èra, lula miu lèka ama lamatua.

source_text: so i made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
target_text: de ja'a unu ku dhu pama'ète, na, ja'a bisa mèka dhiu ngad'o miu, sèna ka baku pabia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: for if i grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom i have grieved?
target_text: te ladhe ja'a pabia d'ara miu, na, cee hari ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a? dhoka miu di. te ngaa ladhe ja'a dhiu d'ara lai-lai ne, ja'a pabia miu.

source_text: i wrote as i did so that on my arrival i would not be saddened by those who ought to make me rejoice. i had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, peka na, ja'a lake kore mèka dhiu asa miu. ja'a tatae era, sèna ka miu pamola mere ku lii langu miu. hèia ropa ja'a dhiu, ja'a rasa bia heka, lula lii langu miu sèra. te dhu lèke mola-mola, na, miu se ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. ja'a tadhe mèu miu se aa'i-aa'i mi. ka ja'a ke'a mèu ladhe d'ara ja'a karej'e, na, d'ara miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for through many tears i wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much i love you.
target_text: lod'o ja'a suri sasuri dhu uru èèna hia miu, ja'a rasa susa dènge d'ara ja'a roe. ja'a pahaa èi madha ae-ae. te ngaa ja'a suri sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu me'a sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. te ja'a suri boe j'ara ne, ho pasusa miu.

source_text: now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you-to some degree, not to overstate it.
target_text: ètu talora juma'at miu sèra, abhu ca dhèu dhu pasusa d'ara dhèu ae. d'ara ja'a susa kahèi lula tatao dhèu èèna. masi ka tatao nèngu ne lèke iia boe mi ja'a, te ngaa dhu lèke ae mi miu.

source_text: the punishment imposed on him by the majority is sufficient for him.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii pa'ae heka, te ae ka nèti miu dhu pasanèd'e nèngu le, hèia na ele-ho'a le.

source_text: so instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
target_text: de limuri ne miu pabhèlu eele ka sasala na, aa padhai lii pabe'a-be'a ka dènge ne. te mage dhoka dhèu ne pakaj'èu iisi.

source_text: therefore i urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'asu-pareo dènge ne, ho pa'èra d'ara na, peka na, miu sue nèngu taruu.

source_text: my purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, ho neo uji miu. te neo ke'a, na, miu tao dhu lèke, dènge tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a paredha mi miu.

source_text: if you forgive anyone, i also forgive him. and if i have forgiven anything, i have forgiven it in the presence of christ for your sake,
target_text: ladhe miu tèka heka d'ara, aa pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, ja'a madhutu kahèi ngaa dhu miu pama'ète mere le. ladhe abhu sasala na dhu ja'a parluu pabhèlu, na, ja'a pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu èèna kahèi. ja'a tao sèmi èèna ka ètu madha kristus, sèna ka j'aj'i conto dhu be'a hia miu.

source_text: in order that satan should not outwit us. for we are not unaware of his schemes.
target_text: te ja'a d'èi boe ladhe dhèu aae nidhu sii nare èdhi, sèna ka segi èdhi. èdhi hud'i te'a ku naneo aapa nèngu. de baku pagoa iisi!

source_text: now when i went to troas to preach the gospel of christ and a door stood open for me in the lord,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu kota troas, ho aj'a dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a yesus kristus, lamatua bhoke j'ara hia ja'a.

source_text: i had no peace in my spirit, because i did not find my brother titus there. so i said goodbye to them and went on to macedonia.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ja'a mau boe, lula ja'a paraga boe dènge ari ja'a titus ètu nèi. hèia ja'a palangu lii dènge dhèu parcaya ètu troas sèra, ka pakèd'i asa propensi makedonia.

source_text: but thanks be to god, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of him.
target_text: te ngaa, masi ka ja'a ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua. te kristus lab'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a, ka na segi le. aa èdhi pa'èki dènge ne kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pad'elo taruu, peka na, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na. de ropa èdhi peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti kristus, èèna nuka sèmi hèu mèngi èci, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i sangèd'u rare.

source_text: for we are to god the sweet aroma of christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing. to the one, we are an odor of death and demise; to the other, a fragrance that brings life. and who is qualified for such a task?
target_text: uru-uru sèra, lod'o dhèu yahudi tao korban tunu, sèb'u hèu gèmu na ca'e asa lamatua, ho pakarej'e d'ara na. èdhi èci èèna kahèi dènge hèu mèngi èci, dhu pasanèd'e lamatua lula-nèti kristus. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu cahag'e, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge hèu badha madhe. te ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri pakaj'èu nèti lamatua rèdhi mamuri èdhi, èèna pasanèd'e rèngu, peka na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu madhe, aa cèri eele nèti lamatua. te ngaa mi dhèu cahag'e hari, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge hèu mèngi èci. te ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri mola rèdhi mamuri èdhi, èèna pasanèd'e rèngu tasa mera mia kristus hia mamuri mi èdhi, aa pala-bagi hia rèngu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia. dhèu rai-haha cee ka dhu bisa ad'u-ue j'ara se aa'i-aa'i? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: for we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of god for profit. on the contrary, in christ we speak before god with sincerity, as men sent from god.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ji'i se sama boe dènge dhèu leo dhu aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua, sèna ka abhu oto nuka sèmi pahia-pahèli pake lii holo-nori lamatua. ji'i se sèmi boe èèna! ladhe ji'i padhai lii, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa ladhe rèdhi iia-iia, peka na, ji'i aj'a-nori dènge d'ara mola. lii padhai ji'i kapua nèti ama lamatua. aa mamuri ji'i pa'èki dènge kristus.

source_text: are we beginning to commend ourselves again? or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
target_text: baku pangee, na, ji'i mulai padhai lii padedha iisi. aad'o! tao-tao miu pangee, na, ji'i sama sèmi dhèu leo dhu parluu ngèti sasuri hia miu dhu manèngi, ho miu sèmi ji'i dènge be'a, heka ji'i bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i, do? do, ji'i parluu manèngi sasuri sèmi èèna kahèi nèti miu, ho ngèti asa dhèu leo? aad'o, si?

source_text: you yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
target_text: te sasuri ijin ji'i dhu abhu le. sasuri ijin èèna nuka miu se. te ji'i nge'a j'ara ae-ae nèti mamuri miu. j'ara se dhu tèke le ètu d'ara ji'i. dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa baca mamuri miu; nèti j'ara ne'e ra tadhe hua-hela nèti sasab'a-la'a èdhi.

source_text: it is clear that you are a letter from christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the spirit of the living god, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
target_text: te dhu lèke le, na, miu nuka sèmi sasuri èci dhu kristus suri nare le. hèia na pangèd'u mi ji'i. kristus pake boe tinta ho na suri sasuri ne, te ngaa na pake roh mola-mèci nèti lamatua dhu mamuri. kristus kahèi dule boe lii lolo be'a na ètu hadhu kabela, nuka sèmi ama lamatua tao hia musa. te ngaa kristus dule ètu d'ara èdhi dhu mamuri.

source_text: such confidence before god is ours through christ.
target_text: ji'i bisa parcaya mi ama lamatua, na, j'ara se'e mema lèke tare'a, lula kristus ka dhu pad'elo sèmi èèna.

source_text: not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from god.
target_text: ladhe dhoka nèti ngi'u ji'i mesa mi, na, ji'i se unu boe koasa ho ad'u-ue ngaa-ngaa. te koasa dènge hak dhu ètu ji'i, kapua na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and he has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the spirit; for the letter kills, but the spirit gives life.
target_text: lamatua ka dhu ded'e ji'i j'aj'i dhèu sab'a na, dhu lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii pajaji hiu na. te ngaa lii pajaji hiu na èèna lula boe madhutu atora rupa-rupa, te ngaa lula-nèti dhèu pa'èki dènge roh mola-mèci. ladhe dhoka tao madhutu iia d'ara di atora sèra, èèna nuka sèmi d'ara rèngu dhu madhe le dènge unu boe mamuri dhu lèke, dhu ma'ète boe èèna. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, nèngu unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the israelites could not gaze at the face of moses because of its fleeting glory,
target_text: uru-uru sèra, ropa ama lamatua dule atora na ètu hadhu kabela sèra, èèna mema be'a seli eele. te ngaa masi ka dhèu madhutu aa'i atora sèra, rèngu pacèri era dènge ama lamatua. ka ropa musa sèmi nare atora se'e, rèhu na kaha'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu isra'el bisa boe ladhe patae rèhu na. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka, kaha'a ne ele.

source_text: will not the ministry of the spirit be even more glorious?
target_text: de ladhe dhu suri tèke ètu hadhu bisa abhu kale'e sèmi èèna, na, tasamia hari dènge ngaa dhu roh lamatua tao tèke le ètu d'ara èdhi? tatu risi hari, si?

source_text: for if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
target_text: de atora ne paj'uj'u, na, èdhi hud'i pasae tare ku huku madhe, ho pacèri nèti lamatua, lula èdhi tao boe madhutu atora aa'i-aa'i sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa atora ne èra taruu era nèti lamatua. te ngaa roh lamatua èra risi eele hari nèti èèna, te nèngu ka pad'elo j'ara sèna ka èdhi pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.
target_text: de atora dhu uru èèna dhèu pangee, na, dedha titu kèna, limuri ne dadedha na sèmi heka uru èèna, te ne'e ne abhu le dhu dedha risi.

source_text: for if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
target_text: atora se dhu uru èèna, kaha'a nuka sèmi rèhu musa, nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka kaha'a na ele. musa dènge atora se mema dedha tare'a, te ngaa dhu dedha risi hari, nuka dhu taha taruu dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nge'a mèu, na, lii pajaji hiu lamatua èèna taha taruu, dhu ma'ète boe ciki sa. nèti èèna ka, ji'i padhai lii mola-mola dhu pa'abhe boe.

source_text: we are not like moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
target_text: ji'i tao boe sama sèmi musa. te nèngu hud'i pa'abhe ku rèhu na dènge bèla, sèna ka dhèu isra'el bisa boe rèdhi rèhu na, ho re'a na, kaha'a èèna ele le, do dhae.

source_text: but their minds were closed. for to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. it has not been lifted, because only in christ can it be removed.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua tao ngangee dhèu isra'el sèra topo. te toke d'ai sange ne'e, ladhe rèngu baca ètu sasuri lamatua nèti lii pajaji dhu dhui èèna, nuka sèmi bèla èci dhu hutu nare kètu ra, ka ro'o boe nanene aa ro'o boe re'a. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhoke d'ara rèngu, sèna ka rèngu bisa re'a mèu. dhodhoka kristus mesa na.

source_text: and even to this day when moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, ladhe dhèu yahudi baca sasuri musa, rèngu nanene, te ngaa re'a iia boe. ne'e ne j'aj'i lula rèngu nanene pake boe d'ara ra, lula abhu dhu pa'abhe d'ara rèngu.

source_text: but whenever anyone turns to the lord, the veil is taken away.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mulai parcaya kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, na, kristus ka dhu bhoke d'ara dhèu èèna, sèna ka nèngu bisa ne'a mèu. èèna sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, nèngu bhoke eele le bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na.

source_text: now the lord is the spirit, and where the spirit of the lord is, there is freedom.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lod'o musa padhai lii, peka na, lamatua, sasoa na, roh ama lamatua. ladhe èdhi abhu le roh ne, nèngu tao èdhi j'aj'i mi dhèu bebas.

source_text: and we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the lord, are being transformed into his image with intensifying glory, which comes from the lord, who is the spirit.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na tao èdhi asa tabha èra, sama sèmi nèngu. rèhu èdhi parluu heka pahutu. aa èdhi pangee dhoka dadedha lamatua èdhi, te roh na ka dhu soru-bara èdhi.

source_text: therefore, since god in his mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pad'elo le rasa kasia na mi dedha ji'i. nèti èèna ka, na pua le ji'i ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii pajaji hiu na. nèti èèna ka, ji'i taha taruu, dhu nge'a boe roe.

source_text: instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. we do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of god. on the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of god.
target_text: de karèi nèti uru ka ji'i pama'ète ngare le, na: ji'i peka-padhai mola-mola, na, ji'i tao boe j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sama sèmi dhèu leo. dhèu sèra tao pahuni-pahuni sèna ka dhèu baku ladhe rèdhi. aa rèngu dhu re'a boe makae. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe kapod'e dhèu. ji'i kahèi padhai lii hèb'a hua boe lula lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori dènge mola-mola madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parisa unu ra lii padhai ji'i ètu madha lamatua, aa nile unu ra, ji'i se dhèu sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: and even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu ji'i aj'a sèra, rèngu laho kahèi, lula rèngu cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: the god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of christ, who is the image of god.
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu, nuka sèmi lamatua èci dhu dhèu lasi sogo-tagu. na ad'u-ue pa'ele iie kahadhu dhèu cahag'e, ka d'ara dhèu se j'aj'i maroga kiu-kiu. rèngu se dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua èdhi. lula rèngu bèdhu, bisa boe ladhe rèdhi saraa nèti ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa boe re'a lii lolo be'a lula-nèti kristus. rèngu re'a boe kahèi dadedha kristus. te kristus ne, ca ropa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for we do not proclaim ourselves, but jesus christ as lord, and ourselves as your servants for jesus' sake.
target_text: ji'i padhai lii boe padedha iisi ji'i. te ngaa ji'i padhai lii padedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhu ji'i padhai lula ngi'u ji'i dhodhoka sèmi ne'e di: nuka ji'i tao iisi ji'i nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka laladhe-leru miu lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus.

source_text: for god, who said, let light shine out of darkness, made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of god in the face of jesus christ.
target_text: uru-uru sèra ama lamatua dhu peka nèdhi le, na, hud'i dènge ku saraa dhu heo ètu era maroga. hèia na tao saraa na ho pasaraa d'ara èdhi. te nèngu d'èi pala-bagi èdhi saraa na. sasoa na, ropa èdhi pangee lula-nèti kristus, èdhi sanèd'e kahèi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from god and not from us.
target_text: masi ka ji'i se dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lamatua hia mèdha dhu kab'ua ètu d'ara ji'i. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu èci tèke mèdha na dhu kab'ua ètu d'ara èru rai. mèdha dhu kab'ua ne, nuka saraa ama lamatua. de dhu lèke ka, koasa dhu kapai dhu ji'i unu, mai boe nèti ji'i, te ngaa kapua na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: we are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
target_text: de masi ka dhèu ènyi raruri ji'i ètu mia-mia, te ngaa ji'i taha taruu. masi ka ji'i nge'a aa'i boe, te ngaa ji'i ele boe ngangee.

source_text: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra ji'i ae-ae, te ngaa ama lamatua pa'ana-lalu eele boe ji'i. masi ka dhèu dhedhe ji'i, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe palaho ji'i.

source_text: we always carry around in our body the death of jesus, so that the life of jesus may also be revealed in our body.
target_text: lula ji'i abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti èèna ka ladhe ji'i ètu mia, ji'i bisa lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, yesus abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae kahèi, lod'o na madhe. te masi ka dhèu paj'èra ji'i rupa-rupa, te ngaa ji'i madhe boe. ne'e ne pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, yesus mamuri taruu ètu d'ara ji'i.

source_text: for we who are alive are always consigned to death for jesus' sake, so that the life of jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
target_text: mema tare'a! ae le mamuri ji'i dhu abhu j'aj'èra oe madhe, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, yesus pala mamuri dhu lèke mi ji'i, masi ka bèli-camèd'a ji'i madhe.

source_text: so then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
target_text: de masi ka lèpa limuri ji'i madhe, te ngaa ji'i madha'u boe padhue-padhai lula-nèti kristus. te ji'i sadia madhe sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: and in keeping with what is written: i believed, therefore i have spoken, we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, na, lula ja'a parcaya lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a padhai lii. ngangee ji'i sama kahèi. lula ji'i lèka lamatua, nèti èèna ka ji'i hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: knowing that the one who raised the lord jesus will also raise us with jesus and present us with you in his presence.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. èèna na nèngu kahèi ka dhu pamamuri hari èdhi, lula èdhi pa'èki dènge yesus. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua patitu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ètu madha na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi.

source_text: all this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may overflow in thanksgiving, to the glory of god.
target_text: lamatua tao j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka soru-bara miu. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi dhèu dhu asa tabha ae. èèna na lii manèngi makasi rèngu mi lamatua asa tabha ae, aa ra mangaku dadedha na kahèi.

source_text: therefore we do not lose heart. though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi taha taruu, aa ele boe ngangee. masi ka ngi'u èdhi asa roe-bhilu, te ngaa ama lamatua asa pa'èra d'ara èdhi nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o.

source_text: for our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal glory that is far beyond comparison.
target_text: te madhutu ngangee èdhi, lod'o limuri ne èdhi dhu abhu sasusa rupa-rupa. te ngaa èdhi hud'i sanèd'e ku, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi padedha-dedha. nèti èèna ka èdhi hud'i te'a, na, ngaa dhu j'aj'i se'e dènge boe sasoa!

source_text: so we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. for what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i ngee paie-iie ku mi j'ara-j'ara dhu tèdhi mèka. baku pangee dhoka mi dhu ladhe tèdhi di. te j'ara-j'ara dhu ladhe tèdhi, taha boe nare nèbhu. te ngaa j'ara dhu tèdhi mèka sèra ka dhu taha taruu, aa dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from god, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, ngi'u aae ne, èdhi pake taha ètu rai-haha di, nuka sèmi paleo dhu èdhi patitu taha. masi ka ngi'u aae èdhi ele iie, te ngaa èdhi baku pangee, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia tèke le era dhu be'a èci hia èdhi ètu sorga. era ne'e, j'aj'i boe nèti pa'ue-ai dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa j'aj'i nèti pa'ue-ai lamatua. nèti èèna ka, era ne'e taha taruu.

source_text: for in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,
target_text: te ngi'u aae èdhi ne roe-bhilu ètu rai-haha ne. ka èdhi neo titu kèna abhu ngi'u hiu dhu èdhi pake ètu sorga.

source_text: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
target_text: hèia ropa èdhi d'ai era nèi, èdhi sama boe sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ngi'u, te ngaa pake mèdha hiu ètu ua èdhi. te èdhi j'aj'i boe samanga di, te ngaa ètu nèi èdhi abhu ngi'u hiu kahèi.

source_text: so while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
target_text: ngi'u aae èdhi dhu ele iie ne, tao èdhi mangeta, lula rasa j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, to'o boe madhe, ho tèke eele ngi'u aae ne. aad'o! èdhi neo abhu ngi'u dhu hiu, sèna ka tèke eele ngi'u dhui, gati dènge mamuri hiu dhu lèke.

source_text: and god has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the spirit as a pledge of what is to come.
target_text: ama lamatua ne'e ka dhu pa'èra èdhi ho sèmi tare mamuri dhu hiu. nèngu kahèi bagi hia èdhi roh na, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha nèti lii pajaji na.

source_text: therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the lord.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi taha dènge d'ara èra taruu. èdhi te'a, na, lod'o èdhi mamuri era ètu d'ara ngi'u aae ne'e ne, èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
target_text: nèti èèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua. èdhi mamuri boe dènge ngaa dhu èdhi ladhe tèdhi ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: we are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the lord.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a tare'a-re'a kahèi, na, ladhe èdhi madhe tèke eele ngi'u aae ne, ho lati mamuri sama-sama dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, na, tatu èdhi karej'e risi eele hari.

source_text: so we aspire to please him, whether we are here in this body or away from it.
target_text: masi ka èdhi mamuri taruu ètu rai-haha ne, do madhe ètu ne'e sèna ka mamuri ètu nèi, te ngaa dhu lèke ka, èdhi hud'i pakarej'e ku d'ara lamatua. te dad'èi èdhi kèna.

source_text: for we must all appear before the judgment seat of christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
target_text: baku bhèlu. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi paraga dènge kristus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pama'ète lii langu madhutu tatao dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. hèia kristus b'ala dhu pamèci dènge tatao dhu dhèu ad'u-ue. te kristus ne'a, dhèu ne tao be'a do tao dhu karehe.

source_text: therefore, since we know what it means to fear the lord, we try to persuade men. what we are is clear to god, and i hope it is clear to your conscience as well.
target_text: lula ji'i nge'a, na, bèli-camèd'a kristus parisa mamuri ji'i, nèti èèna ka ji'i hud'i madha'u, aa pakab'ua ne. ka ji'i sab'a pa'èra-èra ho pamako dhèu, sèna ka ra parcaya kristus. ama lamatua dhu ne'a d'ara mola ji'i. ja'a d'èi kahèi, ladhe miu me'a d'ara mola ji'i se.

source_text: we are not commending ourselves to you again. instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
target_text: ji'i padedha boe iisi ji'i ètu madha miu. aad'o! te ngaa ji'i dhoka hia miu j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka miu bisa pakab'ua ji'i dhu dènge boe makae. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa dhaa lii dhèu dhu hèb'a aae. te rèngu dhèu dhu koa iisi lula sasab'a-la'a rèngu dhu dhèu ladhe rèdhi, aa te ngaa d'ara rèngu mola boe.

source_text: if we are out of our mind, it is for god; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
target_text: ladhe miu pangee, na, ji'i se huj'u, hèia ji'i padhai lii sèmi èèna ho pakako sasab'a lamatua. masi ka miu me'a boe, te ngaa lamatua ne'a. ladhe ji'i padhai lii pake ngangee dhu mola, na, ji'i padhai lii sèmi èèna, ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: for christ's love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, therefore all died.
target_text: kristus sue èdhi titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ho pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ji'i parcaya, na, dhèu èci, nuka kristus, madhe gati dhèu aa'i-aa'i. sasoa na, èèna sama sèmi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, aa dhu dènge heka hak ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for him who died for them and was raised again.
target_text: kristus madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, mamuri heka madhutu dad'èi mesa ra. te ngaa rèngu hud'i mamuri madhutu dad'èi kristus, lula nèngu madhe le gati rèngu, hèia na mamuri hari.

source_text: so from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. although we once regarded christ in this way, we do so no longer.
target_text: de karèi nèti deo ne'e, èdhi baku nile dhèu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. masi ka uru èèna èdhi nile kristus pake ngangee dhèu biasa. te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nile heka nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: therefore if anyone is in christ, he is a new creation. the old has passed away. behold, the new has come!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge kristus j'aj'i le dhèu hiu, dhu unu mamuri hiu. dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna, lula mamuri dhui na ele le. te limuri ne, dhu hiu abhu le.

source_text: all this is from god, who reconciled us to himself through christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ama lamatua ka dhu tao. nèngu ka dhu padame, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne, lula kristus saku eele le sasala-sasigo èdhi. hèia na pangèd'u èdhi sasab'a, ho èdhi pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu leo kahèi bisa padame hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: that god was reconciling the world to himself in christ, not counting men's trespasses against them. and he has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
target_text: sanèd'e, te lod'o kristus pea ètu rai-haha ne era, ama lamatua dhu pake ne ho lere nèti dhèu padame hari dènge ama lamatua. de nèngu ige heka sasala dhèu, ka rèngu dui heka hahuku nèti sasala. hèia na pua èdhi lati peka dènge dhèu, na, rèngu bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: therefore we are ambassadors for christ, as though god were making his appeal through us. we implore you on behalf of christ: be reconciled to god.
target_text: te èdhi j'aj'i duta kristus. de ama lamatua pake èdhi ho tèti dhèu mai, sèna ka padame dènge ne. lula ji'i j'aj'i duta kristus, nèti èèna ka ji'i manèngi miu kahèi, na, lamatua d'èi titu kèna, ladhe miu pabe'a hari dènge ne.

source_text: god made him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of god.
target_text: kristus mesa na tao nèdhi boe sala. te ngaa ama lamatua hia ne pasae sasala-sasigo èdhi. lamatua tao j'ara ne hia èdhi, lula mamadhe kristus bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri dènge d'ara mola, sama sèmi lamatua d'ara mola kahèi.

source_text: as god's fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive god's grace in vain.
target_text: lula ji'i sab'a sama-sama dènge lamatua, ji'i pasanèd'e miu sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dedha miu. de miu baku sèmi mere d'ara hua iia na iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: for he says: in the time of favor i heard you, and in the day of salvation i helped you. behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na dhu suri tèke, peka na, ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, ja'a nanene lii èu. ja'a soru-bara èu kahèi, ropa ja'a pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu. de nanene pabe'a-be'a! ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o dhu hua iia èèna kèna. te ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o lamatua kèna ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu.

source_text: we put no obstacle in anyone's way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i j'aga mamuri ji'i pabe'a-be'a sèna ka mamuri mola. te ji'i ngo'o boe bhabhae dhèu dhu neo mai asa j'ara mamuri lamatua. aa ji'i neo padhai mola-mola kahèi, sèna ka dhèu baku pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i.

source_text: rather, as servants of god we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
target_text: aa aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i sab'a, ji'i tenge j'ara ho pad'elo, na, ji'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua. de masi ka ji'i abhu susa, do paraga dènge j'aj'èra, do mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae patao-palaha, ji'i taha taruu.

source_text: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;
target_text: ji'i taha kahèi ètu d'ara lod'o dhèu gama ji'i, lod'o ra pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho, lod'o ra patao-palaha, lod'o ji'i sab'a bia, lod'o ji'i abhu boe pasaruru musi madha, aa lod'o ji'i manganga.

source_text: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the holy spirit and in sincere love;
target_text: ji'i taha dènge d'ara mola kahèi. ji'i nge'a ae lula-nèti ama lamatua. ji'i taha dènge d'ara taleo. ji'i tao dhu be'a hia dhèu. ji'i soro tèke roh lamatua ator ji'i. sasue ji'i mola-mola mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: in truthful speech and in the power of god; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
target_text: ladhe ji'i padhai lii, ji'i padhai dhu lèke, dhu nge'a boe monya. ji'i sèmi ngare koasa nèti lamatua kahèi, sèna ka tao dhu be'a. ji'i nuka sèmi sordad'u dhu ngèd'u rèka dhu tesa nèti lamatua, sèna ka lab'a musu, aa segi taruu.

source_text: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
target_text: ji'i taha kahèi masi ka dhèu pakab'ua, do pahahe ji'i; masi ka dhèu padhai lii pamanahu ji'i, do ra j'aga kolongara ji'i; masi ka dhèu monya, peka na, ji'i kapod'e-kabèli dhèu, do ra peka na, ji'i padhai lii dhu lèke.

source_text: as unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;
