target_text: abhu dhu tadhe boe ji'i, te ngaa abhu dhèu ae kahèi dhu re'a ngara ji'i. pèri-pèri hari kèna, ji'i se oe madhe, te ngaa ji'i mamuri era. dhèu huku ji'i bia pèri-pèri hari kèna, te ngaa ji'i madhe boe.

source_text: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
target_text: masi ka ji'i rasa bia, te ngaa ji'i karej'e-karae taruu kahèi. masi ka ji'i dènge boe doi-dhari, te ngaa ji'i tao dhèu ae j'aj'i kaja ètu d'ara ra. èèna nuka sèmi ji'i unu boe ngaa-ngaa, te ngaa ji'i unu aa'i mèu-mèu kahèi.

source_text: we have spoken freely to you, corinthians. our hearts are open wide.
target_text: ji'i padhai lii paled'a-led'a hia miu dhu ètu kota korintus ne. aa ji'i sue miu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: it is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
target_text: ji'i pad'elo le sasue ji'i mi dedha miu dènge d'ara kateme. te ngaa sasue miu mi ji'i kura, lula dènge boe d'ara kateme.

source_text: as a fair exchange, i ask you as my children: open wide your hearts also.
target_text: de ja'a neo holo miu nuka sèmi holo ana-ana ja'a. be'a risi miu sue ji'i dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. for what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
target_text: baku pakadheb'e dènge dhèu dhu parcaya boe kristus. te miu sama boe dènge rèngu. dhèu parcaya dhu mamuri mola, sama boe dènge dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua, de nia boe ladhe ra tenge j'ara ho sab'a pa'èci. dhèu be'a dènge dhèu be'a boe, pantas boe pa'èci. èèna nuka sèmi saraa bisa boe pa'èci dènge maroga.

source_text: what harmony is there between christ and belial? or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
target_text: kristus bisa boe d'ara èci dènge dhèu aae nidhu, si? sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua abhu pusaka, te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe abhu boe pala.

source_text: what agreement can exist between the temple of god and idols? for we are the temple of the living god. as god has said: i will dwell with them and walk among them, and i will be their god, and they will be my people.
target_text: de a'abhu miu, sa mia? ele boe miu pangee, na, miu bisa lami asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ama lamatua sèna ka pahaha iisi mi nèngu, èle na lami sogo-tagu hari asa èmu sogo-tagu nidhu, do? bisa boe, si? te lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu j'aj'i kètu èdhi kahèi. ka èdhi j'aj'i le sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a na, lula nèngu pea ètu d'ara èdhi. te lamatua suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, èmu ja'a ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu ja'a. ja'a laku-mai nèti talora aae rèngu kahèi. ja'a neo j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the lord. touch no unclean thing, and i will receive you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua suri sèmi ne'e kahèi, na, miu hud'i kalua nèti talora aae rèngu, aa pacèri nèti rèngu, sèna ka miu baku j'aj'i sama sèmi rèngu. d'ara miu hud'i mola-mèci. aa miu hud'i pakaj'èu nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaj'alu d'ara miu, dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a sèmi kore miu dènge be'a.

source_text: and: i will be a father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the lord almighty.
target_text: ja'a neo j'aj'i ama miu; aa miu j'aj'i ana-ana ja'a. se'e se ka dhu kètu èdhi peka tèke, nèngu ka dhu unu koasa risi aa'i.

source_text: therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of god.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lula ama lamatua padhadha tèke le ho pala-bagi èdhi j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, nèti èèna ka èdhi hud'i pamèu ku d'ara dènge mamuri èdhi. baku tèke eele hahera ciki sa hèi ètu mamuri èdhi. te èdhi neo sèna ka mamuri èdhi mola-mèci tare'a-re'a hia mi ama lamatua, sèna ka pad'elo, na, èdhi madha'u dènge pakab'ua nèngu.

source_text: make room for us in your hearts. we have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! hia ji'i tebho. bhoke d'ara miu ho sèmi mere ji'i dènge be'a. baku soro kabodho mi ji'i. te uru èèna, lod'o ji'i ètu talora aae miu, ji'i tao ngèdhi boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi dhèu èci sa. ji'i dadugu ngèdhi mèka dhèu ho ad'u-ue sasala. ji'i kapod'e-kabèli ngèdhi mèka dhèu, sèna ka abhu oto nèti rèngu kahèi.

source_text: i do not say this to condemn you. i have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a ne, neo boe pèci sasala asa dedha miu. te ja'a dhu peka le, na, ji'i sue miu. de tasa mera mia èèna ka, ji'i se dhu pa'èki dènge miu, masi ka ji'i madhe do mamuri.

source_text: great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; i am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a parluu heka pangee ae-ae, te ja'a lèka miu. ja'a koa miu, aa miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. de masi ka ji'i abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae taruu, lula miu.

source_text: for when we arrived in macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction-conflicts on the outside, fears within.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa propensi makedonia, ngi'u ji'i roe-bhilu. te ji'i abhu susa nèti g'ana-kariu. ji'i pab'ala d'ara lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya boe. d'ara ji'i madha'u kahèi.

source_text: but god, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of titus,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu pa'èra dhèu dhu ele ngangee. hèia nèngu pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ropa na pua titus mai dènge ji'i.

source_text: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. he told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that i rejoiced all the more.
target_text: nèti mamai titus ne'e ka d'ara ji'i èra hari. te nèngu peka na, lod'o nèngu ètu nèi era, miu dhu pa'èra d'ara na. lii lolo nèngu ne'e ka, pa'èra d'ara ji'i. nèngu lolo kahèi, na, miu neo titu kèna mèdhi rèhu ja'a, aa miu manyasa kahèi lula lii langu dhu uru èèna j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu. aa titus peka kahèi, na, miu tenge j'ara ho soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: even if i caused you sorrow by my letter, i do not regret it. although i did regret it, i now see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, isi sasuri ja'a uru èèna dhu pasanèd'e miu dènge lii sakaa, èèna ka dhu papèd'a d'ara miu. te ngaa ja'a manyasa boe ja'a suri sasuri èèna. aa te ngaa lod'o èèna ja'a ako manyasa, ropa ke'a, na, nèti sasuri ja'a ka d'ara miu pèd'a, masi ka nare boe nèbhu.

source_text: and now i rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. for you felt the sorrow that god had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, d'ara ja'a karej'e. ja'a karej'e boe lula uru èèna miu ètu d'ara susa. aad'o! ja'a karej'e lula lod'o èèna, sasuri ja'a dhu pamako miu sèna ka ele-ho'a. hèia miu mangaku sasala miu, aa tèke eele j'ara-j'ara dhu karehe, sèna ka kabèli hari ho madhutu j'ara mamuri mola nèti lamatua. te lamatua ka dhu tao miu manyasa. j'ara ne, nèti boe ji'i dhu tao miu j'aj'i maruru.

source_text: godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi manyasa ètu d'ara èdhi, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, èdhi ae eele nèti tao j'ara dhu bhèlu, hèia lèpa hari madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola. ne'e ne ka dhu pakaj'èu èdhi nèti hahuku ama lamatua, ka èdhi mamuri heka dènge d'ara manyasa taruu. te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhoka manyasa ètu hèb'a di, sama sèmi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, èèna na èdhi cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! in every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
target_text: miu pangee sèku! lod'o miu baca sasuri ja'a, ja'a ke'a na, miu manyasa kahèi. èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua. ne'e ne ka pa'èra miu ho miu core eele bhabhèlu nèti mamuri miu. miu roe-bhilu le ètu d'ara bhabhelu miu. miu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka manahu hari asa d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a. miu neo mèdhi ja'a, aa pa'èra taruu ho tao j'ara be'a. miu pa'èra kahèi ho neo huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. lula miu tao j'ara dhu lèke sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka miu mola-mèci. dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhu bisa pèci sasala asa miu.

source_text: so even though i wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of god.
target_text: de sasuri ja'a uru èèna, hia boe mi dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, do, mi dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra nèti bhabhelu na. te ngaa ja'a suri sasuri èèna hia miu, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo, na, lii padhai miu ètu madha lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a. aa miu tare'a-re'a sue ji'i.

source_text: on account of this, we are encouraged. in addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of titus. for his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
target_text: se'e se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èra d'ara ja'a. miu pa'èra d'ara titus kahèi, sèna ka d'ara na bisa mera-milu. sèra sa, asa pakarej'e d'ara ji'i.

source_text: indeed, i was not embarrassed by anything i had boasted to him about you. but just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to titus has proved to be true as well.
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu ètu madha titus, lula tatao miu dhu be'a. ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, na, miu pamakae mèdhi mèka ja'a. te j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i lolo ngèdhi dènge miu sèra lèke tare'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i lolo dènge titus lula-nèti miu lèke tare'a kahèi.

source_text: and his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
target_text: de lod'o-lod'o na ngee nèdhi tatao dènge lii padhai miu, sasue na mi dedha miu asa tabha. aa nèngu sanèd'e kahèi ropa na dhiu asa miu, ka miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te ngaa isi sasuri ja'a j'aj'i ngangee mi miu.

source_text: i rejoice that i can have complete confidence in you.
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ja'a bisa parcaya miu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. de d'ara ja'a kabèdhi heka dènge miu!

source_text: now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that god has given the churches of macedonia.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ji'i ka ladhe miu me'a mèu d'ara hua iia ama lamatua, dhu na pad'elo mi dedha juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi makedonia.

source_text: in the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.
target_text: te masi ka rèngu abhu susa ae-ae, te ngaa d'ara rèngu karej'e taruu. nèti èèna ka, masi ka rèngu unu boe ngaa-ngaa, te ngaa ra hia doi ae-ae dènge d'ara mola-mèci, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu abhu sasusa.

source_text: for i testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. of their own accord,
target_text: ja'a bisa lole kahèi, na, dhu rèngu hia sèra, hia aa'i nèti dhu rèngu bisa hia. aa ra hia risi nèti sèra sa kahèi. abhu boe dhèu dhu laka-seti si.

source_text: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.
target_text: rèngu mesa ra ka dhu tare'a-re'a manèngi, sèna ka ji'i bhoke j'ara hia si. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu bagian ho soru-bara dhèu dhu abhu susa ètu yerusalem.

source_text: and not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the lord and then to us, because it was the will of god.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i sanao sèna ka ra tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dhu ra tao èèna, risi nèti dhu ji'i sanao! dhu uru j'ara, rèngu hia mamuri ra asa ama lamatua. hèia ra peka kahèi, na, ji'i neo soro mamuri ji'i, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o miu, lula èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: so we urged titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
target_text: lula conto nèti juma'at-juma'at ètu makedonia sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ji'i manèngi titus lèpa hari asa miu ètu korintus, sèna ka miu soru-bara kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa ètu yerusalem. te uru èèna, nèngu ka dhu mulai pakaboko doi-dhari ho hia si. hèia limuri ne, ji'i manèngi sèna ka nèngu bisa tao pamèci sasab'a-la'a miu ho soru-bara dhèu.

source_text: but just as you excel in everything-in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you -see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
target_text: sasab'a miu hia ama lamatua èèna, be'a titu kèna. conto sèmi: parcaya miu èra, lii padhai miu be'a; miu me'a ae j'ara-j'ara lamatua; miu sab'a dènge maj'èni; aa miu sue ji'i d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu soru-bara kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa, dènge j'ara hia si doi ae-ae.

source_text: i am not making a demand, but i am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.
target_text: ja'a paredha boe miu ètu korintus, sèna ka hia si doi ae-ae, te ngaa ja'a neo cob'a miu. te juma'at-juma'at ètu makedonia neo le soru-bara dhèu sèra. de dènge j'ara ne'e miu bisa pad'elo, na, miu tare'a-re'a sue dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa kahèi.

source_text: for you know the grace of our lord jesus christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.
target_text: te miu me'a, na, kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. mema nèngu kaja. te ngaa na pama'ète nare ho tao iisi na j'aj'i dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèna ka soru-bara miu, ho miu j'aj'i kaja ètu madha j'ara ae-ae.

source_text: and this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
target_text: ranga-jahi na, miu mulai pakaboko le doi ho hia rèngu. mesa boe miu hia doi-dhari di, te ngaa miu soru-bara nèti d'ara miu kahèi. de madhutu a'abhu ja'a, miu hud'i tao ku sèmi ne'e:

source_text: now finish the work, so that you may complete it just as eagerly as you began, according to your means.
target_text: uru èèna, miu pama'ète mere le neo soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa ètu yerusalem nèi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ngaa dhu miu dhae pakaboko mere mèka, na, pa'oru aa'i si ho hia ka. aa ca ngaa dhu miu bisa hia, na, hia laa. dhu lèke ka, hia dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: for if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi hia dènge d'ara kateme madhutu ngaa dhu èdhi bisa hia, èèna be'a kèna. sad'i madhutu dad'èi èdhi. te dhèu baku hia ngaa-ngaa dhu pabia nèngu, lula laka-seti nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: it is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.
target_text: ja'a d'èi boe pabia miu, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu samaa. te dad'èi ja'a ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tago sama-sama sasusa dhèu se'e.

source_text: at the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. then there will be equality.
target_text: te limuri ne, miu dhu unu risi, aa rèngu dhu unu ciki. lod'o limuri, rèngu bisa b'ala kahèi, ladhe miu dhu unu ciki. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa tago sama-sama.

source_text: as it is written: he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu abhu ae, risi boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu parluu. aa dhèu dhu abhu ciki, kura boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu parluu.

source_text: but thanks be to god, who put into the heart of titus the same devotion i have for you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu pamako titus, sèna ka neo soru-bara miu, sama sèmi ja'a neo soru-bara miu.

source_text: for not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.
target_text: mema ji'i manèngi sèna ka nèngu dhiu ngad'o miu. aa te ngaa, èèna madhutu dad'èi nèngu mesa na. nèti èèna ka, nèngu mesa na neo dhiu soru-bara miu, nèti boe lii manèngi ja'a.

source_text: along with titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu dhiu boe mesa na. te ji'i pua le a'ari ji'i ca dhèu, ho kako palere dènge ne. juma'at aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e tadhe mèu dhèu ne, lula nèngu sab'a bia ho peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: more than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the offering -the gracious gift we administer to honor the lord himself and to show our eagerness to help.
target_text: kètu juma'at se dhu pili ne kahèi, ho palere-lere dènge ji'i, sèna ka soru-bara ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a ji'i dhu hua iia ne. ji'i pakako sasab'a ne, sèna ka pad'elo dadedha lamatua èdhi, aa tao dhu be'a hia dhèu susa sèra ètu yerusalem.

source_text: we hope to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.
target_text: ji'i tenge j'ara sèna ka tao dhu lèke, ho baku abhu dhèu dhu pasala ji'i, peka na, ji'i sab'a lèke boe lod'o ji'i ngèti doi sèra papala mi dhèu dhu parluu.

source_text: for we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the lord, but also in the eyes of men.
target_text: te ji'i pangee paie-iie, sèna ka tao dhu lèke nèti d'ara dhu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, aa ètu madha dhèu ae kahèi.

source_text: and we are sending along with them our brother whose earnestness has been proven many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.
target_text: abhu a'ari èci hari dhu ji'i pua dhiu palere dènge titus si, ho rèti doi sèra. ji'i ladhe paie-iie le mamuri nèngu. aa ji'i nge'a, na, nèngu neo sab'a bia hia miu kahèi. dhèu ne maj'èni, lula ne'a le, na, miu tao dhu lèke.

source_text: as for titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. as for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, to the glory of christ.
target_text: ladhe dhèu karèi miu lula-nèti titus, peka mi rèngu, na, titus èèna a'ari ja'a dhu sab'a taruu dènge ja'a hia miu. dhèu parcaya ètu era leo kahèi hag'e rare le dhèu rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi rèti doi sèra asa yerusalem. rèngu pakaboko le ho neo dhiu. titus sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pad'elo dadedha kristus sèmi èèna.

source_text: in full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
target_text: de miu hud'i pad'elo sasue miu mi dhèu dhu rèti doi sèra. aa pad'elo dènge ra, tasamia ka ji'i koa-kad'iri miu. dènge j'ara èèna, dhèu-dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at ètu mia-mia re'a, na, miu sue rèngu.

source_text: now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.
target_text: dhu lèke, ja'a parluu heka suri hia miu, ho manèngi miu soru-bara dhèu parcaya unu lamatua.

source_text: for i know your eagerness to help, and i have been boasting to the macedonians that since last year you in achaia were prepared to give. and your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.
target_text: te ja'a ke'a le, miu d'èi titu kèna soru-bara dhèu sèmi sèra. ja'a d'èi palolo dènge dhèu parcaya ètu makedonia kahèi, lula-nèti babe'a d'ara miu. ja'a palolo le, peka na, miu nèti propensi akaya dhu pa'èra le karèi nèti ranga-jahi ni, ho pa'adhu doi bantuan. ja'a lolo le kahèi, lula-nèti maj'èni miu ka dhu pamako dhèu leo, ho soru-bara dhèu-dhèu susa.

source_text: but i am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as i said.
target_text: ka ja'a pua le a'ari èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo, na, ngaa dhu ji'i palolo lula-nèti miu se, leko-monya boe. ja'a peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu pa'èra mema.

source_text: otherwise, if any macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we-to say nothing of you-would be ashamed of having been so confident.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu makedonia mai palere dènge ja'a, aa miu dhae pa'èra mèka, na, èdhi ta'e makae. mage dhoka lalèka ja'a mi dedha miu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: so i thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. this way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pangee, na, be'a risi ladhe a'ari èdhi dhiu uuru asa miu, sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa ator uuru ku doi bantuan sèra, madhutu lii pamoa miu uru èèna. miu hud'i hia nèti babe'a d'ara miu, baku hia dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: remember this: whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu sèle hini ciki, èèna na abhu hua-hela ciki kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèle hini pa'ae-ae, èèna na abhu hari hua-hela ae-ae kahèi.

source_text: each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. for god loves a cheerful giver.
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka hud'i pama'ète unu na, nèngu neo hia ca ngaa. baku hia dènge d'ara cabèka. baku hia lula dhèu laka-seti. te ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu hia dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: and god is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
target_text: lamatua bisa hia miu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. nèngu bisa hia miu ae risi eele kahèi, sèna ka miu baku kura ngaa-ngaa. te ladhe miu parluu, èèna na miu abhu risi nèti dhu miu parluu. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa papala dhu karisi, sèna ka soru-bara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu nèti babe'a.

source_text: as it is written: he has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever.
target_text: dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ama lamatua d'èi pala-bagi hia dhèu unu aad'o, nèti d'ara hua iia na. nèngu tao dhu lèke taruu, te d'ara mola na èèna, taha taruu.

source_text: now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia hini, sèna ka dhèu sab'a sèle oka-tedhe. lamatua ka dhu hia nganga'a, sèna ka èdhi ta'a. lamatua èèna kahèi, ka dhu hia miu mèngi-nale, ho miu bisa tao dhu lèke. èèna sama sèmi miu dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, hèia lamatua hia miu hini, ho miu sèle. aa hua-hela dhu miu abhu sèra, lamatua hia hari ae-ae, nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o.

source_text: you will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to god.
target_text: te lamatua neo pala-bagi hia miu risi nèti dhu miu parluu, sèna ka miu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, dènge d'ara be'a miu. de ladhe miu soru-bara le dhèu leo, tatu dhèu se manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: for this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to god.
target_text: te bantuan dhu miu hia mi dhèu unu lamatua ètu nèi, tatu pasamaa si. aa dènge j'ara ne'e kahèi, miu manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify god for your obedient confession of the gospel of christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
target_text: te lod'o miu soru-bara dhèu leo sèra, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a-re'a. j'ara ne'e kahèi tao dhèu leo sèra koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu bisa rèdhi dènge re'a, na, parcaya miu mi lii lolo be'a kristus leko-monya boe. èèna, lula miu tao madhutu lalèka miu. hèia ropa miu hia bantuan dènge d'ara kateme mi rèngu, aa hia mi dhèu leo kahèi, na, èèna ka dhu tao rèngu koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace god has given you.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi rare bantuan nèti miu sèra, èèna na ra sabaj'a hia miu. rèngu neo rèdhi miu kahèi, lula ama lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dedha miu.

source_text: thanks be to god for his indescribable gift!
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu hia iia èdhi hadia èci dhu be'a titu kèna, nuka yesus! kab'ua na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama peka dènge ama lamatua, na, makasi!

source_text: now by the mildness and gentleness of christ, i appeal to you-i, paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, ka dhu suri sasuri ne. tatu abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ladhe ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, ja'a makae padhai lii paled'a. te ngaa ladhe miu dènge boe ja'a, na, ja'a bani padhai lii dhu pa'abhe boe. sèmi èèna ka, si? aa te ngaa, ja'a dhu pasanèd'e le miu, na, kristus ne dhu lii mako dènge d'ara hua iia mi dedha miu.

source_text: i beg you that when i come i may not need to be as bold as i expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e nèti miu dhu ro'o boe nanene lii ja'a. rèngu peka, tatao ji'i beda boe dènge tatao dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. de ladhe ja'a dhiu, ele boe ja'a padhai lii dènge rèngu pake boe pa'abhe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka ladhe ja'a d'ai èèna, ja'a tao heka lii taka dènge rèngu.

source_text: for though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.
target_text: masi ka èdhi se dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pab'ala lii dènge dhèu leo, èdhi pakadhii boe, sèmi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: the weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the world. instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
target_text: ladhe èdhi patao dènge dhèu, baku bhèlu, te rèka èdhi sama boe dènge rèka dhèu rai-haha ne. aa ladhe èdhi patao dènge dhèu kètu hadhu, na, èdhi unu koasa lamatua, dhu bisa palaho ngangee rèngu.

source_text: we tear down arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of god; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to christ.
target_text: koasa lamatua bisa palaho aa'i ngangee dènge tatao dhu palab'a dènge lamatua, dhu tao dhèu ho ro'o boe tadhe lamatua. koasa nèngu kahèi bisa pad'elo j'ara, ho gati j'ara ngangee èdhi dhu dhui, dènge j'ara ngangee dhu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa pangee madhutu a'aj'a kristus.

source_text: and we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
target_text: ae ka nèti miu mulai d'èi nanene kristus, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na aa'i-aa'i. te ngaa abhu cahag'e nèti miu dhu ro'o boe nanene ne. de ji'i dhu pa'èra le ho huku si.

source_text: you are looking at outward appearances. if anyone is confident that he belongs to christ, he should remind himself that we belong to christ just as much as he does.
target_text: miu d'èi laladhe ngaa dhu ladhe mèdhi ètu li'u di. te ngaa miu hud'i ladhe ku d'ara dhèu. de ladhe dhèu pangee, na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus, sanèd'e paie-iie, te ji'i se dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus kahèi, sèmi nèngu.

source_text: for even if i boast somewhat excessively about the authority the lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, i will not be ashamed.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a padhai lii ae risi eele lula-nèti koasa dhu ji'i abhu nèti lamatua. sèmi èèna ka, si? aad'o! te lamatua hia koasa èèna ho pa'èra miu, aa pa'ele iie boe miu. de ja'a soro tèke eele boe dhèu dhu pamakae ja'a, lula rèngu pa'ele iie sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: i do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.
target_text: ja'a neo boe pamadha'u miu dènge sasuri ja'a sèra.

source_text: for some say, his letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sèra peka, na, baku pusi-pahae dènge paulus. te masi ka isi sasuri na bia dènge sakaa, te ngaa ladhe patoo madha, nèngu roe aala-aala, aa lii padhai dhu dènge boe koasa.

source_text: such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
target_text: te ngaa sèna ka dhèu dhu padhai lii omo koso sèra re'a, na, ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri nèti kaj'èu, beda boe dènge ngaa dhu ji'i peka-padhai, ladhe ji'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: we do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. when they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.
target_text: dhèu sèra sa d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu kapai nèti kristus. ji'i bani boe pasoro ngi'u ji'i dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. me'a, sina ma? ele boe ji'i se èra boe sama sèmi rèngu! dhèu sèmi sèra sa, dhodhoka tenge dhèu dhu sama sèmi rèngu di. sèna ka rèngu pa'èra èci dènge èci, lula rèngu se ca ropa! gagoa ra sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: we, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that god has assigned to us-a field that reaches even to you.
target_text: aa te ngaa ji'i padedha boe iisi, ladhe dènge boe kolo-kapua na. ji'i dhoka padhai lii sèmi èèna lula-nèti sasab'a dhu lamatua pangèd'u mi ji'i. ngaa dhu ji'i tao hia miu sèra, dhoka tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua ji'i sab'a. te ji'i sab'a boe dhu leo nèti èèna.

source_text: we are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of christ.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, ji'i se padhai lii karisi boe, lod'o ji'i koa-kad'iri miu. te ji'i ka dhu mai lole lii lolo be'a kristus hia miu. ka miu sèmi mere lii padhai ji'i kahèi. ladhe lamatua pua boe ji'i, te ngaa ji'i koa-kad'iri miu, na, èèna mema lèke boe.

source_text: neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. but we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo ka dhu sab'a, na, ji'i padedha boe iisi, peka na, èèna rui-j'aj'èra ji'i na. te madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya miu hud'i asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rui-j'aj'èra ji'i ètu dedha miu karèi nèti uru ka asa tabha taruu.

source_text: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man's territory.
target_text: hèia ji'i bisa la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus asa era-era dhu pakaj'èu nèti era miu, dhu abhu mèka dhèu sab'a ètu era sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, sasab'a ji'i patogo boe dènge sasab'a dhèu dhu ra pakako le ètu èèna.

source_text: rather, let him who boasts boast in the lord.
target_text: te abhu ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ladhe dhèu neo padedha iisi, na, hud'i padedha iisi dhoka lula-nèti kètu èdhi, ama lamatua di.

source_text: for it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the lord commends.
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu padhai lii dedha lula-nèti mamuri nèngu unu na, èèna sasoa na hèb'a-hua. te ngaa ladhe lamatua ka dhu koa-kad'iri dhèu ne'e, heka lèke kèna!

source_text: i hope you will bear with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.
target_text: ja'a neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa. de miu nanene sèku! lii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: i am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. for i promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to christ.
target_text: ja'a nuka sèmi ama miu, aa miu nuka sèmi ana bhèni ja'a dhu dhèu lii d'ai le. dhèu dhu lii d'ai miu èèna, nuka kristus. ka ja'a ate sale boe miu, sèna ka ladhe d'ai lod'o miu kab'i, miu kalora iisi era. hèia ja'a j'aga miu, sèna ka dhèu leo baku gagai miu, ho pa'ele iie parcaya miu.

source_text: i am afraid, however, that just as eve was deceived by the serpent's cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to christ.
target_text: ne'e ne miu madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge d'ara mola. te ngaa ja'a madha'u, mage dhoka dhèu tipu rare, miu sèna ka miu piku eele nèti j'ara mola èèna, nuka sèmi uru èèna mege tipu nare hawa. mege ne bisa tipu sèmi èèna, lula nèngu baki nèti kapod'e-kabèli!

source_text: for if someone comes and proclaims a jesus other than the one we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the one you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it way too easily.
target_text: ladhe lod'o-lod'o miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa, ho ra aj'a-nori miu lula-nèti yesus ropa leo dhu sama boe dènge yesus dhu ji'i aj'a-nori miu, na, tasamia ka miu lèka lii padhai ra? uru èèna, miu bhoke le d'ara miu ho sèmi mere roh mola-mèci lamatua, sèna ka na ator miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne, miu neo hari sèmi mere roh ropa leo èci? uru èèna, miu lèka lii lolo be'a kristus dhu ji'i aj'a miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne miu parcaya hari a'aj'a ropa leo?

source_text: i consider myself in no way inferior to those super-apostles.
target_text: dhèu se padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu kapai risi. madhutu ngangee miu, hak rèngu se risi nèti hak ja'a, do? aad'o! ja'a pake boe ngangee sèmi sèra.

source_text: although i am not a polished speaker, i am certainly not lacking in knowledge. we have made this clear to you in every way possible.
target_text: masi ka ja'a d'èlu-mèu boe ètu d'ara lii padhai pake lii dedha, te ngaa ke'a mèu sasoa nèti ngaa dhu ja'a padhue-padhai. miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, lula ja'a peka pahari-pahari le dènge miu.

source_text: was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because i preached the gospel of god to you free of charge?
target_text: lod'o ja'a aj'a miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo-oru hia ja'a. ja'a tao iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, sèna ka bisa ded'e padedha miu. teko-teko nèti j'ara ne'e ka miu neo pasala ja'a, do?

source_text: i robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.
target_text: te dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at era leo sèra ka dhu tago ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa ladhe-leru miu. ne'e èci èèna ka dènge ja'a kore nèti rèngu ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: and when i was with you and in need, i was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from macedonia supplied my needs. i have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and i will continue to do so.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ladhe ja'a parluu ngaa-ngaa, na, ja'a manèngi boe miu, aa pabia boe miu. a'ari èdhi dhu mai nèti propensi makedonia ka dhu soru-bara ja'a. te ngaa ja'a pabia kèdhi mèka miu, aa bèli-camèd'a ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: as surely as the truth of christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of achaia.
target_text: lii holo-nori kristus ne lèke tare'a-re'a. ja'a lèka mèu, na, lii padhai ja'a lèke kahèi, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge kristus. abhu boe ca dhèu sa ètu propensi akaya dhu bisa kutu hèb'a ja'a, aa kai ja'a sèna ka baku padhai lii padedha, peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna.

source_text: why? because i do not love you? god knows i do!
target_text: nga tao ka ja'a peka sèmi ne'e? ele boe, lula ja'a sue boe miu, do? masi ka miu pangee sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a, na, ja'a sue miu.

source_text: but i will keep on doing what i am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao kèdhi le, ja'a tao taruu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu tema padedha iisi, peka na, tatao rèngu sèra èci èèna ka dènge tatao ji'i, na, padhai lii rèngu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of christ.
target_text: rèngu peka, na, lamatua ka dhu pajuu-paleha rèngu. rèngu se, dhèu sab'a dhu d'èi leko-monya dhèu! dhèu se tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu lèke nèti kristus. aa te ngaa rèngu se dhoka padhai lii hèb'a-hua!

source_text: and no wonder, for satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
target_text: miu baku cag'ag'a! te dhèu aae nidhu kahèi tao iisi na sama sèmi ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu nèti saraa aa d'ara be'a.

source_text: it is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. their end will correspond to their actions.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku malaa ladhe dhèu sab'a na neo tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola. sanèd'e, te èèna na ama lamatua b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu.

source_text: i repeat: let no one take me for a fool. but if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that i too may boast a little.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, na, ja'a padhai lii hari ciki sama sèmi dhèu goa. te ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi ciki.

source_text: in this confident boasting of mine, i am not speaking as the lord would, but as a fool.
target_text: dhu ja'a suri padedha iisi ne, dhoka neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa sa. te lii padhai ja'a ne kapua na nèti boe lamatua èdhi.

source_text: since many are boasting according to the flesh, i too will boast.
target_text: abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi ded'e padedha ngi'u ra madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha ne. de ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi kahèi sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: for you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.
target_text: te miu dhu pangee, na, ngangee miu mola ladhe paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu kahadhu bia, na, miu soro tèke ne, si?

source_text: in fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo tao miu madhutu dad'èi rèngu, na, miu soro tèke si. nuka sèmi: ladhe dhèu tao miu sèmi ènu sa, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhu mana'u mèdha miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhèu tipu miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe dhèu tao iisi nuka sèmi dhèu kapai, aa pahahe miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, na, miu soro tèke ne, do? sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèb'e miu, na, miu soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: to my shame i concede that we were too weak for that! speaking as a fool, however, i can match what anyone else dares to boast about.
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! te ja'a makae, lula ji'i roe aala-aala. te ji'i lake ngare boe tao sèmi èèna, sama sèmi dhèu sèra tao mi dedha miu. te ngaa ladhe rèngu neo padedha iisi lula ngaa sa, ja'a bani padedha iisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii sèmi dhèu goa na!

source_text: are they hebrews? so am i. are they israelites? so am i. are they descendants of abraham? so am i.
target_text: rèngu se dhèu ibrani tare'a-re'a, do? oo! ja'a kahèi dhèu ibrani. rèngu dhèu isra'el, do? oo! ja'a kahèi. rèngu sèra ana-èpu abraham, do? oo! ja'a kahèi.

source_text: are they servants of christ? i am speaking like i am out of my mind, but i am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.
target_text: rèngu sèra dhèu sab'a hia kristus, do? oo! ja'a kahèi sèmi èèna. baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii paleko ne! mema, ja'a peka na, ja'a sama sèmi rèngu. aa te ngaa ja'a risi nèti rèngu. te ja'a sab'a bia risi. ra bèdho ja'a ae risi. ra game ja'a ae risi. ja'a kahèi oe madhe pahari-pahari ae risi nèti rèngu.

source_text: five times i received from the jews the forty lashes minus one.
target_text: ètu d'ara adhe-aai dhèu ja'a, dhèu yahudi, ra hake paparu ja'a lèmi hari. lod'o-lod'o ra hake paparu ja'a, na, ra hake tèlu nguru ceo hari pake gui.

source_text: three times i was beaten with rods, once i was stoned, three times i was shipwrecked. i spent a night and a day in the open sea.
target_text: tèlu hari, dhèu hake ja'a pake aj'u. ca tèka dhèu pèci neo pamadhe ja'a. ja'a molo dènge kapa tèlu hari. d'ara ca mèu ca mèda, ja'a leb'o-leb'o ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: in my frequent journeys, i have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,
target_text: ja'a laku kaj'èu asa mia-mia pahari-pahari. ètu d'ara kakako ne, ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, dhu tao ja'a oe madhe. nuka sèmi: nèti èi aae lala ètu d'ara loko aae, nèti parapo, nèti dhèu ja'a dhèu yahudi, nèti dhèu yahudi boe, aa nèti dhèu dhu tao ngi'u ra sama sèmi a'ari dhèu parcaya, aa te ngaa rèngu leko-monya. ja'a oe madhe kahèi ètu talora lèu, ètu d'ara kota, dènge era dhèu pea boe.

source_text: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.
target_text: ja'a sab'a bia, aa paraga dènge sasusa ae-ae. lod'o ae ka dhu ja'a bisa boe bhèj'i. ja'a manganga dènge koko-kamango kahèi. pahari-pahari ku'a boe ngaa-ngaa. abhu kahèi lod'o dhu ja'a unu boe mèdha-papake, ka maringi oe madhe.

source_text: apart from these external trials, i face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
target_text: aa ladhe mo'o boe ige j'ara se'e, na, ige sèmi ne'e ka: te bèli-bèli ja'a j'aj'i ngangee kapai, lula ngee kèdhi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: who is weak, and i am not weak? who is led into sin, and i do not burn with grief?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu rasa roe-bhilu dhu bisa boe sab'a ngaa-ngaa, na, sanèd'e ja'a. te ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu dadugu dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèna ka tao j'ara karehe sama-sama dènge rèngu, na, ja'a makae, aa nasa.

source_text: if i must boast, i will boast of the things that show my weakness.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, be'a risi ja'a padedha iisi lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu pad'elo raroe ja'a. tare'a!

source_text: the god and father of the lord jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that i am not lying.
target_text: kètu èdhi yesus, dènge ama na, ama lamatua re'a, na, ja'a monya boe. dhu lèke, ladhe dhèu koa-kio ne toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: in damascus, the governor under king aretas secured the city of the damascenes in order to arrest me.
target_text: conto nuka sèmi, uru èèna ètu kota damsik, gubernur nèti dhèu aae aretas pua dhèu mate ho kèpe ja'a ètu hèb'a tedhe kota.

source_text: but i was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.
target_text: te ngaa angalai ja'a pamaso ja'a asa d'ara karogo èci. ka ra dulu ja'a dènge dhari re li'u tembok kota. hèia gubernur kèpe nare boe ja'a. de sanèd'e, ladhe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, tatu bisa boe, si?

source_text: i must go on boasting. although there is nothing to gain, i will go on to visions and revelations from the lord.
target_text: ladhe miu mo'o, na, ja'a padedha iisi hari ciki, masi ka gaguna aad'o. te ngaa ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua èdhi pad'elo le dènge ja'a ètu d'ara tanila.

source_text: i know a man in christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. whether it was in the body or out of it i do not know, but god knows. and i know that this man-whether in the body or out of it i do not know, but god knows- was caught up to paradise. the things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell.
target_text: ja'a tadhe ca dhèu unu kristus. canguru èpa tèu dhu la'e, abhu dhu ded'e ne asa dedha-liru dhu dedha aae. te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe, na ca'e dènge ngi'u aae, do dhoka roh nèngu di. dhodhoka lamatua di ne'a. ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, ropa ded'e ne asa era hua iia lamatua èèna, nèngu tadèngi lii padhai dhu be'a titu kèna, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe peka-padhai.

source_text: i will boast about such a man, but i will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
target_text: de mi dhèu sèmi èèna, ja'a neo padhai lii padedha. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe padedha iisi lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a unu ku. ja'a ded'e dhoka raroe-bhilu ja'a, aa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a bisa boe tao kore.

source_text: even if i wanted to boast, i would not be a fool, because i would be speaking the truth. but i refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, ja'a parluu boe monya, te ja'a dhu dènge j'ara ae dhu lèke, dhu ja'a bisa peka-padhai. te ngaa ja'a mau-mau, sèna ka dhèu baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge kolo-karisi nèti ngaa dhu rèngu tadèngi aa ladhe rèdhi nèti ja'a.

source_text: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. so to keep me from becoming conceited, i was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of satan, to torment me.
target_text: risi-risi hari, lamatua dhu pad'elo le dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a abhu susa kahèi, sèna ka ja'a baku pamone. te dhèu aae nidhu pua ana pajuu na èci, ho mai kakèj'i taruu ja'a, nuka sèmi dhudhu dhu pakèj'i ètu d'ara isi ja'a ne. waa! ja'a j'èra titu kèna!

source_text: three times i pleaded with the lord to take it away from me.
target_text: tèlu hari kèna, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu eele j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a.

source_text: but he said to me, my grace is sufficient for you, for my power is perfected in weakness. therefore i will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of christ may rest on me.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua peka na, ja'a pad'elo le d'ara hua iia ja'a mi èu, de èèna d'ai le, sèna ka èu me'a, na, nèti d'ara raroe ka koasa ja'a asa tabha. nèti èèna ka ja'a d'èi padedha iisi ètu d'ara raroe ja'a, sèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ja'a.

source_text: that is why, for the sake of christ, i delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. for when i am weak, then i am strong.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe a'èra ja'a mesa ku bisa boe sab'a ngaa èci sa, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. de ropa dhèu pahahe ja'a, do pasusa ja'a, do paj'èra ja'a, do game ja'a, lula ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. te ladhe ja'a mesa ku bisa boe, na, ja'a abhu koasa nèti kristus, ho bisa èra tao j'ara sèra.

source_text: i have become a fool, but you drove me to it. in fact, you should have commended me, since i am in no way inferior to those super-apostles, even though i am nothing.
target_text: miu mamuri nuka sèmi me'a boe, na, lamatua pua nèdhi mèka ja'a dhiu peka-padhai dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a ako padhai lii ciki sèmi dhèu goa. madhutu iia-iia na, miu se'e ka dhu padhai lii padedha ja'a. ja'a ne mema dènge boe kab'ua, te ngaa ladhe pasoro ja'a dènge dhèu kapai sèra dhu peka na, lamatua pua-paleha rèngu, na, rèngu sèra risi boe ja'a.

source_text: the true marks of an apostle-signs, wonders, and miracles-were performed among you with great perseverance.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pua dhèu ho lole lula-nèti nèngu, dhèu ne tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa pake koasa, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha nèngu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te lod'o ja'a ètu talora aae miu, ja'a tao tadha malaa kahèi sèmi sèra. aa ja'a sab'a mau-mau.

source_text: in what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that i was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong!
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! dhodhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ja'a tao boe ètu talora miu, dhu dhèu leo tao ètu juma'at leo. nuka ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo ja'a.

source_text: see, i am ready to come to you a third time, and i will not be a burden, because i am not seeking your possessions, but you. for children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
target_text: sèmi ne'e! ja'a dhu tèlu hari kèna pa'èra kore le ho dhiu ngad'o miu. ja'a parluu boe miu ogo mamuri ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe mèdha-panyau miu kahèi. te madhutu ad'a èdhi, lèke boe ladhe ana iiki tèka mèdha-panyau hia ina-ama ra. dhu lèke nuka ina-ama ka dhu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ana niki ra. de ja'a parluu boe ladhe miu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ja'a, te miu se sama sèmi ana-ana ja'a! dhu ja'a parluu, dhoka mamuri dènge sasue miu.

source_text: and for the sake of your souls, i will most gladly spend my money and myself. if i love you more, will you love me less?
target_text: ja'a d'èi hèli mèdha hia miu. ja'a d'èi sab'a bia kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ladhe ja'a sue miu d'ai seli, na, miu hud'i sue ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. nga tao ka miu papènyi sasue miu? lèke boe, sina ma?

source_text: be that as it may, i was not a burden to you; but crafty as i am, i caught you by trickery.
target_text: ètu talora miu, abhu dhu peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ja'a dhèu dhu mèu pakapod'e miu, sèna ka miu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: did i exploit you by anyone i sent you?
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu ja'a pua dhiu asa miu sèra, tipu rare miu, do? aad'o!

source_text: i urged titus to visit you, and i sent our brother with him. did titus exploit you in any way? did we not walk in the same spirit and follow in the same footsteps?
target_text: te ja'a dhu pamako titus ho dhiu asa miu. ja'a pua a'ari dhèu parcaya èci sèna ka dhiu palere dènge titus kahèi. titus pakapod'e miu, do? aad'o, si? te titus dènge ja'a ne, ca ropa. ji'i sab'a j'ara dhu sama, te ngangee ji'i dua mi sama kahèi.

source_text: have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? we speak before god in christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! tao-tao miu dhu pangee, na, ji'i siri iisi ji'i ètu madha miu, do? aad'o! te aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai se, ama lamatua dhu ne'a le. de ji'i bisa boe pahuni ngaa-ngaa nèti nèngu. ji'i pa'èki kahèi dènge kristus. lula ji'i sue miu, nèti èèna ka aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tao sèra, sèna ka bisa pa'èra miu.

source_text: for i am afraid that when i come, i may not find you as i wish, and you may not find me as you wish. i fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu ngad'o miu, ja'a pangee mage dhoka miu j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi ja'a. te mage dhoka abhu dhu patao-palaha, d'èi boe dhèu karisi nèngu, tèka d'ara, abhu dhu pangee dhoka mamuri nèngu mesa na, abhu dhu pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, abhu dhu padhai-kakoli dhèu, abhu dhu padedha iisi, aa abhu dhu maruru jahu lulu-lulu. mage dhoka ja'a kahèi j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi miu.

source_text: i am afraid that when i come again, my god will humble me before you, and i will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu ka asa miu, ja'a j'aj'i ngangee, lula tatao-tatao miu. mage dhoka ama lamatua neo pamakae ja'a ètu madha miu. mage dhoka ja'a pabia dhèu, lula, nèti miu abhu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a era, te ngaa ele-ho'a boe, sèna ka madhutu j'ara mola nèti lamatua. rèngu se dhèu kaj'alu! te abhu dhu ad'u j'ara makae dènge mone do bhèni dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe. ra ad'u-ue j'ara makae rupa-rupa dhu re'a heka makae d'ara.

source_text: this is the third time i am coming to you. every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
target_text: de ne'e ne kali ka tèlu kèna ja'a neo dhiu ngad'o miu. ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu, na, baku bhèlu atora na. te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu èci, hud'i dènge ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi mere kèna. te ladhe abhu boe lii èci sèmi èèna, baku sèmi mere lii galaa èèna.

source_text: i already warned you the second time i was with you. so now in my absence i warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: if i return, i will not spare anyone,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhiu kali ka dua asa miu uru èèna, ja'a pasanèd'e le dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sèra. limuri ne, ja'a pasanèd'e hari rèngu sama-sama dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèra. nuka sèmi uru èèna, dhu ja'a peka kore le, na, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i mai hari, ja'a soro tèke boe rèngu sèra.

source_text: since you are demanding proof that christ is speaking through me. he is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
target_text: miu tenge bukti, dhu peka na, kristus padhai lii re ja'a. ladhe kristus neo ator miu, na tao dènge koasa kapai ètu talora aae miu. te nèngu sab'a boe dènge roe.

source_text: for he was indeed crucified in weakness, yet he lives by god's power. and though we are weak in him, yet by god's power we will live with him to serve you.
target_text: lod'o dhèu pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, mema na roe aala-aala, lula na patalale eele koasa na. te ngaa ama lamatua pangèd'u le kristus koasa, hèia na mamuri hari le. ka masi ka ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu rasa na, ji'i ètu d'ara raroe era, te ngaa ama lamatua hia le ji'i mamuri hiu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa ladhe-leru miu pake koasa nèngu.

source_text: examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. can't you see for yourselves that jesus christ is in you-unless you actually fail the test?
target_text: parisa d'ara miu unu mi dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a mi kristus, do aad'o. koasa na bisa tèdhi ètu d'ara mamuri miu, do aad'o? uji mamuri miu sèmi èèna. te ladhe kristus pa'èki boe dènge miu, miu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu na.

source_text: and i hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
target_text: ladhe miu parisa ji'i, na, miu bisa ladhe mèdhi koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ji'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, ji'i lolos.

source_text: now we pray to god that you will not do anything wrong-not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
target_text: ji'i sabaj'a kahèi manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala ngaa-ngaa. ji'i pusi-pahae boe dhèu d'èi, do d'èi boe, nèti sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ngaa ji'i d'èi ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, masi ka dhèu cahag'e tule eele ji'i. masi ka dhèu tule eele ji'i sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: for we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
target_text: te ji'i bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, ho lab'a j'ara dhu lèke. ji'i nge'a dhoka tao dhu lèke di.

source_text: in fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.
target_text: ladhe miu j'aj'i èra, aa ji'i j'aj'i roe èèna ka, ji'i karej'e-karae. te ji'i sabaj'a, ho manèngi lamatua tao pamèci miu.

source_text: this is why i write these things while absent, so that when i am present i will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, masi ka ja'a pakaj'èu dènge miu, ja'a suri tèke le j'ara se'e se, ho ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ja'a dhiu, ja'a tao heka lii sakaa dènge miu. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua èdhi. te ngaa na pangèd'u hak dènge koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka pa'ele iie boe miu, te ngaa pa'èra miu.

source_text: finally, brothers, rejoice! aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. and the god of love and peace will be with you.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne, dhoka lii maho'o di. pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ja'a. mamuri d'ara èci. miu èci dènge èci hud'i pabe'a-be'a. kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua bera-bera taruu dènge miu, aa na soru-bara miu, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: greet one another with a holy kiss.
target_text: miu hud'i pamaho'o aa pa'uu dhu pantas dènge dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu se'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu.

source_text: all the saints send you greetings.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo d'ara be'a na, ho hud'i laa miu mamuri d'ara èci. sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle-sent not from men nor by man, but by jesus christ and god the father, who raised him from the dead- and all the brothers with me, to the churches of galatia:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne asa a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi galati. a'ari dhu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ja'a pasanèd'e miu, na, ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a. nèti boe dhèu rai-haha ne. yesus kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai le. kristus madhe, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia ra pua-paleha ja'a, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge dhèu-dhèu.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our god and father,
target_text: kristus madhe, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala èdhi aa pakaj'èu èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rai-haha ne. aa'i-aa'i dhu kristus ad'u-ue sèra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: to whom be glory forever and ever. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i koa-kio ne taruu! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: i am amazed how quickly you are deserting the one who called you by the grace of christ and are turning to a different gospel-
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a heka tao miu sa mia! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na neo ho miu me'a d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa tasamia ka miu malai titu kèna lami madhutu lii lolo leo

source_text: which is not even a gospel. evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of christ.
target_text: dhu lèke boe? uuru èèna, ja'a aj'a le dhu mola-mola lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra mai pakapod'e lii lolo be'a èèna, toke miu malaa-maloha.

source_text: but even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a lamatua huku dhèu dhu aj'a lii lolo be'a dhu sama boe dènge dhu ji'i aj'a-nori uru èèna. masi ka dhèu nèti ji'i do, ana pajuu nèti sorga do, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: as we have said before, so now i say again: if anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!
target_text: ji'i dhu peka le karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo hari pasanèd'e sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu aj'a leo nèti lii lolo be'a dhu miu abhu le uru èèna, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: am i now seeking the approval of men, or of god? or am i striving to please men? if i were still trying to please men, i would not be a servant of christ.
target_text: ja'a bani peka sèmi èèna, lula ja'a neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, neo boe pakarej'e dhèu rai-haha ne. miu ngee, na, ja'a tenge kolongara nèti dhèu rai-haha, do? aad'o! te ladhe ja'a tao sèmi èèna, ja'a pantas boe j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti kristus.

source_text: for i certify to you, brothers, that the gospel i preached was not devised by man.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka paled'a dènge miu, na, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori miu, nèti boe tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: i did not receive it from any man, nor was i taught it; rather, i received it by revelation from jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a abhu boe nèti dhèu rai-haha, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu aj'a-nori ja'a. te yesus kristus mesa na ka dhu bhoke sasoa na mi ja'a.

source_text: for you have heard of my former way of life in judaism, how severely i persecuted the church of god and tried to destroy it.
target_text: tatu miu tadèngi le lii lolo nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a, lod'o ja'a madhutu agama yahudi era, si? lod'o èèna, ja'a paj'èra titu kèna dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, aa neo pa'ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: i was advancing in judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
target_text: aa lod'o èèna kahèi, d'ara ja'a neo titu kèna aj'a j'ara-j'ara agama yahudi, risi nèti dhèu yahudi dhu leo dhu ca dadena dènge ja'a. aa ja'a ne maj'èni risi pakako ad'a bèi-baki èdhi dènge atora agama aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but when god, who set me apart from my mother's womb and called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his son in me so that i might preach him among the gentiles, i did not rush to consult with flesh and blood,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le ho patadhe ana na mi ja'a. ina ku dhae nara iisi mèka ja'a, te nèngu dhu hag'e mema le ja'a, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèngu kahèi pua ja'a ho laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o na pua ja'a èèna, laku boe manèngi a'abhu nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: nor did i go up to jerusalem to the apostles who came before me, but i went into arabia and later returned to damascus.
target_text: aa laku boe paraga dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen dhu j'aj'i mema le dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus ètu kota yerusalem. te ngaa laku dènge ka asa rai arab. èle ka, ja'a lèpa hari asa kota damsik.

source_text: only after three years did i go up to jerusalem to confer with cephas, and i stayed with him fifteen days.
target_text: hèia lalu eele tèlu tèu ku, heka laku paraga dènge petrus ètu yerusalem, ho pakarèi j'ara-j'ara nèti nèngu. ka ja'a manubha taha canguru lèmi lod'o ètu nèi.

source_text: but i saw none of the other apostles except james, the lord's brother.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a paraga kahèi dènge yakobis, ari d'èlu lamatua yesus. te ngaa ja'a paraga boe dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra. dhoka dua ra di.

source_text: i assure you before god that what i am writing to you is no lie.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a suri ne, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! ja'a kapod'e boe! lamatua ne'a aa'i!

source_text: later i went to the regions of syria and cilicia.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ja'a laku asa propensi siria dènge propensi kilikia.

source_text: i was personally unknown, however, to the churches of judea that are in christ.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu-dhèu unu kristus ètu propensi yudea, dhae tadhe mèka ja'a.

source_text: they only heard the account: the man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.
target_text: dhèu se'e dhoka tadèngi lii palolo, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu uru èèna paj'èra èdhi, limuri ne nuka aj'a lii lolo be'a kristus. nèngu ka dhu uru èèna, neo pa'ele iie aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they glorified god because of me.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio ama lamatua, lula ja'a parcaya le yesus kristus.

source_text: fourteen years later i went up again to jerusalem, accompanied by barnabas. i took titus along also.
target_text: d'ai èle canguru èpa tèu, hèia ja'a lèpa asa kota yerusalem sama-sama dènge barnabas. aa ji'i ngèti dènge titus, ca dhèu parcaya dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: i went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that i preach among the gentiles. but i spoke privately to those recognized as leaders, for fear that i was running or had already run in vain.
target_text: ja'a laku asa nèi, lula lii paredha ama lamatua. d'ai nèi, ka ja'a lole mi dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o èèna, ja'a peka unu ku mi rèngu se, ho ra parisa pabe'a-be'a ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a le sèra, lèke do aad'o. te ladhe ra pama'ète, peka na, a'aj'a ja'a èèna sala, na, dhèu bisa ngee, na, ja'a sab'a iia d'ara di!

source_text: yet not even titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a greek.
target_text: ropa dhèu se'e tadèngi rare lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra sèmi rare dènge be'a. aa ra d'èi sèmi rare titus dènge be'a kahèi. masi ka titus dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa ra laka-seti boe sèna ka na suna.

source_text: this issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom in christ jesus, in order to enslave us.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu a'ari dhèu pèri dhu d'èi boe a'aj'a ja'a, lula rèngu se aj'a dhu leo. rèngu se, dhèu kristen kapod'e-kabèli. ka rèngu mau-mau mai laka-seti dhèu unu kristus sèra dhu dhèu yahudi boe, ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. te ngaa, lula yesus kristus patalale eele le èdhi, nèti èèna ka atora sèra èki heka èdhi, sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: we did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.
target_text: masi ka ra laka-seti sèmi èèna, te ngaa ciki sa ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi ngare. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa parcaya taruu lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a nori le. te dhu mola-mola na kèna!

source_text: but as for the highly esteemed-whatever they were makes no difference to me; god does not show favoritism -those leaders added nothing to me.
target_text: dhèu heka-dhèu heka se sèmi rare lii a'aj'a ja'a ne, aa ra patabha heka ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu. de masi ka rèngu dhèu kapai do ana iiki, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: on the contrary, they saw that i had been entrusted to preach the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as peter had been to the circumcised.
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka: rèngu re'a, na, ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a, ho kèti lii lolo be'a mi dhèu-dhèu yahudi boe. nuka sèmi dhu na paredha mi petrus kahèi, sèna ka nèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: for the one who was at work in peter's apostleship to the circumcised was also at work in my apostleship to the gentiles.
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi petrus ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu yahudi. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia ja'a koasa sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and recognizing the grace that i had been given, james, cephas, and john-those reputed to be pillars-gave me and barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
target_text: lod'o èèna, madhutu ngangee dhèu sèra, yakobis, petrus, dènge yohanis, dhu j'aj'i le ama-ama gareja. ropa rèngu tèlu ra re'a, na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, hèia ra kèd'i paj'ola ai dènge ja'a, aa dènge barnabas, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ara èci le. rèngu ro'o kahèi, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi boe, aa rèngu rèti asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: they only asked us to remember the poor, the very thing i was eager to do.
target_text: dhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ra pasanèd'e ji'i, nuka ji'i baku bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra. mema j'ara ne'e ka dhu ja'a neo tao.

source_text: when cephas came to antioch, however, i opposed him to his face, because he stood to be condemned.
target_text: ka ca tèka, petrus mai asa kota antiokia. hèia ja'a kai ne patoo madha dènge madha, lula nèngu tao sala.

source_text: for before certain men came from james, he used to eat with the gentiles. but when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself, for fear of those in the circumcision group.
target_text: lod'o na heka mai, nèngu karèj'e madhèdi na'a dènge dhèu-dhèu unu kristus dhu dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa ropa angalai yakobis dhèu yahudi sèra mai, hèia petrus mulai pakaj'èu nèti a'ari dhèu yahudi boe, ka na na'a pa'èci heka dènge rèngu. te lula na madha'u dènge a'aj'a nèti dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, dhèu unu kristus hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra atora agama yahudi aa'i-aa'i, aa hud'i pakaj'èu ku dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: the other jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even barnabas was led astray.
target_text: ropa rèdhi tatao petrus ne, ka dhèu yahudi dhu leo sèra tao madhutu kahèi. toke barnabas kahèi madhutu tatao ra dhu peka leo, tao leo.

source_text: when i saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, i said to cephas in front of them all, if you, who are a jew, live like a gentile and not like a jew, how can you compel the gentiles to live like jews?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ja'a patigi kèdhi, rèngu madhutu be'a heka dad'èi lii lolo be'a, hèia ja'a kai dènge ka petrus ètu katanga madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, eee, petrus! èu ne, mema dhèu yahudi. te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara, ho dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus pa'èki heka madhutu atora agama yahudi sèra. aa èu dhu sèmi more le j'ara ne'e, nga tasamia ka, èu laka-seti dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka tao iisi ra sama sèmi dhèu yahudi?

source_text: we who are jews by birth and not gentile sinners
target_text: ja'a kai petrus sèmi èèna, lula ji'i dua mi dhèu yahudi. suku ji'i dua mi se dhèu yahudi, sama boe dènge suku leo sèra, lula suku ji'i dhu nèbhu le tadhe ama lamatua.

source_text: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in jesus christ. so we, too, have believed in christ jesus, that we may be justified by faith in christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nge'a kahèi, na, lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula nèngu tao madhutu atora agama dènge be'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe nèngu parcaya yesus kristus, lula boe nèti nèngu madhutu atora agama. sèmi èèna ku, heka lamatua peka na, dhèu ne dènge heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: but if, while we seek to be justified in christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make christ a minister of sin? certainly not!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i aj'a, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula na parcaya yesus kristus. te ngaa abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pasala ji'i. ra peka na, ji'i parcaya yesus kristus, te ngaa kèpe heka atora agama yahudi. miu neo pèci sasala sèmi èèna mi ji'i kahèi, do?

source_text: if i rebuild what i have already torn down, i prove myself to be a lawbreaker.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a kèpe kore hari atora agama dhu ja'a patabuli eele le, èèna heka peka na ja'a sala kèna!

source_text: for through the law i died to the law so that i might live to god. i have been crucified with christ, and i no longer live, but christ lives in me. the life i live in the body, i live by faith in the son of god, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
target_text: mema uru èèna, ja'a tenge j'ara ho madhutu dènge be'a atora agama yahudi, sèna ka ja'a pabe'a dènge lamatua. te ngaa bisa boe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tèke eele le atora agama sèra, ho mamuri pa'èki dènge kristus. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu mola. peka sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a madhe lèke paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sama-sama dènge kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a boe ka dhu mamuri, te ngaa kristus ka dhu mamuri ètu d'ara ngi'u ja'a. ja'a abhu mamuri dhu hiu ne, lula parcaya ana nèti lamatua. te nèngu sue ja'a titu kèna, toke na madhe gati ja'a.

source_text: i do not set aside the grace of god. for if righteousness comes through the law, christ died for nothing.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a, lula d'ara hua iia na, lula boe nèti ja'a madhutu atora agama sèra. te ladhe dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua lula madhutu atora agama, èèna sasoa na, mamadhe kristus iia-iia d'ara di. sèra sa ka dhu ja'a peka dènge petrus si ètu antiokia.

source_text: o foolish galatians! who has bewitched you? before your very eyes jesus christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
target_text: heh! dhèu galati sèra! uru èèna, ja'a unu ku lole dènge miu patoo madha dènge madha, lula-nèti mamadhe yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa limuri ne dhèu monya miu mamadha iia-iia! miu se, goa titu kèna!

source_text: i would like to learn just one thing from you: did you receive the spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?
target_text: ja'a neo dhoka karèi ca j'ara di. miu sèmi mere le roh lamatua èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! roh na mai asa miu, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: are you so foolish? after starting in the spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
target_text: de, nga tao ka miu goa sèmi èèna, ee? uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu kabèli hari, mamuri madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu dhu miu parcaya kristus èèna, miu abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna. mage dhoka j'ara sèra ele iia d'ara di! te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya mi kristus ele boe iia d'ara.

source_text: does god lavish his spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hia roh na, aa pad'elo rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu madha miu, miu ngee, na, lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: so also, abraham believed god, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
target_text: sanèd'e mèdhi era sina ma, bèi-baki dhèu yahudi, nuka abraham. te sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lula na parcaya ama lamatua, ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of abraham.
target_text: de miu hud'i me'a pabe'a-be'a ku j'ara ne'e! dhèu dhu parcaya sama sèmi abraham, rèngu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: the scripture foresaw that god would justify the gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to abraham: all nations will be blessed through you.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu nèti suku leo j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ladhe ra parcaya ne. te uru èèna, na peka mema le mi abraham lii lolo be'a, na, bèli-camèd'a suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale lula èu ne.

source_text: so those who have faith are blessed along with abraham, the man of faith.
target_text: lula lii moa ama lamatua èèna, ka na papuru kahèi berkat mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, nuka sèmi dhu na hia mi abraham.

source_text: all who rely on works of the law are under a curse. for it is written: cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the book of the law.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu atora agama, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu hud'i pasae nare ku babia nèti atora sèra aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi nèngu lèke le dhoo. te dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, dhèu dhu madhutu boe taruu atora agama d'ai lutu, nèngu lèke le dhoo èèna!

source_text: now it is clear that no one is justified before god by the law, because, the righteous will live by faith.
target_text: te ngaa te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa, lula na madhutu atora agama. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, heka sèmi kore ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ho na abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: the law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, the man who does these things will live by them.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu neo mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora agama, nèngu hud'i tao madhutu ku aa'i-aa'i toke lutu! te lamatua dhu peka mema le ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, dhèu dhu neo mamuri madhutu atora, èèna na nèngu bhute dhoka dènge atora sèra di.

source_text: christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. for it is written: cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.
target_text: te ngaa kristus b'ae pama'ète le, ho patabuli èdhi nèti atora agama dhu èki èdhi. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri oe madhe, dènge pasae babia atora agama, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu lèke dhoo. te ngaa limuri ne lamatua yesus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti èdhi. te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, ladhe dhèu madhe lèke kadhoe ètu agarii, sasoa na, nèngu madhe aapa.

source_text: he redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to abraham would come to the gentiles in christ jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the spirit.
target_text: ropa yesus kristus madhe, sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri mi èdhi, berkat èèna ka dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi abraham, aa hia kahèi mi suku leo. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus, bisa abhu roh ama lamatua dhu na jaji le.

source_text: brothers, let me put this in human terms. even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! doe ne'e ja'a neo kore pakasame nèti mamuri èdhi bèli-mai bèli-mai. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu suri sasuri lii padhadha nèti pusaka, ka dhu ènyi le ngara na ètu sasuri ne, sasoa na, sasuri ne lèke tare'a. dhèu leo bisa boe ère eele ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, aa bisa boe suri tabha hari ngaa-ngaa asa d'ara sasuri èèna.

source_text: the promises were spoken to abraham and to his seed. the scripture does not say, and to seeds, meaning many, but and to your seed, meaning one, who is christ.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o ama lamatua patari lii padhadha dènge abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. ama lamatua peka boe, na, ja'a patari lii padhadha ne dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, lula na padhadha boe dènge dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa na padhadha dhoka dènge ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu di, nuka kristus.

source_text: what i mean is this: the law that came 430 years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by god, so as to nullify the promise.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua paj'ari uru lii padhadha dènge abraham. hèia èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu ku, heka na papuru atora agama hia dhèu yahudi kèna, re baki ra musa. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, lamatua ère heka lii padhadha dhu na tao uru èèna.

source_text: for if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but god freely granted it to abraham through a promise.
target_text: te lamatua hia boe mèngi-nale mi abraham, lula na tao madhutu atora ne. te ngaa lamatua hia berkat lula na moa tèke le, karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia hadia mi abraham. èèna nuka sèmi ana ca dhèu abhu pusaka nèti ama na. ana ne abhu pusaka na, lula ama na dhu padhadha uru le, lula boe nèti ana ne tao madhutu atora.

source_text: why then was the law given? it was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. it was administered through angels by a mediator.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ama lamatua sèmi nare abraham j'aj'i mi dhèu mola lula lalèka na, nga tao ka lamatua tabha hari atora agama re musa? lamatua tabha atora agama sèra, sèna ka aj'a dhèu rai-haha lula-nèti sasala-sasigo ra. dad'èi na sèna ka dhèu rai-haha mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora sèra, toke ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu mai. hèia ladhe dhèu ne mai ka, nuka kristus èèna, na, atora ne parluu heka. lod'o lamatua papuru atora agama yahudi, nèngu j'ole mema boe mi dhèu yahudi sèra. te ngaa na hia re ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai pangèd'u mi adhe-aai musa, heka musa hia asa dhèu yahudi kèna. dènge j'ara ne'e, musa j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalete sa nèti lamatua dènge dhèu-dhèu unu na.

source_text: a mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but god is one.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ama lamatua tao lii pajaji dènge abraham, na pake boe kalete. te lamatua peka unu na dènge abraham! dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, lii pajaji lamatua ne kab'ua risi eele nèti atora sèra.

source_text: is the law, then, opposed to the promises of god? certainly not! for if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
