target_text: lod'o lamatua hia atora agama asa musa èèna, pasala dènge lii-lii pajaji na, do? aad'o! te ladhe abhu atora dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa tao madhutu ne, ho lamatua sèmi nare ne sèna ka na bisa mamuri, tatu atora dhèu yahudi bisa tao sèmi èèna kahèi. madhutu iia-iia na, abhu boe atora èci sa dhu dhèu bisa tao madhutu ne, sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua ho lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: but the scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in jesus christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
target_text: te ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, suri peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki madhe dènge rupa-rupa sasala ra. nèti èèna ka, dhodhoka dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus di, bisa abhu ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa tèke èèna.

source_text: before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.
target_text: lod'o kristus dhae mai mèka, ji'i dhèu yahudi pa'èki madhe dènge atora sèra, toke bisa boe kalau. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua bhoke j'ara ho ji'i kalua nèti atora sèra, ladhe ji'i parcaya kristus.

source_text: so the law became our guardian to lead us to christ, that we might be justified by faith. now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
target_text: de atora agama sèra, sama sèmi dhèu madhenge dhu aj'a paie-iie èdhi toke kristus mai. te ngaa ropa na mai ku, heka èdhi bisa parcaya ne, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi parluu heka dhèu madhenge èèna.

source_text: you are all sons of god through faith in christ jesus.
target_text: limuri ne, miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, lula miu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for all of you who were baptized into christ have clothed yourselves with christ.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu sarani èle le, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu pa'èki madhe dènge ne.

source_text: there is neither jew nor greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in christ jesus.
target_text: dhèu dhu lèka kristus, aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, beda boe. de masi ka miu dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do ènu boe, dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni, aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, ca ropa èèna ka.

source_text: and if you belong to christ, then you are abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise.
target_text: kristus ne, ana-èpu abraham dhu ama lamatua padhadha karèi nèti uru ka. lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka miu j'aj'i le tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa kahèi abhu berkat dhu ama lamatua moa tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: what i am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dhu leo hari. ca dhèu ana dhu dènge hak ho abhu pusaka nèti ama na, ladhe ama na madhe. te ngaa ladhe ana ne ana iiki ae era, nèngu bisa mèka abhu pusaka èèna, masi ka èèna na aa'i-aa'i se unu nèngu. lula nèngu d'ai mèka umur, nèngu ne nuka sèmi ènu dhu dènge boe hak, sèna ka nare mèdha-panyau lamatua na.

source_text: he is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hud'i dènge ku dhèu dhu pa'uri ana ne dènge pusaka na. ana ne hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi nèti dhèu madhenge nèngu, toke d'ai lod'o dhu ama na pama'ète nare èèna, heka na sèmi nare pusaka na kèna.

source_text: so also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi. lod'o yesus kristus dhae mai mèka, èdhi nuka sèmi ana iiki èèna. te èdhi dhu pa'èki madhe dènge dad'èi rai-haha, nuka sèmi ènu ca dhèu.

source_text: but when the time had fully come, god sent his son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, ama lamatua pua mai ana d'èlu na dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha èèna, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha bisa kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua ded'e nare j'aj'i ana-ana na. ana d'èlu na èèna mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, sèna ka nèngu bisa patabuli dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge atora se.

source_text: and because you are sons, god sent the spirit of his son into our hearts, crying out, abba, father!
target_text: lula miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na hia le roh ana na mai asa d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu dènge hak paroa ama lamatua, na, ama pasue.

source_text: so you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through god.
target_text: de limuri ne miu j'aj'i heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. te ngaa miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua dhu dènge hak, sèna ka abhu pusaka aa'i-aa'i dhu na pajaji tèke le.

source_text: formerly, when you did not know god, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua, miu tao iisi mi j'aj'i ènu, ho sogo-tagu ngaa-ngaa dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but now that you know god, or rather are known by god, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu tadhe le ama lamatua. be'a risi, ja'a peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu tadhe miu. de tasamia ka miu neo lèpa hari asa sogo-tagu ngaa dhu guna boe, aa dhu dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa sèra? miu neo tao iisi mi pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara sèra, sèna ka j'aj'i hari ènu ra, do?

source_text: you are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, miu kèpe atora ho pakab'ua risi lod'o-lod'o hua iia madhutu lod'o, hèru, èj'i lai, hèru hadhu, dènge tèu, ho neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: i fear for you, that my efforts for you may have been in vain.
target_text: ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee ja'a! mage dhoka j'aj'èra ja'a aj'a-nori miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ele iie d'ara di.

source_text: i beg you, brothers, become like me, for i became like you. you have done me no wrong.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki ia ka dènge madha j'ara sèra, sèmi ja'a ne. te mamuri ja'a ne pa'èki heka le dènge atora agama, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe. uru èèna, lod'o èdhi bera-bera era, miu pasusa boe ja'a.

source_text: you know that it was because of an illness that i first preached the gospel to you.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a mai hiu-hiu èèna, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ngi'u aae ja'a ne roe-bhilu.

source_text: and although my illness was a trial to you, you did not despise or reject me. instead, you welcomed me as if i were an angel of god, as if i were christ jesus himself.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu tule eele boe ja'a, lula miu sèmi mere ja'a nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. risi-risi hari, miu sèmi mere ja'a ne, nuka sèmi yesus kristus mesa na.

source_text: what then has become of your blessing? for i can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
target_text: lod'o èèna, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti karej'e titu kèna. te ngaa, nga tao ka limuri ne, sèmi heka èèna? uru èèna, miu sue ja'a titu kèna, ka miu toke neo ed'o eele ana madha miu ho hia ja'a.

source_text: have i now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu ngee, na, ja'a j'aj'i le musu miu, lula ja'a padhai dhu mola dènge miu, do?

source_text: those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ro'o boe ja'a pa'angalai dènge miu, ka ra dadugu miu ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. dad'èi d'ara ra, sèna ka miu bhute madhutu dad'èi rèngu di.

source_text: nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose-at any time, and not only when i am with you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu maj'èni tao j'ara dhu be'a, èèna be'a kahèi! masi ka ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i miu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: my children, for whom i am again in the pains of childbirth until christ is formed in you,
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a sab'a bia risi hari hia miu, nuka sèmi bhèni dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. te ja'a ae kora boe ciki sa nèti sasab'a, toke d'ara miu èci èèna ka dènge d'ara kristus.

source_text: how i wish i could be with you now and change my tone, because i am perplexed about you.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a ke'a heka neo tao miu tasamia hari! ja'a d'èi titu kèna, dhiu padhai lii patoo madha dènge miu, sèna ka ja'a baku padhai lii taka sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?
target_text: ladhe miu neo mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, be'a risi miu me'a uuru ku dad'èi nèti atora sèra.

source_text: for it is written that abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua abhu lii lolo dhu lole, peka na, ana mone abraham, dhèu dua. nèngu abhu ana ca dhèu nèti bhèni dhu ènu na, aa ca dhèu hari nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhu ènu boe.

source_text: his son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
target_text: ènu ne nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa dhèu èmu abraham nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka mema le.

source_text: these things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. one covenant is from mount sinai and bears children into slavery: this is hagar.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, nuka sèmi tadha dhu pad'elo dua lii pajaji dhu ama lamatua padhadha dènge dhèu rai-haha. lii pajaji èci, lamatua pangèd'u mi musa ètu ledhe sinai, lod'o nèngu papuru atora agama dhèu yahudi. dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge atora agama sèra, rèngu j'aj'i ènu sama sèmi hagar kahèi.

source_text: now hagar stands for mount sinai in arabia and corresponds to the present-day jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
target_text: era ètu ledhe sinai ètu rae arab èèna, nuka sèmi hagar ne kahèi. dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i lod'o limuri ne, dhu pa'èki era dènge atora agama yahudi, rèngu sèra ènu kahèi nuka sèmi hagar.

source_text: but the jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
target_text: te ngaa lii pajaji dhu leo hari, paj'uj'u asa kota yerusalem dhu leo èci ètu sorga. ana-ana unu ama lamatua dhu pea ètu èèna, ènu boe. te rèngu dhèu bebas dhu pa'èki boe dènge atora agama èèna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se èci èèna ka dènge ina ji'i sara, dhèu èmu abraham.

source_text: for it is written: rejoice, o barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri tèke, peka na, wee! bhèni dhu nara iisi nèdhi boe! pakarej'e d'ara mu! wee! bhèni dhu rasa nèdhi boe kabake pèd'a nara iisi! sod'a pakarej'e d'ara mu! bhèni dhu d'ara roe-bhilu, lula dhèu èmu na pusi-pahae heka ne, pe na abhu ana ae risi nèti bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu-kamali.

source_text: now you, brothers, like isaac, are children of promise.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna ama lamatua dhu padhadha le hia ana mi abraham. te ngaa nèbhu ku, heka lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na kèna, hèia sara nara iisi isak hia abraham. èdhi sama sèmi isak kahèi, lula ama lamatua pajaji hia abraham ana-èpu dhu leo kahèi.

source_text: at that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the spirit. it is the same now.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana ènu dhu j'aj'i madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha èèna, ropa na kapai, na paj'èra isak, dhu j'aj'i madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua. èèna sama kahèi dènge ngaa dhu j'aj'i limuri ne.

source_text: but what does the scripture say? expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman's son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman's son.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri kahèi, peka na, babège eele ènu dènge ana na. te ana nèti ènu ne dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. dhodhoka ana nèti dhèu èmu kab'i na dhu dènge hak.

source_text: therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! èdhi sama boe dènge ana nèti ènu, lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi. te èdhi nuka sèmi ana nèti dhèu èmu kab'i abraham, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: it is for freedom that christ has set us free. stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
target_text: uru èèna dhèu yahudi j'èra bia pasae atora agama ra. te ngaa limuri ne, kristus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti dhèu dhu parcaya ne. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi pasae heka babia. de miu baku lèke kapod'e-kabèli, ho pasae hari atora sèra, tao nuka sèmi ènu sa!

source_text: take notice: i, paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, christ will be of no value to you at all.
target_text: de nanene, ee! ja'a ne, paulus, ka dhu peka lii ne'e. ladhe miu suna ho madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, na, mamadhe kristus dhu hia miu bebas èèna, gaguna na aad'o!

source_text: again i testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
target_text: ladhe dhèu suna ho madhutu atora agama sèmi èèna, nèngu hud'i pasae hari ku atora sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. miu sanèd'e era, do aad'o? te uru èèna, ja'a dhu peka mema le.

source_text: you who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from christ; you have fallen away from grace.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo pake atora, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu tao iisi na pakaj'èu nèti kristus. te dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu core eele d'ara hua iia ama lamatua.

source_text: but by faith we eagerly await through the spirit the hope of righteousness.
target_text: te ngaa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu bhoke j'ara hia èdhi, ho èdhi parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka èdhi sanao, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pama'ète, na, èdhi dhèu mola.

source_text: for in christ jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. all that matters is faith, expressed through love.
target_text: masi ka dhèu suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu hua iia risi, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya kristus aa sue dhèu leo.

source_text: you were running so well. who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu cee ka dhu kapod'e-kabèli miu, ka miu madhutu heka j'ara èèna?

source_text: such persuasion does not come from the one who calls you.
target_text: te a'aj'a-nanori kapod'e-kabèli dhu miu nanene èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu ka dhu paroa nare miu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.
target_text: ngaa dhu ra aj'a, hiu-hiu èèna dhoka ca hèb'a-dua hèb'a di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, lii a'aj'a ne tao ngangee miu ele iie. nuka sèmi ragi ciki dhu dhèu pakihu dènge tarigu ho neo tao roti. nèbhu-nèbhu hèia ragi ne'e ka paca'e tarigu dhu pakihu èèna.

source_text: i am confident in the lord that you will take no other view. the one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
target_text: lula èdhi j'aj'i le èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a mèu, nèngu èèna hia miu parcaya hari mi ngaa dhu ja'a nori le sèra. aa ama lamatua mesa na, pe huku dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie lalèka miu.

source_text: now, brothers, if i am still preaching circumcision, why am i still being persecuted? in that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! ladhe ja'a aj'a, peka na, dhèu hud'i suna ku, tatu ja'a abhu boe j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. aa dhèu yahudi tule eele boe a'aj'a ja'a lula-nèti mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: as for those who are agitating you, i wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli miu sèra lula j'ara suna, na soro tèke si sèna ka rèngu unu ra pake tud'i ho ari eele mèdha nèti isi ra!

source_text: for you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. rather, serve one another in love.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lamatua patabuli le miu, ho miu mamuri pa'èki heka dènge dad'èi atora agama. te ngaa mage pangee, na, miu bisa tao leli ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi miu di! te dhu lèke, nuka miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku, aa paladha-leru èci dènge èci, sèmi ènu lalau-lalo'o lamatua na.

source_text: the entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: love your neighbor as yourself.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ladhe miu tao madhutu dhoka atora sasue ne di, na, miu tao aa'i le madhutu dad'èi atora agama dhèu yahudi.

source_text: but if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu èci patao-palaha dènge èci, do, èci pakèji dènge èci, pe mèdhi unu mi! nèbhu boe, te miu palaho ngi'u miu unu mi.

source_text: so i say, walk by the spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, miu madhutu heka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for the flesh craves what is contrary to the spirit, and the spirit what is contrary to the flesh. they are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
target_text: te dad'èi dhèu rai-haha madhutu boe dad'èi roh. aa dad'èi roh madhutu boe dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. dua ra bisa boe pa'èci, te ngaa palab'a taruu! nèti èèna ka, miu bisa heka tao hari madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi!

source_text: but if you are led by the spirit, you are not under the law.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua ator miu, na, miu pa'èki heka dènge atora sèra.

source_text: the acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
target_text: dhèu dhu loe boe madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, nuka sèmi: dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhèu dhu ngangee kaj'alu, dhu re'a boe d'ara makae,

source_text: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
target_text: dhu sogo-tagu nidhu ho suagi dhèu, dhu pamusu, dhu d'èi pasibha d'ara lii, dhu tèka d'ara, dhu nasa leli, dhu ngee dhoka ngi'u na, dhu d'èi kakèj'i dhèu, dhu d'èi tao maruru,

source_text: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. i warn you, as i did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhu d'èi boe dhèu leo risi ne, dhu d'èi mahu paa-paa, dhu d'èi madhutu pesta toke re'a heka makae, aa d'èi tao sasala dhu leo hari. uru èèna, dhu ja'a pasanèd'e le, na, dhèu dhu tema tao j'ara-j'ara sèmi sèra, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: but the fruit of the spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, èèna na roh tao ne ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'èi pasue, d'ara dhu karej'e-karae, dhu d'èi padame, taha nare d'ara, d'ara be'a dènge dhèu leo, dhu d'èi soru-bara dhèu, dhu d'èi kèpe pa'èra-èra lii pajaji,

source_text: gentleness, and self-control. against such things there is no law.
target_text: dhu lii mako dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa j'aga paie-iie mamuri na. abhu boe atora èci sa dhu magee j'ara se'e se.

source_text: those who belong to christ jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus, nèngu dhu pakaj'èu le nèti dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te d'ara dhu d'èi tao bhelu èèna, dhu na paku pamadhe le ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge yesus.

source_text: since we live by the spirit, let us walk in step with the spirit.
target_text: de ladhe roh lamatua hia le mamuri hiu mi èdhi, na, èdhi hud'i madhutu taruu ku dad'èi nèngu.

source_text: let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku padedha iisi, baku d'èi èci kakèj'i èci, aa baku patèka d'ara èci dènge èci.

source_text: brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. but watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ladhe abhu dhèu parcaya ca dhèu dhu tao sala, na, miu dhu me'a tare'a-re'a dad'èi roh lamatua, lami padhai lii mako-mako dènge ne dènge d'ara mola. hèia mèti hari ne, sèna ka madhutu j'ara dhu lèke nèti lamatua. te ngaa j'aga ngi'u mi, sèna ka baku manahu asa sasala na èèna.

source_text: carry one another's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of christ.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paraga dènge sasusa, na, miu dhu leo lami soru-bara ne. te dènge sèmi èèna, miu tao le madhutu atora nèti kristus.

source_text: if anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu padedha iisi, peka na, nèngu risi nèti dhèu leo, aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, na, nèngu tipu ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: each one should test his own work. then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
target_text: de ca dhèu-dhèu ka hud'i parisa ku ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue. ladhe ngaa dhu nèngu tao ne be'a le, pe ne'a unu na. mage pasèku dènge tatao dhèu leo.

source_text: for each one should carry his own load.
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi èèna, lula ca dhèu-dhèu ka dhu tago nare unu na, ngaa dhu nèngu tao.

source_text: nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, nèngu hud'i pabagi ku rui-j'aj'èra na, ho soru-bara dhèu dhu aj'a-nori nèngu.

source_text: do not be deceived: god is not to be mocked. whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ama lamatua ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. de baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi, aa baku neo tipu lamatua. lula, ngaa dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka-tedhe, pe nèngu abhu hari hua-hela na.

source_text: the one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the spirit, from the spirit will reap eternal life.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na dui nare hari mamuri dhu ele iie. te ngaa ladhe dhèu tao j'ara be'a madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci, pe nèngu abhu hari mamuri dhu lèke toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a. te ropa d'ai lod'o na, èdhi abhu hari j'ara dhu be'a, sad'i èdhi taha taruu.

source_text: therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
target_text: de ropa èdhi abhu lod'o dhu taleo, na, èdhi tao mema ka j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, risi-risi mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: see what large letters i am using to write to you with my own hand!
target_text: sasuri ne'e, ja'a ka suri unu ku, pake huruf dhu kapai aae hua.

source_text: those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. they only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of christ.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra lèka kahèi mi yesus kristus dhu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa rèngu laka-seti miu ho suna, lula ra madha'u dènge dhèu yahudi leo, rèngu mage dhèu se paj'èra si, ladhe rèngu aj'a, peka na, ama lamatua sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu madhutu boe atora suna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se d'èi solo-mako dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: for the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
target_text: masi ka rèngu dhu suna le, te ngaa rèngu unu ra madhutu aa'i boe atora agama sèra. rèngu d'èi ho miu madhutu suna, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, partei ra ded'e padedha-dedha rèngu.

source_text: but as for me, may i never boast, except in the cross of our lord jesus christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and i to the world.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ne d'èi dhoka ded'e padedha-dedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. nèngu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pusi-pahae heka dènge dad'èi rai-haha. aa dad'èi rai-haha ne èki heka ja'a.

source_text: for neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. what counts is a new creation.
target_text: suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu karisi, nuka èdhi abhu mamuri hiu nèti lamatua.

source_text: peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the israel of god.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu a'aj'a ja'a ne, ho rèngu mamuri padame, aa pad'elo rasa kasia èci dènge èci. te rèngu j'aj'i le suku dhu hiu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: from now on let no one cause me trouble, for i bear on my body the marks of jesus.
target_text: ja'a peka mola-mola kèna, na, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu sèku ia ka ja'a dènge lii langu suna ne. te ètu ngi'u ja'a ne dènge tadha nu'a era, lula ja'a sab'a hia yesus kristus.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with your spirit, brothers. amen.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na asa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of christ jesus by the will of god, to the saints in ephesus, the faithful in christ jesus:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a suri sasuri ne, hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus ètu kota epesus, aa dhu taha ètu d'ara mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi na. nèngu mesa na ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua ne, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus, kètu èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ, who has blessed us in christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! nèngu ka ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ama lamatua pala-bagi le mi èdhi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i nèti sorga, lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: for he chose us in him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in his presence. in love
target_text: te lod'o rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, ama lamatua sue aa hag'e nare le èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus. na d'èi sèna ka èdhi mamuri mola-mèci. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pasala èdhi.

source_text: he predestined us for adoption as his sons through jesus christ, according to the good pleasure of his will,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pama'ète mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho ded'e èdhi j'aj'i ana na, lula yesus kristus. ne'e ne ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: to the praise of his glorious grace, which he has freely given us in the beloved one.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio ne. te nèngu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri pa'èci dènge ana pasue na.

source_text: in him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
target_text: masi ka èdhi uru èèna mamuri mola-mèci boe madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa hia ana na mai, sèna ka pasuti raa na toke madhe. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana na sui nare èdhi nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: that he lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
target_text: lula na dutu-bhori sasue na mi èdhi, nèngu pasaraa d'ara èdhi kahèi, ka bisa te'a mèu dad'èi d'ara na.

source_text: and he has made known to us the mystery of his will according to his good pleasure, which he purposed in christ
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae peka aa'i mèka dad'èi d'ara na mi dhèu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, madhutu dad'èi na, na hia le èdhi te'a, peka na, karèi nèti uru ka, na pama'ète nare le ho neo pake yesus kristus sèna ka padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in christ.
target_text: aa, pe d'ai lod'o na, yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu ho uri aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga.

source_text: in him we were also chosen as god's own, having been predestined according to the plan of him who works out everything by the counsel of his will, in order that we, who were the first to hope in christ, would be for the praise of his glory.
target_text: lula èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka èdhi abhu pusaka kahèi nèti ama lamatua. te karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, na hag'e nare ji'i dhèu yahudi, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. dad'èi nèngu ka, neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu-dhèu leo, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya kristus. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, madhutu ngaa dhu na pama'ète nare le. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa ded'e padedha-dedha risi hari, kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and in him, having heard and believed the word of truth-the gospel of your salvation-you were sealed with the promised holy spirit,
target_text: lula ji'i bhoke le j'ara, nèti èèna ka miu nèti suku leo bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, sad'i miu parcaya lii lolo be'a na dhu mola. te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu pamamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya sèmi èèna, miu sèmi mere kahèi roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu na moa mema le. te roh lamatua mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi cap ho patadha, peka na, miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are god's possession, to the praise of his glory.
target_text: roh mola-mèci ne'e j'aj'i mi jaminan kahèi, dhu peka na, pe ama lamatua hia aa'i mèu-mèu dhu na moa mema sèra, toke na sui nare èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio dadedha na.

source_text: for this reason, ever since i heard about your faith in the lord jesus and your love for all the saints,
target_text: ja'a tadèngi ae le, j'ara-j'ara lalèka miu mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèti sasue miu mi dhèu parcaya sèra. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: i have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,
target_text: ja'a loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: that the god of our lord jesus christ, the glorious father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of him.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ama ku, ama lamatua nèti kètu ja'a, yesus kristus. aa ama ku ka dhu kapai risi aa'i. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama hia roh ama mi dhèu epesus, ho re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, aa bisa tadhe ama mèu risi hari.

source_text: i ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of his calling, the riches of his glorious inheritance in the saints,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke ngangee dènge pasaraa d'ara ra, sèna ka bisa re'a aa'i ngaa dhu ama padhadha neo hia si. ja'a neo kahèi sèna ka rèngu re'a pusaka dhu ama moa neo hia si bèli-camèd'a. te pusaka èèna kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: and the surpassing greatness of his power to us who believe. these are in accordance with the working of his mighty strength,
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho ama bhoke j'ara hia si, sèna ka bisa re'a mèu koasa ama dhu dedha risi èèna. te ama pake koasa èèna, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu unu ama sèra.

source_text: which he exerted in christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly realms,
target_text: te koasa ama lamatua èèna, risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti koasa ne'e ka na pamamuri kristus nèti mamadhe na. hèia ama lamatua ded'e kristus asa sorga, ka hia ne madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, ètu baboa g'ana na.

source_text: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
target_text: nèngu dedha risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga. te nèngu dedha risi nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhu rèd'u paredha aa'i-aa'i ra. na kèpe koasa na dhu risi nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra, mesa boe doe ne'e ne di. te na nèd'u koasa ne taruu toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and god put everything under his feet and made him head over everything for the church,
target_text: ama lamatua unu na ka dhu tao sèna ka aa'i-aa'i se pahaha iisi mi kristus. aa nèngu kahèi ded'e kristus j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka uri aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
target_text: de ladhe na j'aj'i kètu, èdhi dhèu parcaya j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu sab'a pa'èle aa'i mèu sasab'a dhu na pakako lod'o na ètu rai-haha ne era. te nèngu ka dènge koasa ho paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. lii sabaj'a ja'a sèmi ne'e ka hia miu.

source_text: and you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
target_text: uru èèna, miu sisu paredha ama lamatua, aa ad'u-ue rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka lamatua peka na, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.
target_text: uru èèna, mamuri miu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne, dènge dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. toke d'ai sange ne'e, nidhu loe boe dadugu-rariu dhèu rai-haha, sèna ka palab'a dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: all of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna kahèi, ka ngaa dhu èdhi rasa do, pangee do, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. te èdhi dhèu bhelu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka ama lamatua nasa titu kèna dènge èdhi,

source_text: but because of his great love for us, god, who is rich in mercy, made us alive with christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. it is by grace you have been saved!
target_text: aa pangee na, èdhi nuka sèmi dhèu madhe kahèi dhu cèri eele nèti nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara na la'e boe lula na sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pua yesus kristus mai sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri hiu hia èdhi. de lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi lula d'ara hua iia na.

source_text: and god raised us up with christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms in christ jesus,
target_text: yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia lamatua ded'e ne ho nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. lamatua tao sèmi èèna kahèi mi dedha èdhi, na pala-bagi mamuri hiu mi èdhi, hèia na ded'e èdhi, ka tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge kristus ètu sorga.

source_text: in order that in the coming ages he might display the surpassing riches of his grace, demonstrated by his kindness to us in christ jesus.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mulai nèti doe ne'e, d'ai mia-mia la'e, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara sasue na ae-ae, dènge d'ara hua iia na dhu risi aa'i èèna, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of god, not by works, so that no one can boast.
target_text: ropa miu parcaya kristus, ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, lula d'ara hua iia na. na hia mamuri sèmi èèna, baku pangee, na, nèngu b'ala ngaa dhu miu tao. lula mamuri èèna j'aj'i hadia dhu na hia iia d'ara mi miu. nèti èèna ka, miu baku padedha iisi nèti ngaa dhu miu tao.

source_text: for we are god's workmanship, created in christ jesus to do good works, which god prepared in advance as our way of life.
target_text: èdhi mamuri, lula ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i èdhi. hèia yesus kristus hia èdhi mamuri hiu, sèna ka èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: therefore remember that formerly you who are gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision that done in the body by human hands-
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le, na, dhèu yahudi kèpe pa'èra-èra atora suna rèngu, aa ra pusi-pahae boe miu dhèu yahudi boe, lula mo'o boe madhutu atora èèna! madhutu iia-iia na, atora suna ne dhoka nèti ngi'u aae di, nèti boe d'ara dhèu.

source_text: remember that at that time you were separate from christ, alienated from the commonwealth of israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without god in the world.
target_text: lod'o miu dhae parcaya mèka yesus kristus, miu dènge mèka hak ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. te uru èèna, miu dhae maso mèka asa d'ara lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu na pa'èki tèke mi abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. lod'o èèna, miu mamuri ètu rai-haha, te ngaa bisa boe maena mi ama lamatua, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu leo rai kara era,

source_text: but now in christ jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of christ.
target_text: dhu cèri nèti lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus kristus bhoke nare le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa pa'èki dènge ama lamatua. te kristus madhe sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua, ho miu bisa padame dènge ne, aa bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: for he himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i dhèu yahudi ngo'o boe mamuri dame dènge miu dhèu leo rai kara. nuka sèmi kadidhi dhu hag'e eele èdhi. te ngaa lula mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka na paguri eele le kadidhi èèna, sèna ka èdhi dhu uru èèna pamusu, bisa padame hari ho j'aj'i mi ca suku.

source_text: by abolishing in his flesh the law of commandments and decrees. he did this to create in himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho pake atora agama rèngu sèna ka pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ropa yesus kristus madhe, na pa'ele iie le j'ara dhui, aa bhoke j'ara hiu, sèna ka dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara, dua-dua ra bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki j'aj'i mi ca suku dhu hiu, dhu mamuri mera-milu.

source_text: and reconciling both of them to god in one body through the cross, by which he extinguished their hostility.
target_text: de kristus madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèna ka tao dua suku sèra j'aj'i mi èci, aa nèti hari si asa ama lamatua. te kristus palaho eele aa'i le ngaa dhu uru èèna tao rèngu ho pamusu.

source_text: he came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
target_text: nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, nèti lii lolo be'a hia dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara sèra, dhu lole na, uru èèna miu mamuri pamusu, te ngaa limuri ne abhu le j'ara sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for through him we both have access to the father by one spirit.
target_text: de ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, aa'i-aa'i ti abhu j'ara ho lati asa ama lamatua èdhi, lula yesus bhoke le j'ara hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. aa roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pad'elo j'ara mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti kahèi.

source_text: therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of god's household,
target_text: lula pa'ue-ai yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe j'aj'i heka dhèu leo rai kara dhu dènge boe hak ngaa-ngaa. te limuri ne, miu unu le hak ho j'aj'i ana kabarai sorga, lula ama lamatua ded'e le miu j'aj'i ana-èpu na.

source_text: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with christ jesus himself as the cornerstone.
target_text: ne'e ne, nuka sèmi ama lamatua neo patitu èmu cue. na patitu hadhu dhu padhèdi uru, nuka yesus kristus. hèia na tao fanderen, nuka dhèu rèti lii padhai na dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ka na padhèdi hadhu se pagod'o-god'o ètu dedha sèra aa'i-aa'i. hadhu se, nuka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na.

source_text: in him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the lord.
target_text: èmu ne titu èra bia, lula hadhu se dhu pagod'o si dènge be'a ètu dedha hadhu dhu padhèdi uru sèra. aa èmu èèna nèbhu-nèbhu asa kapai, ka dhèu lasi asa d'ara èmu èèna, sèna ka manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and in him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for god in his spirit.
target_text: de limuri ne, ama lamatua tao sèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe kahèi j'aj'i nuka sèmi hadhu, sama-sama dènge ji'i dhèu yahudi. ama lamatua padhèdi pagod'o-god'o èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ho j'aj'i era pea roh na.

source_text: for this reason i, paul, the prisoner of christ jesus for the sake of you gentiles.
target_text: lula ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, nèti èèna ka na pua ja'a, paulus, ho lole lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe ètu d'ara kota epesus. ja'a pakako le sasab'a ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho.

source_text: surely you have heard about the stewardship of god's grace that was given to me for you,
target_text: tatu miu me'a kahèi, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a mai, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu.

source_text: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as i have already written briefly.
target_text: uru èèna, mema ama lamatua dhae peka mèka dènge dhèu rai-haha ne, lula-nèti ngaa dhu na pama'ète hia mi dhèu dhu yahudi boe. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu peka le dènge ja'a, j'ara ne aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ne'e ne, ja'a dhu suri pabab'a-bab'a le ètu sasuri ne hia miu.

source_text: in reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of christ,
target_text: ladhe miu baca mere, tatu miu bisa me'a kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua mi yesus kristus, dhu na bhoke hia ja'a.

source_text: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the spirit to god's holy apostles and prophets.
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu rai-haha re'a mèka dad'èi na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake le roh na, sèna ka peka dad'èi na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na.

source_text: this mystery is that through the gospel the gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in christ jesus.
target_text: te karèi nèti uru ka, ama lamatua pama'ète le sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu yahudi boe parcaya lii lolo be'a yesus kristus, rèngu bisa j'aj'i kahèi ana-ana ama lamatua, sama sèmi dhèu yahudi sèra. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'a'ari le, aa èdhi sama-sama bisa abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama èdhi, ama lamatua.

source_text: i became a servant of this gospel by the gift of god's grace, given me through the working of his power.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, ka hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. aa na pangèd'u koasa na mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: though i am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the gentiles the unsearchable riches of christ,
target_text: nèti dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ja'a ne haha d'ai seli. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare ja'a, ho pakako sasab'a na dhu kapai risi eele èèna. dad'èi na sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu yahudi boe, lula-nèti d'ara hua iia yesus kristus dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in god, who created all things.
target_text: te karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, dad'èi na neo hia kristus mai èèna, dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu neo, sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho ra re'a mèu dad'èi na èèna.

source_text: his purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of god should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
target_text: te dad'èi na èèna, d'èlu-mèu risi eele. hèia nèngu neo pake dhèu unu na, ho pad'elo mamèu na mi koasa-koasa dhu leo, aa mi aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: according to the eternal purpose that he accomplished in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: lod'o dhu na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le neo bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele dhèu rai-haha nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèti èèna ka, na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: in him and through faith in him we may enter god's presence with boldness and confidence.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu parcaya yesus kristus, parluu heka madha'u padhai lii dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu dhu pakabhèle mema ai na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi lod'o mia èèna ka.

source_text: so i ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a j'èra lula lalau-lalo'o miu dhèu yahudi boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu mage èra boe kahèi. ja'a pasae kore j'aj'èra ne, lula neo pa'èra miu ho sèmi mere babe'a na.

source_text: . for this reason i bow my knees before the father,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a ngee kèdhi d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu risi eele èèna, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho manèngi makasi.

source_text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
target_text: te a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga unu dhoka ama èci di, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: i ask that out of the riches of his glory he may strengthen you with power through his spirit in your inner being,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale ae-ae mi dedha miu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara na dhu hua iia risi èèna. aa ja'a manèngi kahèi ho na hia roh na, dènge koasa na, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu.

source_text: so that christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho yesus kristus pea ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya ne taruu. aa ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki dènge sasue na, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u asa èra, lula amo na maso marèma asa d'ara rai.

source_text: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth of the love of christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of god.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a kahèi ho miu dènge dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i bisa me'a mèu sasue kristus dhu dhèu rai-haha ne d'èu rare boe. te sasue ne, kapai titu kèna, taleo titu kèna, marèma titu kèna, aa ae titu kèna! ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu rasa sasue na, toke sasue ne maso papènu d'ara dènge mamuri miu.

source_text: now to him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to his power that is at work within us,
target_text: koasa ama lamatua kapai titu kèna, risi aa'i nèti dhu èdhi manèngi dènge dhu èdhi bisa ngee. aa na pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho sab'a ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: to him be the glory in the church and in christ jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, ti ded'e ne padedha-dedha! koa-kio ne taruu, mulai nèti doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. ne'e ka dhu lèke!

source_text: as a prisoner in the lord, then, i urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
target_text: ja'a pakako le sasab'a lamatua ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho. de limuri ne ja'a pamako miu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lula na paroa nare le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri dènge pahaha iisi, aa pamaho'o èci dènge èci. miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa tadhe mèu èci dènge èci, ho mamuri pasue dhu tare'a. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the spirit through the bond of peace.
target_text: tenge j'ara ho muri dame èci dènge èci, lula roh ama lamatua dhu èki le miu j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: there is one body and one spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
target_text: te dhèu unu yesus kristus dhu j'aj'i le èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u kristus unu na. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare le roh lamatua dhu dhoka èci èèna di. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua di, lula nèngu ka dhu paroa nare si ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: one lord, one faith, one baptism;
target_text: lamatua èdhi, dhoka èci di; parcaya èdhi, dhoka ca j'ara di, sèna ka bisa padame dènge ne. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu sarani, sèna ka pa'èki dènge ne.

source_text: one god and father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
target_text: ama lamatua, dhoka èci di, aa ama èdhi, dhoka nèngu di. dhoka nèngu di dhu paredha èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. dhoka nèngu di dhu bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa nèngu mesa na di dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of christ.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kristus pala-bagi le koasa na mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi èci-èci ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: this is why it says: when he ascended on high, he led captives away, and gave gifts to men.
target_text: nèti èèna ka sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e asa era dedha, sèna ka na pamusu ètu èèna toke segi. hèia ère nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu lèke taha, aa papala hadia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: what does he ascended mean, except that he also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
target_text: sanèd'e lii-lii dhu peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e. ladhe na ca'e la'e, sasoa na, uru èèna na puru nèdhi le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: he who descended is the very one who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
target_text: de dhèu dhu puru mai èèna, nuka kristus. te nèngu ca'e hari asa sorga, sèna ka bisa uri aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and it was he who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
target_text: kristus dhu pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a-la'a dhu na pala-bagi hia rèngu. abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si koasa ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na; cahag'e j'aj'i sèmi ca dhèu ama sa, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu kristus; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a dhèu unu na; aa cahag'e hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu tema rèti lii lolo be'a asa era-era dhu hiu.

source_text: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of christ,
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka sèmi rare sasab'a ra, sèna ka pa'èra dhèu-dhèu parcaya ho aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pakako sasab'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu parcaya yesus kristus asa tabha èra,

source_text: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the son of god, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of christ. then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
target_text: toke èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya d'ara èci. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadhe tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua. èdhi sèmi heka ana iiki, lula èdhi madhutu mola-mola le j'ara nèngu, aa j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na. ladhe èdhi mamuri ka sèmi èèna, èdhi sèmi heka koha dhu dènge boe uli, ka madhutu dhoka rii di. te ladhe dhèu kapod'e-kabèli mai aj'a pagoa èdhi, ra tao rare boe.

source_text: instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into christ himself, who is the head.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi dènge lii mako lole dhoka ngaa dhu lèke hia mi a'ari èdhi sèra, lula èdhi sue rèngu. aa ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ètu d'ara ngaa èèna ka, èdhi j'aj'i ca ropa dènge kristus. te nèngu ne kètu èdhi dhu uri èdhi.

source_text: from him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
target_text: aa èdhi j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. sama sèmi ngi'u dhèu èci, dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa haga, ladhe sab'a sama-sama madhutu sasab'a ra èci-èci, na, ngi'u na asa tabha èra. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu unu yesus kristus sèra. ladhe èdhi pasue aa soru-bara èci dènge èci, tatu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti asa tabha èra kahèi.

source_text: so i tell you this, and insist on it in the lord, that you must no longer walk as the gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka, lula kètu ja'a, yesus kristus ka dhu nori ja'a. miu mamuri ia ka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula ngaa dhu ra tao sèra madhutu dhoka gagoa ra.

source_text: they are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of god because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
target_text: rèngu raga leli, nuka sèmi dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga. ra mamuri pacèri nèti ama lamatua, lula ra kètu hadhu, aa pusi-pahae boe ne.

source_text: having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
target_text: rèngu re'a heka makae. nèti èèna ka, ra madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara ho ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge mamuri kaj'alu. te ngaa re'a boe roca kahèi.

source_text: but this is not the way you came to know christ.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aj'a-nori boe miu j'ara mamuri kristus sèmi èèna!

source_text: surely you heard of him and were taught in him-in keeping with the truth that is in jesus-
target_text: te, ngaa dhu miu me'a le lula-nèti yesus kristus, a'aj'a èèna ka dhu mola. tatu miu tadèngi le!

source_text: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
target_text: de tèke eele j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui èèna! te ladhe miu mamuri kaj'alu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, na, miu dhu lèke le tipu. miu dènge heka hak mamuri sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa ama lamatua tao d'ara dènge ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu,

source_text: and to put on the new self, created to be like god in true righteousness and holiness.
target_text: ho miu j'aj'i dhèu hiu, madhutu ropa na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara hiu miu, dhu mola-mèci dènge mera-milu.

source_text: therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
target_text: de limuri ne, loe eele ka nèti kapod'e-kabèli! padhai lii èci dènge èci dhu mola, te èdhi dhu pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u èci dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa dènge haga.

source_text: be angry, yet do not sin. do not let the sun set upon your anger,
target_text: ladhe nasa, baku ad'u sasala kahèi. hua iia miu pabe'a hari! baku tèke nanasa toke lod'o cèna!

source_text: and do not give the devil a foothold.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe dadugu-rariu miu. baku golo ne!

source_text: he who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi mana'u, ae eele ka! be'a risi dhèu sèmi sèra sab'a pake kacui-aai unu ra, sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra na soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra.

source_text: let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
target_text: ladhe padhai lii, na, baku hia lii karehe, masi ka ca hèb'a doko-doko di! hua iia risi padhai lii dhu be'a di. aa holo dhèu sèna ka ra soru-bara dènge be'a, aa pa'èra d'ara si.

source_text: and do not grieve the holy spirit of god, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
target_text: baku papèd'a d'ara roh ama lamatua, te nèngu pea ètu d'ara miu. aa na cap nare miu, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. roh na j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, toke d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua sui nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
target_text: de baku tèka d'ara dènge dhèu leo! bqku kadhi ngutu dènge dhèu! baku panasa! baku patao-palaha! baku padhai kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu! aa baku ad'u-ue j'ara bhabhelu dhu leo-leo hèi!

source_text: be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in christ god forgave you.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi mi pasue, aa tao j'ara dhu be'a èci dènge èci. miu hud'i pabhèlu eele ku sasala dhèu, aa hia si abho, sama sèmi ama lamatua saku eele sasala miu, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus.

source_text: be imitators of god, therefore, as beloved children,
target_text: miu ana pasue ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi na.

source_text: and walk in love, just as christ loved us and gave himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to god.
target_text: aa miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sue miu. te na soro le ngi'u na, ho madhe gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi badha sogo-tagu dhu ra tunu ka hèu mèngi, sèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: but among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
target_text: miu dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua kahèi. de baku mamuri dènge d'ara kaj'alu! baku ngee madha j'ara kaj'alu kahèi! de baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu! baku manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
target_text: baku padhai lii kaj'alu! aa baku padhai lii leli! te dhèu unu ama lamatua, ladhe padhai lii sèmi sèra, lèke boe. hua iia risi miu padhai lii be'a aa manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: for of this you can be sure: no immoral, impure, or greedy person that is, an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of christ and of god.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! te ama lamatua nare boe dhèu dhu mamuri kaj'alu, aa dhèu dhu tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu! rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, aa ama lamatua j'aj'i boe dhèu aae rèngu. ama lamatua sèmi nare boe kahèi dhèu dhu manga'a dèu ngara, lula rèngu seti eele ne, ka ra pakab'ua risi j'ara dhu leo sèra.

source_text: let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of god is coming on the sons of disobedience.
target_text: mage dhèu pagoa miu dènge padhai lii hèb'a hua, peka na, mamuri kaj'alu ciki di, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, we! te tatu ama lamatua nasa mi dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu boe dad'èi na.

source_text: therefore do not be partakers with them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for you were once darkness, but now you are light in the lord. walk as children of light,
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, lula miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, na hia le saraa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na.

source_text: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri taruu ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu ne tao j'ara dhu be'a, mamuri mola, aa leko-monya boe.

source_text: test and prove what pleases the lord.
target_text: tenge taruu j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ne dhèu aae èdhi.

source_text: have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
target_text: baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te tatao ra, gaguna aad'o. de mi pasanèd'e si, aa bhoke paled'a sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: for it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue pahuni-pacub'i, kaj'alu titu kèna, toke èdhi makae, ladhe neo padhai lii j'ara-j'ara sèra.

source_text: but everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu d'elo mèdha èci ètu d'ara maroga, tatu dhèu bisa rèdhi mèu.

source_text: so it is said: wake up, o sleeper, rise up from the dead, and christ will shine on you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi peka paled'a j'ara bhelu dhu dhèu ad'u-ue, nèngu bisa ne'a, na, j'ara dhu na ad'u-ue ne, karehe. abhu lii sod'a èci, peka na, wee! miu dhu bhèj'i, kèd'i ka! miu dhu madhe, mamuri hari ka! te kristus neo hia saraa mi miu.

source_text: pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu èci-èci parisa paie mamuri mi, sèna ka baku sèmi dhèu goa. be'a risi pake ngangee dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu. de ladhe abhu lod'o tao j'ara dhu be'a, na baku pamata!

source_text: therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the lord's will is.
target_text: pangee paie-iie, ho me'a mèu dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka baku mi goa.

source_text: do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. instead, be filled with the spirit.
target_text: baku mahu, te, ngaa dhu miu minu èèna ka dhu uli miu, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu karehe. te ngaa bhoke d'ara miu, sèna ka roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu uli miu.

source_text: speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. sing and make music in your hearts to the lord,
target_text: de padhai lii èci dènge èci pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua, mèti lii koa-kio mi nèngu, aa mèti lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci na. aa ladhe sod'a, baku dhoka ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa koa-kio ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: always giving thanks to god the father for everything in the name of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: te yesus kristus j'aj'i le kètu èdhi, aa ama lamatua dhu tao le j'ara-j'ara ae titu kèna hia èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku loe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: submit to one another out of reverence for christ.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi, hud'i mamuri èci nanene èci. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pakab'ua yesus kristus.

source_text: wives, submit to your husbands as to the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene dhèu èmu mi, sama sèmi miu nanene yesus kristus, kètu miu.

source_text: for the husband is the head of the wife as christ is the head of the church, his body, of which he is the savior.
target_text: te dhèu èmu miu èèna, nuka sèmi kètu nèti miu bhèni se. aa yesus kristus kahèi j'aj'i kètu nèti dhèu unu na. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho dhèu abhu mamuri.

source_text: now as the church submits to christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu unu kristus hud'i mamuri nanene paie-iie nèngu. de sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu, hud'i nanene pabe'a-be'a ku dhèu èmu na, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: husbands, love your wives, just as christ loved the church and gave himself up for her
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu, sèmi èèna kahèi! miu hud'i sue dhèu èmu miu, èci èèna ka dènge kristus sue dhèu unu na, toke na soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati rèngu.

source_text: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna ka, ho rèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, lula rèngu madhutu le lii holo-nori na, aa sarani le.

source_text: and to present her to himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
target_text: dhèu unu yesus kristus èci èèna ka dènge bhèni dhu neo kab'i dhu pagaa iisi na, te dhèu mone dhu neo kab'i èèna neo mai nare ne. sama sèmi èèna kahèi, kristus neo mai nare dhèu unu na sèra. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge be'a aa mola-mèci, toke abhu boe sasala ciki sa.

source_text: in the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. he who loves his wife loves himself.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu mi, nuka sèmi miu sue ngi'u miu mesa mi. te ladhe dhèu mone sue dhèu èmu na, sasoa na, nèngu sue ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as christ does the church.
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu sue boe ngi'u na. te ngaa na lalau-lalo'o ngi'u na pabe'a-be'a, sèmi yesus ladhe-leru dhèu unu na paie-iie,

source_text: for we are members of his body.
target_text: lula èdhi nuka sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: for this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, peka na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, te dua ra j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: this mystery is profound, but i am speaking about christ and the church.
target_text: te mamuri pasue dhèu èmu-kamali ne, lamatua bhoke le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori na nèti uru ka mai. j'ara ne'e ne, ka dhu kapai. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, lii holo-nori ne pad'elo sasue kristus mi dhèu unu na sèra.

source_text: nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
target_text: de dhèu mone hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu na, nuka sèmi sue ngi'u nèngu unu na. aa dhèu bhèni hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu èmu na.

source_text: children, obey your parents in the lord, for this is right.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku ina-ama mi, te èèna ka dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi d'ara lamatua èdhi.

source_text: honor your father and mother which is the first commandment with a promise,
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri tèke le, peka na, èu hud'i pakab'ua ku ina dènge ama mu. ne'e ne lii paredha ama lamatua dhu uru tèka, dhu dènge lii pajaji.

source_text: that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.
target_text: te lod'o lamatua hia paredha èèna, nèngu moa kahèi, peka na, ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, pe èu abhu mèngi-nale ae-ae, aa mamuri èu madhii-manèro.

source_text: fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the lord.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ina-ama sèra! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. be'a risi miu lalau-lalo'o si paie-iie, aa nori si nèti ana iiki mai ho madhutu j'ara lamatua. ladhe ra tao sala, nori si dènge be'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey christ.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a! miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge lamatua dhu paredha miu ètu rai-haha ne, aa nanene ne. baku sab'a dènge d'ara cabèka, te ngaa madhutu dad'èi lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nuka sèmi miu madhutu dad'èi kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: and do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of christ, doing the will of god from your heart.
target_text: te miu dhèu sab'a unu kristus. de ètu rai-haha ne miu baku sad'i sab'a di, lula lamatua dhu ladhe miu. te ngaa sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni hia lamatua mi, masi ka nèngu aad'o ètu madha. te èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: serve with good will, as to the lord and not to men,
target_text: de sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia ama lamatua, kètu èdhi.

source_text: because you know that the lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
target_text: lula èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua b'ala hia dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. masi ka rèngu dhèu sab'a do, lamatua do, ènu do, ènu boe do, nèngu b'ala aa'i mèu-mèu si.

source_text: and masters, do the same for your slaves. give up your use of threats, because you know that he who is both their master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua sèra! baku miu j'ege pamadha'u leli dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra. te rèngu dènge lamatua ètu sorga kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge miu. ama lamatua ladhe boe rèhu dhèu, te ngaa na nanene dhèu cee èèna ka. masi ka lamatua do, dhèu sab'a do, na nanene si aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: finally, be strong in the lord and in his mighty power.
target_text: nanene pabe'a-be'a lii padhai ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne. miu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku parcaya miu mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka kètu miu, aa koasa na dhu dedha risi eele aa'i si. èèna na dhu bisa pa'èra miu!

source_text: put on the full armor of god, so that you can make your stand against the devil's schemes.
target_text: sordad'u dènge rèka ho lab'a musu ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua neo pake miu sèmi sordad'u. te nèngu neo miu lab'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu aae nidhu ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra ku, sèna ka pake aa'i rèka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world's darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
target_text: te èdhi ètu d'ara pamusu! èdhi lab'a boe musu dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa èdhi lab'a koasa bhabhelu dhu èdhi tèdhi boe, lab'a dhu rèd'u paredha, lab'a koasa maroga, aa lab'a j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: therefore take up the full armor of god, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
target_text: de miu hud'i pa'èra pake rèka aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua sèna ka bèli-camèd'a, ropa d'ai lod'o-lod'o bhabhelu-katub'a, miu bisa lab'a taruu. te ladhe miu taha, miu bisa segi.

source_text: stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
target_text: de miu hud'i titu pa'èra-èra! parcaya dhoka lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, te èèna nuka sèmi miu dhu bori dhari hake sordad'u. mamuri mola, te èèna sama sèmi miu silu kodho bèsi pa'abhe kakara.

source_text: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
target_text: pa'èra ho lami peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dhu pad'elo j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri padame dènge ama lamatua, te èci èèna ka dènge miu pake salapa sordad'u.

source_text: in addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
target_text: parcaya taruu mi lamatua, te parcaya èèna sama sèmi mèdha èci dhu sordad'u pake ho sili iisi nèti rèka musu. dènge parcaya sèmi èèna, miu bisa pamadhe ai ètu isi kataki nidhu bhelu, dhu ra siri mi miu.

source_text: and take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of god.
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu dhu peka na, miu unu le mamuri nèti ama lamatua, te èèna sèmi sordad'u pake solo bèsi. kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci, te èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu kèpe samala.

source_text: pray in the spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. to this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
target_text: ladhe miu neo titu èra, na, miu baku loe sabaj'a pake koasa nèti roh mola-mèci ama lamatua. j'aga taruu aa baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia dhèu unu lamatua buli mia-mia.

source_text: pray also for me, that whenever i open my mouth, words may be given me so that i will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
target_text: aa baku bhèlu kahèi sabaj'a hia ja'a. manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia kahèi lii holo-nori na, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka mola-mola naneo na mi dhèu leo.

source_text: for which i am an ambassador in chains. pray that i may proclaim it fearlessly, as i should.
target_text: masi ka ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, te ngaa lamatua yesus pua-paleha ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ai g'ana nèngu. de sabaj'a hia ja'a, ho ja'a baku madha'u padhai dhu lèke, te èèna ka dhu j'aj'i sasab'a-la'a ja'a!

source_text: tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what i am doing.
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a mèu mamuri ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua tikikus dhiu asa miu. nèngu ne, a'ari pasue ja'a, aa na maj'èni pakako sasab'a kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: i have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
target_text: hud'i laa na lole j'ara-j'ara mamuri èdhi ètu ne'e. aa ja'a neo, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi.

source_text: peace to the brothers and love with faith from god the father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho tao miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci, aa pasue èci dènge èci, lula miu parcaya mi rèngu.

source_text: grace to all who love our lord jesus christ with an undying love.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne taruu. sasuri ja'a, d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul and timothy, servants of christ jesus, to all the saints in christ jesus at philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, paulus. aa angalai ja'a, timotius pa'adhu hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. ji'i dua mi se, ana sab'a nèti yesus kristus. ji'i pa'adhu sasuri ne, hia mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu kota pilipi. ji'i neo kahèi, ho dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra, re'a mèu isi sasuri ne'e.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus èèna, kètu èdhi. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho bisa mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i thank my god every time i remember you.
target_text: masi ka nèbhu le ja'a paraga heka dènge miu, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu! lod'o-lod'o ja'a sanèd'e miu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula miu parcaya ne taruu.

source_text: in every prayer for all of you, i always pray with joy,
target_text: lod'o ja'a sabaj'a hia miu, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae,

source_text: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
target_text: lula karèi nèti hiu-hiu miu sèmi mere lii lolo be'a lamatua, miu pakako taruu sasab'a na, sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of christ jesus.
target_text: èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ama lamatua mulai sab'a ètu d'ara miu kèna. aa ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, lamatua pakako taruu sasab'a na dhu be'a èèna, toke pamèci aa'i mèu-mèu, toke d'ai lod'o yesus kristus mai hari.

source_text: it is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since i have you in my heart. for in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a ladhe ja'a sue miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu karèi nèti uru ka. ca hari nèi, miu sab'a le bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua, aa ropa ja'a dhaa mi dhèu dhu lab'a lii lolo be'a èèna. masi ka ja'a maso bui, te ngaa miu hari boe nèti baboa ja'a.

source_text: god is my witness how i long for all of you with the affection of christ jesus.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu ne'a, na, d'ara ja'a neo taruu paraga dènge miu. te sasue ja'a mi dedha miu, èci èèna ka dènge sasue yesus kristus.

source_text: and this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight, so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of christ,
target_text: de ja'a sabaj'a hia miu sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a manèngi ho miu asa tabha pasue èci dènge èci. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka ama lamatua hia miu me'a mèu, mia dhu be'a, sèna ka miu mamuri mola-mèci. pe d'ai lod'o kristus pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na peka na, miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa,

source_text: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through jesus christ, to the glory and praise of god.
target_text: lula nèngu mesa na ka dhu tao d'ara miu mola-mèci, ho bisa mamuri mola. dènge mamuri mola sèmi èèna ka, dhèu leo ded'e padedha-dedha aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: now i want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a, na, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa ja'a, toke pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa te'a boe, na, lii lolo be'a lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia,

source_text: as a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that i am in chains for christ.
target_text: toke sordad'u dhu madhenga èmu dhèu aae, dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ja'a maso bui lula madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: and most of the brothers, confident in the lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
target_text: ka dhèu unu ama lamatua ètu se'e se rèdhi, na, lamatua ka dhu tao j'ara èèna lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne. nèti èèna ka, rèngu asa tabha bani, toke re'a heka madha'u. hèia ra padhai paled'a-led'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: it is true that some preach christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill. the latter do so in love, knowing that i am appointed for the defense of the gospel. the former, however, preach christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu dua rupa dhèu dhu maj'èni aj'a j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, aa abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo. dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, rèngu be'a dènge ja'a. dhèu se re'a mèu, na, ja'a dui sasusa ne, lula pakako sasab'a ja'a, dhu hari boe kabodho ciki sa. te ngaa dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèti rèngu aa tenge kolongara di. rèngu pamae-pamanyèla dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu madhutu ra. te ra tenge j'ara ho bisa padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu risi ja'a. rèngu pangee, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu madhutu rèngu, èèna na asa tabha paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: what then is the issue? just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, christ is preached. and in this i rejoice. yes, and i will continue to rejoice,
target_text: te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! ja'a pusi-pahae boe, ladhe dhèu aj'a dènge d'ara mola, do aad'o. sad'i dhu rèngu aj'a, dhoka lula-nèti yesus kristus di! èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a karej'e tare'a-re'a,

source_text: because i know that through your prayers and the provision of the spirit of jesus christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu sabaj'a hia ja'a, aa roh yesus kristus dhu soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a, na, lèpa lod'o limuri, aa'i-aa'i se èle dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: i eagerly expect and hope that i will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
