source_text: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka miu mamuri dènge mera-milu. baku soro iisi sa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, te ngaa èci-èci ka laladhe mamuri na. miu hud'i sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge kacui-aai miu mesa mi. baku maena dhèu leo. se'e se ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, miu pabia boe dhèu leo. ladhe dhèu dhu lèka boe kristus rèdhi miu mamuri sèmi èèna, tatu ra peka na, waa! dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus sèra, mamuri ra mola tare'a, nga!

source_text: brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
target_text: a'ari! limuri ne, ja'a neo peka ngaa èci, sèna ka miu me'a mèu, j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti dhèu madhe. èdhi te'a, na, dhèu dhu madhe le, bèli-camèd'a, na mamuri hari. de ladhe nèti dhèu unu lamatua èci madhe, miu baku tao ngi'u mi j'èra nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu re'a boe j'ara èèna.

source_text: for since we believe that jesus died and rose again, we also believe that god will bring with jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, yesus dhu madhe le, ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu ama lamatua pamamuri hari kahèi dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, aa oru nare si aa'i-aa'i ra bera-bera dènge lamatua yesus.

source_text: by the word of the lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep. for the lord himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of god, and the dead in christ will be the first to rise. after that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the lord in the air. and so we will always be with the lord.
target_text: de ladhe lamatua yesus mai hari, na puru nèti sorga asa rai-haha ne, èèna na dènge paredha dhu lii mèdhu aae. ka kètu kapai nèti ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga hia paredha ho tiu tèbhe. hèia dhèu unu lamatua dhu madhe sèra, mamuri hari. ka rèngu dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era, lèke ded'e asa ra'i-liru, ho aa'i-aa'i ti soru mamai lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri pa'èci dènge ne taa-taa. mi nanene pabe'a-be'a, lula ngaa dhu ji'i peka ne, lamatua unu na ka dhu peka-padhai.

source_text: therefore encourage one another with these words.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i pa'èki lii aj'a-nori ne, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i suri ia ka laa, peka na, mamai lamatua lèke hake pèri, do tanggal pèri.

source_text: for you are fully aware that the day of the lord will come like a thief in the night.
target_text: lula miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, mamai na dènge sahèka, sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re mèda.

source_text: while people are saying, peace and security, destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae dhu madhèdi mau-mau, te ngaa cag'ag'a laa paraga dènge j'aj'èra. mamai na sama kahèi dènge dhèu bhèni dhu cag'ag'a laa kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. ladhe paraga le j'ara ne'e, èdhi pakaj'èu iisi tasamia hari! èci èèna ka dènge mamai lamatua.

source_text: but you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief. for you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness. so then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage dhoka mamai na nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re talora mèda, lèke dènge miu dhu bhèj'i luu. mage lèke miu sèmi èèna kahèi! èdhi mamuri heka ètu d'ara maroga, sèmi dhèu leo dhu bhèj'i luu era. de èdhi dhu lèka le lamatua yesus, mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa, ti pa'èra soru mamai ne, aa j'aga paie mamuri èdhi. j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i miu me'a le!

source_text: for those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
target_text: te dhèu dhu bhèj'i, na, bhèj'i re mèda. aa dhèu dhu mahu, na, mahu re mèda.

source_text: but since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna, lula èdhi dhu mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa. miu hud'i j'aga paie mamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya taruu lamatua aa mamuri pasue, èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu pake kodho bèsi dhu pa'abhe kakara. aa ladhe miu maena taruu mi lamatua yesus dhu hia miu pakaj'èu nèti nanasa ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge sordad'u dhu pa'abhe kètu na dènge solo bèsi.

source_text: for god has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e boe èdhi ho na huku ti. te ngaa na hag'e èdhi sèna ka abhu mamuri, sad'i èdhi lèka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: he died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
target_text: te na madhe le gati èdhi. de ladhe na lèpa hari mai, èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, masi ka èdhi madhe le, do mamuri era.

source_text: therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, pake lii-lii ja'a se'e, sèna ka hia karej'e dènge pa'èra èci dènge èci, sèmi dhu miu tao le karèi nèti uru èèna ka.

source_text: but we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the lord and give you instruction.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! sanèd'e ho pakab'ua ina-ama dhu j'aj'i kètu ètu juma'at. te rèngu sèra sab'a dhu re'a boe j'èra hia miu, aa pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: in love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. live in peace with one another.
target_text: pad'elo sasue miu dènge ra, sèna ka re'a, na, miu pakab'ua si, lula rèngu sab'a bia hia miu. mamuri dame èci dènge èci.

source_text: and we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara era dhu ji'i neo pasanèd'e miu: dhèu dhu bai-eed'a sèra, peka si sèna ka ra sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni. dhu d'ara roe, pa'èra si. dhu haha, sarimu mere si. taha d'ara aa lii mako mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: make sure that no one repays evil for evil. always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
target_text: sanèd'e, bhabhelu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu. te ngaa tenge j'ara sèna ka tao be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. baku tao be'a dhoka dènge dhèu èdhi di, te ngaa dènge dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: rejoice at all times.
target_text: pakarej'e d'ara taruu.

source_text: pray without ceasing.
target_text: sabaj'a mèu-mèda.

source_text: give thanks in every circumstance, for this is god's will for you in christ jesus.
target_text: sad'i paraga dènge ngaa èèna ka, j'aj'èra, do karej'e-karae, manèngi makasi mi lamatua. te ama lamatua d'èi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus kristus tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: do not extinguish the spirit.
target_text: baku magee sasab'a roh lamatua.

source_text: do not treat prophecies with contempt,
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu parcaya dhu peka na, nèngu abhu le lii moa nèti ama lamatua, mage miu pusi-pahae boe lii padhai na!

source_text: but test all things. hold fast to what is good.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i kanucu ku paie-iie lii èèna mai tare'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. ladhe tare'a, na, madhutu.

source_text: abstain from every form of evil.
target_text: te ngaa pakaj'èu nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe.

source_text: now may the god of peace himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our lord jesus christ. the one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ho pamèu d'ara dènge mamuri miu aa'i-aa'i mi. nèngu èèna ka dhu uri ho èdhi bisa mamuri dame èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ladhe d'ai lod'o mamai hari lamatua èdhi, yesus kristus, miu bisa titu ètu katanga madha na dènge ngi'u aae miu, d'ara miu, dènge samanga miu dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! te lamatua yesus dhu paroa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu monya boe. ngaa dhu na peka, na tao madhutu sama sèmi èèna ka. de èèna na, na lere nèti miu dènge mola-mèci asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: brothers, pray for us as well.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu manèngi-mangaj'i hia ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu hia lii maho'o ji'i kahèi mi dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra!

source_text: i charge you before the lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
target_text: ja'a manèngi dènge kolongara lamatua yesus, ho miu baca hia juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra isi sasuri ja'a ne.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul, silvanus, and timothy, to the church of the thessalonians in god our father and the lord jesus christ:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, aa angalai ja'a, silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne'e, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: we are obligated to thank god for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu lèke, ladhe èdhi loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula miu asa parcaya ne, aa asa pasue èci dènge èci.

source_text: that is why we boast among god's churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i palolo dènge dhèu sarani ètu mia-mia, lula-nèti mamuri miu. ji'i palolo, peka na, masi ka dhèu leo paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu rai boe nèti parcaya mi.

source_text: all this is clear evidence of god's righteous judgment. and so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of god, for which you are suffering.
target_text: se'e se peka na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua j'ue lii langu miu dènge mola. te j'aj'èra dhu miu pasae èèna ka, hia miu nia j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. aa nèngu èèna, dhèu aae miu.

source_text: after all, it is only right for god to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
target_text: baku madha'u, te lamatua pama'ète lii langu dènge boe bia cabèka. mi ladhe, ee! bèli-camèd'a na b'ala mi dhèu dhu paj'èra miu.

source_text: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. this will take place when the lord jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels
target_text: aa nèngu hia miu ae mere d'ara nèti j'aj'èra dhu mi pasae kahèi. sèmi èèna mi dedha ji'i kahèi. se'e se j'aj'i, lod'o lamatua yesus puru mai nèti sorga, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na sèra dhu èra titu kèna.

source_text: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know god and do not obey the gospel of our lord jesus.
target_text: rèngu puru mai dènge ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. hèia na b'ala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe tadhe ama lamatua, aa dhu madhutu boe lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: they will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the lord and the glory of his might,
target_text: na hia huku dhu bia titu kèna mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka palaho si taa-taa. na babège si nèti katanga madha na, ka ra rasa heka koasa lamatua dhu kapai.

source_text: on the day he comes to be glorified in his saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
target_text: lod'o na mai èèna, dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra paca'e padedha-dedha kolongara na, aa ra pakab'ua ne. bèli-camèd'a miu ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra kahèi, lula miu sèmi mere le lii lolo be'a dhu uru èèna ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: to this end, we always pray for you, that our god will count you worthy of his calling, and that he will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mèu-mèda ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi-mangaj'i hia miu, sèna ka madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua, na, miu nia j'aj'i dhèu unu na. ji'i manèngi sèna ka na hia koasa na mi miu kahèi, ho miu bisa tao madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a madhutu ngaa dhu miu parcaya, aa madhutu ngaa dhu miu neo tao.

source_text: so that the name of our lord jesus will be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our god and of the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua yesus. aa miu abhu koa-kad'iri kahèi, lula miu madhutu ne. se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, mai nèti babe'a d'ara ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: now concerning the coming of our lord jesus christ and our being gathered together to him, we ask you, brothers,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu pèri lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus puru mai, aa dènge j'ara tasamia èdhi bisa pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the day of the lord has already come.
target_text: dhèu baku pagoa miu ho mi ele ngangee ropa tadèngi dhèu peka, na, lamatua dhu mai hari le. masi ka ra peka, na, rèngu tadèngi nèti roh lamatua, do nèti dhèu, do abhu sasuri nèti ji'i, mage miu lèka kahèi. te sèra sa ra leko-monya!

source_text: let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness-the son of destruction-is revealed.
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu pagoa miu. te bèli-camèd'a ca dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a cèu uuru mai, heka lamatua yesus lèpa hari kèna. dhèu ne'e ne, palab'a dènge lamatua, toke dhèu ae madhutu ne ho palab'a dènge lamatua kahèi. dhèu ne'e ne mema seli-kolane! nèti èèna ka, nèngu hud'i maso ku asa d'ara naraka.

source_text: he will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. so he will seat himself in the temple of god, proclaiming himself to be god.
target_text: na padedha iisi na risi nèti dewa aa'i-aa'i ra, aa palab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu. toke na maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka na padedha iisi, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, lamatua!

source_text: do you not remember that i told you these things while i was still with you?
target_text: miu sanèd'e, do aad'o? uru èèna ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, lula dhèu èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era, si?

source_text: and you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
target_text: limuri ne, d'ai mèka lod'o ho dhèu bhelu-katub'a èèna pacèu iisi na, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne era. aa miu me'a kahèi ngaa ka dhu pahèb'e ne!

source_text: for the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu bhelu èèna sab'a pahuni-pahuni era, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne. te ngaa ladhe bèli-camèd'a dhu pahèb'e na, patabuli ka ai na,

source_text: and then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the lord jesus will slay with the breath of his mouth and annihilate by the majesty of his arrival.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhelu ne cèu mai dènge pahuni heka sasab'a na. te ngaa lèke dènge lod'o kapai mamai lamatua yesus, ka na palaho dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne dènge pake lii ca hèb'a doko di.

source_text: the coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o lamatua yesus dhae d'ai mèka, dhèu aae nidhu hia koasa kapai hia mi dhèu bhelu ne, sèna ka bisa na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, hèia dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne pake koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu lèke tipu nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne. rèngu se'e ka dhu d'èi palaho iisi ra. ama lamatua dhu bhoke j'ara hia si mamuri, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi dad'èi na dhu hua iia èèna, aa ro'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: for this reason god will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pabèdhu d'ara ra nèti ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka hud'i laa ra parcaya mi kapod'e-kabèli sèra.

source_text: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ka, ama lamatua hia si huku dhu bia, lula rèngu lèka boe ngaa dhu tare'a. te rèngu d'èi risi tao dhu karehe.

source_text: but we should always thank god for you, brothers who are loved by the lord, because god has chosen you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the spirit and by faith in the truth.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula na sue miu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le, sèna ka hia miu mamuri. ka na hia roh na ho pamèu miu, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu tare'a.

source_text: to this he called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: lod'o ji'i lole lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ama lamatua pake lii lolo be'a na ho ère miu, sèna ka miu me'a dadedha dènge kapai nèti lamatua yesus kristus.

source_text: therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! taha d'ara dènge kèpe pa'ère-ère lii holo-nori dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu. sanèd'e kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ji'i.

source_text: now may our lord jesus christ himself and god our father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i taruu mi ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pa'èra d'ara miu, ho miu bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. ji'i manèngi sèmi èèna, lula ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue titu kèna mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. lula d'ara na hua iia, nèti èèna ka nèngu loe boe pa'èra d'ara èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu.

source_text: finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i. sabaj'a sèna ka lii lolo be'a lamatua, pale-palème asa mia-mia dènge malai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pakab'ua lii lolo be'a èèna, sèmi dhu lod'o miu abhu lii lolo be'a ca hari ni.

source_text: and pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ji'i pakaj'èu nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu tao kaco, aa nèti dhèu bhelu leo sèra, te dhèu aa'i boe dhu parcaya lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: but the lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua kèpe pa'ère lii padhai na. nèngu tao pa'èra miu, aa na bhiri miu nèti dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and we have confidence in the lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
target_text: aa ji'i nge'a tare'a kahèi, na, lamatua yesus hia miu madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i lole le dènge miu. ka tatu miu tao madhutu le sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: may the lord direct your hearts into god's love and christ's perseverance.
target_text: ji'i sanao ho lamatua yesus sanoro miu, sèna ka asa me'a, na, ama lamatua sue miu, ka miu èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi kristus uru èèna taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra na.

source_text: now we command you, brothers, in the name of our lord jesus christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka mema miu dènge ale ngara lamatua yesus kristus! baku lami pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu bai-eed'a dhu re'a dhoka rodha di. te rèngu sèra madhutu boe èdhi dhu maj'èni sab'a bia.

source_text: for you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ji'i, lod'o ji'i pea ètu talora aae miu. miu mèdhi unu mi. ji'i ngo'o boe core eele lod'o iia d'ara.

source_text: nor did we eat anyone's food without paying for it. instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
target_text: ji'i sab'a bia mèu-mèda, sèna ka ji'i baku pabia miu. ji'i sèmi boe iia d'ara, nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu.

source_text: not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
target_text: ji'i se dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. de ji'i dènge hak kahèi manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe tao sèmi èèna. ji'i neo pad'elo j'ara dhu be'a sèna ka miu madhutu.

source_text: for even while we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i hia le kahèi atora dhu peka na, dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe sab'a, baku hia ra'a-rinu.

source_text: yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi lii, peka na, nèti talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, ro'o boe sab'a. rèngu sèra re'a dhoka bhute dènge soro iisi ra asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo.

source_text: we command and urge such people by our lord jesus christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
target_text: ji'i pasanèd'e dhèu sèmi sèra, dènge kolongara lamatua yesus kristus, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a. be'a risi rèngu sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge èi kabhèsu unu ra.

source_text: but as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a!

source_text: take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
target_text: miu patadhe paie-iie dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne. hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ra'e makae.

source_text: yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.
target_text: sad'i miu baku tao si nuka sèmi musu miu. te ngaa kai si dènge be'a, sèmi miu kai a'ari miu mesa mi.

source_text: now may the lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. the lord be with all of you.
target_text: lamatua èèna, dhèu aae mera-milu. ja'a manèngi ho na hia miu mera-milu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a maena, sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: this greeting is in my own hand-paul. this is my mark in every letter; it is the way i write.
target_text: ja'a pa'èle sasuri ne dènge kacui-aai ja'a unu ku, sèna ka miu me'a, na, sasuri ne tare'a-re'a nèti ja'a. lii limuri tèka, oe pa'èle sasuri leo aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu suri kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with all of you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka d'ara hua iia lamatua yesus kristus rai eele boe nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. sasuri ne d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of christ jesus by the command of god our savior and of christ jesus our hope, to timothy, my true child in the faith: grace, mercy, and peace from god the father and christ jesus our lord.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua ded'e le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. aa lamatua yesus, era sanao-maena dhu hia èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge nèngu, lula ama lamatua pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. timotius! èu ne, nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a, lula ja'a ka dhu pad'elo j'ara ka èu parcaya kristus. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia rèngu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: as i urged you on my departure to macedonia, you should stay on at ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
target_text: uru èèna, dua ti ètu kota epesus. lod'o ja'a neo laku asa propensi makedonia, ja'a manèngi èu ho pea ètu epesus. te lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pab'ingu dhèu sarani sèra dènge aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu lamu kai si, ho ra loe eele ka.

source_text: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of god's work, which is by faith.
target_text: aa dhèu sèra core eele lod'o iia d'ara kahèi lasi palolo nanuku, pab'ala lii dènge kapod'e-kabèli nèti bèi-baki toke lai ana lai èpu. j'ara sèmi sèra, dhoka hia dhèu patao-palaha, aa hia boe ra mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua.

source_text: the goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
target_text: ja'a holo èu, sèna ka èu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra ho mamuri pasue èci dènge èci kahèi. sasue ra hud'i mai nèti d'ara dhu mèu, nèti ngangee dhu mola, aa nèti parcaya dhu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.
target_text: te ngaa abhu mese cahag'e dhu kako sala le j'ara, ra tèke eele lii holo-nori. hèia lasi core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge padhue-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: they want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
target_text: rèngu padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu mese dhu aj'a madhutu atora musa. ra tao iisi ra sèmi mese aae, te ngaa re'a boe ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a-nori èèna.

source_text: now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, huku musa èèna be'a, sad'i èdhi pake ne madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: we realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,
target_text: atora sèra suri boe hia mi dhèu dhu mamuri mola le. te ngaa pala mi dhèu palab'a, dhu d'èi boe nanene paredha, dhu mamuri pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a, dhu pusi-pahae boe lamatua, dhu pamud'e j'ara-j'ara dhu hua iia, dhu tuka pamadhe dhèu, dènge dhu pamadhe ina dènge ama ra.

source_text: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
target_text: atora sèra suri kahèi hia dhèu kajeo dènge bhèni do dènge mone, aa mone dhu tao j'ara makae dènge mone, dhu rai rèti dhèu ho sui dènge doi-dhari, dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu j'aj'i sakasii omo koso, aa hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu d'èi palab'a lii aj'a dhu lèke.

source_text: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed god, with which i have been entrusted.
target_text: a'aj'a dhu lèke sèra, mai nèti lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ja'a. aa lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ded'e ne padedha-dedha.

source_text: i thank christ jesus our lord, who has strengthened me, that he considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na lèka ja'a, ka na hia ja'a bisa pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: i was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because i had acted in ignorance and unbelief, i was shown mercy. and the grace of our lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in christ jesus.
target_text: masi ka uru èèna, ja'a d'èi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara yesus, aa paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri na. ja'a d'èi ènyi raruri si. bhabhelu ja'a sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a tao, aa parcaya mèka yesus kristus. te ngaa ama lamatua core eele boe ja'a. ka na pad'elo sasue na mi ja'a. mia hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, loe boe pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a! nèngu hia mèngi-nale dhu ae hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne, aa ja'a bisa sue dhèu leo kahèi nuka sèmi nèngu sue ja'a.

source_text: this is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: christ jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom i am the worst.
target_text: èdhi biasa tadèngi le, peka na, yesus kristus mai le asa rai-haha, ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ad'u-ue sasala, ja'a ka dhu bhelu risi eele.

source_text: but for this very reason i was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, christ jesus might display his perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in him for eternal life.
target_text: masi ka ja'a bhelu sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua huku boe ja'a. te nare ja'a j'aj'i mi tadha sena ka pad'elo sasue yesus kristus mi dhèu dhu bhelu risi eele, nuka sèmi ja'a ne'e ne. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, dhèu leo dhu tao sala sèra bisa parcaya ne kahèi, ka ra abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: now to the king eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only god, be honor and glory forever and ever. amen.
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lula dhoka nèngu di, ama lamatua; dhu leo aad'o! nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu paredha taa-taa. mamuri na dènge boe too-lane. mamadhe aad'o ètu nèngu. dhèu bisa boe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha. pakab'ua dènge koa-kio aa'i-aa'i hia mi nèngu di! tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: timothy, my child, i entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
target_text: ana timotius dhu be'a! ja'a neo peka dènge èu ngaa dhu hud'i èu tao ku ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a èu. aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka tèke le lula-nèti èu ne. ladhe èu madhutu lii se'e dènge mola-mola, èu sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu bisa pamusu dènge be'a, ho lab'a bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èu mi yesus kristus. aa j'aga paie, sèna ka d'ara èu mola taruu. te abhu kahèi dhèu leo dhu ro'o heka nanene d'ara iiki ra, dhu pa'ele iie parcaya rèngu, nuka sèmi kapa rage nare hadhu aae.

source_text: among them are hymenaeus and alexander, whom i have handed over to satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
target_text: himeneus dènge aleksander si, ra sèmi èèna ka! nèti èèna ka, ja'a soro le rèngu asa dhèu aae nidhu. ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka aj'a si loe eele pakarehe kolongara lamatua,

source_text: first of all, then, i urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone-
target_text: dhu uru tèka miu tao: ja'a manèngi miu sabaj'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ladhe miu mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, manèngi sèna ka na ladhe-leru dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa manèngi makasi, lula na tao le babe'a mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for kings and all those in authority-so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
target_text: sabaj'a sèmi èèna kahèi hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. dènge j'ara ne'e èdhi bisa mamuri mera-milu, dènge dame, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, mamuri pamèci dènge dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi lamatua.

source_text: this is good and pleasing in the sight of god our savior,
target_text: manèngi-mangaj'i sèmi èèna ka dhu be'a. j'ara ne'e ne ka pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, dhu hia èdhi mamuri.

source_text: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu mamuri, aa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. nuka sèmi:

source_text: for there is one god, and there is one mediator between god and men, the man christ jesus,
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, dhoka èci di. aa kalete dhoka èci di dhu padame èdhi dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, nuka, yesus kristus. aa yesus tare'a-re'a dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: who gave himself as a ransom for all-the testimony that was given at just the right time.
target_text: na soro iisi na, ho sui èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi. lèke dènge lod'o na, ka ama lamatua bhoke le pasaraa lii lolo be'a èèna hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for this reason i was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the gentiles. i am telling the truth; i am not lying about anything.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, sèna ka laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe ètu mia-mia, aa nori si sèna ka ra parcaya lamatua yesus, dènge mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna. ja'a leko-monya boe.

source_text: therefore i want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ètu mia-mia miu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i, hud'i dènge ku d'ara dhu mola-mèci. baku panasa. baku patao-palaha. ladhe sabaj'a, bisa ded'e kacui-aai asa ama lamatua, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, d'ara miu mola-mèci tare'a-re'a.

source_text: likewise, i want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes, but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship god.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a kahèi ladhe dhèu-dhèu bhèni re'a lalau iisi ra pake mèdha-papake dhu pantas. dhu tao bhèni j'aj'i bhèni iia, lula boe nèti pasaraga rèu kètu, do pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu nèti makae, do pake risi eele mèdha hualaa, doi pudhi dènge mutiara. te dhu tao bhèni sèra j'aj'i bhèni iia, nuka d'ara dhu hua iia, aa rèngu tao dhoka j'ara dhu be'a. èèna ka pamèci dènge dhèu bhèni dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: a woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sarani pakaboko ho nanene lii holo-nori, na, bhèni sa kahèi madhutu atora, sèna ka pasa dhilu ra be'a-be'a ho nanene lii holo-nori dènge d'ara kateme. baku pagagai sèna ka tao maruru.

source_text: i do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, lèke boe ladhe dhèu bhèni ded'e ngi'u ra ho paredha aa aj'a dhèu mone. be'a risi bhèni sèra taha d'ara.

source_text: for adam was formed first, and then eve.
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru adam, heka hawa kèna.

source_text: and it was not adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
target_text: aa adam dhu uru boe lèke ag'o nèti dhèu aae nidhu, te ngaa dhèu bhèni. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu rai-haha mulai lab'a paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu bhèni abhu mamuri lula rèngu rara iisi ana. sad'i rèngu parcaya tare'a-re'a mi kristus, mamuri pasue, mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, aa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: this is a trustworthy saying: if anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
target_text: mema tare'a sèmi lii dhèu, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hag'e nare le sasab'a èci dhu hua iia titu kèna.

source_text: an overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
target_text: kètu juma'at èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu kolongara be'a. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu hud'i taha nare d'ara na, dhèu dhu patao-palaha boe, dhu dhèu pakab'ua ne, dhu d'èi bhoke babèdho èmu ho dhèu lasi pangad'o dènge ne, aa bisa aj'a-nori dhèu leo.

source_text: not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
target_text: baku dhèu dhu tema mahu, baku dhèu dhu nasa dènge kacui-aai malai. dhu lèke ka, dhèu dhu d'ara hua iia, dhu d'èi tenge dame, aa dhu manga'a boe doi-dhari.

source_text: an overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
target_text: nèngu hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na dènge be'a. ana-ana na re'a pakab'ua dènge d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: for if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of god?
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èèna ne'a boe lalau-lalo'o d'ara èmu na, na, tasa mera mia nèngu bisa ladhe-leru juma'at lamatua.

source_text: he must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
target_text: be'a risi, pili dhèu dhu mamuri palèke dènge dad'èi kristus. de baku ded'e kètu juma'at nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu mèka mi yesus. te èèna na, rèngu sèra bisa padedha iisi malai. mage dhoka lamatua huku si, sama sèmi lamatua huku dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i dhèu dhu rai lesa re'a pakab'ua ne kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna nèngu makae boe. aa dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe pabèbhe ne kahèi.

source_text: deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at. rèngu sèra hud'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara be'a, dhèu dhu he'o kajari boe, dhu tema boe rinu mahu, aa dhu d'èi boe ra'e a'oto ae-ae.

source_text: they must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
target_text: d'ara rèngu hud'i mola-mèci, aa rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra ku lii holo-nori dhu lamatua bhoke pasaraa hia èdhi, dhèu parcaya se'e.

source_text: additionally, they must first be tested. then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie mamuri dènge sasab'a ra. ladhe abhu boe sasala si, heka ded'e si ho soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra.

source_text: in the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. rèngu sèra hud'i bhèni dhu mamuri madhutu madha j'ara dènge tatao dhu be'a. mage dhèu dhu tema padhai-kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo. rèngu hud'i dhèu dhu re'a taha rare d'ara, aa dhèu lèka si kahèi.

source_text: a deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
target_text: aa dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra hud'i mone dhu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu èèna hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na, aa uri ana-ana na dènge be'a.

source_text: for those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in christ jesus.
target_text: rèngu dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani dènge be'a, tatu dhèu asa pakab'ua si. aa rèngu asa bani, dènge boe madha'u lole parcaya rèngu mi yesus kristus.

source_text: although i hope to come to you soon, i am writing you these things in case i am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in god's household, which is the church of the living god, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
target_text: timotius! ja'a sanao sèna ka nèbhu boe ja'a dhiu ngad'o èu. ladhe ja'a pakai, do ako nena ciki, na, ele boe sasuri ne d'ai uuru èu. sasuri ne ja'a suri ho peka dènge èu, na, dhèu unu lamatua sèra hud'i ra mamuri tasa mera mia ku. baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. dhèu unu na nuka sèmi èmu dhu dènge era padhèdi, aa dènge agarii talora dhu èra. èmu sèmi èèna ka dhu titu èra, sama sèmi dhèu unu lamatua dhu kèpe pa'èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tare'a, aa rèngu bisa bara ho pakako dènge be'a.

source_text: by common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: he appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
target_text: lamatua pasabhoka le rahasia dhu kapai nèti lalèka èdhi. kapua na sèmi ne'e ka: kristus èèna, ca dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka. aa kristus èèna mai le asa rai-haha ne, pake rupa dhèu rai-haha sèmi èdhi. roh lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, yesus èèna, nuka kristus. aa ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra rèdhi na kahèi. ama lamatua dhu ded'e nèti le asa sorga, ka nedhe padedha-dedha ne. lii lolo na pale-lème le suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne. ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i parcaya le nèngu. kapua lalèka èdhi sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: now the spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, roh ama lamatua dhu peka paled'a le, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani cahag'e patalale eele ngaa dhu èdhi parcaya. ho lasi madhutu roh-roh dhu sala aa dhu leko-monya, aa lasi madhutu lii holo-nori nidhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nori sèmi sèra, padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèra mema dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli! dhèu sèra sa, d'ara iiki ra dhu bèdhu le.

source_text: they will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that god has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
target_text: ra aj'a dhèu, baku paleo èmu. aa ra aj'a dhèu luri rupa-rupa nganga'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao nganga'a-nganginu sèra, ho ladhe dhèu parcaya ra'a, rèngu manèngi makasi mi nèngu. te rèngu re'a mia dhu lèke.

source_text: for every creation of god is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
target_text: ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao sèra, tare'a-re'a be'a. de baku luri rupa-rupa. dhèu hud'i sèmi rare aa'i-aa'i sèra dènge manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: because it is sanctified by the word of god and prayer.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi sèra ka pamèu si.

source_text: by pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of christ jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
target_text: timotius! pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, èu j'aj'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti yesus kristus. lii holo-nori ama lamatua sèra ka dhu tao èu parcaya ne, aa hia me'a mèu, mia ka lii holo-nori dhu lèke. èu kèpe pa'èra-èra le lii holo-nori lamatua sèra! sèra nuka sèmi nganga'a dhu pa'èra ngi'u èu.

source_text: but reject irreverent, silly myths. instead, train yourself for godliness.
target_text: baku core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge palolo omo koso dhu lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua. baku pusi-pahae dènge lii lolo bhèni heka dhu nèti laluri rupa-rupa. be'a risi pa'èra taruu ngi'u dènge d'ara èu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
target_text: olaraga pa'èra ngi'u na, be'a. masi ka babe'a na ciki oo'e di. te ngaa pa'èra ngi'u dènge d'ara ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, babe'a na ae seli eele. babe'a na mesa boe mamuri ètu rai-haha deo ne'e di, te ngaa mamuri lèpa limuri kahèi.

source_text: this is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
target_text: lii se'e se, lèke tare'a-re'a! de tèke paie mi d'ara, ho baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: to this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living god, who is the savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
target_text: èdhi tao era maena mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu na ka dhu hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, risi-risi mi èdhi dhu parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi sab'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: command and teach these things.
target_text: nori lii se'e aa'i-aa'i. aa pua dhèu sèra ho madhutu lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu sèra pahae boe èu, lula èu ana ngèru era. èu hud'i j'aj'i conto hia dhèu parcaya sèra, nèti lii padhai èu, nèti kakako èu, nèti d'ara sasue èu mi dedha dhèu, nèti parcaya èu mi yesus kristus, dènge mamuri èu dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: until i come, devote yourself to the public reading of scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
target_text: ètu d'ara miu tatae mamai ja'a, baku bhèlu baca lii holo-nori lamatua hia mi dhèu parcaya sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, aa nori si paie-iie.

source_text: do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
target_text: pake pabe'a-be'a karunya dhu lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu, dhu èu sèmi lod'o kètu-kètu juma'at sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha kètu èu. lod'o èèna, rèngu peka lii moa lamatua kahèi lula-nèti j'ara mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu. de baku soro tèke karunya dhu èu abhu èèna.

source_text: be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
target_text: pakako dènge maj'èni j'ara sèra. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu asa be'a.

source_text: pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
target_text: j'aga sèna ka èu mamuri dènge mola. aa j'aga sèna ka èu loe boe aj'a dhu lèke j'ara. ladhe èu pa'èra dènge j'ara sèra, pe lamatua bhoke j'ara hia èu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai èu, sèna ka miu pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. treat younger men as brothers,
target_text: baku tao lii sakaa dènge dhèu mone dhu heka risi nèti èu. te ngaa dènge lii mako, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ama mu. aa mi dhèu dhu ngèru risi, pa'èra d'ara si, tao nuka sèmi ari mu.

source_text: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu bhèni dhu heka risi sèra. padhai lii dènge rèngu, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ina mu. aa ladhe padhai lii dènge ana bhèni ngèru, tao si nuka sèmi ana hèni èu. d'ara èu hud'i mola dènge si.

source_text: honor the widows who are truly widows. but if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of god. the widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in god and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
target_text: dhèu sarani hud'i soru-bara bhèni balu dhu dènge heka a'ari sèna ka ladhe-leru si. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu ana-èpu era, na, rèngu ka dhu hud'i ladhe-leru ne. aj'a si, sèna ka re'a b'ala sasue ina ra dhu rèngu abhu sèra. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu sab'a hia ama lamatua, ho pakarej'e d'ara na. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu tare'a-re'a mamuri mesa di, nèngu dènge boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe-leru ne. nèngu dhoka maena mi ama lamatua di. mèu-mèda na manèngi sasue ama lamatua. dhèu sarani hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu sèmi sèra sa.

source_text: but she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni balu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri na karej'e-karae di, masi ka na mamuri era, te ngaa dènge heka kab'ua, sama sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
target_text: pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka dhèu leo baku pa'ele iie kolongara rèngu.

source_text: if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe ladhe-leru a'ari na, risi-risi hari isi èmu na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pèci eele lalèka nèngu mi lamatua. nèngu bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: a widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, the wife of one man,
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e bhèni balu ho soru-bara kètu juma'at, j'ara na sèmi ne'e ka: umur nèngu bisa boe kura nèti 60 tèu; uru na nèngu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di;

source_text: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
target_text: dhèu re'a, na, nèngu ca dhèu dhu tema tao babe'a mi dhèu; dhu ladhe-leru ana-ana na dènge be'a; dhu bhoke tèke kacui-aai ho leru dhèu leo; dhu soru-bara dhèu parcaya sèra ètu d'ara sasab'a, masi ka dhu samaa èèna ka; dhu d'èi soru dhèu ètu d'ara sasusa; aa dhu bhori mema ho soru-bara ètu madha j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but refuse to enroll younger widows. for when their passions draw them away from christ, they will want to marry,
target_text: baku pili bhèni balu dhu ngèru era, ho sab'a ètu d'ara juma'at. te mage dhoka cèu ètu d'ara na, ho neo hari leo-èmu. ladhe sèmi èèna, rèngu se abhu heka lod'o dhu taleo, ho lalau dhèu sarani dènge be'a.

source_text: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
target_text: te ladhe lod'o dhu rèngu pake hia juma'at èèna kura, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu pa'ele iie lii pajaji rèngu ètu katanga madha lamatua. èèna na, dhèu pasala si.

source_text: at the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
target_text: mage dhoka rèngu bai-eed'a, aa maso-kalua èmu dhèu, padhai-kaked'u pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. aa dhu karehe risi eele hari, rèngu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, dènge padhai dhu lèke boe.

source_text: so i advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
target_text: be'a risi eele, bhèni balu dhu ngèru era leo hari èmu, sèna ka rara iisi, aa ladhe-leru d'ara èmu rèngu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pamusu dènge èdhi abhu boe j'ara ho pa'ele iie kolongara èdhi.

source_text: for some have already turned aside to follow satan.
target_text: abhu bhèni balu ngèru cahag'e dhu kako sala j'ara. rèngu se madhutu j'ara dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: if any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu a'ari ra j'aj'i le bhèni balu, na, bhèni ne hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu èèna. baku soro tèke hia juma'at ladhe-leru. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna juma'at bisa ladhe-leru bhèni balu dhu leo, dhu tare'a-re'a dènge heka a'ari.

source_text: elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
target_text: dhèu dhu ladhe-leru juma'at dènge be'a, miu hud'i pakab'ua risi ne, aa b'ae gaji dènge be'a. risi-risi rèngu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, ho lole pataraa lii holo-nori lamatua, aa aj'a j'ara mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for the scripture says, do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain, and, the worker is worthy of his wages.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, ladhe pake sapi j'èli puru are nèti huri, mage mi kape hèb'a na kahèi, sèna ka bisa na'a. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, cee ka dhu sab'a, na, nèngu hud'i abhu gaji ku.

source_text: do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu galaa kètu juma'at, baku sad'i sèmi mere di! hud'i abhu ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka mi sèmi mere ho parisa ne.

source_text: but those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
target_text: ladhe miu kai ne, te ngaa na mamuri taruu madhutu d'ara sasala èèna, kai hari ne ètu madha juma'at. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu leo bani boe madhutu tatao èèna.

source_text: i solemnly charge you before god and christ jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
target_text: pakako aa'i atora se'e mi juma'at dhu hag'e boe, aa baku bia cabèka. ja'a pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi d'ara kacui-aai èu, ètu katanga madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus. ana pajuu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ètu sorga, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi!

source_text: do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. keep yourself pure.
target_text: baku pamèri ded'e dhèu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. ladhe uuru ku paie-iie ne. te ladhe miu ded'e sad'i ngara di, hèia dhèu ne tao sala, na, miu pasae sasala èèna kahèi, lula tatao na. j'aga paie ngi'u èu sèna ka mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi èu kabake pèd'a taruu. be'a risi nèti deo ne'e, èu pab'ali èi dènge anggor ciki tao sèmi èi na'i. baku minu dhoka èi iia di.

source_text: the sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie! abhu sasala dhèu dhu cèu mema. rèngu d'ai mèka madha hakim, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le èèna. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka sasala ra cèu kèna.

source_text: in the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu tao be'a sèra. abhu mema dhu led'a. te ngaa cahag'e pahuni-pahuni tao dhu be'a. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, nèbhu-nèbhu cèu asa li'u kahèi. bisa boe pahuni tatao dhu be'a.

source_text: all who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that god's name and our teaching will not be discredited.
target_text: abhu lamatua dhu ènu na parcaya lamatua yesus. rèngu hud'i pakab'ua lamatua ra, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu boe j'ara ho padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, aa pamud'e dènge lii aj'a-nori èdhi.

source_text: those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. teach and encourage these principles.
target_text: abhu ènu dhu lamatua na parcaya le lamatua yesus. ènu ne bisa boe pahaha lamatua na, lula lamatua na dhu parcaya lamatua yesus. masi ka tasamia èèna ka, rèngu hud'i lalau ku pabe'a risi hari lamatua ra, lula rèngu dènge rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dhèu parcaya dhu hud'i mamuri pasue ku. timotius! aj'a aa'i-aa'i se, aa pa'èra d'ara dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our lord jesus christ and with godly teaching,
target_text: lii aj'a-nori èdhi dhu lèke èèna, j'aj'i kapua nèti d'ara mamuri èdhi dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu nori leo nèti lii aj'a se'e, dhèu sèra dhu core eele le lii lamatua yesus kristus dhu lèke.

source_text: he is conceited and understands nothing. instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and semantics, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, padedha iisi, te ngaa goa. papèd'a rèngu ka d'èi dhoka tenge lii langu, aa pab'ala d'ara lii. j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao dhèu ho: tèka d'ara, patao-palaha, pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo, aa pangee dhu lèke boe mi dhèu leo.

source_text: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. these men regard godliness as a means of gain.
target_text: dhèu sèmi se'e, loe boe patao-palaha. ngangee ra karehe bia. re'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. rèngu ngee, ladhe rèngu maj'èni dènge j'ara-j'ara agama, rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i.

source_text: of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
target_text: mema, agama bisa hia a'oto mi dhèu. te mamuri dènge lamatua èèna ka dhu hia dhèu karej'e nèti ngaa dhu rèngu unu. èèna, heka agama dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! lod'o rara iisi èdhi, èdhi tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa asa rai-haha ne. aa ladhe lod'o madhe, tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa kahèi nèti rai-haha ne.

source_text: but if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
target_text: de sad'i dènge nganga'a, mèdha-papake sèra sa nia le!

source_text: those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu neo kaja, mud'a titu kèna lèke dadugu-rariu rupa-rupa, aa lèke sasii g'ana-kariu, lula rèngu pangee dhoka mèdha-panyau di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pa'ele iie mamuri rèngu.

source_text: for the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. by craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
target_text: te sue doi-dhari, èèna j'aj'i mi amo nèti rupa-rupa bhabhelu. abhu dhèu cahag'e magèle dhoka doi-dhari di, toke ra pakaj'èu nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke. hèia rèngu mesa ra pa'ele iie mamuri ra.

source_text: but you, o man of god, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
target_text: timotius! èu ne, dhèu unu ama lamatua. de pakaj'èu iisi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i. mamuri mola-mèci. mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. parcaya taruu mi yesus kristus. sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. mamuri d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: fight the good fight of the faith. take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
target_text: sab'a pa'èra-èra dènge d'ara kateme, sèna ka pakako lii holo-nori aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi parcaya. lamatua paroa le èu, ho abhu mamuri taa-taa. de liku pa'èra-èra mamuri èèna, baku patalale eele. aa èu dhu peka le ètu madha dhèu ae, lula-nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus.

source_text: i charge you in the presence of god, who gives life to all things, and of christ jesus, who made the good confession in his testimony before pontius pilate: keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: de nèti deo ne'e, ja'a manèngi èu pa'èki lii pajaji sèmi ne'e: tao madhutu lii paredha aa'i-aa'i nèti lamatua yesus. baku sisu èci sa hèi, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi sasala èu. tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra dènge mola-mola toke lod'o mamai hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha ama lamatua. nèngu ka dhu hia le samanga mi dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a manèngi kahèi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha yesus kristus. nèngu dhu peka paled'a le, lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu, ètu madha gubernur pontius pilatus.

source_text: which the blessed and only sovereign one-the king of kings and lord of lords-will bring about in his own time.
target_text: lamatua yesus dhu kapai risi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u koasa! nèngu èèna, dhèu aae kapai nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra. aa nèngu èèna, lamatua kapai nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua paled'a aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: he alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. no one has ever seen him, nor can anyone see him. to him be honor and eternal dominion! amen.
target_text: dhoka nèngu mesa na di, dhu madhe boe. nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa dhu dhèu rai-haha taha boe laladhe. abhu boe dhèu èci sa ladhe rèdhi ne. lii-lii pakab'ua dhodhoka mi nèngu di! koasa aa'i-aa'i, ètu kacui-aai na, toke d'ai mia-mia! d'ai sange ne'e ka! tare'a!

source_text: instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in god, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
target_text: peka mi dhèu kaja ètu rai-haha ne, ho rèngu baku padedha iisi, aa baku dhoka maena mèdha-panyau rèngu di. te mèdha-panyau sèra, bèli-camèd'a èla aa'i. de dhu lèke ka, maena dhoka mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri di. te nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi èdhi ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,
target_text: peka dènge ra, ho pake kakaja sèra sèna ka tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i bhoke kacui-aai ho soru-bara dhèu leo, aa d'èi pala-bagi mèngi-nale dhu rèngu abhu nèti lamatua.

source_text: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.
target_text: hèia ra pakaboko mèdha-panyau ho j'aj'i mi kapua dhu èra, hia mamuri ra bèli-camèd'a. ka rèngu unu mamuri dhu dènge kab'ua.

source_text: o timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called knowledge,
target_text: timotius! j'aga paie aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu. baku lamu padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. baku padhai lii kaj'alu dhu pakab'ua boe ama lamatua. sanèd'e, ee! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ‘mamèu' rèngu sèra dhu hèb'a hua. baku lamu pab'ala lii padhai dènge ra.

source_text: which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. grace be with you all.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e lèka lii aj'a-nori dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, toke ra sero eele nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke mi ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èu dènge angalai mu si aa'i-aa'i ra. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of christ jesus by the will of god, according to the promise of life in christ jesus, to timothy, my beloved child: grace, mercy, and peace from god the father and christ jesus our lord.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus, dhu ama lamatua mesa na hag'e nare j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ra pua ja'a ho laku lole nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu lamatua moa le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. timotius! èu dhu j'aj'i le sèmi ana ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sue èu, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i thank god, whom i serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as i constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
target_text: mèu-mèda ja'a sabaj'a hia èu. ja'a manèngi taruu makasi mi ama lamatua, lula èu madhutu taruu ne. èu me'a! ja'a sab'a hia nèngu dènge d'ara mola-mèci, èci èèna ka dhu bèi-baki èdhi sèra sab'a hia ne.

source_text: recalling your tears, i long to see you so that i may be filled with joy.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e lod'o èdhi pacèri uru èèna, èu pahaa èi madha. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo titu kèna paraga hari dènge èu, sèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e.

source_text: i am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother lois and your mother eunice, and i am convinced is in you as well.
target_text: ja'a ngee kèdhi uru èèna, lod'o èu heka parcaya tare'a lamatua yesus. parcaya sèmi èèna na dhu amo le ètu d'ara bèi mu luisa dènge ina mu yunike. aa ja'a ke'a mèu, na, parcaya sèmi èèna muri le ètu d'ara èu kahèi.

source_text: for this reason i remind you to fan into flame the gift of god, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bane ai ètu kètu èu aa sabaj'a hia èu, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua hia karunya mi èu, sèna ka èu bisa sab'a hia ne. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pakaroo hari karunya èu dhu nuka sèmi ai dhu oe madhe sa.

source_text: for god has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu madha'u. te ngaa na tao, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara èra, dhu te'a pasue, aa te'a taha tare d'ara.

source_text: so do not be ashamed of the testimony of our lord, or of me, his prisoner. instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of god.
target_text: de baku makae peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lamatua èdhi. aa baku makae lula ja'a ne ana bèdho. te ja'a maso bui lula ja'a pakako sasab'a na. de ladhe lamu lole lii lolo be'a, èu hud'i pa'èra ku iisi, ho dui j'aj'èra nuka sèmi ji'i dui. ladhe èu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, èèna na lamatua pa'èra d'ara èu.

source_text: he has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by his own purpose and by the grace he granted us in christ jesus before time began. and now he has revealed this grace through the appearing of our savior, christ jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
target_text: lula lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. aa na hag'e nare èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci. na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula na sue èdhi, masi ka èdhi tao boe ngaa-ngaa ho nia sèmi babe'a na. lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa pama'ète nare le ho hia yesus kristus mai, sèna ka na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala mamuri hia èdhi. ka yesus kristus mai le, aa bhoke paled'a ngaa dhu uru èèna ama lamatua nelu tao, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia nèngu mi èdhi. na palaho le koasa mamadhe! ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a! de cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, madhe heka taa-taa, te ngaa mamuri manèro toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: to which i was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua ded'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, sèna ka ja'a lole lii lolo be'a na, aa aj'a-nori dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: for this reason, even though i suffer as i do, i am not ashamed; for i know whom i have believed, and i am convinced that he is able to guard what i have entrusted to him for that day.
target_text: sèra sa ka dhu paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa ja'a makae boe! lula ja'a ke'a le cee ka dhu ja'a parcaya, nuka lamatua yesus. aa ja'a ke'a kahèi, peka na, nèngu ka dhu pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi adhe-aai ja'a, nèngu ka dhu bisa j'aga sasab'a ne'e, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra ja'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a ne'e, toke nèngu mai hari.

source_text: hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in christ jesus.
target_text: de madhutu ka, j'ara mamuri nèti a'aj'a dhu lèke dhu ja'a pad'elo le dènge èu. ladhe èu parcaya taruu, aa sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna, ne'e peka na, èu j'aj'i le èci dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the holy spirit who dwells in us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le ètu d'ara adhe-aai èu kakaja èci dhu kab'ua, nuka a'aj'a dhu lèke. de ladhe-leru pabe'a kakaja èèna! pake roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èdhi, sèna ka hud'i laa na pa'èra èu ho ladhe-leru kakaja èèna paie-iie.

source_text: you know that everyone in the province of asia has deserted me, including phygelus and hermogenes.
target_text: ele boe èu tadèngi le, na, figelus, hermogenes dènge dhèu leo nèti propensi asia sèra, pusi-pahae heka ja'a.

source_text: may the lord grant mercy to the household of onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains. indeed, when he arrived in rome, he searched diligently until he found me. may the lord grant onesiphorus his mercy on that day. you know very well how much he ministered to me in ephesus.
target_text: te ngaa onesiforus leko-leo nèti rèngu. na pakaj'èu boe nèti ja'a. èu mesa mu me'a, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, nèngu ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. limuri ne, na pea ètu kota roma ne'e. ropa na d'ai ne'e, na patangi-tenge ja'a ètu mia-mia. ka na abhu ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa na makae boe. na mai taruu ngad'o ja'a ho pa'èra d'ara ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi onesiforus dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra. ladhe lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu rai-haha, ja'a sanao ho lamatua pama'ète dhu be'a hia mi onesiforus si.

source_text: you therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in christ jesus.
target_text: ana timotius dhu ja'a sue! yesus kristus d'ara hua iia titu kèna. limuri ne, èu èci le dènge nèngu. na pa'èra èu. de èu me'a dhoka sèmi more di!

source_text: and the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a aj'a le èu ètu madha dhèu ae lula-nèti j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. de limuri ne ja'a manèngi èu, ho aa'i-aa'i dhu èu tadèngi nèti ja'a, lamu aj'a hari hia dhèu dhu èu bisa lèka si. dhèu sèra hud'i bisa lasi aj'a hari sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo.

source_text: join me in suffering, like a good soldier of christ jesus.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, nuka sèmi sordad'u yesus kristus. de èdhi pasae j'aj'èra sèmi nèngu kahèi. lula èu ne sordad'u dhu be'a, èu hud'i pasae more ku pala unu mu.

source_text: a soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
target_text: sordad'u dhu pakako sasab'a bisa boe sab'a pab'ali dènge sasab'a dhu leo. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu ne'a pakarej'e d'ara komedhaa na.

source_text: likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
target_text: tare conto leo sèmi olaraga. ladhe madhutu lomba, hud'i madhutu ku atora na. te ladhe aad'o, na, kalua! bisa boe abhu juara. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe neo pakako sasab'a lamatua, madhutu ku atora na.

source_text: the hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.
target_text: ladhe kahèi dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. na sab'a dènge tèku rui na ètu d'ara oka na. de nèngu ka dhu uru tèka abhu hua-hela.

source_text: consider what i am saying, for the lord will give you insight into all things.
target_text: pangee paie-iie conto sèra. pe ama lamatua hia me'a mèu j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: remember jesus christ, raised from the dead, descended from david, as proclaimed by my gospel,
target_text: pangee pabe'a-be'a mi yesus kristus. nèngu èèna ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri ne. èèna ka j'aj'i lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a laku peka-padhai ètu mia-mia.

source_text: for which i suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. but the word of god cannot be chained!
target_text: lula ja'a lole lii lolo be'a, èèna ka ja'a j'èra sèmi ne'e ne. risi-risi hari ra èki-karadhe ja'a dènge rate, tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa. te ngaa rèngu taha rare boe lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: for this reason i endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in christ jesus, with eternal glory.
target_text: de ja'a sadia pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. sad'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu na hag'e nare sèra abhu mamuri. pe ama lamatua ded'e si padedha-dedha, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: this is a trustworthy saying: if we died with him, we will also live with him;
target_text: aa lii se'e mema lèke tare'a: ladhe èdhi mangaku, na, kristus madhe ho gati èdhi, èci èèna ka èdhi madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia èdhi kahèi mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he will also deny us;
target_text: ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èdhi tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasili ne, nèngu pasili èdhi kahèi.

source_text: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot deny himself.
target_text: masi ka d'ara èdhi satia boe, te ngaa nèngu satia taa-taa, lula nèngu bisa boe leko-monya. ngaa dhu na peka, èèna ka dhu na tao.

source_text: remind the believers of these things, charging them before god to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu baku bhèlu j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra. kai si dènge kolongara ama lamatua, ho ra loe eele ka nèti pa'uji lii padhai lii. te aa'i-aa'i sèra guna boe ngaa-ngaa. dhodhoka pa'ele iie ngangee nèti dhèu dhu nanene.

source_text: make every effort to present yourself approved to god, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
target_text: tenge j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka tao iisi èu nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu nia abhu koa nèti ama lamatua. dhèu sèmi èèna parluu boe makae, lula nèngu èèna sab'a sasab'a na dènge be'a. èu hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu aj'a dènge mola lii holo-nori lamatua mi dhèu, aa baku dènge koe-kapengo. lula lii holo-nori na, mola!

source_text: but avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
target_text: pakaj'èu nèti lii padhue dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, aa nèti lii padhai dhu pakab'ua boe lamatua. te sèra sa dhoka tao dhèu asa bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. among them are hymenaeus and philetus,
target_text: lii padhai dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra paj'ala sèmi èi papèd'a kangker. lii padhai himeneus dènge filetus sèmi sèra ka!

source_text: who have deviated from the truth. they say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.
target_text: dua ra aj'a sala, peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri aa'i hari le. te ngaa èèna lèke boe! dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu se piku eele nèti ngaa dhu lèke. ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a se'e, pa'ele iie parcaya nèti dhèu cahag'e.

source_text: nevertheless, god's firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: the lord knows those who are his, and, everyone who calls on the name of the lord must turn away from iniquity.
target_text: te ngaa kapua dhu ama lamatua padhèdi nare èèna, kalau-karèto boe. ètu kapua èèna, dhu suri peka na, lamatua tadhe mèu dhèu unu na, aa, dhèu cee dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, hud'i pakaj'èu ku nèti bhelu-katub'a. kapua èèna, dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: a large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use. so if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the master, and prepared for every good work.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kaja, abhu rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau. abhu dhu tao nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu tao nèti aj'u dènge rai kalili. mèdha dhu kab'ua, lamatua èmu na d'èi pake ètu d'ara iia-aala. te ngaa mèdha dhu biasa sèra, lamatua èmu makae pake ètu madha dhèu. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu rai-haha. ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua sèra. lamatua èmu d'èi pake ne, lula nèngu dènge gaguna sèna ka tao rupa-rupa sasab'a dhu be'a.

source_text: flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the lord out of a pure heart.
target_text: ana ngèru sèra manahu malai lula madhutu dad'èi ra. te ngaa èu, timotius, hud'i j'aga ngi'u mu paie-iie, ho baku madhutu dad'èi d'ara sèmi èèna. tenge j'ara ho tao dhu be'a taruu. parcaya taruu lamatua. mamuri pasue aa padame dènge dhèu leo. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara dhu be'a. de èu, timotius, hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi rèngu sèra!

source_text: but reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e hari èu ca tèka! baku lamu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te sèra sa dhodhoka tao dhèu ho patao-palaha di.

source_text: and a servant of the lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
target_text: dhèu dhu sab'a hia lamatua nia boe j'aj'i dhèu dhu tenge lii langu, sina ma? te ngaa rèngu sèra hud'i d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, dhu d'èlu-mèu aj'a-nori dhèu, dhu taha rare d'ara ropa paraga dènge dhèu dhu tema tenge lii langu.

source_text: he must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that god may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
target_text: rèngu hud'i holo paie-iie dhèu dhu palab'a sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ele boe lamatua hia si ele-ho'a, hèia ra sèmi rare ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
target_text: hèia ra mase'a, ka ra rai nèti kacui-aai dhèu aae nidhu, dhu uru èèna èki si ho madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: but understand this: in the last days terrible times will come.
target_text: timotius! ladhe dètu dènge lod'o èle rai-haha ne, j'aj'èra na ae titu kèna. ja'a peka mema dènge èu sèmi èèna.

source_text: for men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
target_text: dhèu dhoka sue ngi'u ra, aa manga'a doi-dhari. rèngu padedha iisi, aa d'èi pahaha dhèu leo, d'èi pakarehe kolongara lamatua, d'èi boe nanene ina-ama ra, re'a boe manèngi makasi, kètu hadhu, d'èi boe madha j'ara lamatua,

source_text: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,
target_text: re'a boe sue dhèu, d'èi boe mamuri padame, d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, taha rare boe iisi ra, bhelu-katub'a dhu risi eele, d'èi boe dhu be'a,

source_text: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of god,
target_text: d'èi pahie mone aanga-angalai ra, ngangee bab'a, aa tao ngi'u ra d'èlu-mèu risi, madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara risi nèti dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: having a form of godliness but denying its power. turn away from such as these!
target_text: rèngu tao iisi ra dhèu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao. koasa lamatua abhu boe ètu d'ara ra. baku padètu dènge dhèu sèmi sèra kahèi!

source_text: they are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
target_text: rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu dènge rèhu mare, ho lasi kakèj'i d'ara dhèu bhèni dhu èra boe, aa mud'a lèke god'a. dhèu bhèni sèmi sèra sa, mamuri ètu d'ara sasala-sasigo dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, aa madhutu dhoka rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ra.

source_text: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi mese hiu mai nori j'ara dhu hiu, na, rèngu madhutu rii. te ngaa re'a boe hag'e mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia dhu sale.

source_text: just as jannes and jambres opposed moses, so also these men oppose the truth. they are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
target_text: èu sanèd'e era lii lolo yanes dènge yamres, si? lod'o èèna, dua ra palab'a dènge musa. mese taa limuri se'e, tatao ra èci èèna ka. rèngu palab'a dènge lii holo-nori dhu be'a. ngangee ra ele iie le, aa parcaya rèngu lèke boe.

source_text: but they will not advance much further. for just like jannes and jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
