target_text: mese dhu lèke boe sèmi sèra sa, bisa boe taha rare nèbhu. nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a gagoa rèngu! nuka sèmi uru èèna dhèu re'a kapod'e-kabèli lula-nèti yanes dènge yamres.

source_text: you, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
target_text: timotius! èu me'a aa'i le mamuri ja'a. èu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a. èu me'a j'ara mamuri ja'a. èu me'a d'ara dad'èi ja'a. èu me'a ngaa dhu ja'a parcaya. èu mèdhi unu mu le, ja'a taha kore d'ara, aa sasue ja'a mi dhèu. aa èu me'a tasamia ja'a taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra dènge be'a.

source_text: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in antioch, iconium, and lystra. what persecutions i endured! yet the lord rescued me from all of them.
target_text: èu me'a kahèi ra hake-paparu ja'a, aa dui rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. ja'a abhu j'aj'èra sèmi èèna ètu kota antiokia, ikonium, dènge listra. te ngaa ama lamatua patalale eele ja'a nèti j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in christ jesus will be persecuted,
target_text: mema dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus, aa neo mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, tatu dhèu paj'èra rèngu.

source_text: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
target_text: ngaa hari, dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, asa tabha bhelu. rèngu kapod'e-kabhèli ho pamanahu dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu sèra lèke kapod'e kahèi.

source_text: but as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori dhu èu abhu le. aa ngaa dhu èu parcaya èèna, madhutu taruu. te èèna ka dhu lèke! èu me'a mèu cee ka dhu aj'a aa'i-aa'i sèra mi èu! èu bisa lèka si!

source_text: from infancy you have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in christ jesus.
target_text: karèi nèti èu ana iiki era, èu abhu a'aj'a le isi nèti sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. nèti sasuri se'e, èu me'a rahasia mamuri dhu lèke, dhu tao èu me'a mèu j'ara mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: all scripture is god-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, mema ama lamatua ka dhu uri ho dhèu suri sèra. gaguna sasuri èèna, nuka: aj'a dhèu ngaa dhu lèke, pad'elo sasala dhèu, ère hari dhèu asa j'ara dhu mola, aa nori dhèu ho bèli-bèli mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: so that the man of god may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, sasuri mola-mèci èèna bisa tao pamèci dhèu unu lamatua sèra, sèna ka rèngu re'a sasab'a dhu be'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: i charge you in the presence of god and of christ jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom: preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a yesus kristus mai hari asa rai-haha ne, ho nèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. masi ka dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhèu dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa katanga madha na, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu ra èci-èci. nèti èèna ka, ètu madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus, ja'a manèngi mi èu ho lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu, lii holo-nori ama lamatua. èu pa'èra taruu! baku pangee, na, lod'o dhu be'a, do aad'o. pad'elo sasala dhèu, te ngaa kai si pabe'a-be'a dènge lii mako. pa'èra d'ara dhèu pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: for the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu ro'o heka nanene lii holo-nori dhu lèke. pe ra kaboko rare mese-mese dhu d'èlu-mèu padhue-padhai madhutu dad'èi ra, sèna ka pabe'a ro'a dhilu ra.

source_text: so they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
target_text: ra hutu dhilu ra ho tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke. te ngaa pasa dhilu ra, ho nanene lii lolo nanuku dhu leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
target_text: masi ka tasamia èèna ka, èu hud'i taha d'ara. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. lamu lole lii lolo be'a, sèna ka dhèu sèmi rare yesus kristus. soru-bara dhèu dènge d'ara kateme, toke pa'èle sasab'a. baku dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: for i am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
target_text: baku pusi dènge ngi'u ja'a ne, te lod'o mamadhe ja'a dètu le. èci èèna ka dènge galaa dhu isi na oe èle kèna.

source_text: i have fought the good fight, i have finished the race, i have kept the faith.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a segi le ètu d'ara pa'uji èèna dènge be'a. ja'a rai d'ai le lane. ja'a madhutu taruu le yesus kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: from now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the lord, the righteous judge, will award to me on that day-and not only to me, but to all who crave his appearing.
target_text: de ne'e ne, di èci ka dhu ja'a tatae. nuka piala juara dhu lamatua tao tèke le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola. lamatua èdhi èèna, nuka dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola. dhu ne'a boe bia cabèka. ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, na pangèd'u mi ja'a piala juara èèna. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne, aa dhu mate mamai na, rèngu sèra abhu piala sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: make every effort to come to me quickly,
target_text: timotius! mai ka lai-lai ngad'o ja'a!

source_text: because demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to thessalonica. crescens has gone to galatia, and titus to dalmatia.
target_text: te limuri ne ja'a kaliu bia. krekes la'e le asa propensi galati. aa titus la'e le asa rai dalmatia. aa demas sue risi j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu rai-haha ne, la'e le sa kota tesalonika.

source_text: only luke is with me. get mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
target_text: dhodhoka lukas di dhu pea dènge ja'a ètu ne'e. tenge more markus sèna ka dua mi mai palere-lere. te nèngu èèna bisa ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: tychicus, however, i have sent to ephesus.
target_text: ja'a hia le tikikus la'e asa kota epesus.

source_text: when you come, bring the cloak that i left with carpus at troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
target_text: ladhe èu mai, baku bhèlu mèti kodho pana ja'a dhu tèke eele ètu èmu karpus ètu kota troas. aa baku bhèlu mèti dènge sasuri ja'a sèra, risi-risi dhu ja'a suri ètu ka'uri badha.

source_text: alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. the lord will repay him according to his deeds.
target_text: aleksander, tuka tabaga èèna, tao bhelu dhu ciki boe mi dedha ja'a. hud'i nèngu sène, te bèli-camèd'a, lamatua ka dhu b'ala ne, sèmi dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: you too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
target_text: èu hud'i mage-mage ku dènge dhèu èèna, lula nèngu na d'èi palab'a lii-lii dhu èdhi aj'a-nori.

source_text: at my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. may it not be charged against them.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu ja'a titu ètu madha hakim ho siri iisi ja'a, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re ja'a. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra kako tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! pe lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra.

source_text: but the lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the gentiles would hear it. so i was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ja'a. na pa'èra ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka-padhai lii lolo be'a na dhu pakura boe ciki sa. ja'a lolo sèmi èèna ka mi dhèu yahudi boe, ho ra nanene lii lolo be'a. aa pakaj'èu le nèti mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: and the lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. to him be the glory forever and ever. amen.
target_text: aa èèna na ama lamatua pakaj'èu ja'a nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra. aa lere nèti ja'a dènge sod'a-mole laku asa sorga. ètu era nèi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha. lamatua èèna, kapai seli eele! ja'a koa-kio ded'e padedha-dedha ne, dhu ma'ète boe! tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: greet prisca and aquila, as well as the household of onesiphorus.
target_text: baku bhelu mèti lii maho'o ja'a mi ina priskila dènge dhèu èmu na akila. sèmi èèna kahèi, mi a'ari onesiforus.

source_text: erastus has remained at corinth, and trophimus i left sick in miletus.
target_text: erastus pea ètu kota korintus. ca hari ni, ja'a tèke eele trofimus ètu kota miletus, lula na pèd'a aae.

source_text: make every effort to come to me before winter. eubulus sends you greetings, as do pudens, linus, claudia, and all the brothers.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka lod'o d'ai mèka hèru pacuhi, èu dhu d'ai le ne'e. angalai ètu se'e se, nuka: ebolus, pudes, linus dènge ina klaudia pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge a'ari dhèu kristen dhu leo sèra.

source_text: the lord be with your spirit. grace be with you all.
target_text: ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua sama-sama dènge èu taruu. sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, a servant of god and an apostle of jesus christ for the faith of god's elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness, in the hope of eternal life, which god, who cannot lie, promised before time began. in his own time he has made his word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of god our savior. to titus, my true child in our common faith: grace and peace from god the father and christ jesus our savior.
target_text: ana titus dhu be'a! sasuri ne'e nèti ja'a, paulus, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua, aa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. na pua ja'a sèna ka pa'èra parcaya dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra. na pua ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara mola kahèi, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu unu ama lamatua re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa na moa mema, bèli-camèd'a dhèu unu na mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. nèngu ne'a boe leko-monya. d'ai lod'o na, ka ama lamatua peka paled'a, na, nèngu saku eele sasala-sigo dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. aa na paredha ja'a ho laku peka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. titus! èu ne nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a sa, lula èu dènge ja'a ne sama-sama parcaya kristus. de ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, ho èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: the reason i left you in crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as i directed you.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho èu pea ètu pulu kreta, sèna ka uri pèri-pèri j'ara dhu èdhi parluu era ètu èèna. aa hud'i laa èu ded'e dhèu dhu re'a lalau-lalo'o juma'at ètu d'ara rae-rae. baku bhèlu atora dhu ja'a peka le dènge èu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. peka na:

source_text: an elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e dhèu ho j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku dènge boe sasala. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. ana-ana na parcaya kahèi yesus kristus. mage dhoka dhèu peka, na, rèngu sèra ana-ana dhu tenge patao-palaha di, aa palab'a dènge dhèu.

source_text: as god's steward, an overseer must be above reproach-not self-absorbed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
target_text: lula kètu juma'at sèra pakako sasab'a lamatua, de rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge mola, aa dènge kolongara hua iia. baku ded'e dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi; dhu nasa malai, d'èi mahu, dhu d'èi pagama, aa dhu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i d'èi sèmi rare dhèu asa d'ara èmu ra. dhu d'èi j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu taha rare d'ara, dhu bia boe cabèka, dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhu re'a taha rare ngi'u.

source_text: he must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
target_text: rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, dhu uru èèna èdhi nori si. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu pad'elo j'ara lamatua dhu mola hia dhèu leo, aa bisa pamola lii lolo dhu lèke boe j'ara sèra.

source_text: for many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
target_text: te abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi palab'a a'aj'a dhu lèke. abhu dhu peka-padhai dènge boe kolo-kapua. aa abhu kahèi dhu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. risi-risi dhèu yahudi dhu peka, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo abhu mamuri hud'i suna ku.

source_text: who must be silenced. for the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
target_text: ra pake a'aj'a rèngu dhu sala ho nuni rèti a'ari èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke. rèngu sèra d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari dènge j'ara kapod'e-kabèli di! kai dhèu sèmi sèra sa, sèna ka ra loe nèti aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: as one of their own prophets has said, cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu èci nèti pulu kreta, dhu tema padhai pake lii hini, lole dhèu nèngu unu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu pulu kreta d'èi dhoka padhai lii hèb'a hua di, dhu manga'a, nuka sèmi badha hui dhu re'a boe atora, aa bai-eed'a mèje adhe!

source_text: this testimony is true. therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
target_text: mamuri dhèu sèra mema sèmi èèna ka! de èu hud'i lamu ère more hari dhèu dhu lèke kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ho pa'èra hari parcaya ra mi lamatua.

source_text: and will pay no attention to jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
target_text: èle èèna, ra nanene ia ka nanuku nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aa rèngu hud'i ae eele ku nèti lii paredha dhèu-dhèu dhu tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: to the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bagi dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa'i-aa'i mola-mèci. te ngaa bagi dhu d'ara kaj'alu aa dhu parcaya boe lamatua, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu mola-mèci. lula d'ara dènge ngangee rèngu dhu kaj'alu mema le.

source_text: they profess to know god, but by their actions they deny him. they are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
target_text: rèngu mangaku tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa mamuri ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ne. rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo. rèngu mema tare'a-re'a dhèu karehe di! rèngu ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku maena dhèu sèmi sèra re'a tao dhu be'a!

source_text: but as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
target_text: te ngaa èu ne, titus, baku j'aj'i sèmi rèngu kahèi! èu hud'i pa'èra d'ara dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke.

source_text: older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
target_text: peka dènge ama-ama dhèu heka sèra ho mamuri madhutu atora, j'aga paie kolongara, aa taha rare d'ara. rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra aa taha taruu madhutu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu lèke. aa rèngu hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ina-ina dhu heka sèra. peka dènge ra j'aga paie kakako dènge lii padhai ra, aa mamuri taruu madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku padhai-kakoli kolongara dhèu. baku j'aj'i ènu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. te ngaa rèngu hud'i aj'a dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge mola.

source_text: in this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi ina-ina dhu ngèru era, sèna ka ra sue dhèu èmu-kamali dènge ana-ana ra.

source_text: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of god will not be discredited.
target_text: rèngu hud'i aj'a kahèi dhèu ho ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara, mola-mèci, re'a lalau d'ara èmu, re'a pahae dhèu èmu ra, aa d'èi nanene lii dhèu èmu ra. ladhe mamuri rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa heka padhai lii pahaha lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: in the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, holo mone ngèru sèra, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara.

source_text: in everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. in your teaching show integrity, dignity,
target_text: titus! èu ne hud'i mamuri dènge be'a ku, ho bisa j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo. sad'i èu tao ngaa èci sa, sab'a dènge be'a, sama sèmi dhu èu aj'a dhèu sèra. ladhe èu aj'a ngaa sa èci, na, tao madhutu ngaa dhu èu aj'a sèra. mage pamud'e dènge sasab'a èu.

source_text: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed to have nothing bad to say about us.
target_text: ladhe èu nori dhèu, pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu abhu boe j'ara ho pamanahu èu. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu-dhèu dhu lab'a èdhi ra'e makae, lula rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho segi èdhi.

source_text: slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
target_text: aj'a ènu sèra ho ra nanene lamatua rèngu ètu j'ara ngaa èèna ka, aa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ra. baku ra pab'ala lii padhai dènge lamatua ra.

source_text: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about god our savior.
target_text: rèngu baku mana'u mèdha-panyau lamatua ra. rèngu hud'i pad'elo ku dhu peka, na, lamatua ra bisa parcaya rèngu tare'a-re'a. rèngu sèra hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu be'a aa satia. ladhe dhèu leo neo pakasame mamuri ènu rèngu dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi aj'a, tatu ra dhaa, peka na, lii a'aj'a èdhi be'a titu kèna. te a'aj'a èdhi se'e, madhutu j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua dhu hia le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: for the grace of god has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
target_text: te ama lamatua pad'elo le babe'a d'ara na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, aa bhoke j'ara ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: it instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mamuri dhu pamèci boe, aa dad'èi dhu karehe, ti core eele si. èdhi mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, hud'i te'a taha tare d'ara, mamuri dènge mola-mèci, aa satia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great god and savior jesus christ.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi sanao-maena mamai hari yesus kristus dhu kapai risi eele! èèna j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. nèngu èèna, lamatua èdhi dhu kapai risi dhu pala-bagi le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: he gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good deeds.
target_text: nèngu hia le ngi'u aae na j'aj'i mi korban, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka tao èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci, dhu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara hua iia di.

source_text: speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. let no one despise you.
target_text: de titus, aj'a aa'i-aa'i se mi dhèu sarani sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, sèna ka madhutu a'aj'a sèra. dhèu cee dhu tao sala, na, pad'elo j'ara be'a hia ne. dhèu bisa boe pahaha èu, lula èu dènge hak ho tao paie rèngu.

source_text: remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu sarani sèra, ho nanene dhèu paredha aa dhèu-dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. rèngu hud'i madhutu ku atora sèra. aa rèngu hud'i pa'èra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
target_text: baku lasi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. baku d'èi pasibha d'ara lii. be'a risi, mamuri mola, dènge d'ara hua iia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures-living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
target_text: te uru èèna, lod'o èdhi tadhe mèka lamatua yesus, èdhi te'a boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dènge mud'a lèke tipu. èdhi to'o boe nanene dhèu leo. èdhi dhoka mamuri madhutu d'ara bhelu di, ka èki ngi'u èdhi dènge rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ti. èdhi d'ara karehe dènge dhèu leo. èdhi mamuri dhoka dènge jeluus. èdhi d'èi tèka d'ara mi dhèu leo, hèia ra kab'èli tèka d'ara dènge èdhi.

source_text: but when the kindness of god our savior and his love for mankind appeared,
target_text: masi ka mamuri èdhi ne ele iie le, te ngaa ama lamatua dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, pad'elo le sasue dènge d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èdhi.

source_text: he saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to his mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the holy spirit.
target_text: na hia èdhi mamuri lula boe nèti tatao èdhi dhu be'a, te ngaa lula sasue na mi èdhi. nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi sèra pake roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pahiu mamuri èdhi, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi.

source_text: this is the spirit he poured out on us abundantly through jesus christ our savior,
target_text: lula yesus kristus madhe le ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala sèra, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua hia dènge boe too-lane roh na dhu mola-mèci mi èdhi.

source_text: so that, having been justified by his grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
target_text: lula d'ara hua iia yesus, ka na pabe'a pa'èci èdhi dènge ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana na. hèia èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. se'e se j'aj'i mi pusaka èdhi!

source_text: this saying is trustworthy. and i want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed god will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. these things are excellent and profitable for the people.
target_text: dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a ne, dènge kab'ua hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, èu hud'i pasanèd'e dhèu ho madhutu lii aj'a dhu mola. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, loe boe tenge j'ara sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
target_text: baku soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu leko-monya, nuka sèmi: pasibha d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, patao iia d'ara dènge dhèu leo, patula-pajuku nèti j'aj'aj'i mia dhu dedha risi, aa patao nèti atora ad'a yahudi. tao ngaa? sèra sa aa'i-aa'i, èci sa gaguna na aad'o. pèci eele lod'o iia d'ara!

source_text: reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
target_text: lamu holo dhèu dhu tema pamae juma'at sèra. ladhe nèngu tao taruu, kai ne. aa ladhe na loe boe, soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, ngangee na mola heka. nèti tatao unu na ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a mèu sasala na.

source_text: as soon as i send artemas or tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at nicopolis, because i have decided to winter there.
target_text: ja'a neo hia artemas do tikikus, dhiu paraga dènge èu asa pulu kreta. ladhe na d'ai, èu tenge j'ara sèna ka mai lai-lai paraga dènge ja'a ètu kota nikopolis. te ja'a neo pea ètu nèi d'ara hèru pacuhi ne.

source_text: do your best to equip zenas the lawyer and apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
target_text: èu tadhe le dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu hukum, ngara na senas, aa angalai na apolos, do? ra neo lasi asa era kaj'èu. de mu bara si, sèna ka ra baku kura ngaa-ngaa ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
target_text: te dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus baku madhèdi iia d'ara di. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a, aa bara dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a parluu. dènge sèmi èèna, mamuri ra dènge kab'ua.

source_text: all who are with me send you greetings. greet those who love us in the faith. grace be with all of you.
target_text: titus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e pa'adhu lii maho'o hia èu. aa hia kahèi mi angalai ji'i dhu sama-sama parcaya lamatua yesus. ja'a sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, a prisoner of christ jesus, and timothy our brother, to philemon our beloved fellow worker,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. angalai ja'a, timotius, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèna ka èu me'a, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne, lula ja'a peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, pilmon, dhu ji'i sue, aa dhu j'aj'i angalai ètu d'ara sasab'a;

source_text: to apphia our sister, to archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
target_text: hia ina apfia, dhu ji'i tadhe nuka sèmi ana hèni ji'i; hia arkipus, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a ne'e; dènge hia juma'at dhu tema sabaj'a sama-sama ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi dedha miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: i always thank my god, remembering you in my prayers,
target_text: pilmon! lod'o-lod'o dhu ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula mamuri èu.

source_text: because i hear about your faith in the lord jesus and your love for all the saints.
target_text: te ja'a tadèngi ae le nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus, dènge sasue èu mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya.

source_text: i pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in christ.
target_text: lula lalèka èu, èu bisa mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu parcaya dhu leo sèra. ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ho ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a miu èci dènge èci, miu bisa me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu èdhi bisa tao hia lamatua yesus.

source_text: i take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
target_text: sasue èu èèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ja'a, aa pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. aa sasue èu èèna ka, pa'èra kahèi d'ara dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: so although in christ i am bold enough to order you to do what is proper, i prefer to appeal on the basis of love. for i, paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of christ jesus as well.
target_text: a'a, ee! ja'a parluu ciki, sèmi ne'e: ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dènge hak kahèi ho paredha èu, sèna ka tao j'ara ne'e. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe tao paredha di, dhoka neo manèngi èu bantu di, nuka sèmi dhèu heka dhu to'a mi dedha èu. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho lula madhutu yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka ja'a bani manèngi èu soru-bara ja'a, lula ja'a ke'a sasue èu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: i appeal to you for my child onesimus, whose father i became while i was in chains.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pad'elo sasue èu mi ana ja'a, onesimus. nèngu èèna, nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, te nèngu parcaya yesus nèti sasab'a ja'a, ropa ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne.

source_text: formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, onesimus ne, ènu èu dhu rai nèti èu. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna nèngu dhu laku boe ètu katanga madha èu. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a parcaya nèngu nèti gaguna ae-ae hia èdhi dua ti.

source_text: i am sending back to you him who is my very heart.
target_text: ja'a sue ne titu kèna. te ngaa hud'i laa, ja'a pua na lèpa hari asa èu.

source_text: i would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, na, ja'a taha onesimus sèna ka gati èu, ho nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e. te ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho ne. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, lula peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus.

source_text: but i did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe sèna ka èu sad'i madhutu di, ladhe èu rasa dhèu laka-seti èu. dad'èi ja'a, na, èu tao dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi èu unu mu. de ladhe èu mo'o mèka sèmi dènge be'a lii manèngi ja'a, na, ja'a ko'o boe tao ngaa ciki sa mi onesimus ne, lula dhu hak dhoka èu di.

source_text: for perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good-
target_text: ele boe èu pangee sèmi ne'e: lamatua soro tèke onesimus ele nèti èu d'ara ciki oo'e ne, sèna ka na mai hari ho pea taruu dènge èu.

source_text: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. he is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the lord.
target_text: lod'o na rai èèna, nèngu dhoka j'aj'i dhèu ènu èu di. te ngaa ladhe nèngu lèpa hari dhiu, nèngu j'aj'i mi ari pasue èu. ja'a sue ne titu kèna kahèi. de ne'e ne, gaguna na hia mi èu asa tabha. te nèngu ne mesa boe j'aj'i ènu èu di, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i kahèi ari dhu sama-sama parcaya kristus.

source_text: so if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka. ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne angalai èu ètu d'ara sasab'a èci, na, ja'a manèngi ho èu sèmi more nèngu, nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu dhiu èèna.

source_text: but if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe onesimus tao nèdhi sala mi dedha èu, do, na pakèlu era, hud'i laa pe ja'a ka tago kore.

source_text: i, paul, write this with my own hand. i will repay it-not to mention that you owe me your very self.
target_text: ladhe laa! sasuri pakèlu ne, ja'a suri unu ku. ja'a, paulus, èèna na b'ae pama'ète kèlu onesimus mi pilmon. d'ai le, sina ma? de ja'a parluu heka pasanèd'e, na, èu pakèlu ja'a ae risi. te èu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, lula ja'a.

source_text: yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the lord. refresh my heart in christ.
target_text: lèke kèna! hud'i laa sèna ka èu bantu ja'a ètu j'ara ne'e, lula èdhi pa'a'ari ètu d'ara lamatua. pakarej'e d'ara ja'a sèmi èèna, lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama dhèu unu kristus.

source_text: confident of your obedience, i write to you, knowing that you will do even more than i ask.
target_text: pilmon! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, lula ja'a parcaya èu bisa taru kira mi ja'a dènge be'a. ja'a rasa, èèna na èu tao risi nèti ngaa dhu ja'a sanao.

source_text: in the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because i hope that through your prayers i will be restored to you.
target_text: j'ara èci era. sadia ku kama èci hia ja'a. te ja'a parcaya lamatua tadèngi lii sabaj'a miu, aa pe na bhoke j'ara ho kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara bui, sèna ka dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu ètu nèi.

source_text: epaphras, my fellow prisoner in christ jesus, sends you greetings,
target_text: epapras ètu ne'e. nèngu j'aj'i dhèu bui kahèi, lula nèngu lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus kristus sèmi ja'a kahèi. na pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia èu.

source_text: as do mark, aristarchus, demas, and luke, my fellow workers.
target_text: markus, aristarkus, demas, dènge lukas ètu ne'e kahèi. sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. rèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace of the lord jesus christ be with your spirit.
target_text: ja'a manèngi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka! saloom, paulus

source_text: on many past occasions and in many different ways, god spoke to our fathers through the prophets.
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua pake dhèu rèti lii padhai na, ho padhai lii dènge bèi-baki èdhi dhèu ibrani. nèngu pake rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka peka pahari-pahari dènge rèngu.

source_text: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom he made the universe.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, na pua le ana na mai, sèna ka padhai lii dènge èdhi. karèi nèti uru-uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua hag'e nare le ana na, ho nèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i, ana na dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: the son is the radiance of god's glory and the exact representation of his nature, upholding all things by his powerful word. after he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the majesty on high.
target_text: ana lamatua ne, pad'elo dadedha ama na, nuka sèmi saraa madha lod'o dhu lèke tèru. te nèngu ne, ca ropa dènge ama na. aa nèti lii holo-nori na dhu èra titu kèna, na pakako aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. nèngu bhoke j'ara kahèi, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu, sèna ka ra j'aj'i mola-mèci. hèia na lèpa hari asa sorga, ho madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua, ètu era dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: so he became as far superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.
target_text: ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga mema kapai. te ngaa ana na kapai risi eele nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. kapai dènge dadedha ama lamatua risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i ra. aa kapai dènge dadedha èèna, na pangèd'u le mi ana na. nèti èèna ka, ana na kapai risi eele nèti ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: for to which of the angels did god ever say: you are my son; today i have become your father? or again: i will be his father, and he will be my son?
target_text: ama lamatua peka nèdhi mi ana na, aku nèngu na, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha. ama lamatua, peka kahèi, na, ja'a ne, ama na. aa nèngu ne, ana ja'a. ama lamatua peka dènge ana na sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua peka nèdhi boe sèmi èèna, mi ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: and again, when god brings his firstborn into the world, he says: let all god's angels worship him.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua mai ana na dhu kapai risi eele èèna, na paredha ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga, aku nèngu na, miu ana pajuu aa'i-aa'i! lami ho pakab'ua, aa pahaha iisi mi ana ja'a!

source_text: now about the angels he says: he makes his angels winds, his servants flames of fire.
target_text: ama lamatua padhai lii kahèi mi ana pajuu na ètu sorga, peka na, ja'a tao ana-ana pajuu ja'a ètu sorga, j'aj'i malai sama sèmi lai ngèlu. ja'a tao ènu-ènu ja'a, j'aj'i nuka sèmi ai. ama lamatua peka dènge ra sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhoka ana pua-paleha na di.

source_text: but about the son he says: your throne, o god, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of your kingdom.
target_text: te ngaa mi ana d'èlu na, nèngu peka dhu leo, na, èu ne, ama lamatua. èu, èèna na madhèdi ètu kadera paredha toke d'ai mia-mia. èu èèna na mèd'u koasa, ho paredha dènge d'ara mola.

source_text: you have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore god, your god, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
target_text: d'ara èu karej'e, ladhe mèdhi dhèu dhu mamuri mola. te ngaa d'ara mu susa, ladhe mèdhi dhèu dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu karej'e, ka ja'a pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu èu, ho ded'e èu j'aj'i dhèu aae, dhu risi nèti dhèu aae leo sèra.

source_text: and: in the beginning, o lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
target_text: ama lamatua peka mi ana na kahèi, na, ana, ee! èu ne, kètu dhu mèd'u paredha karèi nèti uru ka. èu ne'e ka dhu pua liru j'aj'i, hèia na j'aj'i dènge. èu ne'e ka dhu paredha rai-haha, hèia na j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: they will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. you will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but you remain the same, and your years will never end.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a liru dènge rai-haha laho aa'i si. bèli-camèd'a liru dènge rai-haha ele aa'i si. te ngaa èu mesa mu, mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna na èu core eele liru dènge rai-haha, nuka sèmi dhèu core eele kaha'i soho dhasi. bèli-camèd'a èu gati eele liru aa rai-haha, nuka sèmi dhèu silu mèdha-papake hiu. te ngaa èu mesa mu sèmi boe èèna. lula èu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: yet to which of the angels did god ever say: sit at my right hand until i make your enemies a footstool for your feet?
target_text: ama lamatua peka kahèi dènge ana na, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai madhèdi asa era dhu kab'ua titu kèna, ètu baboa g'ana ja'a ne. pe ja'a tao musu èu sèra, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. ama lamatua peka-padhai mi ana na sèmi èèna, te ngaa na padhai lii nèdhi boe sèmi èèna mi ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
target_text: ana pajuu na sèra mema panting. te nèngu paleha si lasi lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na nèngu patabuli eele si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana ama lamatua risi nèti rèngu era.

source_text: we must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra ngaa dhu èdhi tadèngi le nèti j'ara-j'ara ana ama lamatua, sèna ka èdhi baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: for if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,
target_text: lod'o uru-uru sèra, lamatua pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho lole lii moa na mi bèi-baki èdhi. te'a boe na, lii moa sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lèke. ladhe ra sisu paredha na, rèngu tatu abhu huku dhu palèke dènge tatao ra.

source_text: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? this salvation was first announced by the lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him,
target_text: mema uru èèna, sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ana ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hiu, sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu rai-haha. na peka le j'ara mamuri dhu be'a aae ne mi dhèu unu na dhu pakako sasab'a na ètu rai-haha ne. hèia ra peka dènge èdhi, sèna ka èdhi parcaya. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pusi-pahae boe, dui tare pala ti!

source_text: and was affirmed by god through signs, wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the holy spirit distributed according to his will.
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa kahèi, sèna ka ra tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na papuru roh na mi rèngu kahèi, ho ra ad'u-ue j'ara-j'ara leo dhu madhutu dad'èi na. nèti èèna ka èdhi te'a, na, aa'i-aa'i se j'ara mamuri dhu lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: for it is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
target_text: ja'a lole lula-nèti rai-haha rupa hiu dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. te ngaa ama lamatua peka nèdhi boe dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga, na, pe rèngu ka dhu ator rai-haha hiu èèna. te dhu lalau ka, dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: but somewhere it is testified in these words: what is man that you are mindful of him, or the son of man that you care for him?
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, daud dhu karèi nèdhi le kab'ua nèti dhèu rai-haha, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! nga tao ka ama tao madha-dhilu mi dhèu rai-haha? nga tao ka ama sue si? te rèngu dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di!

source_text: you made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor
target_text: te ngaa lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, ka rèngu oe sèmi ana pajuu ètu sorga. lamatua pakab'ua si hèi, aa ded'e si,

source_text: and placed everything under his feet. when god subjected all things to him, he left nothing outside of his control. yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.
target_text: ho ra paredha aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i. de madhutu sasuri daud, ama lamatua ded'e dhèu rai-haha j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka ra uri aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i. te ngaa èdhi tèdhi mèka na, dhèu rai-haha èci sa dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna.

source_text: but we see jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of god he might taste death for everyone.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca dhèu dhu bisa paredha aa'i-aa'i se. nèngu èèna, nuka yesus. na mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu pasae j'aj'èra, ka na madhe hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu rai-haha. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri ne, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha, sèna ka na paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nare sèra.

source_text: in bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for god, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
target_text: de lèke, ladhe ama lamatua hia yesus pasae j'aj'èra, ho yesus bisa bhoke j'ara mamuri pala mi dhèu rai-haha. te ama lamatua neo sèna ka dhèu ae bisa mamuri bera-bera dènge nèngu ètu sorga. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, mamuri lula nèngu ka.

source_text: for both the one who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. so jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
target_text: ama lamatua tatu sèmi nare si dènge be'a dhèu dhu yesus tao mola-mèci, ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. ama lamatua èèna, ama nèti yesus. dènge sèmi èèna, yesus dènge rèngu, ca ama. nèti èèna ka, yesus makae boe paroa mi dhèu se'e, na, miu se, a'ari ja'a.

source_text: he says: i will proclaim your name to my brothers; i will sing your praises in the assembly.
target_text: te yesus peka le dènge ama na, ja'a neo peka dènge a'ari ja'a, lula-nèti babe'a ama! ja'a neo sod'a ètu talora aae rèngu, lula-nèti dadedha ama!

source_text: and again: i will put my trust in him. and once again: here am i, and the children god has given me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sarai-maena mi ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia. hèia yesus peka hari, na, ladhe ku! ja'a ka ne'e, sama-sama dènge ana-ana ama lamatua, dhu na pangèd'u le mi ja'a, ho uri si.

source_text: now since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity, so that by his death he might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
target_text: lula ana-ana lamatua se, dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèti èèna ka yesus hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu kahèi. te nèngu hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku dhèu rai-haha, heka na bisa madhe. ho nèti mamadhe na, heka nèngu bisa parame nare koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae bhabhelu-katub'a ne'e ka dhu nèd'u koasa, ho uri j'ara-j'ara dhu pa'èki dènge mamadhe.

source_text: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
target_text: aa nèngu kahèi tao dhèu rai-haha madha'u dènge mamadhe, toke ra madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi ènu sa. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus bisa patalale le dhèu rai-haha nèti d'ara madha'u.

source_text: for surely it is not the angels he helps, but the descendants of abraham.
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka yesus mai boe ho soru-bara ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga. te ngaa na mai sèna ka soru nare èdhi, nuka ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: for this reason he had to be made like his brothers in every way, so that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to god, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus j'aj'i sama sèmi èdhi, dhu j'aj'i le a'ari na. dènge j'ara ne'e nèngu j'aj'i mi kètu agama èdhi dhu kapai risi eele, ho soru-bara èdhi sèna ka madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi èdhi. aa ladhe na peka ngaa, na tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. uru èèna, bèi-baki èdhi manèngi kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, sèna ka tao korban, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. limuri ne, yesus mesa na ka dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala èdhi.

source_text: because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
target_text: lod'o yesus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae. abhu kahèi dhu dadugu ne, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu manahu boe. nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi, sèna ka tao sasala, yesus ka dhu bisa soru-bara èdhi ho baku manahu.

source_text: therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, a'ari! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, aa cap miu dhèu d'ara mola, sèna ka èèna na miu mamuri bera-bera dènge ne ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee ku pabe'a-be'a lula-nèti yesus ne. te èdhi dhu mangaku le, na, nèngu ne dhèu pajuu-paleha ama lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi kètu kapai risi agama èdhi.

source_text: he was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as moses was faithful in all god's house.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua yesus mai, yesus tao madhutu aa'i dad'èi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, nèngu nuka sèmi musa. te musa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua kahèi, lod'o na ladhe-leru bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra.

source_text: for jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti musa. te yesus sama sèmi lamatua èmu. aa mema lèke, lula lamatua èmu kapai risi nèti ana pua-paleha ètu d'ara èmu.

source_text: and every house is built by someone, but god is the builder of everything.
target_text: dhèu èci-èci ka pa'uri d'ara èmu na. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu uri aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: now moses was faithful as a servant in all god's house, testifying to what would be spoken later.
target_text: de musa tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lod'o na j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti isi èmu lamatua. te lod'o èèna, na peka mema le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua neo tao.

source_text: but christ is faithful as the son over god's house. and we are his house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
target_text: masi ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu ana pua-paleha dhu sama boe sèmi musa. lula nèngu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka pua mai asa rai-haha ne. aa kristus ne'a mèu uri isi èmu ama na. de ladhe èdhi kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, aa ma'ète boe sanao-maena èdhi mi kristus, èdhi bisa j'aj'i isi èmu na kahèi.

source_text: therefore, as the holy spirit says: today, if you hear his voice,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pasa dhilu paie-iie, ho nanene pabe'a ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka, na, doe ne'e, ropa miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua,

source_text: do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness,
target_text: mage miu kètu hadhu, sama sèmi dhèu sèra, dhu lasi-mai èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a. te rèngu ro'o heka puai-pahae musa, toke ama lamatua mesa na oe taha nare heka d'ara na.

source_text: where your fathers tested and tried me, and for forty years saw my works. therefore i was angry with that generation, and i said, ‘their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways. '
target_text: pangee ku laa! èpa nguru tèu kateme ja'a tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha ra! te ngaa ra loe boe sèku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a nasa dènge ra, peka na, ‘miu se, seli-kolane! te miu soro kabodho tèke eele j'ara ja'a, ho madhutu j'ara miu dhu koe-kapengo! '

source_text: so i swore on oath in my anger, ‘they shall never enter my rest. '
target_text: ropa kèdhi bhabhelu miu, ja'a ru'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo miu, peka na, ‘miu bisa boe mai ho ae mere d'ara mi, sama-sama dènge ja'a. '

source_text: see to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living god.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu tao bhelu, toke nèngu parcaya heka, hèia na soro kabodho mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: but exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin's deceitfulness.
target_text: be'a risi bèli-bèli miu pa'èra d'ara, èci dènge èci. baku pamata ia ka! lula miu dhu malai lèke tipu ka tao sasala, toke miu kètu hadhu aa pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua.

source_text: we have come to share in christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
target_text: èdhi bisa pa'angalai dènge yesus kristus, sad'i baku pama'ète sanao mi nèngu, nuka sèmi ropa èdhi heka parcaya nèngu.

source_text: as it has been said: today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, peka le kahèi, na, doe ne'e, ladhe miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua, miu baku kètu hadhu sama sèmi dhèu se'e se, dhu lasi-mai toke èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a, te rèngu lab'a musa.

source_text: for who were the ones who heard and rebelled? were they not all those moses led out of egypt?
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: cee ka dhu uru èèna nanene musa, hèia ra pusi-pahae heka ne? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi dhu musa lere si nèti rai masir.

source_text: and with whom was god angry for forty years? was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
target_text: aa dhèu cee ka dhu tao d'ara ama lamatua pana magoro d'ai èpa nguru tèu èèna? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi. te mamuri ra koe-kapengo ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, toke ra madhe, ka padhane si ètu nèi.

source_text: and to whom did he swear that they would never enter his rest? was it not to those who disobeyed?
target_text: aa cee ka dhu lèke kutuk nèti ama lamatua, toke bisa boe maso asa rai èèna, sèna ka ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge lamatua? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi. te rèngu se ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua.

source_text: so we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
target_text: de me'a le, si? bèi-baki èdhi bisa boe maso asa d'ara rai èèna, ho ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge ama lamatua, lula ra parcaya boe ne.

source_text: therefore, while the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi hud'i pangee madhera ku, lula lamatua dhu pajaji era, na, dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge nèngu. de mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu tule eele lii pajaji lamatua ne.

source_text: for we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.
target_text: te èdhi dhu tadèngi le lii lolo be'a, sama sèmi bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra tadèngi. te ngaa, lula rèngu lèka boe lii èèna, rèngu abhu boe oto ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: now we who have believed enter that rest. as for the others, it is just as god has said: so i swore on oath in my anger, ‘they shall never enter my rest. ' and yet his works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parcaya, èdhi bisa ae tare d'ara bera-bera dènge ama lamatua. te uru èèna, nèngu dhu pajaji le dènge bèi-baki èdhi, te ngaa lula na nasa, hèia na peka dènge ra, na, ja'a taha heka ladhe kèdhi tatao bhabhelu miu ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo miu, peka na, ‘miu bisa boe maso, ho ae mere d'ara sama-sama dènge ja'a. ' aa te ngaa èdhi te'a le, na, lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, nèngu ator nare le, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara, ho mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: for somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: and on the seventh day god rested from all his works.
target_text: ètu lii lolo nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, dhu suri, ama lamatua ae nare d'ara, peka na, lamatua sab'a nare aa'i le, hèia asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu, na ae nare d'ara.

source_text: and again, as he says in the passage above: they shall never enter my rest.
target_text: aa dhu suri ètu era leo hari, ama lamatua peka dènge bèi-baki èdhi, na, miu bisa heka maso, ho ae mere d'ara mi sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: since, then, it remains for some to enter his rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,
target_text: de dad'èi ama lamatua ka, dhèu unu na ae rare d'ara ra sèna ka mamuri sama-sama dènge ne. te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi dhu tadèngi uuru lii lolo be'a ne, rèngu bisa boe maso, lula rèngu tao boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: god again designated a certain day as today, when a long time later he spoke through david as was just stated: today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, lamatua hag'e nare lod'o èci, sèna ka dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge nèngu. te na pake daud ho padhai lii, peka na, doe ne'e, ladhe miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua, mage miu tao d'ara mi adhu sèmi hadhu, te ngaa nanene paie-iie.

source_text: for if joshua had given them rest, god would not have spoken later about another day.
target_text: lod'o daud peka na, doe ne'e, nèngu paj'uj'u boe asa lod'o dhu yosua lere ana-èpu nèti bèi-baki se asa rai kana'an. te lod'o daud padhai lii ne, rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe nèbhu le.

source_text: there remains, then, a sabbath rest for the people of god.
target_text: nèti èèna ka èdhi te'a, na, lamatua ator le lod'o dhu leo èci, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra, ho mamuri pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for whoever enters god's rest also rests from his own work, just as god did from his.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu maso le sèna ka ae nare d'ara na sama-sama dènge ama lamatua, nèngu dhu ae nare le nèti sasab'a-la'a na, sama sèmi lamatua kahèi ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu.

source_text: let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.
target_text: de bori pa'èra ho miu bisa maso ae mere d'ara, sèna ka mamuri sama-sama dènge ama lamatua. mage dhoka abhu dhu j'aj'i boe maso, lula nèngu nanene boe lii holo-nori lamatua, cakaraa bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: for the word of god is living and active. sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. it judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
target_text: te lii holo-nori ama lamatua ka dhu paj'uj'u j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii se'e dhu dènge koasa ho maso asa d'ara èdhi, sèna ka pasoro ngangee dènge dad'èi èdhi aa'i-aa'i. te lii holo-nori se, dhu madèka titu kèna, risi nèti hela madèka dhu bisa sabhi eele isi, aa j'ue eele kalua dènge sèg'i rui, sèna ka pasabhoka aa'i.

source_text: nothing in all creation is hidden from god's sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, abhu boe èci sa dhu pahuni nèti ama lamatua, te nèngu bisa nèdhi aa'i mèu-mèu. aa bèli-camèd'a èdhi hud'i lati asa katanga madha na, sèna ka ti dhaa aa'i, ngaa dhu èdhi ad'u-ue.

source_text: therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, jesus the son of god, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
target_text: èdhi hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, lula ana ama lamatua, yesus, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. te nèngu ètu le madha ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka sarii èdhi.

source_text: for we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
target_text: na bisa sarii èdhi dènge be'a, lula ne'a, èdhi dhèu rai-haha biasa. ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi ho tao sala, na, èdhi manahu malai. yesus abhu dadugu-rariu kahèi sama sèmi èdhi, te ngaa na manahu nèdhi boe.

source_text: let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mai ti pabani d'ara ho ara lati asa madha ama lamatua dhu ètu kadera paredha na. te nèngu ne, d'ara hua iia. de ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi nèngu, tatu na neo pad'elo rasa kasia na, ho soru-bara èdhi lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to god, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
target_text: dhèu dhu ded'e rare j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, sasab'a na, hud'i soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka rèngu pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèngu hud'i sèmi nare ku mèdha persembahan dènge badha korban, ho saraka asa lamatua. nèngu kahèi hia badha korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu.

source_text: he is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided, since he himself is beset by weakness.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, do dhèu dhu rai eele nèti j'ara èèna, kètu agama ne pasusa boe rèngu. nèti d'ara hua iia na, nèngu lii mako dènge ra, lula nèngu kahèi dhèu rai-haha dhu mud'a manahu, sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: that is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
target_text: lula nèngu kahèi dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu, nèti èèna ka kètu agama ne hud'i hia badha korban, ho lamatua saku pamèu sasala nèngu mesa na.

source_text: no one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by god, just as aaron was.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe ded'e iisi na, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te dhoka ama lamatua di dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hag'e nare dhèu sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra na ded'e harun, a'a musa.

source_text: so also christ did not take upon himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but he was called by the one who said to him: you are my son; today i have become your father.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kristus. na ded'e boe iisi na, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te uru èèna, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu ded'e ne, peka na, èu ne, ana ja'a, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha.

source_text: and in another passage god says: you are a priest forever in the order of melchizedek.
target_text: ètu era leo nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu suri kahèi, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama dhu ca ropa dènge ca dhèu dhu mamuri uru èèna, nuka melkisedek, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: during the days of jesus' earthly life, he offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverence.
target_text: ètu lod'o oe èle mamuri yesus ètu rai-haha ne, na loe boe sabaj'a dènge tangi d'ara pèd'a, manèngi ama lamatua sèna ka hia ne a'èra. te ne'a, na, koasa lamatua bisa hia ne mamuri. hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi yesus, lula na madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: although he was a son, he learned obedience from what he suffered.
target_text: te yesus ne, ana ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra, ho ne'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and having been made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey him
target_text: èle èèna ka, na tao madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i le kapua mamuri bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, ho mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and was designated by god as high priest in the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te lamatua ded'e nare le yesus j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama uru sèra.

source_text: we have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
target_text: j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus dènge melkisedek, te ngaa ako carui paled'a j'ara se'e, lula miu nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu me'a mèu mèka dènge be'a.

source_text: although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of god's word. you need milk, not solid food!
target_text: aa te ngaa, miu dhu parcaya nèbhu le. madhutu iia-iia na, miu j'aj'i le mese ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo. te ngaa te'a boe na, miu cakaraa ana rara iisi hiu, dhu ne'a mèka na'a, te ne'a dhoka ninu susu di. miu parluu dhèu era ho aj'a miu lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu carui mèka nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
target_text: ja'a pakasame miu dènge ana rara iisi hiu, lula miu me'a mèka j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe nèti kristus, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: but solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o ana iiki ne kapai, nèngu ninu heka susu, te ngaa na'a nganga'a dhu sakaa. èèna èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu aj'a ne toke ne'a mèu a'aj'a lamatua, sèna ka ne'a mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe.

source_text: therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in god,
target_text: de miu hud'i aj'a paie-iie ku a'aj'a dhu carui risi, lula miu dhu aj'a nèbhu ae le a'aj'a dhu carui mèka lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka limuri ne, baku dhoka aj'a pahari-pahari a'aj'a dhu carui mèka sèra, nuka sèmi: dhèu hud'i tèke eele ku sasala rèngu aa'i-aa'i; a'aj'a lula-nèti dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ama lamatua;

source_text: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
target_text: a'aj'a lula-nèti sarani; a'aj'a lula-nèti bane ai mi dhèu sèna ka dhèu èèna sèmi nare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci; a'aj'a lula-nèti ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu nèti mamadhe ra; aa a'aj'a dhu èèna na dhèu lasi asa katanga madha lamatua, ho sèmi rare lii pama'ète, dhu peka na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, aa cee ka dhu bisa boe.

source_text: and this we will do, if god permits.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua hia ijin, na, èdhi j'aj'i heka ana iiki dhu te'a dhoka tinu susu di. te ja'a neo aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu carui risi hari.

source_text: it is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the holy spirit, who have tasted the goodness of the word of god and the powers of the coming age- and then have fallen away-to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the son of god all over again and subjecting him to open shame.
target_text: aa te ngaa, abhu le dhèu dhu re'a mèu lii a'aj'a kristus, aa dhu rasa le d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, toke na hia si roh na dhu mola-mèci. rèngu re'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, aa rasa le koasa na dhu na neo pake lod'o èle rai-haha ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu se tèke eele le parcaya ra, aa ra soro kabodho mi kristus. nèti èèna ka, bisa heka abhu j'ara ho rèngu bisa lèpa hari manèngi abho, sèna ka mamuri pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te ladhe dhèu ro'o boe ele-ho'a, èèna sama sèmi rèngu ka dhu paku pamadhe hari ana ama lamatua ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra nyanyèi ne ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: for land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of god.
target_text: dhèu sèmi sèra, èci èèna ka dènge rai dhu hèu mèngi boe, nèti èèna ka abhu boe hua-hela dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe abhu ka èj'i, rai dhu hèu mèngi bisa hia hua-hela dhu dènge guna mi lamatua oka. hèia ama lamatua papuru mamèngi-nale, sèna ka hua-hela nèti rai ne asa tabha ae.

source_text: but land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. in the end it will be burned.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi kristus, nuka sèmi rai dhu pènu dènge dhudhu dènge sete di. aa dhudhu-sete se guna boe mi ngaa-ngaa èci sa. nèbhu boe, ama lamatua mai ho huku rai èèna. hèia na labhu pakèpu aa'i dhudhu dènge sete se, dhu gaguna ra aad'o.

source_text: even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case-things that accompany salvation.
target_text: a'ari pasue! masi ka ja'a ako padhai lii bia ciki, te ngaa ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, miu rai eele boe kristus. te miu parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri miu kahèi abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: for god is not unjust. he will not forget your work and the love you have shown for his name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
target_text: de sanèd'e, te d'ara ama lamatua mola, aa na bhèlu boe èi kabhèsu miu. te miu sab'a bia le, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu unu na sèra, aa mi sue si. mema karèi nèti uru ka, miu pakako le sasab'a na. aa miu pakako taruu sasab'a na era.

source_text: we want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.
target_text: te limuri ne, ja'a d'èi ladhe miu sab'a èra risi hari, sèna ka tao madhutu taruu toke pa'èle. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere babe'a aa'i-aa'i dhu miu sanao nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
target_text: sad'i miu baku bai-eed'a! miu hud'i laladhe nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu le mi ama lamatua. te rèngu tino sanao-maena mi nèngu, toke ra sèmi rare aa'i dhu lamatua pajaji le.

source_text: when god made his promise to abraham, since he had no one greater to swear by, he swore by himself, saying, i will surely bless you and multiply your descendants. and so abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise. men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.
target_text: conto nuka sèmi abraham. uru èèna, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ne pake lii subha. ladhe dhèu rai-haha ded'e subha, nèngu tema pake kolongara ama lamatua, sèna ka lamatua j'aj'i sakasii na, lula lamatua risi nèti nèngu. aa ladhe paraga dènge lii langu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, lii dhu dhèu ne peka èèna lèke tare'a, lula na subha pake kolongara ama lamatua. èèna mema j'ara dhèu rai-haha kèna. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e subha dènge abraham, lamatua pake kolongara nèngu unu na, lula abhu boe dhu risi nèti nèngu. na jaji, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale ae-ae, mi èu dènge ana-èpu mu, bèli-camèd'a rèngu bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu bisa boe ige rare si. ama lamatua padadha nare sèmi èèna, hèia abraham parcaya, aa sanao-maena taruu mi lamatua, masi ka d'ai nèbhu ae ku, heka sèmi nare ngaa dhu lamatua pajaji sèra.

source_text: so when god wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, he guaranteed it with an oath.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, èdhi te'a, ladhe lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge dhèu unu na, nèngu pa'èki lii pajaji ne pake subha, ho j'aj'i mi tate'a, ngaa dhu na moa èèna, mema lèke aa ub'a boe.

source_text: thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for god to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
target_text: te abhu dua j'ara dhu bisa boe ub'a. ka èci, nuka lii pajaji ama lamatua. aa èci hari, nuka lii subha lamatua, dhu na pake j'aj'i mi tate'a nèti lii pajaji na. de ladhe ama lamatua dhu moa le j'ara èci, tatu na tao madhutu, lula nèngu bisa boe omo koso. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku pangee rupa-rupa dènge lii pajaji na. èdhi dhu rai lati le, sèna ka tenge mamuri nèti nèngu, de limuri ne, èdhi dhoka mate di, ho sanao dhoka mi nèngu di.

source_text: we have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. it enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara èdhi taleo nuka sèmi koha dhu rai eele nèti d'ara rii, ho la'e panahu ètu hèb'a-namo. te era maena èdhi dhoka kristus di, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. uru èèna, lèke dènge lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, kètu kapai risi agama rèngu maso asa kama luri mola-mèci re bèla gorden, sèna ka paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: where jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. he has become a high priest forever in the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, yesus dhu la'e uuru le, ho bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. te nèngu kètu kapai risi agama kahèi, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna. te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti kètu agama uru èèna, lula na ae nèdhi boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: this melchizedek was king of salem and priest of god most high. he met abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him, and abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. first, his name means king of righteousness. then also, king of salem means king of peace. without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the son of god, he remains a priest for all time.
target_text: uru èèna, melkisedek j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. nèngu kahèi kètu agama nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna. ngara melkisedek ne, sasoa na, dhèu aae d'ara mola. aa dhèu aae salem, sasoa na, dhèu aae dame. èci sa re'a boe j'aj'aj'i melkisedek ne nèti mia. èci sa re'a boe kahèi ina dènge ama na, aa bèi-baki na. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a lod'o rara iisi na, aa lod'o mamadhe na. dhèu re'a dhoka, nèngu dhèu aae kota salem, aa kètu agama nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ana ama lamatua, lula nèngu ama agama dhu pakako taruu sasab'a na kahèi. ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu aae dènge sordad'u ra mai parame rèti mèdha-panyau angalai abraham. ka abraham dènge angalai na lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae se, toke abraham segi si. hèia mèdha-panyau nèti angalai na sèra, abraham nèti aa'i hari. ropa abraham lèpa asa rai na, hèia melkisedek kalua nèti kota salem, ho la'e soru ne. ka na hia abraham berkat, peka na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale. èle ka abraham hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu na parame nare hari sèra. abraham pabagi hia ne, lula melkisedek ne kètu agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.

source_text: consider how great melchizedek was: even the patriarch abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
target_text: de pangee paie-iie melkisedek ne! abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a risi dhu na parame nare hari. de dhu lèke, nuka melkisedek ne dhèu kapai.

source_text: now the law commands the sons of levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people-that is, from their brothers-though they too are descended from abraham.
target_text: aa te ngaa lod'o sèra, ama lamatua ded'e mèka dhèu j'aj'i ama agama. toke d'ai ku lod'o lewi, ana-èpu èci nèti abraham, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne dènge ana-èpu na, sèna ka j'aj'i ama agama hia mi ana-èpu abraham aa'i-aa'i ra. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru atora na dhu peka na, dhèu nèti suku lewi dènge hak ho abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra a'ari ra suku leo sèra ètu isra'el.

source_text: but melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from levi, collected a tenth from abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
target_text: te ngaa melkisedek ne, ana-èpu boe nèti lewi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, lula na pangee, na, melkisedek ne dhèu kapai. lod'o èèna abraham dhu sèmi nare le lii pajaji nèti ama lamatua ho hia ne berkat. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa melkisedek peka kahèi, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale.

source_text: and indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.
target_text: ne'e ne ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, melkisedek ne, dhèu kapai. lula dhèu dhu hia berkat tatu kapai risi nèti dhèu dhu sèmi nare berkat.

source_text: in the case of the levites, mortal men collect the tenth; but in the case of melchizedek, it is affirmed that he lives on.
target_text: ama agama aa'i-aa'i ra dènge hak abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala. te ngaa, lula rèngu dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèbhu-nèbhu ra madhe kahèi. kètu agama melkisedek abhu kahèi ca pala nèti canguru pala. te ngaa na mamuri taruu, lula sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka boe na, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and so to speak, levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through abraham. for when melchizedek met abraham, levi was still in the loin of his ancestor.
target_text: lula abraham bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti mèdha na sèra, dhèu bisa pangee, na, abraham tago nare kahèi ana-èpu na dhu rara iisi mèka. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èdhi bisa pangee, na, nèngu b'ae mema le unu ana-èpu na lewi, ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: now if perfection could have been attained through the levitical priesthood for on this basis the people received the law, why was there still need for another priest to appear-one in the order of melchizedek and not in the order of aaron?
target_text: lod'o ana-èpu lewi sèra j'aj'i ama agama, lamatua pili nare harun, a'a musa, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama dhu partama. sasab'a nèti ama agama sèra, nuka soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka mamuri mola, pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. masi ka rèngu mamuri madhutu atora agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, te ngaa kètu agama ca ropa dènge harun, lake nare boe tao dhèu se mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, rèngu parluu kètu agama leo, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek.

source_text: for when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed as well.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kètu agama rupa hiu gati eele kètu agama rupa dhui, tatu atora dhui hud'i gati eele kahèi.

source_text: he of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
target_text: de te'a mèu le, kètu agama rupa hiu èèna, nuka yesus. te rara iisi ne, nèti boe suku lewi, te ngaa nèti suku leo. madhutu atora musa, kètu agama ca ropa dènge harun, dhoka mai nèti suku lewi di, bisa boe nèti suku leo.

source_text: for it is clear that our lord descended from judah, a tribe as to which moses said nothing about priests.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a, na, kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i nèti suku yahuda. madhutu atora musa, abhu mèka dhu j'aj'i kètu agama nèti suku ne'e.

source_text: and this point is even more clear if another priest like melchizedek appears,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pake heka atora dhui, lula abhu le yesus dhu j'aj'i kètu agama rupa hiu, nuka sèmi melkisedek.

source_text: one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.
target_text: te madhutu atora musa, kètu agama rupa dhui hud'i mai ku nèti suku lewi. te ngaa yesus mai boe nèti suku èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu agama rupa hiu, lula nèngu dènge koasa ho mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia, aa abhu boe dhu bisa palaho ne.

source_text: for it is testified: you are a priest forever in the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te sasuri lamatua suri, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: so the former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless
target_text: sasoa na, atora dhui dènge boe koasa, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu rai-haha. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pake heka atora dhui, dhu uru èèna na pangèd'u mi musa.

source_text: for the law made nothing perfect, and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to god.
target_text: te masi ka dhèu mamuri madhutu atora dhui sèra, te ngaa sasala ra era. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara dhu be'a risi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri padame dènge ne.

source_text: and none of this happened without an oath. for others became priests without an oath, but jesus became a priest with an oath by the one who said to him: the lord has sworn and will not change his mind: ‘you are a priest forever. '
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ama lamatua ded'e ana-èpu lewi ho j'aj'i ama agama, lamatua pajaji boe, aa subha boe ngaa-ngaa dènge rèngu. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e yesus j'aj'i kètu agama, na pajaji, peka na, ja'a ne, lamatua! ja'a subha, ja'a ub'a boe ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a pajaji le. ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu agama, sèna ka èu pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a mu.

source_text: because of this oath, jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
target_text: dènge lii pajaji sèmi èèna, ama lamatua pake yesus j'aj'i mi tate'a hia èdhi, dhu peka na, nèngu neo pa'èki lii pajaji dhu be'a risi dènge èdhi.

source_text: now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.
target_text: uru èèna, kètu agama rupa dhui gati taruu, lula ra madhe. nèti èèna ka, hud'i abhu ku kètu agama ae-ae.

source_text: but because jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.
target_text: te ngaa yesus, kètu agama rupa hiu dhu mamuri taa-taa, aa na loe boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe dhèu gati ne.

source_text: therefore he is able to save completely those who draw near to god through him, since he always lives to intercede for them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo mai re nèngu asa madha ama lamatua. nèngu bisa tao sèmi èèna, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. aa nèngu j'aj'i dhèu d'ara, dhu loe boe manèngi ama lamatua ho soru-bara rèngu.

source_text: such a high priest truly befits us-one who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
target_text: yesus kètu kapai risi agama dhu lalau-lalo'o èdhi. te nèngu ne, dhèu mola-mèci dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. nèngu ne, sama boe dènge dhèu rai-haha biasa, dhu re'a dhoka ad'u-ue sasala di. te ama lamatua dhu nedhe ne padedha-dedha, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu sorga dènge rai-haha.

source_text: unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for his own sins and then for the sins of the people; he sacrificed for sin once for all when he offered up himself.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus be'a risi nèti kètu agama rupa dhui aa'i-aa'i ra. uru sèra, rèngu bèli-bèli hud'i roro badha tao korban, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu unu ra. èle ku, heka ra tao korban hia dhèu biasa kèna. te ngaa yesus parluu boe tao korban pahari-pahari sèmi èèna, lula na saraka ngi'u na ca tèka èèna ka di, sèna ka j'aj'i korban. ne'e ne d'ai aa'i kèna, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the son, who has been made perfect forever.
target_text: madhutu atora musa, rèngu ded'e dhèu rai-haha biasa ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te ngaa sasala ra era. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tao lii pajaji hiu, peka na, nèngu ded'e ana na j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te ana na, madhutu taruu dad'èi na.

source_text: the point of what we are saying is this: we do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the majesty in heaven,
target_text: de lii padhai ja'a dhu kab'ua, sèmi ne'e ka: limuri ne, èdhi dènge le kètu kapai risi agama dhu be'a risi nèti uru sèra. nèngu ne'e, nuka yesus. nèngu dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu sorga, ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.
