target_text: èu madhutu a'aj'a dhu peka, na, ama lamatua èèna, dhoka nèngu di. dhu leo aad'o. be'a kahèi! te ngaa nidhu sèra be'a risi nèti èu, lula rèngu parcaya sèmi èèna kahèi, toke ra karèbha. de baku ngee, na, te'a dènge dhoka kahadhu di, d'ai le èèna. dhae!

source_text: o foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
target_text: goa, ee! de me'a mèu le, si? parcaya dhu pad'elo boe dènge tatao be'a, gaguna na aad'o kahèi.

source_text: was not our father abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son isaac on the altar?
target_text: tare conto nèti abraham. uru èèna, na sab'a madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua paredha ne, ho nèti ana na isak, sèna ka tao asa dedha mei sogo-tagu ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua peka na, abraham tao le dhu lèke.

source_text: you see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
target_text: abraham parcaya ama lamatua, ka na sèmi nare paredha èèna, hèia na tao madhutu. de èdhi te'a, na, nèngu lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua, lula na tao madhutu lii paredha èèna.

source_text: and the scripture was fulfilled that says, abraham believed god, and it was credited to him as righteousness, and he was called a friend of god.
target_text: de se'e se j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, abraham parcaya ama lamatua, hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare nèngu ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abraham èèna, angalai lamatua.

source_text: as you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
target_text: me'a mèu le, si? èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe parcaya na mi lamatua dhu tao nèngu d'èi sab'a madha j'ara hua iia. te ngaa ladhe dhoka parcaya di, d'ai mèka.

source_text: in the same way, was not even rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
target_text: conto leo, nuka rahab, dhu uru èèna bhèni kajeo. lod'o dhèu kota jeriko tenge neo pamadhe dhèu mata-mata nèti isra'el, rahab ka pahuni si. hèia na pua si rai asa li'u re j'ara leo, sèna ka dhèu jeriko baku kèpe rare si. hèia lamatua sèmi nare ne, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola, lula na tao dhu be'a.

source_text: as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
target_text: parcaya dhu nèti boe hua-hela, èci èèna ka dènge ngi'u dhu dènge boe a'ae. sasoa na, madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a, sèra dhu leko-monya! èèna peka mèka, na, parcaya dhu mamuri.

source_text: not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu dhèu ae dhu neo aj'a-nori dhèu parcaya sèra. be'a kahèi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua parisa toke lutu dhèu dhu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra. de dhèu baku sad'i aj'a di.

source_text: we all stumble in many ways. if anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ae ka padhai lii sala. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha nare hèb'a na, ho baku padhai leli, ne'a kahèi uri mamuri na.

source_text: when we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
target_text: tare conto sèmi jara. èdhi te'a uri jara dhu kapai ho madhutu dad'èi èdhi, dhoka dènge ère rarapa na.

source_text: consider ships as well. although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
target_text: conto leo hari, nuka kapa. ngèlu mèdhu tiu kapa aae madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa uli dhu ana iiki-iiki bisa pod'e kad'uru kapa ne madhutu dad'èi juraga.

source_text: in the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge he'o èdhi. masi ka he'o ana iiki, te ngaa tatao na kapai titu kèna! èèna nuka sèmi he'o ai dhu ana iiki te ngaa bisa tunu eele j'ami dhu kapai aae.

source_text: the tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. it pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
target_text: hèb'a ne nuka sèmi he'o ai. re hèb'a, èdhi bisa pa'ele iie madha j'ara ae-ae. hèb'a èdhi bisa pa'ele iie kateme mamuri èdhi. bhelu-katub'a ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne, mai nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu. aa dhèu aae nidhu pake hèb'a dhèu ho pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: all kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
target_text: dhèu pamau rare rupa-rupa badha hui, badha dhu rod'o re rai, manu-bhui, dènge i'a ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: but no man can tame the tongue. it is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
target_text: te ngaa abhu mèka ca dhèu sa dhu pamau rare he'o na. te he'o ne, mèdha dhu bhelu, dhu uri tare boe. nèngu èci èèna ka dènge raco dhu lale lème d'ara ngi'u, toke pamadhe dhèu.

source_text: with the tongue we bless our lord and father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in god's likeness. out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. my brothers, this should not be!
target_text: dènge hèb'a èèna ka, dhèu koa-kio, aa dhèu padhèd'a. se'e se, lèke boe! èdhi pake hèb'a ho koa-kio ama lamatua. aa dènge hèb'a èèna kahèi, èdhi padhèd'a aapa dhèu dhu lamatua paj'aj'i madhutu rupa na. tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èi ca madha, bisa kalua èi nèta dènge èi sèro.

source_text: my brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.
target_text: bisa boe, sina ma, nèti kanana kalua hua dhimu? aa tarae sina bisa kalua hua anggor? te aj'u ladhe hua na, hua madhutu rupa ra. èci èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe dhui èi nèta nèti dano èi sèro.

source_text: who is wise and understanding among you? let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
target_text: dhèu dhu ngangee madhera, aa ne'a j'ara dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua, baku padedha iisi. te ne'a, mamèu na mai nèti lamatua. hud'i laa nèngu pad'elo mamèu na dènge j'ara mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: but if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth. such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
target_text: baku padedha iisi, peka na, èu dhèu dhu dènge ngangee madhera, ladhe èu tèka d'ara era ho pabèbhe dhèu leo. èci èèna ka èu ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te mamuri sèmi èèna, peka boe, ‘ngangee madhera'. tatao nuka sèmi, tèka d'ara, d'èi pabèbha dhèu, sèra sa mai boe nèti ama lamatua. èèna na tatao dhèu rai-haha. sèra sa lèke mi dhèu dhu soro boe mamuri ra mi ama lamatua. tatao sèra madhutu dad'èi nidhu.

source_text: for where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
target_text: te ladhe tèka d'ara aa d'èi pabèbha dhèu, tatu abhu kahèi patao-palaha dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: but the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
target_text: te ngaa ngangee madhera dhu mai nèti ama lamatua, nuka: dhu tao èdhi mamuri mola, pamau d'ara èdhi, d'èi pa'uru dhèu, taha tare d'ara, dènge lii mako. hua-hela nèti ngangee madhera èèna, nuka: tao èdhi d'ara hua iia, d'èi soru-bara dhèu, bia boe cabèka, aa kapod'e-kabèli boe dhèu leo.

source_text: peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
target_text: dhèu dhu uri padame, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu babe'a. j'ara èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sèle hini, ho nèbhu-nèbhu na puu hua dhu be'a.

source_text: what causes conflicts and quarrels among you? don't they come from the passions at war within you?
target_text: miu loe boe patao-palaha aa pagama èci dènge èci. tasamia ka sèmi èèna? èèna, lula ètu talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu dhoka tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: you crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. you quarrel and fight. you do not have, because you do not ask.
target_text: miu neo ae le abhu mèdha èci, te ngaa ai d'ai boe. hèia mi tèke d'ara, patao-palaha, dènge pagama, toke mangingi boe pamadhe dhèu. lula miu sabaj'a boe, aa manèngi boe nèti lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu abhu boe.

source_text: and when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu sabaj'a toke padhe aj'u-hadhu, miu abhu boe ngaa dhu miu manèngi, lula manèngi madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu di.

source_text: you adulteresses! do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward god? therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of god.
target_text: mema miu satia boe! miu nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali dhu èci pusi-pahae boe èci, aa tao j'ara makae di. ladhe miu pa'angalai dènge dad'èi rai-haha, miu pamusu dènge ama lamatua. j'ara èèna la'e sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: or do you think the scripture says without reason that the spirit he caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, lamatua hia le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. aa madhutu dad'èi roh, èdhi madhutu ne taa-taa. te ama lamatua ne d'ara kura kahèi.

source_text: but he gives us more grace. this is why it says: god opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
target_text: ngaa hari, ama lamatua neo hia tabha hari babe'a d'ara na. ka sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: submit yourselves, then, to god. resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
target_text: de soro iisi mi asa adhe-aai ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu dad'èi na. miu baku madhutu dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. lab'a ne pa'èra-èra; baku golo. dènge sèmi èèna, na rai tèke eele miu.

source_text: draw near to god, and he will draw near to you. cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded. grieve, mourn, and weep. turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu padètu-dètu dènge miu kahèi. wee, miu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara kaj'alu sèra! miu hud'i pamola ku j'ara mamuri miu. aa miu dhu d'ara kajari sèra! miu hud'i kako mola-mola madhutu lamatua, aa baku piku hari g'ana do kariu. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, miu mamuri karae dènge pasoa-pasoka di. de hua iia, ae eele ka! miu me'a le, na, d'ara miu kajari lula sasala-sasigo miu sèra. be'a risi miu ele-ho'a aa tangi dènge d'ara manyasa.

source_text: humble yourselves before the lord, and he will exalt you.
target_text: ladhe tare'a-re'a miu me'a, na, miu dhu nia boe ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na ded'e nare miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu nia ètu madha na.

source_text: brothers, do not slander one another. anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. and if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
target_text: a'ari! baku padhai pakarehe kolongara èci dènge èci. te ladhe miu padhai le sèmi èèna, aa d'èi pèci sasala nèti èci asa èci, miu lab'a le atora nèti lamatua dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku a'ari èu, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. aa ladhe miu madhutu boe atora ne, miu ded'e iisi mi dedha risi nèti atora ama lamatua.

source_text: there is only one lawgiver and judge, the one who is able to save and destroy. but who are you to judge your neighbor?
target_text: dhodhoka lamatua mesa na dhu tao atora èèna, dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète lii langu èdhi. dhoka nèngu di mesa na dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi, do huku pamadhe ti. miu dènge boe hak ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu, do padhai pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: come now, you who say, today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.
target_text: sèmi ne'e! madhutu iia-iia na, miu me'a le ho baku peka na, deo ne'e, do bèli, ji'i neo la'a sa kota nèi! ji'i neo pea mi era nèi pe d'ai ca tèu sa. aa ji'i neo d'aga sèna ka abhu ku leto d'ai ciki sa.

source_text: you do not even know what will happen tomorrow! what is your life? you are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
target_text: èu me'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i lod'o bèli? dhèu èci sa re'a boe tasamia mamuri na. mamuri èdhi dhèu ne nuka sèmi sèb'u dhu tèdhi dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna, kaca'a laa ele.

source_text: instead, you ought to say, if the lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.
target_text: be'a risi miu peka na, ladhe lamatua sue, na, ji'i mamuri madhera. aa ladhe lamatua d'èi, hud'i laa ji'i tao ne'e.

source_text: as it is, you boast in your proud intentions. all such boasting is evil.
target_text: te ladhe peka boe sèmi èèna, miu dhodhoka padedha iisi di. èci èèna ka dènge miu bhèlu eele lamatua ètu d'ara nanelu miu sèra. èèna sala kapai titu kèna!

source_text: anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu re'a le ngaa dhu lèke, te ngaa tao boe madhutu, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu tao sala le.

source_text: come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you. your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes. your gold and silver are corroded. their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. you have hoarded treasure in the last days. look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. the cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the lord of hosts. you have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. you have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter. you have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.
target_text: miu dhèu kaja sèra, sanèd'e, ee! pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! dhèu sab'a hia miu toke èi kabhèsu hae, te ngaa miu taha mere gaji ra. limuri ne rui-j'aj'èra ra pa'oo-parodha dhu peka nèti kapod'e-kabèli miu. tatu ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, tadèngi le lii roma iisi dhèu sab'a sèra. sasab'a miu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka tao pagaa ngi'u miu mesa mi, ka mamuri mi ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti. limuri ne miu nuka sèmi sapi kab'oi dhu neo lèke roro. miu huku dènge pamadhe le dhèu be'a sèra, dhu re'a boe siri iisi ra ètu madha miu. miu dhèu kaja sèra! tangi ka laa! pe miu pasae mere rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. mèdha-panyau miu, ele iia kèna. aa mèdha-papake miu dhu be'a sèra, ana ca ngèpi na'e aa'i si. hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi miu sèra, dènge heka kab'ua. aa bèli-camèd'a hualaa miu sèra ra'e hari miu, sèmi ai na'e aj'u mango. rai-haha oe èle kèna, te ngaa tasamia ka miu kabhèsu lutu pakaboko taruu mèdha dhu madhe sèra? mèdha-panyau miu unu mi ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu me'a boe mia ka dhu dènge kab'ua ètu madha lamatua!

source_text: be patient, then, brothers, until the lord's coming. see how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil-how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i taha d'ara ku, tatae mamai hari lamatua. ladhe ku laa dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu tatae hèru puu-g'ètu. èj'i hua hiu, na sèle hini. mate hari èj'i limuri, ho na pamangèru ana nganga'a sèra. nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka hua kèna. d'ai lod'o puu-g'ètu, dhèu ne la'e puu.

source_text: you, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the lord's coming is near.
target_text: miu hud'i taha d'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. pa'èra ngi'u, te nèbhu heka lamatua mai!

source_text: do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. look, the judge is standing at the door!
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku ka'uu-kamuki èci dènge èci. ka'uu-kamuki taruu, pe lamatua ka dhu huku èu! ladhe ka, te ama hakim ètu dedha nèi, titu le ètu madha miu.

source_text: brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the lord.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! madhutu conto nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra. masi ka rèngu paraga dènge susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu ètu d'ara sasusa.

source_text: see how blessed we consider those who have persevered. you have heard of job's perseverance and have seen the outcome from the lord. the lord is full of compassion and mercy.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara sasusa, èdhi d'èi padedha ngara dhèu ne. nuka sèmi ayub. masi ka na abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa na kalau-karèto boe. hèia lamatua sue ne, ka na ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a hia ayub. lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula d'ara na hua iia, pènu dènge sasue.

source_text: above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. simply let your yes be yes, and your no, no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu be'a risi miu baku j'oka subha. ladhe neo peka, oo, na, dhaa la oo. aa ladhe peka aad'o na, dhaa la aad'o. sèmi èèna, d'ai le! baku parisi dènge j'oka subha dhu ale ngara dhèu madhe ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari pasubha dènge kolongara lamatua dhu mamuri ètu dedha-liru. gaguna na aad'o dènge pasubha rupa-rupa. de ladhe taruu sèmi èèna, miu pasae mere huku, lula lii subha sèra.

source_text: is any one of you suffering? he should pray. is anyone cheerful? he should sing praises.
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu sasusa, be'a risi na sabaj'a. aa dhu ètu d'ara karej'e, be'a risi na sod'a koa-kio lamatua.

source_text: is any one of you sick? he should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the lord.
target_text: ladhe ètu talora miu abhu dhu pèd'a, be'a risi paroa ina-ama juma'at. manèngi sèna ka ra pasuti èi lèngi mi dhèu pèd'a ne, aa sabaj'a pake kolongara lamatua, ho hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: and the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. the lord will raise him up. if he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
target_text: aa ladhe miu sabaj'a dènge lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua hia dhèu pèd'a, èèna na lamatua puri-pa'èle ne. aa ladhe na tao sala, pe lamatua saku eele sasala na sèra.

source_text: therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. the prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
target_text: ladhe nèti talora miu abhu dhu manahu asa d'ara sasala, na, miu mangaku sasala èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara èèna, miu èci sabaj'a hia èci, sèna ka miu j'aj'i be'a. dhèu dhu d'ara na mola-mèci, lii manèngi na pènu dènge koasa, aa nèti babe'a.

source_text: elijah was a man just like us. he prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi elia. nèngu ne dhèu rai-haha cakaraa èdhi kahèi. te ngaa ropa na sabaj'a, manèngi èj'i mai boe, ka èj'i puru heka toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta.

source_text: again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
target_text: hèia na sabaj'a hari ho èj'i mai, hèia èj'i mai dènge. j'u'u mangèru bidhu-bidhu, aa oka-tedhe hia hari isi rai.

source_text: my brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
target_text: a'ari sèra! ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu bèbhe asa d'ara sasala, ka rai eele nèti j'ara dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhèu dhu pamako ho na lèpa hari asa j'ara dhu mola nèti lamatua, èèna na be'a!

source_text: consider this: whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
target_text: sanèd'e ne'e paie-iie! ladhe miu soru-bara dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia na lèpa hari asa lamatua ka na tao heka sala, miu se pasod'a le dhèu èèna, hèia na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, lamatua saku eele aa'i sasala na. d'ai sange ne'e ka! nèti ja'a, yakobis

source_text: peter, an apostle of jesus christ, to the elect who are exiles of the dispersion throughout pontus, galatia, cappadocia, asia, and bithynia, chosen according to the foreknowledge of god the father and sanctified by the spirit for obedience to jesus christ and sprinkling by his blood: grace and peace be yours in abundance.
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, petrus, dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne'e hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le. nuka miu dhu mamuri pahag'a palème era ètu propensi pontus, propensi galati, propensi kapadokia, propensi asia, dènge propensi bitinia. a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua hag'e nare mema le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. roh na ka dhu pamèu miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia nèngu, sèna ka miu bisa tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus kristus hia miu. aa ladhe miu madhutu aa'i paredha na sèra, èèna nuka sèmi lamatua pici miu dènge raa yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci hia nèngu. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu, ho mamuri miu asa tabha dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ! by his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of jesus christ from the dead,
target_text: koa-kio hia aa'i mi ama lamatua! nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. lula d'ara lamatua hua iia titu kèna, nèti èèna ka nèngu kasia èdhi seli eele. yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa na mamuri hari. de ladhe kristus pamamuri èdhi, na hia èdhi mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya taruu kristus, lula èdhi sanao dènge èra, bèli-camèd'a nèngu ladhe-leru èdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
target_text: sama sèmi èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ladhe ca dhèu ama madhe, tatu nèngu tèke eele mèdha-panyau na hia ana niki na. sèmi èèna kahèi, yesus dhu tèke le pusaka hia èdhi ètu sorga. te ngaa pusaka se dhu ele iie boe, laho boe, aa ele boe.

source_text: who through faith are shielded by god's power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
target_text: miu parcaya, na, ama lamatua dènge koasa ho soru-bara miu. na piara dènge madhenga miu, sèna ka baku abhu dhu palaho miu. aa ladhe èle ka rai-haha ne, na neo pad'elo dènge j'ara tasamia nèngu hia miu mamuri.

source_text: in this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
target_text: nèti èèna ka, d'ara miu karej'e, masi ka limuri ne miu rasa bia lula miu sili mere boe rupa-rupa sasusa.

source_text: so that the proven character of your faith-more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire-may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke èdhi paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, sèna ka na sèku neo ne'a mèu parcaya èdhi mi nèngu. ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara dadugu ne, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, parcaya èdhi lèke aa èra. èdhi bisa pakasame dènge hualaa. èdhi hud'i tunu pamèu hualaa ètu d'ara ai karoo, sèna ka ai na'e aa'i kaj'alu na, heka èdhi abhu hualaa isi adhu kèna. aa te ngaa, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, lalèka èdhi kab'ua risi nèti hualaa. de ladhe parcaya èdhi taha ètu d'ara dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ropa yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri èdhi, hèia na pad'elo kolo-karisi èdhi, aa na pakab'ua èdhi kahèi.

source_text: though you have not seen him, you love him; and though you do not see him now, you believe in him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
target_text: masi ka miu ladhe mèdhi mèka yesus, te ngaa miu sue ne. masi ka limuri ne miu mèdhi mèka nèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya ne. miu karej'e risi eele, masi ka abhu boe lii dhu pamèci, dhu bisa peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti d'ara karej'e miu.

source_text: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
target_text: lula miu parcaya ne, ka upa miu, nuka ama lamatua patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, pakanucu ho neo re'a mèu, j'ara tasa mera mia lamatua patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala ra. dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra dhu peka tèke le j'ara-j'ara lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu, lula nèngu dhu pa'èra mema le, sèna ka na hia miu mamuri.

source_text: trying to determine the time and setting to which the spirit of christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of christ and the glories to follow.
target_text: roh kristus dhu sab'a ètu d'ara rèngu, sèna ka peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a kristus hud'i pasae ku sasusa, aa dènge j'ara tasamia nèngu dui j'aj'èra. ladhe èle aa'i ku se'e, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra neo re'a lod'o mia madha j'ara se'e j'aj'i.

source_text: it was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the holy spirit sent from heaven. even angels long to look into these things.
target_text: ka roh kristus èèna peka dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai se kahèi, na, rèngu rèdhi boe, te ngaa miu ka dhu mèdhi j'ara se j'aj'i. aa miu tadèngi j'ara se kahèi, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci nèti sorga pua le dhèu leo ho lole dènge miu lii lolo be'a lamatua. aa te ngaa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga neo rèdhi j'ara se'e se kahèi.

source_text: therefore prepare your minds for action. be sober-minded. set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of jesus christ.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra sèna ka me'a mèu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i. j'aga paie-iie sèna ka ngangee miu mola. bori pa'èra ho parcaya taruu yesus kristus toke na lèpa hari mai. lula lod'o èèna, ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: as obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
target_text: miu hud'i nanene paie-iie ku ama lamatua, sama sèmi ana-ana nanene lii ina-ama ra. uru èèna, miu me'a iia mèka j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. te ngaa limuri ne me'a mèu le. de baku mamuri madhutu dad'èi miu dhu neo tao bhabhelu. te èèna, j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui.

source_text: but just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri mola-mèci. te ama lamatua èèna, mola-mèci. nèngu ka dhu paroa nare miu ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, mamuri miu kateme aae hud'i mola-mèci ku.

source_text: for it is written: be holy, because i am holy.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula ja'a ne mola-mèci.

source_text: since you call on a father who judges each one's work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
target_text: miu d'èi padhai lii dènge ama lamatua nuka sèmi ama miu. nèngu dhèu pama'ète lii langu kahèi, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu èci-èci. te ngaa nèngu baka-leo nèti dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu leo sèra. te na pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, dhu dènge boe koe-kapengo. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aga paie ku mamuri miu. te miu nuka sèmi dhèu tao-mai dhu dhoka manubha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, na, kristus ka dhu tihe pama'ète le miu nèti mamuri miu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. j'ara mamuri rupa sèmi sèra ka dhu miu sèmi mere nèti bèi-baki miu, nuka sèmi pusaka. te ngaa sanèd'e, te kristus sui nare le miu, b'ae boe pake doi pudhi do hualaa dhu ele bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: but with the precious blood of christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ae-baj'a pake raa nèngu unu na. ne'e ne, kab'ua titu kèna! nèngu madhe nuka sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu ad'u-ue nèdhi boe sasala, dhu ra roro ne tao j'aj'i korban.

source_text: he was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu ne'a aa'i le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na kristus tao. te ngaa uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae patadhe mèka kristus mi dhèu rai-haha. limuri ku, heka nèngu pad'elo kristus sèna ka j'aj'i berkat hia miu.

source_text: through him you believe in god, who raised him from the dead and glorified him; and so your faith and hope are in god.
target_text: lula tatao kristus, ka miu bisa parcaya ama lamatua. te nèngu pamamuri hari kristus, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha. ama lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu parcaya ne, aa sanao ho na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu padhadha tèke.

source_text: since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
target_text: miu tao madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. de limuri ne miu bisa sab'a pa'èra-èra hia lamatua. j'ara èèna ka tao miu pasue dènge d'ara kateme mi a'ari miu dhu parcaya sèra. sasue miu hud'i asa tabha èra, lula d'ara miu mola-mèci.

source_text: for you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of god.
target_text: miu limuri ne, abhu le mamuri hiu. te ngaa mamuri hiu ne, mai boe nèti ina-ama miu dhu bèli-camèd'a madhe ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa miu abhu nèti ama èdhi ètu sorga dhu madhe boe. mamuri hiu unu mi ne, miu abhu re lii holo-nori ama lamatua. lii holo-nori nèngu ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, aa taha taruu.

source_text: for, all flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi j'u'u, do hela-bunga. te saraga ra taha nèbhu boe. j'u'u kamale dhae-dhae. hela-bunga kabhui eele kahèi. nèbhu boe madhe, hèia ela aa'i si.

source_text: but the word of the lord stands forever. and this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori lamatua èdhi, taha taruu, dhu bisa boe ele. lii holo-nori lamatua èèna, nuka lii lolo be'a dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
target_text: de miu baku tao bhabhelu èci sa. baku padhai-kakoli do kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. baku padhai lii leo tao leo. baku tèka d'ara ladhe mamuri dhèu leo risi èu. baku pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. core eele tatao se'e se!

source_text: like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
target_text: ana rara iisi hiu d'èi dhoka èi susu ina ra. sèmi èèna kahèi d'ara miu hud'i d'èi dhoka me'a mèu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ne'e ne ka dhu asa pa'èra parcaya miu nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu juu noo-noo j'aj'i kapai, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: now that you have tasted that the lord is good.
target_text: te miu dhu rasa mèdhi le d'ara hua iia lamatua èdhi.

source_text: as you come to him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in god's sight,
target_text: pa'èki ngi'u miu dènge kristus. te nèngu nuka sèmi hadhu cue dhu mamuri. tuka hadhu core eele ne, lula ra ngee, na, hadhu ne guna boe. te ngaa madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, na, hadhu ne kab'ua titu kèna, hèia na pili nare ne, tao mi hadhu padhèdi dhu kab'ua risi eele.

source_text: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to god through jesus christ.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki ku dènge kristus, sèna ka ama lamatua pake miu kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, miu sama sèmi hadhu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ho patitu èmu hia roh na. miu nuka sèmi hadhu dhu mamuri kahèi, sama sèmi kristus. miu èci èèna ka dènge ama agama sèra, dhu mamuri mola-mèci hia mi ama lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi miu mèti mèdha korban hia ne. mèdha korban dhu miu mèti ne pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus madhe le hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: for it stands in scripture: see, i lay in zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, ladhe ku laa! te ja'a padhèdi le hadhu uuru, ètu kota yerusalem ne'e, dhu ra pangare, na, ‘kota sion'. ja'a pili kore hadhu ne kahèi. madhutu ja'a, nèngu kab'ua bia. de dhèu dhu parcaya ne, bèli-camèd'a ra'e boe makae.

source_text: to you who believe, then, this stone is precious. but to those who do not believe, the stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,
target_text: hadhu ne, nuka yesus. ka nèngu kab'ua titu kèna bagi mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu parcaya boe yesus kristus, sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua suri, peka na, hadhu dhu tuka sèra core eele, limuri ne j'aj'i le hadhu uuru, dhu kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: and, a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense. they stumble because they disobey the word-and to this they were appointed.
target_text: abhu dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abhu hadhu dhu pakadhunu dhèu. abhu hadhu dhu pabèbhe dhèu. rèngu bèbha lula ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. te ama lamatua dhu ator mema le, sèna ka ra bèbha.

source_text: but you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for god's own possession, to proclaim the virtues of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
target_text: te ngaa miu aad'o sèmi èèna. te miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e unu na. miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu. miu sama sèmi ama agama dhu ladhe-leru dhèu aae. miu èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu ca suku dhu mamuri mola-mèci hia mi ama lamatua. miu j'aj'i sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu bisa lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu na pala-bagi hia miu. te lamatua pua le miu ho tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu be'a. se'e se nuka sèmi miu kalua nèti d'ara maroga, ho mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na dhu be'a risi eele.

source_text: once you were not a people, but now you are the people of god; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
target_text: uru èèna, miu sama sèmi ca suku dhu dènge boe kolongara. te ngaa limuri ne miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. uru èèna, miu pahae boe rasa kasia lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere le.

source_text: beloved, i urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu dhoka mai manubha ètu rai-haha ne. te miu nuka sèmi dhèu tao-mai dhu mamuri ètu dedha rai dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a loe boe manèngi sèna ka miu baku mamuri sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. te ètu d'ara miu nuka sèmi pamusu sa. d'ara dhu neo tao karehe lab'a dènge d'ara dhu neo tao be'a. de baku soro tèke d'ara neo tao karehe èèna segi miu. te ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, na, miu laho mae-mae!

source_text: conduct yourselves with such honor among the gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify god on the day he visits us.
target_text: j'aga paie, sèna ka miu mamuri mola ètu madha dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, ladhe ra galaa leli miu, na, dhu rèngu rèdhi, dhoka babe'a miu di. hèia ropa yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, rèngu unu ra ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua, lula tatao miu dhu be'a sèra.

source_text: submit yourselves for the lord's sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
target_text: dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka miu nanene dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha. nuka sèmi: nanene mi dhèu aae, te nèngu ka ama paredha dedha.

source_text: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
target_text: nanene mi gubernur, te dhèu aae ka dhu pua ne, ho huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, aa na koa-kad'iri dhèu dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: for it is god's will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi miu tao dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu goa dhu re'a boe ngaa-ngaa sèra, abhu boe j'ara ho galaa miu.

source_text: live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of god.
target_text: masi ka miu dhèu bebas dhu dènge hak sèna ka madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, te ngaa miu baku tao leli hak ne ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu. pake hak ne sèna ka sab'a hia ama lamatua, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: treat everyone with high regard: love the brotherhood of believers, fear god, honor the king.
target_text: miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i. miu hud'i sue ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. miu hud'i mamuri dhu lèke ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu miu. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha.

source_text: servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
target_text: ana pua-paleha sèra! nanene paie-iie lamatua miu sèra, aa pakab'ua si. mage nanene dhoka lamatua dhu d'ara be'a aa lii mako di. masi ka lamatua miu bhelu titu kèna, te ngaa miu hud'i nanene paie ne kahèi.

source_text: for if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of god, this is to be commended.
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu huku dhu lèke boe j'ara nèti lamatua miu masi ka miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa, aa ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara sasusa èèna, lula miu ngee mèdhi dad'èi lamatua, pe ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: how is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? but if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before god.
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu tao sala, hèia abhu gama, na, a'oto na ngaa, ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra èèna? abhu boe, si? te ngaa ladhe miu abhu susa lula tao dhu be'a, hèia miu taha mere d'ara, na, lamatua ladhe-leru miu.

source_text: for to this you were called, because christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his footsteps:
target_text: te kristus neo kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri mola, masi ka miu abhu susa. te nèngu dui j'aj'èra kahèi pala èdhi. dènge sèmi èèna, nèngu j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi madhutu ne, èci èèna ka èdhi madhutu kab'a-j'èla na.

source_text: he committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, nèngu tao nèdhi boe sala. abhu boe lii kapod'e-kabèli kalua nèti hèb'a na.

source_text: when they heaped abuse on him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats, but entrusted himself to him who judges justly.
target_text: lod'o ra padhai lii pa-aape ne, nèngu bhoka boe hèb'a. ropa dhèu pasusa nèngu, na b'ala boe. te ngaa na soro ngi'u na asa d'ara adhe-aai ama lamatua. te ne'a, na, ama lamatua èèna dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola.

source_text: he himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. by his stripes you are healed.
target_text: kristus ka dhu pasae nare sasala èdhi ropa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na ad'u-ue j'ara ne, ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, sèna ka èdhi mamuri ia ka dènge tao sasala. ka limuri ne èdhi mamuri heka tao sasala, dhoka mamuri dènge tao dhu lèke di. te nèngu gati èdhi, sèna ka pasae nare hahuku èdhi. hahuku ne'e ka dhu panu'a nèngu toke madhe. te nu'a dhu pamadhe yesus èèna ka puri-pa'èle miu.

source_text: for you were like sheep going astray, but now you have returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
target_text: te miu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu uru èèna sigo eele nèti j'ara. te ngaa limuri ne miu lèpa hari le asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola. te nèngu ka dhu madhenga dènge kab'oi miu, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu j'aga dènge ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho na sèra.

source_text: wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
target_text: bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! deo na ja'a peka, na, èdhi hud'i nanene paie-iie ku dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. de miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu èmu miu. sanèd'e, te abhu dhèu mone cahag'e dhu leo le èmu, ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. masi ka rèngu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, te ngaa èèna na, rèngu neo parcaya lamatua, lula rèdhi j'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
target_text: te rèngu rèdhi miu sab'a aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara mola-mèci aa mamuri dhu pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
target_text: bhèni dhu bhèni iia, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu tèdhi nèti li'u. nuka sèmi: sageri kètu madhutu rupa-rupa mod'e, do, pake mèdha hualaa dhu risi eele, do, pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in god's sight.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao bhèni iia dhu lèke, nuka: d'ara dhu tèdhi boe nèti li'u. conto sèmi: d'ara hua iia, dènge lii mako. te bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu taha taruu, masi ka toke d'ai heka bhora. madhutu a'abhu lamatua, bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: for this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. they put their hope in god and were submissive to their husbands,
target_text: te uru-uru sèra, dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola-mèci, dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bhèni iia. rèngu nanene aa madhutu dhèu èmu ra dènge be'a.

source_text: just as sarah obeyed abraham and called him lord. and you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
target_text: tare conto nèti sara. nèngu nanene mi dhèu èmu na abraham. nèngu soro iisi na, sèna ka dhèu èmu na ator nèngu. miu bhèni aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhutu ku j'ara nèti sara ne. ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, na, miu madha'u boe.

source_text: husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
target_text: mone aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu. ngee paie-iie ngaa dhu be'a hia mi nèngu, aa tao madhutu. pakab'ua ne ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i, lula a'èra bhèni sama boe dènge a'èra dhèu mone. te miu sama-sama abhu pusaka dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. nuka, mamuri hiu dhu lamatua hia miu nèti d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa miu mone dhu ngara na dhèu èmu-kamali, hud'i mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu, sèna ka ladhe miu dua mi sabaj'a d'ara èci manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti lamatua, na, lamatua nanene lii manèngi miu.

source_text: finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a pab'ab'e lii holo ja'a aa'i-aa'i sèra sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i mamuri ku d'ara èci. ladhe ca dhèu abhu susa do karej'e, na, miu dhu leo hud'i rasa sèmi èèna kahèi. sue dhèu dhu parcaya kristus. pad'elo d'ara hua iia èci dènge èci. baku padedha iisi, te miu hud'i pahaha iisi ku.

source_text: do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
target_text: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii padhèto dènge miu, baku b'ala kahèi. te ngaa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia dhu be'a mi nèngu. te lamatua dhu paroa nare le miu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere dhu hua iia nèti nèngu.

source_text: for, whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu tenge mamuri be'a, aa dhu tenge mamuri madhera, dhèu èèna hud'i j'aga hèb'a na sèna ka baku ore leli, aa baku pakapod'e d'ara lii.

source_text: he must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
target_text: nèngu hud'i ele-ho'a, sèna ka tao heka bhelu, te ngaa tao dhu lèke di. nèngu hud'i patema mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa tenge j'ara ho pabe'a taruu dènge ra.

source_text: for the eyes of the lord are on the righteous, and his ears are inclined to their prayer. but the face of the lord is against those who do evil.
target_text: te lamatua èdhi dhu haduli dhèu dhu mamuri mola. aa nèngu kahèi neo nanene lii manèngi-mangaj'i rèngu. te ngaa lamatua èdhi loe boe lab'a dhèu dhu ad'u-ue taruu bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
target_text: ladhe miu d'èi tao dhu lèke, cee ka dhu neo paj'èra hari miu? abhu boe, si?

source_text: but even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu tao dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhu pasusa miu, miu oto. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe kristus j'aj'i madha'u lula madha j'ara èci, na, miu baku madhutu ho madha'u sèmi èèna. ngangee miu baku kahèlu, aa d'ara miu baku susa èci èèna ka dènge rèngu.

source_text: but in your hearts sanctify christ as lord. always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. but respond with gentleness and respect,
target_text: pamau d'ara miu, lula miu dhu ded'e le kristus ètu d'ara miu ho j'aj'i lamatua miu dhu mola-mèci. ladhe sèmi dhèu manèngi sèna ka miu lole parcaya miu aa sanao-maena miu, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a kristus tao aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a, na, miu hud'i pa'èra ku ho dhaa lii karèi rèngu sèra.

source_text: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in christ.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i dhaa ku nèti d'ara dhu hua iia, aa pakab'ua si, sèna ka re'a, na, miu tao dhu lèke mai nèti d'ara dhu mola. masi ka miu tao dhu be'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa tatu abhu dhu padhai lii neo pamanahu miu, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ladhe miu tao taruu dhu be'a, na, rèngu dhu pa-aape miu èèna na ra'e makae.

source_text: for it is better, if it is god's will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
target_text: ladhe èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua, na, baku bhèlu, te be'a risi miu abhu j'aj'èra nèti tao j'ara dhu lèke; baku nèti miu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe.

source_text: for christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to god. he was put to death in the body but made alive in the spirit,
target_text: te kristus madhe ca tèka di, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha tao sala. nèngu dhu mamuri mola, madhe le pala èdhi dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèngu madhe sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi kahèi, dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa roh lamatua pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison
target_text: roh èèna kahèi lere nèti nèngu la'e aj'a-nori mi roh-roh dhu lèke bèdho ètu era èci, nuka sèmi d'ara bui.

source_text: who disobeyed long ago when god waited patiently in the days of noah while the ark was being built. in the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
target_text: roh se, nuka samanga nèti dhèu dhu uru-uru sèra ro'o boe nanene lamatua. lod'o èèna, noh tao kapa aae cue. lamatua tatae sèna ka neo nèdhi dhèu sèra tao madhutu dad'èi na, te ngaa rèngu pusi-pahae boe. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhoka dhèu aru di, dhu mamuri nèti èi aae lala.

source_text: and this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also-not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward god-through the resurrection of jesus christ,
target_text: èi aae lala ne j'aj'i conto, nuka sèmi lod'o sarani miu. sarani ne j'aj'i tadha, peka na, lamatua patabuli eele miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu, lula kristus mamuri hari le. lod'o sarani miu, ra padiu boe miu, ho pamèu ngi'u mi. te dhu lèke ka, nuka, miu padhadha mi lamatua, ho neo tao pamèu d'ara miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na, miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of god, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to him.
target_text: limuri ne, yesus lèpa hari le asa sorga. ètu nèi, na madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, re baboa g'ana ama lamatua. ka ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga, koasa aa'i-aa'i, dènge dhu rèd'u koasa, hud'i nanene ku kristus.

source_text: therefore, since christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
target_text: kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha èci èèna ka dènge èdhi. lula nèngu abhu le j'aj'èra ae-ae, miu hud'i pa'èra dui sasusa sama sèmi nèngu kahèi. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu abhu susa lula pa'èki dènge kristus, nèngu pama'ète nare le ho ad'u-ue heka sasala.

source_text: consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of god.
target_text: masi ka nèngu mamuri era ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu mamuri heka ètu d'ara sasala sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ae le ka dhu miu bisa pake ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu ngaa èèna ka, sama sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. nuka sèmi: rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. tao j'ara makae. tao bhabhelu madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rinu mahu. rèngu tao pesta liar. rèngu tao pesta j'ara makae rupa-rupa. ra sogo-tagu nidhu dènge j'ara dhu pamamuru iisi èdhi.

source_text: because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
target_text: rèngu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara miu, lula rèngu re'a boe, nga tao ka miu tao boe madhutu bhabhelu sèmi rèngu dhu seli-kolane èèna.

source_text: but they will have to give an account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lasi ku asa madha ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu pama'ète lii langu. rèngu hud'i lole dènge ama lamatua nga tao ka rèngu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèmi sèra. baku bhèlu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bèli-camèd'a hud'i lasi ku asa madha nèngu. dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa madha lamatua.

source_text: that is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to god in the spirit.
target_text: lèke tare'a! ama lamatua neo parisa dhèu dhu madhe le, nuka sèmi dhu nèngu parisa dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu neo ne'a j'ara mamuri rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e le peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dedha rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke ho tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: the end of all things is near. therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
target_text: lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe dètu ae le. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pajiko paie-iie dènge d'ara dhu mau, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi miu.

source_text: above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu èci dènge èci. te masi ka dhèu leo tao sasala ae-ae, te ngaa miu bisa pa'angalai era dènge ne, lula miu sue ne.

source_text: show hospitality to one another without complaining.
target_text: pakabhèle ai sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu tao-mai ho manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu. te ngaa sanèd'e, baku sèmi mere si dènge d'ara ka'uu-kamuki.

source_text: as good stewards of the manifold grace of god, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
target_text: èdhi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i abhu le karunya nèti lamatua. de èdhi hud'i pake karunya ne ho lalau-lalo'o a'ari dhèu parcaya. haduli aa pake pabe'a-be'a karunya èèna, te èèna ka dhu dènge guna hia mi lamatua.

source_text: if anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of god. if anyone serves, he should serve with the strength god provides, so that in all things god may be glorified through jesus christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. amen.
target_text: nuka sèmi: ladhe abhu karunya aj'a-nori dhèu, na, sanèd'e te miu hud'i lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua. ladhe abhu karunya ho ladhe-leru dhèu, na, sab'a pake a'èra dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi miu. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe, na, miu dhèu unu yesus kristus. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, kapai titu kèna! aa koasa nèd'u paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane! lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage malaa ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu dhu bia. te èèna neo uji parcaya miu. baku pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu abhu dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna.

source_text: but rejoice that you share in the sufferings of christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of his glory.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara miu bisa karej'e-karae, lula miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi kristus dhu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na d'ara miu asa karej'e-karae ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi dadedha kristus.

source_text: if you are insulted for the name of christ, you are blessed, because the spirit of glory and of god rests on you.
target_text: ropa dhèu pahahe miu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus, miu oto, lula dadedha roh lamatua pa'èra miu.

source_text: indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra, na, baku lula miu pamadhe dhèu, do, dhèu mana'u, dhèu bhelu-katub'a, do, dhèu dhu d'èi soro iisi asa lii langu dhèu.

source_text: but if you suffer as a christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify god that you bear that name.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu pasae j'aj'èra lula j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, nèngu baku makae. hua iia risi rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu kristen.

source_text: for it is time for judgment to begin with the family of god; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of god?
target_text: lod'o d'ai le ho dhèu lasi asa madha ama lamatua. na parisa uuru mamuri dhèu-dhèu unu na. de pangee paie-iie! ladhe na mulai nèti èdhi dhèu kristen, na, tasa mera mia dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe sèmi lii lolo be'a na? tatu hahuku rèngu bia risi hari!

source_text: and, if it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?
target_text: te abhu dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri mola oe abhu boe mamuri sa hèi, tasamia hari dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe pahae lamatua? aa tasamia hari dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala?

source_text: so then, those who suffer according to god's will should entrust their souls to their faithful creator and continue to do good.
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua soro tèke dhèu unu na abhu susa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, rèngu bisa lèka, peka na, èèna na nèngu j'aga si kahèi. te nèngu ka paj'aj'i si. nèngu kahèi tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka le. lula nèngu j'aga si sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa tao taruu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: as a fellow elder, a witness of christ's sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, i appeal to the elders among you:
target_text: ja'a ne, ca dhèu kètu kahèi. uru èèna, lod'o kristus pasae j'aj'èra na, ja'a kèdhi unu ku dènge musi madha ja'a. aa bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i laladhe rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, ja'a kahèi neo kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. de ja'a neo holo kètu juma'at dhu leo sèra, na:

source_text: be shepherds of god's flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is god's will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
target_text: miu nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho ra. de miu hud'i leru paie-iie dhèu dhu lamatua pangèd'u asa miu. uri si paie-iie. mage miu ladhe-leru si, lula dhoka sasab'a miu di, te ngaa lula miu d'èi tao sèmi èèna. uli si madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku d'èi tenge oto, te ngaa sab'a dènge karej'e ho soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
target_text: baku paredha leli, ho pabia dhèu dhu lamatua hia miu ladhe-leru si. te ngaa miu hud'i j'aj'i conto dhu be'a, dhu bisa paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu.

source_text: and when the chief shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
target_text: yesus, nuka sèmi kètu nèti dhèu madhenga badha. bèli-camèd'a ladhe na lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua neo b'ae rui-j'aj'èra miu, lula miu uri dhèu miu dènge be'a. upa ne, bisa boe ele iie, te ngaa taha taa-taa d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. and all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, god opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
target_text: ana ngèru aa'i-aa'i! miu kahèi hud'i nanene ku kètu juma'at sèra. miu aa'i-aa'i mi baku padedha iisi. te ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi, te ngaa nèngu d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: humble yourselves, therefore, under god's mighty hand, so that in due time he may exalt you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku koasa lamatua, sèna ka miu baku pamone-pabhèni. hèia ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: cast all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.
target_text: pataleo d'ara miu, sèna ka lamatua uri j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu tao miu madha'u. te nèngu ka dhu haduli miu.

source_text: be sober-minded and alert. your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
target_text: mage-mage! pake ngangee madhera. aa j'aga paie-iie, te musu èdhi, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, neo palaho miu. neo dhèle aa'i miu, nuka sèmi singa dhu manganga, dhu patangi-tenge badha neo na'a.

source_text: resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
target_text: te ngaa baku madha'u. miu hud'i lab'a dhèu aae nidhu èèna. miu hud'i pa'èra lalèka miu mi lamatua kahèi. te miu me'a le, na, a'ari miu dhèu parcaya buli mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, abhu sasusa sama sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and after you have suffered for a little while, the god of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in christ, will himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, te ama lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi kahèi. nèngu ka dhu paroa le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula miu sèmi mere le kristus. nèti èèna ka, nèngu neo ded'e miu padedha-dedha, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri taruu dènge nèngu. te ngaa ladhe miu abhu le j'aj'èra dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua neo pabe'a hari miu. na neo pa'èra miu, aa tao miu bisa taha. nèngu pamadhèdi miu kahèi mi dedha fanderen dhu èra.

source_text: to him be the power forever and ever. amen.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua nèd'u koasa aa'i-aa'i toke d'ai mia-mia. lèke tare'a!

source_text: through silvanus, whom i regard as a faithful brother, i have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of god. stand firm in it.
target_text: silas ka dhu soru-bara ja'a ho suri sasuri dhu bab'a ne. nèngu ne, a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya, aa ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a holo-nori miu sèna ka miu taha pa'èra, te lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na taruu mi èdhi. de miu hud'i èra ku, sèna ka baku hari kabodho.

source_text: the church in babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son mark.
target_text: dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu kota babel hia miu lii maho'o. ama lamatua hag'e nare le rèngu, sama sèmi na pili miu. ana ja'a markus pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: greet one another with a kiss of love. peace to all of you who are in christ.
target_text: ladhe miu paraga, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci ho pad'elo pasue miu. ja'a d'èi ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya kristus bisa mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. saloom, petrus

source_text: simon peter, a servant and apostle of jesus christ, to those who through the righteousness of our god and savior jesus christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, simon petrus. ja'a j'aj'i ana pua-paleha yesus kristus. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na kahèi, dhu na pua laku asa mia-mia ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, dhu parcaya le yesus kristus. lula d'ara mola ama lamatua, ka na bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus kahèi, sama sèmi ji'i. parcaya ne kab'ua titu kèna hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. kristus èèna j'aj'i ama lamatua èdhi, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo.

source_text: grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of god and of jesus our lord.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu tadhe mèu ama lamatua, aa tadhe kètu èdhi, yesus, dènge be'a. hud'i laa sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu bisa mamuri dènge dame aa mera-milu èci dènge èci.

source_text: his divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and excellence.
target_text: yesus dhu dènge koasa èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus papala èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu tao sèmi èèna, lula èdhi tadhe mèu ne. aa na paroa èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula d'ara hua iia dènge dadedha na.

source_text: through these he has given us his precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
target_text: yesus hia le èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia. te uru èèna, na padhadha tèke le ho neo hia j'ara se'e. lii padhadha na, aa'i-aa'i be'a titu kèna. yesus hia aa'i mèu-mèu se'e mi èdhi, sèna ka d'ara èdhi bisa sama sèmi d'ara lamatua. aa èdhi bisa lehe tare j'ara-j'ara karehe dhu dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi ad'u-ue, lula rèngu mamuri d'èi dhoka tao madhutu dad'èi unu ra, aa dhu taha rare boe d'ara ra.

source_text: for this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'èra tao j'ara dhu be'a. mema miu parcaya le yesus, te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka. sab'a taruu j'ara dhu be'a. tadhe lamatua dènge be'a risi hari.

source_text: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
target_text: te ngaa mage d'ai dhoka sange èèna di. patema mamuri ho taha mere d'ara. te ngaa sèra dhae d'ai mèka kahèi. lod'o-lod'o miu abhu sasusa, na, miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara ho baku hari kabodho. te ngaa tao parisi hari nèti èèna. tao aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
target_text: te ngaa mage dhoka d'ai sange èèna di. pad'elo sasue mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka kahèi. te miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu.

source_text: for if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: ladhe mamuri miu sèmi sèra ka, aa j'ara dhu be'a asa tabha taruu, na, sèra sa hia miu asa tadhe mèu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te j'ara dhu be'a ele boe iia d'ara, aa core eele boe lod'o kahèi. te j'ara be'a se'e ka dhu tao d'ara miu ho me'a mèu nèngu.

source_text: but whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'èi boe tao sèmi sèra, sasoa na, ngangee nèngu bab'a. nèngu nèdhi boe ngaa ètu madha nèngu, nuka sèmi dhèu bèdhu. te lamatua dhu saku eele le sasala na, sèna ka d'ara nèngu bisa mola-mèci. te ngaa dhèu ne bhèlu eele!

source_text: therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. for if you practice these things you will never stumble,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu limuri ne hud'i bori dhari asa pa'èra. lamatua hag'e nare le miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ka miu lami asa madha na. de miu hud'i pad'elo ku, na, miu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na. ladhe j'ara dhu ja'a peka se tabha taruu ètu mamuri miu, na, miu manahu boe.

source_text: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our lord and savior jesus christ.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, ama lamatua bagi hia miu j'ara èci dhu kapai titu kèna. nuka na bhoke pataleo j'ara, dènge pangèd'u miu hak, ho sèmi mere yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae miu, sèna ka miu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te yesus kristus ne, kètu èdhi. aa nèngu kahèi, dhèu dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: therefore i will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a peka deo sa, aa miu taha pa'èra, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a loe boe pasanèd'e miu pahari-pahari, sèna ka miu baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: i think it is right to refresh your memory as long as i live in the tent of my body,
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe ladhe miu pabhèlu eele j'ara sèra. ja'a d'èi pasanèd'e miu taruu, sèna ka miu pajiko taruu j'ara se'e se, ètu d'ara kahadhu miu. te lod'o ja'a mamuri ètu rai-haha ne era, mema sala boe ladhe ja'a loe boe pasanèd'e j'ara se'e mi miu.

source_text: because i know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our lord jesus christ has made clear to me.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe, sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus peka le dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a le.

source_text: and i will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
target_text: masi ka bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a tenge j'ara ho miu sanèd'e taruu j'ara se'e.

source_text: for we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our lord jesus christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
target_text: ca hari na, ja'a dènge angalai ja'a lole le dènge miu, lula-nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i peka kahèi, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe kristus lèpa hari mai, mamai nèngu èèna dènge koasa dhu kapai titu kèna. lèke, si? dhu ji'i lolo se, nanuku boe. lula ji'i lole dhoka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi dènge musi madha ji'i unu mi! nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a, na, dadedha yesus kristus ne nuka sèmi dhèu aae kapai sa.

source_text: for he received honor and glory from god the father when the voice came to him from the majestic glory, saying, this is my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased. and we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
target_text: ca tèka, ji'i sama-sama dènge yesus ètu ledhe mola-mèci lamatua. hèia ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka lula-nèti dadedha yesus ne. te lod'o èèna, ji'i tadèngi lii dhu be'a titu kèna mai nèti dedha-liru, peka na, ne'e ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: we also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
target_text: èèna ka dhu tao ji'i asa lèka èra lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra ji'i abhu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. de hua iia risi miu tao madhutu lii moa dhèu se'e! te lii moa rèngu sèra, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga. de miu hud'i nanene paie-iie ku lii moa se, toke d'ai yesus mai hari. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu asa tabha me'a mèu. te èèna na nuka sèmi miu mèdhi uuru ku hua-hètu aae dhimu, hèia lod'o heka rea kèna ho pasaraa aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: above all, you must understand that no prophecy of scripture comes from one's own interpretation.
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu rèngu peka-padhai se nèti boe dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: for no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from god as they were carried along by the holy spirit.
target_text: lula ngaa dhu rèngu suri se, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu neo padhai lii. te ngaa mai nèti ama lamatua, madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci na pad'elo dènge rèngu.

source_text: now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. they will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the master who bought them-bringing swift destruction on themselves.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu isra'el cahag'e peka na, rèngu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa te ngaa rèngu se kapod'e-kabèli di. pe miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra ètu talora aae miu. te abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, rèngu aj'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ra leko-monya di. rèngu aj'a pahuni-pahuni ngangee rèngu dhu karehe. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa pamaso a'aj'a rèngu dhu koe-kapengo sèra. ladhe miu nanene lii aj'a-nori rèngu, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu calaka. rèngu pasili, peka na, lamatua yesus èèna, lamatua rèngu boe. aa te ngaa, yesus ka dhu sui nare rèngu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. lula tatao rèngu sèmi ne'e ne ka, nèbhu boe rèngu unu ra laho malai.

source_text: many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu madhutu rèngu, aa tao leli dhu re'a heka makae. bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakarehe a'aj'a dhu lèke, lula tatao rèngu.

source_text: in their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. the longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.
target_text: mese dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra manga'a-dèu ngara. rèngu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa lii padhai, sèna ka tipu rare doi-dhari miu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ama lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu dhu pasaruru nèdhi boe musi madha. karèi nèti uru ka, nèngu pa'èra mema le ho huku si. bèli-camèd'a ra laho aa'i.

source_text: for if god did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
target_text: conto sèmi, uru èèna, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua cahag'e ètu sorga dhu tao sala. te ngaa lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu soro tèke boe si. na pèci si asa d'ara naraka, aa bèdho si ètu d'ara ro'a maroga dhu marèma aae. rèngu pea taha ètu èèna toke d'ai lod'o lasi asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri uru-uru sèra. tèu èèna, rèngu ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a dènge pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu ator le dhèu na èci dhu d'ara mola, ngara na noh, pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mola. te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ne kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia èi aae lala, ka palaho aa'i dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. te ngaa lamatua hia mamuri dhoka noh dènge isi èmu na. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra aru dhèu.

source_text: if he condemned the cities of sodom and gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
target_text: ca tèka hari, dhèu uru-uru sèra ètu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, mamuri dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. hèia ama lamatua huku si. nèngu labhu pakèpu aa'i si j'aj'i ahu, ka dhèu ètu sèra madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. se'e se j'aj'i mi conto hia mi dhèu leo dhu d'èi mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. rèngu bisa re'a mema le mamadhe-mamopo ra, ladhe ele boe ho'a.

source_text: and if he rescued lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu ca dhèu ngara na lot, dhu mamuri mola. nèngu roca le dènge tatao dhu seli-kolane nèti dhèu bhelu se'e, dhu ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua. ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu lot nèti era èèna.

source_text: for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard-
target_text: lot ne ca dhèu dhu d'èi tao dhu lèke, te ngaa na pea ètu talora aae dhèu sodom. bèli-bèli èèna, lot nèdhi aa tadèngi kahèi rèngu sisu atora ama lamatua. se'e se ka dhu pasusa d'ara lot.

source_text: if all this is so, then the lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
target_text: conto sèra sa pad'elo, peka na, ama lamatua ne'a j'ara hia mamuri mi dhèu dhu d'èi nanene nèngu, ka na pakaj'èu si nèti rupa-rupa dadugu-rariu. nèngu ne'a pamanahu hahuku dhu bia kahèi mi dhèu dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. aa lamatua tao j'ara se'e toke d'ai lod'o na pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
target_text: hahuku dhu bia èèna, lèke risi-risi mi dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri kaj'alu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rèngu ro'o boe nanene ca dhèu sa, aa pahahe dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. tatu ama lamatua huku si. de mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra bani titu kèna, aa padedha iisi seli eele. rèngu ro'o boe pakab'ua aa madha'u boe padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua dènge ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the lord.
target_text: madhutu mola-mola na, ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra èra risi nèti rèngu mese-mese kapod'e-kabèli se. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana-ana pajuu se padhai lii pa'ele iie boe kolongara mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra ètu madha lamatua rèngu. aa ra pèci boe sasala asa mese sèra kahèi.

source_text: these men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. they blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.
target_text: te ngaa mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra re'a dhoka padhai lii pa'ele iie j'ara-j'ara dhu rèngu mesa ra re'a boe. te rèngu èci èèna ka dènge badha dhu dènge boe ngangee na! be'a risi, kèpe ho palaho eele si! te kalua aapa rèngu, sèmi èèna ka. tatu bèli-camèd'a rèngu laho aa'i, lula tatao rèngu dhu karehe sèra.

source_text: the harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness. they consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. they are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.
target_text: rèngu paj'èra ae le dhèu. pe, ama lamatua pasusa rèngu kahèi, lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe sèra. rèngu d'èi dhoka tao pesta liar. ladhe re mèu, rèngu d'èi tao leli kahèi, sèna ka dhèu bisa rèdhi bhabhelu rèngu. rèngu re'a boe makae, ka pa'ele iie kolongara miu. ladhe rèngu ra'a pesta sama-sama dènge miu, rèngu d'èi dhoka neo tao madhutu bhabhelu ra.

source_text: their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. they are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
target_text: musi madha ra seru lee, ho patangi-tenge dhèu bhèni dhu neo karihu kaj'alu dènge rèngu. mamuri rèngu dhoka bhelu-katub'a di. rèngu tenge dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe mi lamatua, ka pamako si, sèna ka pa'èci dènge rèngu ho tao bhabhelu. rèngu manga'a, aa re'a boe roca. tatu ama lamatua huku si!

source_text: they have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of balaam son of beor, who loved the wages of wickedness. but he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man's voice and restrained the prophet's madness.
target_text: mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra, uru èèna, rèngu dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mola, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka ra sero eele j'ara. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu sèra nuka sèmi balaam, ana bosor. nèngu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa nèngu d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari di, nèti èèna ka na tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. ca tèka, balaam manya'e badha keled'ei. keled'ei dhu bisa boe padhai lii. te ngaa lod'o èèna, lamatua hia keled'ei ne padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu! ka keled'ei ne kai balaam, lula bhabhelu na. dad'èi keled'ei ne, sèna ka balaam ae eele ka nèti tatao na dhu koe-kapengo, nuka sèmi dhèu huj'u sa.

source_text: these men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. blackest darkness is reserved for them.
target_text: mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra, èci èèna ka dènge madha èi dhu guna boe, lula mèti eele. rèngu cakaraa kahèi dènge bhuru dhu guna boe, lula lai ngèlu tiu eele. ama lamatua tao tèke le era dhu maroga aatu-aatu èci, sèna ka taha si.

source_text: with lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.
target_text: te rèngu padhai lii hèb'a-hua dhu dènge boe sasoa. rèngu dadugu dhèu, sèna ka madhutu tao j'ara dhu lèke-lèke boe. rèngu d'èi pamako dhèu dhu heka lèpa hari asa j'ara mola, sèna ka tao hari j'ara karehe.

source_text: they promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. for a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se padhadha, peka na, ladhe miu nanene ji'i, na, miu neo tao ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi miu, na, tao laa! te ngaa dhèu dhu peka sèmi sèra sa, sama sèmi ènu dhu bisa boe pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a. te dhèu dhu soro tèke j'ara èci ator nèngu, nèngu j'aj'i le ènu ètu j'ara èèna.

source_text: if indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our lord and savior jesus christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
target_text: ladhe neo pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu ètu rai-haha dhu pakaj'alu èdhi, na, èdhi hud'i tadhe dènge be'a ku kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu nèti nèngu, hèia pa'èki hari dènge bhabhelu sama sèmi uru sèra, èèna nuka sèmi bhabhelu sèra ka dhu ator rèngu. d'ai lod'o limuri, rèngu asa tabha j'èra!

source_text: it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.
target_text: be'a risi, ladhe dhèu re'a rèdhi mèka j'ara mola. te ladhe dhèu re'a le j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, te ngaa ra pakaj'èu iisi ra, ka tao boe madhutu j'ara dhu be'a dènge dhu mola, dhu ama lamatua paredha le mi èdhi, èèna be'a boe.

source_text: of them the proverbs are true: a dog returns to its vomit, and, a sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.
target_text: abhu lii tate'a dhu palèke dènge mese kapod'e-kabèli se, dhu peka na, ladhe busa mèdhu, na'e hari mèdhu na. dhu leo hari peka na, masi ka padiu tare le hahi ci'u, te ngaa la'e hari loli èi lobho.

source_text: beloved, this is now my second letter to you. both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
