target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne, sasuri ka dua kèna nèti ja'a dhu ja'a pa'adhu hia miu. ètu d'ara sasuri dua se, ja'a pasanèd'e le miu ho bisa pangee j'ara-j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our lord and savior through your apostles.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie lii lolo nèti dhèu mola-mèci dhu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra. sanèd'e kahèi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus. pangee paie ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha mi rèngu ho peka mi miu. te nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala mi!

source_text: most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
target_text: sanèd'e sèmi ne'e: d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha sèra, abhu le dhèu dhu padhèto d'ara lii, dhu tao leli madhutu dad'èi ra. rèngu padhai lii pa'ele iie aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: where is the promise of his coming? they will ask. ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.
target_text: dhèu se, peka na, baku pusi-pahae! yesus padhadha, na, nèngu neo mai hari, do? ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu buli mia? te karèi nèti bèi-baki èdhi madhe, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne, ngaa-ngaa èci sa dhu ub'a boe. ngaa aa'i-aa'i sama sèmi uru-uru sèra, karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: but they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by god's word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water, through which the world of that time perished in the flood. and by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca j'ara dhu dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se ro'o boe sanèd'e. nuka, karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka liru j'aj'i dènge. ka na paj'aj'i èi. hèia na hag'e èi nèti rai-dedha, ka rai-dedha cèu nèti d'ara èi. ladhe lamatua padhai lii sèmi mia, na, j'aj'i dènge sèmi èèna ka. nèbhu ae ku, lod'o noh mamuri era, ama lamatua pake èi aae lala ho palaho aa'i mèu-mèu dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua dhu peka tèke le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a na tao ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. limuri ne lamatua tatae era, te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o èèna, tatu na neo tunu pakèpu aa'i si. te lamatua bèli-camèd'a papuru hahuku, sèna ka palaho dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se ro'o boe re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua tatu tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka sèra.

source_text: beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: with the lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu j'ara ne'e. lamatua èdhi ige boe lod'o sama sèmi dhu èdhi ige. te madhutu nèngu, na, ca lod'o bisa sama sèmi ca riho tèu. aa ca riho tèu bisa nuka ca lod'o doko di.

source_text: the lord is not slow in keeping his promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi pajaji neo tao ngaa èci sa, na tao pamèci dènge lod'o na, aa pamata boe. abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pangee, na, nèngu sab'a nena di. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna! te na taha d'ara, ho tatae d'ai ku lod'o na. dad'èi lamatua èdhi, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele-ho'a ku, sèna ka tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, hèia lèpa madhutu nèngu. te d'ara na la'e boe, ladhe dhèu pacèri nèti nèngu.

source_text: but the day of the lord will come like a thief. the heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a mema. te mamai na dènge sahèka, nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u maso asa d'ara èmu. lod'o èèna, aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru kèpu aa'i mèu-mèu, nuka madha lod'o, liru dènge hua-hètu. aa'i-aa'i ra ele! sèmi èèna kahèi, rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i. kèpu eele!

source_text: since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? you ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
target_text: de ladhe aa'i-aa'i kèpu ladhu ai sèmi èèna, na, mamuri miu hud'i sèmi ngaa sa? miu hud'i pa'èra-èra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. miu hud'i mamuri mola-mèci!

source_text: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of god, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
target_text: miu hud'i tatae mamai lamatua kahèi. de miu hud'i pa'èra taruu, sèna ka lod'o èèna j'aj'i malai risi hari. lod'o èèna, liru kèpu ladhu ai kahèi. aa ngaa aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru kèpu toke roe eele aa'i si.

source_text: but in keeping with god's promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, abhu liru rupa hiu dènge rai-haha rupa hiu. ama lamatua dhu moa tèke le sèmi èèna ka. j'ara se'e se ka dhu èdhi mate tae-tae. ètu era nèi abhu dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri mola di.

source_text: therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace-spotless and blameless in his sight.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o miu tatae j'ara se'e se era, miu hud'i bori pa'èra dhari ho j'aj'i dhèu be'a madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala asa miu. pa'èra sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: consider also that our lord's patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother paul also wrote you with the wisdom god gave him.
target_text: te lamatua èdhi taha d'ara, ho nèngu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu. a'ari èdhi paulus suri nèdhi le hia miu madha j'ara ae-ae dhu sama hua, si? lamatua ka dhu hia ne mamèu sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka nèngu suri madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: he writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the scriptures, to their own destruction.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu paulus suri sasuri, na peka kahèi j'ara se'e se. nèti sasuri na, abhu kahèi dhu èdhi te'a tare mèka sasoa na. abhu kahèi dhèu dhu pakapod'e asa j'ara leo nèti naneo paulus. dhèu se'e kahèi pakapod'e j'ara-j'ara dhu leo nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua. dhèu sèra, nuka dhèu bai-eed'a dhu ro'o boe pakanucu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, aa rèngu dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe. dhèu sèmi se'e se, bèli-camèd'a laho unu ra.

source_text: therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le j'ara mamuri nèti mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra. de baku pamud'e! te rèngu d'èi boe nanene atora èci sa. rèngu neo cob'a ho kapod'e miu nèti j'ara dhu mola. te ngaa baku soro tèke si segi miu. miu hud'i pakadhii ku lalèka miu.

source_text: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our lord and savior jesus christ. to him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. amen.
target_text: be'a risi parcaya miu asa tabha èra. te miu me'a le kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. aa nèngu neo miu tadhe ne be'a risi hari kahèi. ja'a d'èi ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus nèti doe ne'e toke d'ai mia-mia la'e! saloom, petrus

source_text: that which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands-this is the word of life.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne, lula-nèti lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri. lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri ne, abhu mema le karèi nèti rai-haha j'aj'i. ne'e ne, ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ladhe ngèdhi le nèngu dènge musi madha ji'i. ji'i tadèngi le lii na dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i. aa ji'i g'ag'e ngèdhi le nèngu dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi. ji'i ladhe ngèdhi ne sèmi èèna ka,

source_text: and this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the father and was revealed to us.
target_text: lula na cèu mai ètu talora aae ji'i. uru èèna, nèngu pea dènge ama na, te ngaa limuri ne na pad'elo le ngi'u aae nèngu mi ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bani lole dènge miu tasa mera mia dhèu rai-haha bisa abhu mamuri mola dhu dènge boe too-lane. te nèngu ne lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri.

source_text: we proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. and this fellowship of ours is with the father and with his son, jesus christ.
target_text: ji'i neo peka dènge miu, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i ngèdhi le aa aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tadèngi le, sèna ka miu dènge ji'i sama-sama bisa mamuri d'ara èci. te èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu pa'èki le dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na dhu nèngu pua mai, nuka yesus kristus.

source_text: we write these things so that our joy may be complete.
target_text: de ji'i suri sasuri ne, sèna ka pamaho'o d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara ji'i asa tabha karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and this is the message we have heard from him and announce to you: god is light, and in him there is no darkness at all.
target_text: a'aj'a dhu yesus lole dènge ji'i, èèna ka dhu limuri ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu. sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua be'a seli eele. bhabhelu-katub'a ciki sa abhu boe ètu nèngu. te nèngu ne nuka sèmi saraa dhu heo lo'a-lo'a, dhu pab'ali boe dènge maroga ciki sa.

source_text: if we say we have fellowship with him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
target_text: ladhe èdhi padhai lii, peka na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge lamatua, aa te ngaa èdhi mamuri tao bhelu era, na, èèna sama sèmi èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te èdhi padhai lii kapod'e-kabèli aa mamuri madhutu boe j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: but if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of jesus his son cleanses us from all sin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara mola, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa mamuri d'ara èci. aa d'ara èdhi mola-mèci, lula mamadhe yesus kristus, ana ama lamatua, aa raa nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi.

source_text: if we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi padhai lii, peka na, èdhi tao boe sala, èèna j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èdhi tipu ngi'u èdhi unu ti, aa te'a boe mia ka dhu lèke.

source_text: if we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi mangaku sasala èdhi, tatu ama lamatua dhu d'ara mola, saku eele sasala èdhi madhutu lii pajaji na, aa na pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: if we say we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar, and his word is not in us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi peka, na, èdhi tao tèdhi boe sasala, sasoa na, èdhi tao ama lamatua dhèu leko-monya! te nèngu ka dhu peka tèke, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manahu asa d'ara sasala-sasigo. aa ladhe lii padhai èdhi sèmi èèna, tadha na, lii holo-nori nèngu abhu boe ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: my little children, i am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. but if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the father-jesus christ, the righteous one.
target_text: ana pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a suri se'e aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka miu mamuri dènge tao ia ka sasala. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao sala, èèna na abhu kahèi dhu sarii èdhi ètu madha ama lamatua. dhu sarii èdhi èèna, nuka yesus kristus, dhèu mola-mèci dhu ama lamatua pua mai le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: he himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
target_text: nèngu madhe j'aj'i korban pala èdhi, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. madha j'ara ne hia boe mi èdhi mesa ti di, te ngaa hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne kahèi.

source_text: by this we can be sure that we have come to know him: if we keep his commandments.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, èdhi tadhe mèu ama lamatua ladhe èdhi madhutu paredha nèngu.

source_text: if anyone says, i know him, but does not keep his commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
target_text: dhèu bisa peka, na, ja'a tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa ladhe nèngu madhutu boe paredha lamatua, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, na, nèngu dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu padhai lii leo tao leo.

source_text: but if anyone keeps his word, the love of god has been truly perfected in him. by this we know that we are in him:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha lamatua, èèna j'aj'i tadha, peka na, sasue nèngu mi lamatua èèna, dhu lèke tare'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi te'a, na, èdhi dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: whoever claims to abide in him must walk as jesus walked.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mamuri pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, sasoa na, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi yesus kristus.

source_text: beloved, i am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. this commandment is the message you have heard.
target_text: ana pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii paredha dhu ja'a suri hia miu ne, j'ara hiu boe. te paredha ne dhu suri le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori lamatua dhu miu tadèngi le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: then again, i am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in him and also in you. for the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu j'ara hiu dhu ja'a neo suri lula-nèti paredha lamatua. lii paredha ne, j'aj'i le dènge be'a ètu d'ara mamuri yesus. aa paredha ne mulai sab'a le ètu d'ara miu, lula maroga ètu d'ara miu mulai ele, aa saraa dhu tare'a èèna, pasaraa le ètu d'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: if anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
target_text: dhèu bisa padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mamuri ètu d'ara saraa. te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, sasoa na, nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga era.

source_text: whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
target_text: lula dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa, nèngu hud'i pasue ku dènge a'ari na, aa abhu boe bhabhelu-katub'a ètu d'ara na dhu pamanahu nèngu.

source_text: but whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. he does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu gogo ai lae-lae, lula maroga pabèdhu le musi madha na.

source_text: i am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through his name.
target_text: ana-ana! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula kristus madhe le gati miu, hèia ama lamatua saku eele le sasala miu.

source_text: i am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. i am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. i have written to you, children, because you know the father.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu heka! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe yesus kristus, dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka. ana-ana ngèru! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu lab'a le bhabhelu-katub'a, toke segi.

source_text: i have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. i have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of god abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
target_text: ana-ana! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu heka! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe yesus kristus, dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka. ana-ana ngèru! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tèka le lii holo-nori ètu d'ara miu, toke miu j'aj'i èra, aa miu lab'a le bhabhelu-katub'a, toke miu segi.

source_text: do not love the world or anything in the world. if anyone loves the world, the love of the father is not in him.
target_text: miu baku sue dad'èi rai-haha, dènge mèdha-panyau na. te dhèu dhu sue rai-haha, bisa boe sue ama lamatua.

source_text: for all that is in the world-the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life-is not from the father but from the world.
target_text: madha j'ara dhu abhu ètu rai-haha ne, pa'èki boe dènge ama lamatua. nuka sèmi, dhèu dhu mamuri pakarej'e dhoka ngi'u na; dhèu manga'a; aa dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi lula kakaja-sasu'i na. j'ara sèmi se'e se mai boe nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa mai dhoka nèti rai-haha di.

source_text: the world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of god remains forever.
target_text: aa te ngaa rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele, palere-lere dènge ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu neo unu. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, dhèu ne ele boe, te nèngu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. this is how we know it is the last hour.
target_text: ana-ana! lod'o-lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe d'ai kèna. miu tadèngi le, peka na, dhèu dhu lab'a kristus, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai. madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu mai le. te ètu mia-mia, abhu le dhu lab'a kristus. se'e se j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lod'o-lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: they went out from us, but they did not belong to us. for if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. but their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
target_text: dhèu palab'a sèra cèu nèti talora aae èdhi. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu èdhi boe. te, ladhe rèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èdhi, tatu ra tèke eele boe èdhi, te ngaa ra taha taruu dènge èdhi. aa te ngaa rèngu rai aa'i le nèti èdhi. de lèke tare'a, rèngu se dhèu èdhi boe, si?

source_text: you, however, have an anointing from the holy one, and all of you know the truth.
target_text: te ngaa miu sama boe sèmi rèngu. te miu dhu sèmi mere le roh nèti dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua. aa nèngu soru-bara le miu, sèna ka me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: i have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a suri sasuri ne'e, lula ja'a pangee, na, miu me'a boe ngaa dhu lèke, do? aad'o! te miu me'a mèu le mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia ka dhu leko-monya.

source_text: who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that jesus is the christ? this is the antichrist, who denies the father and the son.
target_text: madhutu mola-mola na, abhu le ètu rai-haha ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. tasamia sèna ka èdhi tadhe si? rèngu sèra, nuka dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, yesus èèna kristus boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, yesus èèna, dhèu mola-mèci boe, dhu lamatua pajaji tèke hia mai. dhèu dhu padhai lii sèmi sèra palab'a dènge kristus, te rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dènge ana na.

source_text: whoever denies the son does not have the father, but whoever confesses the son has the father as well.
target_text: dhèu dhu tule eele ana ama lamatua, rèngu tule eele ama na kahèi. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mangaku ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: as for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. if it does, you will also remain in the son and in the father.
target_text: de miu hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra ngaa dhu miu tadèngi mere le karèi nèti uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na kahèi.

source_text: and this is the promise that he himself made to us: eternal life.
target_text: aa nèngu unu na ka dhu padhadha le dènge èdhi, peka na, pe èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: i have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne, sèna ka miu tadhe dhèu dhu neo leko-monya miu.

source_text: and as for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. but just as his true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in him as you have been taught.
target_text: miu sèmi mere le roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa miu mamuri pa'èki le dènge nèngu kahèi. de miu parluu heka dhèu leo aj'a-nori hari miu. te roh lamatua nia le, lula nèngu ka dhu bisa aj'a aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. roh ne kapod'e-kabèli boe, sèmi dhèu leko-monya sèra. de kèpe pa'èra-èra mi ngaa dhu nèngu nori le, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci taruu dènge kristus.

source_text: and now, little children, remain in christ, so that when he appears, we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge kristus. sèna ka ropa na mai hari, miu madha'u boe, aa dènge boe d'ara makae lami titu ètu madha na.

source_text: if you know that he is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le, na, nèngu tao dhoka ngaa dhu lèke, nèti èèna ka bisa me'a kahèi, peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ladhe tao ngaa dhu lèke, rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: behold what manner of love the father has given to us, that we should be called children of god. and that is what we are! the reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
target_text: miu pajiko sèku sasue ama ètu sorga mi dedha èdhi! te sasue na kapai titu kèna, toke na ded'e nare èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana nèngu. lèke si! te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi rai-haha, re'a boe, na, èdhi se cee, lula rèngu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: beloved, we are now children of god, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. we know that when christ appears, we will be like him, for we will see him as he is.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! èdhi j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, te ngaa te'a tare mèka, bèli-camèd'a èdhi j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa. dhu te'a, sèmi ne'e ka: bèli-camèd'a ropa kristus mai hari, èdhi j'aj'i sama sèmi nèngu kahèi, lula èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu iia-iia.

source_text: and everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as christ is pure.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatae mamai kristus, tatu ra pamèu mamuri rèngu, sèna ka mamuri ra mola-mèci sama sèmi kristus.

source_text: everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. indeed, sin is lawlessness.
target_text: sasala aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sala, sisu paredha ama lamatua aa palab'a dènge ne.

source_text: but you know that christ appeared to take away sins, and in him there is no sin.
target_text: miu me'a le, peka na, kristus j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. nèngu bisa tao j'ara èèna, lula nèngu mesa na tao nèdhi boe sasala.

source_text: no one who remains in him keeps on sinning. no one who continues to sin has seen him or known him.
target_text: de dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge ne, mamuri heka dènge tao sala. te ngaa ladhe dhèu loe boe ad'u-ue sasala, sasoa na, nèngu tadhe boe aa pa'èki boe dènge kristus.

source_text: little children, let no one deceive you: the one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as christ is righteous.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku lèke tipu. te dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, nèngu dhèu d'ara mola èci èèna ka dènge kristus.

source_text: the one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. this is why the son of god was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri ad'u-ue sasala, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae nidhu ne, baki nèti bhabhelu-katub'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka. nèti èèna ka, ana ama lamatua mai ho dhedhe palaho bhabhelu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: anyone born of god refuses to practice sin, because god's seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana lamatua mamuri heka tao sala, lula lamatua dhu pea le ètu d'ara nèngu. nèngu bisa heka ad'u-ue sasala taruu, lula j'aj'aj'i na nèti lamatua.

source_text: by this the children of god are distinguished from the children of the devil: anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of god, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa tadhe mèu, cee ka dhu j'aj'i nèti lamatua, aa cee ka dhu mai nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu dhu madhutu boe j'ara dhu lèke, aa dhu sue boe a'ari na, sasoa na, j'aj'aj'i na nèti boe ama lamatua.

source_text: this is the message you have heard from the beginning: we should love one another.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, miu tadèngi le lii moa dhu peka na, pasue èci dènge èci!

source_text: do not be like cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. and why did cain slay him? because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
target_text: miu sanèd'e era lii lolo kaen dènge habel, si? baku tao madhutu kaen, te nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a, ka nèngu pamadhe ari na, habel. nga tao ka nèngu tao sèmi èèna? lula kaen tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, te ngaa ari na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: so do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku malaa ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha d'èi boe miu.

source_text: we know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. the one who does not love remains in death.
target_text: èdhi te'a le dhu peka na, dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, ladhe madhe, nèngu cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa, lula èdhi pasue dènge a'ari èdhi, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ropa èdhi madhe, èdhi mamuri taruu dènge lamatua. te, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri dènge boe sasue, bèli-camèd'a madhe, na, rèngu pakaj'èu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sue boe a'ari na, nèngu cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu. de me'a le, na, dhèu dhu sèmi sèra sa, abhu boe mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: by this we know what love is: jesus laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a conto sasue dhu lèke nèti kristus. te nèngu sue èdhi, ka soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i soro ngi'u èdhi kahèi bagi a'ari èdhi.

source_text: if anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of god abide in him?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu unu d'ai, nèdhi a'ari na ca dhèu dhu mamuri susa, te ngaa na tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu susa ne, na, tasamia ka nèngu peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua! lèke boe!

source_text: little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku dhoka sue ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa tao j'ara dhu be'a, ho pad'elo sasue dhu lèke.

source_text: and by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in his presence:
target_text: te, ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue dènge ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, èdhi abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi madha'u heka, aa èdhi bisa doa kètu ropa èdhi ara lati asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: even if our hearts condemn us, god is greater than our hearts, and he knows all things.
target_text: masi ka d'ara iiki èdhi galaa èdhi lula-nèti j'ara dhu lèke boe dhu èdhi ad'u-ue uru èèna, èdhi madha'u ia ka. te rasa kasia ama lamatua kapai risi nèti rasa kasia èdhi. aa nèngu dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu kahèi.

source_text: beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before god,
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ladhe d'ara iiki èdhi galaa boe èdhi, na, èdhi bisa bani aa makae boe, ropa èdhi ara lati asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and we will receive from him whatever we ask, because we keep his commandments and do what is pleasing in his sight.
target_text: lula èdhi tao madhutu paredha lamatua, aa pakarej'e d'ara na, nèti èèna ka èdhi bisa abhu ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi manèngi nèti nèngu.

source_text: and this is his commandment: that we should believe in the name of his son, jesus christ, and we should love one another just as he commanded us.
target_text: lii paredha na sèmi ne'e ka: parcaya taruu ana na yesus kristus, dhu nèngu pua mai. aa baku loe pasue èci dènge èci, sama sèmi lii paredha yesus.

source_text: whoever keeps his commandments remains in god, and god in him. and by this we know that he remains in us: by the spirit he has given us.
target_text: dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua sèra, mamuri na pa'èki dènge ne, aa ama lamatua pa'èki dènge ne kahèi. èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, lula roh na mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from god. for many false prophets have gone out into the world.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku lèka leli lii padhai ladhe dhèu mai, peka na, nèngu nèti lii moa ama lamatua. te ngaa miu hud'i dadoo ne paie-iie, ho me'a mèu lii padhai na tare'a-re'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. te limuri ne, ae le dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu kako pale-lème rai-haha ne. dhèu se tipu dhèu, peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: by this you will know the spirit of god: every spirit that confesses that jesus christ has come in the flesh is from god,
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a mèu lii moa dhu tare'a-re'a mai nèti roh lamatua, dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua padhadha tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka neo hia ana na mai asa rai-haha ne. ladhe dhèu dhu nèti lii moa èèna mangaku, peka na, yesus kristus èèna tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi, na, lii moa èèna mema nèti lamatua.

source_text: and every spirit that does not confess jesus is not from god. this is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mangaku boe yesus sèmi èèna, nèngu mai boe nèti ama lamatua. te èèna mai nèti dhu lab'a kristus. miu tadèngi le dhu peka na, dhu lab'a kristus èèna, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai. madhutu mola-mola na, dhu sèmi èèna abhu le ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: you, little children, are from god and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! miu se, mema mai nèti ama lamatua, aa koasa na ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu segi le dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua. te roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, èra risi nèti koasa dhu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: they are of the world. that is why they speak from the world's perspective, and the world listens to them.
target_text: dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti rai-haha. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai lii ra pa'èki mèno madhutu dad'èi rai-haha. hèia dhèu rai-haha ne d'èi nanene si.

source_text: we are from god. whoever knows god listens to us; whoever is not from god does not listen to us. that is how we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
target_text: te ngaa j'aj'aj'i èdhi nèti ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua d'èi nanene lii padhai èdhi. te ngaa dhèu dhu mai boe nèti lamatua, ro'o boe nanene lii padhai èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu nèti lii moa lamatua, bisa te'a mia ka dhu lèke dhu mai nèti roh lamatua, aa mia ka dhu kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from god. everyone who loves has been born of god and knows god.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, lula kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri pasue mai nèti ama lamatua kahèi, aa ra tadhe mèu ne.

source_text: whoever does not love does not know god, because god is love.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasue tadhe boe lamatua. lula lamatua èèna, nuka sasue.

source_text: this is how god's love was revealed among us: god sent his one and only son into the world, so that we might live through him.
target_text: lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi èdhi sèmi ne'e: na pua ana na dhu dhodhoka ca dhèu èèna ka, mai asa rai-haha ne sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èdhi bisa mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: and love consists in this: not that we loved god, but that he loved us and sent his son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
target_text: ladhe neo me'a sasue dhu lèke tare'a, baku pasoro sasue èdhi dènge sasue lamatua. te ngaa ladhe sasue lamatua mi dedha èdhi, lula ama lamatua pua ana na mai, ho j'aj'i korban sèna ka gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge nèngu.

source_text: beloved, if god so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! lula ama lamatua sue èdhi seli eele, na, èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: no one has ever seen god; but if we love one another, god remains in us, and his love is perfected in us.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe nèdhi mèu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasue èci dènge èci, sasoa na, ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa sasue na asa tabha ètu d'ara mamuri èdhi, toke j'aj'i sasue dhu kateme.

source_text: by this we know that we remain in him, and he in us: he has given us of his spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, te'a, na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne, aa nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge èdhi kahèi.

source_text: and we have seen and testify that the father has sent his son to be the savior of the world.
target_text: ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ngèdhi le ana ama lamatua dènge musi madha ji'i. ka ji'i peka palème dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, ama lamatua hia le ana na mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: if anyone confesses that jesus is the son of god, god abides in him, and he in god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua, nèngu mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa ama lamatua pabe'a dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and we have come to know and believe the love that god has for us. god is love; whoever abides in love abides in god, and god in him.
target_text: èdhi te'a kahèi, peka na, lamatua sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya, nèngu sue èdhi taruu. lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha ne titu kèna. de dhèu dhu mamuri pasue, nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua, aa lamatua mamuri d'ara èci dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: in this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like him.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi d'ara èci dènge lamatua, sasue èdhi j'aj'i kateme. hèia, ropa d'ai lod'o èle ka rai-haha ne, lamatua parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, èdhi madha'u boe ara lati asa madha na, lula èdhi dhu j'aj'i le sèmi kristus, lod'o dhu na mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: there is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. the one who fears has not been perfected in love.
target_text: ladhe èdhi mamuri pasue, na, èdhi dènge heka d'ara madha'u ciki sa. te ladhe èdhi pasue dènge mola, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi pakaj'èu eele aa'i le madha'u nèti d'ara èdhi. ladhe dhèu madha'u, d'ara na susa, lula nèngu madha'u lèke huku. dhèu ne, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a mèka sue dhèu dènge mola.

source_text: we love because he first loved us.
target_text: èdhi pasue, lula ama lamatua dhu sue uuru le èdhi.

source_text: if anyone says, i love god, but hates his brother, he is a liar. for anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love god, whom he has not seen.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, nèngu monya di. te ladhe dhèu sue boe a'ari na dhu ètu katanga madha nèngu, tasamia hari nèngu sue ama lamatua dhu nèdhi mèka? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: and we have this commandment from him: whoever loves god must love his brother as well.
target_text: te ama lamatua unu na ka dhu papuru paredha, peka na, èdhi baku sue dhodhoka nèngu di, te ngaa sue ku a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: everyone who believes that jesus is the christ has been born of god, and everyone who loves the father also loves those born of him.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu peka na, yesus, tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu sue ca dhèu ama, tatu sue ana na kahèi.

source_text: by this we know that we love the children of god: when we love god and keep his commandments.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sue lamatua, aa sab'a madhutu paredha na, èèna peka na, èdhi sue ana-ana lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for this is the love of god, that we keep his commandments. and his commandments are not burdensome,
target_text: de ladhe èdhi sue nèngu, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku paredha na sèra. aa paredha na bia boe.

source_text: because everyone born of god overcomes the world. and this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
target_text: èdhi dhu j'aj'i le ana-ana lamatua, bisa segi dad'èi rai-haha ne, lula èdhi parcaya ne.

source_text: who then overcomes the world? only he who believes that jesus is the son of god.
target_text: te dhèu dhu segi dad'èi rai-haha, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: this is the one who came by water and blood, jesus christ-not by water alone, but by water and blood. and it is the spirit who testifies to this, because the spirit is the truth.
target_text: sad'i miu me'a, na, yesus, dhèu rai-haha kahèi, aa nèngu ne, kristus kahèi dhu ama lamatua hia mai asa rai-haha ne. lod'o nèngu neo pakako sasab'a-la'a na, yohanis sarani ne pake èi. èle èèna ka, nèngu madhe aa pasuti raa na kahèi. de dhu lèke ka, mesa boe èi di dhu yohanis pake sarani nèngu, te ngaa raa na dhu suti eele èèna dhu kab'ua risi. te roh ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna, aa dhu ne'a boe leko-monya.

source_text: for there are three that testify:
target_text: te abhu tèlu j'ara dhu j'aj'i sakasii:

source_text: the spirit, the water, and the blood-and these three are in agreement.
target_text: nuka roh lamatua, èi dhu yohanis pake sarani yesus, aa raa yesus unu na. tèlu j'ara se'e ka, pad'elo ca j'ara dhu sama lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of god is greater. for this is the testimony that god has given about his son.
target_text: ladhe dhèu rai-haha ka j'aj'i sakasii, na, èdhi bisa parcaya ne. risi-risi hari ladhe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ana nèngu unu na. aa te ngaa tèlu j'ara se'e dhu ama lamatua pake, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, yesus mesa boe dhèu rai-haha biasa di, te ngaa nèngu ne kristus kahèi.

source_text: whoever believes in the son of god has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe god has made him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that god has given about his son.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu ne sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, lula-nèti ana na. te ngaa dhèu dhu lèka boe lamatua, nèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua leko-monya! dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu sèmi boe lii holo-nori lamatua lula-nèti ana na.

source_text: and this is that testimony: god has given us eternal life, and this life is in his son.
target_text: isi nèti lii holo-nori lamatua nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, toke d'ai mia-mia. aa èdhi abhu mamuri ne, lula èdhi parcaya ana na.

source_text: whoever has the son has life; whoever does not have the son of god does not have life.
target_text: de dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ana ama lamatua abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ana ama lamatua, abhu boe mamuri sèmi èèna.

source_text: i have written these things to you who believe in the name of the son of god, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
target_text: ja'a suri madha j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i hia miu dhèu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sèna ka me'a mèu, na, miu unu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and this is the confidence that we have before him: if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, sad'i èdhi manèngi ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi bisa te'a tare'a-re'a, na, nèngu tadèngi lii manèngi èdhi sèra.

source_text: and if we know that he hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of him.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi parcaya tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, èdhi abhu ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi manèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: if anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask god, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. there is a sin that leads to death; i am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
target_text: ladhe èu mèdhi a'ari mu tao sala dhu nèti boe mamadhe, be'a risi èu sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua soru-bara a'ari èu èèna ho na abhu sod'a. a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: abhu sasala dhu nèti boe dhèu asa d'ara mamadhe. abhu kahèi sasala dhu nèti dhèu asa mamadhe. te ngaa ja'a pua boe miu ho sabaj'a ladhe abhu sasala sèmi èèna.

source_text: all unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
target_text: tatao karehe aa'i-aa'i, sala ètu madha ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu kahèi sasala dhu nèti boe mamadhe.

source_text: we know that anyone born of god does not keep on sinning; the one who was born of god protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama lamatua, mamuri heka tao sala, te ana ama lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ne. aa dhu bhelu-katub'a bisa boe segi ne kahèi.

source_text: we know that we are of god, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, èdhi kapua ètu d'ara ama lamatua. te ngaa èdhi te'a kahèi, na, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge koasa ho ator dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and we know that the son of god has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true; and we are in him who is true-in his son jesus christ. he is the true god and eternal life.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua mai le, sèna ka hia èdhi te'a mèu j'ara se'e, ho èdhi bisa tadhe mèu ama lamatua dhu tare'a. limuri ne, èdhi bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ne, lula èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ana na, yesus kristus. te yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua kahèi. aa nèngu ka hia dhèu abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: little children, keep yourselves from idols.
target_text: ana-ana, ee! j'aga paie-iie mamuri miu. mage abhu dhu seti eele ho gati ama lamatua nèti d'ara miu. d'ai sange ne'e ka. nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: the elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom i love in the truth-and not i alone, but also all who know the truth-
target_text: ina pasue! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yohanis, dhu j'aj'i ama gareja. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia mi ina, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa dènge ana-ana ina sèra. ja'a sue miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i, dhu re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, ra sue miu kahèi.

source_text: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
target_text: ji'i sue miu, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèle ètu d'ara èdhi, aa èèna na muri taruu ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: grace, mercy, and peace from god the father and from jesus christ, the son of the father, will be with us in truth and love.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge ana na yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia dènge rasa kasia ra mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dame, mamuri pasue, aa pa'èki taruu dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: i was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the father has commanded us.
target_text: ja'a karej'e titu kèna, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge ana ina cahag'e, dhu ra mamuri dènge be'a, madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi dhu ama lamatua hia le paredha mi èdhi.

source_text: and now i urge you, dear lady-not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning-that we love one another.
target_text: ina pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri ètu d'ara pasue. dhu ja'a manèngi èèna, paredha hiu boe, te ngaa ja'a dhoka pasanèd'e di nèti paredha dhu èdhi unu le karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: and this is love, that we walk according to his commandments. this is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
target_text: èdhi bisa pad'elo sasue èdhi, ladhe èdhi tao madhutu paredha ama lamatua. karèi nèti uru ka, na paredha le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. ne'e ne j'ara hiu boe, te miu tadèngi le karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: for many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of jesus christ in the flesh. any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli ae kako palème le rai-haha ne. rèngu aj'a, na, yesus kristus mai asa rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a boe. dhèu se'e dhèu kapod'e-kabèli kahèi dhu lab'a kristus, aa ro'o boe sèmi rare, peka na, yesus, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
target_text: j'aga paie-iie, ho èi kabhèsu èdhi baku core eele iia d'ara. de miu hud'i maj'èni sab'a taruu, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua moa neo hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of christ does not have god. whoever remains in his teaching has both the father and the son.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sigo eele nèti aj'a-nori kristus, nèngu pa'èki boe dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a na, nèngu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na, yesus kristus.

source_text: if anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu leko-leo lula-nèti kristus, na, baku sèmi mere ne asa d'ara èmu miu, aa baku soro-suu hia ne.

source_text: whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
target_text: te ladhe pusi-pahae ne, na, miu sèmi mere le sasab'a na dhu bhelu-katub'a èèna.

source_text: i have many things to write to you, but i would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. instead, i hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
target_text: madha j'ara ae era, dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa be'a risi ja'a baku suri ètu d'ara sasuri. te nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu padhai lii dènge miu, sèna ka èdhi sama-sama bisa karej'e-karae tare'a-re'a.

source_text: the children of your elect sister send you greetings.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare kahèi a'a ina. ana-ana na hia lii maho'o mi ina si aa'i-aa'i ètu èèna. sange ne'e ka. salam nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: the elder, to the beloved gaius, whom i love in the truth:
target_text: angalai gayus dhu ja'a sue tare'a-re'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yohanis, ama gareja!

source_text: beloved, i pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua j'aga èu, ho èu baku isi-noso kètu-kabo'o, aa d'ara èu be'a-be'a.

source_text: for i was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri a'ari dhu mai lolo dènge ja'a, peka na, èu madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: i have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
target_text: te ja'a karej'e risi eele, ladhe tadèngi ana-ana ja'a mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
target_text: angalai pasue! èu pakako le sasab'a ama lamatua dènge be'a, ropa èu sèmi more dènge hua iia a'ari dhu kako palème ho pakako sasab'a kristus. masi ka èu tadhe mèka si, te ngaa sèmi more si dènge be'a.

source_text: they have testified to the church about your love. you will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu lèpa hari mai, palolo hia juma'at ètu ne'e, peka na, èu sèmi more dènge be'a, aa sue si. limuri ne, ja'a manèngi ho èu soru-bara taruu dhèu sèmi sèra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: for they went out on behalf of the name, accepting nothing from the gentiles.
target_text: rèngu loe boe kako palème sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu nèti j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. te ngaa rèngu sèmi boe bantuan ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu parcaya boe kristus.

source_text: therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
target_text: de mema dhu lèke kèna, ladhe èdhi ka dhu soru-bara si. te dènge j'ara ne, èdhi pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: i have written to the church about this, but diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pa'adhu le sasuri hia juma'at ètu èèna, te ngaa diotrefes padedha iisi na nuka sèmi dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. aa na d'èi boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: so if i come, i will call attention to his malicious slander against us. and unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a dhiu, èèna na ja'a bhoke paled'a-led'a ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue. te na padhai lii pod'e-ed'o sèna ka neo pamanahu èdhi. risi-risi hari, na tule eele dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu dhiu asa èèna. hèia na kakèj'i a'ari ètu èèna kahèi, ho baku sèmi rare dhèu sèra.

source_text: beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. the one who does good is of god; the one who does evil has not seen god.
target_text: angalai pasue! èu hud'i madhutu ku tatao dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. baku madhutu dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a. te dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a, rèngu sèra dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a, tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. we also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
target_text: ladhe sèku demetrius. dhèu aa'i-aa'i koa-kad'iri ne lula na madhutu mola-mola j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu lèke. ja'a koa ne kahèi, aa èu me'a, na, ja'a monya boe.

source_text: i have many things to write to you, but i would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae-ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge èu, te ngaa ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri.

source_text: instead, i hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face. peace to you. the friends here send you greetings. greet each of our friends there by name.
target_text: te ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka èdhi paraga, sèna ka èdhi dua ti bisa padhai lii patoo madha dènge madha.

source_text: jude, a servant of jesus christ and a brother of james, to those who are called, loved by god the father, and kept in jesus christ:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yudas, ari yakobis. ja'a ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, dhu na sue, aa dhu yesus kristus loe boe j'aga si toke d'ai nèngu mai hari.

source_text: mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: beloved, although i made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, i felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! uru èèna ja'a neo suri sasuri hia miu, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu lii langu, de ja'a hud'i suri hari j'ara dhu leo. ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èdhi j'ara mamuri dhu mola. nèngu hia j'ara mamuri ne ca tèka di, aa na ub'a boe. nèngu hia j'ara mamuri ne mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'èra-èra d'ara, ho dhèu baku pakapod'e j'ara mamuri nèti lamatua.

source_text: for certain men have crept in among you unnoticed-ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. they turn the grace of our god into a license for immorality, and they deny our only master and lord, jesus christ.
target_text: te ngaa abhu le pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mai pahuni-pahuni ètu talora aae miu. dhèu sèra madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola, te ngaa ra madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ra. rèngu peka na, d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho rèngu bisa tao leli. èèna na omo koso! rèngu se dhèu dhu peka leo, tao leo! dad'èi rèngu ka, ho èdhi nanene ia ka dhèu aae èdhi dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, lamatua unu na ka dhu tao tèke le hahuku dhu j'èra karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: although you are fully aware of this, i want to remind you that after jesus had delivered his people out of the land of egypt, he destroyed those who did not believe.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu miu me'a le, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e hari, ho miu baku pamud'e. sanèd'e ku lii lolo uru-uru sèra, lod'o dhèu isra'el kalua nèti masir. masi ka ama lamatua hia mamuri le dhèu ca nau kateme, te ngaa d'ai loo-limuri, na palaho eele aa'i dhu ro'o boe parcaya ne.

source_text: and the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling-these he has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
target_text: conto leo, nuka ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, te ngaa dènge lane kahèi. te ngaa rèngu cahag'e roca boe, hèia ra tao risi nèti hak rèngu. hèia lamatua èki si, pake rate dhu bisa boe ma'ète, aa taha si ètu era maroga sèna ka mate d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua neo pama'ète sasala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: in like manner, sodom and gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, dènge rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu sèra. dhèu-dhèu ra d'èi dhoka ad'u-ue rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu rèngu boe. rèngu d'èi titu kèna pa'èci dhu lèke-lèke boe kahèi. te ngaa lamatua pakèpu aa'i si pake ai. lii lolo ne pasanèd'e èdhi, peka na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua pake ai naraka dhu madhe boe èèna, sèna ka huku aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu dhu maso asa talora aae miu sèra, mamuri ad'u-ue sasala taruu. aa te ngaa, lii nii ra, ka rèngu pake j'aj'i mi alasan ho pakaj'alu iisi ra, ho lab'a leli dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa, aa pahahe koasa-koasa dhu hua iia ètu sorga.

source_text: but even the archangel michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, the lord rebuke you!
target_text: te ngaa mikael tao boe sèmi rèngu. nèngu èèna, madho nèti ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. lod'o musa heka madhe èèna, mikael dhu pab'ala dènge dhèu aae nidhu lula-nèti ngi'u aae musa. te ngaa mikael pasala boe ne, do pahahe boe ne kahèi. dhoka na peka na, pe lamatua ka ator èu, heka èu sèmi more pala mu kèna!

source_text: these men, however, slander what they do not understand, and like irrational animals, they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu maso asa talora aae miu, sama boe sèmi èèna. dhèu se pahahe aa pusi-pahae boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu re'a boe. rèngu dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di, nuka sèmi badha sa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pa'ele iie ngi'u unu ra.

source_text: woe to them! they have traveled the path of cain; they have rushed headlong into the error of balaam; they have perished in korah's rebellion.
target_text: mata unu ra! pe sèmi rare pala ra. te tatao rèngu nuka sèmi kaen, dhu hake pamadhe ari d'èlu na. ra tao nuka sèmi balaam, dhu sab'a ngaa èèna ka, sad'i abhu doi. rèngu tao kahèi sama sèmi kora, dhu unu mamadhe-mamopo lula palab'a dènge lamatua. lula bhabhelu-katub'a ra, èèna na rèngu pakaj'èu nèti lamatua kahèi.

source_text: these men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves. they are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.
target_text: ladhe rèngu pakaboko dènge miu ho sanèd'e sasue lamatua, lod'o miu mi'a sama-sama, na, rèngu re'a boe makae, aa manga'a dèu ngara. de miu baku pamud'e. te rèngu nuka sèmi hadhu aae ètu d'ara dhasi dhu bisa pamae kapa. rèngu cakaraa liru mèdhi ètu dedha rai mango dhu papuru boe èj'i ca pasuti sa. rèngu dhoka lii padhai di dhu kapai, te ngaa tao rare boe ngaa èci sa dhu be'a. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana aaj'u dhu guna boe ngaa-ngaa. ladhe d'ai hèru hua, hua boe cue sa hèi; te'a boe, na, dhu bete eele le toke d'ai amo-èsu kateme.

source_text: they are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
target_text: sasab'a ra dhoka pamakae èdhi di. te rèngu nuka sèmi naha dhasi dhu tèke eele horo dhu pènu dènge kaj'alu dhutu-dhutu ètu sebhe dhasi. rèngu sama sèmi hua-hètu kahèi dhu la'e-mai ètu dedha-liru dhu abhu huku, ka lamatua tèke si ètu era èci dhu maroga aatu-aatu, hèia ele aa'i si.

source_text: enoch, the seventh from adam, also prophesied about them: behold, the lord is coming with myriads of his holy ones
target_text: henok, ana-èpu ka pidhu, ige mulai nèti adam. nèngu peka mema le, lula-nèti dhèu sèmi se'e se. te na peka na, miu ladhe sèku. lamatua èdhi mai dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga dhu mola-mèci. rèngu sèra, ae titu kèna toke ige tare boe.

source_text: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against him by ungodly sinners.
target_text: nèngu mai ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. èèna na nèngu pad'elo sasala nèti ca dhèu-ca dhèu, dènge bhoke paled'a-led'a tatao-tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. na pabèbhe hahuku mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sèra, lula padhai lii rèngu dhu lèke boe mi lamatua.

source_text: these men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.
target_text: dhèu se'e se re'a dhoka loe boe ka'ugu di. rèngu muri dhoka pasasei di. ra pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, aa madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara rèngu di. rèngu dhoka padhai lii padedha iisi ra. ra d'èi pahie rèhu dènge mangojo d'ara dhèu, sèna ka hud'i laa rèngu abhu pala madhutu dad'èi ra.

source_text: but you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our lord jesus christ when they said to you, in the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu lii padhadha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu dhèu pajuu-paleha na peka-padhai mema mi miu, na, ladhe oe èle rai-haha, dhèu dhu tema pa-aape dhèu, èèna na, cèu mai. rèngu d'èi pahahe dad'èi lamatua, ho madhutu dad'èi rèngu unu ra dhu koe-kapengo.

source_text: these are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the spirit.
target_text: limuri ne, abhu le dhèu sèra. rèngu ka dhu kakèj'i dhèu ètu mia-mia, sèna ka pamae-pamanyèla miu. mamuri ra dhoka madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci abhu boe ètu d'ara rèngu.

source_text: but you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the holy spirit,
target_text: te ngaa a'ari pasue! miu hud'i padhèdi ku mamuri miu mi dedha fanderen nèti lalèka miu dhu mola-mèci. aa ladhe miu sabaj'a, madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci peka dènge miu.

source_text: keep yourselves in the love of god as you await the mercy of our lord jesus christ to bring you eternal life.
target_text: sanèd'e, ama lamatua sue miu titu kèna. de j'aga ngi'u miu, aa sanèd'e sasue na. aa miu hud'i tatae taruu, sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo rasa kasia mi miu, aa hia miu mamuri dènge ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;
target_text: miu hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia mi dhèu dhu d'ara kajari.

source_text: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
target_text: miu hud'i bantu dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parluu abhu mamuri, sama sèmi miu ère dhèu nèti d'ara ai karoo. abhu dhèu leo hari dhu miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara be'a miu dènge rèngu. te ngaa, mage-mage! masi ka miu rasa kasia mi rèngu, te ngaa miu kahèi hud'i madenge ku dènge kaj'alu ra, nuka sèmi dhèu madenge dènge kodho dhu kaj'alu.

source_text: now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in his glorious presence, with great joy-
target_text: mai ti koa-kio padedha-dedha ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu bisa madhenga miu, sèna ka baku manahu. aa nèngu ka dhu bisa lere miu, sèna ka miu titu ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pamèu miu, toke hahera abhu boe ciki sa hèi. miu mai dènge d'ara karae, te dadedha na kapai titu kèna!

source_text: to the only god our savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through jesus christ our lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. amen.
target_text: dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa-mesa na, dhu j'aj'i lamatua dhu lèke, dhodhoka nèngu di dhu bisa pamamuri èdhi! hèia na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho pala-bagi èdhi mamuri. de lii koa-kad'iri hia aa'i mi nèngu. dadedha dènge kapai aa'i-aa'i unu nèngu. koasa na kapai titu kèna. aa hak paredha nèngu, karèi nèti uru ka, deo ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. tare'a-re'a! nèngu èèna kèna! nèti ja'a, yudas

source_text: this is the revelation of jesus christ, which god gave him to show his servants what must soon come to pass. he made it known by sending his angel to his servant john, who testifies to everything he saw. this is the word of god and the testimony of jesus christ.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yohanis, ana pua-paleha nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a. ja'a ke'a j'ara se'e se, sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka tèke mi yesus kristus. hèia ama lamatua pua yesus ho lole mi dhèu unu na sèra. èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai bhoke pad'elo j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a suri mema. te nèbhu heka j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, tatu j'aj'i. de nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu yesus peka ne.

source_text: blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu baca sasuri ne'e toke dhèu bisa nanene, na, rèngu oto titu kèna. aa dhèu dhu nanene isi na, aa tao madhutu sèmi dhu na moa, rèngu oto kahèi. te lod'o mamai na dètu ae le.

source_text: john, to the seven churches in the province of asia: grace and peace to you from him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, hia mi pidhu juma'at ètu propensi asia. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. te ama lamatua abhu mema le, karèi nèti uru ka. nèngu dhu deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a, toke d'ai mia-mia. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh na dhu mola-mèci pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. ja'a ladhe kèdhi roh mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi abhu pidhu roh sa dhu patangara dènge kadera paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and from jesus christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. to him who loves us and has released us from our sins by his blood,
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi ho yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ne loe boe padhai lii paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ama lamatua peka dènge ne. uru èèna na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne, ka na j'aj'i dhèu uru tèka, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe. pe nèngu ka dhu paredha dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. lula yesus sue èdhi, nèti èèna ka na pasuti raa na hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, na bhoke j'ara sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to his god and father-to him be the glory and power forever and ever! amen.
target_text: ka na ded'e nare èdhi, j'aj'i ana kabarai na, sèna ka èdhi sab'a hia ama na, ama lamatua. yesus kristus ne, kapai titu kèna, lula koasa na èle boe. lèke sèmi èèna!

source_text: behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him-even those who pierced him. and all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of him. so shall it be! amen.
target_text: de bhoke musi madha ho ladhe paie-iie! yesus dènge ama na, limuri ne ètu sorga nèi. te ngaa nèbhu heka na puru mai d'ara ra'i-liru. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na ladhe rèdhi ne, sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu uru na kèj'i ne. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne manyasa, aa tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula tadhe ne. se'e se, mema tare'a-re'a j'aj'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: i am the alpha and the omega, says the lord god, who is and was and is to come-the almighty.
target_text: ama lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, alpa toke d'ai omega. ja'a ne, a toke d'ai z. aa'i-aa'i ra kapua nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru tèka toke d'ai èle. ja'a ne dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka mai. ja'a dhu deo ne'e. aa ja'a dhu bèli-camèd'a, toke d'ai mia-mia. ka ja'a mesa-mesa ku dhu dènge koasa kapai risi eele!

source_text: i, john, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in jesus, was on the island of patmos because of the word of god and my testimony about jesus.
target_text: lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya, na, yesus ne dhèu aae èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi pa'a'ari. abhu dhèu leo dhu nasa kahèi lula èdhi madhutu yesus, ka rèngu paj'èra èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. te ngaa yesus pa'èra d'ara èdhi, ka bisa taha taruu. lula ja'a aj'a-nori le dhèu lula-nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus, ka abhu dhèu dhu tèka d'ara. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne ra kèpe rare ja'a, ka hue eele asa pulu patmos ne'e.

source_text: on the lord's day i was in the spirit, and i heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
target_text: ka d'ara ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a abhu roh ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, ja'a tadèngi lii rodhe nèti kabodho. lii èèna nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe sa.

source_text: saying, write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to ephesus, smyrna, pergamum, thyatira, sardis, philadelphia, and laodicea.
target_text: lii ne, pua ja'a, peka na, yohanis! ja'a neo bhoke j'ara èci, ho pad'elo dènge èu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi se, èu hud'i suri more ku. èle èèna, èu hud'i pa'adhu hia pidhu juma'at, nuka ètu kota epesus, kota smirna, kota pergamus, kota tiatira, kota sardis, kota piladelfia, dènge kota laodikia.

source_text: then i turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. and having turned, i saw seven golden lampstands,
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kabib'a asa kabodho, neo ke'a cee ka dhu lii deo na. te ngaa ja'a kèdhi labhu èi mènyi pidhu bua dhu pamadhèdi ètu dedha tatèka labhu, dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: and among the lampstands was one like the son of man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around his chest.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci dhu titu ètu talora aae labhu se'e. rèhu na nuka sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake kodho èci dhu robho d'ai rai, aa dhu cape dènge saledha hualaa ca bèla ètu kakara na.

source_text: the hair of his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like a blazing fire.
target_text: rèu kètu na pudhi lao-lao nuka sèmi rèu kahib'i-kalèbho pudhi. musi madha na heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai.

source_text: his feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and his voice was like the roar of many waters.
target_text: haga na mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga dhu tunu ètu d'ara ai karoo. lii na kadèru sèmi lii bèbhe naha dhasi kapai.

source_text: he held in his right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from his mouth. his face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
target_text: ètu ai g'ana, na kèpe dènge hua-hètu pidhu bua. nèti hèb'a na, bhodho samala èci dhu dua rèka dhu madèka. rèhu na cèb'a-cèb'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o dhu re mèu rai.

source_text: when i saw him, i fell at his feet like a dead man. but he placed his right hand on me and said, do not be afraid. i am the first and the last,
target_text: ropa ja'a ladhe kèdhi dhèu ne'e, hèia ja'a bèbhe dènge ka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe ètu haga na. te ngaa na gai ja'a dènge ai g'ana na, hèia na lii peka na, ana, ee! baku madha'u! te aa'i-aa'i se kapua ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru toke d'ai èle.

source_text: the living one. i was dead, and behold, now i am alive forever and ever! and i hold the keys of death and of hades.
target_text: uru èèna, mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, èu ladhe ku laa! ja'a mamuri hari le, aa èèna na mamuri taa-taa. aa ja'a ka dhu kèd'u gagoe dhu bisa bhoke era pea dhèu madhe, sèna ka pamamuri hari si.

source_text: therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
target_text: èu hud'i suri more aa'i ku dhu ladhe mèdhi se, aa suri kahèi ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: this is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
target_text: ja'a peka uuru ku sasoa na: labhu hualaa pidhu bua se, nuka pidhu juma'at. aa pidhu hua-hètu dhu èu mèdhi ètu ai g'ana ja'a ne, nuka ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti lii ama lamatua hia mi pidhu juma'at sèra.

source_text: to the angel of the church in ephesus write: these are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna paredha ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more ku sasuri èci. isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota epesus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u pidhu hua-hètu ètu ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a dhu kako palème kahèi laladhe pidhu labhu hualaa se cue-cue. nanene paie lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. i know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le, j'ara mamuri miu ètu kota epesus, peka na, miu sab'a bia hia lamatua. ladhe abhu dhèu bhelu ètu talora aae miu, miu soro tèke boe ne. ladhe dhèu mai dadugu, peka na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, miu parisa paie-iie mamuri na, sèna ka me'a na, nèngu ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. hèia miu tule eele, aa nanene boe ne.

source_text: without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of my name.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu lula miu parcaya ja'a, te ngaa miu taha taruu aa hari boe ciki sa.

source_text: but i have this against you: you have abandoned your first love.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca madha j'ara. lula uru èèna, lod'o miu hiu-hiu parcaya ja'a, miu mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi heka èèna.

source_text: therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. repent and perform the deeds you did at first. but if you do not repent, i will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
target_text: de miu hud'i sanèd'e hari ku j'ara uru èèna! te limuri ne, miu pakaj'èu ae nèti j'ara uru èèna. de miu ae eele ka nèti sasala miu se'e, sèna ka mi pasue hari sèmi uru èèna. te aad'o na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai kore hari labhu hualaa èèna nèti miu.

source_text: but you have this to your credit: you hate the works of the nicolaitans, which i also hate.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ja'a ako karej'e, lula miu tule eele lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai, dhu ana madhutu na sèra tao madhutu. ja'a tule eele kahèi tatao kapod'e-kabèli ra sèra.

source_text: he who has an ear, let him hear what the spirit says to the churches. to the one who overcomes, i will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the paradise of god.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu taha pa'èra madhutu ja'a toke na madhe, pe ja'a soro tèke na'a hua aj'u ètu d'ara talora oka ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu na'a hua aj'u èèna, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. '

source_text: to the angel of the church in smyrna write: these are the words of the first and the last, who died and returned to life.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota smirna: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka toke d'ai èle. uru èèna mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a mamuri hari le. de miu nanene lii padhai ja'a ne.

source_text: i know your affliction and your poverty-though you are rich! and i am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be jews, but are in fact a synagogue of satan.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le j'aj'èra mamuri miu ètu kota smirna. masi ka ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, miu unu aad'o, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua miu kaja. abhu dhèu dhu mangaku, na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa padhai lii pakarehe kolongara miu. te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu se unu boe lamatua. rèngu madhutu dhoka dhèu aae nidhu di.

source_text: do not fear what you are about to suffer. look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. be faithful even unto death, and i will give you the crown of life.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie. miu baku madha'u, ladhe abhu j'aj'èra era. sad'i miu me'a, na, dhèu aae nidhu neo tenge dhèu ho kèpe miu cahag'e, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara bèdho d'ai canguru lod'o. dad'èi na, sèna ka miu rai tèke eele ja'a. masi ka nidhu neo pamadhe miu èèna ka, te ngaa miu baku bhèlu ja'a kahèi. te dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pala-bagi ne mamuri, sèna ka na mamuri taa-taa dènge ja'a.

source_text: he who has an ear, let him hear what the spirit says to the churches. the one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu madhutu ja'a toke madhe, èèna na nèngu abhu boe j'aj'èra ètu d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo robhe-robhe kura boe ciki sa èèna. dènge sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu boe mamadhe ka dua hari. '

source_text: to the angel of the church in pergamum write: these are the words of the one who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota pergamus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u samala rèka dua dhu madèka. nanene lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know where you live, where the throne of satan sits. yet you have held fast to my name and have not denied your faith in me, even in the day when my faithful witness antipas was killed among you, where satan dwells.
target_text: ja'a ke'a mèu le kota pergamus miu èèna. te, dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu kèpe pa'èra kolongara ja'a, aa parcaya taruu ja'a. uru èèna abhu dhèu ja'a èci ètu èèna, ngara na antipas. nèngu aj'a lèke mola-mola j'ara mamuri ja'a, te ngaa ra pamadhe ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu pasili boe ja'a.

source_text: but i have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of balaam, who taught balak to place a stumbling block before the israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca j'ara dua j'ara. abhu nèti miu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti balaam. uru èèna balaam aj'a balak ho kakèj'i dhèu isra'el, toke ra sisu dad'èi lamatua. balak kakèj'i dhèu isra'el sèra, ho pae'a dènge ra'a-rinu mèdha sogo-tagu, aa ra tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra.

source_text: in the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the nicolaitans.
target_text: abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti miu dhu madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai.

source_text: therefore repent! otherwise i will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of my mouth.
target_text: de miu hud'i loe ku nèti sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, nèbhu heka ja'a dhiu pad'ui miu dènge lii sakaa dhu nuka sèmi pare dènge samala.

source_text: he who has an ear, let him hear what the spirit says to the churches. to the one who overcomes, i will give the hidden manna. i will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na. dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne na'a roti manna nèti sorga dhu tèke paie iie ne. pe ja'a pangèd'u ne hèi, hadhu pudhi cue dhu suri tèke ngara hiu na. dhodhoka nèngu mesa na di dhu ne'a ngara na; dhèu leo re'a boe. '

source_text: to the angel of the church in thyatira write: these are the words of the son of god, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota tiatira: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, nuka ana ama lamatua. musi madha ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai, aa haga ja'a mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga ètu d'ara ai. nanene ku lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know your deeds-your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance-and your latter deeds are greater than your first.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi le mamuri miu. miu sue ja'a tare'a, aa parcaya èra ja'a kahèi. miu madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu. masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu taha taruu. ja'a ke'a kahèi, limuri ne miu sab'a bia risi hari hia ja'a.

source_text: but i have this against you: you tolerate that woman jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. by her teaching she misleads my servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
target_text: te ngaa miu manahu ètu ca j'ara: miu sèmi mere dènge be'a, bhèni dhu ngara na isabel, dhu padedha iisi peka na, nèngu èèna dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. ka miu hud'i na sène, aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe mi dhèu ja'a. lula lii a'aj'a na dhu kapod'e-kabèli èèna ka, dhèu ja'a tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa ra'a nganga'a sogo-tagu.
