source_text: even though i have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
target_text: ja'a dhu kai le bhèni èèna pèri-pèri hari le, sèna ka ele-ho'a nèti sasala na, te ngaa na d'èi boe.

source_text: behold, i will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
target_text: de ladhe paie-iie. te ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho hia ne lèke papèd'a èci, toke na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu j'unu pa'èci dènge ne. ladhe rèngu tèke eele boe bhèni aapa ne, nèbhu boe ja'a huku si kahèi.

source_text: then i will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that i am the one who searches minds and hearts, and i will repay each of you according to your deeds.
target_text: èèna na ja'a pamadhe aa'i ana-ana nèti bhèni aapa ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra re'a, na, ja'a ne ke'a aa'i d'ara dhèu. pe ja'a b'ala miu madhutu tatao dhu miu ad'u-ue.

source_text: but i say to the rest of you in thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of satan: i will place no further burden upon you.
target_text: te ngaa miu cahag'e ètu tiatira sèra, dhu madhutu boe lii a'aj'a bhèni aapa ne. miu tule eele le a'aj'a dhu pahuni èèna, dhu ra peka na, ‘ilmu maroga nèti dhèu aae nidhu'. nèti èèna ka, ja'a parluu heka kai miu,

source_text: nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until i come.
target_text: sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu mi dedha ja'a, toke ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and to the one who overcomes and continues in my work until the end, i will give authority over the nations. he will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery -just as i have received authority from my father. and i will give him the morning star.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne koasa. koasa èèna kapai, nuka sèmi koasa dhu ja'a abhu nèti ama ku, ho paredha dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dènge tatea bèsi. ladhe abhu dhu lab'a ne, pe na ab'o palaho si, nuka sèmi dhèu pamae èru rai. èèna na, ja'a hia miu hua-hètu dhimu kahèi.

source_text: he who has an ear, let him hear what the spirit says to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: to the angel of the church in sardis write: these are the words of the one who holds the seven spirits of god and the seven stars. i know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota sardis: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. roh ama lamatua ètu ja'a. aa roh ne, pidhu rupa. ja'a dhu kèpe kahèi pidhu hua-hètu ètu d'ara ai ja'a. nanene lii padhai ja'a. ja'a ke'a le tatao miu ètu sardis. dhèu peka, na, miu se mamuri madhutu dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa miu nuka sèmi samanga aad'o ètu kètu.

source_text: wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for i have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of my god.
target_text: de kèd'i ka! pa'èra parcaya miu dhu oe èle na. te ja'a dhu parisa le ngaa dhu miu sab'a, abhu boe dhu mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: remember, then, what you have received and heard. keep it and repent. if you do not wake up, i will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when i will come upon you.
target_text: de baku bhèlu lii aj'a-nori dhu mola, dhu miu nanene aa abhu nèti uru èèna. madhutu paie-iie dad'èi ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe miu kèd'i malai boe, ho mi tao madhutu j'ara sèra, cag'ag'a laa ja'a dhiu nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu miu me'a mere boe.

source_text: but you do have a few people in sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with me in white.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e era nèti miu ètu sardis dhu mamuri mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pakaj'alu boe mèdha-papake ra. lula miu mamuri mola, ka miu nia kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, pake mèdha-papake pudhi.

source_text: like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. and i will never blot out his name from the book of life, but i will confess his name before my father and his angels.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pake mèdha-papake pudhi kahèi. bèli-camèd'a ja'a roso eele boe ngara na nèti d'ara sasuri dhu suri ngara dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. èèna na ja'a mangaku ne ètu madha ama ku, dènge ètu madha ana pajuu ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: he who has an ear, let him hear what the spirit says to the churches.

source_text: to the angel of the church in philadelphia write: these are the words of the one who is holy and true, who holds the key of david. what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

target_text: ja'a ke'a aa'i ngaa dhu miu tao. ja'a ke'a kahèi, pangaru miu kapai boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, miu pasili boe ja'a, aa madhutu taruu lii a'aj'a ja'a. sanèd'e paie, te ja'a dhu conge le babèdho hia miu, de dhèu èci sa bisa boe bèdho hari.

source_text: look at those who belong to the synagogue of satan, who claim to be jews but are liars instead. i will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that i love you.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te abhu dhèu leko-monya dhu peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa rèngu sèra, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu madhutu dhèu aae nidhu. pe me'a unu mi! ja'a tao si, sèna ka ra dhiu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha miu, aa ra mangaku na, ja'a tare'a-re'a sue miu.

source_text: because you have kept my command to persevere, i will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
target_text: lula miu madhutu le paredha ja'a, ka miu taha madhutu ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a bhabhae miu nèti j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo hia mai, ho sèku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i am coming soon. hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. de miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lii aj'a-nori ja'a, dhu miu abhu le karèi nèti uru ka. te mage dhoka abhu dhu parame rare rui-j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo b'ala hia miu.

source_text: the one who overcomes i will make a pillar in the temple of my god, and he will never again leave it. upon him i will write the name of my god, and the name of the city of my god the new jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from my god, and my new name.
target_text: dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pea taruu dènge lamatua, sama sèmi agarii aae dhu titu mèno ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua. pe ja'a suri ngara lamatua ja'a, dènge ngara kota lamatua ètu ngi'u dhèu ne. kota èèna ra pangare, na, ‘yerusalem hiu', dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua papuru mai nèti sorga. aa èèna na, ja'a suri kahèi ngara hiu ja'a mi ngi'u dhèu ne.

target_text: èle ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more ku sasuri dhu limuri tèka, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota laodikia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, dhu dhèu paroa na, ‘tare'a sèmi èèna'. ja'a ne loe boe padhai lii dènge mola lii holo-nori ama lamatua. dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua ad'u-ue sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: i know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. how i wish you were one or the other!
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le tatao miu ètu laodikia. te ngaa miu sèmi ngaa mèro? ! pana aad'o, aa pacuhi aad'o kahèi. ladhe pana, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pana! aa ladhe pacuhi, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pacuhi!

source_text: so because you are lukewarm-neither hot nor cold-i am about to vomit you out of my mouth!
target_text: te ngaa, lula d'ara miu kajari, bèli-camèd'a ja'a sabhuu eele miu nèti d'ara hèb'a ja'a, sama sèmi dhèu sabhuu ilu.

source_text: you say, ‘i am rich; i have grown wealthy and need nothing. ' but you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
target_text: miu padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ‘ji'i se, kaja-su'i. ji'i mamuri be'a, kura boe ngaa-ngaa! ' te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, d'ara miu dhu bèdhu le, ka me'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dhu dènge boe mèdha ètu ua mi.

source_text: i counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
target_text: de hua iia mai ho hèli mere poe-pai nèti ja'a, sèna ka miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. aa hèli mere mèdha-papake pudhi, ho pahutu era makae mi. aa hèli mere kahèi èi na'i musi madha, sèna ka roso mi musi madha miu, ho mèdhi mèu hari.

source_text: those i love, i rebuke and discipline. therefore be earnest and repent.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pasue ja'a tao sala, ja'a kai aa huku si, sèna ka ra j'aj'i be'a. de miu hud'i pamola d'ara mi, ho madhutu ja'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: behold, i stand at the door and knock. if anyone hears my voice and opens the door, i will come in and dine with him, and he with me.
target_text: nanene paie-iie. te ja'a nuka titu ètu hèb'a èmu ne, aa ja'a paroa taruu ho neo maso asa d'ara èmu. ladhe dhèu cee dhu tadèngi lii ja'a, ho na conge èmu, ja'a dhiu asa d'ara, sèna ka madhèdi ta'a-tinu pa'èci.

source_text: to the one who overcomes, i will grant the right to sit with me on my throne, just as i overcame and sat down with my father on his throne.

target_text: ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, peka nare lii moa na mi pidhu juma'at sèra, hèia lamatua bhoke pad'elo dènge ja'a, ngaa-ngaa dhu leo hari. ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna kahèi, ja'a kèdhi babèdho èci dhu bhoke le tangare la'e asa sorga. ka ja'a tadèngi hari lii dhu mèdhu nèti dhèu deo na, nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe, peka na, mai ku! ca'e asa ne'e, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo dènge èu ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: at once i was in the spirit, and i saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, roh lamatua ded'e nèti ja'a asa sorga. cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi kadera paredha èci, aa abhu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha.

source_text: the one seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
target_text: dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna heo mangèru dènge mea, èci èèna ka dènge hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dhu ra peka na, yaspis dènge sardius. abhu kahèi saroo èci dhu reo nare kadera paredha na. saroo ne heo na mangèru sama sèmi hadhu kale'e samrud.

source_text: surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu dua nguru èpa kadera paredha iiki, dhu reo rare kadera paredha dhu ètu talora aae èèna. ètu dedha kadera paredha iiki se'e, madhèdi katua dua nguru èpa dhèu. aa'i-aa'i ra pake mèdha-papake pudhi, dènge solo paredha dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: from the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. before the throne burned seven torches of fire. these are the seven spirits of god.
target_text: nèti kadera paredha ètu talora aae èèna, abhu bela dhu kacèb'a, dènge d'oro dhu lii mèdhu patuu ma'èta boe. abhu kahèi ob'o pidhu bua dhu heo ètu madha kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se, nuka sèmi roh ama lamatua dhu pidhu rupa.

source_text: and before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. in the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.
target_text: ètu madha kadera paredha ne, ja'a kèdhi èi, oe sèmi dhasi dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. hèia ja'a kèdhi badha èpa ngi'u dhu dhae kèdhi mèka ciki sa rai-reo kadera èèna. ngi'u ra nèti madha toke kabodho, pènu dènge musi madha. badha se'e ka dhu lalau-lalo'o lamatua.

source_text: the first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
target_text: badha ka èci, rèhu na sèmi singa. ka dua, rèhu na sèmi sapi mone. ka tèlu, rèhu na sèmi dhèu. aa ka èpa, rèhu na nuka sèmi manea luji dhu lela.

source_text: and each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. day and night they never stop saying: holy, holy, holy, is the lord god almighty, who was and is and is to come!
target_text: badha èpa ngi'u se, ci'u-ci'u ka dhu dènge èla ra, èna. re li'u dènge re d'ara èla se, pènu dènge musi madha kahèi. mèu-mèda, badha se loe boe sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua! lamatua èèna, dhu mola-mèci risi eele! koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. lamatua èèna karèi nèti uru ka mai. lamatua dhu deo ne'e ne. aa lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: and whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the one seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,
target_text: dènge ra sod'a sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio dènge pakab'ua ama lamatua, aa ra manèngi makasi mi nèngu kahèi, lula nèngu ka dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna, aa nèngu ka dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. ropa rèngu sod'a,

source_text: the twenty-four elders fall down before the one seated on the throne, and they worship him who lives forever and ever. they cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
target_text: hèia dua nguru èpa katua sèra pabèbha iisi ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna. katua se bhoke eele solo paredha ra, ka ra tèke mi madha kadera paredha èèna, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge boe too-lane. èle ka, ra koa-kio ne, peka na,

source_text: worthy are you, our lord and god, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things; by your will they exist and came to be.
target_text: ooo, ama lamatua! ji'i koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua. lamatua ne, kètu ji'i. lamatua ne, ama lamatua ji'i! lamatua ka dhu nia sèmi more koa-kio ji'i. lamatua ka dhu pantas sèmi lii pakab'ua ji'i. lula lamatua ka dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa lamatua ka dhu dedha risi eele. lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri aa'i-aa'i. aa'i-aa'i dhu tesa, j'aj'i, lula lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue. aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, dènge a'ae, lula lamatua ka dhu hia.

source_text: then i saw a scroll in the right hand of the one seated on the throne. it had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe hari nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna. na kèpe dènge sasuri ca lulu ètu ai g'ana na. ètu lalulu sasuri ne, dhu suri le re li'u dènge d'ara. ra segel le ètu pidhu era.

source_text: and i saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga ca dhèu dhu kapai aae. dènge lii aae, na karèi, dhèu cee ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel aa baca sasuri ne?

source_text: but no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
target_text: na karèi sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa ra abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak, ho bisa bhoke dènge baca isi sasuri ne. masi ka ètu sorga, do ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe èci sa hèi dhu dènge hak. ètu era dhèu madhe, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and i began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
target_text: ropa kèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke sasuri aa baca isi na.

source_text: then one of the elders said to me, do not weep! behold, the lion of the tribe of judah, the root of david, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.
target_text: èle ka, ca dhèu nèti dua nguru èpa katua se'e, lii dènge ja'a, peka na, baku tangi, we. te ana-èpu dhèu aae daud ca dhèu dhu kapai risi eele, dhu ra haji ngara na, ‘singa nèti udhu-rasa yahuda'. nèngu ka dhu ab'o palaho le aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a. de nèngu ka dhu dènge hak, sèna ka bisa bhoke segel aa baca isi sasuri ne.

source_text: then i saw a lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. the lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of god sent out into all the earth.
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kèdhi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu titu ètu talora aae badha èpa ngi'u sèra, dènge dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi reo rare kadera paredha èèna. ana kahib'i-kalèbho ne, oe sèmi dhu ra pamadhe le. nèngu ne dènge tadhu pidhu, aa musi madha na pidhu kahèi. musi madha pidhu sèra, nuka sèmi roh na dhu dènge pidhu rupa, dhu na papuru mai palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he came and took the scroll from the right hand of the one seated on the throne.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho ne, kako la'e asa madha nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, sèna ka sèmi nare lalulu sasuri nèti ai g'ana na.

source_text: when he had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the lamb. each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
target_text: ropa ana kalèbho ne sèmi nare sasuri, cag'ag'a laa badha èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua sèra, pabèbha iisi ra, ka ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. rèngu se èci-èci ka kèpe mèdha lii sod'a oe sèmi sasadhu sa, dènge mago hualaa dhu isi dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi, sèna ka ra pasèbu ho pahèu mèngi. raa aj'u hèu mèngi se'e ka, nuka lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and they sang a new song: worthy are you to take the scroll and open its seals, because you were slain, and by your blood you purchased for god those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci, peka na: ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu nia sèmi nare sasuri ne. ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel sèra. te nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe le. hèia ama lamatua pake raa na, ho sui nare dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu cahag'e bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu rai-haha nèti lii aa'i-aa'i dènge rai aa'i-aa'i, bisa j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: you have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our god, and they will reign upon the earth.
target_text: ana kalèbho ne'e ka, oru nare si aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ca rae-ca nadha. ana kalèbho ne'e ka, hag'e nare si, j'aj'i dhèu sab'a lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha. pe rèngu sab'a hia lamatua ètu rai-haha.

source_text: then i looked, and i heard the voices of many angels and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a boti kètu, hèia tadèngi lii mèdhu aae èci. hèia ja'a ladhe badha aae èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua se, tabha hari dènge ana pajuu nèti sorga ae titu kèna. ana pajuu se d'ai juta-kehi.

source_text: in a loud voice they were saying: worthy is the lamb, who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho dhu ra pamadhe le, lula nèngu ka dhu nia sèmi nare lii koa-kio ji'i! koasa na, kapai risi eele. kakaja na, lale-kabèle. ngangee lii padhai na, lèke mola-mola. a'èra na, èci sa risi boe. ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. ji'i pakab'ua ne. ji'i koa-kio ne.

source_text: and i heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: to him who sits on the throne and to the lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a tadèngi hari lii sod'a dhu leo èci. lii sod'a ne, mai nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu: sorga, dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhasi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a. nèti era dhèu madhe kahèi, ra madhutu sod'a. aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha. ji'i nedhe padedha-dedha kahèi ana kalèbho ne. ji'i pakab'ua rèngu. ji'i pahaha iisi mi rèngu. lula rèngu ka dhu rèd'u paredha taa-taa! aa koasa ra dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: and the four living creatures said, amen, and the elders fell down and worshiped.
target_text: hèia èpa badha aae se, loe boe dènge lii dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a! lèke kèna! ka dua nguru èpa katua se'e pabèbha hari iisi ra, hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, ho ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dènge ana kalèbho èèna.

source_text: then i watched as the lamb opened one of the seven seals, and i heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, come!
target_text: èle ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka èci nèti lalulu sasuri èèna. hèia ja'a tadèngi, na, èci nèti èpa badha aae sèra parodha dènge lii mèdhu, nuka sèmi lii d'oro. na paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: so i looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. and he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u. dhèu èci dhu manya'e pake dènge solo kapala musu, lula nèngu ka dhu segi taruu ètu d'ara pamusu. limuri ne na kèpe le kataki-hahusu, la'e ho segi hari musu na ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when the lamb opened the second seal, i heard the second living creature say, come!
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka dua. ka ja'a tadèngi badha aae ka dua paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: then another horse went forth. it was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. and he was given a great sword.
target_text: ka jara ci'u dhu mea gèu-gèu kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne sèmi nare samala aae èci. ra hia ne koasa ho la'e pamaruru ètu rai-haha, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha èci pamadhe èci.

source_text: and when the lamb opened the third seal, i heard the third living creature say, come! then i looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka tèlu. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii paredha nèti badha aae ka tèlu, peka na, lamu dènge ka! kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara mèdhi ci'u. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne nèd'u dènge kabatai cue, sèna ka tai nganga'a dhu oe kura kèna.

source_text: and i heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, a quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari, nuka sèmi lii èci mai nèti talora aae badha èpa ngi'u se, peka na, bèli-camèd'a, abhu manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna ètu rai-haha. gaji dhèu ca lod'o nia dhoka hèli laludhu tèlu moo di; te ngaa neo laludhu be'a, abhu dhoka ca moo di. masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pa'ele iie aj'u saitun dènge aj'u anggor ètu d'ara oka ra.

source_text: and when the lamb opened the fourth seal, i heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, come!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èpa. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii nèti badha aae ka èpa hia paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: then i looked and saw a pale green horse. its rider's name was death, and hades followed close behind. and they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi jara ci'u dhu rèu na sanama karara. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne, ngara na ‘mamadhe'. aa abhu dhu madhutu ne re limuri, ngara na ‘era pea samanga dhèu madhe'. rèngu dua ra abhu koasa ho lasi pamadhe dhèu ètu rai-haha pake samala, tèu manganga-madèu, papèd'a-tarègu, dènge pasoku badha hui dhu bhelu. ladhe ige aa'i dhèu dhu madhe, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kaboko nèti èpa kaboko nèti dhèu dhu pea ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when the lamb opened the fifth seal, i saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of god and for the testimony they had upheld.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka lèmi. ka ja'a kèdhi samanga dhèu dhu ra pamadhe uru sèra ètu ro'a mei korban. ra pamadhe rèngu lula parcaya ama lamatua, aa aj'a-nori dhèu taruu lula-nèti lii holo-nori na.

source_text: and they cried out in a loud voice, how long, o lord, holy and true, until you avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?
target_text: ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, oo lamatua, ama dhu kapai risi! ama dhu mola-mèci! ji'i parcaya ngaa dhu lamatua peka-padhai. te ngaa ji'i hud'i tatae d'ai pèri lod'o hari, heka lamatua pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu pamadhe ji'i ètu rai-haha nèi?

source_text: then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed.
target_text: ropa rèngu karèi rare sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu èci-èci ka abhu kodho pudhi robho d'ai rai. abhu dhu peka dènge ra, tatae hari ku ciki oo'e, toke miu tesa aa'i. te abhu anga miu era dhu ra pamadhe sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and when i saw the lamb open the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,
target_text: ka ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èna. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi rai-haha ne opo kapai titu kèna. hèia madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, nuka sèmi bèla mèdhi, aa hèru mea sama sèmi raa.

source_text: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu nèti dedha-liru bèbhe mai asa rai-haha, nuka sèmi hua aj'u hoa dhu kabhui, lula lèke ngèlu aae.

source_text: the sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe, na, liru mae bagi mi dua, ka lulu nuka sèmi dhèpi, toke ele. aa ledhe-ledhe dènge pulu aa'i-aa'i ra gaged'o, toke ele nèti era ra.

source_text: then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
target_text: ropa j'ara se j'aj'i, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, mulai nèti dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, komedhaa sordad'u, dhèu kaja-su'i, toke d'ai ènu sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi lu'u ètu ro'a-ro'a loe, dènge sasanga-sasanga hadhu ètu ledhe.

source_text: and they said to the mountains and the rocks, fall on us and hide us from the face of the one seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the lamb.
target_text: dhèu sèra pua ledhe-ledhe aa hadhu aae sèra, peka na, saguru mere ka ji'i laa! pahuni ji'i sèna ka nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna, baku nèdhi ji'i. aa ana kalèbho èèna huku ia ka ji'i.

source_text: for the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?
target_text: ira ii! ji'i laho mae-mae le, te lod'o d'ai mamadhe-mamopo kèna! ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho èèna, neo dutu nanasa rèngu mi dedha ji'i. te ngaa èci sa bisa boe sili rare, hèia tatu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: after this i saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhèu èpa puru mai nèti sorga, titu ètu èpa madha ngèlu ètu rai-haha ne, ho taha ngèlu. ka ngèlu bisa boe tiu asa d'ara dhasi, rai-dedha, dènge aj'u-aj'u.

source_text: and i saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living god. and he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa, ho ra pa'ele iie rai-dedha dènge d'ara dhasi. ka ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai nèti dhimu. na mai nèti dènge cap ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa. hèia na rodhe mi ana pajuu dhèu èpa sèra, peka na,

source_text: do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have sealed the foreheads of the servants of our god.
target_text: mate ku! baku pa'ele iie ku rai-dedha, do d'ara dhasi, do aj'u sèra. mate toke ji'i tao ngare ku cap mi katangarèi dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and i heard the number of those who were sealed, 144, 000 from all the tribes of israel:
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, ana pajuu ne tao le tadha mi dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu, dhu mai nèti suku isra'el. nuka:

source_text: from the tribe of judah 12, 000 were sealed, from the tribe of reuben 12, 000, from the tribe of gad 12, 000,
target_text: nèti suku yahuda, 12. canguru dua riho dhèu; suku ruben, 12. 000 dhèu; suku gad, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: from the tribe of asher 12, 000, from the tribe of naphtali 12, 000, from the tribe of manasseh 12, 000,
target_text: suku aser, 12. 000 dhèu; suku naftali, 12. 000 dhèu; suku manase, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: from the tribe of simeon 12, 000, from the tribe of levi 12, 000, from the tribe of issachar 12, 000,
target_text: suku simeon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku lewi, 12. 000 dhèu; suku isaskar, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: from the tribe of zebulun 12, 000, from the tribe of joseph 12, 000, and from the tribe of benjamin 12, 000.
target_text: suku sebulon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku yusuf, 12. 000 dhèu; aa nèti suku benyamin, 12. 000 dhèu.

source_text: after this i looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the lamb. they were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi dhèu ae titu kèna, dhu ige kore boe. rèngu mai nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i, aa nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. rèngu pakaboko tangara asa kadera paredha, aa asa ana kalèbho kahèi. dhèu sèra pake kodho pudhi, aa ra kèpe dènge rèu palam.

source_text: and they cried out in a loud voice: salvation to our god, who sits on the throne, and to the lamb!
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio, aku rèngu na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua ji'i, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho ne kahèi! rèngu se'e ka dhu pala mamuri hia ji'i. rèngu se'e ka dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hia ji'i.

source_text: and all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. and they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped god,
target_text: ropa padhai lii rare sèmi èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga dhu rai-reo rare kadera paredha ne, patitu kètu urutuu ra, toke rèhu d'ai rai, tangare asa kadera paredha aae ne. katua-katua dènge èpa badha aae sèra, tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua,

source_text: saying, amen! blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our god forever and ever! amen.
target_text: aa ra peka na, tare'a! èèna tare'a-re'a! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua kahèi! ngangee dènge lii padhai lamatua, dhu lèke mola-mola. koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. a'èra lamatua seli eele. ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ji'i loe boe pakab'ua lamatua. lèke! tare'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: then one of the elders addressed me: these in white robes, he asked, who are they, and where have they come from?
target_text: ropa rèngu koa-kio rare sèmi èèna, hèia nèti dua nguru èpa katua se, èci karèi ja'a, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae-ae dhu pake kodho pudhi se, èu tadha si, do? rèngu se mai nèti mia?

source_text: sir, i answered, you know. so he replied, these are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the lamb.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ama. ja'a tadhe boe rèngu se, cee. ama ka dhu tadhe risi. ka na peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, rèngu se, dhèu dhu bhodho nèti d'ara j'aj'èra aae. rèngu se, dhèu dhu pake le raa ana kalèbho ne, sèna ka rase mèdha-papake ra, aa tao papudhi kodho ra.

source_text: for this reason, they are before the throne of god and serve him day and night in his temple; and the one seated on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu titu ètu madha kadera paredha ama lamatua. mèu-mèda rèngu lalau-lalo'o lamatua ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i na. lamatua dènge si taa-taa. lamatua madhenge si taa-taa.

source_text: ‘never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat. '
target_text: pe rèngu re'a heka manganga. pe rèngu koko-kamango heka. pe madha lod'o pakèpu heka si. pe ka'uri rèngu carici heka lèke lod'o pana.

source_text: for the lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘he will lead them to springs of living water, ' and ‘god will wipe away every tear from their eyes. '
target_text: ana kalèbho dhu padètu dènge kadera paredha èèna, pe nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu bata-magee kètu rèngu. èèna na nèngu ka eo nèti si, lasi rinu asa madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu. pe lamatua saku eele sasusa ra, sèna ka ra tangi ia ka.

source_text: when the lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka pidhu. kabèdhi laa, aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga kalau-karèto boe. abhu boe lii èci sa, pe d'ai catenga jam sa.

source_text: and i saw the seven angels who stand before god, and they were given seven trumpets.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, titu taruu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu pa'èra lalau ne. rèngu èci-èci ka sèmi rare tèbhe ra.

source_text: then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. he was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, titu ètu madha mei era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. nèngu dhu nèd'u dènge mago hualaa cue, era isi raa aj'u hèu mèngi. hèia ra hia ne raa aj'u hèu mèngi ae-ae, sèna ka na pab'ali dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua. ka na nèti mago hualaa, ho tao sèmi korban dhu hèu mèngi, sèna ka la'e tèke asa dedha mei hualaa ètu madha kadera paredha aae.

source_text: and the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before god from the hand of the angel.
target_text: ka na tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ne. hèia hèu mèngi na ca'e asa madha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ne nare ai nèti dedha mei ne, la'e tao asa d'ara mago hualaa èèna. hèia na pèci mago ne asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti g'ana-kariu ètu rai-haha. ka lii tea ma'ète boe, aa rai opo kapai titu kèna.

source_text: and the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga sèra, pa'èra ho tiu tèbhe ra.

source_text: then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. a third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka èci tiu tèbhe na, hèia èj'i es aa ai pab'ali dènge raa, sabhori mai asa rai-haha. j'u'u aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia kèpu-ladhu ai. ca era nèti tèlu era ètu rai-haha ne, kèpu-ladhu ai. aa ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha ne, dhu kèpu-ladhu ai kahèi.

source_text: then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. a third of the sea turned to blood,
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka dua tiu tèbhe na, ka mèdha èci sama sèmi ledhe aae cue dhu heo robhe-robhe, pèci la'e asa d'ara dhasi, toke ca era nèti tèlu era ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa.

source_text: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
target_text: hèia ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko badha ètu d'ara dhasi, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko kapa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, laho eele aa'i si.

source_text: then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water. the name of the star is wormwood. a third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka tèlu tiu tèbhe na, hèia nèti dedha-liru hua-hètu aae cue bèbhe mai, nuka sèmi ob'o kapai aae èci dhu heo. hua-hètu ne, ngara na ‘pèd'u'. ropa na bèbhe mai, èi loko dènge madha èi, j'aj'i pèd'u. hèia nèti dhèu dhu rinu, ae ka dhu madhe. ladhe sèmi loko dènge èi madha ètu rai-haha ne hag'e mi tèlu, na, ca hag'e j'aj'i pèd'u.

source_text: then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. a third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu lèke hake, hèia maroga. ladhe re mèu, maroga èpa jam, lula madha lod'o heo iia heka. aa ladhe re mèda, maroga kiu-kiu èpa jam kahèi, lula hèru dènge hua-hètu heo iia heka kahèi.

source_text: and as i observed, i heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, woe! woe! woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!
target_text: èle ka, ja'a doa kètu, ka ladhe kèdhi manea luji ci'u dhu lela dedha titu kèna. na parodha, peka na, kasian! kasian! bèli-camèd'a j'aj'èra kapai lèke dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. te ana pajuu dhèu tèlu era, dhu tiu mèka tèbhe ra.

source_text: then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and i saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the abyss.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka lèmi tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi hua-hètu cue bèbhe asa rai-haha. ra pangèd'u hua-hètu ne gagoe èci, ho na bhoke babèdho ro'a j'aj'èra dhu marèma na dènge boe too.

source_text: the star opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.
target_text: lod'o na bhoke nare babèdho ro'a ne, kaca'a laa sèb'u dhu mèdhi guru-guru kalua mai, nuka sèmi sèb'u ai na'e j'ami. sèb'u ne kalua mai dhu kahore-kahore, ca'e la'e asa dedha, ka dedha-liru dènge madha lod'o maroga.

source_text: and out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
target_text: hèia kabara ae titu kèna, lela nèti d'ara sèb'u ai ne, ka bèbhe asa rai-haha. ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u le koasa mi rèngu, sama sèmi karakarai.

source_text: they were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of god on their foreheads.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge si, ho baku pa'ele iie j'u'u, aj'u-aj'u, dènge ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha. te ngaa ra hud'i paj'èra ku dhèu dhu dènge boe tadha lamatua ètu katangarèi ra.

source_text: the locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
target_text: lamatua soro tèke kabara se paj'èra dhèu sèra toke d'ai lèmi hèru, te ngaa bisa boe pamadhe si. dhodhoka tao papèd'a di, sama sèmi karakarai tèpu.

source_text: in those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lèmi hèru èèna, rarii aa j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi madhe. masi ka sèmi èèna, ra madhe boe.

source_text: and the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men.
target_text: ja'a ladhe rupa kabara se sama sèmi jara pamusu. rèngu pake solo kapala musu dhu tao nèti hualaa. rèhu ra sama sèmi rèhu dhèu.

source_text: they had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
target_text: rèu kètu ra madhera èci èèna ka dènge rèu kètu dhèu bhèni. ngutu ra mariu sèmi ngutu singa.

source_text: they also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
target_text: rèngu se oe sèmi pake kodho bèsi ètu sangasa ra. lii kahaku èla ra mèdhu sama sèmi jara sordad'u ae titu kèna dhu ère kareta pamusu ra.

source_text: they had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
target_text: rèu lai ra èra titu kèna, aa dhu dènge raco nuka sèmi raco karakarai. rèngu se abhu koasa, ho paj'èra dhèu pake raco ra, toke d'ai lèmi hèru.

source_text: they were ruled by a king, the angel of the abyss. his name in hebrew is abaddon, and in greek it is apollyon.
target_text: dhèu aae kabara se, nuka kètu nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra babège si nèti d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. ngara na ètu d'ara lii ibrani, abadon, aa madhutu lii yunani, apolion. sasoa na, dhu d'èi pa'ele iie.

source_text: the first woe has passed. behold, two woes are still to follow.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, seli le j'aj'èra ka èci. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te dua j'aj'èra dhu leo era, dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i hari.

source_text: then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and i heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before god
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka èna tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi mei hualaa, era dhu pake tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi, dhu patangara dènge lamatua. ka lii èci kalua nèti èpa tadhu ètu kabicu mei èèna,

source_text: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, release the four angels who are bound at the great river euphrates.
target_text: ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhu heka tiu nare tèbhe na, abhu ana pajuu dhèu èpa, dhu nèbhu nare sange ne'e lèke èki ètu d'ara loko aae èci, dhu ngara na efrat. lamu patabuli eele si!

source_text: so the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
target_text: hèia la'e patabuli si, sèna ka ana pajuu èpa se lasi pamadhe dhèu, dhu lèke dènge tèu na, hèru na, lod'o na, dènge jam na, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le. ladhe èdhi bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne mi tèlu kaboko, na, dhu madhe, ca kaboko.

source_text: and the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; i heard their number.
target_text: rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, sordad'u ana pajuu dhu ca'e jara pamusu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dua ngasu juta dhèu.

source_text: now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: the riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. the heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi sordad'u dènge jara ra. sordad'u se dhu pake kodho bèsi pa'abhe sangasa ra. kodho se nuka, dhu mea gèu-gèu, mangèru kale'e, dènge karara oe sèmi èi nasu. rupa kètu jara se, sama sèmi kètu singa. nèti hèb'a jara se, kalua ai, sèb'u, aa èi nasu,

source_text: a third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.
target_text: ho hia j'aj'èra tèlu rupa asa rai-haha, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne madhe aa'i ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko.

source_text: for the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia jara se lasi paj'èra dhèu pake hèb'a dènge rèu lai ra. ètu rèu lai ra, abhu kètu sèmi kètu mege.

source_text: now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. they did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha, dhu ra pamadhe boe nèti j'aj'èra se'e. masi ka sèmi èèna, rèngu neo boe tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a ra. rèngu sogo-tagu taruu nidhu aa mèdha-panyau dhu ra tao nèti hualaa, doi pudhi, tabaga, hadhu, dènge aj'u. masi ka mèdha se bisa boe rèdhi ngaa-ngaa, bisa boe tadèngi ngaa-ngaa, aa bisa boe kako, te ngaa ra loe boe sogo-tagu si.

source_text: furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.
target_text: dhèu se'e ro'o boe loe kahèi nèti sasala dhu leo, nuka sèmi pamadhe dhèu, pake na'i nidhu, tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa mana'u pagogo-pagero.

source_text: then i saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. his face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhu kapai èci puru mai nèti sorga. ra'i-liru sarimu nare ngi'u na. kètu na dhu poi dènge saroo. rèhu na heo sama sèmi madha lod'o, aa haga na heo èci èèna ka dènge heo ai.

source_text: he held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. he placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
target_text: nèngu ne kèpe dènge lalulu sasuri iiki, dhu bhoke tèke. na titu, haga g'ana na ètu d'ara dhasi, haga kariu na ètu dedha-rai.

source_text: then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. and when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo-parodha, sèmi lii taraa singa. ropa na pa'oo-parodha nare, hèia d'oro lii pagod'o-god'o pidhu hari.

source_text: when the seven thunders had spoken, i was about to put it in writing. but i heard a voice from heaven saying, seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.
target_text: ropa d'oro lii, ka ja'a neo suri lii padhai ra. te ngaa ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti sorga, peka na, èu baku lolo dènge dhèu lii padhai lula-nèti pidhu d'oro se'e! mage mu suri ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: then the angel i had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu titu haga calaa ètu dedha-rai, aa haga calaa ètu d'ara dhasi èèna, j'oka ai g'ana na asa dedha-liru,

source_text: and he swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: there will be no more delay!
target_text: hèia na subha, peka na, lii dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu taa-taa! nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, aa isi ra aa'i-aa'i. nanene paie-iie! lod'o dhu èdhi tatae èèna, mamai na oe dètu le.

source_text: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of god will be fulfilled, just as he proclaimed to his servants the prophets.
target_text: te ladhe ana pajuu lamatua ka pidhu èèna neo tiu tèbhe na, pe lamatua tao madhutu ngaa dhu uru èèna dhèu dhae re'a mèka. te ngaa, ngaa dhu na neo tao ne, na peka le dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na dhu lalau-lalo'o ne. de nanene paie-iie, te lii padhai ja'a ne lèke tare'a.

source_text: then the voice that i had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.
target_text: ka lii dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti dedha-liru èèna, peka hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, lamu ka asa ana pajuu nèti sorga nèi, dhu titu haga na calaa ètu rai-dedha, aa calaa ètu d'ara dhasi. more nèti kacui-aai na, lalulu sasuri iiki dhu bhoke tèke èèna.

source_text: and i went to the angel and said, give me the small scroll. take it and eat it, he said. it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.
target_text: hèia ja'a laku dènge ka asa ana pajuu ne, manèngi kore sasuri iiki èèna. ka na lii dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, more ho mu'a ka! èèna na d'ara hèb'a èu, rasa kee nuka sèmi dhua nasu oni, te ngaa ètu d'ara kabake èu, rasa pèd'u.

source_text: so i took the small scroll from the angel's hand and ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when i had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka ja'a sèmi kore sasuri iiki èèna nèti kacui-aai na. hèia ja'a ku'e dènge ka. ètu d'ara hèb'a ja'a ne kee sèmi dhua nasu oni. te ngaa ropa ja'a dhèle, ja'a rasa na ètu d'ara kabake ja'a pèd'u.

source_text: and they told me, you must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.
target_text: ka abhu dhu pua ja'a, peka na, èu hud'i lamu hari ku, ho peka dènge ka ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo tao ètu rai-haha. peka j'ara-j'ara dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i, mi dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: then i was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, go and measure the temple of god and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
target_text: hèia ra j'ole hia ja'a aj'u a'uku calaa dhu madhera nuka sèmi tatea. ka ama lamatua paredha ja'a, peka na, yohanis, lamu ho uku èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a dènge mei sogo-tagu na ètu kota yerusalem. aa ige dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu èèna.

source_text: but exclude the courtyard outside the temple. do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
target_text: te ngaa madha èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, mage mu uku, te era èèna dhu hag'e eele le hia suku-suku leo dhu tadhe boe ja'a. èèna na rèngu mai j'aj'èli leli ho pakaj'alu kota ja'a ne, d'ai tèlu tèu dènge cabèka nuka, 1. 260 ca riho dua ngasu èna nguru lod'o.

source_text: and i will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1, 260 days, clothed in sackcloth.
target_text: pe ja'a pua dhèu ja'a dhèu dua lasi asa era èèna, sèna ka rèti lii padhai ja'a. dhèu dua se pake mèdha sasusa, aa ra lole lii moa nèti ja'a, toke èle 1. ca riho dua ngasu èna nguru lod'o èèna.

source_text: these witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the lord of the earth.
target_text: sakaria, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri mema le nèti uru ka, lula-nèti dhèu dua se. na pakasame sèmi aj'u saitun dua kapua, aa era tatèke labhu dua, dhu patitu tangare asa ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: if anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. in this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo paj'èra dhèu dua dhu rèti lii padhai lamatua, èèna na ai bhodho nèti d'ara hèb'a ra, ho pakèpu aa'i musu ra. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu dhu neo paj'èra si, tatu madhe.

source_text: these witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
target_text: lod'o dua ra j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua pangèd'u ra koasa ho ra bisa taha èj'i, koasa sèna ka tao madha èi j'aj'i raa, aa koasa ho ad'u-ue rupa-rupa mamadhe-mamopo ètu rai-haha, madhutu dad'èi ra.

source_text: when the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.
target_text: lod'o d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ra, èèna na badha bhelu ci'u bhodho mai nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. badha ne'e lab'a rèngu dua ra, toke na segi si, aa na pamadhe dua ra.

source_text: their bodies will lie in the street of the great city-figuratively called sodom and egypt-where their lord was also crucified. for three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dua ra madhe ètu kota kapai, dhu uru èèna era dhèu paku pamadhe lamatua rèngu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te kota ne'e j'aj'i le kota bhelu, sèmi kota sodom dènge rai masir uru èèna. èèna na, dhèu core eele ngi'u aae dua ra, toke d'ai tèlu lod'o dènge ca èta. ka dhèu-dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i ra, mai lingu. dhèu se ro'o boe hia ijin ho padhane si,

source_text: and those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them, and will celebrate and send one another gifts, because these two prophets had tormented them.
target_text: lula ra karej'e laladhe ngi'u aae dhèu dua se, dhu mai lalai ngangee dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra tao pesta, aa ra pa'adhu hadia èci dènge èci.

source_text: but after the three and a half days, the breath of life from god entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.
target_text: te ngaa ropa èle tèlu lod'o dènge ca èta, hèia ama lamatua hia si a'ae, ka dua ra mamuri hari. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi si, madha'u toke isi ra rèbha-rèbha.

source_text: and the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying, come up here. and they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them.
target_text: ka dhèu dua se tadèngi lii dhu mèdhu èci nèti dedha-liru pua ra, peka na, dua mi ca'e ka asa ne'e mai! hèia dua ra ca'e asa dedha-liru lasi dènge ra'i-liru dhu sarimu nare si. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musu ra malaa ko'a-ko'a sène.

source_text: and in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the god of heaven.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rai opo dhu kapai titu kèna. ladhe ige èmu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota, nèti canguru èmu, dhu guri, cue. aa dhèu dhu madhe, pidhu riho dhèu. dhu madhe boe, ra madha'u bia. te ngaa rèngu èèna na pakab'ua kahèi kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha ètu sorga.

source_text: the second woe has passed. behold, the third woe is coming shortly.
target_text: dènge sèmi ne'e, j'aj'èra ka dua seli le. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te calaka ka tèlu oe mai kèna.

source_text: then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: the kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our lord and of his christ, and he will reign forever and ever.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu lamatua ka pidhu tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, ja'a tadèngi lii ae-ae nèti sorga, dhu peka na, limuri ne, dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha, dhodhoka ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua hag'e nare karèi nèti uru ka mai. èèna na lamatua nèd'u paredha taa-taa, sama sèmi dhèu aae.

source_text: and the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before god fell on their faces and worshiped god,
target_text: ka dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha ètu madha ama lamatua, tadèngi lii èèna kahèi. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, toke rèhu ra d'ai rai, ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua,

source_text: saying: we give thanks to you, o lord god almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.
target_text: aa sod'a, peka na, oo ama lamatua! kètu ji'i! ama lamatua ji'i! lamatua ka dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i. lamatua ka dhu koasa nare aa'i. lamatua ka dhu karèi nèti uru ka mai. lamatua ka dhu deo ne'e ne. ji'i manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula ama pake le koasa mu dhu kapai risi, sèna ka mèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha.

source_text: the nations were enraged, and your wrath has come. the time has come to judge the dead and to reward your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear your name, both small and great- and to destroy those who destroy the earth.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti suku-suku nasa titu kèna, lula rèngu ro'o boe madhutu lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua nasa kahèi, lula rèngu ro'o boe tadhe ne. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka lamatua huku dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, ho lamatua palaho dhèu dhu palaho dhèu leo. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, ho lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu madhe. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, ho lamatua b'ae-baj'a èi kabhèsu dhèu sab'a na. nuka: dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, dènge dhèu unu lamatua, ana iiki-dhèu kapai, dhèu ngèru-dhèu heka. lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, dhu pakab'ua kolongara na.

source_text: then the temple of god in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant appeared in his temple. and there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi babèdho èmu manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua ètu sorga, dhu conge tèke. ka ja'a kèdhi boaraka dhu uru èèna era tèke lii paredha ama lamatua dhu suri ètu lei hadhu. hèia bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti haa, nèti dhimu, d'oro lii pagod'o-god'o, rai-haha ne karedha, dènge èj'i es hadhu dhu bia, kabhui mai nèti dedha-liru.

source_text: and a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
target_text: ka cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi tadha èci dhu kapai titu kèna cèu ètu dedha-liru, dhu dhèu dhae rèdhi mèka ca tèka sa. tadha ne, nuka sèmi: bhèni ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pahutu dènge madha lod'o. hèru j'aj'i mi era pacapa haga na. nèngu pake solo dhèu aae, dhu dènge hua-hètu canguru dua bua.

source_text: she was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
target_text: bhèni ne dènge babia, ka dhu tangi, te abhu le tadha ho nara iisi.

source_text: then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi hari tadha èci dhu kapai aae, dhu cèu ètu dedha-liru kahèi. tadha ne, nuka mege naga mea ci'u dhu kapai. kètu na pidhu, aa tadhu na canguru bua. ètu kètu na sèra, dhu pake solo dhèu aae.

source_text: his tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, tossing them to the earth. and the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
target_text: na pake rèu lai na, ho saku eele hua-hètu ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko ètu dedha-liru. hèia na core hua-hètu se asa rai-haha. ka la'e titu ètu madha bhèni ne, na tatae toke bhèni ne nara iisi. te na neo dhèle dènge ka ana nèti bhèni ne.

source_text: and she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. and her child was caught up to god and to his throne.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai parame nare ana ne, ka rai nèti asa lamatua, sèna ka nèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga. te bèli-camèd'a ana ne paredha suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha dènge koasa dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: and the woman fled into the wilderness, where god had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1, 260 days.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne rai la'e asa d'ara mamoo èci dhu lamatua tao tèke hia ne. pe ra ladhe-leru ne, toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta, nuka, 1. 260 ca riho dua ngasu èna nguru lod'o.

source_text: then a war broke out in heaven: michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
target_text: èle èèna ka, j'aj'i pamusu aae ètu sorga. ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, dènge kapala musu ra mikael, lab'a mege naga dènge ana pajuu na.

source_text: but the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
target_text: ka mikael si segi mege naga ne dènge ana pajuu na sèra. èle ka, ra kai mege naga ne dènge ana pajuu na sèra, ho pea ia ka ètu sorga.

source_text: and the great dragon was hurled down-that ancient serpent called the devil and satan, the deceiver of the whole world. he was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra bhabhoo eele si nèti sorga, hèia core si asa rai-haha. mege naga ne, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ngara na ‘lamatua nidhu'. karèi nèti uru ka, nèngu ne'e ka dhu leko-monya dhèu ho ad'u-ue sasala.

source_text: and i heard a loud voice in heaven saying: now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our god, and the authority of his christ. for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down- he who accuses them day and night before our god.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari lii dhu mèdhu èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, uru èèna, mege naga ne'e ka dhu titu dhii-dhii ètu madha ama lamatua. sasab'a nèngu, nuka pèci sasala asa a'ari èdhi, dhèu parcaya sèra. na loe boe galaa si mèu-mèda. te ngaa limuri ne, ra bhabhoo eele ne nèti sorga. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i tesa le. te d'ai lod'o na kèna, sèna ka lamatua hia mamuri mi dhèu rai-haha. limuri ne lamatua nèd'u le paredha dènge koasa na dhu kapai. aa na ded'e le kristus, dhèu dhu hag'e nare ho j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu paredha suku aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: they have conquered him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. and they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
target_text: a'ari èdhi sèra ka dhu segi mege naga èèna, dhu uru èèna pèci sasala mi rèngu, lula raa ana kalèbho dhu suti sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo ra. a'ari èdhi segi ne kahèi, lula rèngu bani lole lii holo-nori lamatua. masi ka dhèu nasa ho neo pamadhe si, te ngaa ra bege boe.

source_text: therefore rejoice, o heavens, and you who dwell in them! but woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.
target_text: de aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu sorga hud'i karej'e-karae ku! te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha hud'i bori pa'èra ku, lula mamadhe-mamopo oe bèbhe mai lèke miu. dhèu aae nidhu puru mai le ètu talora aae miu. nèngu nasa titu kèna, lula ne'a, na, lod'o ho nèngu tao bhabhelu, oe èle kèna!

source_text: and when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
target_text: ropa mege naga ne'a, na, nèngu dhu ra core le asa rai-haha, ka la'e dènge tenge bhèni dhu nara iisi ana èèna, ho neo paj'èra ne.

source_text: but the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
target_text: te ngaa ra hia bhèni ne èla dua, nuka sèmi èla manea luji, sèna ka na lela la'e lu'u asa d'ara mamoo dhu pakaj'èu nèti mege naga. ètu era nèi, ra ladhe-leru ne, toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta.

source_text: then from the mouth of the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
target_text: ropa nèdhi nare sèmi èèna, hèia mege naga ne sabhuu èi, nuka sèmi èi aae lala, ho neo hae nèti bhèni ne.

source_text: but the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that had poured from the dragon's mouth.
target_text: te ngaa rai-haha bara bhèni ne, dènge j'ara pacangange rai, ho dhèla aa'i mèu-mèu èi ne, dhu kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a mege naga, sèna ka baku d'ai bhèni ne.

source_text: and the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of god and hold to the testimony of jesus. and the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
target_text: ka mege naga ne nasa titu kèna dènge bhèni ne. hèia la'e pamusu dènge ana-ana leo nèti bhèni ne, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua, aa dhu loe boe nèti peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: then i saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. there were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu ci'u dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhasi. badha ne, kètu na pidhu, aa tadhu na canguru. ètu kolo tadhu na sèra, dhu pake solo dhèu aae. ètu kètu na sèra, dhu suri lii-lii pakarehe ama lamatua.

source_text: the beast i saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. and the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
target_text: ngi'u na, sama sèmi meo aasu. haga na, èci èèna ka dènge haga kiu aau. hèb'a na sèmi hèb'a singa. mege naga èèna pangèd'u koasa na mi badha bhelu ne, ho madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha, aa pake koasa na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: one of the heads of the beast appeared to be mortally wounded. but the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
target_text: ètu kètu èci nèti badha bhelu ne, abhu era hisu aae èci, nuka sèmi dhu ra pare ne ka oe madhe, te ngaa madhe boe. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne malaa, ropa ladhe rèdhi a'èra na, ka dhèu se madhutu ne.

source_text: they worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?
target_text: dhèu se pahaha iisi ra mi mege naga ne, dènge ded'e padedha-dedha ne nuka sèmi lamatua, lula mege ne ka dhu pangèd'u koasa na mi badha bhelu èèna. dhèu sèra koa-kio kahèi badha bhelu ne, peka na, nèngu ne kapai titu kèna! abhu boe èci sa dhu bisa segi ne!

source_text: the beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke badha bhelu ne, sèna ka na padedha iisi na, aa padhai lii pakarehe lamatua. hia ne ijin kahèi, ho nèd'u paredha toke d'ai tèlu tèu dènge ca èta nuka 42 èpa nguru dua hèru.

source_text: and the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against god and to slander his name and his tabernacle-those who dwell in heaven.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu pea ètu sorga.

source_text: then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke ne kahèi, ho pamusu lab'a dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, toke na segi. na abhu koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha suku aa'i-aa'i, udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, lii aa'i-aa'i, aa kabarai aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast-all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life belonging to the lamb who was slain.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sogo-tagu badha bhelu èèna, nuka rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ngara ra suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. uru èèna dhèu pamadhe ana kalèbho èèna, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu dhu suri nare le ngara-ngara nèti dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra ètu d'ara sasuri na. dhu peka na, pe rèngu sèra ka dhu unu mamuri taa-taa, toke d'ai mia-mia dènge nèngu.

source_text: he who has an ear, let him hear:
target_text: nanene paie-iie!

source_text: if anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed. here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pama'ète nare le, dhèu cee ka dhu hud'i lèke kèpe, pe ra kèpe rare ne. aa ladhe lamatua pama'ète nare le, dhèu cee ka dhu hud'i madhe ku dènge samala, pe ra pamadhe nèngu pake samala kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua baku hari kabodho, te èèna hia ra tebho ho madhutu taruu dènge parcaya na taa-taa!

source_text: then i saw another beast rising out of the earth. this beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
target_text: èle, hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu dhu leo ci'u, bhodho nèti rai-haha. tadhu na dua, nuka sèmi tadhu kahib'i-kalèbho. lii na nuka sèmi lii mege naga.

source_text: and this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
target_text: nèngu nèti lii padhai lamatua na, nuka badha bhelu dhu uru èèna, dhu lèke pare ka oe madhe. na abhu koasa nèti lamatua na, sèna ka na laka-seti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i ho sogo-tagu lamatua na.

source_text: and the second beast performed great signs to cause even fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.
target_text: nèngu tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu kapai kahèi, toke na bisa papuru ai nèti dedha-liru, ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ka badha bhelu ka dua ne, pake koasa nèti lamatua na, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu rai-haha. na paredha dhèu ho tao mèdha sogo-tagu cue, rupa na nuka sèmi lamatua na, sèna ka ra pakab'ua lamatua na, dhu uru èèna dhèu pare ne, ka oe madhe.

source_text: the second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke kahèi, badha dhu kapod'e-kabèli ne, ho na hia a'ae, sèna ka pamamuri mèdha sogo-tagu ne. nèti èèna ka, mèdha sogo-tagu ne bisa padhai lii, ho pua pamadhe dhèu dhu ro'o boe pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and the second beast required all people small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
target_text: badha dhu kapod'e-kabèli ne laka-seti dhèu kahèi, sèna ka tao tadha mi ai g'ana ra, do mi katangarèi ra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i, nuka ana iiki-dhèu kapai, dhèu kaja-dhèu unu aad'o, dhèu ènu, do dhèu mardeka, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i abhu ku cap èèna.

source_text: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark-the name of the beast or the number of its name.
target_text: te ladhe aad'o, dhèu sèra bisa boe pahia do pahèli ngaa-ngaa. ètu d'ara cap ne, dhu suri ngara badha bhelu ka èci, dènge nomer na.

source_text: here is a call for wisdom: let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
target_text: de hud'i pangee paie-iie! dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu bisa re'a sasoa nèti nomer èèna. nuka 666 èna ngasu èna nguru èna, dhu paj'uj'u mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: then i looked and saw the lamb standing on mount zion, and with him 144, 000 who had his name and his father's name written on their foreheads.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a boti kètu, kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho dhu titu ètu kolo ledhe iiki èci. ngara na ledhe sion. na titu dènge dhèu na 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara ana kalèbho, dènge ngara ama na.

source_text: and i heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. and the sound i heard was like harpists strumming their harps.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru. lii ne kadèru sèmi lii bèbhe naha dhasi kapai, aa dou sèmi lii d'oro. te ngaa lii ne culi be'a titu kèna, nuka sèmi dhèu ae dhu karihu sasadhu.

source_text: and they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. and no one could learn the song except the 144, 000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu se, dhu titu tangare asa madha ama lamatua, dènge badha aae èpa ngi'u dhu reo rare kadera paredha lamatua, aa dènge katua-katua sèra. dhèu ae-ae se sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci. lii sod'a ne, dhodhoka rèngu di dhu re'a, dhèu leo aad'o. te rèngu dhu pabe'a le dènge lamatua, lula lamatua pake raa ana na, ho sui si nèti sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: these are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. they follow the lamb wherever he goes. they have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to god and to the lamb.
target_text: mamuri rèngu mola-mèci le, nuka sèmi mone kalora iisi dhu pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge dhèu bhèni. rèngu parai eele boe dènge ana kalèbho èèna, sad'i asa era mia èèna ka, lula ama lamatua sui le rèngu pake raa ana na, sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge hua hela dhu uru tèka nèti d'ara oka hia mi lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: and no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
target_text: rèngu dhu re'a boe padhai lii leko-monya, lula d'ara ra mola.

source_text: then i saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth-to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua ca dhèu hari mai nèti sorga. ana pajuu ne dhu lela dedha titu kèna, ho rodhe palème lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu ma'ète boe ciki sa. na lela palème era, ho peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti lii aa'i-aa'i, dènge negara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and he said in a loud voice, fear god and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. worship the one who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.
target_text: na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, miu hud'i pakab'ua ku ama lamatua! miu hud'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na dhu dedha risi eele! lula lod'o na d'ai le, ho lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i madhutu tatao ra. koa-kio ne! ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula nèngu ka paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha. aa nèti paredha na, ka dhasi dènge madha èi j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: then a second angel followed, saying, fallen, fallen is babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, dhu mai madhutu ana pajuu dhu mai uru èèna. na lii, aku nèngu na, laho eele le! laho mae-mae le! kota babel dhu kapai na, laho le! kota dhu bhelu èèna, guri eele le pamera dènge rai. uru èèna, kota ne, nuka sèmi bhèni kajeo dhu laka-seti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne ho rinu mahu, aa madhutu dad'èi na, ka ad'u-ue j'ara makae. te ngaa limuri ne kota ne, pasae nare le pala na nèti nanasa lamatua.

source_text: and a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, if anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai madhutu ana pajuu ka dua deo na. na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, mata unu mi! dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do abhu cap ètu katangarèi, do ètu kacui-aai, pe rèngu pasae rare nanasa lamatua!

source_text: he too will drink the wine of god's anger, poured undiluted into the cup of his wrath. and he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the lamb.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a lamatua mesa na sabhori mai nanasa na mi dedha rèngu, nuka sèmi na panginu si èi uuru nèti èi anggor pèd'u. èèna na core si asa d'ara èi nasu dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu loe boe ciki sa. ana pajuu na nèti sorga sèra, aa ana kalèbho èèna kahèi ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne'e.

source_text: and the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.
target_text: peka ka laa, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do rèngu dhu lèke le cap na, pe dui rare j'aj'èra taa-taa. sèb'u nèti j'aj'èra rèngu bhodho mai loe boe mèu-mèda.

source_text: here is a call for the perseverance of the saints who keep the commandments of god and the faith of jesus. and i heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, blessed are the dead-those who die in the lord from this moment on. yes, says the spirit, they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.
target_text: de se'e se, sasoa na, dhèu unu ama lamatua, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie lii paredha na, aa parcaya taruu mi yesus, aa baku hari kabodho. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri ku sèmi ne'e: karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, ladhe ra madhe, rèngu abhu oto. hèia roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhaa, peka na, tare'a! bèli-camèd'a rèngu sèra oto tare'a-re'a! lula rèngu j'èra le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa ra taha ho madhutu taruu lamatua. de èèna na, lamatua b'ala j'aj'èra rèngu, ka rèngu mamuri j'èra heka ètu sorga.

source_text: and i looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like the son of man, with a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a padoa kètu. kaca'a laa, kèdhi ra'i-liru dhu pudhi lao-lao, aa ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha na. dhèu ne, oe sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake dènge solo juara dhu tao nèti hualaa, aa nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci.

source_text: then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the one seated on the cloud, swing your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest; for the crop of the earth is ripe.
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu èci hari nèti sorga, kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. na rodhe dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, pake hela èu èèna ho lamu puu-g'ètu ka! te d'ai le hèru pakaboko isi rai.

source_text: so the one seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru ne, kèpe nare hela na, ka na la'e puu-g'ètu. hèia na oru kaboko isi rai nèti rai-haha.

source_text: then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo hari ca dhèu kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. nèngu nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci, ho neo g'ètu hua aj'u.

source_text: still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu dhu leo hari èci kalua nèti era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. sasab'a ana pajuu ne, nuka j'aga ai ètu era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. na pa'oo pua ana pajuu dhu nèd'u hela pare j'u'u deo na, aku nèngu na, pake ka hela èu èèna, ho lamu ka g'ètu hua aj'u ètu rai-haha! te ètu nèi, hua anggor dhu madhasa aa'i le.

source_text: so the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of god's wrath.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne kèpe nare ka hela pare j'u'u na la'e asa rai-haha, ho na g'ètu hua anggor, j'ue dènge ii kateme. hèia na pamaso hua anggor se asa d'ara bak pacèli anggor. ka ra j'èli marèu anggor se, sèna ka rare èi. j'èli marèu hua anggor ètu d'ara bak pacèli ne, sasoa na, nanasa lamatua.

source_text: and the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1, 600 stadia.
target_text: bak pacèli ne ètu li'u kota. ropa ra j'èli marèu anggor se, hèia raa kalua ae-ae. raa ne hae sama sèmi loko cue, dhu madhera na tèlu ngasu kilo, aa marèma na d'ai ca meter ca èta.

source_text: then i saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of god is completed.
